ownerUpdates.text:
Your October Self-Care Reminder ✨

You've been taking care of everything. Now it's time to take care of yourself. 🤍

Between work, daily responsibilities, and busy schedules, it's easy to forget to make time for yourself.

So here's your little reminder:
💆‍♀️ Take a break.
🌿 Slow down and relax.
💧 Give your skin the care it deserves.
✨ Do something that makes you feel good.

Sometimes, all you need is a peaceful hour and a refreshing facial to feel a little more like yourself again.

Make your next self-care moment a Korean facial experience at Jasmin.

Travelers From Around the World Choose Jasmin 🌍

Different countries. Different journeys. One place to relax. 🌍🤍

We’re always happy to welcome travelers and guests from around the world to Jasmin Korean Facial Spa.

Whether you’ve just arrived in Bangkok or you’re taking a break between adventures, our team is here to make your facial experience comfortable, relaxing, and easy.

✨ Authentic Korean facial techniques
💬 English-speaking staff
📍 Convenient Bangkok locations
💆‍♀️ Personalized facial care

Thank you to all our international guests for trusting us with your skin. 💛

Visiting Bangkok? We’d love to welcome you

Your Premium Reset After a Long Trip

Your vacation should include time to do absolutely nothing. 🤍

Take 100 minutes away from your busy Bangkok itinerary with our P11 Korean-Style Premium Anti-Aging & Anti-Wrinkle Treatment.

Combining no-needle mesotherapy with our signature Korean-style facial massage, P11 is designed to deeply hydrate, refresh, and leave your skin looking smoother and healthier.

✨ Hydration & plumpness
✨ Smoother-looking skin
✨ Premium Korean facial care
✨ Relaxation after a long journey

Sometimes the best part of traveling is slowing down.

Coming to Bangkok? Add this to your itinerary. 🇹🇭✨

🍜 Try amazing Thai food
🛍️ Go shopping
🛕 Explore the temples
☕ Discover cute cafés
💆‍♀️ Get a facial

After all the walking, shopping, sunshine, and sightseeing, treat yourself to a relaxing skin reset at Jasmin Korean Facial Spa.

This September, travelers can enjoy special prices on selected P2, P7 & P11 facial treatments. ✈️

🚆 Convenient for your Bangkok itinerary

Just Landed in Bangkok?

Hours on a plane and changes in climate can leave your skin feeling dry, tight, and tired.

Meet P2 Skin Regeneration & Nourishing Treatment : 75-minute facial designed to restore moisture and nourish dry, stressed skin.

✨ Deep hydration & nourishment
✨ Supports the skin barrier
✨ Helps skin feel soft and comfortable again

September Traveler Special
1,400 THB → 1,290 THB

Your Bangkok adventure starts with refreshed skin. 🇹🇭

What Traveling Does to Your Skin

Your vacation might be relaxing… but traveling can be stressful for your skin. ✈️

Long flights, changing climates, Bangkok’s heat, sun exposure, pollution, and lack of sleep can leave your skin:

💧 Dry & dehydrated
☀️ Dull after sun exposure
🌆 Congested from sweat & pollution
😴 Tired-looking from busy travel days

A little extra care can help your skin feel fresh and comfortable again.

This September, discover our Traveling Promotion with special prices on P2, P7 & P11.

Rainy Season Glow Starts Here ✨

Just because the weather is gloomy doesn’t mean your skin has to be.

The rainy season is the perfect time to focus on hydration, balance, and professional skin care. Regular facial treatments can help keep your skin feeling fresh, healthy, and radiant despite the humidity and daily stress.

Give your skin the care it deserves this season.

Which Facial Is Best for the Rainy Season? ☔

Not all skin concerns are the same. Here’s a quick guide to help you choose:

🌿 Oily or acne-prone skin
→ P3 Pore Tightening & Sebum Control

💧 Dry or dehydrated skin
→ P6 Collagen Extra Plus Rejuvenating

✨ Dull and tired-looking skin
→ P7 Oxygen Jet Skin Brightening

💎 Premium anti-aging care
→ P11 Korean Style Premium Anti-Aging & Anti-Wrinkle

Not sure which treatment is right for you? Our team is happy to help recommend the best option for your skin.

Feeling Tired? Your Skin Can Show It Too ☁️

Long commutes, grey skies, busy schedules, and less sunshine can leave you feeling drained and your skin often reflects it.

You may notice:
✨ Dull-looking skin
✨ Lack of radiance
✨ Tired appearance
✨ Uneven texture

Sometimes all your skin needs is a boost of hydration and revitalization.

Our P7 Oxygen Jet Skin Brightening treatment helps refresh tired skin and restore a healthy-looking glow.

📲 Book your skin refresh today

How to Keep Your Skin Fresh on Rainy Days 🌿

A few simple habits can help your skin stay healthy during the rainy season:

✔ Cleanse gently morning and night
✔ Keep your skin hydrated
✔ Wear sunscreen even on cloudy days
✔ Avoid touching your face unnecessarily
✔ Schedule regular facial care to keep pores clean

Small changes can make a big difference when it comes to maintaining clear, balanced skin.

reviews.name: Vi
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at Jasmine Korean Facial Spa in Asok. I went in for a facial with extractions and pore tightening, and everything was done so thoroughly without feeling rushed.

Rat, the specialist who worked on me, was amazing — super detail-oriented, gentle, and really took her time to make sure everything was properly cleaned without being overly harsh on my skin. You can tell she really cares about her work.

One thing I didn’t expect (but loved) was that while my face mask was drying, they gave me a hand and foot massage, which made the whole experience feel even more relaxing and thoughtful.

The price was also extremely affordable and fair for the level of care and service you receive, which makes it even more worth it.

My skin feels so clean, smooth, and refreshed after. Definitely one of the better facials I’ve had in Bangkok — I’ll be coming back for sure.

title: Solmassage.bkk
ownerDescription:
SOLmassage.bkk is a wellness massage studio located in the Saphan Khwai area of Bangkok, dedicated to providing high-quality therapeutic massages in a warm, calming environment.
The idea of SOLmassage.bkk was born from a desire to offer more than just a massage - it was to create a space of tranquility and genuine care. The name "SOL" is inspired by the Spanish word for "sun", symbolizing warmth, renewal, and positive energy.

Vangvela in Bangkok is one of the better massage spots I’ve been to.

The setting is what makes it stand out. It’s quiet and calming the second you walk in.

The head spa is the highlight. They use a water sprayer that circles around your head while they’re working, and it actually feels really relaxing. Combined with the scalp massage, you can feel the tension release.

Nothing feels rushed. They take their time and the whole experience is just easy and calming.

If you want something different from a regular massage and actually want to relax, this place is worth it.

reviews.name: Raya Albusaidi
reviews.text: I had an incredible head spa experience at Vangvela Spa and Sleep Salon in Bangkok! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was soothing and inviting. The expert staff made me feel right at home, and the treatment itself was pure bliss. My scalp and hair felt rejuvenated, leaving me refreshed and relaxed. To top it all off, they serve a delicious sweet treat (the dessert was a highlight!) after the session. I can't wait to visit again! I highly recommend Vangvela to anyone looking for a top-notch head spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Melisa Wee
reviews.text: Very refreshing and relaxing experience especially after a long day’s work! Thanks to my daughter’s recommendation! Will come back again when I am back in BKK next time.

reviews.name: Aliya Elge
reviews.text: I came multiples times and it's been fantastic every time. The girls are truly wonderful. They're very attentive and caring. A special thank you to Yamin, who is incredibly talented. All her work is perfect. She is so gentle and kind. Thank you again! 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Lilly Chantha
reviews.text: Very relaxing. Calm and peaceful. The staffs are nice and professional. I would come back when I’m in Bangkok. This place is a hidden gem.

reviews.name: Bundit Chanaphot
reviews.text: My first time at a Vietnamese spa, and it was incredibly relaxing! The entrance is next to the barbershop, on the second floor. We opted for the 990฿ package, which included a 7-step treatment for 1 hour: a facial, hair wash, and neck, shoulder, and back massage. It was amazing! I chose medium to firm pressure, which felt perfect. I'll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Miya Yeshayahu
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience here! The treatment was amazing, relaxing, and exactly what I needed. A special thank you to my therapist, Kob, who was so professional, kind, and attentive. I felt completely relaxed and taken care of throughout the whole session. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back!♥️

reviews.name: Hafsa Hafsa
reviews.text:
I visited Vangvela Spa in Bangkok for their 7-step head massage and loved every single moment of the experience. I discovered this place through a TikTok recommendation, and it truly lived up to the hype.
My therapist, Yamin, was absolutely wonderful. She had the perfect balance of a firm yet deeply relaxing touch, and I honestly fell asleep during the massage. Throughout the session, she treated me with so much respect, making sure my body was properly covered at every step, which made me feel very comfortable and at ease.
The staff at the spa were all incredibly smiley, welcoming, and helpful. At the end of the treatment, Yamin kindly dried and styled my hair, which was such a thoughtful finishing touch. She also offered to take some pictures for me during the massage, which I really appreciated.
If you’re looking for the best head massage in Bangkok, I would highly recommend booking Vangvela Spa. I loved this place and cannot wait to come back again :))

reviews.name: Vindy Kariyawasam
reviews.text: From start to finish, the spa experience was incredibly relaxing and enjoyable. I especially loved the face masks and the high-quality products they used throughout. The staff were extremely attentive and made us feel so welcomed — from the refreshing welcome drinks to the soothing green tea and the delicious sago snack. Every detail was thoughtfully curated. Truly a wonderful experience!”

reviews.name: Assya
reviews.text: Had one of the best experience @ VANGVELA SPA! The massage & head spa were done perfectly to my needs! A much needed spa after so many days of walking. My hair looks refreshed and alive. Truly a wonderful, and I would most definitely come back when I’m back im Bangkok. ❤️ I would definitely recommend to those who are in Bangkok to come VANGVELA SPA!

reviews.name: Graeme Cuizon
reviews.text: Best place to get the head spa, it was relaxing and I fell asleep holy moly , the treatment was amazing and it’s feel so refreshed. 10/10 recommended.

reviews.name: janani pokkuluri
reviews.text: Loved the entire experience. I took the 10 step process for 2 hours and I just passed out with how good the massage and the experience was . 100% highly recommend

reviews.name: Em A
reviews.text: The shop looks very nice, and the staff are very friendly. I had a head spa treatment that was so wonderful I didn't want it to end; I almost fell asleep from relaxation. My boyfriend had a scalp treatment and he's also more than satisfied! His scalp feels amazing. If we're ever in Bangkok again, we'll definitely come back.

reviews.name: Tanya van Schoor
reviews.text: This was a really lovely spa experience at an affordable price. The staff were so kind and professional. The facilities were clean and offered a very luxurious feel. The treatment was great and included a head massage, thorough wash, neck and shoulder rub, face wash/ massage and mask. They even did a proper blowout at the end. Highly recommend for a more affordable head spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Zara Gomez
reviews.text: Loved our experience with Vangvela Spa today. The team were very accommodating to fit my boyfriend and I into their busy schedule. I have been wanting to come here for months and came all the way from Australia. Very relaxing! My hair is so soft and shiny. The spa is very clean ✨ Looking forward to coming back again.

reviews.name: shilpa banerjee
reviews.text:
Amazing people and amazing service. Da and khak were amazing . The massage the ambience . Special the candle treatment and the scalp massage was amazing. The full 2 hours were totally worth it.
And the tea served later with that amazing dessert was simply sugar to the eye . 😘🙏🫡

reviews.name: Esther Flatters
reviews.text: Incredible experience I just had the headspa, my therapist was very calming, professional, and extremely relaxing. She was sensitive to my shoulder injury and made me feel Wondeful. Thank you!!

reviews.name: Udonthedewgong -3-
reviews.text: Amazing experience here! from the head spa to the friendliest people, the experience was really nice. my therapist was Kob and she made sure everything was okay for me throughout the whole session.

reviews.name: Isaiah Segovia
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I came to try the viral Vangvela despite seeing some reviews. Let me tell you everything about this place was great. I don’t typically do face mask and all that. It was very soothing, the ladies were very professional and beyond nice. You must try it. From the head massage, neck, chest, and scalp. It was very well worth it! Would definitely come back again. Thanks again! Treat yourself

reviews.name: Julie M
reviews.text:
What a hidden gem!
We stumbled upon Vangvela Hair Spa near our Airbnb, and I’m so glad we did. From the moment I walked in, I felt completely welcomed and at ease. The spa has such a clean, cozy, and relaxing vibe—it was exactly what I needed.

I had the pleasure of being taken care of by their ladies staff, and the experience was nothing short of amazing. I chose the second-tier package, which came with multiple soothing massages throughout the session. Talk about feeling pampered!

I’ve struggled with dandruff for most of my life, but after the treatment and air dry, I couldn’t spot a single flake—my scalp was clean and my hair felt noticeably softer and healthier right away.

The entire staff was kind, skilled, and made me feel right at home. All this at such reasonable prices, too. Thank you, ladies, for such a rejuvenating and unforgettable experience. I’ll definitely be back! 💆‍♀️✨

title: Natural touch massage & nails @ L building Ratchathewi
ownerDescription:
Discover a peaceful retreat in the city at Natural Touch Massage & Nails @ L Building Ratchathewi. Located on the M floor inside L Building, just a short walk from BTS Ratchathewi, our spacious and private setting offers a warm, welcoming atmosphere where relaxation comes naturally.

Our professional and friendly staff provide a wide variety of high-quality services including Thai massage, full body massage, couple massage, body scrub, face massage, nail care, and spa treatments. Whether you’re unwinding solo or enjoying time with a loved one, every visit promises a great experience at an affordable price.

Treat yourself to the care you deserve – book in advance or walk in and let us take care of the rest.

reviews.name: Wa Lun Cheung
reviews.text: It is a very clean place. The masseurs there I have experienced was very professional. I highly suggest whoever wants a massage there to specific about your level of hard or easy to the masseurs in order to get the best experience. Don’t be shy. I have did s 350 bhats foot massage there for an hour.

reviews.name: Kletdoaw Sincharoenkul
reviews.text:
They offer “special value packages” with unbeatable price! I booked and paid 790 Baht for “All in one Touch” package for 2 hrs with oil added.
The therapist P’ Ly really delivered. I felt really nice afterwards. They’re fast to communicate and receive booking on Facebook messenger too which is really convenient for customers.

The only thing I’m not so fond of is that during my visit, the welcome area was so packed with customers that it was almost difficult to walk past to the massage room.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience and kind words about our All in One Touch package and P’Ly’s massage 🌿
We’re really happy to hear you felt great afterwards and appreciated our quick communication.

We’re sorry about the crowded welcome area during your visit — it can get quite lively at times! We truly appreciate your feedback and will keep improving the flow for a more relaxing arrival experience.

Hope to welcome you again soon.

reviews.name: Noa Ramírez
reviews.text: This was an amazing experience! I did a Traditional Thai Massage for 1 hour and it was incredible. The lady was very kind and professional, you could tell she knew what she was doing. She stretched and massaged my body and it was very relaxing. After that they gave me a cup of hot tea and a small herbal inhaler as a gift. If I come back to Bangkok I'll definitely come back here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review 🙏
We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed your Traditional Thai Massage experience with us.

It means a lot to know that you felt relaxed and well taken care of by our therapist 

We’re also glad you enjoyed the small touches like our herbal tea and inhaler — we always want our guests to leave feeling refreshed and cared for 

We truly look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit to Bangkok

reviews.name: jerelyn suayan
reviews.text: This Thai massage is a must try after a week of touring and roaming around Bangkok and Pattaya. The relaxing ambiance, amenities and the SERVICE exceeded our expectation. This place is highly recommended especially to those who are near Pratunam. Also, a five star review to the therapist.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review 🙏
We’re delighted to hear that our service and ambiance exceeded your expectations.

It means a lot to be recommended as a must-try place, especially for travelers in the Pratunam area 
We hope to welcome you again on your next trip to Bangkok

reviews.name: Natalie Ramos
reviews.text:
This might be more of a massage parlor than nail salon tbh. They respond back in WhatsApp very prompt and will give prices to any combo you ask. I had several places saved but didn’t know where I’d end up as the day went on. They were responsive enough so I booked

I got gel nails, removal of gel prior, and foot massage all for 1551 B. It’s a good price for all of this work!

Experience: It was very similar to my nails done back in California since it was loud in the lobby and many people came to check in. The lobby is the same area where you get your nails done. So it can get very loud. A group of Indian men came in to all get massages.

Nails: I got my nails cut and shortened. My natural nail had a break in it from a previous Usage. They didn’t have any patch to put over the nail or any strengthening polish. Also, I asked for almond. I don’t think she knew what that shape was even with the photo so I got more of round. The gel looks a little chunky, depending on how you look at the nails… It’s not too bad, but it’s definitely not the best work.

Other things to know: you pay before you begin service. They take card or cash.
You get tea and water during the service.

Foot massage: I did a 30 minute massage but she went about 45 minutes which was really nice. It felt good. But it was just lotion and oil. I guess I was expecting something different.

Overall it’s okay but I wouldn’t come back. Too loud and gel nails were okay
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for taking the time to share such detailed feedback.
We’re glad you enjoyed our massage and appreciated our team’s friendliness and quick response.
We’re truly sorry to hear that your nail experience and the noise level in the lobby didn’t meet your expectations. Your comments are very valuable and we’ll use them to improve both the nail service quality and atmosphere for a more relaxing experience next time.
We sincerely appreciate your visit and honest review 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Si Anne
reviews.text: I’ve tried about seven or eight massage parlours in Bangkok and this is by far the best in every aspect. The parlour itself is the most charming I’ve seen, definitely as classy as hotel spas. The atmosphere was super relaxing and contrary to other massage parlours where there is the street noise or people talking loudly or where the masseuse are speaking non-stop, the only noise I experienced was the soothing relaxation music and the sound of birds chirping. It was heavenly. The staff were very welcoming, and as for the massage itself, it was the best I’ve had so far. I closed my eyes and she immediately asked if I wanted a warm eye mask. She asked me twice if the pressure was alright for me. And she made sure I was in a comfortable position, rearranging the pillows I’m covering me from the neck down in a plush blanket. I really had a relaxing moment there and I’m definitely going back. The prices range from 100 to 150 baht more than other places, but the difference is absolutely worth it.

reviews.name: Helen Rimmer
reviews.text:
Based on the recommendations we booked a pedicure and aloe massage for my husband, a pedicure and aromatherapy massage for me. Staff were very quick to respond through Line and we were able to get in the next day. When we arrived for the appointment there was confusion and it didn't seem like we expected, which caused a bit of a delay but nothing major. To give them credit the staff are very friendly.

The Pedicure chairs are comfortable enough but your feet are in and out of a dish tub not a sink set up where you are able to soak your feet. I had existing old nail polish and expected that it would be removed with nail polish remover per usual. Nope the tech doing my pedicure just used a nail file to remove it which is horrible for your nails. My husband was left with a raw spot on his foot when the tech got "overzealous" with the scrubbing.

We booked the couples room for our massage which had proper massage tables and was quiet. My husband has stated that his aloe massage was good, decent pressure and the masseuse seemed trained. My massage was not good. The masseuse used her forearms, elbows and knuckles. I asked for a change to the pressure which lasted less than 5 minutes and I had to ask again which lasted about another 5 minutes. I walked out more uncomfortable than I was when we got there.

Overall, our experience was disappointing and much different to what others have had based on their reviews so maybe it was just an off day.

reviews.name: Sam S
reviews.text:
The place itself is smaller than expected, and the front counter can be a bit loud. However, K. Bee is the reason we went back three times during our 9-day trip.

Her skills, professionalism, and warm smile made every session truly enjoyable, honestly the best massages we had in Bangkok. While the spa may not have the quiet, luxury atmosphere of high-end venues, the price (around THB1,150 for a 2-hour hot oil massage, with 10% discount) is very reasonable, and our expectations were met.

We kept coming back purely because of K. Bee. Thank you again, K. Bee, for the wonderful massages and memorable experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such an honest and detailed review 🙏
We truly appreciate your understanding regarding our space and front counter. Most importantly, we’re very grateful for your kind words about K. Bee. Her skill, professionalism, and warm care are something we’re very proud of, and we’ll be sure to share your feedback with her.
We’re honored that you chose to come back multiple times during your trip and hope to welcome you again whenever you’re in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Anthony Do
reviews.text: My cousin and I decided to stop by and get a massage after two long days of traveling. I can say with confidence that this was one of the greatest if not the best massage I’ve ever received. My masseuse was very attentive and on point with the areas I had the most tension in. The space was very clean, tidy and professional. Prices were very affordable and I would come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Anthony! We’re honored you chose to visit us after your travels. It means a lot to hear that you had such a great experience. We hope to welcome you and your cousin back whenever you’re in Bangkok again! 😊

reviews.name: l Wingki
reviews.text: The massage experience is very good. I came here twice in 5 days. Really enjoyable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your lovely review 😊
We’re so glad you enjoyed your massage experience and came back again during your trip, that truly means a lot to us.Looking forward to welcoming you again next time in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Vithu
reviews.text:
The staff were very friendly and polite. The foot massage was excellent – 5/5. They really took their time and even massaged all the way up to our thighs, which we really appreciated. We were also served tea and received two small gifts (fragrances), which was a nice touch.

Unfortunately, the pedicure was very disappointing. It felt rushed, and the work wasn’t done very carefully. On top of that, they cut my big toenail too short, and it started bleeding immediately. All I received was a quick “sorry.” The next day, the wound even became infected.

Because of this, I wouldn’t come back here for a pedicure. However, I would definitely return for a massage. The prices are reasonable, although slightly on the expensive side.

reviews.name: Mel A
reviews.text: Absolutely sensational massage and great service, well priced and a relaxing venue inside a building away from the noisy street. My friend and I had a 90 minute Thai massage plus 30 min hand massage each today which were both bliss. We have come here everyday since being in Bangkok after long days of walking and sightseeing, a great treat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing review 🙏
We’re truly happy to hear that you and your friend enjoyed your massages and had a relaxing experience with us 

It means a lot to know that you chose to visit us almost every day during your stay — that’s the biggest compliment we could receive 

We’re glad you enjoyed both the Thai massage and hand massage after your long days of exploring Bangkok 

We truly look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit

reviews.name: Mergim Beqaj
reviews.text:
Very good experience at Natural Touch, where we got a good welcome, it was clean and nice. We chose 90 minutes full body massage with aroma. I got massaged by Tong and my wife by Jeen, and I chose the hard part, and Tong was a super woman and got deep in every place, and my wife took the gentle part and fell asleep several times during the massage.
Very kind personal and a place we would recommend to others!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for such a detailed and wonderful review 🙏
We’re delighted that both you and your wife enjoyed the 90-minute aroma massage. Thong and Jeen will be very happy to hear your feedback. Thank you for recommending us — it truly means a lot.

reviews.name: Kitrina Cooper
reviews.text: We’re vacationing in Thailand……this is the 1st place that truly is comparable to my massages in America! My lady was Kai, she listened to my injury and was careful, but also able to not baby it too. She knows her techniques and tried some I’ve never had done before. I hope to be back before we leave Thailand

reviews.name: Tawan Moody
reviews.text:
All masseuses are very well trained and all have great personalities to them. I always get the best massage experience here. The entire place is clean and I come back at least once a week.

My only go-to massage place in Bangkok! Natural touch L Building only! 🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so glad that we can give you a blissful experience with us 💕 Thank you so much for visiting and giving us a review🙏🏻 We will do our best to ensure your best experience in the future ! Hope we can serve you soon 😄

reviews.name: Asti
reviews.text: 10/10 when i asked which part i wanted to get the massage the most, they listened and cracked my pain away👌✨✨ very good service and free tea at the end of service, soo soothing 🔥
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Asti! 😊 We’re happy we could focus on the areas you needed most and help you feel better. Enjoying a relaxing cup of tea afterward is the perfect way to finish. We can’t wait to see you again!

reviews.name: Maegan Govan
reviews.text: Honestly the besttt!! Amazing Thai oil massage highly recommend. Place is lovely and clean. Super friendly service and great prices. Also probably the best mani + pedi gel I’ve ever gotten. <3 xxxx

reviews.name: Emily MacNeil
reviews.text: My partner & I did walk ins tonight, we both had oil massages & I got gel nails. I was blown away from start to finish by the service. A very tranquil and nice vibe to the place. It’s very clean. All the staff are super friendly. The massage had me leaving feeling incredible & the tea they served after was so tasty. Thanks ladies!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your amazing review, Emily! It was our pleasure taking care of both your massage and gel nails. We’re delighted you enjoyed the whole experience. Safe travels, and we hope to welcome you back again someday!

reviews.name: vinCe kaka
reviews.text: Good massage techniques. Loosen my muscles nicely. Must try if nearby here after a days of walking.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re glad you enjoyed the massage and felt relief from your muscle tension.
Perfect after a long day exploring Bangkok.

Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Evangeline L
reviews.text: Mixed review here. I went twice - first time on a Thursday afternoon and had a very good massage by a kind and friendly lady. I then brought my friends back on a Sat evening and was very disappointed - my masseuse this time was kind of lazy, didn’t use much strength, cut short the time, and had a long face throughout. My friends and I thought perhaps they’d had a long day and we had wrongly chosen to come at the end of the day on a weekend. Just something to note.

reviews.name: Jeffrey Lim
reviews.text: Very professional Masseur No. 35 for my neck, legs and body area. Recommend you to try.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text:
Hands down most miserable and painful massage of my life.

And it's a shame because we got one there day before with no problems.

This was done by a guy listening to loud podcasts on his earpods.
Usually with the shoulders they go down to the shoulderblades, work the entire neck and head.

This 20 min shoulder portion consisted soly of rotating between poking the top of the neck and rubbing the temples with full force. There was no coherent system and one side was "massaged" for a much longer.
This guy couldnt care less. I wouldnt even care that he stepped out for 5 minutes to get his headphones and then finished before my friends massage did. There were no slippers offered in the beginning and no water at the end, it doesnt matter.
I have a pain in my neck and a headache that persists.

Reference: 16th march at around 23:30, foot, shoulders, back with tigerbalm

reviews.text: It was horrible. It completely ruined my mood. The masseuse reeked of cigarette smoke. Her hands were soaking wet and her fingers had long, claw-like nails. Oh my God, I never, ever want to go back.

reviews.name: 涂宇
reviews.text:
This is a new shop I think,new and Really good massage place to relax and enjoy the Thai massage,the massager is a little bit too strong haha but still feels very good.even thought it is close to a club area after u get inside it is not loud at all.such a nice door.
And I like the shop style a lot,a really good looking massager shop,with old European style,I guess the boss really payed a lot for it,and it really works.
I will come back again for sure: P

reviews.name: R U

This is my first time to go here and I think that they gave such a great impression. I will look for you when I return to Bangkok, Mr 75! Your hands healed me tonight. I will miss it when I am back home for sure.

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text: Great massage service, really good clean and private environment. Price is much worthy compared to their services. Great massage place. Wonderful experience.

reviews.name: Therese Zhang
reviews.text:
I strongly don't recommend any women, especial single women or any people who makeup, to try Thai massage in this shop.
First of all, the big actions you think are completely no, and you can almost feel that they are not pressed in the right place.
Then, it will RUIN YOUR MAKEUP without notice and rude attitude!!! My masseur didn't give me any word and directly destroyed my makeup, especially my eyebrows. i don't know how they got these positive comments.
Or just because I'm a skinny-looking single woman, so they think it's ok just ignore me and i will go asap.

reviews.name: R K
reviews.text: It was a great 60-minute foot massage with no. 76. he‘s such a kind guy. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Sugar Tata
reviews.text: I was there with a friend of mine who had Thai massage while I got foot massage. The masseur was telling from the start he hurt his hands and was not able to do harder massage.Why not taking a day break instead.The massage was way too soft  for my liking After massage he didn’t hand out the bottle of water to me as I might not have given him enough tip as he expected. reviews.name: Jonny G
reviews.text: Amazing massage and very relaxing environment. We came in by chance and had a leg and foot massage with 103 after our long flight, I would highly recommend Olivia’s. I will be back!

reviews.name: Tom Soap
reviews.text: I paid 1250 baht for 2 hour massage. My therapist was Gong. Half way through, he asked if I want a happy ending for 1500 baht tip. I said no and he got very mad at me. He ended the massage after 1.5 hour. I still gave him a good tip at the end to be nice, but he didn’t say thank you or look at me anymore. I regret tipping, instead, I should ask the shop owner for some money back. When I walk out, no one attended me to help get my shoes or say thank you. Don’t feel welcomed at all. Never again.

reviews.name: MUSA NOVA
reviews.text: Can’t recommend it highly enough!! Amazing professionals of their jobs. If you are in the area - this is the place to go for a really good quality massage

I choose Mr. Big No.91
he's done amazing job very professional I usually come back here to do massage with him. Recommended to call to book him first. Any further symptoms or any pain or any specific spot to massage you may let him know before do massage. After finish I sleep so well

reviews.name: Tmt M
reviews.text: The best massage place I ever experienced. Receptionist M’s Tan .is such a helpful and take very good care of whole group of our friend. Highly recommended aroma oil massage & body scrubs service here. Reasonable price fantastic service.will come back soon.

reviews.name: 육지엘
reviews.text: (16.06.2024) Conclusion, it's very disappointing. I came to Thailand once a month and got a massage once or twice a day, but this was the second worst. I had a lot of luggage in both hands, but I should change pants in the bathroom, so I held my luggage and weared my pants. Even the pants were defective(without straps). Until then,  I thought that as long as the massage was good, all of this would be okay.  Unfortunately, The masseuse was not qualified. He talked to the person next to him or looked at his cell phone. He was away for four minutes in the middle. He didn't go to smoke e-cigarettes, did him? Fundamentally, He don't have any understanding of massage. It's clear that he don't know which muscle to press. He just pressed the skin(just the same part). I kept looking at the clock because I wanted to quit on it because I didn't want to waste time. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for sharing your review.  We are really happy with 5 stars youve given. Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Sammuel Wong
reviews.text: This store located in the Massage Street in OnNut. I have been here for couple times and finally wrote a review. In my opinion to determine how good is a massage shop, is not only the value of what you pay. But you have to try couples different Masseur/Masseuse. Overall 80% of them have great skill and very high standard. You hardly book the same Massage Therapist unless you call in advance (could be a day or 2 in advance). One unique package that I like to point out is their 90 mins foot, head and shoulder massage is what I love to do over there. This store was recommended in many different FB group posts.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are surprised with your detailed review. Satisfaction depends on what kind of therapy she or he is, but I think all of our therapeutics are above average. reviews.name: S L

reviews.name: Jarle fds
reviews.text:
My first bad review on google, reserved for when its deserved.
Useually I say you get what you pay for, but ive had far better experiences at the same price.

Bad massage, and uncomfortable room.
The massage was more painful than relaxing, the massage theraphist had rough hands that did not feel gentle against the skin, and she frequently used a lot of power breaking me out of relaxation.
This would be fine if thats I bought, but I specifically bought Aroma massage cus that was suppose to be gentle and relaxing.
The room was also way to warm, and when I asked if we could lower the temperature she made me change bed….
Eventually I had to leave early, cus the massage just brought me pain and absolutely no relaxation, there was no reason to stay. I will not pay to be uncompfortable for 2 hrs, its the opposite of what this place is suppose to be…
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.
Our aroma massage is designed to be gentle and relaxing. However, we understand that pressure preference can vary greatly from person to person. Some guests prefer stronger pressure, while others prefer a softer touch. We are always happy to adjust the pressure at any time if informed, and we sincerely wish we had the opportunity to better tailor the session to your comfort.
Regarding the room temperature, your session was one of the first of the day, and the air conditioning had just been turned on. It can take some time for the room to reach a comfortable temperature. We apologize if this caused any discomfort during your visit.

It’s been my best Thai masaage place from 10 years ago.

reviews.name: Macaquinha Suiza
reviews.text:
Returning customer for many years!

I like the calming atmosphere here. The massage space is partet by curtains for your privacy and is genourously spaced. Lots of plants, fans and decorations. Staff is welcoming and friendly.

Coming to the massages ... well it really depends who's doing it! I had brilliant massages here but unfortunately also some they felt not well executed. Aromatherapy was a disappointment. No essential oils, only a massage oil with a very dull coconut scent. I wouldn't consider this a massage it felt more someone is creaming up your body.
The other day I had a herbal stamp massage which was very nicely done. Right pressure for the massage and temperature of the stamps just right.
Thai massage I enjoyed the most - perfect amount of stretching, deep tissue pressures and massages.

I would come back as I do for years. Just would wish for better consistency of the quality and knowledge of the therapist.

The massage was brilliant and for the same price as any of the noisy public brightly lit places you get a far more relaxing experience

The facilities are set back from the road in what feels like a little Japanese garden (stone paved paths, a big tree in the middle). The staff are so friendly and offer you tea before and after your massage.

Cannot recommend enough and I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in Bangkok!

After the massage you get a nice tea and fill out an experience form.
I recommend ✨

reviews.name: Yves C
reviews.text:
My wife and I are regular visitors to Thailand and get a Thai massages almost every day when we are here — we know what a good one feels like.
The place looks nice, but unfortunately it was one of the biggest disappointments we've had in Bangkok.
The two masseuses were extremely casual and disengaged the whole time. They spent most of the session chatting with each other. It felt like we were just an inconvenience between their conversation.
There was zero real technique. What’s the difference between a proper Thai massage and elbow grinding painfully into the back or gliding hands over the body? The difference is technique, training and professionalism — and none of that was present here.
Instead of relaxing, the experience actually created stress. When a massage makes you tense up and check the time, something is seriously wrong.
There are plenty of much better options right on Rambuttri Road and around Khao San — places where the therapists are focused, skilled and actually care about giving a proper massage.
We won’t be coming back and we can’t recommend this salon at all.
1 star, only for the nice place

reviews.name: Daniele Boscolo
reviews.text: The ambient is amazing! I loved thai massage with feet massage. It was very relaxing. It was perfect after a long flight.

reviews.name: Jay Ann Cha
reviews.text: We did the Thai herbal compress and it was really good! It was the perfect balance of Thai stretching massage and using the warm relaxing Thai compress to massage. It was a lovely place in a garden but there was mosquito nets, fans and portable AC.

reviews.name: Leonie J
reviews.text: Amazing place! Must go when nearby khao San,  its a little more expensive than the rest of the salons close by but the quality is amazing

reviews.name: Stas B.
reviews.text:
Very good place for the following reasons:

[1] you are actually in a garden - very spacious and pleasant place with nature, forest atmosphere - it's like going to a spa, but for a price of a regular massage. very good deal.

[2] The massage therapists are thorough, give good massage, and are always polite.

reviews.name: Paloma Poblete Riesco
reviews.text:
I visited this place 7 years ago and came back today with my boyfriend. I was attended by “Uy” (sorry if I’m spelling it wrong!). I thanked her in person, but I also wanted to leave this review to recommend her — she was incredibly kind, such a sweet lady.

She did the OIL massage with real care and presence. You can feel when someone is truly connected to what they do, and that was definitely the case. It wasn’t just a routine — she was precise, respectful, calm, and very gentle. I really appreciated how mindful and quiet she was throughout the session.

The setting also adds to the experience: the space is open, with fans and natural air, surrounded by a little green corner that makes everything feel more peaceful and authentic — not like being inside a building. The lighting is soft, perfect for relaxing.

My boyfriend didn’t have the same experience, unfortunately — he felt like his massage was a bit rushed. It lasted the same amount of time, but he didn’t feel the same calm or softness I did.

The only suggestion I would make is about the entrance area — a little visual decluttering would really enhance the ambiance. Right now, you can see lockers, bottles and items that distract a bit from the calm and natural aesthetic. Personally, I think the white tones and wooden elements give a clean and spacious feel. Or, if the idea is to keep the “green jungle” vibe, I would lean fully into that — make it even greener to match the forest-like experience.

Still, I highly recommend this place — especially if you get Uy!

reviews.name: Mel F.
reviews.text: My husband and I arrived when they opened at 10 am. We got 90-minute Thai massages. We were in a tented area together for the massages. Smelled great. Also nice spa music and running water made for a relaxing atmosphere. The massage was definitely not as firm as other Thai massages I’ve had in Thailand, which is the reason I’m giving 4 rather than 5 stars. It was still great!

reviews.name: Lai Carol
reviews.text:
As be a senior massage experiencer, I will say here is the best massage in Bangkok
Definitely high professional massage skill, fair cheap price and good vibes.
When I tried first time and booking for next time immediately 😂
Don’t missed relax and chill place !

reviews.name: Mars Yang
reviews.text:
Cool experience
If you don’t mind it has no AC but only fans
and something special
The therapist has good technique
And careful leading me through whole treatment

I think it will be perfect if it’s raining to come

reviews.name: Ha My Tran
reviews.text: I came here to do foot massage with my family base on the review on the Google. Worthy. I had my 1,5 years old with my and three ladies did massage for us (my mom, my sister and me) were so kind and cheerful

reviews.name: Dani Baribeau
reviews.text: My husband and I used services of 60 minute Thai Massage - very friendly and professional!  Cool tea and foot wash to begin, change into fresh pants and shirt. Full body massage very excellent. Hot tea to end 😋 My brain and body are very happy! Highly recommend for beautiful garden, friendly staff, great service! 👍

reviews.name: Jasper Heldenbergh
reviews.text: Best massage ever! It's one of the few places without people outside trying to get you in. It's a bit hidden, you could easily walk by without noticing. But once you're in, it's heaven. We chose a traditional massage with extra foot massage. 90 mins in total. The therapists where very friendly and extremely professional. I felt reborn.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text: Lovely place, very friendly and excellent massage. I had a 90 minute Thai massage and she had an impeccable sense for finding my tense spots. My friend had the combination of aromaoil massage and feet and was also very happy and satisfied.

title: Arunda oriental massage
address: 16 Soi Phetchaburi 15, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: QG3P+2W Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: LF Chan
reviews.text:
I came bangkok every year ,the quanlity of massage here went down alot from previous years , the masseurs didnt perform similar step for both side of my foot massage,until i ask why right side use stick but left side no use ,only she use it before the massage ends.

Hope the quality can be recover back very soon .

reviews.name: Gan Chloe
reviews.text: I had a great foot scrub and massage. The scrub made my feet feel very soft, and the massage was relaxing with just the right pressure. The place was clean, the staff was friendly, and I left feeling refreshed. I would definitely come back and look for Nueng

reviews.name: James
reviews.text: Best massage in the area hands down and probably the best in Thailand. Very affordable, clean, staff super friendly and attentive. The massage has a standard and it doesn't matter who you get the service is still the best. Ignore all other places trying to undercut Arunda's prices, it's with the extra couple of bucks and the short walk.

reviews.name: ZHAO YIHAN
reviews.text: This massage parlor offers particularly excellent service and a very beautiful environment. The cost-effectiveness is the highest I've ever experienced. The massage experience was perfect. During the massage, I felt so relaxed that I almost fell asleep, but after it was over, I felt very energetic. It felt like all the meridians in my body were unblocked. There was also hot tea available to drink after the massage. It was a truly perfect experience.

reviews.name: Samson Sim
reviews.text:
Went there for neck, shoulder, and back massage for 90 minutes.

The masseuse pays attention to detail, every muscle knot was released.

Cleanliness is average, they provide you with their clothing during massage.

Given the price range, it is considered at the more affordable range, but the value of the massage is worth it.

Definitely recommended.

reviews.name: North Star
reviews.text:
After a long trip and some nagging pain in my upper back, I decided to try a sports massage at Arunda Oriental Massage, and it turned out to be an incredible experience. The therapist was skilled, and the staff were warm and welcoming, making me feel completely at ease. The place was spotless, organized, and maintained a truly professional and respectful atmosphere, nothing inappropriate at all. To wrap things up, they served us tea in a beautiful backyard with a peaceful view.

It was the perfect way to end a relaxing session. 💕💕

reviews.name: Georgina Akiew
reviews.text: Took a 1 hour normal thai massage by a staff named Par. Such a great massager, knows where to pinpoint where your body ache from bottom to top part of the body. Also a nice place to go for a massage, clean soothing environment, has proper rooms with privacy. Definitely will come here again whenever i visit bangkok 🤩🇹🇭❤️

reviews.name: Josh D’Leonne
reviews.text: Very good massage and location. With free tea. Affordable and worth it. A must try! Had a 90mins Thai massage with balm. I will definitely come back!

reviews.name: Magdaléna Pierson
reviews.text:
I can highly recommend this massage place. We came here just before our flight back home. We got an oil massage 500THB - they let you take a shower before and after the massage, which worked out great for us as we didn’t want to head all sweaty to the airport.
The staff is very kind and so professional, they wash your feet before and give you hot tea afterwards. The massage was very relaxing and enjoyable.

reviews.name: Anna Tran
reviews.text: Clean, professional place which takes card payment. Had the 90min foot massage; pre-clean, scrub, rinse, then deep oil/lotion massage and finished with a neck/shoulder stretch. Will definitely come back. 550 baht  for 90mins.

reviews.name: Ivan Toh
reviews.text: Tried a few massage places in Bangkok, and this is one of the best I’ve been to. The prices are reasonable, and the service is excellent. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Nhật Kim
reviews.text: I just came across this place but it was worthy experience. Good service, nice staff, reasonable price, beautiful place (don't noisy like nearby shop in the area). You must try this massage shop

reviews.name: Neo
reviews.text:
Location fairly easy, same row with the SeabX2 wanton mee and pork legs rice restaurant.
Same street but this massage center is located in the middle of the street.

The service are great. Went for the hot stone massage and I can feel recharged after the massage. Refreshing. The strength just nice. Or maybe I don't need too much strength as I asked the master to lower down the strength.

Price is fairly reasonable as the price almost the same for all the shops nearby.

Overall it is a good experience.

reviews.name: Mel
reviews.text: Very peaceful and calm. Masseuse also very caring keep on asking either i am ok with the strength or not. They provide tea at the back where water fountain were at. Def recommended

reviews.name: Naric LAU
reviews.text: You won't believe the incredible Thai massage I just had. Not only was it absolutely amazing, but the best part is that it didn't break the bank! The masseurs were so professional and skilled, I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Trust me, it's definitely worth giving it a try!

reviews.name: Wayne K
reviews.text:
Beware of rude masseurs.

The receptionist was polite and welcoming, but unfortunately the experience went downhill from there.

The staff who washed my feet was unfriendly. She asked me to place my feet in the sink and turned on the water. When I pulled my feet back and mentioned it was too hot (it almost burned), she dismissed it and insisted it wasn’t.

In the treatment room, the male masseur was also difficult. When I said the pressure was too strong, he reduced it to the point where it felt ineffective. When I asked for slightly more pressure, he went back to being overly rough. After I told him again it was too strong, he seemed annoyed and spoke in Thai to his colleague. The air conditioning was also blowing directly at me, and when I mentioned it was too cold, he simply replied that we had to share it.

Overall, the service felt unwilling and unprofessional, as if the staff were forced to be there. It made the whole experience uncomfortable.

Very disappointing — I won’t be returning.

reviews.name: Elena zzz
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite massage place. Overall price worthy. I usually do foot massage annd shoulder annd back massage. Environment is nice, it’s clean inside and the procedure is clear. I would recommend to come here

reviews.name: Jen Chiew
reviews.text:
Loved my experience at this place and came twice during our trip. Prices are very good with a full body Thai massage only costing 250 baht for an hour.

After you pay at the counter, the therapist starts by washing your feet with some warm soapy water, and changing your footwear to slippers. For Thai massage, you'll be led to the second floor. Change your clothes into their provided garments which are loose and comfy. The massage area is dark and cooling which makes it very calming. The therapists use their body weight to apply pressure to different parts of the body to loosen the muscles. They are very good at what they do and my body felt so relaxed and soft afterwards.

After your massage, you're given some warm sweet tea which you can enjoy in their lovely and serene back garden. When it's raining, you can also have it indoors in their cafe area.

Although there are many massage places along this street with very competitive prices, this place is my favourite as their vibe is very calming and relaxed, which is totally different from the rest of the shops.

You can usually walk in without any prior appointment or booking and they can start immediately. But do note they start to get busy after 10pm and you may have to wait a while.

reviews.name: Charlotte Rathausky
reviews.text: Aroma oil massage was perfect. Especially Fost was a great therapist - calm, with full attention and very focused. I will definitely come back.

reviews.name: Tariq Kattawi
reviews.text:
Nice experience and fair price, the thai massage costs 250 baht for one hour which a very good price. The staff there is helpful and they do it very well.
We had to wait for around one hour before we start but i think this is fine as we went there on Saturday night by 10 pm.

Many other similar shops in same street with similar prices but i think this one is better than the others

title: Happiness Massage
address: 24/2 Soi Sukhumvit 23, Klongtoey Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHQ7+V7 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Yan Chi
reviews.text: I love this place which is fantastic! The massagist whose name is Nid is very hard-working, And I think I came across her twice, not so sure, Coz The first time I can't remember the face because of the dim light. I think the promotion is gonna be changed every month. This time originally I just want to get the head neck shoulders massage, and after one hour I changed my mind maybe need more hours for my legs. Nid's work is sooooo wonderful! I really feel relaxed and comfortable after massaging~ recommended!

reviews.name: Xinna Song
reviews.text: I really love the massage from Happiness until I had to go back on the day after. The service is nice. The ambiance is so good. They open until late at night which is a perfect timing for the relax after a heavy trip in Bangkok. Highly recommend 😍👍🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Githu George
reviews.text: Me and wife went. It was a good experience for us. The ladies there were nice and they knew what they were doing. Id recommend taking atleast the medium one btw and not stop on the 60 min one like we did.

reviews.name: Chris Lastovicka
reviews.text: I just got an incredibly therapeutic and divine 90-min head, shoulders, and back massage from Pui at Happiness Massage. Pui was exceptional -- she was highly engaged and present, and somehow knew the exact amount of pressure to use on me. I left feeling incredibly refreshed and relaxed. 🙏

reviews.name: Stefan Sick
reviews.text: Absolutely the best Thai massage I have ever had! The therapists are incredibly skilled and professional. I was so impressed after my 2-hour session yesterday that I came back for another 90 minutes today. The environment is clean, peaceful, and perfect for relaxing. My colleague also visited and loved it just as much. A must-visit in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kristin Marsh
reviews.text: Incredible Thai massage. Went back the next day and tried a back, shoulder and head massage. Great pressure, good environment and the staff is so kind and friendly. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Kristijan Mandusic
reviews.text: Perfect service and massage. Simply something you have to try and that is the Thai massage and it's in this massage salon. If you come here, feel free to look for Ms. Noi. She gives a great massage and delighted with the massage. I recommend this place.We will return 😍

reviews.name: Matt M
reviews.text: We can endorse this massage shop. Very friendly employees, very good price performance ratio. Clean and comfortable armchairs. They provide WiFi as well for your comfort, but we like to enjoy the massage without distraction. If we are in bangkok, this is the massage to go for us. We have been there this year again on our weekly trip (5 times). Looking forward to go there again.

reviews.name: Julie Olivas
reviews.text: Loved it best message ever girls are really nice. They know what there doing. Had many stress balls in my back they new how to make them disappear. 🥰🥰🥰

reviews.name: 小感
reviews.text: We had 5 massages in Thailand in my 10 day trip. This massage shop was very clean, quiet with good music and scents. The shop owner does his business with heart. The masseuses are professional and skillful. My husband and I had 2 hour thai and foot massages. Both of our masseuses can press right on the reflex points. Their strength were just right to make you feel very very relax and comfortable, not too strong to cause pain but also not too weak.  We both felt our whole body were relaxed after the treatment. It was so comfortable that I felt asleep 3 times. The price was also very affordable. We will definitely visit this shop again. No wonder this shop has a stamp system because I believe customers will return again. There are not so many review in google yet because it is a new shop. Be aware that when you walk down the street, there are many other massage shops with very sexy girls sitting outside which provide "different type" of massages. It's good this shop owner clearly states that they don't provide sexy massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Happiness massage owner
Yushi Matsushita

reviews.name: david davidjh1
reviews.text: I had the best foot and thigh massage ever. Perfect strength. I don't like too hard.she was cute and good English had a nice Chat. Every thing went fine 300B for 1 hour was more than reasonable although slightly cheaper available there are way more expensive on this main street. However...two days later I went back for another. She said sorry only doing special massages today starting at 1000B then of course more on top for anything else. I declined and she changed from the lovely lady that provided a wonderful massage to a nasty uncaring thing. My thoughts is take that to the alley. If you provide genuine massages then provide them. All the time. I don't deny her making a living but I don't think they should be on the main road when there are hundreds of these in every alley

reviews.name: Travelling Mom
reviews.text:
randomly walked by and got sucked in by the 200 baht price. I was with my
child and they were very welcoming. The masseuses absolutely adored them (child) and managed to get them a massage too.

They do chatter away while massaging but somehow their voices were very pleasant compared to other places I've been to.

as for quality, I've had better but for 200 baht it's absolutely worth the amount and you still feel relaxed at the end. highly recommended and will come again.

reviews.name: Ishikawa Junko
reviews.text: It was so relaxing with quiet room and relaxing music, nice scent. Thank you for the good massage :)

reviews.name: alfred zhao
reviews.text: Most of the massage therapists at this store have nothing to say about technology. I have basically experienced it all. The massage is effortless and basically goes through the motions. It is completely unlike authentic Thai massage. It is a store that attracts customers by offering low prices. This is my real experience!

reviews.name: Peyton B
reviews.text: Went there 6 days out of our 7 day trip to Bangkok. Amazing place to start your day after a nice breakfast. Thank you to everyone there who made our mornings extra relaxing and have us ready to tackle the day ahead!

reviews.name: Daisy L.
reviews.text: Literally one of the best foot massages of my life and I’ve been living in Thailand for over a year.

reviews.name: Mimar Ehab
reviews.text: It was the worst experience of my life.  Because of this place and the massage where there was wrong movement, I am now in the hospital with pain and pain in the spine.  I will demand all my rights and file a lawsuit against you when I improve.

reviews.name: Michael Hua
reviews.text:
Got the foot massage and scrub. Wow i tried a few spots like highly rates. This one is my favorite. I hope they do well but too well so I dont have to wait in the future when I come
Back. The staff are so friendly and professional. You even got a cold towel and water. The seats are brand new leather seats as well. Winnnnner
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the review & evaluation.  If you come to Thailand for sightseeing, we will be waiting for you again.
We will try again to improve our massage skills and make our customers happy.
Thank you so much.

reviews.name: Claudio Di Mauro
reviews.text: I had the foot massage+aroma oil massage 2 hours. The best massage in Thailand for quality and price. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Ryan L
reviews.text: I went one night and the wait was 90 minutes to get a massage. I came back the next day and still had to wait 40 minutes. I assumed it must be good.  What I ended with was the worst massage of my life.  I get massages daily every time I am in Thailand and get them regularly back home.  I ordered a Thai massage, but basically got a leg massage. She spent 50 minutes on my legs.  I literally wanted to get up and leave.  She also spent almost the whole time talking to the other ladies giving massages. The way she handled my arms and legs, you would think she never gave a massage before. I highly recommend picking any other shop.  I actually feel worse leaving than entering.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your valuable evaluation and comment. We are very sorry for making you feel uncomfortable. We apologize. We will improve the skills of all our staff and warn them not to talk during massages.

title: DeepSense Massage - Pra Singh

Ranging from truly relaxing hair spa, sleep therapy, Indian ayurveda, all kinds of body massage eg. Sports massage, 4 hands massage with Aroma Oil , Hot Olive Oil massage, Hot herbal balls compress massage, Hot stones massage, body scrubs, and many more. It is a town house located in the Chiang Mai old city in front of Wat Pra Singh Temple. DeepSense Massage where amazing pampering awaits you with the best spa customer service and professional massage
address: 175 1 Rachadamnoen Rd Old City Ampur, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQM+98 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Cameron
reviews.text:
My first thai massage experience and it was so good we toon the whole family back for the second time.

Very good air conditioned rooms, and very good massage.

Welcomed with water and then your feet washed and then massage and finished with jasmine tea.

10/10

reviews.name: Dani Leite
reviews.text: Melhor investimento q fiz em mim nos últimos tempos - 3h full scrub body, oil body massage and refreshing spa facial. Every thing was perfect. I ve done some massages in Thailand, but this was the best !

reviews.name: Laura Botia
reviews.text: An incredible massage! From start to finish it was absolutely amazing. We had a foot bath before heading upstairs for our Aroma Oil Full Body Massage and at the end they give you green tea and some traditional Thai sweets which was a lovely surprise! Could not recommend it enough

reviews.name: Tara J
reviews.text: Fantastic spa package! My partner and I did the 3 hour deep relax massage and felt so refreshed. Very reasonably priced given the physical effort from the masseuses.

reviews.name: Brendan Simpson
reviews.text: Very relaxed activity in the city before a long plane home. Very easy going and respectful presentation of options. Couples room available, where we received a Thai massage and a foot massage. Was stretched in ways I didn’t know were real. Feeling loose!

reviews.name: Shai Yahav
reviews.text:
Amazing experience!
One of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand. The place is spotless, intimate, and feels much more premium and professional than your average massage parlor. The staff is incredibly welcoming and attentive.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Andrew Drefahl
reviews.text: Wonderful herbs wellness incorporated a traditional Thai style tabletop massage with 1 1/2 hours of full body massage with oil and hot herbal compresses. The private room was whisper quiet, and the garments offered allowed adequate movement and coverage during each the various styles. A wonderful combination of techniques which stretched, compressed and soothed. I am a licensed massage therapist in the US and would get this massage weekly if available. Simply wonderful.

reviews.name: lilimarlina
reviews.text: Came here (as drop-in) after visiting nearby temple. Lovely place- clean, serene, reasonably priced and staff are very friendly. Had 60 minutes foot massage booked with my young daughter. They start you off with cleansing your feet before going into your treatment room. Love the fact that the foot massages are done with guests lying on their back on massage bed and they covered your eyes so you can fully relax and enjoy the quiet. At the end, they placed warm towels on your legs and thoroughly wiped off excess oil which was a really nice touch. Tea and traditional Thai candy (Kalamae) were served afterwards, they were yummy.

reviews.name: Zahresh Walji
reviews.text: Service was great. They were not pushy and everything inside was clean. They also showed us their certification when we asked for it (we had read online that some of them were not licensed and we should avoid those ones). Staff were friendly. I did the traditional thai massage 1 hour. They start with cleaning your feet, then proceed upstairs to get the massage. At the end, they give you green tea and some traditional Thai sweets

reviews.name: Marco Sivelli
reviews.text: Amazing massage, I got the Thai Ancient Herbal Compress it was so incredible I’m definitely coming back!

reviews.name: Zian Chen
reviews.text: seldomly review but this is definitely the most pleasant massage experience ever. Had a lie-down foot massage and customised to get a little Thai to the thigh. Masseuse Ruth is just great. Know how to release and recover. I’m completely new after an hour. Hate to find this out in the last night. Otherwise i will def try other options more.

reviews.name: Georgia Walker
reviews.text: Came here twice in three days! Would highly recommend - super five star service, really friendly staff who make you feel comfortable and the massage is worth every penny! I had the Aroma Oil Full Body

reviews.name: Andy Martin
reviews.text: Very relaxing foot reflexology massage. One of the better places to get a massage in Chiang Mai old town. They lie you down here instead of being seated. Directly in front of the Sunday Markets (after 5). A recommended visit.

reviews.name: Maria Fernanda Leon
reviews.text: The best massage experience! From the moment you step inside, they greet you with a smile and so much kindness. They welcome you with a glass of water, and the entire staff is very friendly. They really respect your privacy, and the ladies who do the massages are very kind and have amazing hands to get rid of all the knots and stress in your back! The place is very hygienic. If you have the chance to come, take it, i guarantee you won’t regret it 😁 Also at the end, you get some thai candy and a tea.

reviews.name: Emily C-M
reviews.text: Walked in for a 60mins Sports Aroma Oil Full Body Couples Massage and the service and general vibes of the place was perfect. Felt at ease and well looked after as soon as we stepped through the door. Feeling very relaxed and would highly recommend ✨

reviews.name: Marlyn Persaud
reviews.text: Tranquil massage experience. The facility was extremely clean and the staff  were professional and courteous. Jiab conducted a masterclass in a Thai deep tissue shoulder and neck massage. I've been getting massages for over 30 yrs and this was the best one yet. It's a little more pricey than other nearby massage places but you are paying for experience of a great  massage therapist, as well as the spa-like atmosphere. A must try.

reviews.name: Ed L
reviews.text: I've never had a better massage in Thailand.  The Thai massage was phenomenal and therapist pays attention to all my problem areas. I've been twice during this trip and both times were great

reviews.name: oliver appleby
reviews.text: Brilliant massage ! Me and my wife went together in a double room on massage tables. I had a traditional Thai massage and my wife had the aroma oil - head, back and shoulders massage. Both massages finished with a head massage too ! A very professional and clean establishment that I would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: A.
reviews.text:
Deep Sense Spa – A Hidden Gem Near Tha Phae Gate

Our visit to Deep Sense Spa was completely unplanned. We had been exploring the Tha Phae Gate Sunday Night Market for about two hours when it started drizzling. Conveniently, we found ourselves near the spa and decided to go in for a foot reflexology session.

We opted for a one-hour foot reflexology treatment for two people at just 500 Thai Baht each—an excellent price. The receptionists, two young men and a young lady, were exceptionally professional and friendly. They welcomed us warmly and started with a soothing foot wash before introducing us to our masseuses, Mr. Chan and an older lady.

What made this foot reflexology session unique was that it was performed on a lie-flat bed, similar to a traditional Thai massage setup. This unexpected twist intrigued us, and we quickly realized we were in for something special.

Mr. Chan was incredibly skilled, applying strong, precise pressure to all the key acupuncture points. By the end of the session, I felt like I had a brand-new pair of legs. My partner had a similarly amazing experience with her masseuse.

Deep Sense Spa truly delivered one of the best foot massages we’ve ever had. If you're in the area, this place is absolutely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Chen Pin Hao
reviews.text: Nice and relaxing experience. The masseuse is friendly and very considerate. Feels good after the massage. Nice environment. Will definitely come again.

title: Zen Sense Health Spa
ownerDescription:
Every touch at Zen Sense Spa isn't merely a service, it's s a testament to our heritage. Dive deep into Thailand's heart, one Serene embrace at a time.
Free pick and drop service within city.
Zen Sense 水疗中心的每一次接触不仅仅是一项服务，更是我们传统的证明。 深入泰国的内心，一次一个宁静的拥抱。
市内免费接送服务。

reviews.name: Pauline Joy

She was very attentive and had a great technique with strong, consistent pressure throughout the massage. She was especially thorough in working on the areas that needed extra attention.

I took the Thai Aroma Massage (full body). I chose the Golden Spice aroma. It was magical which cost me 590 THB for 1 hour 30 minutes on 30 Oct 25.
Foot, Leg, Thai, Hand, Finger, Shoulder, Head, Back and Chest massage was surreal.
The lady was very attentive, polite, well behaved and not but the least she had magical hands. She magically massaged all the muscle then rubbed with oil and massage again. The soft music at times made me feel asleep.
They allowed me to take shower first as I had a long drive and exhausted. They maintains top notch hygiene and privacy. I was provided with one time use underwears, fresh towel and bath robe. After the massage I took shower again with a sweet smelling body shower gel.

The receptionist speaks English well and the massage lady speaks a little English. They enternained with traditional Thai tea and puffed rice cookie afterwards. All my stress and tiredness just vanished. Will visit again when I come to Chiang Mai.

I had a Thai traditional massage. It was one of the worst massage ever. The lady that done my massage, I could tell she didn’t have any actual skills, but was just using force and it was everywhere, arms all over the show, she didn’t get any pressure points, I didn’t even allow her to crack my back and just done it myself (I know how to twist and crack my back neck etc myself) …. But I love that at the end there was a customers satisfactory questioner - I never like to complain here and to the business unless something is quite bad. Because this service was not okay - the lady needs to be taught proper ways of massage before doing it to every customer, it could cause damage.

I told the front desk lady (I’m guessing she was the manager.) I kindly explained to her - and said I was still happy to pay in full because the lady still done an hours massage. But she had given me a discount which was nice of her.
I’m not saying that all The therapist  will be bad, because I’m sure some of the ladies they hired there will have a lot of experience, but it’s the business at fault to not train and test out every massage ladies skills

I visited the place for twice, one for head and foot massage by Siu which was a nice experience.

Worst of all, she cut me into blood with both my toes and fingers. I am sure the rest toes are cut more or less as it hurt when she was working on them.
I tried not to be mean to her and thought accidents happens even for the most experienced person when she cut my toes at first. Then she still cut my finger later on and it took around 10mins to stop bleeding. (Photo of the finger is taken the next day. And blood under nail of my toe, yes it’s from the wound)

I didn’t tip her but still paid the charge in full. While I showed the blood and wound to the receptionist and a guy there before paying, they didn’t say anything, neither apologized.
After I showed my anger, they called the lady over to ask what happened and that’s it.
They then offered to put medicine on my wound but I refused as I trust my own medicine at hotel way more.
Very bad experience and the shop should know that the tools are to be used with all customers. Even they sanitize every time after use, they should still be very careful not to cut client to avoid any possible infection.

reviews.name: Hee Jung Lee
reviews.text:
I first visited this spa on August 4 and was genuinely impressed by the exceptional service and the outstanding quality of the massage. My friends and I were so impressed that, although we had planned to try a different spa the following day, we decided to return here because we trusted the quality we had experienced.

After a round of golf, I was looking forward to a 90-minute massage to relieve the tension in my body. Unfortunately, my second visit was completely different from the first. The massage techniques were unskilled, and the therapist's attitude lacked professionalism and sincerity, which left me very disappointed.

I understand that massage is a very personal experience, and it is possible that a particular therapist's style simply doesn't suit me. However, this felt like more than just a difference in preference.

When I shared my concerns with the staff, I was told that it was because I had not booked a full-body massage, that the therapist was a professional, and that everyone experiences massages differently. Rather than trying to understand my feedback, they seemed more focused on making excuses.

A massage therapist doesn't need to have flashy techniques to be professional. However, at a luxury spa, I do expect a therapist to know the body's pressure points, apply consistent pressure, and follow a structured massage routine. Instead, it felt like the therapist was randomly pressing different areas, lightly rubbing my body without purpose, and there was no rhythm or consistency in the massage on either my arms or legs. I could barely feel any pressure, so I politely asked for a stronger massage. Toward the end, however, the pressure suddenly became so harsh that it felt as though I was being pinched. The therapist then left without saying a single word.

If the therapist was still a beginner, I could completely understand that. My point is not that everyone must be highly skilled from the start. Even if the techniques were not perfect, I would not have complained if I had seen genuine effort and a sincere desire to provide the best possible service.

I still believe this is a luxury spa worth experiencing when visiting Chiang Mai. My first visit was truly exceptional, and every aspect of the experience exceeded my expectations. That is exactly why the second visit was so disappointing. I sincerely hope the spa can maintain a more consistent standard of service and massage quality so that every guest receives the same excellent experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to explain your experience in such detail.

We sincerely regret that your second visit did not meet the high standard you experienced during your first visit. We understand that your disappointment was not only about the massage itself, but also about how your feedback was received, and we are truly sorry that you felt unheard.

Your comments have been shared with our management and therapist team, and we will use them as an opportunity to improve our consistency in both service and communication.

We genuinely appreciate that you recognized the excellent experience you had during your first visit, and we are grateful that you chose to return. Thank you again for your honest feedback, and we wish you all the best.

ownerDescription: Srimantra Spa is a unique cave-inspired spa in Chiang Mai, conveniently located near Chiang Mai Night Bazaar. Inspired by traditional Lanna heritage and natural cave architecture, we offer a peaceful sanctuary for relaxation and wellness. Our experienced therapists provide authentic Thai Massage, Aromatherapy Massage, Hot Coconut Oil Massage, Body Scrubs, Herbal Steam, Facial Treatments, and spa packages for individuals, couples, families, and friends. Every treatment is personalized using premium natural products in private treatment rooms. Experience authentic Thai hospitality and discover one of Chiang Mai's most unique spa destinations.
