reviews.name: Puchit Hongsawat (Czech)
reviews.text:
First of all, Im thai, (meaning I had a-lot of massage experiences, I go to massage shop very often locally internationally, I love to find local and massage gem wherever I go travel) and I don’t usually give 5 stars.

At first didnt expect much here as I thought it was just a hype or selling point on the cave decoration only, my gf just see the outside and wanna try. So I was like okay, I ll give it a try despite it also almost 2 times higher price than the local one.

—>

Turn out damnn, one of the best in Chiangmai on massaging!! Thanks god I decided to join with my gf.

My doctor was ms. kung (แม่กุ้ง) , I chose to do the pure thai massage (no oil).

Wowww this was the 1 hrs that worth every single touch and seconds.

She gave it all every second, press very dedicatedly and always ask to check the feedback along the journey.

Usually I felt like 1 hr massage is very short, and not enough for me. But with Ms. Kung and her professionalism. It’s really full-fill and I felt satisfied.

Tho the price was almost double, but the quality is amazing. This is way better than spend cheap price on 2 hrs and get nothing.

Thus, I leant the lesson that, you can pay cheap and suffer for 2 hrs somewhere else, but here 1 hr with that price. Oh dear, I love it. Time save and effective.

So this is a gem, high quality!

Keep this quality , keep your amazing attitude, and I’m sure you will get more customer.

To the boss of this location, you are so lucky to have these people work for you. Massagers are professional, kind , the front desk also well represent, kind and customer service mind, very patient and helpful. Mrs. Tawan. Thank you for your amazing work. There is no need to take the mask out but I can felt her smile and kind from her eyes. Kind and beautiful heart.

Lastly, I don’t usually give tip (because the price is already high) but this time, I’ll feel bad if I didnt haha, because she deserved it 100% thanks to her skill and dedication on customer.

reviews.name: Kym Cura
reviews.text:
They almost did not accept my voucher with Agoda. I came 15 mins early, reserved my slot a day before and they confirmed, only to come to the place telling me that they “don’t partner with Agoda”. First of all they didn’t even look at my voucher yet telling me that “maybe you came to the wrong place because we don’t partner with Agoda”. Turns out, it was Agoda linked to Kkday and I was the one who even figured this out! At this point I already felt unwelcomed. I was the one to even say that, why don’t you just scan the QR here because this is voucher? And then they tell me they cannot access the QR reader because they need the login details of the manager who wasn’t there!! Receptionist even told me “can you just go back” (while they further try to verify) when I was there early and excited for my 7pm appointment. At this point I gave the guy a sharp look, and only then he decided to provide the massage first while they figure it out. Got my massage at around 7:15pm. My voucher was proved ok after and the receptionist did apologize, but I already lost my excitement because of this unprofessional treatment.
As for the massage I had an old lady therapist who did not seem to be trained with gentleness and customer service, but I can sense she’s a veteran and knows what she’s doing.
Hope this shop would train the staff more on courtesy, such a waste having a really good interior but terrible service.

Your feedback regarding our front desk communication and service has been shared with our team. We will continue to improve our procedures and staff training to ensure a smoother and more welcoming experience for all guests, especially when handling third-party bookings.

We also appreciate your kind comments about our therapist and our interior. Your feedback, both positive and constructive, is very valuable to us.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide you with the relaxing experience you expected from us.

Warm regards,
The Management

reviews.text: Highly recommend ka!!! Always choose Lantana whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Super friendly staff and nice spa. Cheap and convenient option in Nimman neighborhood ✨

reviews.name: Janice Koh
reviews.text: Very professional and clean. I like it that my masseuse washed / clean her hands b4 massaging my head. I chose the 2h hot herbal compressed & traditional massage and did tue same package for both 1st & 2nd visit over my 3 days stay in chiang mai.

reviews.name: Coda Wong
reviews.text: This massage shop is amazing! The therapists are professional and gentle, the pressure is just right. The space is quiet and clean, super relaxing. Left with my body totally unwound—definitely my go-to spot and will come back for sure!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Christian Breitkreutz
reviews.text: Great massage. The place feels a bit like a private house. But that makes it even nicer and more relaxing. Slightly pricier than other places in the area. But still fine and reasonable. My masseuse was super professional and figured out what I liked so there was not much need to explain. Will definitely be back when I am in Nimman next time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: YK Lam
reviews.text: Unlike most of the other massage places, this one is a house by itself, with a small garden. You can hear birds chirping when you are doing your massage. Quite a good experience. Very clean and spa like.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Trần My
reviews.text: This place is really good. Service is the best and the staffs are so kind. Location is near One Nimman which is really convenience for tourism. The price is also good for the service 💯💯💯
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: vivian Chan
reviews.text: We came for a 2 hour body scrub + oil massage and it was magical!   Great ambiance and super relaxing. Plus we got a little bonus snack after  Lovely! Anything to say is the toilet is a bit old fashioned.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Bb Sutharat
reviews.text:
Highly recommend / nice staff
Thai massage with ป้าสร้อย is very good and relax have a great time here

reviews.name: Maprang
reviews.text: Reasonable price, Good service, Smell good, I'm gonna be back when i come to CNX 👍👍👍

reviews.name: Natthamon C.
reviews.text: Massage therapist is experienced and humble. The place is cozy and feels like home. I felt so relaxing and comfortable after 2 hours of aroma massage.

reviews.name: HANSEN LEE
reviews.text: Been here many times each time I come back to CNX. Always get a great massage to fix up all my pains & tension. If you like deep tissue massage, you can try Pink, her technique is pretty spot on but as usual, the more relaxed you can be, the deeper she will go 😉
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Supakdipon Sue
reviews.text:
soooo good!
P'Pin (the massager is the best)
the service they provided was good!

Highly recommended!⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Rachel Tan
reviews.text: Had a 1-hour foot massage here and really enjoyed it. The therapist was professional, the atmosphere was relaxing, and my feet felt much better afterwards. Will come back again!

reviews.name: Dom. M.
reviews.text: Excellent foot scrub at Lantana Massage 2! Kham and Soi were very gentle and professional. Our feet feel amazing and look brand new! We come here regularly and highly recommend this nice and pleasant place!

reviews.name: kayla sun
reviews.text: It‘s quite good to try massage here. I will recommend all of my friends who will travel to Chiangmai^_^
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Wei Lun Soh
reviews.text: Came here twice, both times are wonderful! First time was foot scrub massage, second was head back shoulder massage. Therapists are very experienced and strong! Everyone very friendly and service is good :) place is very quaint too!

reviews.name: Yu Bing Chan
reviews.text: The massage was really good—I felt the tension leave my body afterwards. It was very relaxing, and the vibes and atmosphere were great. I will come back again.

reviews.name: shirley phox
reviews.text: We walked by a few before deciding, and this was worth the walk. Everyone was very welcoming. The thai massage was relaxing and so good. The ambiance is 1000% percent better than the night market and surrounding spas. Give this place a try!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for a great review

reviews.name: Wei Li
reviews.text: 💆‍♀️ Such a peaceful vibe! The massage was heavenly and exactly what we needed. Left feeling totally refreshed and relaxed. Will definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

title: Khunka Massage
subTitle: คุณคะ มาสสาส
description: Unpretentious spa facility offering a variety of massages in an informal atmosphere.
ownerDescription: Chiang mai Health massage certified by province and public health.
address: 80 7 Rachadamnoen Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQP+8M Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Simon Lee
reviews.text: The service really good and all the staff is friendly and nice. Their speak English and serve you with a cold towel and cold green tea when you enter. When finish they will server a hot drink. The price and the quality of masseur’s skill is very good and definitely I with visit again. I had the ‘Head to Toes’ treatment with promotion price  590 bath and it come with Foot massage 30min, Thai Massage 60min & Back Shoulder Massage with Oil 30min.  Recommend to try this.

reviews.name: MyVisit MyView
reviews.text:
Amazing! Worth it! Can’t wake to do it again! You never know how much you need this until you’re having it done. Fabulous! Relaxing! A Royal treat.
Friendly staff, clean and very affordable.

reviews.name: A N
reviews.text: I had a 1.5 hr package (30 mins foot and 1 hr  body oil massage) here yesterday. I came in around 3pm and they were fully booked so I have to set an appointment later at 5pm with 100 bahts deposit up front. I requested a male masseur and his name is Tam. He was the only male therapist there. I was very happy with Tam. He has 10 years experience and he did not lie. His technique included long, short stroke, combined with finger, palms and elbows pressing. Tam could feel where my muscles stiffness was and he focused on it without me telling him. He checked with me few times to make sure I was comfortable with his pressure. The massage was done in a private room. Tam spoke good English.  The place was clean and all staff were very polite. Prices are reasonable to me. I paid 650 bahts for the package. If you need a good massage from a guy, I highly recommend Tam at Khunka massage.

reviews.name: BT 10
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed the hour in foot/head/hand massage by Nicky! First time was several yrs ago, am so pleased their quality has been upheld. Comfy massage chairs, great service, and they serve drinks before and after the session.

reviews.name: Peter Kam Fai Cheung
reviews.text: My wife and I were recommended by Eva of BED hotel two places to do massage in Chaingmai during our stay from February 2-5, 2018.  Having tried both respectively on February 3-4, 2018, I could tell the similarities and differences even among the best in the league. Here was really better all factors considered, although the relatively higher price has already reflected the difference!

reviews.name: Tomáš Obzina
reviews.text: I choose traditional one hour massage and i was best choice in my life ❤️ Absolutely perfect. I must go there again. Nice, quite and clean place. Perfect for relaxation. They have private rooms for pairs or oiled massages. You can make a shover before or after massage. After massage i got tea with an biscuit. Perfect choice. Go there! ❤️ Thank you

reviews.name: Sabena V
reviews.text:
1 hr foot massage and 1 hr foot, hand and head. They were both incredible- best we’ve had in Chiang Mai. We have been to four other places, but this is the best.

They were attentive, always asked if you were comfortable, and the place is very clean. We wish we would have came here sooner!

reviews.name: Princess Villanueva
reviews.text:
Today was my second time getting a Thai massage here.
I've never had someone massage me with care and knew where the focus points are. Nikki was the massause. If you ever go here for a Thai massage look for that name. She is really good!
Will come back for an oil massage next time.

reviews.name: R. Sindhu
reviews.text: I got foot, hand and head massage here and it was very good. Definitely one of the places I would recommend. And they also accept credit card payments.

reviews.name: Isabelle Oliveira
reviews.text: One of the best Thai massage I’ve done! Everyone is thoughtful and the lady who did the massage was impeccable with the correct amount of pressure!

reviews.name: Miryam Bögli
reviews.text: I had a whole body oil massage and enjoyed every minute of it. Very skilled and talented masseuse. She knew exactley where I needed it the most. I felt comfortable at all time. I appreciate that it is kept simple and highly focused on the massage. Will come back here for sure!

reviews.name: Renate A
reviews.text: I had a 60 minutes foot massage combined with head/shoulder/neck for 350 Baht with a therapist who introduced himself as A - time and money well spent :)

reviews.name: Jon S.
reviews.text: Very relaxed, laid-back atmosphere. The ladies were very nice and attentive.  I got the 1-hour foot and back massage with oil and the masseuse did a good job at a reasonable price.

reviews.name: Miwa Ichikawa
reviews.text: Excellent foot massage! She is very polite and skillful! Highly recommend!!!!!!

reviews.name: happykaren 6
reviews.text:
It was a terrible experience for me, the environment is fine, the attitude of staff are also fine, but the skill of massage is not good for the staff that serve me. The staff have asked for the force at first, but the force is ok for beginning, for the part the massage lady using bone to do, the force become too strong and when she massage other body parts with her hands , the force is so weak so it’s unpredictable.

Secondly, the staff will massage to some position close to the sensitive part of the body like underarm or inner thigh close to sensitive area, even though I used my hands to cover, the lady still try to massage those parts, and the force is soft when massaging these parts so it’s almost like touching with force not really ‘massaging’ .

Thirdly, I thought should be fine for the massage for the head and shoulders part because there are no sensitive area. But turns out I was totally wrong, while the lady doing the massage on my head, what she massaging is not my head but my hairs, she keep rubbing my hairs , my hairs became so damaged that I can feel. And when she massaging my shoulders, she used towels to cover while she do the massage, and she was not even massaging my shoulder but only the towels or the pillows.

There are just so many points that I can’t tell the lady one by one. The discount price was cheap, 1000 thb for 2 hours oil massages, but I would definitely not recommend people to go there. Maybe just that I am unlucky, my score to this experience is 2.8 out of 10. And my friends score to the experience is 6 out of ten, not as worse as me but definitely not a good experience though. If not all other nearby shops are full today, we won’t give a try to this shop and will never go again for now.

reviews.name: Ludovic Gonella
reviews.text: Nice place for having a relax full massage. Ladies are working great . All people there are nice and gentle .let give a try after a long walk in Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Chawisa Tosumlee
reviews.text: The receptionist explained everything very professionally, and it smelled amazing in the shop. However, my masseuse was a bit rougher than I expected. But hey, my back cracked nicely at the end of the massage😆

reviews.name: Wijn100
reviews.text:
Had my first massage ever by another man (male myself) in Thailand. His name was Tam.

I chise the oil massage + hot compress. 90 minute 1000baht.
Expensive, but the best massage I ever received.

Tam gave me goosebumps, made me enjoy every second. I'll sleep like a baby tonight. Highly recommend.

Place is clean hygienic, staff friendly. Explained I had a wrist injury and masseur took good care of me. Can only give 5 stars and not more

reviews.name: A
reviews.text: This is now my standard for what a good thai massage is!! My massage therapist was extremely attentive and senses my needs (too hard/soft, too cold/hot immediately without me even saying anything). She really knows her stuff and worked every one of my muscles thoroughly. Place is clean, service amazing, price reasonable and super worth it. Would definitely make this my regular spot if I live here!

reviews.name: Emily Myers-Wilson
reviews.text:
I had a foot massage and my partner had a back massage. The staff were welcoming and friendly, the atmosphere was relaxing and the massages were great. My foot massage was so relaxing in the comfy bamboo chairs. It was also not busy.
Overall fantastic service for the price, especially compared to other places in the area.

title: Ziam Spa and Massage Chiang Mai
ownerDescription:
Ziam spa, an spa for everyone, provides strictly spa service by young and well-trained therapists. Situated on Rachadamnoen street where Chiang Mai Sunday Walking Street takes place, our building presents a beautiful Lanna-style design. Impressive massage and body treatments are provided in a private room equipped with hot water shower and a jacuzzi at a reasonable price. Advanced reservation is required.
We open 10:00-22:00 everyday.
Easy to booking by Facebook page(recommend) FB : Ziam Spa and Thai Massage Chiang Mai by ZabaiThai.
Our shop sitting in middle of old town next to U Chiangmai Hotel(old town).
address: 80 1 Rachadamnoen Rd Old City Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXQP+8Q Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Your Massage, Your Way — at Ziam Spa 💆‍♂️
A great massage should feel right for you.
At Ziam Spa, every treatment can be personalized to match your body, your mood, and the way you like to relax. Choose the traditional techniques of Thai Massage or unwind with the gentle comfort of Aromatherapy Massage. Prefer a softer touch or deeper, firmer pressure? Simply let us know.
Our experienced therapists will adjust each session with care, creating a massage experience that feels truly your own.
✨ Explore our thoughtfully designed spa packages, combining quality treatments with excellent value.
✨ Enjoy complete privacy in a peaceful, impeccably clean treatment room, with your own in-room shower for added comfort and convenience.
From your arrival to your final moment of relaxation, every detail is considered to make your visit comfortable, peaceful, and memorable.
💖 At Ziam Spa, we don’t believe one massage fits everyone.
We believe the best massage is the one that fits you.
🕙 Open Daily | 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM
📞 Advance reservations are recommended.
Book your appointment via inbox or call:
+66 5321 1800 | +66 6313 66993

reviews.name: Marna Parslow
reviews.text: I enjoyed my hot oil message with Bee.  She really got my neck and shoulder knots worked out.  So far my favorite message in Thailand.  My only complaint was I only scheduled 60 minutes.  I’ll be back.  The atmosphere and friendly staff made my day.

reviews.name: Chris Hightower
reviews.text: Did a walk in and started off with a one hour oil massage. I had to wait a few mins for the massage therapist to get there which they were very apologetic about but as I said, I had walked in off the street so I was fine waiting.  I got Pond as my therapist and he was very good. 10 mins into the massage I quickly changed to a 2 hour massage. Overall great service and very happy with my decision. Would definitely go back.

reviews.name: chunyu lam
reviews.text:
Didn’t make reservation online but walked in to have a try.

I was lucky that there was therapist available when I arrived at 4ish, though needed to wait a little bit, before therapist Tee came over to start the package.

Didn’t know the name of the therapist until I asked him.  Was quite happy to know it was him, Tee as I saw some google reviews saying he is good.

I chose the package with body scrub + oil massage + facial.  Tee was very good at all the skills and techniques, he is gentle when moving your body but also massage with good strength, pressing deep into the inner layers.

He is also a very caring person with attention to detail, reminding not to slip after body scrub when proceeding to a shower, minding every light sources that would interrupt my rest when eyes were closed etc.  Also a kind person with suitable dialogues for enough interactions but not excessive nor insufficient.

First time having such a great experience!

reviews.name: Marco Ngan
reviews.text: I had an excellent here with therapist Pond. He is a kind, polite and skillful therapist. Highly recommend. Also the shop itself is very comfortable and the welcome drink and after massage tea are both very delicious.

reviews.name: Borja Chiquero Pérez
reviews.text: Great massage place in Chiang Mai. We went my couple and me and we had a two hours Thai traditional massage. The place is wonderful, clean and relaxing. The two massageurs boys were very nice and all time treated us very kindly and taking care of us. The massage was great and we recommend it  100%.

reviews.name: Sitthisak Intarasit
reviews.text:
This spa offers an exceptional wellness experience with a serene ambiance, expert therapists, and world-class service.

Every treatment is tailored to perfection, using high-quality natural products in beautifully designed, immaculate spaces.

The staff’s warm hospitality and attention to detail ensure total relaxation.

Whether for a deep tissue massage or a soothing aromatherapy session, Siam Spa guarantees a luxurious and rejuvenating retreat. A must-visit for true relaxation.

I love this place so much. Good for foreigners who wanna feel real Thai massage.

reviews.name: Sam Saban
reviews.text:
I discovered Ziam Spa and Massage Chiang Mai just three days before leaving the city, and I’m so glad I did—it was absolutely worth it! From the moment I reached out on their Facebook page, Mr. Tong was incredibly attentive. He was there to greet me upon arrival, offered tea before and after my session, and ensured everything was perfect. His professionalism and hospitality truly stood out.

My therapist, AU, was exceptional. I opted for the NIRVANA package, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. AU’s skill and professionalism made the entire session incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating. If you're in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend treating yourself at Ziam Spa. It’s a gem you won’t want to miss!

reviews.name: Sam Balbin
reviews.text: I recently had the best massage experience ever, thanks to a therapist whose name I regretfully can't recall. However, his expertise was unmistakable, and the staff were incredibly welcoming and accommodating. The facility itself was impressive, providing me with a spacious room equipped with both a shower and a jacuzzi. I opted for the 2-hour Nirvana package, which was not only reasonably priced but also thoroughly worth it.

reviews.name: Juan Curbelo
reviews.text: Amazing spa in the old city center. I walked in after a morning of a lot of walking and walked out feeling rejuvenated! The therapist Jay had amazing skills! Recommend the facial massage treatment.

reviews.name: Ng Andy
reviews.text: Not the first time to Ziam Spa. Was here last year August and did 2 sessions. Now I am back and just done another 2 sessions. My therapist, Tee was very sweet, polite, great personality. I really like him. Will come back for him again but hopefully by then he still have time tlfor my sessions. Great job and keep it up!

reviews.name: Bevis Fan
reviews.text:
Fantastic service and massage with reasonable price! Ginger tea welcome drink and after massage! Very good music and atmosphere!
We just order 1 hours foot massage but we have our own private room with the bathtub !
The most important thing is massage is wonderful!! Must be here again

reviews.name: Christopher Miranda
reviews.text: After a long day of walking around we wanted to unwind with a nice massage and are glad we chose Ziam. The atmosphere is very relaxing with the soft music and essential oils lingering in the air. The staff was very pleasant and our masseuse had magic hands that had me falling asleep by the end. Ziam is also super affordable for the quality and none of the shadyness of "extra" services. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Wu Li
reviews.text: It wasn't until I saw the handsome appearance of this masseur that I came here. Their prices were much higher than those of other massage parlors. But surprisingly, the masseur wore a mask throughout the session. This is the first time I've seen a spa masseur wearing a mask. I really can't understand it. Moreover, in their promotional materials, the masseur wasn't wearing a mask either. So, were they tricking the guests? It's dishonest behavior. Secondly, the room was very poor and old. Overall, it's not worth the experience.

reviews.name: Alex B
reviews.text: I had a 2hr massage with Neil. It was awesome. Just the right amount of strength, skillful, I felt so relax afterwards. The place is clean and the staff is nice. I strongly recommend it

reviews.name: Jatin Garg
reviews.text: Excellent massage by Nat at Ziam spa. Would highly recommend it. One of the best I’ve had in Thailand. Really nice atmosphere and great experience.

reviews.name: Dave Stewart
reviews.text: I had a Ziam massage consisting of body scrub, oil massage and facial.  Almost 3 hours of services.  Zen was my therapist and did an excellent job.  Not just a rub like many places but he actually found my trouble spots intuitively.   He worked hard on the knots in my back and although sometimes painful, I knew it was going to help in the long run.  I've already scheduled another massage from him next week.

reviews.name: peegolas
reviews.text: Small but luxury massage shop in CNX with promotion price every weekday. Serene with Bali style decoration is amazing. Especailly an outdoor shower and bath tub are relaxy comfort. Well trained and polite Massager named Au+ is professional. Beware of an air condition will made you chill. Ask for extra blanket or adjust temperature is recommended.

reviews.name: Miles Wu
reviews.text:
Best Thai massage ever for 2 hours. The masseur mastered in Thai massage. It was hurt but after that you will be reborn.
Helpful service counter introduced the service very clear.

reviews.name: Yun Han Wee
reviews.text: Although we didnt know that there were only male masseuses before entering the place, the masseuses were all very professional and the massage was so comfortable and relaxing that we went back twice in 3 days! One of the best massages we experienced! Would definitely go back again if we are back in Chiang Mai! :)

reviews.name: Kevin Jim
reviews.text: This is a great find next to my hotel. The massage therapists are fantastic and extremely skillful with their technique. I visited twice, first visit I did a walk-in and had Tea for foot massage and head/neck/shoulder. Second visit I had Pond for a two hour oil massage. Both had a great touch and firm pressure strong enough to loosen all my knots. There is a discount for appointments between 10am and 1pm which is a great value. One can book an appointment via phone, WhatsApp, IG chat, and other channels. The massage market in Chiangmai is fierce with literally multiple shops within a single block, but these guys really stand out. Best massages of my Thailand visit!

title: Rock Valley Hot Springs and Fish Spa
subTitle: ร็อควัลเล่ย์ฮอทสปริงแอนด์ฟิชสปา
address: River Kwai Village Hotel Wang Krachae, Sai Yok District, Kanchanaburi 71150, Thailand
plusCode: 72C4+RX Wang Krachae, Sai Yok District, Kanchanaburi, Thailand

reviews.name: We'd 9Nov
reviews.text: An absolute hidden gem! If you're looking to escape the hustle and bustle, this is the place to be. The variety of hot spring pools is impressive—each with different temperatures and herbal properties. The setting is incredibly lush and peaceful, right by the river. The Fish Spa was a highlight; it’s a bit ticklish at first but leaves your skin feeling amazing. Highly recommend for a day of total relaxation!

reviews.name: Jerrick Lim
reviews.text:
A very well designed spa with 15 different kinds of pool water (2 are at normal temp while rest are from 38 to 40 degrees)

Access to it is via a rural trail road and signages are there to guide. Plenty of parking too.

Once you enter, you can choose the package or simply entrance fee for 2hrs usage at 650baht per pax. You cannot use ur own swimwear but only theirs. Lockers r provided upon checking in and a small bottle of water is offered to you

The varieties as said, are there for you to enjoy but the truth to be told, not much of a difference. Coffee pool had a very very slight coffee smell to it if you sniff it hard while the milk spa pool do not really look norishing to the skin.

Nevertheless, it is a good spa overall and one of its kind within this area.

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Lady Pim
reviews.text:
15 outdoor onsen, each offering a different temperature and atmosphere. One of the best hot spring in Kanchanaburi. Also suggest trying the mud facials.

Entrance (options): Either get day pass for 650 baht or book a package with an overnight stay at River Kwai Village, which includes spa treatments or outdoor activities — both are great. A pleasant drive or you can hop on the shuttle boat at the hotel as well.

The only downside was the front desk service — staff felt a bit cold and inconsistent with information, which made check-in less smooth. Some areas could also use a little extra cleaning. The place could also go a bit greener — maybe replacing the small plastic bottles with refillable cups (like at poolbar),replacing plastic cotton buds with paper ones, and skipping the plastic straws. All in all, still a wonderful and relaxing day — definitely worth it! 🌿♨️

reviews.name: rudy bahar
reviews.text: Very good Hot Springs meni pools with different kind of water, price only 500 BHAT , not expensive at all for the quality and the quantity of the pools , stuff very friendly. Recommend strongly when you in the area to make a visit 👍🙏

reviews.name: Dasha Sumarokova
reviews.text: It was a super experience! There are 15 baths with milk, wine, and coffee of different temperatures. It's just magical! the entrance fee is 650 baht, you can get a massage for an additional price. They give you bathing suits, you can't wear your own swimsuit.

reviews.name: Ss
reviews.text: Disagree with the good reviews. First when I am first on the  lobby, she said only 650baht with no smile and no other more information was told. Second the cleanliness is badly ignored. Third, no fish in the fish pool. No one can explain that only with the answer “there’s few….” But not only one client said there’s no fish at all. Fourth, all the staff has no smiles  . Total no service at all. But the scenes are good

reviews.name: John FK
reviews.text: This place is a must-visit! They offer 15 different herbal pool spas with an entrance fee of 650 baht, along with a variety of additional massage and spa services available for an extra charge. There are two ways to access the area: by boat or via a local road, which, though unpaved, is still accessible. I highly recommend coming by car to ensure you have plenty of time to relax and enjoy your visit. The facilities are very clean, and the service is excellent!

reviews.name: Mark Dore
reviews.text:
15 pools to relax in and soak away life's stresses!
If you drive, the road in is very rough so take care.
We went late afternoon and it was very tranquil and enjoyable having most pools to ourselves. However, when it's busy I think it wouldn't be so enjoyable and maybe a squeeze to get in some pools🫤.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text:
I went there in the morning,  not many customers due to dry season..

Drove unsaved road for around 4 minutes. It was not a pleasant drive. If rain falls, then it will be a muddy road.

15 different pool with different ingredient they mixed with water.
Chinese tea pool, herbal pool, milky pool, butter fly pool...

I paid 630 baht for entrance.
I expected it better to be in this condition and water quality.

It is not worth it to pay 630 baht. I like to enjoy real good quality water.

They promote as mineral water, " mineral water means " water from the deep ground, not from government water pipe. This water nave makes your skin different.

In China mai I had real onsen for 60 baht
..... it was  sulfur hot springs , water was very hot and so soft..

I don't recommend this place  if you are onsen lo er like me.

reviews.name: Vivienne Yoshida
reviews.text:
First time visit here at Rock Valley Hot Springs. Since we already love Onsen and hot springs, this place is magnificent. Services are exceptional in every way.
There are 15 natural hots Springs including one stream dome and one normal temp pool to end with. Also don’t forget to try yellow water melon !!! 🍉

reviews.name: Asadang Tanatipuknon
reviews.text: Atmosphere is good experience, however the service not that my type; I have to ask that water included to the package or not to get “a bottle of water”

reviews.name: Y S
reviews.text:
It isn’t easy to get here by car. If you like to have hot springs, 650THB per person for 2 hours.
You don’t have to bring anything, pool wear and towels are prepared. There are locker room with key.
There should be 15 concepts pools however there were around 10 pools were available. Good river view and enjoy artificial hot springs in Kanchanaburi area.  It depends the cost is worth or not. There are much cleaner one in Bangkok area about same price. Only if you like the suburb area, it may be...

reviews.name: Maya Khan
reviews.text: One of the amazing spas in the nature out here. Had so much fun. They have a variety of spa massages, even the mud ones. The famous dr fish foot pedicure is available too!! I had that and enjoyed fishes biting me haha. The onsen was so nice with beautiful views of River Kwai. We accessed the spav via a boat which is so adventurous. Like 5-10 min ride. The spa is so affordable and have very good staff. We enjoyed our time here and thank you so much for having us 🙏 #mrsnationalUniverse

reviews.name: Scarlett Maturada
reviews.text: 15 different hot springs. Clean. The staff is so nice. Calm and Beautiful to relax. Highly recommended. The price is 650 per person. The road is pretty hard to find and would be amazing if signs are more clear and easy

reviews.name: wowchun
reviews.text: Good place to visit if you are onsen lover. Clean and convenient if you come by boat (2 minutes from River Kwai Village hotel). They have sarong uniform to wear (like local) นุ่งกระโจมอก for female and pant for male. The face spa is also quite good. Really like their wooden furniture. Nowadays, its quite hard to find this furniture style.

reviews.name: Lucio Favata
reviews.text: 15 pools of hot spring pleasure! With many infused pools this was something quite unique 🤩 there are many types such as turmeric, coffee, eucalyptus & milky pools, you could really smell the infusion and it felt great ☺️ you can enjoy a drink at the view of the river, it’s a nice place to spend a couple of hours. 600 baht entry fee.

reviews.name: tommy tham
reviews.text: Great place to relax your sore muscles. You can actually drive here rather than taking the "expensive" ferry route. Driving would take you to the back of the spa that looks like a little lIke a junkyard with chickens hangng around and no proper parking. Just park your car and find your way to the reception, meet the super friendly receptionist Nikky. Is 600 for the 15 pools and 350 for an hour of massage. Water is about 40deg C, so it may feel too warm in the afternoon, come in the morning maybe. But I do like the water hot.

reviews.name: Paul Roy Sanders
reviews.text: As a foreigner living in Thailand this was an absolute gem to find and worth the slight detour away from the main road which I suspect keeps it off the tourist itinerary largely. It's not 5* spa service but definitely a 5* relaxing experience worth the 15 min drive from the main road. The small pool at the top end is quite special with perfect views of the river and a feeling of escape and calm.

reviews.name: Sicilia Pan
reviews.text: Very wonderful places for this hot spring experience, especially for raining day. But the road for going there not so smoothly, you need more carefully drive.

reviews.name: hn
reviews.text:
Soothing sequence of 15 rock pools, mostly with curvy shapes, smallish and well shaded. Not just utter relaxation, but also a pleasure being in imaginatively landscaped grounds sloping towards Kwai Noi river below; with huge bamboo stands, many other trees and shrubs, of course birds and squirrels, but few blossoms.

The place has nothing of the dull rectangles that mar so many Thai parks and hotel grounds. Thankfully, it also has no public loudspeakers piping music or announcements. The rural 1 km driveway to Rock Valley leads through amazing bamboo stands.

Do not bring anything: the place insists you use their own swim trunks/sarongs, poolside slippers, towel and drinking water. No outside food is allowed, and inside i think you only get a few cold drinks and health drinks.

Honestly, I didn't notice much difference between Eucalyptus, Milk, Chinese Tea and Coffee pools (I have limited sensory talent). All the more difference I noted in the “Dr. Fish” pool - it's not only colder, but I also first shrieked, then giggled at swarms of tiny fish nibbling ferociously at my feet. I also like the herbal steam pool, which feels like a greenhouse - a tent of opaque plastic cover, just soothingly warm and not burning hot.

In some pools you hear strong pumps from outside at work, which I didn't care for. The initial and the last shower come from a cutely perforated bamboo tube, but now with *ice-cold* water - I didn't care for that either. One pool has too hot water spouting from hidden jets, which disturbed me twice.

I was there on two weekday mornings and felt almost alone. I had each pool to myself. No Eastern European bus crowds; at Rock Valley, l was well outnumbered by staff - a soothing difference to over-touristed Lin Thin Hot Springs in the morning.

Facilities are quite good, as you could expect for 650 THB entry, which is either for 2 hours or the whole day, I  received conflicting information about this. The clean, spacious toilets even have toilet paper, have you seen that before in Thailand? Change rooms are separate from the toilets, and you get a free locker too.

reviews.name: Marina David
reviews.text: Oh, heavenly was for me this massage experience. So authentic! I got thai and tok sen, also abdominal. The gentleman who did them made me feel very taken care of and well-treated. And his touch and techniques were just perfect for me and my body, that felt contained and got rid of a tone of tension there. All the respect and appreciation. I clearly recommend.

reviews.name: pp liu
reviews.text:
It’s not one of those fancy spa vibes, but WAAAAYYY BETTER. Professional, clean, thorough, and incredibly effective.

I was in Chiang Mai for five days and went three times- including right before my flight out.

For my first visit, I booked a day ahead and was able to get an 11 AM slot for me and my friend. My friend went for the traditional Tok Sen, and I opted for the 1.5-hour Thai massage.

When we arrived, we took off our shoes and waited on the porch. Our masseurs brought out warm bowls of water with slices of green bergamot for a quick foot soak—such a nice touch. Then we changed and got settled in. There are three massage tables with curtain dividers, keeping it simple but cozy.

My masseur was absolutely next level. Every move was perfectly targeted. I walked in sore and stiff, and walked out feeling like I was floating.

reviews.name: Veronica Lin
reviews.text:
This is a more low-frills massage place, but the massage itself was absolutely amazing. I booked a 90-minute massage and the therapist’s technique and pressure were fantastic — one of the best massages I’ve had! I’ve been carrying a lot of tightness from full-time traveling and carrying little kids, and I left feeling so much more relaxed and restored.

Booking was very easy; I contacted them via LINE the day before and they were able to fit me in. I also loved the herbal tea and snacks afterward, which was such a thoughtful touch. Everyone was kind, professional, and welcoming. A wonderful experience overall — highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Look Up Travels
reviews.text:
Wow!! My wife and I both had the oil massage, and our masseuses gave us both really great massages! We arrived close to closing time, but they still took us in graciously and provided excellent service. Once we finished, we were pampered with fresh mango and warm tea. Lovely owners and lovely place!

We are happy we choose to come here out of all the massage parlors in Chiang Mai. It’s located on a smaller street off one of the main streets very near Wat Prha Sing. We highly recommend coming here if you’re in the area looking for a massage.

reviews.name: Angel Tey
reviews.text: The shop lies in such an unassuming place; tucked away in a small alley way and hidden behind heaps of plants, one might not think much of this place. saw some great reviews and decided to try it out without expecting much, but I was blown away by how amazing the massage was! the owner only had time for a 30 mins massage, and gosh it was the best 30 minutes I've had in my life 😂 she managed to work out all the knots and stiffness I had within such a short amount of time! Even provided snacks for me which was so delicious too 🤙 super friendly owner, 10/10 recommend this place!

reviews.name: El-V
reviews.text: Went here for a foot massage and loved it. The vibe was relaxing and the staff were helpful and friendly. My feet have never felt soooo good. 10/10 recommend

reviews.name: Dominik Stegmaier
reviews.text: Our best massage in Chiang Mai, maybe our best in whole Thailand. A-Va is lovely, very friendly, professional and clean. I tried the foot-massage and the deep tissue massage. It was fantastic an we loved the cats from the cute little cafe next to A-Va. Very cheap prices (you should give a big tip😉). I highly recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏🙏Thank you 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Labeeb Ahmed
reviews.text:
5/5 Fantastic place for a massage!

I did my first ever Thai massage here, and was glad that I did.

The lady doing the massage was very skilled, of course. I asked for medium strength for my traditional Thai massage, and what I got definitely felt medium in strength.

Surprisingly, I feel asleep for a little during the massage. I was just so comfortable during the experience that I took a little nap 🤣. I think this goes to show how good the experience was for me.

The prices are very good! Only 240B/hr for the traditional Thai massage, which is very fair!

Also, they gave me tea and mango slices at the end. Great way to end off the experience!

Overall, will come back if in Chiang Mai again!

reviews.name: Sunny J
reviews.text: The massage in this shop is worked well for me.  Also, during the massage, I was moved by the sincerity, and the short communication before and after the massage was very humane, positive energy and high tension were nice and pleasant.  Even after I came back to Korea, it became a memory that came to my mind all the time, and the gift you gave me on the last day is waiting for summer in Korea.

reviews.name: Lizard King
reviews.text:
Came here as my hotel was just around the corner. It is a small massage shop with just 3 tables, so booking in advance is recommended.

I had a 90-minutes deep tissue massage, the masseur was professional and efficient. My back, legs, arms, neck and head muscles all were well taken care of, both in terms of tension release and stretching.

When you’re done, they offer a cup of tea with nice rice cookies. The payment is done in cash or via QR code.

reviews.name: hyyyj
reviews.text: I got a deep tissue massage and my mom got a back neck shoulder + foot massage. We both enjoyed it so much! It was the best massage experience in my  week-long Chiang Mai stay💖👍🏻 I only wish I discovered this place our first night here so we could come every day!! They’re also caring for homeless kittens and cats awaiting adoption🐱

reviews.name: Eyal .k
reviews.text: I came back again after massages elsewhere.  Last time the masseuse was a man and today a woman.  Both were professionals and did exactly what was needed.  The best massage I have ever had.  Just perfect!

reviews.name: Suzana Krevh
reviews.text: I usually don’t write reviews but oh my god! This massage was the best massage of my life! I’m not even kidding. I got the feet massage and the thai full body massage and they were both amazing, the masseuses are extremely kind, welcoming and professional. I was a bit sick when I came to Chiang Mai and I just walked in to this place without reservations and they had time to give me a foot massage. That night I slept like a baby and the next morning I woke up feeling so much better and I really feel the massage helped with me getting better!! And I also love how they don’t just rush you out of their place when you’re finished, but they give you tea and some snacks, so you can chill down a bit and take in the great massage that just happened, before you head on exploring the city. Love it and can’t wait to be back!! Would absolutely recommend!!!

reviews.name: Jack Jones
reviews.text: Great massages and everyone is super kind. What blew me away is that upon learning about a shoulder injury I recently sustained they have spent an incredible amount of time and effort and consulting amongst the therapists present to try and figure out the best way to heal and help me regain more mobility in my shoulder. They really have gone way above and beyond my expectations. Highly recommend, imo the best massage in old town while being less expensive than most other shops!

reviews.name: Jun Kim
reviews.text:
As a massage addict, I've visited many massage shops in Chiang mai.
I declare for sure that A-va massage is the best. The masseuses(male, female) here are all experts in massage.
They knew precisely where to put pressure on the body, how strong or delicate pressure should be, and how to relieve muscle fatigue effectively.
It was quite impressive that they performed more various, more effective stretching routines than what other shops provided.
Despite the humble exterior and interior, extraordinary massage skills and the following satisfaction make many tourists visit here again and again. Some massage nomads settle down here to finally get a relief.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing - don't question, just give it a go. I tried various massages and my body feels new. It was a blessing to have met Ava, thank you.

reviews.name: WTam
reviews.text: Don't see the shop is not luxury but therapists are really good! My neck hurt from the first night massage in Chiang mai, so i think just herb press without massage last day in Chiang mai. Luckily i found this A-Va massage, the therapist use herb press and massage to remove my neck & back pain. So I highly recommend this massage

reviews.name: danielle bickers
reviews.text: I had been having a muscle related hip pain for about 2 months.  While on vacation to Chiang Mai, our Airbnb happened to be across the street from A-Va Massage.  They got me in, the masseuse work on the muscles around my hip, although uncomfortable, I walked away pain-free!  It was wonderful and affordable. When I return to  Chiang Mai, I will definitely return here!

reviews.name: Chu Man
reviews.text:
Lady who runs the shop, speaks good English, so you can really inform her of ANY issues you need resolving.

I went for 3 sessions spaced out over the course of 2 weeks, 2 with her colleague who she called in especially, and one with her.

My troublesome back and tight right leg eased loads after each treatment and I am thankful for it (even if sometimes I had to grit my teeth and endure, no pain no gain!)

Obviously you have to communicate how much pressure you’re willing to take.

Do try and book in advance and she will try and for you in. I had a couple of massages from another shop in town which were fine if you haven’t got deep rooted issues.

😁

reviews.name: Veds Kali
reviews.text:
This is probably the BEST massage experience I have in my whole life. I am even planning to visit Chiang Mai once again just to try their massage.

My biggest mistake was to book my massage an hour before their closing, so extending was not an option. Really really good massage. Highly recommend :)

title: Yoga On the Beach (by Yoga Balance)
ownerDescription: Experience a yoga lesson on Ao Nang beach with beautiful views and an afternoon sunset and good vibes in the Morning Suitable for all levels of experience, from first timers to experts. There will be a chance to take away photos and videos of your lesson too!
address: Aonang beach Krabi Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81180, Thailand
plusCode: 2RHG+55 Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi, Thailand

reviews.name: Jamie Ellwood
reviews.text:
The best yoga experience I've ever had! A 90 minute class on the beach while the sun was rising behind us, the calm ocean waves in front of us, and fresh air was all something so special to remember!

Our instructor Den was incredible, she was so so fun and helpful, every little thing I was doing slightly wrong she helped and adjusted me and explained why - she's given me a bunch of homework it's really helped me! The class was challenging but also the perfect way to start your day with lots of energy but nice and relaxed too.

(Also a bonus that a lovely dog joined us and slept by our yoga mat the entire time!)

Would definitely recommend to anyone in Ao Nang to go and experience it at least once!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: CT
reviews.text: We loved our private sunrise yoga class with Arisa. She was so inviting and helped us through challenging poses. She provided mats, towels and water and we were shaded with the sounds of the peaceful ocean waves. We felt so relaxed after the class and would recommend to anyone looking for a morning tranquil escape.

reviews.name: Lukas Peter
reviews.text: The yoga class with Arisa was just fantastic from start to finish. We had a wonderful sunset and she even took some amazing photos and videos of us. Me and my girlfriend were total beginners and she guided us through these 90 minutes so well and supported us when needed. Arisa is also just a lovely soul! We recommend 10/10

reviews.name: Nazaret Ramirez
reviews.text: Had a fantastic 90-minute session with Den. Doing yoga right in front of the beach made the experience feel even more special and serene. Den is an amazing instructor who knows how to perfectly balance relaxation with physical challenge. She pushed us to try new things while making sure everyone was comfortable and safe. Great atmosphere and great energy!

reviews.name: Colleen
reviews.text: Wow, this was such a new and fun experience! Arisa, the owner and instructor for the yoga on the beach class, is so friendly, helpful, and encouraging. I was able to do poses I never thought possible, and she allows it to feel easy. I was so impressed from start to finish. A yoga mat and a bottle of water are also included. Even though it was raining a bit when the class started, she didn't cancel (and provided towels to wipe the mats clean and dry) and it made the experience even more fun. She also took lots of photos and videos to share with each participant. Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Jan Kaczorowski
reviews.text:
It was a beautiful afternoon when we had an amazing yoga session on Ao Nang Beach with Den. We booked it the day before after seeing a similar class taking place, and we’re so glad we did.

There’s no need to bring anything — mats, water, and towels are all provided and ready for you. Den has fantastic energy and is an excellent teacher. The 90-minute session was very well structured and surprisingly comprehensive.

As the sun began to set halfway through, the atmosphere became even more special, and we couldn’t resist taking a few photos.

To make it even better, a very friendly dog wandered over and joined us. He clearly loves attention and cuddles — we had actually seen him doing the same thing the day before :-)

Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ewa Gulmantowicz
reviews.text:
We stayed in Aonang for few days and decided to do something diffent, so we booked yoga class on the beach. And it was the best yoga classes we’ve ever had! Our tacher Den made this evening really special. Our group was on so many different levels in yoga but Den still managed to make all of us feel seen and taken care of. She was very kind, patient and proffesional. We even tried hand stands for the first time! When I think about my trip to Thailand, yoga classes with Den is the thing that I miss the most 🤍

If anyone hesitates - don’t! It’s the most beautiful memory You can collect 🤍

reviews.name: Maeve-Ellen Moyles
reviews.text:
I honestly couldn’t recommend this beach yoga class enough. The class size was small and intimate, set in the most breathtaking surroundings — practicing yoga with the sound of the waves and fresh sea air was pure magic.

The teacher is truly exceptional: fun, incredibly knowledgeable, endlessly patient, and so inspiring. As an intermediate yogi, I really appreciated how she challenged me in a supportive and encouraging way. She pushed me just enough to step outside my comfort zone while always making me feel safe and capable.

Thanks to her guidance, I achieved poses I’d never even attempted before — including my very first headstand and crow pose, which I honestly never thought I’d be able to do. The way she breaks down poses and builds confidence is amazing.

A beautiful class, a brilliant teacher, and an unforgettable experience.

reviews.name: Rose
reviews.text:
Den 🥰 was the most incredible yoga instructor, she made me feel super comfortable but also gave me constant feedback to improve my poses. I had the privilege of getting a 1:1 class and she catered the class to me by asking if i had any poses I specifically wanted to work on, which was lovely. This part of the beach is so much more private and quiet which is definitely nicer than the yoga spots in the more crowded parts.

She even timelapsed and whole thing and took so many great pictures of me!
Thank you so much Den, hope to see you soon! 🫶🏻🙏🏻💗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Francesca Santamaria
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Yoga on the Beach. The class taught me new skills and helped me feel much more confident in my practice. The teacher was incredibly helpful, skilled, and patient, guiding us through each movement with clear explanations. I also had the chance to explore new poses that I hadn’t tried before, which made the session both exciting and rewarding. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to grow their yoga practice in a relaxing outdoor setting!

reviews.name: Victoria Morgan
reviews.text: Den was so supportive and knowledgeable- her clear instructions allowed me to get my first crow pose and head stand after ive been trying with other teachers for months! The longer 90 minute session allowed a good amount of warm up time before going into the faster flow , so the session felt much less rushed than a 60 minute session, this along with the beach as a setting made for a perfect way to start the day 💞 Would definitley recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Addison Cipowski
reviews.text: I had the best session with Arisa this morning! We had so much fun practicing my head stands and flying lizard. Great mix of breath work and vinyasa flow. She was so encouraging and friendly and gave me many recommendations for my vacation. I’m so happy I found her! One of the best memories of my vacation here :)

reviews.name: RG
reviews.text:
If you’re into learning about yoga, a yoga practitioner or want to experience the beach differently, I highly recommend this!

They have both sunrise and sunset yoga classes.

I joined the sunset yoga classes last year and it was such a beautiful experience! Being by nature while practicing yoga, seeing the sunset was unforgettable! 🧘‍♀️

The instructor Khun Den was really good, ⭐️ she gave a lot of tips on posture and breathing and also modifies the practice depending on your skill level, so don’t worry if you’re new to yoga. 🙂
Plus points for her encouraging energy, for taking photos, and ending the yoga practice with a beautiful affirmation! ✨

I came back this year because I had a such great experience!
The sunrise yoga is at 07:30-09:00. It was very calming and less people so if you have time, give it a try ☀️

Highly recommended! 💯

reviews.name: Wendy Rutten
reviews.text:
What a nice way to do yoga! On the beach during sunset😍 The yoga teacher was very kind and helpful. She gave you confidence. What a power she has and she was smiling all the time. You could see she was happy teaching yoga!
If you like to do yoga, do not miss the sunset yoga on the beach!!! Do not close your eyes😉 the view is breathtaking!
Thank you🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Maryna Dronhovska
reviews.text: I have visited yoga 4 times during my vacation and it was great addition to holidays.   Den is extremely helpful and can create friendly atmosphere for participants. No matter what experience you have in yoga, you will find something cool for yourself🥹 Enjoyed sunrise yoga the most in the empty beach near the sea🫶🏼

reviews.name: Pha
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful yoga session on the beach this morning. It turned out to be a private session, and the instructor, Den, was super friendly and encouraging. She even helped me try a handstand for the first time! It was so enjoyable to flow with the waves and breathe with the sea breeze. To make it even more special, two dogs were running around watching us - such a cute and memorable moment. The beach was quiet in the morning, just nice for yoga. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: rosalia mimin
reviews.text:
Last week, I booked a sunset yoga session with them, and it was truly such a great experience. I felt more grounded, relaxed, and completely immersed in the beautiful energy of practicing yoga by the Ao Nang beachfront.

I still can’t move on from that amazing feeling (dear yogis, if you know, you know 😂🤍)

Hope I can revisit again and join another session with the instructor. I really loved the way she guided us throughout the class, making the whole session so fun, calming, and enjoyable for everyone. - Sincere Thank you- 🤍Rosa from 🇲🇾
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊 and I hope you will to see again ✨

reviews.name: echo gao
reviews.text: Had an amazing morning yoga session today, felt so energized when I practice the breath against the sound of waves in the morning.  Such a great experience. The instructor was very professional and nice. I tried head up side down with her and felt great! Will definitely join the sunset session again! Cannot recommend more.

reviews.name: carlota rovello
reviews.text: It was such a great Yoga session, it was challenging as well but I learned some new poses that I haven’t done before. Arisa is such a great and experienced instructor, I enjoyed a lot. Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Ashley Yu
reviews.text: Our instructor Den brought such wonderful energy. She brought enthusiasm and patience for all levels and helped us feel very comfortable. She encouraged us to try things that we’d never done and made it a very safe and guided environment to push our limits. Very relaxing and empowering 90 minute session—would highly recommend!

reviews.name: Petal D-Ruse
reviews.text:
We loved the Railay Beach Yoga Balance  class with Arisa!
She is an excellent teacher and practitioner, her strength and balance are awesome!  Her guidance is clear and effective, which gave us confidence and enabled me to achieve things I didn’t think possible!  Who knew I’d be able to do a head stand at 62 having not attempted it for 20 years! :)

Everything was provided for our comfort and the timing was perfect, so that the late afternoon class gradually became a beautiful sunset yoga experience, in a beautiful location with photos capturing it all for us.

I am full of gratitude for such a wonderful and inspiring experience with Arisa during my trip to Thailand.

reviews.name: Melissa Artini
reviews.text:
My husband and I did the sunset yoga at Railay Beach with Arissa and also the sunrise yoga at Ao Nang beach with Den. We thoroughly enjoyed both classes and both teachers. These yoga sessions were definitely one of the top highlights of our trip!
While not being very flexible, with the help of the teachers, I was able to do some poses I never thought I'd be able to do. I definitely recommend this to anyone wanting to do yoga and would 100% go back on our next trip 🧘‍♀️ 🧘‍♂️

reviews.name: Kasia Sosinska
reviews.text: I was the only student in the class today and Den was amazing throughout the whole session. She paid attention to details and made me feel safe and comfortable. She noticed my abilities and challaned me to go even deeper into some poses. I highly recommend classes with Den. I will definitely come back again. It was not only professional but also fun and educational. Thank you Den!

reviews.name: Julia Schwarz
reviews.text: my friend and i just accomplished the 10:30 till 12:00 yoga class and it was amazing! Den was the nicest and best yoga teacher you could wish for! she adapted her teaching perfectly to our yoga knowledge, so I felt challenged but not overwhelmed. i would really recommend!

reviews.name: Stephanie Polanco
reviews.text: Arisa was an angel. She gave an amazing class and even helped me build the confidence to do a headstand. So grateful for the experience and for her guidance. 10/10

reviews.name: Robyn Chappell-Wood
reviews.text: Den is an incredible teacher. She sees her student’s capabilities and challenges them. I learned so much from just 90 minutes with her. And watching the sun set was an added bonus!

reviews.name: Rory Robertson
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing yoga session for sunset at Railay Beach. Will definitely go again! Arisa took a brilliant class

reviews.name: Doug Smith
reviews.text: Had a wonderful session with Arisa. A very professional and knowledgeable instructor. She was very patient with me and I have to say it was one of the best yoga sessions I have had in years. What a wonderful teacher she is, I highly recommend taking one of her classes, if you are in Ao Nang Krabi .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Lena Felix
reviews.text: I went to a studio lesson at yoga balance. Den was my teacher and I absolutely loved the class I went the next day again!! She put so much effort and care into her class and she was adapting it directly to my needs and my level which was soo great. She engaged me to do poses that showed me my full potential and I didn’t even know I could do that!! She explained everything so well and really took her time with me so I would understand how I can correctly do the poses. I would recommend a class with her to everyone she is an absolute great teacher!

reviews.name: Gerald Edler
reviews.text:
I loved the AoNang Beach Yoga class with Arisa!
She is an excellent teacher, her strength and balance are awesome!  Her guidance is very clear and effective.
I one time even took a longtail boat at 7 am to AoNang for the morning class, when I stayed in Railay (600 Bt, arrange the day before and bring exact amount ;) ) Awesome, looking forward to coming back and participating again in autumn or next year :-))

reviews.name: agnes subicz
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed a sunset beach yoga class with Yoga Balance Thailand studio. Den is an experienced yoga teacher, who held us a perfect hatha class combined with vinyasa elements. She could fit the level of the class to all participants, there were some challenges in it, and it was also enjoyable. Thank you for the great experience.
Namaste 🙏🌅🕉️

reviews.name: Lee
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful yoga class with the teacher. She is super kind, attentive, and really puts her heart into the practice. In the middle of the class it started raining, so we moved to the studio, and she patiently guided me through many challenging poses. I truly felt she gave her all in the class. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Patricia Bajakova
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Exactly what I was looking for when wanting to do yoga on the beach. Highly recommended! Arisa is great ❤️

reviews.name: L. E.
reviews.text:
Dan is so heartwarming!
She was able to create a joyfull and calm atmosphere, but it was also a lot of fun trying to do the craw! It was perfect for beginners, but also challenging for advanced. The group has the perfect number of participants, so she can pay attention to everyone.
Her attitude is like a sunshine in the morning!

reviews.name: Big Suze
reviews.text: Truly enjoyed my sunrise yoga session with Den. She’s passionate abt yoga and patiently guided me through a meaningful practice, focusing on form rather than speed. Felt energised for the day - yet grounded and calm. It was such a special experience doing yoga on the beach. Made my Ao Nang trip extra memorable!

reviews.name: Harley Gibb Salva
reviews.text: I have definitely enjoyed hatha & vinyasa yoga classes here! The classes here cater to different levels of expertise. Although I still consider myself a beginner, Teacher Den made sure I do not settle for that and pushed me to my limits. I personally preferred classes in the studio than at the beach (where I feel I could get distracted easily). Take it from me when I say that Den is very passionate and knowledgeable in her craft which made me feel at ease because I know that I will learn a lot. Thank you, teacher Den, for your patience, knowledge and tricks so I can do the poses properly. At the core of each classes, finding your inner balance while committing to what’s comfortable to you is the utmost priority. When you are in Ao Nang, this is definitely worth your time. Namaste, Yoga Balance Studio xo

reviews.name: Desiree F
reviews.text: The morning yoga class with Den on Ao Nang beach was wonderful! Den is an excellent teacher with positive energy and helpful guidance for the poses. She made the class fun and doable for students at all levels, even beginners! The class is early enough that it's not hot and before the sun comes out. A very peaceful and active way to start the day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: JP
reviews.text: We loved the morning yoga class with Arisa on Ao Nang beach. She was so encouraging and helped us do some poses we have never tried before. Thank you so much !!

reviews.name: alisha
reviews.text: Had such an amazing morning doing yoga by the beach with Den. It was quiet and peaceful. Den was such a great teacher and she took the time to correct my poses. Genuinely can’t wait to be back. I must say this is one of the highlights of my trip. Thank you so much Den.

reviews.name: Like a Wish
reviews.text:
It’s been 2 months since I joined yoga class, and I can see the transformation within myself in terms of strength, flexibility, and concentration.

Big thanks to Kru Aoi(Arisa) and P’Waan for teaching me yoga, they changed my mind about the yoga that it’s boring and slow, it can be super fun and joyful too ☺️ I really enjoyed learning with them especially the headstands challenge 🧘🏻‍♀️ Go beyond your limits and you’ll see how amazing your body can be.

There’s daily yoga sessions by the beach (sunset hour) and at the studio. You can look up the schedule on their facebook page.

Highly recommended 💗💗💗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for review kaaa 🪢

title: Bodhi Tree Cafe
ownerDescription: In middle of hectic old city, we wanted to create a peaceful oasis, in a traditional wooden house, where you can enjoy organic vegan / vegeterian offerings. And where you can relax in company of like-minded people, or learn cooking class or join a Yoga class.
address: 11 Rachadamnoen Rd Soi 5 Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXQR+J9 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

similarHotelsNearby.name: Garden Yard Inn Chiangmai 清迈院子院子客栈

reviews.name: Ksenia Parkhatskaya
reviews.text:
We had a family lunch there. Was truly delicious. Especially the spring rolls, they were the highlight. Great vegetarian meal.
Btw upstairs they have some yoga classes. It was 300 baht for 90min yoga class. Hatha. Very good.

reviews.name: Julia Davila-Coppedge
reviews.text: The best breakfast I had in Chiang Mai. The woman who owns it is so friendly. She is also able to make things off the menu. I had the avocado toast but with tofu, instead of egg. 10/10

reviews.name: 360marcl
reviews.text: I have been to Bodhi tree 2 it,s a vegan restaurant with a yoga studio.|On Google they have about  600 reviews ant 4.5 stars|The adress is  completly different  11 Tatchadamnoen road soi 5 in the heart of Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Freedom Cole
reviews.text: What set this place apart for me was the amount of mushrooms added to the food. They grow 6 or 7 different mushrooms depending on the season, and they are abundant with how much they add to their dishes. If you like mushrooms, don’t miss the food here.

reviews.name: Mixed Rice
reviews.text:
Lovely cafe down a little soi. We had fresh fruit juices, Khao Soi, and massaman curry.
Very laid back vibes. Attached to a yoga studio and a cooking school.
I'll be coming back for the raw vegan cheesecake!

reviews.name: Adam Schofield
reviews.text: Had a lovely meal here at this small, family-run restaurant. The food was delicious and very reasonably priced. We had a nice chat with the couple running the restaurant and were even given some free fruit after our meal. Wonderful all round.

reviews.name: Nina Mühlemann
reviews.text: Last year I walked around the city and the restaurant caught my attention as there was sound healing sound when I walked by. I came back one year later to this restaurant. The service is still so nice and welcoming. They do vegan/vegetarian food and you can have brown rice upon request. The food is simply amazing with natural & organic ingredients. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Carlos Garces
reviews.text:
Tonight, we stepped away from the bustle of the Night Market into a quiet side street to find Bodhi. It was the perfect decision. We started with the Massaman curry, which was solid and flavorful, but the real stars were the Burmese Tea Leaf Salad and the fried rice—both were absolutely sensational.
We finished the night with the mango cheesecake, which was a highlight. To top it off, the service was excellent; a French gentleman (who appeared to be the owner) was incredibly attentive and made us feel right at home. This is easily one of the best vegetarian spots in Thailand. Don’t miss it!

reviews.name: Charlie Morton
reviews.text: One of my favorite guesthouses and restaurants in Chiang Mai! Full of warmth, soul, and authentic goodness. The team are lovely, and so is the accommodation and delicious vegetarian food. 💘

reviews.name: CJ
reviews.text:
massive maternal energy here. love beings eager to serve. i hope they have more business. was sad to see empty at lunch time.

green curry was amazing ;)

reviews.name: Hannah Cooper
reviews.text: Overall we had a nice meal here- a Spanish omelet, a cashew tofu dish and several different drinks. We were a bit disappointed by the service. We waited for over 40 minutes for our meal and the drinks were also not brought out at the start. While we understand this is a family-run restaurant there was only one other table there, so the wait was quite unexpected. I was also told that they couldn’t make a fried pumpkin dish, but there was pumpkin in the cashew dish I ordered, so a bit confusing and disappointing. I do love all their veg options, but definitely some room for improvement.

reviews.name: H H
reviews.text: The review is only about thé café. It's very cosy with a relaxed vibe. I really enjoyed the mango sticky rice - it was excellent. As for the tea, the quality wasn't great, but everything else looked really good, though I can't judge without having tried it.

reviews.name: John Hale
reviews.text:
Easily my favorite cafe in Chiang Mai, veggie and otherwise. We’re in town once a year, and it’s my first stop.  Food is super-fresh, atmosphere welcoming and chill.  Bring a book or chat with neighbors.
I’m in the guest house this year for the first time, and it’s fine, but the cafe is what really makes the visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks  John. Hope to see you at the Bodhi tree café when you ll' be back to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Eden Mills
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious and fresh vegan food! Staff is attentive and very friendly. Every dish we had was perfect. Very peaceful location as well :)

reviews.name: J A
reviews.text: Super grateful for this place and for meeting Lotus, the amazing owner. She went above and beyond for me during my time in Chiang Mai, from sharing delicious vegan/vegetarian meals to helping me find great accommodations, exploring the city together and her friends, and even offering great yoga classes. The food here is perfectly made with so much care, and the location is right in the heart of Chiang Mai. Forever grateful for the kindness, the connection, and the beautiful energy Lotus brings into this space
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your review.  I enjoyed to take care of you and your friends.

reviews.name: Sky Caesar
reviews.text:
Myself and a friend completed a cooking class at Bodhi Tree Cafe, as a vegan in Chiang Mai not only was the experience tasty and welcoming where sometimes it's a challenge to find vegan-friendly food, but the experience itself was so special as we swapped stories, cooking and health tips, and got to taste along the way.

Our teacher was so friendly and the ingredients were personal; some sourced from her organic garden or fresh from friends. Unforgettable!

reviews.name: Arne Ellerbrock
reviews.text: We spontaneously went to Bodhis Tree Cafe and were greeted by the hospitality of the owner! She spoke very good english and helped us choose the right food and drinks. Especially the drinks (we had a smoothie and different iced green teas) were fantastic, the food was also really good and the owner gave us fresh fruits on top. Strongly advise going here to get a very healthy and tasty dinner!

reviews.name: Verissimus
reviews.text:
Super disappointing experience.
The service was very slow, but the food was good.
We had fruit bowls with yogurt and honey, fresh coconuts, Thai tea, etc.
There seemed to be a misunderstanding with the order, but it was resolved finally. Some staff don't speak Thai, and English is also limited.
However, when it came time to pay the bill, an old lady (the owner?) took forever to organize it, had to speak to the kitchen and waiting staff multiple times, and finally came to inspect the dishes on our table as she didn't believe we hadn't ordered/eaten a large bowl of yogurt... So silly and suspicious and uncomfortable for us.
What a pity. We live locally but won't be back.

reviews.name: Syril Sadasivan
reviews.text: The resturant here is a true gem. Every meal here tastes so good with fresh ingredients that they use. During my stay in Chiang Mai, I kept coming back here to try other things on their menu. Price is affordable as well.

reviews.name: Jeanette Green
reviews.text:
Lotus and Marc are very friendly people and the vibe in the restaurant is zen & friendly. Their food was super delicious! Had to try the khao soi, but also bay leaf salad. Both were supreme.
Lotus also  booked me a private driver out of town for one day; Competitive pricing and turned out great.

reviews.name: worawut chiablam
reviews.text:
This is truly a peaceful and beautiful place, perfect for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway. The hotel offers a wide range of excellent facilities, including a spa, yoga classes, a sauna, massage services, and a stunning swimming pool. (Please note that some facilities may require an additional fee, so it is best to check with the staff for pricing.)

The breakfast was absolutely delicious, with a great variety of options, including authentic Thai cuisine.

What impressed me the most was the Always Eat Late (AEL) dining experience. The menu offered a wonderful selection of beautifully presented and incredibly delicious dishes. Every meal was enjoyable and exceeded my expectations.

I would also like to express my sincere appreciation to the hotel staff. They were exceptionally friendly, attentive, and always available to assist with a warm smile, making my stay even more enjoyable.

A special thank you goes to the hotel owner, Khun Orn, who was incredibly kind, welcoming, and approachable. She provided excellent recommendations and made us feel genuinely cared for throughout our stay.

I highly recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a peaceful atmosphere, outstanding hospitality, excellent facilities, and an unforgettable dining experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and heartfelt review! 😊 We're truly happy to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere, wellness facilities, delicious breakfast, and especially your dining experience at AEL.

Your kind words about our team mean so much to us. And a special thank you for mentioning Khun Orn—we'll be sure to share your lovely message with her. She'll be so happy to know that her recommendations and warm welcome made your stay even more special. 💛

We're grateful for your recommendation and hope to welcome you back to Lis Hotel and AEL again soon for another relaxing and delicious Chiang Mai experience!

LIS Team

We stayed in a few places in Chiang Mai Old Town, and Lis Hotel was definitely our favorite. The people working there are kind, always smiling, and genuinely ready to help. The hotel itself is bright, beautiful, and very clean.

The owner shows such warm hospitality by offering complimentary coffee, tea, and even a fridge stocked with fruits, yoghurt bowls, and little treats that guests can enjoy anytime during the day. It really makes you feel at home.

One more thing that truly impressed us was the communication and care from the staff. After we left, we accidentally forgot our e-book at the hotel. Within a few days, they arranged for it to be sent back to us in Phuket, where we live. We really appreciated that extra effort.

We’re very grateful for our stay and hope many more guests get to experience this kind of hospitality. :)
