I loved the 24/7 access to yoghurt, fruit, juices and coffee. The pool is only 1.20 m deep so not really for swimming.

The cleaning staff never came during the  whole week we stayed, We had to ask twice at reception to get our room cleaned . ( Yes, we had the green light system on for cleaning but no one ever came.)

It was a bit better in the reception area, there’s always people there with their computer, and it’s a nice area to hang out and chill.

We wouldn’t come back mainly because of the location, having stayed 2 months in chiang mai exploring different areas this was our least favorite.

reviews.name: Charles Bohannan
reviews.text:
This is a bright and lovely property with positive energy and cheerful staff. The downstairs common area doubles up as an eating area and co-working/social space. WiFi is solid and I was able to work late into the night at my remote job.

Each morning there’s a healthy breakfast with fresh fruits and salad among other things. Snacks, coffee, and glass bottled water are always available which is a nice touch.

Attached to the hotel is a spa which I didn’t use, I but did enjoy some quiet meditation space by the circular fountain in the mornings. The rooms are clean, bright and minimal — I wouldn’t say cozy but I did sleep very well.

One thing I wish were different is the bathroom: the shower, toilet, and sink all were all in a single open space which means when you shower the entire bathroom floor and toilet get wet. They should have put some dividers for the shower, even if this were designed as an accessible bathroom (which I think it was).

While I realize the bathroom can’t be changed, there is one small but meaningful change I would suggest: offer locally grown tea for non-coffee drinkers. My wife drinks tea and only had access to some rather stale Lipton tea bags. Seems like a great opportunity to feature the products of local tea growers which would lead to more sales for them. The same goes with the coffee: the coffee from the machine in the common area was not good at all. I suspect it’s because the machine is not regularly cleaned or serviced to remove the scaling (which affects the flavor). I do think the coffee beans were local but it would have awesome to see a placard about the grower/roaster and the origin of the beans. These small touches would align nicely with an already savvy, modern, conscious Chiang Mai hotel.

All in all, Lis Hotel is a wonderful place to stay. The landscaping is gorgeous and it’s spotless. It’s a few minutes walking to the Old Town, minutes from the airport. Laundry service is a 2 minute walk away.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review 🤍
We truly appreciate your kind words about our space, team, and overall experience, as well as your valuable suggestions. Your feedback means a lot to us and will help us improve even further.

Lis Team

reviews.name: karen mak
reviews.text:
Mon and the staff are the key to this great property.  Mon is super nice and friendly.  In the morning, she will go around and chat with the patrons.  I got a couple Resto rec. from her and did not disappoint.  The staff are helpful and responsive.

Location - I prefer this location over old town.  The road is wider and not as congested.  Area is quiet and you will get the good night sleep.  I got myself a rental car the day I checked out so the wider road and free parking made life easier (I got my rental from BudgetCatcher, a 10 min walk to the office.  Highly recommended)

Check In/Check Out - got there before noon and left luggage with hotel.  Check in at 2pm.  Very smooth

Room - minimalistic and clean.  There are two chairs (one in patio and one indoor), good to sit and chill.  Basic toiletry = body wash, shampoo, shower cap, cotton & q-tip.  There is hairdryer as well.  Bed is firm and that’s how I like it.  Just like my mattress at home and slept like a baby

Food/Water - good variety of buffet breakfast.  Food was tasty.  Unlimited supply of bottled water (save you trip to 7-11 and worry free teeth brushing 😏)

Hacks - There is a short cut via the yoga studio/spa treatment bldg. of the hotel to Weave Artisan Society and
Beam&Col. coffee bar.  You can also get access to MARU for laundry run.

Minor Improvement for the property (Lis Hotel - if you are reading ☺️☺️☺️)

1. Shelving in the shower install would be nice.  I like to wash my face in the shower and had to place my face cleanser on the shower floor

2. Possible hooks nearby next to shower area for easy access of towel and face cloth
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Hope to welcome you back again soon!

 Contemporary, refined rooms with muted colors offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and balconies. Upgraded rooms add whirlpool tubs and direct pool access. Suites add sitting/dining areas, and villas offer terraces with hot tubs.
 Breakfast and parking are free. Other amenities include a trendy riverfront restaurant, a luxe spa and a yoga studio, along with a gym, tropical gardens, and indoor and outdoor pools. An airport shuttle is available for a fee.

reviews.name: Stella
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at RarinJinda for our anniversary and had an absolutely wonderful time. The traditional Thai decor gives the resort a perfect holiday vibe, and while it’s not a brand-new property, it is very well-maintained. The location is highly convenient, and the complimentary fresh fruit is a nice touch.

What truly sets this resort apart is the staff’s incredible attentiveness. We remarked that it was our anniversary and received lovely room decorations. Shockingly, the staff also noticed from our IDs that my birthday was approaching a few days later—something we didn't mention at all. On our last morning, they surprised me with a small birthday cake during breakfast!

Speaking of breakfast, it was outstanding and something we looked forward to every single day. Sitting by the river is so peaceful, the food quality is top-notch, and the fresh juices are amazing. We also tried the spa, which was incredibly relaxing and very reasonably priced.

The helpful and detailed service made our trip unforgettable. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Chiang Mai! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Mario Khoury
reviews.text: RarinJinda Wellness Spa Resort is an amazing hotel that I highly recommend. The rooms are spacious, luxurious, and feature both a bathtub and a separate shower. The hotel offers excellent facilities, including indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a well-equipped gym, and complimentary fitness classes. We also enjoyed the free hydrotherapy session and EIS wellness assessment, which made the stay even more special. The complimentary welcome drinks, beautiful atmosphere, and exceptionally friendly staff completed a fantastic experience. I would definitely stay here again!

The next day morning, breakfast was served right opposite of the hotel, a restaurant in front of the river that hotel guests can enjoy the kayak for free. Nice foods and view that I would say. One thing that we truly appreciate about this hotel was on The third day we were leaving to the airport and realized my husband phone was missing. We were so nervous and kept calling the phone. It was picking up by a lady who claimed that she is the airport information counter officer, someone from the hotel sent the phone to airport. That moment, nothing that we could say more but only Thank You. We love Chiang Mai and we believe we will be back in real soon to check-in the same hotel.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Rarin Jadin Wellness Spa Resort is undoubtedly the best resort that we have ever stayed in. The Thai Massage was absolutely the best Thai Massage that we ever had and it is a must try. The choices of food for breakfast was sufficient to give us a scrumptious breakfast.However, there was no warm water when we wanted to take shower at about 10 p.m. on our last night and the warm water was still not available in the morning. That was the only downside to our stay. I hope the Management can get the warm water problem fixed soon.Don't get us wrong. The downside is not going to be a factor to discourage us from returning to Rarin Jadin Wellness Spa Resort. Rarin Jadin Wellness Spa Resort is definitely highly recommended to everyone.

reviews.name: Matthew Read
reviews.text: Easily one the best hotels I’ve stayed in, I’ve been in a lot of hotels and this place is exactly the experience you want to have. No let downs, the staff go above and beyond. We wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Chiang Mai! Thanks for the Birthday cake!

reviews.name: Ken Finnegan
reviews.text: A great hotel, walking distance from the old city and many sights. The food was the highlight. We came to Chiang Mai for the culinary scene and it turns out our hotel restaurant (Deck One) was one of our favourite places to eat. Tasty, quality, and wonderful service. Highly recommend this hotel for a great stay in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: A rustic hotel that does everything well. The best thing here also includes the amazing restaurant named 'one deck' and of course the spa. Cleanliness is very good and service is top notch. Every individual staff here is warm and made us feel at home.

reviews.name: Christian Watson
reviews.text:
It was so perfect! Room was comfy and clean with such a great vibe. Friendly staff outstanding service, highly recommend definitely will be back next time!
By the way the massage therapist here is very professional, the best massage I had!

reviews.name: alison lalor
reviews.text:
RarinJinda Spa in Chiang Mai was absolutely incredible — it felt like a true escape from the city.

Breakfast at Deck One was over the top and such a highlight of our stay. Beautiful setting, delicious food, and excellent service. Everything about this experience felt thoughtful and luxurious without being stuffy.

Highly recommend RarinJinda Spa if you’re looking for relaxation, comfort, and outstanding hospitality in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Victor Wong
reviews.text:
Review of the spa, did not stay at the resort.
Unfortunately very disappointed. The ambience and facility was nice, and they have some nice pre and post-treatment refreshments. But other than that, the treatment did not justify the considerably higher cost compared to many of its competitors. I got a 90 min Thai massage, and the masseur unfortunately felt inexperienced. Even after I asked for stronger pressure, it did not really feel good. My parents also had the elements of life package, which was also nothing to write home about.

It’s also a red flag that it’s not part of their standard practice to ask us what kind of pressure we want, or any problem areas to focus on.

The website/booking system is also really hard to navigate.

It wasn’t a terrible experience, but for the price, we really did expect a lot more considering their competitors in the market.

title: Maliwan Thai Cooking Class
address: 9 Thanon Sap Sam Hang, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
plusCode: QF6X+9P Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Lacoste Etienne
reviews.text:
A wonderful experience and one of the highlights of our trip to Bangkok!

We loved starting the morning with a visit to an authentic local market by tuk-tuk, learning about Thai ingredients and local culture before heading to the cooking class. The entire experience was fun, well organized, and truly immersive.

Matinee, our course instructor, was incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable and passionate. We learned to cook delicious authentic Thai dishes and can’t wait to recreate them at home!

A special thank you to Kanda and the entire team for their warm hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bangkok!

reviews.name: Kayla Drouillard
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. If you come to Bangkok you must do this. The instructor was super friendly and explained everything perfectly. The market tour was wonderful. I really enjoyed learning about all of the fish and produce that is used in Thai cooking. Then you go back to the kitchen and cook all of the recipes. She makes it super easy and fun to follow along. The food turned out wonderful. This was definitely a master class on Thai cooking.

reviews.name: selena matheron
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic time at this cooking class with May. We started with a local market visit, where she explained all the ingredients and how they’re used in Thai dishes which is such a great way to understand the cuisine beyond just cooking.
The class itself was really well explained, easy to follow, and genuinely interesting. We ended up cooking a full feast, which made it even more rewarding.
A brilliant, hands-on experience from start to finish. I couldn’t recommend it more!

reviews.name: Agata Motyka
reviews.text: The cooking class at Maliwan Thai was a very memorable experience! The teacher was super friendly, warm hearted and very funny. You can tell she enjoys what she does and it all comes straight from her heart and that’s what makes this great. I recommend doing the morning session with the visit to the local market. While we were there she told us a lot of anecdotes about Thai culture and customs, we learned about various foods that we had no idea they existed. I am usually very clumsy in the kitchen but everything was so well explained that I had no trouble following the instructions and I was happy to learn that what I made was actually delicious! The ingredients are prepared in the amount that you need them, the ladies pick up used dishes so your station is always very tidy and you can focus only on the fun part of cooking

reviews.name: Cecille Saldavia
reviews.text: Loved the experience. One of my favorite things I did in Bangkok. The instructor and the staff are super friendly and the cooking itself is very easy to follow. Everything I cooked tasted so good! 🤤 It’s a must do when you’re in Thailand.

reviews.name: Matthias Deuss
reviews.text: This cooking class is so great that I came a second time and will come again! Maliwan is super nice and a great teacher. She has so much knowledge to share, and the market tour before the class is a great way to dive into thai culture. Highly recommended !

reviews.name: Kristina Ewing
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience at the Maliwan Cooking School at the end of January. We started the day with a tuk-tuk ride to the local market to buy fresh ingredients, which was both fun and informative. We then cooked four incredible Thai dishes. Mae is an outstanding chef and a fantastic teacher - we learned so much from her. She shared great insights both at the market and in the kitchen, making the whole experience unforgettable.

reviews.name: Donavan Heres
reviews.text: It was one of my favorite things I did in Bangkok. The teacher is so knowledgeable, helpful, and so Funny! It was such a great time. I learned so much about Thai culture when we went to the market. She introduced me to those working at the market and explained about their lives and work. She explained so much about the plethora of produce, meat, fruits, and animals for sale. She is such a knowledgeable cook as well. I could go on and on about how amazing this was. I really suprised myself with the dishes I made. I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: James Cho
reviews.text: I had such a great experience here as a solo traveler visiting Thailand for the first time. The instructor has more than a decade of restaurant experience. She gives very detailed explanations while also allowing you to make your food how you like it. She is also fluent in English. I can't recommended this class enough 👍 well worth the price of admission.

reviews.name: Fariba Izadi
reviews.text: I loved my customized cooking class only for me due to my allergy to crustacean. The communication was great in accommodating my needs and timing. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable. Highlight of my trip to Bangkok and I highly recommended this to anyone. I will definitely plan to go back for more dishes  to learn. Thank you again for enjoyable experience.

reviews.name: anushree mathur
reviews.text:
During our 5th trip to Bangkok, my husband and I decided to learn some cooking ..while browsing through classes close to Khao San road where we stayed I read these raving reviews about the classes..we were on the way back from Kanchanaburi when we called them..Mae answered and told us she will wait for us to visit although she was leaving for home , we went there to see the place where we wanted to cook..she has an amazing 6 person kitchen ..neat clean and giving cosy vibes. She helped us book seamlessly

Next day we started off with market visit, shopping some groceries and off to cooking. Mae was patient and answered doubts and explained process of Thai cooking making it an easy cooking class. We cooked , sticky rice with mangoes, green paste and curry, pad Thai and Tom yum soup. Once the food was cooked we enjoyed the meal …Will always recommend Mae’s cooking class. Thanks Mae will come back to learn more

reviews.name: JB91
reviews.text: We had a lot of fun. First visiting a market (real local experience), then cooking four different dishes, including green thai curry, a soup & pad thai. Highly recommended for everyone that wants to dive deeper into the Thai cuisine 🇹🇭👍

reviews.name: Anke Sinnaeve
reviews.text: A friendly and cheerful Thai chef welcomes you with a warm smile and teaches you how to prepare delicious Thai dishes entirely from scratch. The experience begins with a visit to the local food market, where you get to know the fresh ingredients — a valuable and enriching part of the day. During the cooking session, special attention is given to allergies and dietary preferences. After about two hours of cooking, you sit down to enjoy the four dishes you’ve made. Anything you can’t finish can be taken home in a doggy bag. A fantastic experience we highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We're happy to hear you enjoyed the day from market to meal.
It means a lot to hear you'd recommend the experience!

We always aim to make each class personal and enjoyable. Hope to welcome you back again someday!

reviews.name: Rob L
reviews.text: Great afternoon learning how to cook some iconic Thai dishes such as green curry and pad Thai. Very hands on and practical. Mae was full of information and helpful. We enjoyed the tour of the market too. Very happy to recommend this class.

reviews.name: Laura West
reviews.text: Mae's Thai cookery class was brilliant. We attended as a family of 5 with 2 adults and 3 children aged 6-10. The tuktuk to the market to buy ingredients was fascinating and informative and Mae was clearly well known and liked. The cookery class itself was spot on, we learnt a lot as adults and Mae included the children and gave them tasks they could do independently. We created 4 delicious dishes and have lots of wonderful memories.

reviews.name: Sauzede Dorian
reviews.text: Amazing Thai cooking class! The instructor was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and friendly, guiding us step by step through authentic Thai recipes. The flavors were amazing, and I learned so much about traditional ingredients and techniques. The experience was fun, interactive, and left me confident to recreate these delicious dishes at home. I highly recommend it to anyone who loves Thai cuisine or wants to explore it further!

reviews.name: Ray Yim
reviews.text: Wonderful experience for our corporate team bonding event. We learned where and how to buy ingredients, authentic recipes and ate the food. What more could you want!

reviews.name: Marcel Smalc
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic. Chef was great, helpful and fun, food that we cooked was incredible.
Even as profesional cook I learned some techniques. Great price for the value! Going on a local market(by tuk tuk!) smelling ingredients that we bought and learning about them amazing experience! You can take food home if you can not finish, better come hungry :). Small 6 people group also made it very cosy.

reviews.name: Damian Ceulemans
reviews.text: It was tough to wake up since I had the 9am class but it was worth it for sure! The teacher takes you to the market and tells you about everything, after that, she shows you how you cook some delicious dishes and you make them yourself. She really knows what she's talking about and has a good sense of humor definitely would recommend

reviews.name: Laurie
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful time doing a cooking class here. They first took us shopping in a local Thai market, and the we cooked five different dishes from scratch. I don’t cook much at all but they made it super easy to understand the recipe and make the dishes. Everything was delicious and at the end we got to eat it all and keep the recipe cards, and the gave a certificate. Would highly recommend when you’re visiting Bangkok so you can learn how to make delicious Thai food when you get home!

title: Thai Cooking School Phuket (Kata Thai Cooking Class)
ownerDescription: Welcome to Thai Cooking School Phuket, where you can embark on a culinary adventure and immerse yourself in the authentic flavors of Thai cuisine in Phuket! At our cooking class, we take immense pride in introducing you to the art of preparing traditional Thai dishes. Our mission is to provide you with the knowledge and confidence to recreate these tantalizing flavors in your own kitchen. As part of our immersive experience, we offer a captivating market tour that will transport you to the heart of Thai culinary culture, allowing you to indulge your taste buds with a wide variety of fruits that Thailand is renowned for. We are dedicated to preserving treasured Thai recipes and simplifying them, so that anyone can successfully recreate these
address: 1 Patak Rd Kata Beach, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R896+WM Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Maxi E (Million)
reviews.text:
Had an amazing morning at this cooking class.  Jim was a great teacher, fun, professional and knowledgeable .through and through a great experience.
The food all tasted great. Hands down the best mango sticky rice I had eaten on my trip.

reviews.name: samantha hunt
reviews.text:
a MUST when visiting phuket!!

this class was absolutely amazing we got to learn so much while having so much fun.

jim was an amazing teacher and was so lovely.

will definitely be recommending and will definitely be back

thank you jim!!

reviews.name: Ava lon
reviews.text: This was A-MA-ZING! We were the only on yesterday so had a private lesson. They will explain why you use certain ingrediënts and why not. The food tasted so good. We also got the recipes so we can make it at home. I would definitly recommend this cookingclass!!

reviews.name: Michał Cegłowski
reviews.text: Taking cooking classes with Jim was a fantastic experience. The session was packed with great tips, tricks, and insights into ingredient quality, while simultaneously being incredibly entertaining. Jim possesses an extensive knowledge of the dishes we prepared and shares it with infectious enthusiasm. I highly recommend these classes to anyone looking to expand their knowledge of Thai food.

reviews.name: Assaf Lev
reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience – a must!

I first signed up for Jim’s cooking class while looking for something fun for my son, who loves cooking. Personally, I’m more of an eater than a cook, but we decided to join as a whole family and give it a try.

And wow - what an absolute blast! Jim, with his vibrant personality and infectious laugh, shared with us the secrets of Thai cuisine. The class turned into a colorful, fun, and hilarious adventure that we’ll always remember.

Thank you, Jim, for such an incredible experience. It was professional, engaging, and so much fun. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: FlavourFiend
reviews.text:
The best cooking class that I’ve been too. Jim is hilariously funny and so so good at what he does.
We made Tom Yum, Thai Green curry, Pad Thai and Mango and sticky rice. They were absolutely amazing and we were blown away by each dish.
The hospitality was top notch and if you’re reading this, do not hesitate book now!
Thank you 🙏

reviews.name: Lili Omar
reviews.text: AMAZING! Best cooking class we’ve been to. We booked it last minute to fill out a rainy day not really knowing what to expect but we loved it and it ended up being the highlight of our holiday. Jim and Sally were lovely, funny and so dynamic. The tips they gave us were so informative and the food we cooked was delicious. Amazing value for money and could not complain.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow, what an incredible review! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that our cooking class wasn't just a way to fill a rainy day, but the highlight of your holiday! That truly means the world to us.

It makes us so happy to know you loved the class so much, especially how Jim and Sally made the experience so special – they really are lovely, funny, and dynamic teachers. We're also delighted that you found their tips so informative and that the food you cooked was delicious.

Providing amazing value is something we strive for, so your feedback on that front is fantastic to hear. Thank you for choosing us and for your wonderful recommendation – we couldn't ask for more!

Warm Regards,

Sally
Thai Cooking School Phuket (Kata Thai Cooking Class)

reviews.name: Sander Kollerie
reviews.text: Very nice cooking class and super nice instructor. We made a lot of authentic Thai food.

reviews.name: Shirly Niego
reviews.text:
Great experience!
Jim picked us up from the hotel, and then was our teacher for the day.
We explained all about the Thai ingredients, and how you can get them in your country. Everything was super fun and funny with him. They are true professionals, everything was super organized and clean. The staff always ready for the next steps - cleaning and setting up all you need.
The food was delicious!
So happy we chose you!

reviews.name: Sumitha Alex
reviews.text: Jim was great, we went as a family of 4, and it was just us. He picked us up on time and has a great funny energy. The class was very fun even for the kids who haven’t ever cooked. We learnt a lot of things too. The view from the room was nice. Definitely a must if you’re in the area fr.

reviews.name: Quinlan Martin
reviews.text:
Add this cooking class to your To-Do list when you’re in Phuket. Jim & Sally run an amazing class where you learn not only the “how” but also the “why” of making the best Thai dishes you’ll want to replicate at home: Red Thai curry, Tom yum soup and Thai sticky rice pudding.
The class is well paced, really engaging and hands on with fresh ingredients and so much knowledge imparted during the class most of which you wouldn’t even know to ask in a google search. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Aviv Srour
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Jim and Sally, the cooking class is both professional and funny on the same time, you can tell in the first minute they are an awesome instructors with a big smile and welcoming feeling. It’s also a very good meal after all :) Highly recommended! We had a great time! Thanks!

reviews.name: Chris Western
reviews.text: Many thanks to both Phil and Sally for a brilliant cooking experience. We had great laughs whilst making great food. Very informative, yet simple to follow will be sure to continue our thai cooking journey once we return home. Well recommended 👍

reviews.name: Amy
reviews.text: We had so much fun! Pick up was well communicated and right on time. Learning environment was clean and comfortable. Our instructor, Jim, was fantastic! He is a born educator. We learned so much about the ingredients and dishes. He taught us tricks and substitutions so we could successfully replicate the dishes at home. Overall it was the most enjoyable thing we’ve done while in Phuket. We were smiling the whole time, Jim’s enthusiasm is infectious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Amy. Look forward to meeting you again. Happy New Year!

Sally&Jim

reviews.name: Nick Williams
reviews.text: Me, my wife and daughter did one of the classes here and it was a fantastic experience. Jim is a big, energetic, character and really made the class fun as well as sharing some great knowledge. We cooked a soup/broth, a red or green curry, pad Thai and mango sticky rice and it was delicious. Everything was well planned and we really enjoyed the whole experience. Thanks Jim and Sally

reviews.name: Lee Holden
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing class. The food you cook has so much flavour and it's delicious. Jim is a great teacher and very funny. It's a must do if you're in the area.

reviews.name: Bah Anita Nina
reviews.text:
The best part of my birthday was attending this class. It was so fun and a wonderful learning experience. The best Pad Thai I’ve had since landing in Phuket. Can you freaking believe that?  The owners are super friendly and sweet. Would recommend everyone try this class. I love how Jim  made the sticky rice with natural food coloring ie butterfly pea=blue, red cabbage =purple, etc.
also they are huge dog lovers and rescue advocates too! Fun fun fun! They run a very clean facility!!! Can’t wait to recreate these recipes and make Jim proud lol

reviews.name: Catarina Eduardo
reviews.text:
Amazing and fun experience provided by the chef Jim! We cooked the best mango sticky rice I’ve ever eaten, very glad I had this experience, then you get to eat all the food you just cooked!
100% recommend

reviews.name: Marina Kodynska
reviews.text: Loved the cooking class with Jim and Sally - it was both fun and interesting. The ambiance was friendly, the recipes were delicious and the small class size ensured personalized attention. Overall, a fantastic way to improve your cooking skills, learn about new cuisine and culture from the locals in a fun and engaging environment. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Marion Karlsson
reviews.text: Fantastic place with great staff! Such a fun way to learn about the Thai coisene whilst spending time with friends and family. Jim (owner / manager) is super funny and very informative. Thank you!❤️

title: SBG Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Welcome to [SBG Cooking School]!
Are you ready to spice up your day? 🌶️
Join us for a fun and authentic Thai cooking experience right here in [Patong,Phuket], Thailand. Whether you’re a beginner or a foodie, we’ll help you cook like a local – and eat like one too! 😋
Let’s cook, laugh, and enjoy Thai culture together! 🇹🇭🍜
address: 66 Nanai Rd, Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand
plusCode: V8R3+6J Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Dr.Mayank Gupta
reviews.text:
I attended a 45-minute cooking class session today at SGB Cooking Class, Phuket, and it was a wonderful experience. I chose this class because of its excellent online ratings, and it truly lived up to the expectations.

Chef Nana was an amazing instructor—very friendly, knowledgeable, and clear in her explanations. During the session, I learned how to cook Pad Thai and Thai Green Curry, and she guided us step by step, making the whole process easy and enjoyable even in a short time.

The class was well organized, engaging, and perfect for anyone who wants a quick yet authentic introduction to Thai cooking. Highly recommended for tourists and food lovers visiting Phuket!

Ps -Also she made me learn (quick to use ) thai words . Khob khun krap chef nana..

reviews.name: Yasiru Nandasiri
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at SBG Cooking Thailand. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Thai flavors. Every dish was well prepared and satisfying, making it a nice place to enjoy a good meal. 🍜🌶️
The staff were friendly, and the overall atmosphere was pleasant and comfortable. However, prices were a bit higher compared to other nearby restaurants. Despite that, the quality of the food made it worth the visit.
Overall:
⭐ Great food quality
⭐ Pleasant atmosphere
⭐ Slightly higher prices
⭐ Worth trying for good Thai food

reviews.name: James Korn
reviews.text:
This was the most amazing experience, 3 friends and I did class 6 which had 4 meals and market tour. It was super educational and so so much fun! The food we made tasted out of this world and our teacher Nana is THE BEST! Ask for her if you want to have fun and learn lots.

KHAO SOI !!!!!!

reviews.name: Crystal Song
reviews.text:
This was the most fun cooking class I’ve ever taken! Nana (my teacher) is so amazing and she showed me not only how to cook amazing Thai dishes like chicken with cashew nuts, panaeng curry and green curry but also taught me how to speak basic Thai and Thai words commonly used in cooking and describing food.

She’s very patient and detailed and I had a great time. I can definitely see myself making these myself. At the end she even took me to the market and showed me all the best brands and products to buy

reviews.name: KIM EPIFANIS
reviews.text: What an experience. My son & I learnt how to make Tom Yum Goong, Pad Thai, Spring Rolls , Green Curry Paste & Mango Sticky Rice. We were also taken through the local market. Premises were really clean. Highly recommend taking the time to do this. We felt really at home & the people were just beautiful.

reviews.name: Kristen Kotsionis
reviews.text: Couldn’t speak higher of this experience. 4 hours, 4 dishes including a visit to the market. Everything was exceptionally organised, clean and fresh. Nana guided us and was incredibly entertaining as well. A must do if visiting Patong.

reviews.name: Bella Fiapuleniko
reviews.text: Nana & Natalie were amazing teachers and hosts. Definitely family friendly and worth every penny! Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing to study here. And don't forget to cook the dishes you learned to make and eat often. We hope you'll come back to study here again!

reviews.name: Natty Geeski
reviews.text: This was a fantastic experience.  From first contact over WhatsApp directly to being in house cooking with Nana. She is a wonderful chef and her teaching and personality made it a joy to be part of.  Definitely do this if you have an hour and half.  We chose our courses and it was so easy to cook and tasted amazing! Thank you so much.

reviews.name: isabella pietrasanta
reviews.text:
The most FUN cooking class I’ve ever been too!! And amazing food!! The instructor and cook was absolutely beautiful and sooo fun!!
Had an absolute ball. Highly highly recommend!! Best dish for me Tom kha and Tom yum!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing to study here, and don't forget to cook the food you learned and eat it often when you come back to study here again.🧑‍🍳❤️🥦

reviews.name: Yash Barot
reviews.text:
Great place to be here with your friends and
The host Nana is amazing, and she helped us with everything and Basic knowledge about Thai cuisine as well as the recipe
Very well, taken care of food. Recommend how much try
In phuket

reviews.name: Andrew Aylward
reviews.text: My wife and I attended the 3 hour cooking class and it was fantastic. We did it with another couple and we all had fun. So many little cooking tips that we will use again and again. You also get some basic language lessons, very useful and helpful. Nanna is a fantastic and energetic teacher. Would highly recommend it to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for choosing to study at SBG Cooking School. I hope you come back to study again.🧑‍🍳🙏🏻🥰

reviews.name: Andreas Nitschke
reviews.text:
I took the 4-hour Class 6 at SBG Cooking School and it was one of the highlights of my trip! We started with a local market visit, then cooked Pad Thai, Green Curry with Chicken, Tom Yum Goong, and Mango Sticky Rice completely from scratch.

Nana is such a kind, patient, and knowledgeable teacher — she really showed us how to balance Thai flavors the right way. The food came out so delicious! The whole team was friendly and welcoming.

If you love Thai food, don’t miss this class. Highly recommend! ❤️🇹🇭🍜
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing to study here, and don't forget to cook the food you learned and eat it often when you come back to study here again.🍲🦐🥒🦐

reviews.name: Ikram
reviews.text:
This was one of my best moments in Thailand. The class was perfect: we learned a few words of Thai and how to cook with the best teacher in the world, Halima (aka Nana). Thank you again!
Krob khun kaa ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a wonderful review! We were so happy to teach you how to cook delicious Thai food. We hope you'll come back for another class!🧑🏻‍🍳🥒🥭

reviews.name: Lisa McAnally
reviews.text:
Such an amazing experience!!! Nana and Natalie made it such a fun and wonderful experience, I'm now a proud Thai chef! We did the 45min class and cooked Phad Thai and Thai green curry, it was delicious!

They were great with my son who has Autism, so patient and helpful.

Highly, highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wowww look at you!(a real chef now)thank you so much for learning  with uss🧑‍🍳❤️🙏🙏🔥

reviews.name: Annette De Lira
reviews.text: Wonderful class!! Nana made the experience so funny and too fast! We had a great time learning to cook a few Thai soups and a stir fry! I can’t believe we cooked so much in so little time! We got to sit as a class to eat and talk to Nana. They took it upon themselves to trick my wife about not finding our reservation and blamed it on the wifi not working- little did we know it was part of a plan to surprise her with a small cake for her bday. It was so sweet and thoughtful. I hope to come back to Phuket real soon and we will definitely be back to cook with Nana again! Thank you all from us in Dallas Texas USA!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We thank you very much for choosing to come and learn cooking. We hope you will come back again soon!

reviews.name: Sarah Cropley
reviews.text: Nana and the team at SBG were amazing to learn from - this is more than an amazing cooking class, it’s also an incredible cultural opportunity. Nana teaches you not just how to cook the food but how to do it all in Thai. Food is delicious and customised for you - Nana took the time to learn about us and how we like our food to taste and gave us the chance to add more or less of certain ingredients so it would be perfect for us individually. Such a great class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌸 We’re delighted that you enjoyed the class and the cultural experience with us. Hope to welcome you back to SBG Cooking School again soon!

reviews.name: johnny redwood
reviews.text: Na Na is a wonderful teacher/cook with great skills and amazing recipes.  Her three recipe course was fun and interactive.  The recipes are all delicious. Definitely a great way to spend the afternoon learning about traditional Thai recipes.  Krob khun krap 🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for coming to this cooking class. You had a great time. See you again soon.🧑‍🍳🙏🏻🥰

reviews.name: Adriana Henao
reviews.text: Nana was so friendly and a great instructor. The entire support team was wonderful and made the experience wonderful, educational, and fun! I can’t wait to try all the delicious recipes at home.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very grateful that you chose to study cooking here, and we hope you will come back to study again.

reviews.name: Abdul Alamoudi
reviews.text:
Had an unforgettable experience cooking the original Thai food with Nani (:
From start to end everything was remarkable
Strongly suggested for a taste of Thai

I came here on a friend’s recommendation without expecting too much, but I was genuinely impressed. Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the seafood tasted incredibly fresh. The food was served quickly, and everything was cooked just right.

The flavors were well-balanced and enjoyable. If you like your food a bit spicier or with a stronger Thai flavor, just let the staff know and they’re happy to adjust it for you. Most of the customers during my visit seemed to be international visitors, which says a lot about the restaurant’s popularity.

The prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. You can park along the nearby streets, and the restaurant also has a small parking area that can accommodate around 10 cars. Overall, it’s a great place for fresh seafood, friendly service, and excellent value. I’d definitely come back again.

reviews.name: David Kemp
reviews.text:
We were recommended this place from khao soy Mae saw (if you haven’t tried get yourself there too). They told us it was a good original taste Thai restaurant. It did not disappoint.

The dishes start at 50THB. Over 2 nights we had the pad kra prow, crispy pork, stir fried red curry and special beef fried rice. All were great and it was exactly what we were after.

They also have a great craft beer selection too!

You sit in a courtyard with fans around you which is a pretty chilled atmosphere which is perfect.

If you want a wide variety of great reasonably priced authentic thai food this is the place for you!

reviews.name: liad weissman
reviews.text:
We attended Oun's workshop as a family—a couple with two teenagers and a younger girl. Oun picked us up from our hotel and took us to the local market for a tour among the stalls, introducing us to the various ingredients used in Thai cuisine. From there, we continued to his home, where we were welcomed with local fruits before we started cooking the dishes we had chosen in advance.
The workshop was a wonderful experience, conducted with a lot of patience. Each of us cooked our own dish, and afterwards, we sat down and ate together. We thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere, the warm hospitality, and the rich variety of spices and flavors.
We highly recommend coming hungry because it is a full meal!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! ❤️
It was a pleasure to welcome your lovely family to our home and cook together. We're delighted that you enjoyed visiting the local market, learning about Thai ingredients, and preparing your own dishes. It means a lot to hear that you appreciated our warm hospitality and the relaxed family atmosphere.
We're especially happy that everyone, from the teenagers to your youngest daughter, had a great time. Sharing the meal together after cooking is one of our favorite parts of the experience!
Thank you for your kind recommendation—and yes, coming hungry is definitely the best advice! 😄 We hope to welcome you and your family back to Chiang Mai for another delicious adventure in the future.
More Spicy, More Sexy, More Fun! 🌶️

Thank you again for choosing Tom Yum Thai Cooking School! We hope to see you again someday.

reviews.name: Megan Torres
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at Tomyumthai Cooking Class in Chiang Mai 🌶️✨ “More Spicy More Sexy” perfectly describes the fun atmosphere! Such a memorable experience from start to finish. The chef and his wife were incredibly welcoming and showed such great hospitality the entire time.

The class was hands-on, entertaining, and easy to follow, and the food we made was absolutely delicious. You can really feel their passion for cooking and sharing Thai culture. Lots of laughs, great energy, and amazing flavors all around.

Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Chiang Mai. Would definitely come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌶️✨
We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed your time with us at Tomyumthai Cooking Class. “More Spicy More Sexy” always makes us smile 😄
It was truly our pleasure to welcome you and cook together. We’re glad you enjoyed the atmosphere, the food, and the experience of learning Thai culture through cooking. Your kind words mean a lot to us and give us even more passion to continue sharing what we love.
Thank you again for choosing our class during your visit to Chiang Mai. We hope to see you again someday for more laughs, more spicy food, and more amazing memories! ❤️🙏

reviews.name: Georgia Pilkington
reviews.text: Best cooking experience in Chiang Mai! You get to choose your 5 dishes from varied options. The class is taught by funny, lovely people who really know their food!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊
We’re so happy you enjoyed choosing and cooking your 5 dishes with us. It was a pleasure to share Thai food and culture with you. Your kind words about our team truly mean a lot to us! We hope to see you again next time you visit Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Beth Porto
reviews.text: Just completed our AM cooking class at Tom Yum Thai Cooking School and I am so full I can barely stay awake to write this review!  We were picked up promptly at 9am and taken to a local market to learn about and purchase ingredients for the class.  Upon arrival at the school we got right to cooking our first dish.  I love how we got to choose each dish we wanted to prepare in advance of the class.  We were able to personalize according to our different tastes (spice level, leaving out an ingredient you don't like) so everyone was happy.  By 10:30 we were eating our stir fry dish, then soups, then appetizers followed by curry and mango sticky rice.  Can you see why I am so full?!?  Oun was our driver and chef for the day and he was a delight!  He made everything enjoyable and easy for the students.   All our questions were answered and we learned a lot.  Can't wait to try the recipe book back at home!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊
We’re so happy you enjoyed the class, the market visit, and cooking with us. Hope you have fun trying the recipes at home—hope to see you again someday! 🍳✨

reviews.name: Holly Goulden-Catlow
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience. Oun and Kae were both so lovely, funny and welcoming. We started with a trip to the market and learned about the ingredients we would be using as well as other local ingredients.
The class itself was very well organised and so much fun, and the food is delicious! We did 5 dishes each and you definitely leave more than satisfied.
We did this on Christmas day and had the best time. Would highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re very happy to hear that you enjoyed the market visit, the cooking class, and especially the food. reviews.name: Ryan Greco

We started with water and a fruit plate then got into prepping, cooking, and eating many dishes all with stories and excellent instruction. Based on my experience, this is a tremendous experience that everyone with interest in cooking or eating should take part in.

reviews.name: TIM SCHOFIELD
reviews.text:
What a good choice we made to come here. From booking and communication regarding our cooking school course.
We were picked up from our hotel and went to a local market where we collected some of the ingredients for the cooking course and got information on what was for sale at the market, which was very interesting.

We were then whisked away to the cooking school and given some snacks and water (it was needed as a very hot day)

We cooked an appetiser, soup, made our own curry paste, a curry to use the paste, and mango sticky rice.

The cooking and prep were great fun, and the right balance of cooking knowledge and banter.

The food we all cooked was top-notch, and you also got a digital recipe book and photos sent to you that were taken during the morning.

Highly recommended this course as a bit of an amateur cook. I got a lot of new knowledge and skills from this course.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing and detailed review! 😊 We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed the whole experience — from the booking and communication to the market visit, cooking, and sharing the food together. It’s great to know you appreciated the balance of learning, fun, and a bit of banter, and that the heat was helped by some snacks and water 😄
We’re especially glad the dishes, the recipe book, and the photos added to the experience, and that you gained new knowledge and skills as a home cook. Thank you very much for the high recommendation — it was a real pleasure having you with us, and we hope to welcome you again in the future! ❤️

reviews.name: Mike Waldvogel
reviews.text:
We had the time of our lives. Super friendly, varied and responsive to everyone. We were in the luxurious situation of having Yum to ourselves. No one else had signed up. First a walk through the local market, then a detailed explanation of Thai cakes with step-by-step instructions. First the starter, then the main course. The food was cooked in a fantastic outdoor kitchen. His wife then prepared each course with the ingredients, so all we had to do was chop and prepare.

It was great fun! Get in touch and take the cooking course.

At the end, all the ingredients and dishes were available to download as a PDF.

Thank you for a great evening.

reviews.text: This was the best experience at an extremely fair price. I came hungry and left very full and satisfied. Honestly some of the best Thai food I’ve eaten in Thailand. reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the food, the cooking experience, and our team’s hospitality. Your recommendation means the world to us, and we hope to welcome you back again for more delicious moments! 🙏👨‍🍳🌶️✨

reviews.name: NJ
reviews.text:
Super fun, entertaining and educational cooking class. Oun picked us up from the hotel, took us to the market where we shopped fresh, local produce and also touched, smelled different type of vegetables, herbs and he explained in what dish they’re used and for what purpose.
We learned so much just during our shopping.

I’ve never done any cooking class before, so I have nothing to compare to, but we absolutely loved this. Oun is so funny, everyone is involved and time just flew by. We all made and ate 4 different meals that we pre choose before the class, making our own curry paste as well for the curry dish and were also shown the famous Thai mango sticky rice. Everything was super easy and delicious. And you even get a recipe book with all the dishes.

I would 100% do a class with Oun again. 👩🏼‍🍳👨🏼‍🍳
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! 😊 We’re really happy you had such a fun and memorable experience, especially for your first cooking class. It was a pleasure having you with us, and we truly appreciate the recommendation. Hope to see you again! ❤️

reviews.name: Thi Minh Tran
reviews.text:
Great time we had. We loved it! We went to a local market and discovered many things about the Thai ingredients.
Everything is well explained and organized for each meal.
We were looking for a small surprise for the birthday of my son and they had foreseen a cake at the end so he could blow the candles for his Bday.

I really recommend! And when we come back to Chiang Mai, we will defenitely come back to Tom Yum.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 😊 We’re truly happy to hear that you had a great time and enjoyed discovering Thai ingredients at the local market. reviews.name: Brit van de Huygevoort
reviews.text: Incredible cooking class. We were picked up at the hostel and we visited a marked before the class. Oun is very nice and super funny. It is obvious that he loves to give the cooking class and he knows words in many different languages. His English is super good too! The food was amazing. 10/10

reviews.name: Juju Roy
reviews.text:
We decided with some friends to discover Thai cuisine under a new lens.
For that we chose to do a cooking class with Oun and Sam. The teaching was amazing, we had time to understand and learn about everything about the local food.
We managed to make amazing food and we all enjoyed it very much !
Be careful not to eat beforehand because you will make lots of dishes and they will all be delicious so it would be a shame not to eat them because you are full.
All in all I loved my afternoon cooking Thai food, it’s different from visiting temples but it is so worth it !

reviews.name: View Pchy
reviews.text:
I’ve trained at quite a few boxing gyms, and this is honestly one of the best I’ve been to.

The trainers here are amazing—they really pay attention to every little detail and make sure you’re doing everything correctly. They don’t just run through the workout; they take the time to explain, correct your technique, and encourage you throughout the session. I’ve never had this level of attention and coaching anywhere else, and it really makes a huge difference.

The gym has a very friendly and relaxed vibe. There’s no pressure or intimidation, so it’s a great place whether you’re just starting out or already have experience. Everyone is welcoming, which makes training even more enjoyable.

The place is always clean, and parking is super convenient, so getting here is easy and stress-free.

If you’re looking for a boxing gym where the trainers genuinely care about your progress and you can enjoy training in a comfortable, friendly environment, I can’t recommend this place enough. I’m so glad I found it!

reviews.name: Claire Levita
reviews.text:
I have trained 3 times with Rungjaras Muaythai, twice with Kru Mate and once with Kru Bash. Both had different styles and helped me refine my basics and my technique. I was also able to spar for 30 minutes on my second time with Kru Mate, after asking him during the first session. Kru Bash gave me a lot of techniques to work on, defence and feints, which were exactly what I had been looking to train more.

I trained at the Decathlon training center which is open and very clean. Aon takes care of organizing the classes and is extremely kind and flexible. She also takes truly beautiful pictures and videos of the sessions.

I truly recommend these private classes, 800BHT well spent!

reviews.name: debbie dong
reviews.text: The coach is fantastic! Taking the class with my friend was such a fun experience. I totally fell in love with Muay Thai after this trial lesson. The photos and videos we took turned out amazing. I was completely worn out after one session, and I’d highly recommend it to everyone!

reviews.name: Thozi Sejanamane
reviews.text:
I trained with Kru Bash for a couple of months, and I can confidently say it was one of the best decisions I made in Thailand. He has decades of experience and really knows how to tailor training to the individual. As a beginner, I appreciated how well he adjusted to my learning pace—pushing me when necessary but always keeping a strong focus on technique. Even when I started sparring after a month or two, he remained a stickler for proper form, which I really respected.

What sets this experience apart is that training isn’t in a traditional hardcore gym but at Decathlon, which means the space is modern, well-maintained, and has all the amenities you could need. That being said, it’s not the cheapest option out there, but for private training with someone of his skill level, I think it’s absolutely worth it. Plus, his assistant often captures high-quality photos and videos of your training at no extra cost—a really nice touch.

Bash is also extremely welcoming and friendly, making it easy to feel comfortable right away. He speaks English well enough for clear instruction and even went out of his way to take me to watch my first live Muay Thai fight and help me pick out the right gear. That level of care and hospitality really stood out.

A typical class includes a great balance of drills, pad work, bag work, and sparring when you’re ready. Whether you’re looking to get serious about Muay Thai or just improve your skills while in Thailand, I highly recommend training with him. I’ll definitely be back!

1000% recommendation for muaythai.

The gym is well equipped and also has a sauna and a cold bath. I like that during crossfit classes, each member has their own designated spot.

If I am ever back in Chiang Mai, I will definitely visit CrossFit Chiang Mai again.

reviews.name: Lewis McDonald
reviews.text:
Coaching our Burgener Strength course at CFCNX was a real highlight. The energy from the environment & coaching team was so good. The welcome from the community was immediate, and the whole facility is kept in top condition with equipment that’s clearly maintained with care. Communication from the head coach was top throughout, and you can tell the owners are invested in growing their team and raising the standard of coaching.

If you’re after a gym that takes training seriously, you’ve found it. Anyone local should get down here and see for themselves.

reviews.name: William Henke
reviews.text: CFCNX was a fantastic place to run our Burgener Strength weightlifting course. What stood out first was how clean and well-organized everything is, right down to how well they look after their equipment (very high end kit). The members were warm and welcoming, the coaching team was genuinely engaged the whole way through, and the owner made communication effortless before and during the course. It’s obvious the he pours into their coaches and care about delivering real quality. Train here once and you’ll feel it. This is where I’d train if I lived here.

reviews.name: 乐乐
reviews.text:
The training space is open and comfortable, with gym equipment neatly organized. However, from a course content perspective, there are quite a few points to critique for a class priced at 500 THB.

First, there is a distinct lack of interaction. I believe the true purpose of a group class isn't just a bunch of people working out together in the same room, but rather the coach using interactive element and friendly competition to boost everyone's energy and performance. This session felt like everyone was just mechanically doing their own thing. If that's the case, why take a group class instead of training solo?

Second, all three classes this afternoon were taught back-to-back by the exact same coach. It goes without saying—how can you possibly guarantee course quality under such schedule intensity?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re pleased to hear you enjoyed the training space and found the equipment well organised.

We’re sorry the class itself wasn’t quite the experience you were looking for. At CFCNX, the style and focus of our group classes varies depending on the programming that day. Some sessions naturally create more opportunities for teamwork, interaction and friendly competition, while others focus more on individual pacing, movement quality, scaling and getting a solid workout in.

We understand that people come to group training for different reasons. Some enjoy the competitive side, while others are simply looking to improve their fitness, train alongside others and have the guidance of a coach. This is why the experience and coaching focus won’t necessarily look the same from one class to the next.

We’d also like to clarify the point around coaching schedules. Our coaches teach a maximum of three consecutive sessions, and we specifically cap their schedules at this number to ensure they can bring the appropriate energy, attention and coaching to every class.

We do, however, take feedback around member engagement seriously and will review your comments with our coaching team. We appreciate you sharing your experience.

reviews.name: Pauline Joy
reviews.text:
CFCNX is a great gym overall - clean, well-equipped, and consistently motivating. The coaches are friendly, the workouts are well-structured, and the sauna + ice bath add real value to the experience. The environment feels positive and the facilities themselves are excellent.

The main reason I’m giving 4 stars is because of the booking system and class availability, especially for the HYROX-style sessions. From my own experience, the classes fill up quickly, and the way the current system handles waitlists can make it challenging to secure a confirmed spot.

Here are the issues I’ve personally run into:
• Booking opens a week in advance, but joining a waitlist immediately deducts a punch pass, even though you don’t actually have a guaranteed class.
• Because the system shows your pass as “used,” you’re blocked from reserving newly available classes when spots open up - even if there’s space.
• Those openings refill quickly, so you can end up stuck on several waitlists without being able to book an actual confirmed class.
• HYROX is only offered once each morning, and since morning sessions fill the fastest, availability becomes even more limited.

Recommendation

I’ve come across booking systems elsewhere that handle this more effectively, and a similar approach could really improve the experience. For example:
• Joining a waitlist does not deduct a punch pass right away
• A pass is only deducted once you’re officially moved into the class
• And you’re given a short acceptance window to confirm the spot

This avoids penalizing members for planning ahead and prevents missed opportunities when new class openings appear.

CFCNX has a great foundation, and with adjustments to the booking flow and class scheduling, it could easily be a 5-star gym. I highly recommend it overall - the facilities and environment are excellent, and with a few user-experience improvements, it would be exceptional.

reviews.name: Jakub Krejci
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, CrossFit Chiang Mai (CFCNX) is the best CrossFit gym in the area. The gym is spacious, comfortably accommodating both class attendees and open gym visitors. Following the PRVN programming, the coaches at CFCNX always take the time to demonstrate movements properly, prioritizing safety and injury prevention—something that sets them apart from other CrossFit gyms in Chiang Mai, where poor lifting standards can often lead to injury.

In addition to excellent coaching, CFCNX offers great amenities including showers, a functional outdoor area, a sauna, an ice bath, free drinking water, and an on-site coffee shop.

What further sets CFCNX apart is their commitment to constantly improving. Unlike other gyms that remove equipment or cut down open gym hours, CFCNX consistently enhances its facilities, making long-term memberships a valuable investment as the gym continues to improve.

reviews.name: Phadet Asai
reviews.text: Old Crossfit box that requires a major makeover. Coaches are not friendly to newbies and they don't really care to teach people who are new to Crossfit. Not so friendly community to visitors. Sad I didn't have a good experience on my visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Phadet,

We’re sorry to hear that you did not have a good experience. According to our records, you visited Arena once approximately nine months ago through ClassPass and joined a HYROX class, rather than a CrossFit class. As this review was posted only recently, we would like to provide some context for anyone reading it.

For one-time CrossFit visits through ClassPass or a drop-in, we require at least one month of previous CrossFit experience. If you asked about joining a CrossFit class, our team may have asked about your experience for this reason. This policy is not intended to make beginners feel unwelcome—quite the opposite. We care deeply about the beginner experience, safety, and ensuring that every person in a group class receives proper coaching and equal attention.

Those who want to join our community without previous CrossFit experience are warmly welcomed through our complete beginner onboarding program. This prepares them safely and confidently before they enter regular group classes.

Arena is celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. We are well known for the cleanliness of our training floors and the good condition of our equipment, which is also reflected throughout many of our Google reviews. However, we never believe that what we have is “good enough,” so we are currently undergoing a major renovation and expansion, with construction scheduled to finish soon.

We have expanded Arena by an additional 250 sqm, creating a dedicated HYROX training zone with new equipment arriving soon. Our lobby and front desk have already been renovated with considerably more space, while work on the new training zone and our larger shower and changing facilities is still in progress.

Since your only visit was nine months ago and you have not yet seen the new Arena, we warmly invite you to visit us again toward the end of September, once the construction is complete. We would be happy to welcome you back and show you how much the space has changed.
Best,
Team Arena

I signed up yesterday, and I am impressed so far.

I came in to have a look last week, and June showed me around. He was quite thorough, and made it easy for me to make my decision.

When I came in to sign up 2 days later, I was assisted by the lovely staff immediately. Gokce came over personally and introduced herself and her adorable golden retriever Rocky.

Last night, I did a session. A heavy squat session followed by a bit of an AMRAP. Paan(pronounced Baan) is a fantastic coach and got me settled in well.

Today, I joined in again and practised some clean and jerks, followed by a bit of an EMOM at the end. June demonstrated an extraordinarily high level of technical skill and a close eye to detail as he walked through and coached those who needed it.

The community is very warm and inviting, and everyone is wonderful and quite helpful.

I highly recommend giving this gym a look if you are in the area.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Damien,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for the kind words about the venue — we really appreciate it.

At the moment, our HYROX classes are part of an 8-week race preparation cycle, where we follow a structured training program leading up to the race. Because of this, each session focuses on different elements of HYROX performance (strength stations, engine work, technique, pacing, etc.). While running is included on most days, it isn’t necessarily programmed every single session, depending on the focus of that day.

We also appreciate your note regarding the instructions. Clear coaching and guidance are very important to us, and we’ll continue working with our team to ensure cues and explanations are as clear as possible during class.

Thanks again for visiting and for your feedback — we hope to see you back at Arena soon. 💪

reviews.name: Ira Balan
reviews.text:
This is a nice place, but in the end, I had a disappointing experience. I chose the oil massage, as I always do, because it’s usually strong enough for me, while my partner chose the traditional Thai massage. When the massage started, I immediately felt something was off: the touch wasn’t pleasant, it felt unfocused, repetitive, and extremely light. I asked three times for stronger pressure, disturbing my partner’s peace on the bed next to me, but almost nothing changed. In the end, I asked to switch to a therapist who specializes in stronger massage.

I noticed that my partner’s therapist switched to me, and mine switched to him. From the very first touch it was obvious that she knew what she was doing, and it felt so good that I could barely hold back from sighing with relief. Still, some time had already been lost in the beginning — but fine, I was more or less satisfied, and we paid and left.

However, later it turned out that my partner was upset, because at some point his massage became barely noticeable. He didn’t even realize that the therapists had switched, and his politeness kept him from saying anything. But as a result, we ended up having a conflict, since the switch happened because of me. It made me sad to see him in such a mood.

I’m giving three stars only because the second therapist was excellent and a true professional. But in the future, I don’t recommend making such switches, because a huge percentage of people won’t say if something feels wrong — they just stay quiet not to offend the therapist. For me, this is a problem of communication. But at the end of the day, what really matters is the state you leave in after the massage, and ours was spoiled, despite the fact that I personally did receive a good massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So sorry to hear about your experience that was not up to your expectations. I can’t explain how this has happened to you, and we are so grateful that you have taken the time to share this with us. If you ever have the chance to visit with us again, please ask our manager to put you with our best therapist, as we would like to see you again and have a chance to make good on our offering with you. Again, we are deeply sorry for not meeting your expectations.

title: Muay Thai Fever - Muay Thai Training Chiang Mai
ownerDescription:
Train Muay Thai in Chiang Mai's best training gym! Located just 10 minutes from the city center it's easy to get your training in. Our coaches have a rich history spanning 35 years, we bring real Muay Thai to Chiang Mai!

Our Muay Thai gym is clean, fully equipped, and welcomes both locals and visitors. We can assist with training visas and programs, making it easier for you to immerse yourself in authentic Muay Thai training. Members also gain access to Muay Thai Fever online resources for extra support.

Train with some of the greatest legends of the sport, who bring unmatched expertise to help fighters of all levels.

Ready to step into the ring? Experience the best of Muay Thai at our gym in Chiang Mai and start your journey today!

The atmosphere at the gym is full of positive energy, and it’s clear that everyone here is passionate about Muay Thai and helping people improve, no matter their level.

Due to a medical emergency with my partner, I had to postpone my training, but I’ll be back as soon as I can. This place really leaves a lasting impression.

If you’re thinking about training in Chiang Mai, this is the place.

I cannot recommend Muay Thai Fever highly enough.

From my very first enquiry, the communication was excellent. Every question I had was answered promptly and professionally, and the team made the entire process straightforward.

I enrolled in their Muay Thai programme as part of my Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) application. They provided all of the required documentation quickly, accurately and exactly as requested by the Thai Embassy. The documents were prepared to a very high standard, which gave me confidence throughout the application process.

Whenever I needed assistance or clarification, the team responded quickly and were always friendly, helpful and patient. Their knowledge of the DTV process was invaluable, and thanks to their support my visa application was approved successfully.

If you're looking for a professional Muay Thai school that genuinely cares about its students and provides outstanding customer service, I would highly recommend Muay Thai Fever. I'm looking forward to starting my training in Chiang Mai.

Thank you to Walailuck and the entire team for your excellent service.

Training with legends like Boonlai Sor Thanikul, one of the Golden Era GOAT candidates, is an amazing experience.

reviews.name: Lukas Bulla
reviews.text:
I have successfully applied for a DTV with a 12-month Muay Thai course here. The process was smooth. I asked a couple of questions beforehand for clarification, booked the course, and received the necessary documents for the application. Communication was friendly and fast (a few hours max).

The application at the embassy in Ho Chi Minh (Vietnam) took about 14 days. Processing time is 5 working days but they requested more documents after the initial application which seems to be pretty common there. Just inform yourself properly and prepare your documents in advance.

Entering Thailand in Bangkok was pretty smooth, too. Just show the officer your passport, printed visa, and arrival card. Keep all other documents from your application offline on your phone, just in case.

Looking forward to train next month!

reviews.name: Anson Wee
reviews.text: Honestly, the best massage my Mrs and I have had in Bangkok. Our massage therapists Napatrapee and Mayuree are so skilled and professional. I think there were 6 different kind of baths, including a cold one. There is a also a steam and sauna room. After our massage, we were treated to a very nice mango sticky rice with hot tea. Although this is a higher end spa, it is definitely worth it. We will be planning future visits here again.

reviews.name: totoro int.d
reviews.text: It was an exciting experience with excellent service. The atmosphere was incredibly relaxing, making it feel like a true getaway. You can enjoy the onsen facilities all day without any time limit, and you’re free to choose any massage package you prefer. Personally, I really loved their oil massage.🤩🤩🤩🤩

reviews.name: Henrik
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to this spa. The interior looks nice, and it’s located on the 9th floor. It’s important to book an appointment in advance.

Like many spas nowadays, they tend to assign male therapists by default when you are a men, as they often reserve female therapists for female guests who would not accept a male therapist. So if you are male and prefer a female therapist, make sure to clearly state this when booking.

My male therapist, however, was excellent. He has worked there for 9 years and clearly knows how to deliver a strong, firm massage — which is actually quite rare to find.

The waiting area in the morning was very clean and well maintained, but it felt a bit soulless, almost like sitting in a mid-range airport business lounge. It lacks a bit of personal character.

I had a 90-minute foot, shoulder, and back massage. The chairs were comfortable, and the back massage was done in a special massage chair, which worked well. The price was 1100 THB.

Overall, it’s a good and clean place with skilled staff, but it could use a bit more atmosphere and personality.

reviews.name: Victor
reviews.text: I most enjoyed the onsen experience. I think the tubs, dry/steam sauna, and the hot/cold rooms were super relaxing and definitely top notch in the world for quality. The massage however is a mixed bag. I enjoyed the pre/post massage experience where you can choose your preferred scrub/oil from the platter and the mango sticky rice afterwards was a great treat. The massage itself is kind of middling in my opinion. Therapist just seemed inexperienced? Wasn't up to the world class massage quality I've had. It wasn't terrible but it just wasn't amazing.

My therapist ( Phanom ) was exceptionally skilled and experienced, applying the perfect amount of pressure and focusing on areas that needed the most attention. The treatment was both relaxing and rejuvenating, leaving me feeling completely refreshed.
I truly appreciated the excellent service and attention to detail throughout my visit. I highly recommend this branch to anyone looking for a high-quality spa and onsen experience in Bangkok. I will definitely be returning!

reviews.text: If you're looking for a great spa experience in Thailand, this well-known chain has several branches to choose from. reviews.name: Joey B
reviews.text: What a great day of relaxation. I went at 11:00 a.m. on a weekday and there may have been, at most five of us.  Perfect.  It's tastefully decorated, it's bigger than their other branch that I've been to, the design and decor is so calming and relaxing. The pools are beautiful and everything is very clean. Samuel, one of the staff is very friendly, helpful and happy and speaks great English. He and another colleague keep the floors dry and the space neat and orderly all the time.   I had the ramen for lunch and the pork was so juicy tender and delicious, The stuff at the front of the house and all the staff all the way through the whole process was amazing... All of their products smell amazing as well.    All of the signage is in English and Japanese so the only thing I have for comment is that they should have the signs and instructions and etiquette in Thai as well.   Today everyone that was there were Thai and a lot of them didn't know certain etiquette rules which were not written in Thai.  When I explained it in Thai, they were pleased to know. Ie about not putting the towel in the water or rinsing yourself off before getting in the pools after being in the sweaty steam or suana.. They said that they didn't understand because they couldn't read the English or Japanese and good to know...  Other than that small suggestion which is not a big deal It was a great day, all 5 hours.

reviews.name: WanderWithWit
reviews.text:
We’ve always enjoyed our experiences at Let’s Relax Spa, so we were excited to try their newest branch at Grande Centre Point Lumpini, which opened in April 2025.

This location is spacious and beautifully designed, offering a peaceful escape from the bustle of Bangkok. One of the highlights is the Japanese-style Onsen, complete with pools to soak and unwind — a great way to soothe sore muscles after a long day of walking.

We opted for a two-hour Thai massage, expecting the same high standards we’ve experienced before. Unfortunately, this time, the experience fell short. The new masseurs lacked the skill and precision we’ve come to associate with Let’s Relax, and we ended up feeling more discomfort than relief.

Another downside was the poor water pressure and weak water supply in all the shower areas. It made rinsing off after the Onsen feel inconvenient and underwhelming — not what you’d expect from a spa of this standard.

It’s still a lovely setting to relax in, but we hope both the staff training and facility maintenance improve to meet the quality we’ve known and loved at other Let’s Relax locations.

We chose this location as it is the newest location for Makkha. They requested advance payment upon booking so we did. Unfortunately I mixed up the booking time and they rescheduled the booking.

Upon arrival they greeted and offered us welcome drink. The massage place is clean, bright and elegant.

There are a number of single note massage oil to choose from. I asked for medium to firm pressure and they delivered. However the massage was provided with up and down strokes and they did not help much to remove the knots in my muscles. I did not feel too much relief after. This is the 3rd massage place the last few days and this is the least favourite massage place out of the three.

Thank you very much for sharing your experience with us and for your kind compliments regarding our atmosphere, cleanliness, and welcoming service.

We truly regret to hear that the massage style did not fully meet your expectations. We understand that massage preferences can vary from person to person, and your feedback is very valuable to us.

We will continue reminding our therapists to pay close attention to each guest’s muscle tension and comfort level in order to provide the most relaxing experience possible.

Thank you once again for visiting us, and we sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Warm regards,
Makkha Health & Spa
