reviews.name: A C
reviews.text:
Having been a loyal customer who frequently visited the original Asoke branch, I am deeply disappointed by how far the standards have fallen. What used to be a reliable, must-visit spot on every trip to Bangkok has turned into an extremely frustrating experience.
* Hostile Service & Inaccessible Entrance: We arrived 25 minutes early at their new branch, which features a cramped lobby and requires climbing a long flight of stairs. We waited by the elevator, but it never arrived. A male staff member came out and aggressively rushed us to take the stairs instead, making us assume the lift was out of order. Once we finally struggled up the long staircase, we discovered the elevator was working perfectly—the staff member was simply using it for himself.
* Disrespectful Front Desk Staff: The main area upstairs was completely empty, yet the front desk staff were blatantly impolite. One staff member gave me a condescending look, whispered and gossiped with colleagues right in front of us, and kept glancing over. The overall atmosphere was incredibly unwelcoming, and the masseuses present lacked even a basic smile.
* Chaotic Logistics in the Rain: We requested to move to another location to escape the toxic atmosphere. After unnecessary drama and miscommunication, we were walked to a different branch in the rain. Upon arrival, the front desk had no record or context of our booking, forcing us to wait another 25 minutes while they tried to figure out what was happening.
* Subpar Massage Quality: The two masseuses assigned to us lacked basic skill—far below the standard of an average street massage. We spent the entire two hours in discomfort, constantly having to ask them to adjust their pressure and technique. We chose not to complain during the session simply because they were at least polite compared to the hostesses at the first branch.
* Insulting "Apology" & Ignored Management Requests: Afterward, a staff member handed me a hand cream in an unpopular scent, claiming the manager sent it to apologize after hearing the story from the front desk. I am not the type of customer who can be bought off or pacified by unwanted freebies to make a problem go away. I didn't want a random gift; I wanted accountability and to speak directly with the manager so they could hear our side of the story. I agreed to wait, but after sitting there for 20 minutes, no manager ever showed up. I then asked for the manager’s email address, but after waiting again with zero response, we walked out. They had every chance to make things right and completely blew it.
Rapid over-expansion—now running three branches near Asoke station—has clearly led them to hire inexperienced staff just to fill spots, completely destroying their quality control and customer service.
We have blacklisted this business and warned all our friends who visit Thailand to avoid it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear A C,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. 
We are truly sorry to hear about your experience and understand your disappointment.

Our admin team has attempted to contact you to better understand what happened. We would be grateful if you could contact us at makkhaspa@gmail.com so we can personally look into your concerns and address them appropriately.

We sincerely appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to make things right.

Best regards,
Makkha Health & Spa

reviews.name: Sunny K
reviews.text:
We made a reservation the day before and visited the massage shop as scheduled.
Because they said they were short on massage therapists, two of us were able to receive massages, and the remaining one was asked to wait a little longer.
Shortly after, two more customers came in.
Despite being told that two of us could start right away, we ended up waiting for quite a long time. Eventually, a reception staff member from the counter — not a massage therapist — came and began the massage.
The two customers who arrived after us were assigned professional massage therapists, while we, who had made a reservation in advance and waited for a long time, were attended by someone who had been working at the front desk all day and had not been giving massages.
Although she said she was also able to perform massages, she kept glancing at the therapist next to her and imitated her movements a beat behind.
There is no way for us to confirm whether she was a certified massage therapist, but is it normal for someone who has been working at the reception desk all day and appears to be copying another therapist’s techniques to provide a massage?
If there were not enough massage therapists available, they should not have accepted our reservation. I do not understand why they would waste the time and energy of tourists in this way.

For these reasons, I would not recommend visiting a massage shop that operates without a proper system and disregards customers who made reservations in advance. Customers’ time should be respected, and appointments should be honored in a fair and organized manner.

Plus

Even though we made a reservation in advance, they assigned a reception staff member — not a professional massage therapist — to treat a child, resulting in an unprofessional and unethical experience.
Please provide proof of the reception staff member’s massage therapist license and clarify how many hours per day they actually perform massage services.
There is no one in the world who wants to receive a massage from an unqualified person who does not regularly provide professional massage services each day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
We will take immediate steps to improve and correct the mistakes that occurred.

Our staff may not have communicated clearly enough, and we truly regret any misunderstanding this may have caused. We will address this issue and work on improving our communication moving forward.

We sincerely appreciate your feedback and will take all suggestions into consideration to ensure better service in the future.

reviews.text:
I went to several massage salons these almost 2 months in Thailand. This one is top level. Stylishly decorated and warmly welcomed, it made me feel relaxed from the start. But what matters most is the actual massage of course. I had ordered 1 hour Thai massage and 2 hour hot oil massage. The masseuse had a good firm touch, without being hard. She focused on some zones that needed some extra attention, but never overdid it in terms of pressing and stretching my muscles. Exploring the limits, but not over it.
The hot oil massage continued with a similar firm, yet soft touch. Also she operated with delicateness on certain spots f.i. on my calves, which worked remarkably well.  I did remark afterwards that I had expected the oil to be a bit warmer.
Because I have some facial discomfort, she also paid attention to face, jaws and neck.
Afterwards I could shower in a clean bathroom to rinse off the oil.
Definitely one of the best massages I've had out of over a dozen this past month and a half.

I had an absolutely amazing experience at Essento Massage in Phuket. From the moment I arrived, I was warmly welcomed into a calm and beautifully designed salon that immediately put me at ease.

The masseuse was highly skilled, using excellent techniques and ensuring throughout the session that everything was to my liking. Her attention to detail and professionalism made this one of the best massages I’ve ever had. I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. Highly recommend Essento Massage for anyone visiting Phuket!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you!

reviews.name: Denis Belol
reviews.text: Excellent massage! A huge thank you to master AnAn for her professionalism and golden hands. She is very attentive and tactful, found the right approach, and helped me relieve the tension. After the session, I feel absolutely wonderful—light and relaxed. I will definitely come back! I highly recommend her.

reviews.name: Vveronika V
reviews.text: Massage here is 10/10, staff super nice, very cozy atmosfere the place is clean and gives very authentic vibes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing Essento Spa. We are thrilled to hear that you had an amazing experience with us.
It is our goal to provide the best relaxation and service to every guest, and knowing we hit the mark for you truly makes our day. We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating session very soon!

Best regards,

reviews.name: PrinCeS BunNy
reviews.text: Let yourself relax with an organic spa massage, and you’ll find yourself falling in love with the experience. It’s so good, you’ll want to come back again. If you’re looking for a place for an aromatherapy massage, this is a must-try!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Ricardo Salvador
reviews.text: Just fantastic. Been in Phuket for 10 days and having massages everyday. This place is by far the best and cheaper than the very high end Spas we went to. Make reservations if you can to make sure they can attend to you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are happy to hear that you have a good experience in our spa service. Thank you so much for a wonderful comment.

reviews.name: shaima Salim
reviews.text: This was the best massage I ever had in my life. After massage in that Spa, believe me No other place will convince you. Very very professional staff. She knew the right spots and treated them very well.. RECOMMEND
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting us! we hope you had a great time and refreshed. See you again soon

title: Aromdii Cookery School
subTitle: Aromdii Cooking School
ownerDescription: Learn how to cook Thai food with Thai family! Very welcome vegan or vegetarian as well. Offering you a small class cooking in the private house and open air kitchen.
address: 6/2 ถ.ศรีปิงเมือง ซ.1 ก Chang Khlan Sub-district, เมือง Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
street: 6/2 ถ.ศรีปิงเมือง ซ.1 ก
plusCode: QXFJ+2J Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Carolyn Nguyen
reviews.text: This was truly my favorite excursion I did in Thailand! Chef Aek was a wonderful teacher. He gave our group of 9 multiple options for our four coarse dinner class, and then he taught us all at the same time but it was clear and concise and we all were able to follow along really easily. The food was incredible! Chef Aek is truly a great teacher. The location was very convenient for us in chiang mai, and Aek also provided pick up and drop off in a van that fit our group. Chef Aek took us to the market and showed us the ingredient to buy. He taught us a lot about Thai food and culture. He was also so kind and easy going even when some of us needed a lot of help and would mess up here and there. The location is also very homey and made the experience so authentic and memorabe. The space is very clean and well kept, but has an authenticity to it that cannot be replicated anywhere else. I could not recommend enough! Truly one of my favorite experiences. Me and my friends cannot stop raving about it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Carolyn for your lovely review, nice photos and also thanks for spending your time cooking Thai food with us before you leave from Chiangmai 🙂 
Kob Kun Krab 🙏

reviews.name: Dahlia Abou El Hassan
reviews.text: We had a fantastic cooking class with Aek. We pre-selected what we would like to learn to cook in advance and made a 5 course meal.  You get to choose an appetizer, soup, stir-fry, curry, dessert. We started out at the market where we grabbed ingredients for our cooking class. It was a great class size of 8 people maximum. We then went to the cooking school where we prepared our dishes. Aek had great structure and took us through each step. It was a lot of food and so tasty. Highly recommend Aek’s cooking class when visiting Chiang Mai. He is very knowledgeable and funny as well. Khop Khun
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Dahlia and Meahage for spending your time cooking Thai food with us and special thanks for your lovely review too 🙂

reviews.name: Eloise Bray
reviews.text: Such a good cooking class for an amazing price! We went to a local market to shop for some ingredients first and then made 5 dishes over the course of around 3.5 hours. Everything could be made vegetarian or vegan easily and it was all so delicious!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Eloise for spending your time cooking Thai food with us and special thanks for your lovely review! Very nice to meet you 😊 
Nok and Aek

reviews.name: Léa Camilli
reviews.text:
I did the cooking class few days ago and I can only recommend it to everyone.
It's a family owned business and they speak a really good English.
I learned how to cook 5 meals that I choose over s list, we went to the market where I got explanations about the ingredients and I received the receipes after the class
Really a good experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Lea for lovely review and cooking Thai food with us in Chiangmai 😊🙏

reviews.name: Yusuf Ali Patel
reviews.text:
I’d highly recommend this, especially if you love Thai food and want to take some recipes home. The tour was brilliantly organised, from the hotel pick-up, to going to the market and then their home for the class.

You learn how to prepare all the ingredients from fresh and then cook at your own wok station. There is a lot of delicious food to cook so make sure you go on an empty stomach.

Given you get so much food and how well it’s organised and catered for, I think it’s a bargain at 800 baht per person. There were no issues at all with arranging alternatives for vegan and vegetarian diets.

Thanks to Aek and his wife for arranging this!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Yusuf and Sarah for spending time cooking food with us and for your lovely review too 🙂 
Lovely to meet you both and enjoy your holiday and enjoy cook Thai food at your home too!! 

Kob Kun Krab 🙏 
Nok and Aek

reviews.name: Nick Sutcliffe
reviews.text: This was really well done. I enjoyed the market tour where we bought all the ingredients, and then cooking was super fun! Whilst outdoors, the fans kept us cool, and the cooking instructor was very helpful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Nick ☺️ kob kun Krab 🙏

reviews.name: Sara W
reviews.text: Absolutely loved our time learning to cook authentic Thai food with Aek! We visited the market, learned about the foods you can find there, purchased everything needed for our class, and headed to the cooking school where we made 5 dishes and enjoyed them throughout the evening. Come hungry!! Aek does a wonderful job of sharing about his culture while teaching, even explaining the differences in tastes and traditions from where he grew up versus where his wife is from. Myself, my husband and two college kids all had a wonderful evening. Shortly after being dropped off at our hotel Aek sent us all of the recipes we’d made so we can go home and make them again. Thank you so much, this was a highlight of our time in Chiang Mai. If you’re looking to take a cooking class, book with Aromdii Cookery School!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kob Kun Krab Sara, Chris, Lily and Brady for cooking Thai food with us and thank you for your lovely review too 🙂🙏 happy new year 🎊🎊

reviews.name: Alma VH
reviews.text: This was truly an amazing experience. My wife and I enjoyed sourcing, preparing, cooking (and then eating!) all the delicious Thai food that we learnt. 10/10 will definitely return if we are ever in Chiang Mai again. Our host, Aek, was exceptional! He thought us, entertained us, and gave us a great memory to take home. Such a genuine nice man and highly entertaining. This was the highlight of our trip to Chiang Mai. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Kob Kun Krab Alma😊🙏 for your lovely review!

reviews.name: Roxana Montenegro
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience at Aromdii! Aek and his wife are fantastic hosts, and we learned a lot about Thai cuisine and food culture.

The dishes were delicious—some of the best we’ve had on our trip so far. We would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a smaller, more personalized cooking class experience in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Rox and G for spending your time cooking Thai food in Chiangmai 🙏 we had such a great time meeting you and welcome you and Cooking some Thai food together! Thank you for lovely review too 🙂 enjoy your holiday and your honeymoon 🤩🤩

reviews.name: Cesar Muller
reviews.text: Wow! I really loved our stay with Aek! I strongly recommend this to anybody who wants to try cooking Thai food and eating it! It was really fun and he is a great teacher, it suits everyone since you can change the spiciness and other stuff in your cooking. Aek is also super nice and I thank him for making our visit wonderful 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Cesar for spending your evening time cooking Thai food with us and special thanks for your lovely review 🙏🙂 well done and great job for trying all types of chilli chef 😀😀

reviews.name: Thea Bosco
reviews.text: When I say this was the best cooking class I’ve ever done that is an understatement! We made 5 dishes all from scratch with fresh ingredients from the market! What was amazing was everyone was making different dishes but it still ran so smoothly and the food was some of the best I’ve had so far here. I honestly can’t recommend this experience more!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Thea for spending your evening time cooking Thai food with us 🙏🙂 very nice to meet you both 😊

reviews.name: SK
reviews.text: Very lovely experience! We were taken to the market where they source all the ingredients and then made five dishes each and ate along the way, taking around 3-4 hours. Aek and Nok were very kind people and explained everything really well. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for spending your morning time cooking Thai food with us! Thank you for your review too😊🙏🙏

reviews.name: Christopher Hannah
reviews.text:
Amazing class. There is a huge selection of great food to cook and the staff are great to work with, friendly and funny. They do a great job instructing but letting you do everything while making sure the food comes out tasting good. They also take time to explain each ingredient and what it's purpose is so you actually learn to cook the food.

The trip to the market to pick up ingredients for the class which was really cool and the hotel pickup is super convenient.

10/10 great food and experience. I can't wait to try to recreate the recipes after returning home.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for lovely review ☺️☺️ lovely to meet you too!

reviews.name: Maisie Watson
reviews.text:
We go to cooking lessons in every country we visit and this was by far the best one. The teacher was so engaging and taught us so much about Thai cooking and culture, he was also really funny.

We got to make 5 entire dishes from scratch and cook them at the hob ourselves, it was genuinely incredible. The food we made was amazing and the best food we’ve had since being in Thailand.

The class sizes are really small compared to most so you get a real good value for money. We ended up taking food home because we made so much and had no space for it all!

Could not recommend this class enough
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Maisie for your lovely review and for cooking Thai food with us 🙏 kob kun Krab 🙏

reviews.name: Nikolaus Kantner
reviews.text: Thank you for this great experience! Nok & Aek run a small family style cooking school and the whole experience was fantastic! They are funny and tell so many details about thai cuisine! The price is phenomenal and I cannot believe thaz anyone can have a bad experience with them. They are wonderful, honest people full of love and respect! We had a great time! 10/10 recommend. My best experience in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Niko for your lovely review! We had great time meeting you and cooking Thai food with you ☺️

reviews.name: Millie Grace
reviews.text: Had the most amazing time here. One of the best cooking classes I’ve done, we got to go to the markets to get all of the ingredients, and we learnt so much about all of the ingredients as well as the way Thai people cook. The class itself was very engaging and we very hands on. I cannot recommend this class enough. Such a good price for what we got to learn and do!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Millie for spending your time cooking Thai food with us! Very nice to meet you and enjoy cooking Thai food at home! 

Kob Kun Krab 🙏

reviews.name: Jessica Dama

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Jessica for spending your time cooking Thai food with us and give us lovely review too 🙂🙏

reviews.name: Yannic Hönle
reviews.text: Learning to cook Thai dishes with Nok and Aek was an absolutely great experience. We had a ton of fun, from learning about the ingredients during the market tour, to the actual cooking and eating together. It's one of the top 3 experiences from our latest Thailand trip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Yannic for your lovely review and cooking Thai food with us 😊🙏

Nok and Aek

reviews.name: Laura Jane
reviews.text: Me and my partner were part of a group of seven. Aek was very friendly and picked us up and dropped us of from our hotel. As a vegetarian we were provided alternatives to swap out for certain ingredients that meat eaters were using so it felt very inclusive. We were shown how to cook 5 great dishes each! All tasted delicious and you will leave feeling full! Great host and great food, thank you! 🤩

reviews.name: Lucy Elizabeth
reviews.text: Lovely family-run cooking school. We had an amazing time learning about different ingredients at the market and making different dishes! The classes are small which is really nice. Would recommend to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Lucy and Josh for your lovely review and cooking Thai food with us 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Sarah Wilson
reviews.text: Will definitely be coming back. Super friendly and calm welcome, reception and outside area are just beautiful. Calm and peaceful vibes. Massage was best I have had in Phuket. I was lucky to be hear during a thunderstorm so saw all the tiny frogs gathered under the courtyard tree outside drinking my tea. Absolutely wonderful experience, my husband and I will both be back.

reviews.name: S
reviews.text:
The massage therapists were very kind, and the massage itself was really good. However, I was disappointed with the reception service. They pressure customers to leave a review and give 5 stars, which I didn’t feel was appropriate.

There was also a receptionist who had fillers and was on duty around 12:30 PM. Unfortunately, her attitude made me uncomfortable. She was very friendly, smiling and talking mainly with male customers, while her attitude toward female customers was completely different. I felt that she was looking down on women, and her behavior was noticeable and made the atmosphere uncomfortable.
❤️

reviews.name: Sara Provencher Labelle
reviews.text:
I’m a bit of a snob when it comes to a good massage, and So Sabai genuinely impressed me. 🤍

The atmosphere is calm, the therapists are attentive, and the massage itself was exactly what I needed. You can tell they really care about the experience.

Such a lovely little find. I’ll definitely be back! Highly recommend if you’re looking for a massage that feels thoughtful and unhurried.

reviews.name: Munira Mahmud
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place. I’ve been coming here 3 times now with husband. The first massage I got was feet, head neck and shoulder. I went to sleep. Another day, i tried Thai massage which was very thorough and helped with tightness from exercise. The place has a very nice boho ambiance which is just my thing.

reviews.name: Savannah Neville
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience at So Sabai today! I booked in for the 3 hour so calm package and it did not disappoint! The perfect way to get ready for a long flight home.

The team were amazing at helping me pick out suitable treatments for my slight sunburn and the spa itself is absolutely gorgeous, I could spend all day here!

Highly recommend a visit here!! 🤍

reviews.name: Syeda Nawal
reviews.text: We were probably the last customers of the day, but the staff, masseurs, were so wonderful in behaviour as well as skills! I fell asleep twice while getting the aromatic massage. Their prices are quite decent but facilities are very modern and clean. Loved it!

reviews.name: Viktoriya Ershova
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here! 2 hours aromatherapy oils massage to relax after long flight. The masseuse was so strong and yet gentle. I really enjoyed my experience and would love to come back at least once before I leave. Beautiful setting of the place to relax after the massage. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Nadya M
reviews.text: It was a very good massage! The place so cozy and comfortable, I felt myself so calm. And of course we will come back!! 🙏🏻❤️

reviews.name: Diana Zagirova
reviews.text: I had an incredible Thai massage here! The atmosphere is beautifully modern, clean, and calming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I also loved the complimentary drinks. Overall, a fantastic, relaxing experience from start to finish. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Ilič
reviews.text:
Very nice location with a silent and pleasant backyard for meditation after massage.

Very experienced stuff/master with individual approach and focus on You.

We had 3 massage sessions with 3 day intervals (2 persons) and after each You wanted to come back again!

Highly Recommended !

reviews.name: Ramy Carter
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere, wonderful massage, and a wonderful experience. The price is well worth it and the staff is very friendly. I cannot express how happy I am with this experience and I highly recommend you visit. Whether you’re on holiday or you are a local, this is the number 1 massage spot in Phuket.

reviews.name: Mae Fadaak
reviews.text: Relaxing, Clean, friendly & simply wonderful! The 3 of us came 2 days in a row, it was well worth it. Good price for your health & mental well being! Top Spa treatment! Highly recommend ♥️

reviews.name: Miriam Dabrowa
reviews.text: Lovely atmosphere and great service. We took a 120 minute set with onsen and massage, and it was absolutely lovely. The staff is attentive and very friendly. Also very responsive and accommodating. We highly recommend it for truly relaxing atmosphere!

reviews.name: May Mars
reviews.text: The place is very clean and massages are very good. Nice and calm aesthetic 🤍🤎🌿 Staff are friendly. Khun Karn did a very relaxing foot massage .

reviews.name: Isadora Dantas
reviews.text: Personally, one of the best massages I’ve ever had in Phuket. Everything comfy and clean. The massagiat very professonal. I would get back for sure. 10/10

reviews.name: Vika Boyko
reviews.text: It was an incredible experience. We had an amazing massage — very relaxing and professional. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: G
reviews.text:
Beautiful spa ! Warm welcoming when you walk in the place. Very clean and professional I had 1h foot massage by Oh.
Will come back for a full body massage
Definitely recommend this place

reviews.name: Taninnat Rashainbunyawat
reviews.text: If you are in Rawai, need to try this store. I had full body scrub. The material and service is equal to the high standard shop i had in Bangkok with cheaper price.

reviews.name: Ana Paula Carneiro
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this spa. The team was extremely attentive and caring, especially considering that I am pregnant. From the very beginning, everything was thoughtfully planned — the massage, the pressure, and each detail was carefully adapted to make sure I felt safe, comfortable, and well taken care of throughout the entire experience.

I also had a facial hydration massage, which I absolutely loved. It was very relaxing and left my skin feeling wonderful.

The girls on the team have such beautiful, positive energy, and you can truly feel the care and dedication they put into their work. It was a lovely experience, and I would definitely recommend this spa to anyone looking for high-quality, mindful care.

reviews.name: Olfa Kbaier
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
My visit to So Abai Spa in Rawai was absolutely wonderful. From the moment I arrived, I felt calm and welcomed. The staff are warm, professional, and truly skilled. The massage was one of the best I’ve ever had deeply relaxing and rejuvenating. The spa itself is clean, beautifully decorated, and has such a soothing atmosphere. I left feeling refreshed, light, and very happy. Definitely a must visit spa in Phuket!

Wonderful experience for both my wife and me.

My wife had two medical massages on separate days, and she feels so much better afterward. I had a Thai massage, and the experience was excellent — I genuinely felt like a brand new person.

If you’re in Phuket and looking for a proper massage that is both cost-effective and top class, I highly recommend Art Massage.

reviews.name: Spell Singer
reviews.text: I have been visiting this salon for the third year now, each time I return only here, in other salons they often do not do as well as here, moreover, at an affordable price. I tried almost all types of massage, a very cool new bamboo massage, classic Thai, stone massage for relaxation. Last year, my leg hurt, I had a medical massage, the pain went away, my back also hurt chronically, I was advised a course of massages, after which nothing else hurt. The most wonderful and courteous staff, you always come where you are welcome, like at home, this massage parlor and its wonderful massage therapists are always in my heart and memory, I advise everyone to come here if you have chronic pain, especially here and tell the staff about it. Thank you for the wonderful moments of relaxation and for the health that I am taking with me to Russia.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank a lot missing you / Art

reviews.name: Business Advisor
reviews.text:
⚠️ Very Bad Experience at ART MASSAGE PHUKET ⚠️

I DO NOT recommend this place for facial treatments. This was one of the worst beauty experiences I have ever had in Phuket.

The staff had very bad customer service, aggressive behavior, and absolutely no respect for customers. They acted unprofessional from the beginning and made me feel very uncomfortable during the treatment.

The products they used on my face were clearly very cheap quality. The serum smelled strange and felt irritating immediately. After the facial, my skin became extremely red, painful, and looked burned. I was seriously worried because the machine they used did not look clean or hygienic at all.

A professional facial should leave your skin healthy and fresh — not damaged and infected. This place seems to care more about money than customer safety.

My advice: DO NOT let unqualified people touch your face. Please choose real professionals with proper hygiene standards and high-quality skincare products.

Very disappointing and dangerous experience. Avoid this place if you care about your skin
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I don't know your motive for writing this review, but what you are doing is pure slander, as you have never even used our services. I will not apologize, and I will let my customers decide for themselves , you just take photo front of us shop then say not good / Art

Reviews consistently praise the cleanliness, relaxing ambiance, and excellent customer service.

The massage itself is relaxing yet effective, leaving you feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. Small touches such as a welcome drink, aromatic oil selection, and post-treatment refreshments add to the premium experience without feeling overly expensive.

Highlights:

* Exceptionally clean and relaxing environment.
* Friendly, skilled, and certified therapists.
* Wide range of treatments including Thai, oil, foot, neck & shoulder, and aroma massages.
* Excellent value for the quality of service.
* Popular with visitors, so advance booking is recommended.

Overall, Bloom Beauty & Massage is an excellent choice if you’re seeking a genuine, professional spa experience in Phuket. It’s the kind of place where you’ll likely leave feeling relaxed and already planning your next visit.

I had a wonderful experience at Bloom Beauty & Massage in Phuket. The spa is very clean, beautifully decorated, and has a calm and relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The therapists were professional, friendly, and made sure the massage pressure was comfortable throughout the session. What made the visit even better was their special summer promotion — you can choose any 2 types of massages for only 850 Baht, which is excellent value for money.

The combination of treatments was relaxing and refreshing, and I left feeling completely rejuvenated. The staff were attentive and the overall service felt much more premium than the price suggests.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Phuket and looking for a relaxing massage with great service and an amazing summer offer. I will definitely come back again!

Kim’s Massage & Spa Patong Beach: Simply the Best Massage in Phuket!
Kim’s Massage & Spa Patong Beach clearly stands out as a top-tier wellness destination, earning rave reviews not just for its service, but for the skill of its therapists. Your experience confirms the consensus: I would rank this as the best massage I've had in Thailand so far.
This level of praise highlights why Kim's is so popular with returning tourists and locals alike. They focus on delivering an ultimate authentic Thai spa experience, going beyond a quick treatment to offer true professional therapy.
What Makes Kim's Excellent:
* Exceptional Skill: Therapists are often praised for their professionalism and ability to deliver strong, relaxing, and incredibly refreshing massages, focusing on problem areas.
* Atmosphere: The spa offers a peaceful sanctuary away from the bustling streets of Patong, providing a clean, quiet, and well-maintained venue with soothing ambiance.
* Value: Guests often mention the reasonable prices for the quality of service provided, making it excellent value for money.
* Thoughtful Touches: Complimentary tea before and after treatments, and the availability of shower facilities (a huge bonus after a day at the beach!), add to the relaxing and convenient experience.
For anyone seeking deep muscle relaxation or relief from travel fatigue, Kim’s Massage & Spa delivers a truly memorable and highly recommended therapeutic session.

reviews.name: Grace Yang
reviews.text:
This was the first time I’ve ever had to walk out of a massage, less than ten minutes in, because the experience was simply terrible.

To start, the setup itself was deeply uncomfortable. The massage is performed on a mat on the floor with no proper face cradle. Instead, you’re given a very thick, high-loft pillow, which forces your neck into an awkward angle while lying on your stomach. In order to breathe, you have to turn your head to the side, making it difficult to relax from the outset.

Unfortunately, things quickly escalated beyond discomfort. During the massage, my therapist inadvertently applied what felt like her full body weight onto my upper spine near my neck. It was sharply painful to the point that both of us reacted immediately. While I was relieved that I wasn’t seriously injured, the incident caused significant pain and, understandably, an immediate loss of confidence in the therapist’s technique.

It’s also worth noting that the therapist appeared to have limited mobility and was a very heavy set person, at least 80 lbs heavier than me. In a traditional Thai massage, where practitioners often use their own body weight and leverage as part of the technique, this becomes an important safety consideration. In this case, it contributed to the sense that the pressure was not being applied in a controlled or well-supported way, which ultimately made the experience feel unsafe.

After that moment where the masseuse slipped, the session never recovered. The therapist appeared hesitant and unsure, shifting to very light, tentative movements, more like gentle rubbing than any form of therapeutic massage. At that point, with my neck still hurting and the quality of the treatment having deteriorated, I decided to stop the session altogether.

My husband stayed for his massage but described it as similarly underwhelming, more perfunctory than professional. He said he felt pressured to tip so he did, despite a bad experience.

What makes this even more disappointing is that we had visited their sister location in Phuket just days earlier and had a similarly lackluster experience. We initially assumed we had chosen the wrong treatment (an aromatherapy oil massage instead of traditional Thai), but in hindsight, the issue seems to be consistency and training. Neither experience resembled a properly executed massage. Both felt more like unfocused, superficial contact rather than skilled bodywork.

We came here based on our hotel’s recommendation, which makes the outcome even more surprising. Phuket, and the Patong area in particular. has no shortage of massage options, many of which offer far more professional and competent service. I would strongly suggest exploring alternatives.

I recently visited Sunshine Massage in Patong and had such a wonderful experience! If you are looking for a place to recharge after walking around Phuket, this is definitely the spot. The atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, and the staff truly live up to the name—they greet you with such genuine warmth and positivity that you feel relaxed the moment you walk through the door.

​A massive thank you to Meaw, who took care of me during my visit. She is an absolute professional and clearly very skilled at what she does. I went in for a leg and foot massage, as well as some work on my shoulders, and she did a fantastic job targeting all those tight spots. Her technique was perfect—firm but soothing, and she really knew how to work out the knots. I left feeling completely rejuvenated and like a new person!

​The shop itself is well-maintained, clean, and has such an uplifting energy. It's clear the team here really cares about providing a great experience for their guests. I’ll definitely be coming back to see Meaw again next time I’m in Patong. Highly recommended if you need to soothe those tired muscles and enjoy some top-tier service!

reviews.name: Ebrahim Aljasmi
reviews.text:
In the hush of that quiet massage shop, time seemed to soften. The air was calm, carrying only the faint whisper of linen and a gentle, natural fragrance. No loud music, no hurried footsteps — just a deep, soothing silence that wrapped around you the moment you stepped inside.

The therapists moved like shadows, their presence warm but unobtrusive, speaking only in soft murmurs when necessary. Every gesture was intentional, respectful, and deeply professional. It wasn’t just a place to ease tired muscles; it was a sanctuary perfect team with perfect smiles.  I have been several times. I can say they are professional. Yhe place is very clean and quite.  a space where kindness and silence worked together to heal.

And in that stillness, with friendly smiles that asked for nothing but your comfort, you remembered: rest is not a luxury. It is a quiet return to yourself.

After the gel was removed, I was told that no nail cleaning would be done because the 400 THB charge was supposedly only for gel removal.

The pricing and services were not clearly explained beforehand, which was frustrating. When I asked why I was being charged extra and why the service I requested was not being provided, the staff were unapologetic, dismissive, and unfriendly. Rather than taking responsibility for the unclear communication, they acted as if the misunderstanding was entirely my fault. Their attitude came across as smug and unprofessional, turning what should have been a simple discussion into an unpleasant experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Our intention is always to explain service details and pricing beforehand so that our guests can make informed decisions. We regret that in this instance there appears to have been a misunderstanding regarding the services included.

We are also sorry to hear that you felt our staff were unfriendly or dismissive. Providing courteous and professional service is very important to us, and your comments will be discussed with our team to help us improve our communication and customer service.

reviews.name: Ish
reviews.text:
In Patong, where the options for massages are plentiful, my companions and I were drawn to this establishment for its professional appearance. We were pleased to find that some staff members spoke good English, adding to the comfort of our visit. Opting for a more indulgent experience, I decided on the luxury pedicure and manicure, which included the added bonus of a massage chair.

While the massage chair was enjoyable, the experience was somewhat hindered by the inconvenience of having to hold the bowl for my feet and hands, making it less relaxing than anticipated. The foot scrub was a positive aspect, but I found the pedicure to be less attentive than expected. The nail cutting and filing lacked consistency, a detail that left me somewhat frustrated, especially considering the extra cost for a luxury experience.

On the other hand, my mother opted for a foot massage and facial, both of which she thoroughly enjoyed. The overall experience at this establishment was positive, but it's worth noting that, being in Phuket, the prices for massages tend to be on the higher side compared to other places in Thailand.

In conclusion, while the visit was generally good, it's essential to be aware of the relatively higher prices due to the location. The establishment offers a range of services, and while my experience with the pedicure was a bit mixed, the positive feedback from my mother indicates that it could still be a worthwhile destination for specific treatments.

hotelDescription:
Surrounded by mountains, and close to restaurants and shops, this laid-back resort with traditional Thai architecture is a 14-minute walk from bustling Patong Beach and 35 km from Phuket International Airport.
 Unfussy rooms come with Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minifridges, as well as tea and coffeemakers. Some have living areas, mountain views, and furnished patios with access to an outdoor pool.
 There's an outdoor pool with a bar. Other amenities include a Thai boxing stadium, a gym and a spa, which offers Thai massage. Breakfast is served in an open-air restaurant that prepares Western food. Motorbike rentals are offered.

reviews.name: Cerys Shanks
reviews.text:
Just coming to the end of a 3 week stay at Naina Resort & Spa and I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a relaxing stay in Thailand.

From the day we arrived at the hotel, all members of staff have been incredibly friendly, helpful and attentive. Most notably, they take time to get to know you and are interested in chatting with you & giving recommendations for things to do in the local area.

The rooms are tidy, spacious and cleaned to a high standard daily by the housekeeping team.

The pool area is a nice space to relax if you don't have any activities planned for the day. It is quiet enough that it doesn't feel busy but there are always other hotel guests swimming or sunbathing which creates a lovely atmosphere.

There is also a very small gym area with 2 treatmills, 2 stationary bikes and a range of dumbbells if you are looking to stay active during your stay.

Location is great. The hotel is surrounded by several restaurants with various cuisines on offer, so whether you are looking for authentic Thai food, Italian food or even a KFC, there is something for everyone. There are also a few 7-Eleven convenience stores nearby to pick up snacks, drinks or any other essentials.

The hotel is also only a 20/30 minute walk from the beach, main road of Patong, and a massive shopping centre called Jungceylon so there is lots to explore.

Overall, I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking to book a stay in Phuket. All aspects of the hotel are great, but the staff really are the heart of what makes your stay amazing.

reviews.name: 4107_Nisarg Shah
reviews.text:
Our stay at Naina Resort & Spa was truly one of the best parts of our Thailand trip. We stayed for 3 nights and 4 days, and from the moment we arrived until the day we left, everything was perfect.

The rooms were comfortable, the atmosphere was peaceful, and the entire staff was incredibly kind, friendly, and always ready to help. As Indian travelers, we especially appreciated how easily the staff understood and communicated with us, which made our stay even more comfortable.

The biggest highlight of our trip was Jibin Brother. A special thank you is simply not enough for everything he did for us. He guided us on where to visit, where to shop, how to travel, which places were worth experiencing, and even helped us plan our daily schedule. He treated us like family rather than guests.

Because of his support, we never felt like tourists in a new country—we felt cared for, welcomed, and completely stress-free throughout our vacation.

Thank you, Naina Resort & Spa, for your wonderful hospitality, and a huge thank you to Jibin Brother for making our honeymoon/trip so memorable. If you're planning to visit Thailand, this is definitely a place we would recommend without a second thought.

See you again soon! ❤️

reviews.name: jennifergA800OM
reviews.text: We had initially booked the room for 14 nights through booking.com, but only stayed for 5, visiting other islands. We left some of our belongings in the room, fully intending to return.||||When we returned, we discovered that several of our belongings were missing, including a Harrods bear we had purchased at the airport. When we raised this with reception, we were shown a recording of the room the day we left, with staff insisting the items were “not there” and we had never left them there. The way this was handled was extremely aggressive and dismissive, accusing us of losing our belongings on our flight? Instead of an attempt to help us resolve the situation, or treat like a guest.||||Unfortunately, the room itself was also no where near the standard we would expect from a 4-star resort. We were required to pay a £40 deposit yet the facilities were in very poor condition. The air conditioning barely worked, leaving the room unbearably hot both day and night. The shower had virtually no water pressure and would occasionally become dangerously hot. There was no balcony light, no proper room light and broken plug sockets.||||We didn’t bother using the spa or the restaurant after seeing the state of the rest of the resort so we can’t comment on those facilities. however, the pool was unbelievably cloudy and appeared poorly maintained, with very few tiles left actually stuck to the floor. My partner unfortunately sliced himself several times.||||Calling this a 4-star resort is shockingly generous, we unfortunately didn’t recieve a basic standard of cleanliness, customer service or maintenance. We would absolutely not stay here again and hope that others will see this and reconsider giving this ‘resort’ their hard earned money.

They can improve the cleanliness and overall standards, but it seems they are not focusing enough on it. Overall, it was an average experience.

reviews.name: Ruwan Koralegama
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing and Unacceptable Experience – Do Not Book

We are a travel agency from Sri Lanka, and we booked a Deluxe Room at Naina Resort for a honeymoon couple.
From the moment they arrived, the experience was extremely disappointing.
The guests shared a video of the room, and it looked like a basic guesthouse, not a resort. There were serious issues,
including air conditioning not working properly, damaged doors, poor cleanliness, bathroom plumbing problems, and
even electrical leakage concerns.
We immediately contacted the hotel and requested to change the room or provide an upgraded room. However, there
was no proper response. The guest also informed the hotel, and they only sent a worker to fix the door temporarily,
without addressing the overall condition of the room.
In this situation, we made multiple international calls to resolve the issue. The reception staff was very rude, not
flexible, and unprofessional. Initially, they asked for 500 THB for a room upgrade. Due to the late evening, we could
not ask our guest to move to another hotel, so we tried to arrange a one-night upgrade by paying 500 THB. However,
the reception staff refused and insisted that if we wanted an upgrade, we had to pay for the full stay. She strictly
maintained her position without any flexibility.
As a travel agent, we called many times, but there was no proper support. We requested a refund when they could
not provide the upgrade, but this was also refused. Due to this situation, we had to arrange another hotel for our guest
at an additional cost.
They did not reply to emails, there was no proper communication channel like WhatsApp, and overall coordination
was very poor. They clearly do not understand basic hospitality standards and are not maintaining a 4-star level. The
operation feels unprofessional and poorly managed.
If they treat travel agents this way, individual travelers should be very cautious. We hope it was run by an underworld
team or gangsters
⚠️ We strongly advise against making any booking with this property. It is not suitable even for budget
travelers. Better to avoid unnecessary trouble and protect your holiday experience.

reviews.name: wendyh49
reviews.text: This little hotel is a welcome oasis of calm in the midst of the frantic streets of Patong. We stayed in low season so the hotel was very quiet with only a few guests. I liked the layout of the hotel with the attractive countryside style garden beside the restaurant and the attractive pool near the rooms. There is a boxing stadium on site, but this caused no disturbance, again possibly because it was low season. I have mixed feelings about about the restaurant. Breakfast offered a variety of Thai dishes and freshly cooked eggs, including good omelettes prepared to order, but the bread was just terrible.  The staff on the whole complex were charming, but there was a bit of a language barrier at times.  My room was clean and serviceable, but had its faults. Some of the sockets appeared out of order and the shower had a mind of its own! Daily housekeeping was carried out, but was a touch erratic, eg sometimes I got 2 hand towels, sometimes one, but generally I was happy enough with the cleaning. The room was basic but provided all I needed. I had no issues with the WiFi. The pool could do with some maintenance, but  was clean and provided plenty of sunbeds and parasols, with more in the garden.

reviews.name: Relax32990224255
reviews.text: A truly terrible experience during our stay at this resort. Our belongings were stolen from inside our room, even though we were out all day, and the only people who had access to our room were the hotel staff.||When we asked to review the CCTV footage to investigate what happened, the hotel told us that, coincidentally, the cameras were not working on the exact day the theft occurred and that the footage could not be retrieved. How can such a coincidence happen?||This has made me seriously question whether the hotel staff and management may have been working together to steal guests’ belongings.||When we asked the hotel to resolve the matter, they simply blamed us, saying, “You did not lock the door. Our housekeeping staff always lock the door when they leave the room, so this is your fault.”||This is the first time I have ever experienced a hotel completely shifting the blame onto the guest without offering any solution or making any genuine effort to resolve the situation together with us.||The service was absolutely terrible. reviews.text:
I visited Na Spa Pattaya and tried the deep tissue massage (around 1,5xxTHB).

The massage itself was decent. The therapist applied firm pressure, which I personally prefer, and it was stronger than a typical Thai massage. However, compared with the price, I didn’t feel there was anything particularly unique besides the stronger pressure and the use of massage oil.

The atmosphere was beautifully decorated in a traditional Thai style and the staff were polite. Unfortunately, my treatment room was quite warm, which made it difficult to fully relax. The shower in my room was also out of order, so I had to use a different bathroom.

Overall, it was an okay experience, but I expected more for the price. I would rate it 6/10

reviews.name: Vijay Gujar
reviews.text:
I recently visited Let’s Relax Spa in Pattaya, and I have to say – it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The staff were incredibly professional, well-trained, and genuinely friendly, making us feel welcome and comfortable right away.

What really sets this place apart is that it’s a genuine spa – focused purely on wellness and quality treatments. There are no gimmicks or hidden agendas here – just top-notch massages and excellent service. It’s the perfect choice if you’re looking for a real, relaxing, and respectable spa experience.

The facilities are clean, calming, and thoughtfully designed. There is a private room that was spacious, beautifully set up, and very comfortable – ideal for a peaceful experience.

Whether you’re a couple looking to unwind or just someone seeking the best massage in Pattaya, I can’t recommend Let’s Relax Spa enough. Professional, trustworthy, and truly relaxing. We’ll definitely be back!☺️☺️

reviews.name: Rushali Riah
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Let’s Relax Spa, Pattaya Beach (right opposite North Pattaya Beach on Beach Road). This is one of the most premium spa brands here, and it truly lives up to its name.

I went for the traditional Thai massage (120 mins – 1200 Baht, also available 90 mins – 1000 Baht) in their private couple’s room. The vibe was serene, with soothing music, a very hygienic setup, and professional service. They give you spa clothes to change into (no oil involved, just a refreshing herbal spray for pain relief), and before the session, they wash your feet and serve cool refreshing drinks with a hot towel. After the massage, they surprised us with mango sticky rice (which was super delicious) and herbal tea – such a wholesome experience!

They have a display of their own products; I loved the pain-relief spray they used and bought it. The whole spa has multiple floors with an elevator, making it very convenient.

If you want more than just a massage – a complete relaxing experience – this is the place.

Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
A reliable chain of massage shops. They have several branches throughout Pattaya and this was the most central of the lot. Despite being on a busy street, the massage therapy rooms were very quiet and peaceful.

The place is very clean and very modern, well maintained with professionally trained staff who speak English so you can tell them what to focus on. They have a variety of treatments so you can choose a traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy oil massage, warm oil massage, scrubs and so on.

Prices are on the expensive side compared to the smaller businesses you'll find all throughout Pattaya but the premises are a class above the rest.

I felt I had no choice but to switch to a male therapist. While he was excellent, I personally don’t feel comfortable being massaged by a man.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let’s Relax Spa, Sawasdee ka.

We sincerely apologize for the discomfort and inconvenience you experienced during your visit. At Let’s Relax Spa, we always aim to provide thoughtful and personalized service that respects each customer’s comfort and preferences. We regret that our receptionist’s decision regarding the therapist assignment made you feel uncomfortable, and we truly appreciate you sharing this feedback. Please be assured that additional training is being conducted to improve communication and ensure that customers are always given clear choices and feel fully comfortable with their therapist selection. Thank you once again for bringing this matter to our attention. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us continue improving to provide a truly relaxing and respectful experience for every customer.

reviews.name: Raghu Vijaykumar
reviews.text: A visit to Let's Relax Spa for a Thai massage was pure bliss. The therapist's expert touch and unique blend of acupressure and stretches melted away tension. Highly recommend for anyone in need of a rejuvenating escape.

I was put off by the not-so-kind receptionist - it almost seemed like they didn't care for the business...not helpful when asked for basic information regarding the types of massages before making the choice. reviews.name: Pony Preamie

title: Tiger Eye Muay Thai and MMA
ownerDescription:
Mixed Martial Arts Academy located in the vibrant neighborhood of Ari. Family friendly, focused on true technical mastery and developing yourself through martial arts. Founded by Bashir Ahmad, a former professional MMA fighter, United States Army combat veteran and former executive for ONE Championship.

The gym caters to all levels. The best children's program for martial arts in Bangkok.
A gym where kids will learn real martial arts skills in a program meant to unlock their full potential. A gym where the parents will train, be involved and be a part of a community. A gym where professional fighters will get world class training and can be managed by a well known, well connected and experienced individuals in MMA.
address: 180 Pradiphat 9 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: QGPQ+HC Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Carma Lucas Welschinger
reviews.text:
Love this gym! It's a hidden gem in the heart of Bangkok—yet you feel like you're training in the middle of nature thanks to its beautiful garden setting. The facilities are clean and well-maintained, and the coaches are highly professional. Even during group sessions, you get plenty of one-on-one attention.

One thing that really sets this gym apart is the schedule. They offer 4–5 Muay Thai sessions throughout the day, whereas most gyms only have a morning and an evening class. On top of that, they also offer Western Boxing, BJJ, MMA, Yoga, and Meditation, so there's something for everyone.

With a membership package, you can train every day in every class except Sundays, making it incredibly flexible.

They also offer DTV packages and handle all the paperwork. I received my 5-year DTV visa in just 2 working days applying from Switzerland.

I highly recommend this gym, whether you're a beginner, a serious fighter, or planning to stay in Thailand on a DTV visa. They've got you covered. See you in the ring! Oss! 🙏🏽🥊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the fantastic 5-star review and for sharing your detailed experience. We're thrilled you enjoyed the garden setting, clean facilities, and the coaches' one-on-one attention even during group sessions. It's great to hear our varied schedule and class options suited your needs, and we're especially pleased the DTV visa service got your 5-year visa in just two working days. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to training with you again.

reviews.name: Ayushi Verma
reviews.text:
A 5/5 MUAY THAI GYM IN BANGKOK! 🇹🇭
I’m a pedantic researcher so when it came to booking a Muay Thai gym in Bangkok, I was overwhelmed with the options / number of gyms available. As someone who’s trained Muay Thai for 6 months in India, I was looking forward to train at a gym where community mattered (I wasn’t just another member), where trainers were patient with me and yet pushed me to do better - Tiger Muay Thai delivered just that and more.

How to Book - The process is fairly simple. I contacted them through Instagram and was directed to their Webpage. From thereon, I opted for an unlimited weekly pass (Trial Pass was 2,000 Thai Baht). I was directed to an app called ‘Members’ where one can choose from the different class timings and formats.

How to Get there - You can reach BTS Ari from your accommodation. From BTS Ari, you can take exit 1 and book a Tuk Tuk 🛺 on MuvMi for 40-50 Thai Baht to the gym. I was staying on the Sukhumvit Line (in Phrom Phong) close to BTS so commute was easy. You may also choose to book a grab directly to the gym.

About the Gym - Beginner Friendly, Extremely Female Friendly. The gym offers various classes to choose from and at different times so you can decide accordingly. I mostly went for Muay Thai at 8:30 am and sometimes in the evening for Muay Thai again and Boxing. The classes are very well structured - Stretching, Warm Ups, Shadow Boxing, Pad Work, Bag Work, Technique (Clinching, Punching), Sparring and Cool Down. The gym was very clean and the equipment’s are fairly new. You can carry your gloves wraps shin guards and mouth guards, but just in case you don’t have it, the gym provides you that. There’s a neat washroom and they have a water dispenser. The gym is located in an alley adjacent to Main Street, far from the bustle of the city. It’s peaceful, ventilated, safe and serene.

Trainers - The trainers are very patients and super warm. They would always greet you with a smile. Within 3 days, my trainers knew my name, told me about my strength and weakness, helped me hone my skills. The female trainers are exceptionally good and sweet. I realised how much representation matters - As a solo female traveling all the way from India, I was delighted to see strong women who are so skilled, so patient to teach and clear my doubts and just as warm to check on me if I’m feeling okay or to talk about food and fights in Bangkok. Just to train with them again, I intend to visit Bangkok again! 😁

If you’re in Bangkok (currently living, relocating or traveling) and looking to join a Muay Thai community gym, THIS is the place to be. I wish the gym and its warm staff the very best of luck. Hope to see you super soon. ♥️💪🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this wonderful review, Ayushi. We’re thrilled our trainers and community made you feel welcome and supported and that the classes, facilities, and booking process met your expectations. It means a lot to hear our female trainers and inclusive atmosphere resonated with you as a solo traveler. We look forward to training with you again next time you’re in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Brian Lau
reviews.text: Tried a drop-in session at Tiger Eye Muay Thai and had a great first experience. The staff were very friendly and took care of everything—from helping me with the online forms to wrapping my hands and guiding me through the basics. We did stretches, warm-up runs, bag work, and beginner punches/kicks with some light partner drills, which made it fun and welcoming for a first timer. Open-air gym with lots of fans, great energy, and I definitely got a serious sweat in. Even met a few fellow Americans there. Highly recommend if you want to try Muay Thai in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the fantastic review, Brian! We're thrilled you enjoyed your drop-in session and that the team could help with the forms, hand wraps, and basics. It's great to hear the open-air gym, strong energy, and partner drills made it welcoming and fun, and that you met some fellow Americans. Drop-ins are always welcome and we hope to see you back for more training soon.

The grappling class we learned a few techniques, rolled, and tried submissions on different partners the rest of the time. Tiger Eye has people of all different skill levels, meaning this is a great place for everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for dropping in during your Bangkok trip and for the great review. We’re glad you enjoyed the Muay Thai class and found the instructors and structure helpful, and that the grappling session gave you useful techniques and solid rolling time. We pride ourselves on welcoming all skill levels, so it’s great to hear Tiger Eye felt like a good fit. Hope to see you back next time you’re in town.

Our team appreciates your kind words about our accommodating, family-like care and we look forward to welcoming you back next year, Insha Allah.

reviews.name: Wil Nichols
reviews.text:
I moved to Bangkok recently and started training at Tiger Eye MMA, and it’s honestly been one of the best decisions I’ve made since arriving here. I’ve been training Muay Thai, and even in a short amount of time, I can already feel a real difference. My technique is sharper, my conditioning is way better, and I feel more confident every week.

What I really appreciate about Tiger Eye is that the trainers actually pay attention. They correct your form, explain the details, and push you hard without making the environment feel negative or intimidating. Everyone I’ve met there has been kind, supportive, and welcoming, but the training is still serious. They expect you to work, and that’s exactly what makes you improve.

The gym also makes it easy to stay consistent. The class schedule and calendar are simple to follow, and it’s easy to choose the classes that fit your level and goals. They offer beginner-friendly classes, more intense training sessions, Muay Thai, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, grappling, and MMA, so there’s a lot of room to grow no matter where you’re starting from.

Highly recommend Tiger Eye MMA to anyone in Bangkok who wants to train seriously, get in better shape, learn real technique, and be surrounded by good people. 5 stars.

reviews.text: It has been a great experience training at Tiger Eye Gym as a beginner. The coaches and staff are very professional and supportive, and the gym is well maintained and clean.

reviews.text: I had my 2 first ever Muay Thai lessons and the coaches were extremely welcoming, helpful and patient. It was so good that I came back the next day. You learn all the basics and as it is quite small it’s very intimate. Can only recommend

reviews.name: Gradita Purukan
reviews.text:
The muay thai classes are well structured; I really appreciate the balance of cardio, core strength, technique drills, and pad work (from experience, other gyms tend to lean heavier on one aspect).

A key highlight for me was sparring for the first time. The coaches gave me a lot of guidance and support, especially since I was off balance quite a lot. They were encouraging and helped me build my confidence. All of the coaches I trained with were very attentive, approachable and have great energy.

You can come empty handed as they provide everything you need. It’s affordable; the trial week allows unlimited training and the training quality makes it such good value for money.

Overall a positive experience, I would definitely come back to train and highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the fantastic 5-star review and for sharing your experience in detail. We’re thrilled our classes hit the right balance of cardio, strength, technique, and pad work, and that your first sparring session was positive with coaches supporting your confidence. It’s great to hear our team came across as attentive, approachable, and energetic. We’re glad the provided gear and the unlimited trial week made training easy and good value. reviews.text:

reviews.name: janin gies
reviews.text:
A highly recommended place to learn Muay Thai for all levels. I came in not having any experience in this sports and after a month training loving the sports. reviews.name: DONG C (CD)
reviews.text: Great first experience in the basic Muay Thai group class. Coaches are friendly, professional, and give individual guidance for different skill levels. The warm-up and stretching are well organized, the training intensity is solid and fun. The weekly pass is very worthwhile, especially for short-term visitors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great first experience in our basic Muay Thai class. Our coaches strive to provide individual guidance and create a fun, engaging environment. We're glad you found the warm-up and training intensity to your liking. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Shaun Penn
reviews.text:
The Muay Thai classes here were extremely poor, disorganized and unsafe. See full details and our experiences below.

After the 3rd Muay Thai class - my girlfriend was punched repeatedly in the teeth with no mouthguard in her first sparring session by another student going 100%. No staff stepped in to control the tempo, instead they seemed to actually encourage it, she's now needing to see the dentist today.

For context - I've done classes at other gyms for about 3-4 months, learnt good fundamentals, we love going to class, it's the highlight of our week.

This place managed to make it an extremely negative experience, taught very little - and after the teeth incident - make us consider quitting altogether.

Detailed reasons:

1. Very negative atmosphere and culture among the staff - No one seems to want to be there nor help students.

2. The coach / Owner is a very strange guy - he never spoke to us across the 3 classes, yet found plenty of time to glare at my girlfriend from a distance which made her feel really uncomfortable.

3. The women trainers are extremely underqualified - The worst pad sessions I've ever had. We've even overheard the male trainers in Thai question why and how they are training at the gym at all.

5. Ego problem among male trainers - they have better skills to teach, but this is overshadowed by their poor attitude, bad manners and bad teaching ability.

4. The schedule and organization impossible to prep for - The website schedule is incorrect, lessons change on the fly despite us calling ahead to check. This led to us sparring for the first time without mouthguards being assured it would be fine by the trainers.

5. Poor sparring etiquette  encouraged by the trainers - I had great sparring sessions with the other students by the way. This was the first time me and my girlfriend did sparring and - as above - did not expect nor was prepared to do it. The Round with the trainer was really unproductive, 0 communication beforehand, but he seemed to enjoy 'winning'.

For my girlfriends 3rd round of sparring - she was matched with another girl that instantly went for 100% constant punches to the jaw, nose and teeth for the entire round when my girlfriend had no mouthguard (again the trainer said this would not be a problem). The other student was not just trying to 'win' the spar, she was actively trying to damage her as much as possible.

Nobody stepped in to control the tempo or tell the other woman to calm down (coach was nowhere to be seen as explained above).

Now my girlfriend has serious bruising on her front teeth and gums that will need to be looked at by the dentist later. The female trainer didn't seem to say anything about sparring etiquette apart from "make sure you hit hard enough during the sparring so they can really feel it", fantastic advice.

Overall - there's nothing here for a beginner, intermediate or advanced hobbyist or fighter, I've seen all of them in these classes seem frustrated and confused by this place.

This place markets heavily to foreigners visiting Thailand on the DTV for the Muay Thai in order to get you to buy a large package upfront, I think it's this and the Children's BJJ classes which they're most interested in marketing as it brings in the most money, this seems to be where the majority of their energy is spent.

If you're seeing this I'd urge you to try another gym first, there's so many better quality options in Bangkok where you will get much better teaching with regular sparring in a far more positive and safe environment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Shaun, 

First, we are truly sorry that you and your girlfriend left feeling upset after your experience at Tiger Eye. We never want a beginner student to feel uncomfortable or unsafe, and we take feedback like this seriously. 

After reviewing the situation internally and speaking with staff and students who were present, we feel several parts of the review do not accurately reflect our gym, staff, or culture. 

Regarding the sparring, participation is always voluntary at Tiger Eye. Many students — especially beginners — choose not to spar at all and instead work on drills, technique, or bag training. Controlled contact is also inherent to sparring environments, even during light sparring. However, nothing we reviewed on our CCTV suggested malicious intent or sparring that appeared dangerous or out of control. The student involved is a long-time recreational member who is generally considered by staff and students to be a safe and controlled training partner. That said, we are reviewing how we communicate beginner sparring expectations, intensity levels, and protective equipment recommendations so that situations like this are less likely to happen moving forward. 

You also mentioned a trainer saying students should “hit hard enough so they can really feel it.” The phrase was understood to mean that sparring should involve realistic contact rather than completely non-contact movement. In combat sports, some level of contact is necessary realistic learning. 

Regarding your own sparring session, the trainer involved is a veteran fighter with extensive experience. Like many trainers in Thailand, his English is limited, which can sometimes create communication gaps with foreign students. However, we did not observe behavior that appeared hostile or intended to intimidate. 

I also want to be clear that I stand behind our staff, including our female trainers. While you may not have personally connected with their coaching style, they are experienced coaches who have helped many students over the past two years. 

Regarding the comments about me personally, during one of the sessions you attended, I was at the gym to train Brazilian jiu-jitsu myself rather work. On the other two days, those were our busiest evening hours, I had already delegated much of the coaching responsibility to staff while handling other aspects of running the business (I also chatted with a number of students including someone on their first day). 

Regarding the comment about me “glaring” at your girlfriend, I genuinely believe this was a misunderstanding. I wasn’t wearing my glasses and was squinting because I thought she was someone else. 

Our website schedule is updated in real time, and after reviewing our systems we could not find any record of schedule changes or phone calls regarding class confirmation during that period. 

Regarding the comments about DTV packages, Tiger Eye is one of the very few gyms offering one-month Muay Thai packages for DTV applicants rather than requiring large long-term upfront commitments. In fact, most of our DTV students purchase one-month packages, which is also common among our regular non-DTV members. 

Finally, while you described the environment as extremely negative, it is worth noting that you attended the gym on multiple occasions and chose to return for additional drop-ins each time despite having no long-term commitment or obligation to do so. 

We also genuinely appreciate the feedback, even where we may disagree with certain parts of it. It forces us to reflect, review our systems, communicate internally, and improve. 

For anyone interested in Tiger Eye, we encourage people to come see the gym and community for themselves.

reviews.name: Desi Aero
reviews.text:
Tiger Eye Muay Thai is hands down one of the best training facilities out there! Don’t let the name fool you—while they have top-notch Muay Thai training, they also offer an incredible variety of classes, including Wrestling, BJJ, Gymnastics, and all kinds of MMA. I understand that everyone is different and that it’s important to find a good massage therapist. But this was bad — I really didn’t like the massage or the way it was done. I would recommend finding somewhere else.

We started late and finished early. The actual massage lasted only 24 minutes. They spent a long time washing our feet, then mostly just stroked my legs. reviews.name: Maryam
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about this place.

I first came here for a massage the day before, and the massage was actually very good. That positive experience is the reason I returned the next day to use their hair salon.

Unfortunately, the hair salon experience was very disappointing and felt unethical. I asked for a simple root touch-up and a basic trim. I was quoted around US$60, which already felt quite high for a very average, non-luxury hair salon in Thailand, but I agreed.

Once the service started, the issues began. After applying the color and during the wash, I was told they wanted to add “vitamins” to my hair for an extra US$15. I clearly said no. Then after the wash, I was told that the haircut would be another US$15, even though I was originally told the price included both the root touch-up and the trim.

When I questioned this, they claimed the front desk staff “didn’t know” because she was new. I asked them to show me the price list. At first they didn’t want to, but when they finally did, it became clear that I was right — the price I had been charged was not even for a root touch-up, but for a full color, meaning I was already being overcharged.

I also noticed they were doing similar upselling tactics to other clients, adding unnecessary services in the middle of appointments without clear consent. Overall, it felt like a bait-and-switch / skimming business practice, which is very disappointing.

Massage service: Good
Hair salon: Not honest, not transparent

Because of the lack of transparency and ethical pricing, I do not recommend using their hair salon, even though the massage itself was decent.
