reviews.name: Charlotte Marsh
reviews.text:
HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP!!!
May is incredible! This is a must do in Chiang Mai, May is a wonderful teacher and the hands on experience you get is great. She was incredible in adapting the experience for someone with coeliac disease and very accommodating of the dietary requirement.

This is not just a cooking school it’s learning about produce, markets, Thai culture and the building of flavours. The whole experience was amazing and the personalised cookbook at the end is an amazing souvenir we can’t wait to use at home.

We could not recommend anything more when visiting Chiang Mai, this was the best day!

reviews.name: Vernon Wright
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience - May teaches you not just a few Thai recipes but actually educates you in the basics of Thai ingredients and flavours. This is conducted from her well appointed and spacious training kitchen set in grounds that contain a small market garden that you will pick fresh herbs from. The day starts at a local market where May shares her knowledge and gives you tips for sourcing good ingredients for when you return home. Funny and engaging, May keeps a close eye on proceedings, and wether you are a complete beginner or a budding chef - this is a must if you visit Chaing Mai.
Wonderful value, and you get to eat a lot of wonderful food!

reviews.name: Susanne Scholz
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing day at Mai’s Thai Secret Cooking Class! Everything was perfectly organized from the very beginning. We were picked up from our hotel right on time and received a very warm welcome.

Our day started at a local market, where Mai introduced us to the fresh ingredients used in Thai cuisine. She explained the different varieties of rice, traditional Thai herbs and spices, and shared fascinating insights into Thai food culture. It was both interesting and educational.

Afterwards, we went to Mai’s home and cooking school. Each of us was able to choose the dishes we wanted to cook. We were excited to try several new recipes, and every dish turned out to be delicious!

The atmosphere throughout the day was relaxed, welcoming, and fun. Mai is a wonderful host who teaches with great passion, patience, and enthusiasm.

It was truly a unique experience and one of the highlights of our trip. We would do it again without hesitation and highly recommend Mai’s Thai Secret Cooking Class to anyone who wants to learn authentic Thai cooking and enjoy an unforgettable day.

reviews.name: Angela Killian
reviews.text:
MUST-DO in Chiang Mai!

May is a wonderful teacher and we learned more dishes than any other cooking class…we only did the half day but learned a curry, a stir-fry and spring rolls. You choose from the menu at the start of class. And pick fresh ingredients from the garden.

I recommend that you know basic cooking / chopping skills because it’s fast-paced but that’s how you are able to cook so many dishes. May explains everything in detail of what to do before each dish.

Our group had around 10 people and there was plenty of space and May gave everyone the help they needed. You make A TON of food so be ready to eat!

You get a certificate and a little printed cookbook with everything you made plus heaps more. Such great souvenirs to take home and continue cooking!

The school is located about 30min outside of the city so they offer return tuk tuks.

reviews.text: This Thai cooking class was truly an unforgettable experience. I'm especially grateful to May for her patient and detailed guidance. From visiting the local market to buy spices, picking fresh fruits and vegetables ourselves, grinding red and green curry pastes from scratch, to learning stir-frying techniques—every moment was memorable. We also got to play with the animals there and connect with nature. I feel like I discovered the true meaning of life. I wonder if that one-eyed black kitten is still there... I miss him dearly. 😊

reviews.text: This was one of our favorite things we did during our whole trip to Thailand! The class starts with May taking you to the market, and she tells you all about the ingredients you’ll be cooking with. Then, you go with May to her home where she has a lovely area set up for cooking. You literally get to pick the fresh produce you’ll be cooking with from the garden on her farm! After harvesting, you get to the cooking, and May shares so many helpful tips and is such a wonderful teacher. I’m vegetarian (and honestly a bit picky), and she helped me tailor the food to my liking while still respectfully encouraging me to step out of my comfort zone a healthy amount :) We made so much food that the leftovers lasted us 2 days, and every single we dish we made was the best of that dish we had eaten the entire trip! This class is truly such a gem, and I can’t recommend it enough to all who are in Chiang Mai!!

reviews.name: Olivia Simmons
reviews.text: We attended the full day cooking class (definitely stay for the full experience) and it was incredible! May offers multiple options to choose from for five courses, and even with a decent size class, she masterfully manages to check in and teach each person. A beautiful property and kitchen setup, fantastic food, and an enjoyable balance of fun / learning Thai cooking. We enjoyed getting picked up and taking the local transportation as well. Overall, an amazing experience, we have recommended this to everyone going to Thailand!

reviews.name: Mike Dow
reviews.text:
May is not only an expert in Thai cooking, she is a gifted teacher as well. Her English is excellent and she really walks you through each component. She makes sure you sample each ingredient at each step so you can adjust to your own tastes. Everything on the menu can be made vegetarian or vegan, which was a big selling point for us.

After we were picked up by May’s uncle at our hotel, the day started at a local market. May explained and sampled many of the ingredients we would be using. She gave us some time to do our own shopping before bringing us to her classroom, an open air area underneath her home with many cooking stations. We were put to “work”, gathering additional ingredients from her beautiful garden. After that, she guided us through cooking 5 courses of amazing, authentic Thai food.

This course was one of the highlights of our trip, and frankly is a bargain for what you receive. We left full, with much more knowledge, a cookbook in case we need a refresher at home, and a couple of other surprises. Highly recommended for anyone with any interest in cooking.

reviews.name: Marcus Probst
reviews.text:
Are you a foodie? And do you thoroughly want to learn how to make authentic Thai food? Then I know the place for you… The Thai Secret Cooking School by May – just outside Chiang Mai.
It will take your Thai cooking skills to a whole new level.

Let me tell our story…
We are foodies.
We talk about food from dusk till dawn—what to eat, where to eat, where to find the right ingredients, and what is in season.
Northern Thailand is generally a farming region, and specifically, Chiang Mai is considered the food capital. So, when we decided to visit Chiang Mai on our recent trip, I started researching cooking schools.

There are many! I counted 30+ schools. I started reading reviews and watching video clips. Most of them seemed like a fun day with a group of other tourists where the main focus was eating Thai food rather than learning how to make it.

And then May stood out.
I loved that May herself was the one cooking—and only her! I could also see from her video channel that she was the one teaching and cooking, not a “stand-in.”

Her class also starts at the local market, which I loved because we had questions about chili varieties, rice differences, and, in general, we wanted to pick her brain about Thai produce.
Exclusive Class & Custom Menu

In some of the videos, I saw groups of people cooking together, but in others, the class was smaller—down to 6, 4, or even just 2 people.
We wanted to get the most out of the experience, so I contacted May well in advance and asked if we could do a private class just for the two of us. She quickly responded that it was, of course, possible—at an additional cost.
In the same email, May sent a menu and asked what we would like to cook during the day.

The Experience
The day arrived, and we were picked up from our Airbnb and driven 15 minutes outside Chiang Mai, where we met May at the market.

And May is fantastic - lively, communicative, and eager to share her knowledge of Thai food from the very start.
We visited her favorite vendors and learned about different chili varieties, rice qualities, types of prawns, and much more. May bought the last few ingredients we needed, and we picked up (too) many items to take home with us.

After a 30-minute drive, we arrived at her house and outdoor cooking studio, which had the most beautiful view over the rice fields.
But no time to just admire the scenery—on with the aprons and time to chop!

Our chosen menu for the day:
•	Spring Rolls
•	Fried Rice with Chicken and Dressing
•	Hot & Sour Prawn Soup (Tom Yum Goong)
•	Chicken in Coconut Milk Soup (Tom Kha Gai)
•	Green Curry with Chicken
•	Panang Curry with Pork
•	Dips we had tasted with grilled fish

We both love Thai food and had experimented with cooking all of the above dishes before, but we wanted a deeper understanding of the ingredients and cooking techniques.

And wow, did we get that!
Seven hours later, we had chopped, cooked, and eaten all of the above while learning so much. A day we will never forget. From now on, May will be our reference for all our Thai cooking.
Final Tip: DO NOT eat anything before going to May’s class, as you will be eating so much delicious food.

Our Recommendation
So yes, we can truly recommend spending a day cooking with May.

If you are a foodie and want real insights into Thai cuisine, May’s cooking school is the place to go.

reviews.name: Josh Finkelstein
reviews.text:
We first discovered Thai Secret Cooking School back in 2019 while planning our Thailand trip, but Covid forced us to cancel. Then, something unexpected happened—the school sent us a surprise cookbook in the mail as a reminder to rebook in the future. That thoughtful touch stuck with us, and when we finally made it to Thailand in 2025, we knew this was an experience we couldn’t miss.

This isn’t your typical quick-and-easy cooking class. May, our instructor, is a true expert in Thai cuisine. The day started with a guided tour of a local market, where she walked us through fresh ingredients, from exotic herbs to the many varieties of Thai rice and their uses.

Then, we arrived at her home—a peaceful rice farm with a lush garden—where we handpicked the herbs for our dishes. The hands-on experience continued as we prepared not just two, but five traditional Thai dishes, covering everything from spring rolls and soups to curries and even specialty drinks. The pace was perfect—both educational and fun—leaving us confident enough to recreate these flavors back home.

May’s passion for Thai cooking and warm hospitality made this experience unforgettable. We left with a cookbook, a certificate, and skills (and memories!) that will last a lifetime. If you’re in Chiang Mai and want to dive deep into authentic Thai cuisine, Thai Secret Cooking School is an absolute must! 👩‍🍳✨

reviews.name: M P
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our experience with Thai Secret Cooking School. May is incredibly knowledgeable and teaches in a simplistic way that we felt we could replicate the dishes we created back home. The recipes were so fresh and the tastes bold and spicy. From being picked up at our hotel, the guided market tour, to picking herbs right out of May's garden, and the top-notch cooking lessons, we would take another class with May in a heartbeat! Thank you May for the wonderful experience!

reviews.name: Elani 'Elio' Evangelou
reviews.text: Wish I could give this more than 5 stars! May is a fantastic teacher and our day was filled with laughter and joy from beginning to end. You can really tell that May is passionate about authentic Thai cooking and educating people on the whole process. From harvesting different types of rice to eating the finished product I feel I learnt so much during the day, and had a great time meeting new people along the way! Her partner and team of staff are also very friendly and sweet. I would recommend this class to anyone who wants a taste of real, authentic Thai cooking!

reviews.name: Korn Singprasong
reviews.text:
Amazing experience even as a Thai. I booked a class here with my non-Thai partner and we had a great time with full belly by the end.

May is very energetic and knowledgeable. We learned a lot.

I would definitely come back here again for a different menu.

reviews.name: Finola Murphy
reviews.text:
I completed May's cooking class last week.
It was very professional, May's passion for cooking and teaching was astounding!
Pick-up service on time,off to the market which was so clean and a delight.
We choose our menus and cooked each dish,being taught expertly but in a calm and relaxing environment.
After cooking we sat and ate each dish.
Having picked most of the herbs and spices in the beautiful garden,tasting each flavour in our dish was an amazing experience.
Anyone wanting to do a Thai cooking class should definitely pick Secret Garden.
A thanks also to May's husband who chatted and took great photos of our class,presenting us with cookbook and certificate.Also thanks to the wonderful staff, silently doing an amazing job at preparation and keeping everything clean.
Just a perfect day!

reviews.name: Stuart Kenealy
reviews.text: We booked a group of 4 for the full day and we were very impressed. My wife and I lived in Thailand for a few years and did a few cooking schools. This one was definitely the best. It is a short trip out of Chiang Mai but definitely worth it for the extra space and outlook. Very well organized. At the market people were able to make selections depending on things they couldn't eat (e.g. vegan, vegetarian, no egg etc.). Everything was very clean and all questions happily answered. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Midori Izu
reviews.text: So first of all this was such a fun class. I personally liked the friendly vibe at the market. Some people said it was "unprofessional" but May made us feel welcome to ask questions and I liked that she taught us how to pick the produce! It was great and I took lots of notes. I also noticed that one person complained about the size of the class and I think they took the feedback seriously because my class size was perfect. There were only about 10 people. Each person had their own station and it was small enough for everyone to get some personal coaching. I also LOVED THE FOOD. I'm not joking when I say that this is some of the best food I had while in Thailand. I'm serious. I loved the class setting, it was nice and open with plenty of space to move and breathe (I do not like a crowded kitchen) all in all I loved it. The only drawback is that I only got to choose one dish per category so I guess I'll have to come back and learn the different dishes. 😁😁

reviews.name: Tom Kagan
reviews.text: Amazing experience! May (the instructor) was absolutely awesome😎. She was very experienced and had amazing knowledge of all ingredients and meals, including how we can get them or good substitutes for them back home. The class was entertaining, informative, fun and in a great atmosphere. We were picked up from the hotel we stayed at, traveled to a local market where we were taught to recognize Thai ingredients. After that we were taken to their home which is at a beautiful location in the vicinity of Chiang Mai(not a long drive) where all the cooking was done. Thanks to May's fun character the class did not get boring and we all finished with amazing meals.

reviews.name: caleb lin
reviews.text:
Finally got a chance to sit down and write this review. I’ve been very busy after a long stay in Bangkok.

We stayed in Bangkok for a few days, and my girlfriend found this cooking school on Klook. The price was reasonable, and their menu looked promising. The location was also convenient, with a very local market nearby selling many interesting and fancy ingredients. The market itself was worth a short trip with the tour guide from the cooking class.

The interior of the cooking school is very nice and stylish. The owners and the chef were extremely friendly and helpful, and the ingredients were very fresh. Their menu was exceptional, and they even provided one dish that other cooking classes did not offer, which made the experience feel even more special.

Their Thai milk tea was extraordinary! The place was very clean, smelled wonderful, and the hygiene standards were superb.

The chef was very thoughtful and interesting to chat with. She was full of passion and was willing to share all of her techniques and cooking secrets with the participants. Everything we learned in the class was useful and practical, and we felt that we had learned skills we could actually use in our own kitchen.

It was a fantastic experience for my girlfriend and me, and we had a wonderful time in Bangkok. The food was so good, and we were so full after the afternoon class that we didn’t even have dinner!

This is definitely an event worth visiting during your vacation in Bangkok. If they change their menu and we happen to be in Bangkok again, we would definitely revisit the cooking class.

Thank you very much for giving us such a wonderful memory and such an interesting learning experience.

Last but not least, we received a certificate of participation and a souvenir after the class. It was such a kind and lovely gesture from the owners, and we really appreciated it.

Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Had the best time at a cooking class today! The place was super cozy, and everyone there was so welcoming. We got to do it all — prep, cook, plate, and of course eat — while learning fun little facts about the ingredients along the way.
The cutest part? They gave us a certificate and a sweet souvenir at the end. Such a thoughtful touch to wrap up an already memorable experience. 💛
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you sincerely for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class.
We also truly appreciate you taking the time to leave such a lovely and thoughtful review.

We hope the delicious food and happy memories you experienced here will stay with you for a long time.
If you visit us again in the future, we will warmly welcome you with open arms.

reviews.name: Howard Lau
reviews.text: the instructor was sooooooo nice and funny too making the overall experience even better!! Instructions given were super clear and easy to follow making the food easy to make and really really tasty!! Very happy with the whole thing absolutely recommend to people who love food and cooking even if you are not good at it!!! They even help you take pictures!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely appreciate your wonderful compliments about every part of your experience with us. It truly makes us happy to know that you fully enjoyed your time at Udomsuk Cooking Class. 

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a heartfelt review. We hope the special time you shared with us will remain a warm and lasting memory for you for many years to come.

reviews.name: Daniel S
reviews.text: The owners at Udomsok are a lovely couple very friendly warm and responsive to dietary requirements of guests. They make people feel very welcome. You start by meeting them and going to the market to shop followed by a short walk to the studio with the Chef. The studio is very bright and inviting, the Chef at the studio Chef Pon is very friendly, helpful and funny! Favourites were Thai Tea, Glass Noodle Salad and Pork Kra Pao! Highly recommend anyone to come here for a cooking class. Thank you for making it a special and happy experience for us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for discovering and visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class. We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the dishes we carefully prepared with all our heart.

Welcoming such a lovely guest like you filled our whole team with an extra spoonful of warmth and joy. It was a real pleasure to have you with us.

We sincerely wish you a journey ahead filled with happiness, and we hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Sophia Isles
reviews.text: Actually the best cooking class you could ever do. All of the staff were so kind and patient. Big thank you to Chef Pon for such a fun and detailed class, I will be definitely cooking the food I made again and also coming back next time I visit Bangkok. Thank you so much to the team! Very lovely experience 🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class. We truly appreciate your kind review and the beautiful photos you shared. We are delighted to hear that you had such an enjoyable time with us.

Your kind words about our chef Pon and our staff mean a great deal to us and are a wonderful source of motivation.

Thank you once again, and we hope to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: Felony
reviews.text: Booked on klook and showed up to the class with a hungry stomach and left full. We made pad thai, tom yum, and green curry. The instruction and staff were superb. Pon was a very patient chef and guided us all the way. I really recommended this place if you want to spend quality time to make some traditional Thai dishes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you sincerely for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class. We are delighted that we could fill your hungry stomach with our friendly service and delicious food. We truly appreciate the time and care you put into writing your review, and we wish you a journey always filled with happiness.

reviews.name: 강성민
reviews.text: One of the best experiences in Bangkok! The instructor was very kind and patient, and the food we cooked was incredibly delicious. I learned a lot about Thai cuisine. Thank you for the wonderful class!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are thrilled to have provided you with one of your best memories in Bangkok! Thanks again for finding your way to Udomsuk Cooking Class. 

You’ll be visiting Bangkok city again, won't you? When you do, we truly hope to see you back in our cooking class. We love to have more amazing dishes and great times ready for your next visit!

reviews.name: Bryan Soo
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Amazing Pad Thai and Tom Yum Goong! Both dishes were full of flavor and tasted authentic. Friendly service and a nice atmosphere. Definitely worth visiting when you’re in Udom Suk. Will come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for visiting our Udomsuk Cooking Class.

 It was our pleasure to welcome you and provide you with warm hospitality, a comfortable atmosphere, and delicious Thai dishes.

Thank you for spending your time with us. We hope you'll visit us again the next time you're in Bangkok. We would be delighted to welcome you back with open arms!

reviews.name: Luke Elsen
reviews.text: Amazing experience. Very professional, well organised, amazing chef and very friendly owners. An easy class, which anyone can do, but absolutely delicious food. You will learn local food and experience a local (not touristy) market.  Easy and quick to get to from city centre. Would recommend 100%.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class. 
You and your group were truly lovely. Just as you came to Bangkok for a happy occasion, we hope your time at our cooking class will remain a joyful and lasting memory. As the meaning of our name suggests, we wish that your journey ahead will always be filled with happiness.

reviews.name: Izzy Vince
reviews.text: Such an amazing cooking class. A really knowledgeable and helpful teacher and all the staff were so professional and friendly. All of the dishes were so tasty and we left feeling very full! Such a great authentic experience for such an amazing price!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class. We truly appreciate your beautiful photos you shared and kind review. We are delighted to hear that you had such an amazing time with us.

Your kind words about our chef and our staff mean a lot to us.

Thank you once again, and we hope your journey will be filled with happiness.

reviews.name: Devin Leong
reviews.text:
Amazing cooking experience, from buying of ingredients at their local market to cooking each dish ourselves and feasting on each one of them!

Chef patty was very interactive and engaging as well ! Made the entire cooking class very fun and enjoyable.

Best part was the food was super good, (better than some restaurants back in SG)!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you sincerely for visiting Udomsuk Cooking Class.

We truly appreciate every experience you shared with us here, and we would especially like to thank you once again for your generous compliments toward our chef. Your kind words mean a great deal to all of us.

We hope the delicious food and joyful moments you experienced here will stay with you for a long time. And just like the name of our cooking class, we wish that your journey ahead will always be filled with happiness.

Thank you very much.

title: The Best Thai Cooking Course
ownerDescription:
Established in 2006, The Best Thai Cooking Course offers a unique and intimate experience to unlock the secrets of Thai cuisine.

Nestled outside Chiang Mai, our school boasts professional chefs led by Permpoon, who has over 18 years of experience!

Imagine creating culinary masterpieces in our stunning open-air kitchen, enveloped by the fresh air and breathtaking mountain and rice field views.

Our fun and easy-to-follow classes ensure everyone, from beginners to seasoned cooks, can master delicious dishes.
address: 100 Sanpeesue 01, Tambon San Phi Suea, Muang Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: VXCP+WV San Phi Suea, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Boris Van Severen
reviews.text:
I had a wonderfull time in this cooking class. A friendly and very funny chef who makes probably the best pad Thai I have eaten so far. Very insightful visit to the market and good lessons on traditional Thai cooking.

I did not see the hype around pad Thai, but that's because in most places it is just very dull. In this course, we learned to make pad Thai that Will outclass 90% of restaurants.

The location is a Nice calm farm with view on the Thai country side. Lots of space and a garden full of herbs and vegtables.

reviews.name: Yulia Karavaeva
reviews.text: It was a super fun, entertaining course, I laughed a lot! The food turned out to be extremely delicious, it was a feast!!! I also loved the pre-class stroll through the local food market where the chef told us about local vegetables, herbs and other delicious things. And also the walk through the farm picking vegetables and herbs for the class. The place is beautiful and I enjoyed every moment of the event!

reviews.name: Laura Castellanos
reviews.text: Absolutely, the best Thai cooking course in Chiang Mai. The chef is very charismatic and friendly. We started by visiting the local market, where the chef explained the main ingredients of Thai cuisine. Then we went to the farm to find other ingredients, and finally, we started cooking step by step. It was a fantastic experience in a beautiful place.

reviews.name: Simran Rai
reviews.text: Our group had a phenomenal time at the Best Thai Cooking Course! Chef Perm was dynamic, knowledgeable, and made the entire experience so engaging. We loved visiting the market and learning about each ingredient and its benefits, it gave us a deeper appreciation for the dishes we prepared. The cooking school itself is set in a peaceful, idyllic setting, perfect for enjoying the meal afterward. And the food… absolutely incredible! The mango sticky rice was out of this world and some of the best Thai food we had on our trip. This experience was a true highlight of our time in Chiang Mai, and we’d come back again just for the food. Cannot recommend it highly enough!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Phenomenal! That’s exactly what we love to hear. We’re so glad you enjoyed the journey from the local market to the final bite of that mango sticky rice. 
Thanks for the amazing feedback and for being such an engaging group to teach!

reviews.name: Yana Ackx
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at The Best Thai Cooking Course!
Everything was well aranged. We got picked up by chef Perm at our hotel. My husband and I got lucky: We were the only ones who booked the morning class, so it was just us and the chef.
First we went to a local market where we learned about the different vegetables, fruits and herbs. We picked up all the fresh ingredients and than went to the cooking school.
The environment is beautiful! They have there  own garden where we went to pick out some herbs and flowers.
The class itself went perfect: the instructions were clear, we came out of our comfort zones and laughed a lot with all the jokes from the chef (ask him what came first: the chicken or the egg 😉). We made 5 different dishes, all delicous.
We truly recommand booking this adventure, it was a perfect was to spend our morning!

reviews.name: Angeles Carabantes
reviews.text:
One of the best experiences in Chiang Mai. Amazing recipes, we’ve been to the market first and then we actually got fresh ingredients from his own farm. You’re cooking next to a beautiful scenery.
There’s also organic coloured rainbow mango sticky rice we cooked from scratch. I can’t recommend it more.

reviews.name: Matthew Clark
reviews.text: Chef Perm has a wonderful farm & classroom kitchen. The dishes he had us prepare were quite flavorful & delicious. As a fan of Thai cuisine I recommend this course to anyone wanting to explore Thai cooking

reviews.name: Keaton Cook
reviews.text:
Such a good evening at the cooking class. The food was exceptional and the chef was really knowledgeable. We first went to a local market to learn all about the foods we will be using and other ways to use local produce other then just eating. If you are around this area this is definitely the cooking class to choose.

I also have a severe nut allergy and the chef made sure no one touched any food or equipment I would be using!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a lovely review! We are so glad you felt well-taken care of. Safety is just as important as flavor in our kitchen, so we’re happy you could relax and enjoy the 'exceptional' food. Thank you for the high recommendation to anyone visiting the area!

reviews.name: Timo (Bracchiometrix)
reviews.text: Awesome Experience! Our chef did an excellent job cooking and made funny jokes. We made the evening half-day cooking class with a transfer by the chef himself from Chiang Mai town + a local market tour. Then we went to the well-organized cooking school, picked up some spices from the garden, and started cooking. You can always choose a vegetarian option! Everyone has their own cooking station and utensils. Some ingredients are already prepared or half-prepared and can be added after 2 or 3 cuts to the wok, which makes it a bit quicker to prepare so many dishes. We cooked so many awesome dishes! My personal highlight was the holy basil tofu - everyone who wanted could do a huge fire for this dish, and it was SO delicious!!! I can't believe I cooked it myself. The Pad Thai, the naturally colored rainbow mango sticky rice, papaya salad, various soups, and curry were also awesome! We had a nice group of 7 people and we all had a good time. Can highly recommend and would do it again. The best cooking class! (Hint: my spelling mistakes were corrected by AI.)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you for such an incredible review! I’m so glad you enjoyed the holy basil tofu that 'huge fire' is definitely the highlight of the night, and you did a great job handling the heat! It was a pleasure showing your group around the market and my garden. I’m thrilled you loved the rainbow mango sticky rice as much as I do. Come back and cook with us again anytime!

reviews.name: Hans Boesveld
reviews.text:
Nice experience and a good Chef.
Good to visit the market before to buy the ingredients and to taste some local thing with an explanation.

Only one point of critisism is that us was told that the event would be from 15:00h-18:00h but it became 20:00h so we missed our evening program.
Maybe wrong in the brochure?
I would say, change it in the brochure and donot change the cooking time.

I would for sure recommend this while staying in Chang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks for the recommendation and the feedback! We're happy you liked the market visit and the cooking. 

Our apologies for the class running long; we usually get carried away sharing our love for Thai food! We'll make sure to review our schedule and brochures to prevent this from happening again.

reviews.name: Niklas Erblich
reviews.text:
An amazing experience and a great cooking class. We had the half-day class with Perm, what an amazing Host and teacher! We learned a lot and had a lot of fun doing it.
We started at the market and learned a lot about thai herbs, rice and eggs.
Afterwards we cooked several dishes, some are prepared by everyone for the rest you choose between typical dishes.
We were 2 and cooked: Pad Thai, Paneang, Curries, Tom Yum, Tom Kha, Kha Soi, everybody works together for thai Paste and Perm Shows how to prepare Rainbow Mango sticky rice.
All in all an amazing experience! If you are looking for a great activity with great people and food, Book it 👍👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, what an 'amazing' review! Thank you for sharing all the details about the market tour and the dishes we prepared. We love showing off our local herbs and the secrets to a perfect Pad Thai. It was wonderful to have such a great group working together on the curry pastes. Thanks for the high recommendation

reviews.name: Katerina Fast
reviews.text: We loved the half day cooking class with Perm. He is a a really good and funny host. You get to learn a lot of recipes and get to eat all the food you cook (which is also super delicious). The farm is also beautiful! Would definitely recommend this experience, it was one of our highlights of our Thailand vacation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a great review! Thanks for the kind words about the food and our beautiful farm. We’re so happy we could be a highlight of your trip.

reviews.name: Jessy
reviews.text:
This is called „The Best Thai Cooking Course“ for a reason. Totally lives up to the name. Chef Perm was a very charismatic and talented host and it was super a pleasure to learn from him. This course was a highlight of my Thailand trip!

Everything was super well organized, even when everyone was making a combination of 3 individual dishes. 3 dishes we all made the same (papaya salad, pad thai, colourful mango sticky rice). So we all got to try 6 dishes and it was a lot of food. Everything was super delicious.

Before we went to the studio which was a little out of the city, we went to a local market where Chef Perm explained the different ingredients used in Thai cuisine and how to pick good produce and other ingredients. That was really helpful! After the cooking session we also got a short tour of the organic farm, which was more than beautiful. The studio is really spacious and open and beautiful.

Do not hesitate to book this course!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow, what an incredible review! 
Thank you for the 'do not hesitate' recommendation. 

We take a lot of pride in our spacious studio and organic farm, so we’re thrilled they were a highlight of your trip. 

We’re so glad you enjoyed the 'colorful' mango sticky rice and the whole experience. Happy cooking!

reviews.name: Christine Griffin
reviews.text: Amazing! Market visit was fun and informative, we each got to choose 3 dishes to make, one soup, one curry and one stir fry. We got to walk through the garden to pick fresh herbs & each had our own cooking station! Permpoon, the instructor, was funny and kept things moving! We also got to make our own pad thai and shared preparation of mango sticky rice, curry paste and papaya salad. So much food & all delicious, 5 stars, great experience! Definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
What a wonderful 5-star review! We love that you enjoyed having your own cooking station to really get hands-on with the dishes. From the market visit to picking herbs in our garden, we want our guests to see the whole story of Thai food. Thank you for the high recommendation

we’ll have a wok waiting for you whenever you return to Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Mary Marple
reviews.text: Outstanding class… The owner, Permpoon, picked us up from our hotels on time, he is very charismatic and has a great sense of humour, I did the morning class and it was really fun, great connection with the other students. Highly recommended to get out of the city walls and not too far away to the farm. Thank you so much for being a great teacher.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the kind words! I’m so happy you enjoyed the morning class. I always aim to bring a little humor and energy to the kitchen

cooking is always better when we’re laughing together! 
It was great to see such a strong connection between the students. Thank you for making the short trip out to the farm it was a pleasure being your teacher!

reviews.name: abi anderson
reviews.text:
Great experience, started with a trip to a market where we learnt about all the local ingredients and what they are good for.

Got to choose and cook 3 dishes with demonstrations and contributions on 3 more. All were fantastic in flavour and our host chef was funny and really helpful all the way along. Met a great bunch of people too. As it was the quiet season there was only 8 of us but this made it feel so personal and it was so much fun. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Oscar Southwell
reviews.text:
We had such a fantastic time at The Best Thai Cooking Course! We were picked up directly from our hotel and taken to a local market, where we chose fresh ingredients and got a great insight into local produce. From there, we headed to their cooking school, which even had its own garden – we were able to pick herbs and vegetables ourselves, which made the experience feel so authentic.

The class itself was brilliant. We cooked a wide variety of dishes completely from scratch, using the ingredients from both the market and the garden. Our guide and chef, Pom, was outstanding – super friendly, funny, and incredibly knowledgeable. He explained everything so well, gave helpful tips, and made the whole experience extra fun and memorable.

The whole course lasted around 4 hours and flew by. It was the perfect mix of learning, cooking, and enjoying delicious food. Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Roald Willemsen
reviews.text:
Indeed the best cooking class in Chiang Mai.

Our chef brought us on a lovely tour through the local market and after that we went on a cooking journey to create some of our favourite Thai dishes. Some Curries, soups and stir fried dishes that were amazing. The chef explained everything in English so well. You couldn’t mess it up. We got some free drinks and a lovely tour through the garden with even more information about Thai food and where it comes from.

We cooked and ate all together and it was an amazing experience. I learned so much and enjoyed the whole experience.

Please book this class and enjoy yourself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're delighted you enjoyed the class. It sounds like you had a fantastic time at the market tour and enjoyed learning to cook your favorite Thai dishes. We're glad you found the chef's explanations clear and that you appreciated the garden tour and the communal cooking experience.

reviews.name: Susy
reviews.text: best cooking experience ever. we booked a full day cooking class and got to cook about 12 different foods. we were picked up at our hotel in the morning and chef perm showed us how to shop the ingredients at a local market and then we got to pick fresh ingredients from the own garden at the cooking school. we had so much fun with him, there was no language barrier at all. chef perm explained every step really well. we were so lucky that we were the only ones that day, so we had a “private session”. the food that we cooked was incredibly delicious. 10/10 experience in chiang mai! they even packed up the leftovers for us for later.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are honored to be called your 'best cooking experience ever!' 
Thank you for highlighting the hotel pickup and our garden-to-table process. We aim to make the day as seamless and fun as possible, and we’re thrilled you felt so well-taught. 

Best of luck with your Thai cooking back home!

reviews.name: Heather
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Prompt pick up from hotel, great trip to local market where Perm explained all about the ingredients. The farm was beautiful and fun to harvest further ingredients for our meal. Extensive recipe choices allowing to make many different Thai dishes. Easy to follow steps and Perm ensured everyone was catered for and included. Thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience. Highly recommend whilst visiting Chiang Mai. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
What a lovely review! 
Thank you for the kind words about our organization and the farm. 
We love giving our guests the freedom to choose their favorite dishes, and we’re so glad you enjoyed the process from start to finish.

title: Khongsittha Muay Thai (คงสิทธา)
ownerDescription:
We will teach you how to strike with your 8 limbs - fists, elbows, knees, and legs.

You will learn Muay Thai, the national martial art of Thailand!

Our Muay Thai training packages include:

a. Everything Muay Thai - footwork, striking, defending, clinching, sparring.
b. 2 training sessions per day, morning and afternoon.
c. 6 days of training a week. We rest on Mondays.
d. Unlimited access to group classes.
e. Full accommodation in our boutique resort. All rooms are air-conditioned and come with private showers. Packages include your Check-in date!
f. Optional: Upgrade your training package to include food + gain access to our Guided Meal Plan.
We welcome all experience levels!
address: 23 Sukhonthasawat Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand
plusCode: RJC5+R8 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: François Bonneville
reviews.text: Amazing experience! The atmosphere was fantastic, the setting was beautiful, and everything was perfectly organized. A huge thank you to all the coaches for their dedication, kindness, and energy—they truly made this experience unforgettable. I had such a great time and will keep wonderful memories of it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing your experience at our training camp. We are so pleased that you had a great time and we hope to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.name: Emilie B
reviews.text:
I stayed at Khongsittha Muay Thai for a little over a week and had a truly special experience. What stood out most was the strong sense of community. It’s a warm, welcoming environment where you quickly connect with people from all over the world. In a short time, I made genuine friendships and felt very at home.

The trainers are highly experienced, skilled, and incredibly supportive. You can tell they know exactly what they’re doing and genuinely care about your progress. Whether you’re a beginner or more advanced, it’s a fantastic place for anyone looking for a serious and rewarding fitness experience.

Accommodation is simple but comfortable — it’s an authentic training camp, not a luxury resort, which adds to the charm. Overall, a great experience I’d absolutely recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow! Thank you so much for the kind and detailed review! Our team will really appreciate your feedback, and it has been amazing to have you as part of the KST community. We hope to welcome you back another time!

reviews.name: Abigail VanderPloeg
reviews.text: I trained for two weeks at khongsittha and had the best experience!! The trainers were very accommodating for all skill levels and I got a lot of individualized feedback in group classes (alongside private sessions). The classes outside of Muay Thai (Hyrox and yoga) were also great complements to the training with amazing coaches as well. The community of people taking the class was incredibly welcoming and made it easy to adjust and explore the area with friends. I definitely will come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing to train with us and we are so happy that you had a great experience! It is great to have you as part of our community! See you next time!

reviews.name: Alexandra Costa
reviews.text: I had an amazing week at this Muay Thai camp. The coaches are wonderful and always there to help and support you. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and you get to meet some great people. An experience I highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive review and for training with us! We hope to see you back again soon!

reviews.name: Kristina Grant
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! I learnt so much over just the three days that I spent here! I cannot thank or praise the kru highly enough for their skill and patience with everyone that comes through this gym! The feeling of family is unmatched! Definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Tina we really appreciate it and loved having you around the camp. We hope to see you back for more Muay Thai!

reviews.name: Alif Asyraf
reviews.text: It was a best experience me and my partner training at kongsittha gym. The trainer was all amazing and helpful. They so friendly and supportive. They teach me the proper technique and always taking care of our wellbeing. I would like to come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review. We hope you will come back and train with us again.

reviews.name: Freddy Wm
reviews.text: Had a Muay Thai class here, the trainers were really nice and professional. I just did a single session, and they provided free gloves and hand wraps so you don’t have to bring anything. They even gave us free bananas afterward, what legends! There’s an ice bath too, and jumping in was such a nice recovery. Highly recommend this Muay Thai school if you’re in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind review! We are so happy that you had a great private session. Come back anytime and join in for another round of Muay Thai!

reviews.name: Cornelia Mihai
reviews.text: Since I picked this gym because of the reviews it is only fair to pay it forward . It was a great choice! Everything was straight forward ( from answering emails to accommodating me and refunding my deposit on time so I can check out  super early ) . The best were the coaches and the structure of the classes. They adapt to everyone and every skill level and they have tried to improve my skills from the first class . It doesn't matter if you are there for a day or for 6 months ...you feel noticed and you can tell they care . They also have enough coaches to accommodate big groups and you get a lot out of a group class ! 10 out of 10 !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Amazing! Thank you for taking the time to write your personal experience at our training camp. We appreciate it and really loved having you as part of our sessions. I think we will see you back again soon! Take care.

reviews.name: Maarten Habets
reviews.text:
I had the absolute best time training and staying at Khongsittha.
I had never done Muay Thai before.
Travelling solo for the first time, doing a sport for the first time and staying in a place you have never been can be daunting. But everyone here made it feel like a second home.
The trainers all have so moch knowledge. And they really take the time for you. I'm sure you'll feel really comfortable within 10 minutes. I'm going to miss this place. And if i ever train Mauy thai again, it will be here.
Thanks team Khongsittha! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Maarten! Thank you for your kind words and for the great photo! We loved having you at the training camp. See you next time!

reviews.name: Zachary Stull
reviews.text: I had an amazing time training at Khongsittha. All of the trainers have excellent attention to detail, the facilities are clean and organized. And everyone greets you with a smile. I cannot wait to come back early next year to get a fight in raja. 🙏🙏🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Zach! We look forward to working with you in your fight camp and seeing you back at KST next year!

reviews.name: Neerali Pattni
reviews.text: I had the best time learning the skill of Muay Thai. I’m a complete beginner and so grateful for their patience in my skill development and growth. The trainers are so educational and really invest in your learning. The accommodation is super clean, met my needs and the reception is so welcoming. Great food places near by too! Enjoyed the morning runs! 🫶🏽✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautiful review Neerali!

We’re so happy to hear that you had such a positive first experience learning Muay Thai, especially as a complete beginner. That growth and confidence you build in the early stages is so special, and we’re proud our trainers could support you with patience and care at Khongsittha Muay Thai. Those early sessions (and road running drills) hit different in Bangkok. We’d love to have you back anytime to continue your journey with us! Safe Travels!

reviews.name: Kaiet
reviews.text: I stayed for 4 days. It was amazing experience, i learned a lot. True authentic muay thai. Trainers were so good correcting and teaching me technique. I will come back for sure.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We love hearing this. Even a short stay can create big improvements when the focus is right. We’re glad the trainers could fine-tune your technique and give you that true Muay Thai experience. Next visit, we’ll level it up again! Thank you for sharing this great photo!

reviews.name: Annabel Turner
reviews.text: Booked for only 3 days wished I could have stayed for longer. Had the best time super friendly and helpful staff. Also everyone in the camp super kind and fun. This is a must if you want to learn mauy Thai!!!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Amazing! Thank you for joining our camp for 3 days! Next time come and join us for a month!!! We appreciate the kind review.

reviews.name: Nour Tahya
reviews.text: I only did a 3 days camp but loved every second of it! The coaches were amazing and you could see how they enjoy teaching it. Will definitely be back when I have more time! Highly recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for visiting our training camp and we are so happy you had a great time! Look forward to welcoming you back next time!

reviews.name: Leo Cardin

title: Bkk Muay Thai Store
ownerDescription: BKK Muay Thai is a wholesale and retail store in Bangkok, Thailand, specializing in high-quality Muay Thai equipment. Our store boasts a diverse range of training gear for Muay Thai and MMA, sourced from reputable brands such as Windy, ThaiSmai, Fairtex, Top King, Arwut, Boon, King Pro, Mongol, and K-Brand. Customers are encouraged to peruse our selection to find the ideal gear to suit their needs, and our knowledgeable staff is available to offer guidance and recommendations. What impressed me most was the honesty and professionalism of the team. They didn’t try to oversell anything and instead focused on helping me choose equipment that fit perfectly and suited my training level. Highly recommended for anyone serious about Muay Thai. I’ll definitely be coming back for all my future gear.

reviews.text:
When I went to Thailand for my race, one of the places I really wanted to visit was BKK Muay Thai Store—I had seen them online and knew I had to check it out in person.

The selection was honestly so good, I ended up spending way more time than expected just going through everything. But what really stood out was how helpful and accommodating the staff were. The owner and his wife were incredibly friendly—they helped me pick out gear, try on headgear and shin guards, and even choose shorts. They made the whole experience so easy and enjoyable.

I mentioned that I’d been wanting to visit since seeing them online, and they were kind enough to even give me a small gift with my purchase, which I really appreciated.

They also asked where I was training and even offered to suggest nearby gyms, which was such a nice touch (sadly I was already on my last day).

Definitely a store I’d come back to for all my fight gear needs. Great selection, amazing service, and genuinely kind people.

10/10 would come back 🤍

reviews.text: I had a flawless experience here. The ambience was perfect. My massage was firm as requested, and the service was a 10/10 I've been to many let's Relax Spas in Bangkok, but Chiang mai and especially this branch is my favourite. I'd really reccomend chanone if you want to have a good conversation, and firm massage. Thanks once again let's Relax Spa Chiang Mai One Nimman + team and management.

reviews.name: Cy Hiew
reviews.text:
I had the foot massage, and the overall environment was very comfortable, clean, and relaxing. The therapist who served me was a chubby, lovely young lady. She was very polite, attentive, and gentle throughout the session. Her service was excellent, and I really appreciated her professionalism.

However, my friend had a full-body massage without oil, , and unfortunately, the experience was completely different. The therapist was a slim young lady who had a very unfriendly attitude. She had an unhappy expression throughout the entire session, which made my friend feel uncomfortable. What disappointed us the most was that when she returned my friend's shoes at the end, she even rolled her eyes at us.

The environment and some of the staff are wonderful, but the service quality varies too much between therapists. I hope the management will provide better customer service training so that every customer can enjoy the same level of professionalism and respect.

reviews.name: Andy Rupp
reviews.text: This is my new favorite spa in Chiang Mai. The staff were very professional and the place spotless. I did the 90 min dream package and it was awesome (even got a 10% discount). I liked that I was able to book ahead and pay for everything online. After the treatment they gave me tea and mango sticky rice! Because it was at one nimman, there was ample parking (3 hours free). Will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Marshmallow Melo
reviews.text:
Walked in into this branch for a 120min Thai massage. I paid 1200THB. (If you pre book it’s much cheaper)

I really loved it. The lady was very gentle and seemed professional. There is no language barrier because they will pre communicate with you what areas you want to focus on / to avoid.

The procedure also appears wry hygienic. I read some news before some people got skin issues after going to random massage places. So here I’m very relieved. They would wash your feet before starting to massage which is nice in the sense that this protects both the customer and the worker.

I would come back if I revisit CNX. ;) Recommend to people who values hygiene when doing massage.

reviews.name: J’s Life Bites
reviews.text:
💆Let’s Relax Spa - Chiang Mai One Nimman

The massage was so relaxing that I fell asleep during the service. The staff were professional and friendly.

reviews.name: Juan FRIAS VELATTI
reviews.text:
Reserving a massage here was a significant mistake. While I understand that no service can be perfect year-round, this was, without question, the worst massage I’ve ever experienced—not just in Chiang Mai, but in all of Thailand. We were drawn in by its location in a trendy shopping mall, expecting a high-quality experience, but it turned out to be a huge disappointment.

We reserved a day in advance, even agreeing to an earlier time because they claimed to be fully booked. However, while we were waiting, we saw them taking walk-ins during the time that was supposedly unavailable. This made us suspect they had overbooked, which likely led to the poor quality of service. None of the masseuses seemed to have any strength, energy, or professional training. Having experienced many well-regarded massage places in Chiang Mai, this didn’t even come close to the standard expected of a professional establishment.

On top of that, they completely failed to deliver the one-hour back and shoulder massage we had paid for separately. Instead, the masseuse spent an hour on one leg and rushed through the rest of the body in the remaining two hours. While they did apologize and refund the portion of the service that wasn’t provided, there was no acknowledgment or compensation for the overall mediocre massage. Ultimately, it felt like we wasted three hours of our time on uncoordinated skin rubbing that barely resembled a proper massage.

To make matters worse, this place isn’t cheap. If you’re looking for a genuine Thai massage, there are plenty of far better options in Chiang Mai. Personally, we recommend The Home Massage and Spa. While it may look less luxurious on the outside, it offers far superior service and professionalism, making it a much better choice for your time and money.

-venue is clean and modern , good vibe

reviews.name: Becks
reviews.text:
Avoid this place at all cost! They are a chained brand and we have patronised them in Bangkok a number of times before but to our horror, the service at this particular Chiangmai outlet is so bad that I will never pay premium for it! Lousy service! We walked in to ask for two slots and were told that there wasn’t any slot until the following day at 7pm, so we left the outlet to scout for other alternatives that could provide the massage service immediately but couldn’t find a suitable one and returned to take up the slots for tomorrow.

To our surprise, we overheard them telling a group of 5 pax that there were slots for 90mins massage immediately. So I questioned why the difference in the information? We were told there were no slots but another group came in much later and was told there were slots. If we hadn’t returned to book for the day after, we wouldn’t have overheard this ridiculous discrepancy in information. I asked what could they do and all they could say was “sorry” and that’s it with zero remorse nor service recovery. Such horrible service.

If you do not want to be overwhelmed by bad service and one that prioritises Chinese tourists, then avoid this entirely. Not worth the premium price at all. I am disappointed given how often we patronise this chained spa brand in Bangkok.

reviews.name: holly brown
reviews.text:
I found Aiyaret due to its good reviews and being close to my accommodation. It’s a tucked away off the main road but nice and quiet, I was greeted quickly and calmly and given a menu to look through. I opted for the 90 minute Traditional Thai Massage. I’ve had many thai massages over the years and this one was one of the best I’ve had. I was taken to a room away from the front of the shop and a male masseuse came back in to complete the massage. I sadly didn’t get his name but he was fantastic, regularly checking in with the pressure and if I was ok. I tend to count in my head on painful spots to try and handle as much of the treatment as possible so I get maximum benefit. I only had to stop him once on a tender part of my back. Traditional Thai Massage can be slightly painful especially if you want the treatment to work! I will be a little sore for a few days but the overall benefit is worth it! 🙏🏼
My only comment is i hate a ticking clock in a room, i found is super distracting during my massage but i know it’s there to assist the massage therapist but one with no ticker would be my preference!
Again lovely experience, kind and helpful staff.

reviews.text: Very bad experience. The 4 of us decided to have a Thai massage and only 1/4 were actually satisfied. I spoke to the manager and he refunded half  but it wasn't about the money, it ruined the mood for the evening.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're just upset that you were getting a massage next to your child, but you didn't hear your child tell my staff to stop because it hurt. We're just very suspicious. You said money wasn't important, but you came to my shop shouting for a refund. You said my staff broke your child's leg while massaging them, but instead of taking them to the hospital, you took them to another shop. You should have brought your child to my shop to resolve the issue. You said only one person was satisfied. After the massage, I asked you if it was okay. You said it was very good. Therefore, your words cannot be trusted. If you allow us to release the clip, we can. Destroying us unilaterally is not right.You claimed your child cried after the massage. I'm shocked; your child is 19 years old, not 5. That makes me even more suspicious about how that's possible.You claimed your child asked to stop the massage because it hurt. You were right there, why didn't you hear? But then you accuse my staff of not understanding the language. I am truly disappointed in your family.My staff worked hard, but they weren't paid because you demanded a refund, claiming all three massages were unsatisfactory while only one was good. I'm upset that my staff were so tired from massaging you, only for you to claim they weren't satisfied and demand a refund. Your child only had a cramp, and you didn't give us a chance to explain and resolve the issue. Instead, you used abusive language towards us. You've made our traditional Thai medicine seem worthless. If you have time, you should study the workings of the muscular system, instead of unreasonably blaming others.You claim my store manager refunded half the money. That's a lie. We refunded the full amount because you wanted us to. It was the most despicable act.If you are mature enough, you should come back and apologize to us and take responsibility for the damage you have done to us. We have CCTV footage that can prove we were falsely accused.Cramps are caused by tension in the leg muscles. If the muscles aren't relaxed through massage, they will persist. We are cautious about giving massages because of your requests, as you don't trust us. It's unreasonable to blame us for your child's cramps when problems arise.

reviews.text:
Beautifully clean and good looking establishment here I found after some research online.

I was greeted with a warm smile and offered a cold glass of water with a wet cold towel to cool down with. I then chose a 90 minute aloe vera massage which was great value for only 700 baht in such a good looking place.

I had never had a massage with aloe vera but know it's amazing after getting tanned/burnt in the blistering sun.

The masseuse took me to a clean and relaxed room with the most peaceful thai music playing.

The beginning of the massage was very soft but I presumed it was due to the aloe vera application which was so cooling and almost cold at times but great on the tanned skin. After 10 minutes I mentioned I like the massage very strong from which point I got one of the best massages ever.

It's got to be the best massage in Kata for value to quality for sure.

My massage ended with some delicious thai tea and the friendliest staff.

Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Camper Van
reviews.text:
This was my first traditional Thai massage. I’d looked up what to expect and reviews for where to go- decided to try a temple.
The atmosphere is relaxed, it’s a hall with about 10 mats on the floor, there’s no air con only fans- found this to be fine and cool enough.
I was given a basket of loose clothes to change into and then took my basket with me to my mat.
I would liken the massage to an intense sports massage or treatment from a physio/chiropractor.

Here's a polished review that sounds natural, warm, and appreciative while keeping a touch of literary flair:

TrueThai Wellness Spa is one of those rare places that exceeds expectations from the moment you step inside. The spa itself is absolutely beautiful—peaceful, elegant, and thoughtfully designed. Be sure to take some time to enjoy the inner garden; it’s a little oasis of calm and adds so much to the overall experience.

I booked a full-body massage and facial, and it was nothing short of heavenly. I arrived with tired, heavy legs after days of walking, but after my treatment, they felt incredibly light—as if I were walking on clouds. The difference was remarkable.

A special thank you to Koi, who is truly a magician. Her skill, intuition, and professionalism are exceptional. She seemed to know exactly where every knot and tension point was, and her technique was both powerful and deeply relaxing. It’s rare to come across someone so talented at what they do.

The entire staff deserves praise as well. Everyone was warm, attentive, and genuinely polite. From start to finish, I felt cared for and welcomed. They treat their guests like royalty, but in a sincere and gracious way that never feels forced.

I left deeply impressed by the quality of the treatments, the professionalism of the therapists, and the tranquil beauty of the spa itself. If you're looking for a truly memorable wellness experience in Phuket, TrueThai Wellness Spa is a place I would recommend without hesitation.

The therapist was very professional, attentive and intuitive. I felt completely safe, relaxed and taken care of.
The space itself is absolutely beautiful, with so many thoughtful details, elegant design and a very calming atmosphere.

A special thank you to the owner for creating such an incredible place and for his attention to every detail, quality and guest experience.

I highly recommend True Thai Wellness Spa to anyone who wants a truly deep, beautiful and professional wellness experience in Phuket🙏💖

reviews.text: Enjoyed our foot massage session here. They used a wooden tool to press my pressure points, a fresh experience for me that made me feel relaxed after. An improvement would be to provide a towel / blanket to cover my thighs as I was wearing a dress. Other than that, I enjoyed the massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review. 🤍

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the foot massage and that the wooden pressure point tool gave you a unique and relaxing experience.

Thank you also for your valuable suggestions. Before every foot massage, we gently cleanse and sanitize our guests' feet with a warm towel before beginning the treatment to ensure comfort and hygiene. After the massage, we usually leave a light layer of massage oil on the skin, as many guests enjoy its moisturizing and relaxing benefits. However, we are always happy to clean the feet afterward upon request.

We also appreciate your suggestion about providing a towel or blanket for additional comfort, and we will certainly discuss this with our team as we continue improving our service.

Thank you again for choosing Manee Massage Phuket. We hope to welcome you back on your next visit to Phuket. 🌿✨

reviews.name: Abdul Jabbar Shahnawaz
reviews.text:
We came to this massage parlor based on its high Google ratings, which we mentioned to the staff upon arrival. We requested 1-hour foot massages for both my wife and me, and specifically asked for strong kneading as we had been walking a lot.

The place is immaculately clean, with tasteful interiors and spotless bathrooms — definitely a plus. The massage itself was decent, though the pressure was somewhat inconsistent. At times it felt nice and strong, but at other times it was weaker than I would have liked. I would have appreciated if the masseuse had checked in about the pressure at least once. Because of this, I decided to skip the 60-minute Thai massage I had originally planned.

Overall, it was a good experience. The masseuses were skilled, quiet, and professional, which made the environment calm and relaxing. The pricing is very reasonable, and while the massage didn’t fully meet my expectations in terms of pressure, I would still recommend this place if you're in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your honest and thoughtful review. 🙏
We’re truly grateful you chose to visit us and that you appreciated our clean and calm environment, as well as the professionalism of our team.

We also followed up with the therapist, who mentioned noticing some muscle tension and that you might have been in slight discomfort during the session. She was concerned that applying more pressure might cause pain, so she tried to find a balance. That said, we truly appreciate your feedback and will ensure our team checks in more regularly with guests about pressure levels during the massage.

We hope to welcome you again and have the opportunity to give you an even better experience next time.

From “School-Hater” to “First-in-Class”!

If you had told me two weeks ago that I’d be excited to go to school every day, I wouldn’t have believed you. Back in California, I was never a fan of school—but this place completely changed my mind.

I’m not a professional, just someone who loves massage. In only 9 days, I learned so much: 5 days of Thai Massage, 3 days of Table Thai, and 1 day of Self-Massage.

What really makes this school special is the people.

Kloy, the owner, greets everyone every morning with so much warmth and positive energy—it instantly sets the tone for the day. And my teacher, Nok, was amazing: kind, patient, and extremely professional. She guided me step by step, always making sure I understood the techniques while keeping the classes fun and encouraging.

Coming all the way from California was a long trip, but choosing this school was absolutely worth it. It wasn’t just a class—it was an experience I’ll remember for life.

Thank you, Nok and Kloy!
If you’re deciding between schools, this is the one.

curved walls echo ocean waves, while vibrant sapphire accents embody brilliant maritime hues.

Lose yourself to the soothing tropical breeze and the sound of gently rippling water,
as a pair of healing hands treats you to a traditional Thai massage.

Dear Valued Customer,

We sincerely apologize for any confusion regarding our business hours. Our spa operates according to the hours listed on Google, from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

On the date in question, we were in fact open and still had clients receiving services at the time. However, we experienced an unexpected issue with the air-conditioning system and part of the electrical system inside some treatment rooms. Due to this unforeseen incident, we were temporarily unable to continue providing services during that period.

We updated our status on Google as soon as possible. However, Google updates may take approximately 30 minutes or longer to reflect publicly. The time you visited appears to have coincided with this unexpected situation, which unfortunately was beyond our control and could not have been predicted in advance.

We truly apologize for the inconvenience caused. Should anything similar happen in the future, customers are always welcome to call or stop by to check with us directly, and we would be more than happy to provide clarification immediately.

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope to have the opportunity to serve you again.

reviews.name: Norbertas Ju
reviews.text:
We have tried many massage salons, and around Karon Beach we had already found one good place that we visited regularly. However, today I decided to change the environment and try a massage in a new location. I found this salon based on good reviews and a fairly high rating.

Upon entering, we were greeted by a pleasant aroma. There were three of us, and we all chose a Thai massage. The price was 50 THB higher than in other places, but we decided to give it a try.

We were taken to the 3rd floor, laid down, and a curtain was closed off from the hallway, but we were not separated from each other. As a result, there was too much light. Since this was a walk-through floor, people were constantly passing by, talking loudly, and no one tried to control the noise.

Now to the most concerning part — the massage itself. As mentioned, I chose a Thai massage. The masseuse who worked on me clearly had a cold: her nose was running, and she was constantly sniffing. Honestly, if someone is sick, how is it acceptable for them to have direct physical contact with clients?

As for the massage quality — we have had Thai massages many times before, and this one felt very unprofessional. It was constantly painful, and when I showed facial expressions indicating discomfort, the masseuse simply started laughing. This was extremely unpleasant and disrespectful.

Another serious issue: we came in from outside, and in all other salons our feet are usually washed or at least wiped with a wet towel. Here, nothing was done at all. The masseuse touched dirty feet and then touched the face — this is very unhygienic and unacceptable.

The massage felt rushed, as if it was the end of her shift and she was in a hurry the entire time. There was no care or attention.

In short, all three of us left very dissatisfied — in pain, uncomfortable, and disgusted. The worst part remains the same question: why is a sick person working and having direct physical contact with clients?

My wife and I visited many massage shop during the years because we love massages and the experience.

Our favorite massage shop is NIN Massage in Karon Beach but we go and try other salons as well when they have good reviews.

From the price point NIN Massage is one of the cheapest and offers a great selection and promotion packages.
Even a sauna which is great when combined with a scrub and cream massage.

On every floor and room they offer Western style bathrooms with showers and this time we choose the Thai massage and a foot massage.
You always can take a shower if you want. The cleanness of the shop is high level and Western standards.

The massage ladies are perfect.
Most a bit older but with lots of experience and that’s what matters.
Some not so good in English but yes we are in Thailand and can’t expect everyone to speak fluent English.
If we compare the quality of the massages with other shop NIN is, after more than 10 years of experience in many different shops,our favorite.

Also the fact they have private rooms with showers is a big plus especially when you waxing or do scrubs.

Our daughter loves to go for the hair braids or nails.

So thank you NIN Massage for the high quality of massages and kindness.
The Thai massage and foot massage was high quality again and we feel reborn.
Since I am running a lot I love footmassage and when I have injuries they have a few Masters who can perform healing massages.

Very satisfied customer 😊

reviews.name: yesran
reviews.text:
I came here because the Google reviews were so good that I even took a taxi just to visit.

And honestly, it was absolutely worth the trip.

My mom and I got the full-body oil massage.

They were seriously excellent.
My mom and I were both so satisfied.

It wasn’t the kind of massage where they just go through the motions. They found all the tight, tense spots and worked on them thoroughly. Every sore muscle was treated with exactly the right amount of pressure, and it felt amazing.

I wanted to come back again the very next day, but unfortunately we ran out of time. Highly recommend here!

reviews.name: Don Thompson
reviews.text:
I visited I.SiamLand Massage & Spa 1 in the Pratamnak area for the first time for a couples massage, and we were both extremely impressed.

I had the full-body oil massage, and it was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand in a long time—probably one of my top three massages anywhere. My therapist was excellent and used exactly the right amount of pressure throughout the massage. The staff was also very friendly, attentive, and professional.

My date chose a traditional Thai massage and was equally impressed. When I asked her afterward to rate her massage from 1 to 10, she gave it a 10.

I think this place offers a really nice middle ground for massage in Pattaya and Pratamnak. It’s considerably nicer and more comfortable than many of the small, basic massage shops you find throughout Thailand, but it isn’t trying to be a high-end luxury spa either.

I’ve previously gone to Health Land, which offers more of an upscale, full-service spa atmosphere, but you also pay considerably more for that experience. I.SiamLand gives you a clean, comfortable, professional environment with excellent massage quality at a more reasonable price.

After just one visit, I was impressed enough that this will probably become my new go-to massage place. We were both extremely happy with our experience and will definitely be coming back.

My therapist was highly skilled and attentive, checking the pressure and focusing on problem areas without me even having to say much. The massage combined perfect technique with genuine care, leaving me feeling refreshed, loose, and completely stress-free.

The attention to detail stood out—from the comfortable massage bed to the soothing background music and calming tea served afterward. Prices are very reasonable for the quality of service, and the entire experience felt far above average for the area.

If you’re in Pattaya and want a professional, high-quality massage in a peaceful setting, I highly recommend this place. I’ll definitely be coming back.
