reviews.name: Nora Vale
reviews.text:
Let’s Relax Spa at Porto de Phuket has been one of my favorite spa centers for years. When I lived on the island, I visited several times, and during my recent trip to Phuket I decided to come back.

We booked a 90-minute aroma oil massage for two people. The treatment room was very comfortable and well equipped, with bathrobes, hangers, extra towels, lockers, a sink, and even a private shower where you can freshen up before the massage.

The staff were attentive and welcoming as always. Before the treatment, we were served a relaxing herbal tea, which was a lovely touch.

One thing that disappointed me was that I was convinced they had a steam room. I specifically asked about it and was told twice that this branch does not have one. I may have remembered another location, but it was something I was looking forward to.

The massage itself was very good. I requested strong pressure, and my therapist definitely delivered. Her fingers felt surprisingly strong, and the next day my body felt like I had done an intense workout. Personally, I enjoy deep pressure massage, so that was not a problem for me.

My friend did mention that the towels looked a bit worn and not quite at the level of a five-star hotel. However, considering the constant daily use in a busy spa environment, that did not affect our overall experience.

I also love their retail products. The oils, lotions, and pillow mists smell wonderful. I especially liked the pillow mist and will probably buy it next time. Their signature cookies are also delicious. I always look forward to them, especially the coconut and mango flavors.

The prices are above average, but the facilities, service, and overall experience make it worth it. I will definitely return and still give it 5 stars.

reviews.name: Michael Cogan
reviews.text:
This is an excellent brand and location. The prices are very reasonable especially for how nice the facilities are and compared to the insane pricing of some other massage places around the Laguna area. I really loved the back massage, I asked for firm pressure and the therapist used her whole body weight on me by using her knees and it was absolutely what I needed, really helped get deep into my back muscles. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to get a massage.

My only negative feedback would be that the online booking system kind of sucks. It just shows you times to select from, but doesn’t tell you that those times aren’t available until you’ve filled out everything and click the button to complete the booking. Still, a really minor issue given how great everything else is.

reviews.text:
I love this brand and I have been to their other locations in Bangkok.
So family went here for massage because it’s the closest Let’s Relax to our resort.
First impression was the spa has very nice decor. We were greeted with nice drinks and smiling receptionist.
However the massage wasn’t as good and strong as the ones my family got in Bangkok.
My masseur is a guy who sometimes sighed, then sometimes laughed quietly with the masseur lady next to me. I don’t know why he sighed or what made them feel funny, so I felt uncomfortable and couldn’t relax. Then half of my session he went away for a long time (around 9-10 mins), probably for restroom. I was lying there waiting and I had to ask the other masseur what was going on, where was him. That was quite unprofessional. I often tip my masseurs but I think the service was not sufficient so I didn’t tip this time.
If I went alone I’ll give this place 1 star. My parents had better experience so I still gave 3 stars.
I still love this brand but I think they need better training and management for this location.

reviews.name: Linda Nelina
reviews.text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at this spa and, based on this visit, I would not recommend it.

I arrived exactly at 8:00 p.m. for my appointment. During booking, I had clearly repeated several times that I needed a highly experienced therapist for reflexology foot massage with strong pressure. The first therapist assigned to me could barely apply even medium pressure, and the treatment felt random rather than professional.

After 5 to 7 minutes, I politely asked for a therapist change. This led to around 20 minutes of staff going back and forth, leaving me waiting in the room without any proper resolution. A second therapist was eventually sent, and I clearly asked reception to ensure the treatment would start from the time the new therapist took over. Instead, it seemed the spa intended to count the long delay as part of my massage time.

The second therapist started in a disorganized way, beginning on one foot without properly setting up the treatment.
I once again asked for the session to begin correctly from the beginning. That request was refused, and reception was called again. I was then told they could add only 10 minutes, although by that point around 30 minutes had already been lost, and the back and forth a different staff ladies coming to see me and leaving resumed.

The general manager eventually spoke to me by phone, apologized, and acknowledged that the experience was not acceptable. She said the treatment could finally be restarted from the beginning, but by then about 45 minutes had already been wasted and my evening plans were already spoiled. When I asked for fair compensation for the lost time, this was refused.

In the end, I had to cancel and request reimbursement. I left at around 9:30 p.m. after losing 1.5 hours of my evening. Instead of leaving relaxed and reinvigorated, I left stressed, tired, and with a headache.

What is most concerning is not only the poor initial service, but the inability of the staff and management to solve a simple issue promptly and fairly. Restarting the treatment from the beginning should have been offered immediately, not after prolonged waiting, repeated interruptions, and the loss of most of the evening.

This review reflects my personal experience on that visit. Based on it, I would not return, and I would advise to think carefully before booking if you have specific treatment standards or expect professional handling when something goes wrong.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Let’s Relax Spa. The atmosphere was peaceful, high-end, and tranquil from the moment I arrived. Everything felt very professional and well organized, which made it easy to fully relax. The Thai massage was excellent — wonderfully strong, therapeutic, and exactly what I was hoping for. It was also very affordable, which was a great bonus. I would definitely recommend Let’s Relax Spa to anyone looking for a relaxing and high-quality massage experience.

reviews.text:
We visited Let’s Relax Porto de Phuket twice, and unfortunately, both experiences were disappointing, especially compared to other branches we’ve been to.

While some of the therapists were very skilled, others seemed quite inexperienced. At times, the pressure was inconsistent and difficult to endure, and in some cases even uncomfortable to the point where we ended up with injuries due to excessive pressure in the wrong areas.

The most frustrating issue, however, was the room temperature. The air conditioning was set so cold that we were freezing. Even after repeatedly asking for it to be turned off or adjusted, it was switched back on to a very cold setting. I actually felt unwell afterward and had trouble breathing during the massage because of it.

During our second visit, they at least respected our request regarding the air conditioning, but unfortunately there was a noticeable sewage/toilet smell, which made the experience quite unpleasant.

Additionally, we were disappointed that the usual mango sticky rice, which we had enjoyed at other branches, was not served after the massage.

Overall, we would not return to this location. There is definitely room for improvement.

reviews.name: Prashant “Paddy” Demello
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

I recently visited Kinn Massage in Pattaya after a friend’s recommendation, and overall, it was a very pleasant experience that stands out from many of the massage places in the area.

The first thing that impressed me was the ambiance. The moment you walk through the entrance, you immediately get the feeling that you’re entering a much more premium and luxurious establishment compared to the countless massage shops around Pattaya. The interiors are beautifully designed, clean, well-maintained, and create a calm and relaxing atmosphere. It feels more like a high-end wellness spa than a typical street-side massage shop.

Another aspect I appreciated was that it felt very family-friendly. The environment is professional, comfortable, and suitable for anyone looking for a genuine massage experience without any awkwardness. This makes it a great option for couples, families, or travelers who simply want to relax after a long day of exploring the city.

I opted for a foot massage, and it was good and relaxing. The therapist was professional and attentive, and I left feeling refreshed. While I have had a few massages elsewhere in Pattaya that I would rate similarly or perhaps slightly better in terms of technique, the overall experience at Kinn Massage goes beyond just the massage itself.

What really adds to the premium experience is the attention to detail. The friendly staff made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. I was served welcome tea and cookies, which may seem like a small gesture, but it immediately created a sense of personal care and hospitality. These little touches help distinguish Kinn Massage from many other places and contribute to a more upscale and thoughtful customer experience.

The facility itself is spotless, well-organized, and professionally managed. Everything from the reception area to the treatment spaces reflects quality and attention to detail. You can tell that customer comfort is a priority here.

Overall, I had a very enjoyable visit. While the massage itself was good rather than exceptional, the luxurious ambiance, welcoming staff, complimentary tea and cookies, cleanliness, and overall premium atmosphere make Kinn Massage a place worth visiting. I’m glad I followed my friend’s recommendation and would happily return on my next trip to Pattaya.

reviews.name: Nara Martha
reviews.text: The place is really comfortable, and the staff are professional and friendly. The masseuse (Money) who did my massage was excellent—the pressure was perfect. The tea and biscuits they served afterward were a nice touch and tasted delicious too.

reviews.text: It’s the perfect place to enjoy a quick massage in a relaxing atmosphere at a good price. I ordered a foot massage, but they ended up giving me a shoulder massage as well, which felt great.

reviews.name: Heather Lam
reviews.text: Relaxing atmosphere, kind staff, and affordable prices for the Original Thai Massage over 90 minutes. Came 2 days in a row and received a different but equally pleasant experience for great value.

reviews.text: My sister and I had the package of body scrub, aroma oil massage and facial for 180 mins on our last day in Pattaya and it has been the best massage treatment we’ve ever had 💯 staffs were very professional and they’ll guide you through every steps to make your experience the most comfortable ever! There was also one more staff but we didn’t get her name sadly. They were both very hospitable and their attention to details were on point. Will definitely come back every time we visit Pattaya and will definitely recommend to friends and family! 11/10 rating 🤍

reviews.name: Faii W

reviews.name: Kalpak Nikumbh
reviews.text: The top spa and massage place I've been to! I tried the 4 hands head and foot massage. It was a good experience. The ambience is very stylish and classy. The staff is pleasant and make you feel very welcoming. Go for it!

reviews.text: Kinn is a very nice massage establishment. Decor is great, hence it's a bit more expensive than others. 1 hr Thai massage is 390 baht. They take cards but for extra charge. Otherwise I would recommend it. Maybe a discount could have been offered to compensate the noise and not being able to relax. (or a warning at the reception).

reviews.name: Tiff Lam

reviews.name: Dirk Rottmann

my evaluation is based on her massage-style, which is excellent.
The spa is clean and the staff is very kind and polite. I highly recommend coming here. I am not going anywhere else, why should I when the quality here is so exceptionally awesome. Book a session, relax and enjoy every moment.

reviews.text: We went to Anara after a recommendation from friends. Went in with two bad knees (Annie) and two crooked shoulders. After a week of treatment by Jeab and Kaew felt incredibly improved. Great place with staff who are skillful and caring. Highly recommend

reviews.text: Best massage place in Kamala good and best services they provide. The prices good too ,and the worker are so respectful and helpful, also everywhere is clean that’s so important to me will definitely come to visit again.🙏🏻✨

reviews.name: Lai Teng Cheang
reviews.text: Had an incredible experience here at Anara. We came back to back and tried different massage. Both the Thai massage and foot massage were amazing! The place was spotless and staff were polite. Would definitely recommend and return next time!!

reviews.name: Jasmine Tay
reviews.text: Wished we had found this shop earlier instead only on our last night here. The interior is very clean and decent. Loved the calm ambience and very friendly staffs. Their masseurs are very professional. All three of us, including my young girl, enjoyed their service alot. The owner was very nice, gave us a free bottle of mozzie repellent/after bite balm to try. Highly recommend for families.

reviews.name: Julian Toedter
reviews.text:
We decided to try 60-min oil massages at Anara on our long overdue return trip to Phuket. Very clean and new feeling venue. The staff were really friendly. The fee was 400 baht which is a steal compared to where we come from (do consider tipping them if you're happy with the service as they really do appreciate it!).

Our only gripe was that it was too cold with their air conditioning and  even when they got us more towels to cover us, unfortunately it wasn't enough. If you like a cold room while getting massage, this place will be great. If not, you may want to consider another venue.

reviews.name: Yorch Khruekaew
reviews.text: The service here is truly exceptional, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. They go above and beyond to ensure that every guest feels comfortable and well taken care of. If you have the opportunity to visit, I highly recommend trying the aroma massage. It’s a wonderfully relaxing experience that helps melt away stress, leaving you feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. Definitely a must-try for anyone looking to indulge in some quality relaxation!

reviews.name: Hellen McMaster
reviews.text: Fantastic massage experience, wish I had come on my first day. Very clean, tranquil and professional staff with cold aircon.

reviews.name: Her majesty HM
reviews.text: Fabulous place for massage. The decor is so aesthetically pleasing and soothing. It's new, clean and very beautiful. The seats were gold and The white towel they used to cover us was of such good quality. The elderly masseuse are especially strong and skilled! They do not speak loudly at all. Only whispered to us. Also, they do not use the stick! At the end, we were given ginger tea. And the manager gave us each a bottle of Thai balm as a token of appreciation!The best part was that they only charged us after the massage. Service first! First class! When this place is leaps and bounds above the rest at the same price as the rest, why would we go anywhere else? A real steal!

reviews.name: E M
reviews.text: Had an amazing foot scrub and foot massage here. The lady was lovely and it was the best treatment I’ve received in Thailand. I went back the next day for a full body coconut massage and that was incredible too. Cannot recommend enough

reviews.name: S Kana
reviews.text: This is definitely the best place near Kamala beach for a top rated massage! The place is soo clean and when my husband and I went for a Thai massage they get you to change into their clean clothing and we had our treatment in the covered section for couples. They are very professional and the place has a really relaxed vibe! The prices for what I would consider is a 5 star place charge the same as those on the beachfront which are filthy and I would not use even if you paid me!!! Go here you won’t be disappointed :)

reviews.name: Dina sim
reviews.text: Very nice massage place. Clean and calm. The best in the entire street here! Must try. Masseur is very good. She detect tightness at my right shoulder and spent abit a more time to release the tension.

reviews.name: Nicole Scheidemann
reviews.text: From all the massage places in the street, this one seams to be the cleanest. That’s how we choose it. We were there for foot massage with my family. My husband said, his massage therapist was “out of this world” and he is very picky especially, if it comes to techniques, hygiene etc and thus visit marks his 20th visit to Phuket. Mine was good, so was my sons. Prices are good, it’s clean, staff is very friendly . Will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Aaron C
reviews.text: Best massage in Kamala. Best environment, mood and vibe. The massagers are professional and the front desk lady is very kind and friendly.

reviews.name: Sachien Mittal
reviews.text:
Anara Massage Centre is a fantastic choice for anyone seeking a relaxing and high-quality massage experience. The facility is impeccably clean, and the staff are incredibly friendly and professional. They offer a wide variety of massage services, ensuring there’s something for everyone. After trying a few places in the area, I can confidently say that this was the best experience by far in terms of both service and satisfaction. While the prices may be slightly higher than some other spots, the overall experience makes it well worth it. Highly recommended!

Out of my 4 days stay in phuket we visited them 5 times

reviews.name: Danielle Eugénia
reviews.text: Guided by the claims that this was the best massage parlour in Kamala, maybe Thailand, we came skeptical but we’re honestly impressed beyond our expectations. Two of us got Thai oil massages that were thorough, hard, targeted every limb, if not muscle, and relieved the two of us of persistent neck pains we couldn’t shake for months. The ladies here are polite, very thorough, and definitely a bang for your buck in terms of quality. Can’t recommend this place enough.

reviews.name: Savannah Lageweg
reviews.text: This was one of the best massage experiences i have had! I feel completely relaxed. The salon was super clean and smelled amazingly relaxing. The interior was beautiful and very professional. They were doing some construction work, but it didnt bother me at all. The manager Ana was also very kind. I had a thai massage and it was absolutely perfect.

title: Samadee Yoga Studio Aonang Krabi
ownerDescription:
Samadee Yoga & Retreat Aonang Krabi, for all yoga ethusiasts and spiritual seekers, offers a transformative journey that integrates body, mind, and soul. Nestled amidst the captivating landscape of Ao Nang, Krabi. We invites you to deepen your practice, embrace mindfulness, and find harmony through various yoga styles including Hatha, Vinyasa, Anusaranga, and more. Immerse yourself in an array of experiences, from sunrise and sunset beach yoga sessions to rejuvenating half-day and full-day retreats that combine yoga with spa treatments, nature immersion, and meditation. Immerse in the essence of yoga, embark on a transformative journey of self-discovery, and find your true essence at Samadee Yoga & Retreat Aonang Krabi.

* Advance booking i

reviews.name: dorin lazimi
reviews.text:
I joined the Ashtanga Primary Series class and it was absolutely excellent.

The teacher was very professional, with great energy and a wonderful atmosphere throughout the class. I enjoyed every moment and highly recommend it.

If I weren’t leaving tomorrow, I would definitely sign up for more classes.

Thank you so much! 🙏

reviews.name: Tracey Sullivan
reviews.text:
Sunrise yoga on the beach – perfect for beginners!

I took the sunrise yoga class on the beach and had a wonderful experience. The location was easy to find—a nice, clean, peaceful spot right on the sand.

The instructor (I believe her name was Thani—apologies if I'm misspelling it!) was absolutely lovely. She was gentle and patient, which I really appreciated as a beginner. At the same time, she offered helpful corrections when needed and gently encouraged me to go deeper into poses. She was friendly, welcoming, and her English was excellent (which may be helpful for some travelers, though not essential to me).

I highly recommend Samadee Yoga and will definitely return—both later this trip and on future visits to Krabi.

reviews.name: NADINE S.
reviews.text:
A truly wonderful experience at Samadee Studio, ideally located in the heart of Krabi.
I took part in a mini-retreat, which was the perfect format for a short yet deeply enriching escape.

I was very happy to reconnect with Aerng, whom I had met six years ago at the studio — it felt truly special to meet her again. The yoga and pranayama session she guided was beautiful, gentle, grounding, and full of care and presence.

The relaxing massage was deeply soothing and restorative.

The sound healing session with Punch was a truly magical experience, calming both body and mind.

A genuinely enchanted pause in time.
I wholeheartedly recommend the studio and these two exceptional teachers and therapists. 🌿✨

reviews.name: Renee L
reviews.text: Morning yoga in nature here was amazing. So relaxing and the teacher helped us very well and adjusted our poses to stretch better. She even took photos and helped us take photos and videos of class as we wanted to. We got to do some more advanced poses like bird of paradise and head stands if you wanted and she helped you individually for head stands and gave alternatives for modification if needed. Amazing class!

reviews.name: Ste R.
reviews.text:
I attended an amazing Sunday morning class with Tanny at Aonang Fiore Resort.
On a rooftop next to green palm trees and a quite and calm atmosphere we did Vinyasa and Anusaranga Yoga. (7:30 to 9:00)
Tanny has a very strong and calm presence and thought with confidence. I loved the flow and the challenging arm balances she incorporated.
I could not have started my Sunday better than with this Yoga session. 🙏🏻Thanks Tanny!

reviews.name: Nomadizme
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Samadee yoga ! It's a really nice workout during holiday in Krabi.

Started from yoga in nature at Aonang Fiore Resort and the 90min yoga at Samandee yoga, I was so impressed with the yoga flow and the teachers are very friendly.

They do have one day outdoor retreat and mini retreat throughout the week, please check their website before visit so that you won't miss the retreat.

I will definitely come back for yoga again here.

reviews.name: Thidarat Inchounjiw
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful experience with this Yoga Teacher Training course. The teachers are knowledgeable, supportive, and truly dedicated to guiding every student. The course provides a perfect balance between theory and practice — covering asana, pranayama, philosophy, and teaching methodology. The warm and supportive community made me feel at home and gave me the confidence to share yoga with others. Truly a life-changing journey!

reviews.name: Phoebe Falconer
reviews.text: Found this yoga place after someone had suggested it and was close to our hotel. So glad we went! Our instructor Tanny was incredible. We were 3 girls and we ended up having the studio to ourselves so had a more one on one experience. Tanny was really attentive and supportive, especially as we were beginners. We loved it so much we went back 2 days later and even in just those  two sessions we learnt so much. Tanny was extremely generous with her time so we never felt rushed and we even got a sound bath at the end of both sessions. Afterwards, felt super relaxed and refreshed. Incredible experience. Perfect to escape the hustle and bustle of Ao Nang (and midday heat). Would recommend. Thank you Tanny!! 🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Tzoof Shimshon
reviews.text:
The studio is incredible, offering a wide range of classes both indoors and outdoors, including sunrise and sunset on the beach and nature resorts.
I’ve been practicing yoga and meditation with teacher Tanny for over a year and can confidently say she is one of the best yoga instructors I’ve encountered in recent years, excelling in both physical and spiritual guidance.
The classes are suitable to all levels and are led by exceptionally professional teachers who are genuinely warm and kind.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so Tzoof. You are incredible too. Happy you join us

reviews.name: Caro Sedlak
reviews.text: Tanny is such an awesome teacher, my boyfriend and I went several times to her classes. Can highly recomend when you are in Aonang. ❤️

reviews.name: Joyce Tan
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Samadee yoga studio if you are in Ao Nang! The location is very central, so I could easily walk over from my hotel.
The sound healing session here is amazing. K. Punch is incredibly skillful with the instruments—you can literally hear the sound of waves. The yoga class with K. Tanny was also beautiful and grounding. Her instructions are very steady, and the pace of the flow is just right, neither too fast nor too slow.
As a bonus, the rainy season in Krabi provides the perfect natural white noise for meditation. Definitely check this place out!

reviews.name: Johanna Schulz
reviews.text: The Yoga class was great, I want to recommend it to anyone! Tanny is a great teacher who gives classes for everyone, regardless of their level - beginners and advanced ones. The lesson was fun and Tanny gave great advice and new impulses for my practice at home. Also the location on the beach is great. So far I joined her class twice, for sunrise and sunset and I loved them both. But if you have to choose, pick the one in the morning, it is pretty quiet on the beach, not that warm and just a great start in the day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. Hope to see you again on the mat with us :)

reviews.name: Дарья А.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the anusaranga lesson. A good teacher, nice practice  in a perfect place. I would like to come back! Thank you very much🙏

reviews.name: Mackenzie R
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Samadee Yoga enough. Every class I’ve attended has been an exceptional experience for both my body and my mind. I’ve practiced with a few different instructors here, and each one brings their own unique style—yet every class somehow meets me exactly where I am.

The studio itself is intimate and calming, with nature spilling through the windows in a way that instantly grounds you. Classes weave together meditation, breath work, and flow in perfect balance, creating space to stay fully present and reconnect with your soul.

The owner, Tanny, is a true light. Her warm presence fills the room, and she intuitively tailors her classes to the needs of each student. She brings such energy, compassion, and gentleness that you feel supported from the moment you walk in.

And as a bonus—don’t miss the homemade, family-run cereal bars they sell at the studio. They are so delicious and the perfect post-practice treat.

Samadee Yoga is a place that nourishes you from the inside out. I’m so grateful to have found it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was amazing time during you were here, laught- live- energize-calm. Thank you so much for everything and hope to see you again. Warm welcome at anytime

reviews.name: Diana Picos
reviews.text: I went for a studio session and it was amazing! Not too difficult but still challenging. Tammy did a great job at programming the class to suit my needs and my (non-existent) skills. I will definitely be going back

reviews.name: Amber Ameel
reviews.text: I attended a yoga session on the beach from 7:00 to 8:30, and it was such a relaxing and enjoyable experience. The teacher was incredibly kind and welcoming, and always ready to help. She gently guided me in improving my poses whenever needed, which I really appreciated. The class is adapted to all levels, so it feels comfortable no matter your experience with yoga. Overall, it was a wonderful session that left me feeling calm and refreshed. I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.name: S Hull
reviews.text:
I visited for a drop-in Yoga session.

It was an incredible experience and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

The instructor was extremely knowledgeable and I certainly gained new insights from her Indian training and tried some new shapes.  I loved the traditional style (authentic, not about judgement, true disciple unlike more western experiences now) and found the meditation aspect was extremely special: it was combined with breathing techniques to go deep in to it.

She is a powerful teacher who has certainly been dedicated to practice for many years. I hope to train with her formally in the future.
I highly recommend following your call to Samadee  yoga if it has showed up to you!

With kindness ,,

reviews.name: Karl Heeb (Kryling)
reviews.text:
I had a fabulous experience at Samadee. The Shala is full of good energy and the teachers love what they do, and are always open to questions they bring so much to each session. I had the opportunity to spend 7 lessons there and if i had the chance i would have done 7 more.

I also tried the soundbath, which was the best soundbath i ever had, releasing so much tension and giving my body exactly what it needed.

Thank you, Thank you, Thank you for giving me this experience🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for letting us being a part of your holiday experience. We are happy that you enjoyed. Thank you for your supporting by shopping some shirts.

Hope to have a chance to welcome you again. Good luck through your journey

reviews.name: Beanie Wintringham
reviews.text: I had never done yoga before and my partner suggested we try it. Tanny was so kind and patient teaching us. We had an amazing time. I particularly loved the sunset beach yoga. I will definitely be coming again next time we are in Krabi, Thailand.

reviews.name: Ella
reviews.text: Had the best experience at Samadee yoga!! The instructor was super inclusive and gave great hands on adjustments and verbal cues. The class was challenging but so rewarding. I got to try so many new poses I never would have thought I could do. Must try yoga spot in Krabi!!

reviews.name: Mohammad
reviews.text: For 100 THB day pass, you have all the machines you need on 4 floors. Nice views from upper floor is a bonus. One of my favorite gyms.

reviews.name: Michael McElligott
reviews.text:
Long overdue review…I stayed in Chiang Mai for a month in October of 2024 and came here - I loved it then, and still love it now. I’ve returned to Chiang Mai 3 times since then and always come to this gym when I’m back.

4 floors of equipment, featuring nearly everything you could need for a great workout. I’ve included a picture of the signs displaying the machines that they have, but they have a few extra things on some of the floors as well. The gym is incredibly well-equipped and has a bit of everything. No matter what part of your body you want to exercise, you’ll be able to do it here.

The gym is also air-conditioned and has spray bottles/towels on each floor to clean the machine after use. For the past 6 months I’ve been traveling through SE Asia, and the large majority of gyms I went to had no cleaning equipment and only a series of fans for cooling. So the environment/atmosphere of the gym is definitely a step above most others!

The pricing is quite reasonable as well: a day pass is 100 baht, but a month only costs 1100 baht (as of May 2026). In my experience, for a gym with AC in Thailand with multiple floors and a lot of equipment, this is incredibly cheap. As a bonus point, the staff is quite friendly as well and always give a smile and a “hello” when you enter the gym.

One note: there is a recent review on here that says there is no smith machine. There is definitely a smith machine here, but it has a limited range, with permanent stops which allow the bar to go no lower than about half a meter off the ground. It’s fine for bench pressing, military pressing, and squats, but will be too high for all of you hip-thrust enthusiasts out there.

I cannot recommend this gym enough. It’s got all you need for a great workout, a cool interior, and a super-reasonable price. I joined here even when I was staying about 25 minutes away via walk, because it’s worth the commute. Definitely come here for your workout needs if you’re in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: sofie
reviews.text: It’s a great place if you’re new to Muay Thai. The coaches are very friendly and helpful. They love joking around, but they’re also extremely serious about their job, working almost every day from morning till evening. They even invite students to fun activities like watching Muay Thai matches together or going out for food or drinks. It feels like one big family, you really feel part of a community. I genuinely recommend coming here 🫶

reviews.name: M S
reviews.text: Great gym and 5 stars from me. Not sure why people leaving bad reviews, but I'm glad I wasn't put off by them. It was fairly quiet when I was there and they have machines and weights for a full body workout. Dumbells go up to 40kg, free locker and free WiFi. AC is good and staff are friendly. I paid 100 bht for a day pass.

reviews.name: Thomas Vav
reviews.text:
Cool gym and well equiped with 3-4 floors of different machines.
The staff is very friendly and speaks English.
Daily visit is at 100 baht.
Quite clean, but only problem some foreigners don't wear any clothes on top, which is disrespectful for everyone else.

reviews.name: kristina kuster
reviews.text: I tried muay thai as a beginner and it was a really good experience. My trainer Bank was patient, very skilled and he pushed me just enough. Everything was clean, people were friendly, price was very good (350 bath). I higly recommend this place for gym or muai thai session. 10/10! I will for sure come back to this place.

reviews.name: francois bronchart
reviews.text:
I went here almost every day during the three weeks I stayed in Chiang Mai.
I cannot compare with other Thai gyms but frankly I could'nt have asked for anything else.
100 baht for the day pass, the ac works very well, clean toilets/shower, clean floors and equipment (it is cleaned every day), staff is kind, I liked the music most of the time, and between 7am and 9am there are only a handful of people. I almost never had to wait for some equipment.
Free water and free lockers as well.
Oh and the lights on the ground floor are gorgeous 😍

reviews.name: C A
reviews.text: Amazing muay thai gym! My husband and I came here every morning for class and we had such a blast! Great coaches, very clean, super atmosphere. All the best from Toni and Tona 😄♥️

reviews.name: Shani Levi
reviews.text:
Really nice gym, only 100 baht.

Nice equipment and very clean.

They even offer free towels 😎

reviews.name: Cécile Josse
reviews.text:
I love this Muay Thai gym — the coaches are top-notch, the place is clean, the prices are very reasonable, and there are lots of sessions throughout the day.
Simply ideal!

reviews.name: Mihaela Camelia Sandu
reviews.text: No Smith Mashine, but anyway a good gym. You have Water for Free. I recomand. Good A. For a fast workout IT is perfect.

reviews.name: life passport adv
reviews.text:
All in all, this is relatively small but the equipments are clean.
One time visit costs 100 THB, worth visiting. You will get one small towel to use.
Interesting, Inncome is actually has hostel too, right next to this building. Check it out if you want to stay and look for gym that close with each other, this is for you brother!!!
They have three floors that are used for exercise, each level has toilet as you can see from the picture I shared:).
Unfortunately, the locker is not working well, though many are available, mostly are easily to be unlocked by only light pull. For security reasons, just bring your belongings everywhere you go. Lol.
If you find this helpful, kindly follow my account for more.

reviews.text: Nice gym with 4 floors and good equipment. Price was 100 Baht for one Session. Absolutely great :)

reviews.name: Amit Feldman
reviews.text:
Great gym. 4 floors of machines. 100 baht for 1 entrance. Really recommend.

Small downside they should consider, only one set of each dumbbell. And since most people use 5-15kg you might have to wait to use them.
Besides that everything is great 👍🏽

reviews.name: Oscar Ward
reviews.text: Had a small amount of experience with Mauy Thai before hand but waned to get serious with it. Perfect spot for all levels as it’s small group sessions so beginners get lots of attention whilst most trainers here also fight often so definitely skilled enough to advanced fighters. Feels like a family and the coaches and everyone in Inn-come gym and Mauy Thai are like best friends once you get to know them. They bundle deal makes it incredibly affordable and you can stay next door at the hostel giving you free gym pass. Perfect spot would highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I’m so glad to hear that and We happy to have met you. Thank you for becoming part of our family.

reviews.name: Liam O'shea
reviews.text:
100 baht day pass, clean, not busy when we went 9.30-11.30. A dumbbell section that goes heavy and loads of machines that were well maintained. There was also a separate bench area with one flat and incline.

However the downside is that it's not set up for functional fitness. Only 1 squat rack, no bumper plates or area to deadlift. No free barbells to do any oly lifts. No rig to hang from. The only area to do pull-ups is in everyone's way who will want to use the cable machines. Also they need to change up playlist so not 10 songs on repeat.

reviews.name: Sander van Vliet
reviews.text: Nice gym with sufficient equipment to do most of your workout exercises. I went here only once (80 baht entrance) but didn't get any protein shake afterwards. For a small additional fee you can get a towel too and keep the equipment a bit clean behind.

reviews.name: Joseph Cross
reviews.text: A great gym with 4 floors and everything you need. Clean equipment and great staff with a fridge of products. I’ve been in Chiang Mai for 4 days and come here every day. 100 baht for a day pass i think is very reasonable.

reviews.name: Ryan Brown
reviews.text: 100 baht for a day pass felt like a steal. Nice gym with clean equipment and good air con. Wasn’t at all busy when I visited at midday.

reviews.name: Joseph
reviews.text: Easily the best gym in the area. It's missing a few machines and set ups I would like but that's just a small nitpick. Other then that it has everything you need to get the job done.

title: Fruit Tree Lodge & Coffee Shop
description: Airy bungalows with decks in a laid-back guesthouse featuring a cafe, a yoga studio & free Wi-Fi.
ownerDescription: Fruit Tree Lodge & Coffee Shop consists of 8 Thai style bungalows built up on stilts, in a garden setting. The recently refurbished modern coffee shop located on site, is famous for its breakfast, brunch and delicious homemade cakes and desserts. The food is all vegetarian, with plenty of vegan options.
address: 933, Sala Dan, Ko Lanta District, Krabi 81150, Thailand
plusCode: H2XP+79 Sala Dan, Ko Lanta District, Krabi, Thailand
hotelDescription:
On a road lined with eateries, this laid-back guesthouse is a 4-minute walk from the nearest beach on the Andaman Sea. It's 6 km from Koh Lanta ferry terminal.
 Airy wooden bungalows feature free Wi-Fi, minifridges, fans and mosquito nets, as well as decks, balconies, and en suite, shower-only bathrooms. The bungalows have no air-conditioning or TVs.
 There's a cafe and an open-air yoga studio. Breakfast is available, as is an airport and ferry shuttle service (fee).

reviews.name: Lois McGowan
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few nights and went to the cafe every day for breakfast! The service was amazing and the staff made us feel at home. They went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed. Our room was beautiful, the fan kept it cold and cool and the bed was so comfortable. I would stay here again next week if i could. I loved our stay and would happily return.

reviewContext.Rooms: Clean and very beautiful. Fan keeps it cool and they are raised so no interference.
reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Luxury, Romantic, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value, High-tech

reviews.name: Atanas Petkov
reviews.text: If anyone even dared to state that this is not the best place, than they are super wrong! The staff is just amazing, the food is 10/10 and everything is made with so much care. I brought my wife here for our honeymoon breakfast and we had a great time. The whole team and the owner treated us with kindness like no other place around. I needed to write this comment, seeing how someone tried to ruin the reputation of the place. I found the place on GooGle maps and i am so glad i didnt believe this one lady (many accounts) reviews. I also tho she is very wrong. We will come back every morning! Its a must visit!

reviews.name: Georgina S
reviews.text: What a wonderful place. The owner was so welcoming and the food was so delicious - I had the quiche and then the chocolate peanut butter slice. Both excellent, highly recommend visiting here. For those who are vegan or GF they also have lots of options

reviews.name: Claudia Correa
reviews.text:
Awful service — avoid this place.
The owner was rude, pushy, and incredibly disrespectful from the moment we arrived. I ordered a drink to work for a bit, and he kept insisting we order more food, even though he didn’t know how long we’d stay. He told my dad he “had no brain” right in front of him, and when he noticed I was recording, he suddenly went quiet — clearly aware of how inappropriate he was being.

When we left, he mocked me, saying my drink was amazing and I was going to miss out. Honestly, one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. Don’t waste your time here — there are plenty of nicer cafés that actually respect their customers.

Good coffee,
Good brownie & apple cinnamon cupcake

staff at first said everything on the shelf was vegan, but 3 out of 4 energy balls had honey in them.

reviews.text: This is my favourite place on the island! Bamon is the sweetest, most welcoming man I’ve ever met. I will come back every time I’m in Koh Lanta. The food and coffee is also incredible!

reviews.name: Alina Mykhailova
reviews.text: Lovely café with excellent espresso, refreshing kombucha, and a delicious vegan brownie that’s soft and not overly sweet. Perfect spot to unwind and relax. I’ll definitely be back to try their breakfast!

reviews.name: Christina
reviews.text: My absolute favourite vegan-friendly coffee shop on the island. Lots of choice of vegan and vegetarian sweet and savoury food. Friendly staff, nice atmosphere, chia tea and the best vegan brownies. I'm going to be sad to leave Lanta.

reviews.name: 92alexden
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed in Koh Lanta for a few days at the start of August and we were pleasantly surprised. It was a last minute booking and we were given an amazing bungalow type lodge- all of which are elevated on stilts so you feel very private. Excellent room, very clean and so cheap. The hotel owners could not be anymore accommodating! We felt right at home with the European coffees, pastries and cakes. Good location, would highly recommend. Also the photos of the bungalows were exactly as we found them, contrary to the previous review!! They were great!

reviews.text: This place is so lovely. We came here 3 times already for lunch. The staff is very kind and the food is delicious! Please also try their cakes - we had the chocolate covered dates, biscoff cheesecake and carrot cake… and the protein balls! Highly recommend!

Always greeted with a friendly smile, service here is top draw.

Good coffee and a lot of delicious vegan snacks and drinks. We ordered falafel wrap

reviews.name: Katrina Meshke

reviews.name: Matt Hanselman

My wife loved the home made kombucha as well.  Also facilities are modern and clean.  Great all around

reviews.name: Guy Ivie
reviews.text:
I received a gift voucher for a 90-minute bamboo massage at Nakhon Spa. Upon arrival, I was seated at a window with a lovely view of the city, and offered a selection of fruit drinks to relax a bit before the massage.

To start the session, the very pleasant therapist bathed my feet & calves, and gently salt-scrubbed my feet. After I was on the table, she covered me with a light blanket. She performed warm-up compressions on my legs & back before uncovering sections of my body to apply warm oil. She massaged both with her hands and bamboo sticks, using the pressure I requested. The whole process was so relaxing, I kept drifting off to sleep, so I don't recall everything. I was grateful for the forearm massage; I am a massage therapist, and my forearms are often in need be off attention. I definitely appreciated the firm scalp massage toward the end of the session.

Aftercare included a seat at the window again with a warm shoulder pack (my trapezius muscles are always right) and tea with mango sticky rice.

If you visit Nakhon Spa, rest assured they will take very good care of you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a beautiful and detailed review! 🌿
We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your 90-minute Bamboo Massage experience — from the relaxing welcome to the warm oil and bamboo technique, and even the tea and mango sticky rice finale. Your appreciation means a lot, especially coming from a fellow massage therapist! 💆‍♀️✨

For your next visit, we warmly recommend trying our Signature HydraFacial, one of our most sought-after treatments. It’s a perfect complement to your body massage — blending deep relaxation with advanced skincare technology for radiant, rejuvenated skin. 🌸

We look forward to welcoming you again soon at Nakhon Spa Bangkok for another memorable wellness journey. 💫

reviews.name: minnie takes a break
reviews.text:
I went to Bangkok on July 2nd, and before my 4-day trip ended, I went to Nakhon Spa & Massage for a Thai massage. It was my favorite part of the trip! The spa had a welcoming atmosphere upon arrival, and the receptionist was Filipino! ♡

The service menu shows a minimum of 1.5 hours, but you can ask them for the 1-hour option.

Before the massage, they will lead you to a space where you can sit and enjoy a relaxing view of Bangkok. From where I was, I could see a beautiful park at the bottom, which was topped by skyscrapers and the clear blue sky. It was also very quiet in the spa, and it smelled so good, so it really set a relaxing tone. They also served cold and non-alcoholic refreshments, which makes the experience even more memorable.

The massage therapist assigned to me seemed to be a senior, and she greeted me with warmth and a smile. I asked for hard pressure, which I got from start to end. She did not cut short her massage service, and I appreciated the effort she put into giving me a really great and relaxing massage.

After the massage, they took me back to the relaxing seats with a view and gave me warm tea and mango sticky rice. I sat there savoring the moment with a promise to return here when I come back to Bangkok. Thank you, Nakhon Spa and Massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this beautifully detailed review! We're truly honored to know that your visit to Nakhon Spa & Massage was the highlight of your trip to Bangkok. From the warm welcome and soothing ambiance to the personalized care by our senior therapist, we're delighted that every part of your experience was memorable.

Next time you’re in Bangkok, we highly recommend indulging in our exclusive HydraFacial treatment paired with a Signature Massage. It’s the perfect combination of advanced skincare and deep body relaxation — a true treat for both face and body.

We look forward to welcoming you back and making your next visit even more special! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Ankita Samal
reviews.text:
My sister & I booked the Nakhon Signature Spa package for our last evening together in Bangkok and it has been a relaxing experience after all the hustle & bustle of the city.

While it initially felt little pricey for us, by the time we were done, we found it to be completely worth the cost.

The experience started with refreshing welcome drinks while watching over Bangkok city through the glass windows. We then moved to our room for what was one of the best massage experiences we’ve ever had in the past many visits to Thailand.

🌟Peach & Lek🌟 were our designated masseuse and they took care of us incredibly, considering our comfort, understanding the perfect pressure points for stiff/painful areas. The facial was also absolutely amazing. The products used were of top-notch quality and left no irritation on our rather sensitive skin. The experience ended with a pot of hot tea and some fruits which we enjoyed with a heat bag on our shoulders.

Absolutely loved the experience and will surely return for more! I highly recommend Nakhon Spa for those who wish to be supremely pampered on their trip to Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that the Nakhon Signature Spa package was the perfect way to end your trip, and that 🌟Peach & Lek🌟 took such good care of you.

It’s especially rewarding to know that you found the experience worth every moment, from the welcome drinks to the massage, facial, and final tea service. We’ll be sure to pass along your kind words to the team.

We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok for another relaxing escape.

reviews.name: juhi tulsiani
reviews.text: I had my first massage experience here, and I absolutely loved it! I went for the hot stone massage, and it was incredibly relaxing..just what I needed. The whole place feels so inviting and peaceful from the moment you walk in. Everyone was very professional and attentive, making the experience even better. A special mention to Siri at the reception...she’s such a beautiful and sweet girl, and her warm welcome really set the tone for the visit. I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely feedback! 
We’re thrilled to know that your first massage experience at Nakhon Spa was such a memorable one. The Hot Stone Massage is indeed one of our most soothing treatments — perfect for deep relaxation and melting away stress.

We truly appreciate your kind words about our peaceful atmosphere and professional team, and we’ll be sure to share your compliments with Siri at the reception — she’ll be delighted to know she made your visit extra special.

Your support means the world to us as we continue working hard to keep Nakhon Spa among the Top 10 Best Spas in Bangkok. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another relaxing experience!

reviews.name: Netta Ilany
reviews.text: I got the Thai Royal Facial at this beautiful, high-scale, pampering place and it was absolutely incredible. I was welcomed with a drink of my choice and a warm towel, sat overlooking Benchasiri Park, and filled out a short questionnaire. Then I was ushered into a private room, changed into a robe, and enjoyed one of the most relaxing treatments of my life—so soothing I even fell asleep. Afterward, I was served tea and mango sticky rice and given a cozy shoulder warmer. I left feeling refreshed in both spirit and skin. Highly recommended for anyone looking to relax in style.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautifully written review! We’re truly honored that you chose our spa for your Thai Royal Facial and that the entire experience—from the warm welcome to the tranquil treatment and post-facial treats—left you feeling refreshed and pampered.

Next time you visit, we invite you to try our exclusive HydraFacial treatment paired with a Signature Massage – the perfect fusion of advanced skincare technology and full-body relaxation. It’s the ultimate way to unwind in style.

We can’t wait to welcome you back for another luxurious escape at Nakhon Spa! ✨💆‍♀️🌿

reviews.name: Nana Lim
reviews.text:
Always my favourite place in Bangkok.

My go to therapist is Khun First; she has the best skills and is so friendly and professional that I feel rejuvenated after each massage therapy.  Thank you very much Khun First!

Also, the receptionist here is always super friendly.  Would 100% recommend this place and not other spas.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

On your next visit, we’d love to invite you to experience our exclusive HydraFacial treatments, a best-seller in the USA now available here in Bangkok, for the perfect complement to your massage therapy. 💆‍♀️🌸

reviews.name: YN
reviews.text: Really pleasant experience! Staff are lovely with great massage skills. Will definitely revisit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! We’re delighted that you had such a pleasant experience and appreciated both our team’s warm service and massage skills. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Tian
reviews.text:
I tried the Signature Hydrafacial at Nakhon today, and overall it was a great experience. The atmosphere of the spa — from the calming decoration and soothing scent to the relaxing music and the gorgeous view from the waiting area — made me feel relaxed the moment I stepped inside.

The amenities were great as well, and the receptionist was very warm and welcoming. She clearly explained all the available treatments and the differences between them, which was very helpful.

As for the treatment itself, I personally feel that the Deluxe Hydrafacial might be more worthwhile than the Signature one, so I’d be happy to try that next time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your thoughtful review! 🌸 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the calming atmosphere, warm service, and your Signature HydraFacial experience at Nakhon. Your feedback about the Deluxe HydraFacial is very valuable — it’s one of our most popular treatments as it offers even more personalized boosters and advanced steps for deeper results ✨.

We’d be happy to welcome you back anytime for the Deluxe HydraFacial or even our exclusive Platinum HydraFacial, the ultimate experience loved worldwide and now available here in Bangkok. 🌿💆‍♀️

reviews.name: Ramis Manzoor
reviews.text:
Absolutely one of the best spa experiences I’ve had in Bangkok. From the moment I entered Nakhon Spa, the atmosphere felt peaceful, luxurious, and beautifully designed. The attention to detail, calming ambiance, and professional service made the entire experience unforgettable.

A special thank you to First, who did my aromatherapy massage. Her attitude was incredibly warm, polite, and professional throughout the session. She made me feel comfortable and relaxed from start to finish, and her massage technique was excellent.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a premium spa experience in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere, elegant surroundings, and attentive service at Nakhon Spa. It’s wonderful to hear that First made your aromatherapy massage so comfortable and relaxing with her warm, professional care and excellent technique. We’ll be very happy to share your kind words with her. Thank you for recommending us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another premium spa experience in Bangkok 😊

reviews.name: Malay Non Mi
reviews.text:
My friend brought me and my husband here, and it's one of the best massage experience.

I'm usually allergic to dust and dirty places,  but here my allergy did not act up at all which means the therapy room is kept very clean.

The therapists are also very attentive.

reviews.name: Rafat Al-Turki
reviews.text: Out standing reception with great smile, through explanations of every procedure best sport massage I had in this place with the therapist First. Honestly the best care I had compared to many SPA&wellness
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed your aromatherapy massage with Nana and Boos and that Nakhon Spa was the highlight of your spa visits during the trip. It’s lovely to hear that you also enjoyed the view of Benchasiri Park from our relaxation area. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with both therapists, and we look forward to welcoming you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Anne
reviews.text: I had an amazing and luxurious experience at  Nakhon Spa. I’ve been lucky enough to try different spas around the world but the Nakhon Spa is by far the best. The service is exceptional - from the moment I arrived, the staff are very professional and friendly. My therapist First was brilliant and knowledgeable. I highly reccommend the Platinum Hydrafacial if you want to get rid of your impurities and have a glowing skin, even just after one session. I will definitely come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We are truly honored that, after visiting spas around the world, you consider Nakhon Spa among the very best.

We are delighted that you enjoyed our luxurious atmosphere, professional service, and the expertise of your therapist, First. The Platinum HydraFacial is one of our most popular advanced facial treatments, designed to deeply cleanse impurities, hydrate the skin, and restore a visible, healthy glow from the very first session.

Your recommendation means a great deal to our entire team. We look forward to welcoming you back soon to Nakhon Spa Bangkok, our award-winning spa and facial destination at Emsphere, for another exceptional wellness experience.

reviews.name: Angie Ong
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at this spa! From the moment we arrived, everything was thoughtfully arranged. We were greeted with a refreshing welcome drink, and the staff made us feel relaxed and well taken care of.

We went for a massage focused on treating office syndrome, and the therapists were incredibly skilled — they knew exactly where to work on and adjusted the pressure perfectly. It was both relaxing and therapeutic.

After the massage, we were served a light refreshment which added a lovely finishing touch. But what made it extra special was the surprise anniversary cake arranged by the staff — such a thoughtful gesture that truly made our day.

Overall, this was one of the best spa experiences we’ve had — professional, warm, and far beyond your typical spa visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a genuine, quality experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing such a heartfelt review of your anniversary visit. We are thrilled that every detail, from the welcome drink to the surprise cake, contributed to a memorable experience. Our therapists will be delighted to know their office-syndrome focus and personalized pressure made a meaningful difference, providing both relaxation and therapeutic relief.

Your kind words inspire us to keep refining every aspect of our service. When you return, you might enjoy complementing your massage with our signature HydraFacial for an added boost of hydration and radiance. Whatever you choose, we will prepare the same warm welcome and thoughtful touches that made this visit special.

We look forward to celebrating more milestones with you in the future. Thank you again for recommending us.

reviews.name: Krittapoom In-Muang
reviews.text:
Relaxing and professional from start to finish. I was welcomed to a lovely view and a rose-scented welcome drink that was lightly sweet and refreshing. Before starting, the staff did a consultation about my skin and any allergies. My therapist (First) was gentle, attentive, and respectful of my preference to nap. She let me fully relax, and I woke at the end feeling refreshed after a very comfortable hour.
The price is quite high, but the quality of service makes it worth it. I’d happily return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌸 We’re delighted to know you enjoyed the full experience — from the rose-scented welcome drink and calming view to the personalized consultation and attentive care of our therapist, First. It means a lot to us that you felt completely relaxed and refreshed. ✨

We’d be thrilled to welcome you back again — and next time, we invite you to discover our exclusive HydraFacial treatments, best-sellers in the USA and available here in Bangkok, for an even deeper glow and rejuvenation. 🌿💆‍♀️

title: Perception Blind Massage
ownerDescription:
WhatsApp : +66 82222 5936

Our dark interior design concept is inspired by the disability of the therapists, while still making you feel comfortable, serene and allowing you to sink into the deeper state of relaxation.

reviews.name: Fury Mah Thailand
reviews.text: It's a massage parlor where massages are given by blind masseurs.I tried a Thai massage service, and the blind masseuse was excellent—even better than regular masseuses. The price is reasonable considering it's in the city center, and the massage is of high standard. You can be confident that for this price, you'll receive a massage that will truly relax you. The area is clean and there are private rooms available if you are coming as a couple.Reservations can be made in advance through the website and payments can be made via credit card.The entrance to the shop is quite small and might be a little difficult to spot because there are other restaurants located on the first floor.

reviews.name: Alexandra Lenk
reviews.text:
10 Out of 10 - the people at the blind Thai massage are unbelivable mindfull with every movement of the body and handplacement, staying exactly as long at every bodypart as it's needed there.
I never had a Thaimassage before bc. I don't like being touched by strangers but I can highly recommend this!

It's maybe a little easy to overlook bc. of the smal entrance so I added a picture - it's in the right of the bike and very well signed inside - you'll have to move upstairs to the 2nd foor.

reviews.name: TKP 2020
reviews.text: I tried this massage centre as it's nearby my hotel. My blind male masseur has excellent skills (5-stars)... 90mins of acupressure at head, shoulder and lower back. Similar to chinese tuina experience, but cheap and good. Felt so relax after the session. However, I won't consider this place for aromatherapy as shop is next to road, expect noisy traffic throughout yr session!

reviews.name: Andi Comp
reviews.text:
Fantastic massage at Perception. The massage therapists are blind and skillful. Mine located the tight points and gave me an excellent massage that left me feeling great.
I was greeted warmly and asked about pressure I wanted and any focus areas.  I received just what I'd asked for which I appreciate.  I look forward to visiting again

The entrance is right next to Pimp My Salad. Go and visit, you won't regret it.

reviews.name: Christine Aaron
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience here! The back massage was so great that I went back that same day for a foot massage. The masseuse had such an attention to detail for my aches and pains and I felt like a million bucks walking out of here. Highly highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Upekha Atupola
reviews.text: I highly recommend this massage parlour run by differently-abled  therapists. The massage was professional, relaxing, and clearly delivered by highly skilled staff. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, and it felt great to support a place that provides meaningful employment while offering excellent service. A genuinely rewarding and worthwhile experience.

reviews.name: Bhavesh Jhaveri
reviews.text:
This is the best ever massage i've had
They touch every muscle of yours and heal it. Super strongly recommend

reviews.name: Kevin Voglino
reviews.text:
I had one of the most incredible experiences at Perception Blind Massage in Bangkok—hands down the best foot massage I’ve ever had.

From the moment I sat down, I could tell this was going to be something special. Every movement was intentional, precise, and deeply relaxing. The therapist seemed to understand exactly where my feet needed attention without me saying a word. Every pressure point was carefully worked, every knot eased, and every inch of my feet and lower legs was treated with expert care.

What truly sets this place apart is the attention to detail. They didn’t just go through the motions—every sensory spot was thoughtfully addressed. From the gentle stretching to the firm, targeted pressure, it felt like a full reset for my entire body.

I also really appreciated that you can choose your preferred pressure level—low, medium, or strong. That made a huge difference because the massage was perfectly tailored to what I needed in the moment, and the therapist adjusted seamlessly.

By the end, my feet felt lighter, refreshed, and completely renewed. The atmosphere added to the experience—calm, quiet, and focused—allowing you to fully relax and disconnect.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a foot massage, this is the place to go. No question. I would come back here again and again without hesitation.

Highly, highly recommended.

reviews.name: Justine Rugers
reviews.text: What an amazing place! I had a 90 minute foot massage and it was honestly the best foot massage I have ever had. I’ve had hundreds of foot massages all over Thailand, sometimes multiple times a day. This place wins hands down. The ambience is so lovely with dim lighting, comfortable couches, peaceful sounds. The therapist worked on my whole leg, found every problematic spot I had especially my shins. I have had sore shins for years and have never been able to directly find the problem spots. I left feeling so flexible and pain free! I’m going back tomorrow to do the 90 minute aromatherapy full body massage

reviews.name: Sam Ng
reviews.text: I went on a Monday afternoon and did a 90 mins Thai body message by Red. She is gentle and did a wonderful job to relax my body. I like to come back to support the blind masseuse here. They are doing a decent job to support themselves and their family.

reviews.name: Rajkapoor K
reviews.text: Massuer could be blind but not their senses. Had one of the excellent, simple,effective massage in recent times. Must try if you want a focused, calm and very good massage. The entrance is next to the store, one might miss.

reviews.name: Sinem çakır
reviews.text: We had a Thai massage here and it was really good. The atmosphere was very calm and peaceful. My husband kept saying it was the best massage he’s ever had. The location can be affected by traffic, so make sure to avoid rush hours when planning your visit.

reviews.name: Andres Cima
reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly staff. I had two hours of Thai herbal ball body massage, and felt super relaxed after it. Very clean venue and staff very professional. Definitely coming back again. Great experience! Thank you.

reviews.name: Love Aisinia (樂心)
reviews.text:
This place didn’t just heal my body — it healed my heart. After going through aggressive gaslighting, I somehow found this place by chance, while visiting a nearby restaurant. I felt called to have a massage because of a headache, and as I walked in, I saw the messages written on the stairs. They touched me so deeply — it felt like the universe was speaking directly to me, reminding me that I’m loved and supported. 💫

The massage itself was wonderful — I did a 90-minute head, shoulder, and back session, and honestly wish I had extended it another 30 minutes. The environment is peaceful, clean, and filled with calming energy.
Thank you so much for creating such a beautiful, healing space.

I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Bangkok. ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Customs Broker
reviews.text:
I really liked this place. They're true masters of their craft. I had a wonderful experience with a Thai massage from Iaa, performed in complete darkness. The massage was truly excellent—you could feel the experience, attentiveness, and confident hands. They worked on my tension, and I felt lighter afterward.
I'm glad I came here, and I'd be happy to come back. I highly recommend it 👍

reviews.name: Vanessa Markos
reviews.text: We just finished a session at Perception and honestly it was great! The massage was a really good mix of actual massage and stretching which is exactly what I needed. The therapist was super kind and respectful, and they definitely knew what they were doing—they found all the spots that needed extra work without me even saying anything! Getting tea at the end was a nice touch too. I felt comfortable at all times and really enjoyed it. The best massage I have ever received so far. I feel very relaxed and at peace right now. Definitely worth it to come by!

reviews.name: Sandra E
reviews.text: I have been twice there now, each time massaged by Yha. It is the best Thai massage I have ever received and when you pay for 90mins you really get 90mins.  The receptionist, who is seeing, leads the blind/visually impaired masseuse to the massage bed and confirms with you again the type of massage you booked. After the massage you get a hot cup of tea. I will definitely be back again! The massages are high quality and it is equally amazing that this shop offers work to visually impaired people who might otherwise have problems finding jobs due to their condition.

reviews.name: Amie Leavitt
reviews.text: This was the most amazing experience I've had on my round the world trip. I absolutely loved supporting this community and got the best massage of my life. I'll always dream of this place in the future when I think of my time in Bangkok. Come here... You won't regret it! ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: michael peiris
reviews.text: One of the best ever massages I’ve had. This place is awesome if you have body pains or issues within your back shoulder calf’s etc. The place is clean and very professional. A must try if you’re in Bangkok.

reviews.name: alika masei
reviews.text: Wonderful experience and would definitely go back again. The staff were very friendly. Phi and Tom were amazing! The stretched and massaged our bodies, finding areas that we didn’t even know needed work on. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting or local to Thailand who wants a good massage.

reviews.name: harrietta willett
reviews.text: Myself and my two boys, aged 5 and 8 have recently started at forever Muay Thai and we really love it! All the trainers and staff are lovely and brilliant with the kids, very friendly people. The classes are good fun and at a reasonable price. We are really enjoying our time with these guys, would 100% recommend 👍
