It means a lot to know that our trainers and staff have made you all feel welcome and that the kids are enjoying the classes too. We truly appreciate your kind words, your support, and your recommendation. We’re so glad to have your family with us and look forward to many more fun sessions together!  See you all at the fight night tonight!🙏🥊

reviews.name: Jeremy Brinkerhoff
reviews.text: What a great experience! My son and I were visiting Thailand and wanted to try Muay Thai. It's hard to believe this class was completely free. Not only was the instruction great, but they provided hand wraps and boxing gloves for brand new students. The instructors were knowledgeable and friendly. Due to the smaller class size, a good portion of the instruction was given one-on-one. The class started on time and the instructors dove right in. Class length was excellent at 90 minutes which provided plenty of time for warm up, cool down and to hit stuff. 😆
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Jeremy! We’re really happy you and your son had such a great first Muay Thai experience with us. We’re glad you enjoyed the coaching, smaller class size, and all the training time. Hope to see you both again! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Grace L
reviews.text:
This place seems like a great place to learn Muay Thai properly! The coaches are excellent, and I think both kids and adults will really enjoy training here.

Some of the coaches are champions themselves, which makes the training even more impressive. If you're interested in learning Muay Thai, I would definitely recommend this place! 💪🥊

reviews.name: Htet Htet Latt
reviews.text: ​I tried Muay Thai class here today as a beginner for the first time and had a great experience. They offered a free trial session and that push me to start. The trainers are very smart, professional, and patient with newcomers. Owner is also very friendlly to trainers and trainees. I will be back definitely.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Htet Htet Latt! We’re so glad you had a great first Muay Thai experience with us. It’s wonderful to hear that our free trial gave you the push to start, and that our trainers made you feel supported, comfortable, and confident as a beginner. Your kind words about our team and gym atmosphere truly mean a lot to us. We can’t wait to welcome you back for more training soon! 🙏

reviews.name: 격투기 탐구생활
reviews.text: There are ONE Championship fighters and trainers here, and the female manager is incredibly kind. I’m really happy to have a gym like this so close to my home. It’s a great environment to train in. 😊

reviews.name: Stella Yau
reviews.text: We love the Forever Muay Thai community! Love that they offer one free trial if it is your first time. You really get a taste of it first before deciding if you want to commit. We signed up for the 10 sessions (3000b total) and go once a week. We love that they keep the class small so you basically get 1:1 training with the trainers. And since different trainers have different styles, you also get to rotate and learn different techniques. All their trainers are patient and amazing! When we can, we would go watch and support/cheer on some of the trainers (by day) who fight by night. They have 4 trainers now, Khruu Bank, Khruu Joe, Khruu Chat, and the newest Khruu Go. The owners, Peier and TookTook are super friendly too. It's a great community! We get a crazy workout that's fun with amazing people!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Stella!
We’re incredibly happy to hear how much you enjoy being part of the Forever Muay Thai community. It means a lot to us that you noticed the care we put into small class sizes, diverse coaching styles, and building a welcoming atmosphere. Huge thanks for supporting our trainers both in the gym and at their fights – they truly appreciate it! We’re lucky to have amazing people like you training with us. See you again soon! 💪🥊😊

reviews.name: Madeleine Ross
reviews.text: Love this gym so much, truly unique in its community feel, expertise of coaches, care of the owners took took and per, convenient/clean facilities, nice offerings and great prices… I’ve only been doing classes there for about a month but already feel like a valued part of the community. Even in busy group classes the coaches take time to work individually with us and to help achieve our goals and constantly improve. It’s also been so fun to meet new people at the gym and attend the fights that the coaches have in town and events that the gym hosts like a songkran party. Love Forever Muay Thai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Madeleine, for your wonderful and thoughtful review! It truly means a lot to hear that you feel the unique community spirit of the gym and have already felt like a valued part of it after just one month. We’re so happy that you’ve enjoyed the coaching, the care from Took Took and Per, the clean and convenient facilities, and the overall atmosphere we work hard to create. It also means a lot to hear that even in busy group classes, you still feel supported individually and able to keep improving toward your goals. We’re really glad you’ve enjoyed meeting new people, joining the events, and being part of the wider gym community as well. Thank you again for your kind words and support — we absolutely love having you at Forever Muay Thai! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: BaiFern Sirinart
reviews.text:
Great Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai⚠️

👍🏻The trainers are friendly, professional, and easy to understand—perfect for beginners.
First class is free, the gym is clean, and 🚗 parking is available.

Convenient location on the main road, close to Chiang Mai Airport🛬.
👧🏻👦🏻Kids can train here, and the trainers speak multiple languages.

The owner is very kind and welcoming.

If you visit Chiang Mai, Forever Muay Thai is a must❗️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a detailed and thoughtful review, BaiFern! 🌟

We are thrilled that you enjoyed the training and found our location near the airport convenient. We take great pride in keeping a clean space and making sure Muay Thai is accessible to everyone—from absolute beginners to the little warriors in our kids' classes! 👧🏻👦🏻

It was a pleasure having you with us, and we truly appreciate the recommendation. Hope to see you back at Forever Muay Thai very soon! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Maryyah Trodep
reviews.text:
I've always wanted to take a muay thai class so as I was visiting a friend who frequent this gym, she suggested I try out Forever Muay Thai so I thought I give it a try - plus the first session is free!. Did not regret it! The coaches were all very friendly and patient! They took their time teaching me and I got a good workout in.

I came back the next day for another session and I felt like I learned so much in only two days! Not to mention, I was very sore (in the best way possible!) the following days haha. If you're around the area, I would HIGHLY recommend this gym!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Maryyah! We’re so happy you gave Muay Thai a try with us and enjoyed your first sessions. It means a lot to hear that our coaches made you feel supported and that you learned so much in just two days. Thank you for your kind words and recommendation — we hope to welcome you back again soon! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: SASANAT
reviews.text: I wish I could give this Muay Thai gym 100 stars, but unfortunately, I can only give 5! It truly feels like my second home. The owner and trainers are not only kind and funny, but also worldclass champions skilled, strong, and inspiring. Every session is filled with positive energy and great training. I’m so impressed with this place. Come and try it you’ll fall in love with it too!❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you so much, Sasanat! Your kind words truly mean the world to us. We're thrilled to hear that you feel at home here, and we're so proud that our team has made such a positive impact on your training experience. It's an honor to have you as part of our gym, and we can’t wait to see you continue growing and thriving. Thank you for recommending us – we look forward to seeing you again soon! ❤️🥊

reviews.name: Matthew Poh
reviews.text: Great work out and instructors. Professional and engaging. They will teach you to the best of their abilities(: really happy and will come back again definitely. High recommend. Do check out if you are in the area.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Matthew! We’re really happy you enjoyed the workout and our coaches. It means a lot to hear that you found the training professional and engaging. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to seeing you again! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Mill Nana
reviews.text: Good experience. The coaches really care about every student and provide great personal attention.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Mill! We’re really happy you had a good experience and felt the personal attention from our coaches. Hope to see you again soon! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Steve Yung
reviews.text: The trainers here are competent and friendly.  I work out so well and have a lot of fun at the same time. They have a nice cafe, many drinks in the fridge and they provide free water and ice.  Super cool!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks a lot, Steve!
We’re so glad to hear you’re having fun and getting a great workout at the same time. Our coaches and café crew will be happy to hear your feedback too! Looking forward to seeing you again soon – stay cool! 💪😄

reviews.name: Chanelle Laruelle
reviews.text: I just visited this new Muay Thai club and I totally recommend it ! Everyone is so friendly, the coaches and the owner too ! It fits every levels, and also perfect for beginners. It’s definitely one of the best in Chiang Mai ! 🥊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the fantastic review, Chanelle! We're thrilled to hear you had a great experience with us. We strive to create a welcoming atmosphere for everyone, whether you're just starting out or have experience in Muay Thai. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and we're proud to be considered one of the best in Chiang Mai! We hope to see you again soon for more training – keep up the great work! 🥊😊

reviews.name: Jordan Norgate (LordJordNorg)
reviews.text:
Forever Muay Thai is hands down one of the best gyms I’ve ever trained at.

The trainers are outstanding — knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping you improve. Whether you’re brand new to Muay Thai or more advanced, they go above and beyond to make sure you understand the fundamentals properly while also pushing you to the next level.

What really sets this gym apart is the community. From day one, it feels welcoming and inclusive, with a great atmosphere and people who support each other rather than compete in unhealthy ways.

The owners deserve a special mention — they truly care. They take the time to make everyone feel welcome, supported, and part of the gym family, which makes a massive difference, especially if you’re new or training abroad.

If you’re looking for high-quality training, great vibes, and a gym that actually gives a damn about its members, Forever Muay Thai is the place. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Jordan, thank you so much for this incredible review. It honestly means the world to us to hear that you felt that level of support and care! 🙏✨

We’ve worked hard to build a space where the 'ego' stays outside and the 'family' stays inside. Knowing that our trainers' dedication and the welcoming vibe of the community made such a difference for you is exactly why we do what we do. 🥊❤️

You've been a great addition to the Forever Muay Thai family, and we’re so glad you chose to train with us while abroad. We can't wait to see you back on the mats for another session soon! 👊🔥

reviews.name: JT R
reviews.text:
Great Experience
Forever Muay Thai is a gym with a fantastic atmosphere, whether you are a novice looking to improve your fitness or a serious fighter in prep. Catering to all ages, skill and fitness levels
5/5 stars
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We’re really happy you enjoyed the atmosphere and found the gym welcoming for all ages and skill levels. We truly appreciate your 5-star review and support! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Dr. Sandra Gewalt
reviews.text:
PERFECT TRAINING!!

It is super safe, clean, all equipment is provided to you without extra costs.

After training, I continued training by myself, using the weights provided and the skipping rope.
Today, I had an amazing muay thai personal training.
The trainers are super skilled and so friendly!! They explain the techniques professionally, in very good English and with patience.
I can fully recommend the muay thai gym.

Come, have fun, and feel like family.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the wonderful review, Dr. Sandra! 🌟🙏

We are thrilled that you enjoyed your Personal Training session and felt at home in our gym. We believe that professional technique and a 'family' atmosphere go hand-in-hand, so it’s great to hear that our trainers' skills and English made your experience seamless! 🥊✨

We’re also glad you made use of the extra equipment—we want our students to feel they have everything they need to reach their goals. It was a pleasure having you at Forever Muay Thai, and we can't wait to see you back for another round! 👊🔥

reviews.name: mauricio paez
reviews.text: Amazing Muay Thai gym! The trainers are very professional, and you can communicate in English without any problem. I highly recommend this gym for both beginners and experienced fighters 💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Mauricio! We’re glad you enjoyed the training, our professional coaches, and the friendly atmosphere at the gym. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to see you back again soon! 🙏🥊

reviews.name: Ms Betty Trieu
reviews.text: Attentive and fun teachers! I brought my 5yo to see if they have classes for small kids, but since he doesn’t meet the weight requirement he was unable to participate. Staff still made him feel welcome and engaged him in a fun and caring way. They were not annoyed that he was curious and exploring around. I was taken care of since it was my first experience and I hadn’t exercised in years. As a beginner, I got a nice sweat out of the drills - I will come back for sure!👍🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this wonderful feedback, Ms. Betty! 🌟🙏

We truly enjoyed having both you and your son at the gym. While we have to keep safety first regarding age and weight requirements, we always want our space to feel like home for the little ones! We're so glad he felt welcome to explore and stay curious. 👦✨

Also, a huge congratulations on getting that 'first sweat' in after a break! It takes courage to start again, and we are honored you chose us for your first experience. You did great, and we’ll be right here to support you when you come back for more! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Danny Chou
reviews.text: If you’re in the Chiang Mai area and interested in learning Muay Thai as a beginner, this is definitely a place worth checking out. The instructors are patient, knowledgeable, and great at breaking down techniques in a way that’s easy to understand, making it a welcoming environment for newcomers. Not to mention, free trial for first time
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Danny! We’re really happy to hear that you found the gym welcoming and beginner friendly. It means a lot to know that our instructors helped make the techniques easy to understand and gave you a positive first experience with Muay Thai. We truly appreciate your kind words and thank you as well for mentioning the free trial. We hope to welcome you back again soon! 🙏🥊

title: Let's Relax Spa - Central World
subTitle: เล็ทส์ รีแลกซ์ สปา เซ็นทรัลเวิลด์
ownerDescription: Leisure Space, 2nd floor
address: ห้องเลขที่ D203, D205, ชั้น 2, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
street: ห้องเลขที่ D203, D205, ชั้น 2
plusCode: PGWQ+P9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Antepli
reviews.text:
Our experience was excellent from start to finish. Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted and shown to a comfortable seating area with cosy chairs. We were offered a cold towel and a refreshing detox drink, while fresh coconut water was also available as a self-service option.

Our sandals were taken away and replaced with comfortable spa slippers before we were escorted to the treatment room. The experience began with a relaxing foot soak in warm water using fragrant spa products. Our feet were then gently washed and dried with a soft towel.

The spa was exceptionally clean, luxurious, and peaceful, creating a very relaxing atmosphere. All of the staff were warm, welcoming, and professional throughout our visit.

We then enjoyed a 30-minute foot massage in a large, comfortable reclining chair. The ambience was calm and soothing, making it easy to unwind. Afterwards, we were taken to another treatment room where we received a further one-hour back and shoulder massage on comfortable floor mattresses.

Our therapist regularly checked that the massage pressure was comfortable and adjusted it whenever needed, which we really appreciated. The service felt personalised and attentive throughout.

Overall, we had a wonderful 90-minute spa experience. The treatments were relaxing, the facilities were spotless, and the staff provided excellent service. We would definitely recommend this spa to anyone looking for a high-quality massage experience, and we would happily return again.

reviews.name: Angela W
reviews.text:
I visited Let’s Relax on my last day in Bangkok, and it was absolutely amazing. The spa has a clean shower facility for guests to freshen up before the massage, and the room itself was spacious enough to accommodate couples if needed.

My therapist was very professional, and her medium‑strength aroma oil massage was exactly what I needed after a stressful work meeting. She managed to loosen so much tension in my shoulders and back. Before the session, I was given disposable underwear, a hair cover, and even a hairbrush — thoughtful touches that made the experience feel very organised and comfortable.

After the massage, they served mango sticky rice and a cup of hot tea, which was such a lovely way to end the session. I walked out feeling refreshed, relaxed, and completely rejuvenated.

Highly recommended to anyone visiting Bangkok.

reviews.name: P Lim
reviews.text:
In my experience, Let’s Relax outlets tend to be a hit-or-miss. We have had good experiences at this branch before, but unfortunately, this visit was disappointing.

We booked and fully paid for our appointments online a week in advance and specifically requested male therapists for our foot, neck, and back massages.

Upon arrival, we were informed that only one male therapist was available. However, when we pointed out that we had not been notified of this beforehand, the staff quickly changed their response and said they could provide two male therapists after all. This inconsistency was frustrating and left us feeling annoyed from the start.

To make matters worse, the reception staff communicated the wrong massage duration to the therapists. When we checked with the therapists to confirm the length of our sessions, they appeared confused, likely because they had other appointments scheduled afterward. They had to return to the reception desk to verify the booking details, which further disrupted the experience.

Another surprise was the absence of the digital tablets/iPads that had previously been used for guests to indicate areas to focus on or avoid during the massage. This felt like a step backward in service.

Overall, the visit felt poorly managed, with a lack of coordination between the reception staff and therapists. It certainly wasn’t the relaxing experience we had expected.

As for the massage itself, it was decent. However, the hot pad placed under our necks during the foot massage had an unpleasant odor, which raised concerns about quality control and hygiene standards.

reviews.name: Trần Sơn
reviews.text: I booked a voucher via Pelago for the Central World branch, and from the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the welcoming staff who greeted me with refreshing tea and a clean towel. I opted for the 120-minute Thai Body Massage, and it was worth every penny. It did wonders for my stiff muscles, providing deep relief and total relaxation for my tired arms and legs. To top it all off, they served a delicious portion of mango sticky rice after the session, even though it was quite late. A truly high-quality experience you shouldn't miss when in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Ana Timoshina
reviews.text: The WORST service possible. No navigation in the mall except for one arrow facing the wall. Literally. I spent half an hour roaming around and the number for the spa was just out of service. I used to love Let’s relax. Probably need to find another spa which price ambition would match the service level. And the manager of the place is amazing. She said she was sorry like five times. And then she said I had no booking with them but they miraculously can find a slot for me. No thank you. Any street massage shop is better than this. It’s a shame. Avoid this branch. Not worth it. The star manager that kept saying sorry and it’s ok is the one in black jacket. I am not ok. Not even close. 😟

reviews.name: Bec C.
reviews.text:
The massage felt totally professional! I booked a heavenly relax plan. For first 120 minutes, I had a Thai massage first then came with hot herbals compress, that's a prefect match. The last 45 minutes was finished by foot reflexology. I felt completely relaxing and comfortable all the times. I have to shout out, my massage lady, Saowalak. Keep on your amazing work.
In addition, I just walked in and got an appointment within reasonable time (60 mins) on a normal weekday. The reception staff are friendly and proactive to offer information how to select the plans as there are varieties of different massage plans. You can book it in advance online as well. I highly recommend this place to anyone who visits to Thailand.

reviews.name: Gigi_JDP
reviews.text: i had the chance to get a massage here with my husband. The atmosphere in the shop was peaceful and quiet. The receptionist was polite and friendly. The massage therapist was skilled and knew exactly the right pressure points. My husband really enjoyed it. And most importantly, the mango sticky rice was delicious!

reviews.name: Dragonia T
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful time at Let’s relax spa. The masseuse did a great job with gentle care. She asked about my shoulder pain and was attentive when applying pressure around that area. Thank you so much.

Highly recommend to make a reservation in advance as it gets fully booked quickly.

reviews.name: Thach Uyen
reviews.text:
Space 5/5
Food 5/5
Technique 4/5
Professional 5/5.
Must Booking bofore going.Always fully booked
Entering the Spa, there is a very pleasant scent. The lighting in the room can be adjusted to be most comfortable. I used the Thai Massage service. Compass Herbal 120 minutes. After the treatment, I still felt that it was not enough, something was missing. Professional service, you will have your feet washed separately before the massage, the staff will take your slippers away for you. The Thai mango sticky rice served after the treatment is very delicious.

reviews.name: Steven Teo
reviews.text:
This is a nice spa and massage place. The staff is quite nice and the place is very spacious.

The only issue is the Aircon in the massage room is very very cold.

reviews.name: Janina T
reviews.text: Great spa experience for great prices but the only thing I’d like to mention is that I prefer the hot oil massage at urban retreat, only because they do it a little bit differently. The experience of the hot oil is consistent unlike the one here where it’s just hot for a few seconds and proceeds to be a regular massage. But I really appreciate the mango sticky rice at the end and the kind service in general. Thank you! Would still be back again.

reviews.name: Nour A.
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the experience. Three hours of pampering, relaxation, and self-care. I got a package at a good price, and the therapist who assisted me was professional, experienced, and very skilled her name was Rungnapha.

—- I had severe stomach pain for hours after eating their mango sticky rice!!!

reviews.name: Evelyn C.
reviews.text:
I was 15 mins early. My masseuse was late (past appointment time) to pick me up, when other guests who arrived after me already went in.
During the massage, she started by having me facing up (which was odd, usually face-down). She used only knuckles repeatedly on the same spot on my thighs. I asked her to alternate between spots, but then, she rushed to finish the entire massage within 50 mins.
This masseuse clearly needed training, though she was obviously senior (at least 50 yrs old). She couldn’t properly follow the muscles of the back, as she randomly stroked through.
The safe in the room couldn’t be locked.
Would not recommend.

reviews.name: Mint
reviews.text:
My experience at this spa started off on the wrong foot. The reservation process at the counter a day before was very stressful, as slots filled up within minutes while we were still deciding on a package. This created unnecessary pressure.

To make matters worse, the receptionist we dealt with was unprofessional and quite rude. Our group of five arrived 10-15 minutes late, which was admittedly our fault. I was asked to make full payment (offset 1000B deposit), then we were rushed and told that our reservation would be canceled if the rest of our group didn’t arrive within three minutes. After all this, we still waited another 10 minutes, apparently, she claimed that the masseurs were preparing the room—even though it was shortly after opening hours.

This behavior was uncalled for and left us feeling upset even before the session began. Unfortunately, I couldn’t identify the receptionist as she didn’t have a visible name tag, but she was slightly plump and spoke very loudly.

That said, the therapists were excellent. My therapist, Pranom, provided a calming and skilled massage that helped salvage the experience. The body massage skills here are genuinely commendable.

However, the unpleasant booking and welcoming process has left us unsure about returning. The spa could greatly benefit from improving its customer service at the reception to match the exceptional standards of its therapy services.

reviews.name: Dr. Reviews
reviews.text:
Slightly on the pricier side but a good place for a 2hr massage.

Located in Central World and access is via the shop selling Nike .

The face wipe towel provided at the start of the massage was icy cold.  The welcome drink could have been more refreshing.

The mango sticky rice dessert was good.  The tea provided at the end of the massage was so diluted.

reviews.name: Maybelle Adela
reviews.text:
I’ve visited this outlet every time I’m in Bangkok since I stay above the mall at Centara Grand at CentralWorld, and the location is especially convenient when traveling with my young toddler. It’s clearly a popular branch, and I understand that slots are often fully booked.

What prompted me to leave this review was my disappointing experience with the manager on duty (wearing a black jacket, no name tag) on the night of 3 May.

My 10pm massage started late at 10:25pm and ended around 11:30pm. After that, I tried to book another session for 4 May at 10pm, but the manager declined with reasons that felt inconsistent. First, she said, “You can see at 10pm the shutter is down,” which was confusing since the stated operating hours are until 12am & I just completed my massage scheduled at 10pm. When I questioned this, she then said they were fully booked.

I then asked about bookings for 5 and 6 May at 10pm, and she immediately said those were also full. The responses felt dismissive and unclear, as though excuses were being made rather than giving a proper explanation. Her attitude, mainly nodding and smirking, made the interaction even more unpleasant.

One of the staff beside her seemed willing to help and even suggested I could make the 10pm booking, but she was repeatedly overruled by the manager.

I understand that Let’s Relax is a well-known and busy spa brand in Bangkok, but service standards, especially from someone in a managerial role, SHOULD be better. In contrast, my experience at the Central Park outlet was much more professional. I hope management reviews this outlet’s service standards, particularly the attitude and professionalism of this manager. on duty with no name tag on.

reviews.name: Jan
reviews.text:
This is the best massage I've been to ever. Booked the heavenly relax massage from Centralworld Let's relax through Klook.
The space is clean, spacious, service is superb and the masseuse skill is soooo awesome. The aches from walking and the neck relied with peppermint smell really intrigued my senses totally. I have to say this is so wonderful that I'm planning for the next trip here already!

reviews.name: Fatimaa
reviews.text:
The center is luxurious and well-known, with several branches.
However, I faced some difficulty booking an appointment. I tried to schedule a session multiple times at different branches but couldn’t find a suitable slot.
I hope the management can improve the booking process and also consider providing private rooms for Muslim women.
I was interested in trying the foot massage service, but it is currently in a mixed area, and there are no separate rooms for ladies.
Private rooms are only available for full-body massages.

reviews.name: Kee
reviews.text: We had Aromatic hot stone massage for 90mins. Sincerely feel really good! The hot stone temperature is just nice that makes our body very relaxing. Very good for people who has cold body.

reviews.name: Bangkok Stray dog
reviews.text: Great spa. The therapist is very polite and professional. I've done a two hour Thai massage with hot herbal compress which is super relaxing. The massage was done in a private room. After the massage there was a complimentary mango sticky rice with hot tea. Lovely experience!

title: Let's Relax Spa - The Allez Sukhumvit 13
subTitle: เล็ทส์ รีแลกซ์ สปา ดิ อัลเล่ซ์ สุขุมวิท 13
address: ชั้น 3 HYATT REGENCY Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: ชั้น 3 HYATT REGENCY Soi Sukhumvit 13
plusCode: PHQ4+XP Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: H Lee
reviews.text: Easy access location, a few minutes from Nana station, right next to the Hyatt Regency hotel. On a busy street but quiet away from the crowds. This place is very clean. It feels peaceful and comfortable. The therapist’s technique is very professional and even cured the dizziness I had from the stress of flying. I came here almost every day of my stay in Bangkok to try different types of massage.  I like massage and have been to massage in different countries. This is definitely one of the best.

reviews.name: kenny goh
reviews.text:
Great massage here. Came in as a walk-in customer without prior reservations. Masseuse definitely was able to apply good pressure but was mindful of my request to go easy on one of my toes.

Opted for the dream package massage but felt like the foot massage was too short to really enjoy it. If you're getting similar package, consider extending it another 30mins or so.

Would definitely recommend and would come again if staying in this area.

reviews.name: Kedmanee Chaisorn
reviews.text: I had a wonderful massage experience and was impressed with every step. The receptionist was attentive and very polite. They took care of me from start to finish. The mango sticky rice was delicious. Let’s Relax Spa has never disappointed me — highly recommended!

reviews.name: Linda Mkwanazi
reviews.text: Incredible service from all staff members. The spa is very modern and meticulously maintained. We didn't book and were lucky enough to find availability for a traditional Thai massage. It lasted two hours and we came out feeling so refreshed. They give you complimentary welcome drinks and a mango snack with green tea after your message.

reviews.name: Samer Ullah
reviews.text:
Immaculate massage. Went in with my wife - had a spot as soon as we walked in (around 2:30pm). I had recently sustained an ankle injury through MMA fighting, but they were extremely courteous and delicate with my ankle and provided an excellent massage.

Opted for the back and shoulder 1 hour @ 750THB, which is pricier than the average, but it’s definitely worth the premium.

Once the massage had finished, they gave me a hot towel for my ankle which topped off the experience.

Will definitely be back. I’ve travelled all corners of the world seeking massages and have yet come across a spa that compares with Balinese ones, that is until now.

Khapkhoon ka let’s relax spa!

reviews.name: Doreen Prasad
reviews.text: My cousin and I got a full spirit spa package. The overall experience was really good. The scrub was just the right pressure. The massage was also good. The products for the aromatherapy was good. I highly recommend this place. The only reason I gave a 4 out of 5 is because there should be a separate toilet for ladies because the facilities I used had a smell or was it because I went to the spa at 9pm. The therapist had a scolding tone like a teacher maybe I was her last client for the day but she did a good a job. They also serve you sticky mango rice which was yum.

reviews.name: Jessica Lee
reviews.text: I went there twice on our first day in Bangkok. The price is very respectable for the service and facilities. The front desk is also very friendly and helpful. The mango and coconut sticky rice dessert after the massage is a big plus too.

reviews.name: Y Satoshi
reviews.text:
The atmosphere was nice. The other branch near the hotel was fully booked, so I came to this location instead. On Saturday afternoon, there were few customers.
With this type of spa, satisfaction depends on the massage therapist, but I was very satisfied. It was easy to book through the website, and the prices were quite reasonable. I would definitely return.

reviews.name: Aaron Crawford
reviews.text: The best massage I’ve ever had. Lets relax Spa is incredible, when i come back to Bangkok, I’ll be back for more!

reviews.name: Georg S.
reviews.text:
It was a great experience for me. I chose a 30 Minute back massage, started off with a cold refreshment juice and refreshment towel, continued to a foot bath and then on to the Thai back massage including herbs and balsam. The experience finished with a hot cup of tea.
I joined them on a weekday at 6PM without appointment but did not have to wait more than a few minutes. You should though account for 50 minutes overall if you don’t want to rush it.

reviews.name: Clara Tey
reviews.text: Let’s Relax is my go to massage place in Bangkok for a relaxing and spa massage. I feel well rested and treated with tender loving care whenever I’m here. For my package, I purchased through klook and made a reservation via email to them. Once you arrived, you’ll receive a welcome drink and towel while you choose your massage oil. Escorted to your own rooms, there’s a safe and bath robes. If you aroma massage, they’ll wipe it off using hot towel and you can choose to shower after. You’ll also be served with mango sticky rice and tea after the massage. Enjoyable experience 💯💯

reviews.name: Mohamed AlAli
reviews.text: This branch is undoubtedly one of the best in the entire Let's Relax Spa chain. From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was soothing and welcoming. The therapists were highly skilled, delivering a massage that left me feeling completely rejuvenated. Every detail, from the calming decor to the exceptional service, contributed to an unforgettable spa experience.

reviews.name: Siqiang Yang
reviews.text: I went at 10am as its first guest. Very quiet and pleasant. Service is great. Massage is very comfortable and relaxing. Love the idea of providing a small snack after the massage.

reviews.name: distic li
reviews.text: Such a good relaxing moment here I would recommend to all my friends. Firstly, the location is so easy to access by BTS sky train as it’s connected to the skywalk from. Personally, I find the interior vibe is quite calm and chill, also the massage is really good so that my office syndrome could be more relieved. (you can just make a reservation and specify the name “Kade”, she’s a professional one.) Moreover, their staffs’ service mind is very impressive beyond my expectation.

reviews.name: David Donton
reviews.text:
Good, clean.
The seat in front of the reception can be bigger and more comfortable. Too small, too shallow, NOT good for customers to sit and wait.

reviews.name: ADB
reviews.text:
What an awful, horrendous massage experience!

I ended up with neck pain and bruises the following day! My neck was so stiff that I couldn’t even turn my head to either side. The masseuse I had seemed amateur—just because I asked for a firm massage, she dug her thumbs and elbows hard into the wrong points most of the time. At one point, I even flinched while she worked on my left leg and neck! Also, she didn’t follow the indicated focus points.

I didn’t feel the full pain immediately because my pain tolerance is high, but now that I’m back from my holiday, I need to see a physio to relieve my neck pain.

Let’s Relax, please train your staff properly and at least maintain basic massage standards. If you already have standards in place, ensure all your staff follow them. I’ve had massages at Let’s Relax in Hua Hin and Phuket, and they were amazing—this branch was by far the worst massage I’ve ever had! Suffering a neck injury and bruises was not a pleasant way to end my holiday.

This branch’s high rating comes from staff pressuring guests to leave positive reviews in exchange for small gifts like essential oil roll-ons. They even hover around to make sure you don’t give them a bad rating! Paying USD 80 for a massage at this branch was absolutely not worth it.

reviews.name: Sven Jan Dienel
reviews.text: receptionist was inatentive and rude. this was not a language barrier issue. the staff have developed an attitude against toursits even though tourists are the ones actually putting food on their table and a roof over their heads

reviews.name: Juliana Lin
reviews.text:
A very disappointing massage experience and a complete waste of 1,200 THB.

The soundproofing was extremely poor, and many people around were coughing. The therapist who massaged me was also coughing constantly, which made the whole experience uncomfortable and unhygienic.

The massage itself was not professional. Some movements were so light that they felt more like touching rather than an actual massage. At times, she simply pressed on my back for nearly a full minute without any movement. Even worse, she fell asleep several times while leaning on my back.

There are many much better massage places nearby. I will definitely not return.

For comparison, Makkha Health & Spa Bangkok (Asok) is slightly more expensive but absolutely worth the price.

reviews.name: Jen Lau
reviews.text: My husband and I both had the worst massages we have ever experienced. We’ve been to Bangkok so many times and we always go to Let’s Relax and have tried their different locations. Both the masseuses we had were so lazy and did not do a good job - my neck hurt even more after I left. My husband said that it was even painful at times because she did not know what she was doing (and he is able to take hard pressure, so that wasn’t it) Super disappointed, I guess it’s hit or miss here. The reception staff was very nice though. Sadly, I will never come back again.

reviews.name: Andrew Whitlock
reviews.text:
Excellent service and value for money for a premium massage experience. I had a really good aromatherapy massage and the staff were all lovely.

The tea and mango sticky rice post massage is a nice touch.

title: P's Thai Massage 1
ownerDescription: Traditional Original Thai Massage.
address: 5/9 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHR3+86 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: anubhav dubey
reviews.text:
Sweet people but..
1. They took us to 5th floor (NO Lift)
2. It was too hot ( AC took 15 minutes to cool down)
3. We were 4 people and no one felt good at massage
4. They charged good amount and at last asked for the TIP .
5. No Music ( i used my own mobile to play one for me)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear anubhav dubey,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your visit did not fully meet your expectations.

On that day, our shop was unusually busy, which is why your group was accommodated on the upper floor. We understand that this may not have been ideal, and we appreciate your patience.

Regarding the room temperature, the air conditioning needed some time to cool the room due to the very hot weather conditions at the time. We also apologize for the delay with the music, which was later corrected during your session.

We would also like to clarify that tipping at our shop is always completely optional.

While we understand that massage preferences can vary from person to person, we always do our best to ensure our guests are comfortable and satisfied during their visit.

Thank you again for your feedback.

reviews.name: brian leong
reviews.text: The massuer totally no strength. Feel like apply oil and rubbing the skin only. After the oily "rubbing" session, I asked for hot towel to clean off the oil, the massuer asked for 200baht!!! Getting worse everytime I visit. Initially was good but the standard keep dropping. Definitely will not come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear brian leong,

Thank you for your feedback.

We are sorry to hear that your recent visit did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that the 200 Baht mentioned during your visit was not a charge for a hot towel. During the session, you requested an additional 30 minutes of massage, and the extra 200 Baht referred to this optional extension. You ultimately chose not to continue with the additional time.

We would also like to note that our oil massage is designed to provide a relaxing and soothing experience and differs from traditional Thai massage, which typically involves stronger pressure and stretching techniques. Guests who prefer firmer pressure are always welcome to let their therapist know during the session so adjustments can be made where possible.

We appreciate your previous visits and thank you for taking the time to share your comments.

reviews.name: Nguyen Thuy
reviews.text:
A very professional Massage shop. You will choose service and pay in advance.
An adult woman did for me, and a man did for my husband. Both of them have very good technique for Thai Massage.
No requirement for Tips. But I tip them for our satisfaction. Highly Recommendation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nguyen Thuy,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review and for sharing your experience. We’re very happy to hear that you found our shop professional and that you and your husband both enjoyed the Thai massage and the techniques of our therapists. Your kind recommendation truly means a lot to us. We hope to welcome you again on your next visit 😊

reviews.name: Swathy Viswa
reviews.text:
Ni 111 did awesome massage !!!! Relaxing and rejuvenating experience—my feet felt instantly lighter and tension melted away.
Professional service with the perfect balance of pressure, leaving me completely refreshed.. Thank you Ni
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Swathy Viswa,
Thank you so much for your amazing 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you had such a relaxing and refreshing experience and that the massage helped relieve your tension and leave you feeling rejuvenated. Your thoughtful feedback truly means a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Antony Robertson
reviews.text: This hidden gem surprised me with the best massage of my life. Definitely depends on who you get. I was lucky enough to be paired with the best body reader I've ever met. I'll definitely be returning
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Antony Robertson,

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!
We’re delighted to hear that your visit was such a great experience and that the massage exceeded your expectations.

We appreciate your kind words and are happy to know you’ll be returning.
We look forward to welcoming you again soon. 🙏💛

reviews.name: Glenn
reviews.text:
HIT THE JACKPOT ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
Unbelievable massage. It's incredibly hard to find a legit massage, let alone one that you feel goes above and beyond. I chose a foot and neck massage for 400 baht. Definitely worth every dollar and more. Massages are hands for the health and she really took care of those kinks and sore spots to correct them.
My masseuse's name was Toy (No. 108) if you wanted to ask for someone in particular. Considering the minefield of massage places along the street, you would be very wise to choose this one.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Glenn, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. We hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: anand dubey
reviews.text: For an exceptional foot massage, request Chai (ID: 82). Renowned for his expert techniques and attentive service, Chai is the top choice for those seeking a truly rejuvenating experience. While he specializes in therapeutic massage, guests prioritizing skill over gender will find his sessions unmatched. Book with confidence for outstanding results!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear anand dubey, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Edy Salt
reviews.text: Pop was fantastic.  Truly traditional Thai massage.  I've had maybe 50 to 100 massages in my life and this ranks in the top two! and this was determined within 10 minutes of him starting.  He found muscles I didn't even know I had and fixed them.  This chain is exceedingly excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Edy Salt,
Thank you very much for your incredible 5-star review! We’re truly honored to hear that your massage ranks among the top experiences you’ve ever had. Your detailed feedback and kind words mean a lot to our entire team. We’re very happy you enjoyed the traditional Thai massage and look forward to welcoming you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Sangram Thorat
reviews.text: Excellent service and very polite staff. Best for Thai traditional massage for pain relief and relaxation. They have very good understanding and experience about pressure points and technique.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sangram Thorat,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re very happy to hear that you enjoyed the service and found our team polite and professional. It’s great to know that the traditional Thai massage and techniques helped with relaxation and pain relief. Your kind feedback truly means a lot to us. We hope to welcome you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Hercules
reviews.text: Went there at 10am last Thursday with friend. Had a shoulder massage from Soda (No 59). Suggested balm and was very good in getting rid of issue areas by massaging out kinks. Was very happy with results on my shoulders. Will be back soon for same.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Hercules, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Mehrunnisa Moosani
reviews.text:
I have done foot massage & full body massage at P’s thai. They are professionals.
I have done massages with  Miss Hnoi. She is the best ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mehrunnisa Moosani,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re very happy to hear that you enjoyed both the foot and full body massage and found our service professional. Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you again soon 😊

reviews.name: Joey
reviews.text: Fun #69 was very good. She did a great foot massage for me
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Joey,
Thank you very much for your wonderful 5-star review! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the foot massage and had such a positive experience with us. Your kind feedback is greatly appreciated and means a lot to our team.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: paum
reviews.text: Paid 300baht for 60mins foot massage. The service was ok, price reasonable. Massage was good, environment was good and chill. Skill was good. Soda Offerred drink (water) was good gesture for my dry throat. Appreciated that
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear paum, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Suparat Larsson
reviews.text:
My husband and I took 1 hour foot massage. The price was 300B per person, which is pretty cheap, considering the quality of massage that we got.

It was really good. The lady do my leg so gentle, slow with right pressure. They know what to do. We fall asleep right away.

One star taken sadly because the guy next to me chose to do manicure. And it was noisy. The staffs who sitting outside was also talking loudly.
But overall I’m happy, and definitely coming back, preferably second floor where the cool air hits.

reviews.name: HIROE HARA
reviews.text:
Jenny #79 was the best
This place is very reasonable and amazing job!!! I never expected this job but it was more than that 💯
I was there for 3 days in Bangkok stay at the JW marriott. Every single night I request Jenny who has a great job! Very high recommendation. I we I’ll definitely come back again!
Thank you Jenny
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear HIROE HARA, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Aeysha ferdous
reviews.text:
I always come here whenever I am in Thailand. They have 3 outlets in this area and all of them give top notch service. No noise, calming environment and the masseuse always understands the requirements.
Highly recommended for those who want quality massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Aeysha ferdous, thank you very much for your comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Hamad 213, thank you very much for your nice comment and the five-star recommendation, which we greatly appreciate. we hope to see you again soon. 🙏 We secure each individual item left behind by our customers and return them to the respective owners. Glad your watch didn't get lost.

reviews.name: Ews
reviews.text: The lady is nice.. 1 foot message 1 hour 300 baht.. she put pressure when she wanted to.. the massage is overall very relaxing.. I recommend if this place is your only option.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Ews, thank you for your comment and four stars recommendation, we hope to see you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: Vadakam Sowmya
reviews.text: Best ever massage. I have got a traditional Thai massage and pho did a great job. It was money very well spent. Loved it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: H Yusoff

(통로쪽 포레스트는 저희와 상관없는 업체입니다. 예약시나 차량 부르실 때 꼭 주의해 주세요. 감사합니다)
address: 44 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
plusCode: PGFM+MV Bangkok, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text: 예약은 카톡으로 편하게 하세요

reviews.name: Anna Sokolova
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this massage shop. When I came with the severe pain in my back, they managed to reduce my pain. I have office syndrome and this is where I feel very relieved. Also, the foot massage is so good in most of the cases.

And my special treatment when I visit this massage shop is the ginger cat 🧡 Such an adorable creature. Cat never comes to you if you don’t call it. I memorized the name and cat recognized me. So adorable

reviews.name: Zhen
reviews.text:
This is my go-to massage place every time I’m in the area. Hands down one of the best casual massage places at this price point (and I’ve tried many). You never have to wait. The space is simple and calming. If you are lucky, you’ll see one of their cats hanging around. Please note, I can only speak up foot massage there since that’s what I always go for. Their staff has good technique and understands enough English to adjust to my feedback.

Update: I went back a few more times and tried other massages, including Thai, Aroma, and Anti-stress. They do not disappoint! I really can’t recommend Forest enough!

reviews.name: Le voyageur Nantais Christian Ray
reviews.text:
I had a very good massage ( cream massage- 2 hours) with Oat. Very professional and speaking a quite good English.
The place is quiet and clean, comfortable.

reviews.name: Paul Chay
reviews.text:
This Massage place was conveniently jus down the road from my hotel. The price was very reasonable and they accepted walk-ins. I HAD THE BEST MASSAGE EVER!!!!

The masseuse was very meticulous in applying her technique and it soothed all my aches away!!!

I will definitely come back again when I am in Bangkok again!!!!

And the cats...... they are so cute and adorable!!!

reviews.name: nathan anand
reviews.text:
The lady who gave me a foot massage was excellent but the rest of the staff were very loud .

The toilet is too crammed on the ground floor.

The young receptionist also wasn't very welcoming. I wouldn't return here . There are are plenty of far better options in silom

reviews.name: Sawyer
reviews.text: I've tried many massage parlours in Bangkok, but this one is the most professional I've done. The masseur know what he did. I said upfront that I have a pain inside my arm since a few days. He took the time with me and focused on my arm. Not only my arm, but my whole body got treated with great accuracy. I would recommend to come here.

reviews.name: Анна Кузнецова
reviews.text:
Mr. Kan is an exceptional Thai massage therapist whose work goes far beyond a standard massage and feels more like deep body therapy.

Both my husband and I visit him regularly, and each session is a flawless combination of strength, precision, and intuitive understanding of the body. He has an impressive ability to locate areas of tension and work on them deeply and effectively, delivering results that are immediately noticeable and long-lasting.

His technique is confident, refined, and truly professional. At the same time, he is highly attentive and sensitive to the client’s condition, creating a sense of complete trust, comfort, and relaxation.

After each session with Mr. Kan, the body feels light, restored, and free of tension, while the overall state is similar to a full reset.

He is a rare specialist you want to return to again and again. We confidently recommend him to anyone who values a high level of quality and real results.

reviews.name: Tadd Wun
reviews.text: Went there for 3 nights consecutively. Had the best of my massage there. Reasonably priced, quiet with experienced masseuses. I chanced upon Pi Sak who did a great job! Without saying, he knew where’s my problem and was able to fix it without feeling sore the next day n which was why I could returned consecutively for 3 nights! 🤣

reviews.name: Krisztian P
reviews.text:
Visited the Spa based on reviews and it did not disappoint.
Friendly welcome, clean environment. Competitive prices (1hr foor massage+1hr oil massage for 850Bht). My masseur was very professional with great hands, clearly educated on massage techniques.
Great find.

reviews.name: Muna R.
reviews.text:
Great place. Good people, friendly, strong hands. 300 for 1hr foot massage. Nice, soft, dim yellow lights, a hint of aromatherapy, and gentle spa music.

I think it's worth it 💯 just for the cats! There are several cuties who let you pet them. It's like a cat parlor. Love it.

Also, I didn't notice any bad smells. It was just scented oils and whatever perfume they put in their water humidifier. Very pleasant

reviews.name: jordon Lee
reviews.text:
I’ve been to many massages before and I would expect the same or similar techniques used. Unfortunately, the masseuse only massaged my foot and not even the calf/thigh area thoroughly. Although he had good strength and pressure it still wasn’t the most satisfying. As previous reviews state 5 stars, I wouldn’t rate it that high.

I sat by the window and it’s quite bright outside, the windows aren’t blackened and there weren’t any curtains. Above the chair by the window, there were also black mild by the AC which is a health hazard.

350 for a foot massage (literally just foot) 🤣

But it was close by so I thought I’d try!

reviews.name: ardana neswari
reviews.text: The top review that pops up on Google says "the masseuse  rolled me like dough..." and I immediately visited the place 😂 They accept walk-in customer, which is great! I arrived at 9 PM with knotted muscles in my whole body. I chose the 1 hour thai massage + 1 hour oil massage (2 hrs total), and dear lord, rolled like a dough I was 😂 My masseuse completely untangled those knotted muscles. I made all sorts of noises bcs of how good it was, and the lady laughed happily 😂 the price is reasonable, the place is cozy, and the cats are the cutest! Totally recommend it 🩷🩷🩷

reviews.name: Benoît Landreville
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with the Thai massage. The atmosphere was calming from the moment I walked in, with relaxing music and a soothing scent in the air. The therapist was professional, attentive to my needs, and used just the right amount of pressure. I felt my muscles loosen up and all the tension melt away. After the session, I left feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and re-energized. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic relaxation and relief!

reviews.name: Chung Daniel
reviews.text: Used to visit this massage place during visit. Found the smell of the place is not so good. Prolly the molded mixed with cat smell. The massage was ok. Foot massage is 300/hr

reviews.name: YJ Shin
reviews.text:
Best experience in Bangkok!
Friendly, quiet and Zen style atmosphere.  During my four days in Bangkok, I visit here once a day.  The masseuses were good on average.  It was a very good price to relax your trip.  There is a delicious noodle shop nearby and a good shopping mall center.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank u so much. I am so happy that you enjoyed my service. Hope to treat you again here. Happy new year~~

reviews.name: Tsvyatko Kab.
reviews.text: I got foot massage 1.5h it was great. The technique is different than what I’ve had before in other countries. Basically I walked in and after 10min I got a therapist, the guy at the reception speaks good English and it’s easy to communicate. You can pay with card as well. It’s a nice experience after a long walking day.

reviews.name: Colin
reviews.text:
It was the worst experience for me.
After the oil massage, I got a severe rash with itching.
I spend more money on medicine than massage fee.
Please consider my experience before visiting.

Are you serious? I visited 3 shops but had a strong allergic reaction only at your shop.  Instead of showing care, you call it "rare" and even mention raising your price. That shows no responsibility for Customer Safety. The right response is to explain how you will prevent this in the future. Your reply ignored the main point and focused only on money, which makes customers feel disrespected.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 최악의 경험을 하셨다니 안타깝네요. 저희 업소에서 하루에 오일 받으시는 분만 수십분에 달합니다. 저희업소는 특별히 엘러지프리 오일을 사용하고 있습니다. 만약 저희 오일에 문제가 있는것이라면 하루에도 수십분에게서 이런 증상이 발견되어야 하지만, 실질적으로 엘러지증상은 요즘은 거의 나타나고 있지 않습니다. 물론 1000에 한분도 안되는 확율로 오일에 특이체질을 가진 분들이 계십니다. 이런 문제를 방지하려면 오일 받으시는 모든 분들에게 사전 오일 테스트를 진행하고 해야하는데 현실적으로 불가능합니다. 이런 점 부디 양해해 주시길 바랍니다. 마사지가격보다 약값이 더 들었다고 하시니 마사지 가격을 조금 올려야 하나 하는 생각도 드네요.

reviews.name: Honggo Ng
reviews.text: I highly recommended "Ton" who is one of the best massage therapists I've met in Bangkok. He knows how to loosen tight muscles and then relax them with skillful, professional techniques. His service is excellent, and he maintains a polite attitude throughout the massage. I recommend choosing a Thai massage for the first hour to loosen tight muscles, followed by an oil massage for the next hour to relax them further. My body felt lighter after the massage. The location is also convenient. Will come again next time.

reviews.name: Stefan Leung
reviews.text: Went twice, both male massage therapists were great! Footmassage was more than just rubbing the calves. The cream massage was excellent by Ton! They didn‘t shorten the paid time, you pay in advance. They don‘t ask for tips, but of course they deserve some! Paid in cash. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Traisith Charoensintaweekul
reviews.text:
I brought chinese friends with me to experience Thai massage and both of them seem to be impressed.

The staff were friendly and kindly served.

For me as a Thai person, I do think this one is kind of an authentic thai style.

The normal price would be 350 thb/person/hour, but will +50 thb/hour during some Thai long holiday, e.g. Songkran, which should be reasonable price in this area.

reviews.name: Melinda Pattison
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Sense Spa in Phuket. The oil massage and head spa were incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere felt tranquil, luxurious, and beautifully designed to help you unwind.

The therapists were professional and attentive, creating a truly elevated spa experience. The soothing oil massage and deeply relaxing head spa left me feeling refreshed, restored, and completely at ease.

If you’re looking for a peaceful escape and a high-quality wellness experience in Phuket, I highly recommend Sense Spa.

reviews.name: Zack
reviews.text: Overall nice and clean place. Staff friendly and professional. It is more on the premier side for prices but then again the shop and service are all more high class. Treatment wise, I did the upper body massage and head spa, personally I did not feel super recharged or rested… but it was still good overall.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback

We’re pleased to hear that you enjoyed the cleanliness of the spa, the professionalism of our team, and the overall atmosphere. We truly appreciate your recognition of the care and effort that goes into creating a premium experience for our guests

reviews.name: Padma
reviews.text:
They are really famous and kind of viral for their head spa, and I think they’ve even received some awards for it.

As per my experience, I actually wanted to try their viral "Deep Sleep Head Spa," but I was a little confused. The receptionist suggested I go for their promotional offer instead a combo of face massage and head spa (two hours total, one hour each). Honestly, that didn’t work that well for me.

In terms of hospitality, ambience, staff behavior, relaxing atmosphere and everything else is good. The staff are very friendly and approachable. But I feel like they might not be experts in a personalized sense. I explained my focus areas and hair concerns, but it felt like they follow more of a "one treatment fits all" approach.

Overall, it’s not bad at all, but I think it’s better not to mix treatments just because of promotional offers. Instead, go for what they are actually known for. They could probably improve by having more specialized experts as well.

I visited their Chalong branch. Price-wise, it’s in the medium range. Tourists can try it as a one-time experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review

We really appreciate your honesty. It helps us improve in a real way

We’re glad you enjoyed the atmosphere, hospitality, and our team. At the same time, we completely understand your point about the treatment choice. If you came specifically for the Deep Sleep Head Spa, you should have been guided more clearly toward that experience instead of being redirected to a promotion that didn’t suit you

Your feedback about personalization is also very important. Our treatments do follow a structured flow, but they should still feel tailored to each guest. We will take this seriously and continue working with our team to listen better and adjust more during the treatment

You’re absolutely right about one thing. If you’re visiting SENSE Spa Phuket, it’s best to go for what we are truly known for, especially our signature head spa experience which many guests come specifically for when visiting Phuket

We truly appreciate your feedback and hope we may have another chance to welcome you again for a more personalized and complete experience

With Love,
SENSE Spa Phuket Team

If you are looking for an exceptional full-body Thai massage at an unbeatable price, Leteva Thai Massage is an absolute hidden gem. Its location is absolutely perfect—situated right next to the Platinum Fashion Mall, making it the ultimate spot to unwind.
After a long, exhausting day of walking and shopping, stepping in here for a massage felt heavenly and incredibly relaxing.
The value for money here is insane—both the foot spa and the full-body Thai massage are priced at just 250 Baht each. For that price, the quality of the massage and the instant relief you get is unmatched. If you are shopping in the area, skipping this place would be a mistake. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: J T
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience.
This massage shop is clearly more focused on attracting walk-in customers than actually providing quality service. We waited for over 15 minutes after being seated, and no staff came to do the basic foot wash.

They eventually sent someone who seemed to be a cleaner to give me a massage. She kept glancing at other staff to mimic their techniques—it was obvious she wasn’t properly trained.

Then they tried to switch masseuses and told me to move to another seat. When I politely declined, the other masseuse refused to come over. On top of that, my masseuse left halfway through the session to go outside and pull in more customers.

This place lacks professionalism, training, and basic customer service. Would not recommend it to anyone looking for a proper massage experience.

I even told the boss to cancel the massage, and instead of offering an apology, they simply refunded the money without saying a word. Absolutely no sense of responsibility.

reviews.name: abdullah kavak
reviews.text:
They are CHEATER!
I went with a friend for a 1.5-hour massage, but both sessions ended early (8 and 6 minutes). One masseur argued instead of admitting it, while the other at least apologized. The staff at the front desk didn’t seem to care. Also, the room was very cold.

I recommend keeping track of your time.

reviews.text: I have been coming here for years without any major issues, until today. After my massage and returning to my hotel, I realised that 2000 baht was missing from my wallet. After the massage, I went straight back to my hotel and never opened my wallet again until I arrived. As soon as I noticed the missing money, I immediately returned to the shop, but the staff were dismissive and not helpful in resolving the issue. had massages 3 times at this place during recent trip as near my hotel:

Not that I don't like it though, maybe she found my muscle to be too tense and try to help me, I guessed. The massage room was clean and private. reviews.name: Pranay Sodhani
reviews.text:
This was our second visit to this massage place. The first time, everything went really well—the masseuse understood the pressure points, the massage was effective, and we left feeling relaxed. The only minor issue back then was some light coming in from upstairs, but it was easy to ignore given how good the massage was overall.

Unfortunately, this second visit was disappointing from the very beginning. When I called to book, I clearly requested a 1 hour 30 minute massage and was told it was available. However, upon arriving, the receptionist informed me that only a 1-hour session was possible. That was the first letdown, but we agreed and went ahead anyway.

The massage itself was not good. The masseuse spent nearly 55 minutes focusing only on my ankle and barely worked on my calf at all. On top of that, there was constant talking throughout the session, which made it hard to relax. The light from upstairs, which had been a minor issue before, felt much more distracting this time and completely killed the mood.

To make matters worse, with around 20 minutes still remaining, the owner/manager/receptionist began taking used towels and clothes upstairs, put them into the washing machine, and turned it on. The noise was extremely loud—especially since the machine was enclosed by walls and located only about 10 meters away. It completely ruined whatever little relaxation was left.

At the end of the massage, there was no proper service either. Instead of tea or even warm water, we were served lukewarm water, and no one seemed to care.

I came back with good expectations because the place itself is decent and our first experience had been positive. Sadly, this visit showed a clear lack of consistency and attention to detail. After this experience, I won’t be returning.

First ever Thai Massage, and it felt like I was reborn after. My girlfriend had the back,shoulder & neck massage and felt amazing as well.

I had a man that massaged me and I workout a lot, and that was a good choice, he had a firm strong grip and massaged great!

Also the owner and the staff were so nice, kind and friendly. Highly recommend and I will return here when I get back to Phuket!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re thrilled your first Thai massage made you feel reborn and that you enjoyed the strong, firm pressure. So happy your girlfriend loved her massage too!
We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back in Phuket 🌴💆‍♂️

reviews.name: Akilesh Jadhav
reviews.text: Very good massage centre with jolly staff. Highly recommend this place for a good comfortable experience!

reviews.name: Adnan Garan
reviews.text: The reception staff were extremely kind and welcoming. I would definitely recommend this place. Thai Massage and Service very good

Our reception team will be delighted to know you felt welcomed and well looked after. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to seeing you again soon! 🙏✨

reviews.name: Animesh
reviews.text:
A Perfect End to a Naka Market Day

Located just a short walk from the Naka Weekend Market, Aura Thai Massage is an absolute gem. After an exhausting evening of shopping, we stumbled in with tired feet and left feeling completely rejuvenated.

The staff are professional, attentive, and genuinely warm. The owner deserves a special mention,  she is incredibly friendly and personally ensures that every guest feels comfortable and at ease from the moment they walk in. That personal touch makes all the difference.

The spa itself is spotlessly clean, well-maintained, and carries a wonderfully positive, calming vibe that helps you unwind the moment you step inside.

I highly recommend Aura Thai Massage to anyone visiting Phuket. If you're planning a day at the Naka Weekend Market, do yourself a favour and book a session here afterward your body will thank you. I'm already looking forward to my next visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We’re also very happy that you enjoyed the clean and relaxing atmosphere of our spa. Creating a peaceful and positive experience for our guests is very important to us.
Your recommendation truly means the world to us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back again on your next trip to Phuket 💕
