title: Let's Relax Spa - Sukhumvit 31
subTitle: เล็ทส์ รีแลกซ์ สปา สุขุมวิท 31
ownerDescription: Located in the heart of Sukhumvit, just a few steps from BTS Phromphong, Let's Relax Sukhumvit 31 Branch lets you discover the true Serenity surrounded by evergreen lush of trees in the Wooden-decorated House which gives a warm, calm and relaxed feelings. A perfect stop after the days of shopping in Bangkok.
address: 5/2-3 Sukhumvit 31, (Soi Sawasdee), Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHM8+VG Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Savan
reviews.text:
This outlet is conveniently located right next to our hotel, which made it very easy for us to visit. We ended up going twice during our stay.

Our first visit was for a full-body aromatherapy oil massage. There were five different essential oils to choose from. Although we’ve visited Let’s Relax many times in Thailand, this was our first time using an iPad to select preferred pressure levels for different parts of the body, which was a nice touch.

However, the overall experience for this session was a little underwhelming. Both my friend and I felt that the massage techniques were not quite on point and lacked depth, so it wasn’t as relaxing as expected — we didn’t even feel sleepy during the session. The background music in the room was also slightly too loud, which affected the overall ambience.

The next day, we returned for a foot massage as my friend was experiencing some foot discomfort and it was already quite late. I was assigned a male therapist this time, and the experience was excellent. The pressure was just right, and the technique felt much more precise and effective.

I was initially concerned that a male therapist might be too strong, but he was surprisingly gentle while still delivering the right amount of pressure — very well suited to my preference. I was so relaxed that I almost fell asleep (though I tried to stay awake so it wouldn’t affect my sleep later that night 😅).

Overall, the second experience was significantly better. It really highlights that the quality of the massage depends greatly on the therapist’s technique.

reviews.name: Stephanie Ofreneo
reviews.text: Walked in around 4:30 and was able to get appointment within 15 minutes with 2 female masseuse’s. The entire experience was so nice and lovely starting with a foot wash and then moving into a very quiet room where they did the back massage and then the foot massage I loved how peaceful it was great prices very professional, and nice starting tea and snack at the very end.

reviews.name: Green Life
reviews.text:
Nothing wrong with the masseurs themselves, but they handed me an iPad-like device to mark the areas to avoid. I highlighted those spots clearly, yet they still worked on the exact places I mentioned. It made me wonder what the point of asking was in the first place.

But otherwise, it’s still a reliable brand.

reviews.name: Nipada Intarayota
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at the Sukhumvit 31 branch! From the moment I arrived, the receptionist greeted me with a warm smile and a friendly, professional attitude. They explained everything clearly and made me feel right at home.

Before my massage, I was served a refreshing pandan drink and handed a cool, scented towel — a lovely touch that helped me relax instantly. My therapist personally came to welcome me to the treatment room, which felt very thoughtful.

I went for the 90-minute traditional Thai massage, and it was absolutely amazing. The therapist began with a calming spray to set the mood and checked in with me regularly to make sure I was comfortable throughout the session. I truly felt cared for every step of the way.

After the massage, I was served a delicious mango sticky rice — such a sweet and satisfying treat to end the session.

Every time I come here, I leave feeling refreshed and impressed. The service, atmosphere, and attention to detail are consistently excellent. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly relaxing and rejuvenating experience!✨🫶🏻

reviews.name: Jacinta Perth WA
reviews.text:
Located within the Emporium Enquartier - a new luxurious mall in the Sukhumvit district, Bangkok.

Staff were so friendly & warm.  They are respectful & very welcoming.  Upon arrival we were served with a delicious & fragrant pandan flavoured cold drink & a refreshing towel to cleanse your face & hands at the nicely minimalistic seating area.

Prices are reflective of the prime location, so they are probably around double or more than the usual massage places.  For example, traditional Thai massage (90 mins) costs 1100 baht or A  Dream Package (90 mins) 1200 baht, where you could only be paying only around 500-709 baht elsewhere or less depending on location.

Massage therapists themselves are well trained & know their craft.  They are aware & always ask questions to ensure we are comfortable & whether we prefer “softer or harder” pressures on their massage techniques.

The place is pristinely clean & everyone working there is lovely to deal with.

We went to get massages there at least 3 times during our week stay, a testament as to how much my mom & I enjoyed their hospitality & services.

At the end of each session we were again served with some hot tea & a little snack of Thailand’s famous mango & sticky rice served with a tiny squirt of coconut milk ~ DELICIOUS! 😍

I would certainly recommend this place & can’t wait to go back again on our next trip to Bangkok 🥰🙏

reviews.name: reviewed
reviews.text:
This location is not as nice inside compared to other ones, it was somewhat dated. Limited foot massage chairs, the stairs are worn.

Then, I noticed my therapist started the massage timer before we even got to the room. By the time we switched and prior to changing, my time was already down 7-8 minutes. Clearly after changing into the spa wear and waiting we were down 15 minutes of the 120. I have been to other locations and they don’t start the timer until the session starts, not before. Clearly my therapist was trying to pull a fast one, until I pointed this out to her and asked her what she was doing. Of course then she acknowledged it, but this lead to a disturbing experience as when the timer goes off it starts making noises and she still has 15 minutes to make up. Also there was no spa music in the room at all, just silence. I suggest providing a consistent customer experience across all locations.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka.

We sincerely apologize that your visit did not meet your expectations. Regarding the issue with the massage timer starting before your session officially began, please rest assured that the therapist has been formally reminded of our standards and received appropriate corrective action to prevent this from happening again. We also appreciate your feedback about the room ambiance, lack of spa music, and consistency across locations. Your comments have been shared with management to help us improve. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Your feedback is valuable and will help ensure every Let’s Relax Spa customer enjoys a professional and relaxing experience.

reviews.name: Iris Lee
reviews.text: I having my hot stone massage here and it was awesome… my therapist Buasorn was very friendly and kind,her massage skills also very strong and firm. She knows I like to hold the hot stones so she keep replacing the hot stones for me to hold once the stones start to cool down. The best hot stone massage I ever had 😍😍😍

reviews.name: Fiona Wu
reviews.text:
My partner and I booked the 110-minute package (starting with a 45-minute foot massage), and unfortunately, it was one of the worst massage experiences we’ve had.
There were several major issues:
• Ineffective Policy: The spa has a policy allowing a change of masseur within the first 15 minutes. However, when we expressed dissatisfaction, we were told no changes could be made due to "lack of manpower." If you don't have the staff to honor your own guarantees, the policy shouldn't exist.
• Lack of Strength: Despite specifically requesting a certain pressure level at the start, the masseurs had limited strength. It felt like our preferences were completely ignored. Again, what was the point of asking.
• Poor Service Recovery: When we raised our concerns, the masseur's first response was to tell us to walk to the reception ourselves to complain. We found this incredibly unprofessional and confusing—it is not the guest's job to hunt down management in the middle of a session.
Overall, it was a total waste of time and money. If you are looking for a massage with actual pressure and professional service, I would suggest looking elsewhere.

reviews.name: Hazel Razon
reviews.text: I had my first Thai massage in Thailand, and it did not disappoint! I truly enjoyed my time at Let’s Relax Spa and can’t wait to experience it again when I return. A must-try if you’re in the city!

reviews.name: Mj Ng
reviews.text: The ambience was exceptionally clean and relaxing. The masseur was highly professional, delivering a top-notch service at a very reasonable price. I especially loved the warm pillow placed on my tummy throughout the session—it added a comforting touch. The complimentary mango sticky rice dessert after the massage was a delightful surprise. Overall, a truly enjoyable and satisfying experience.

reviews.name: KL Lim
reviews.text: Had my first 4-hand massage here and it was a great experience that really relieved my sore muscles. I'd suggest asking for firm pressure if you're used to a stronger touch. The therapists did a wonderful job and paid close attention when I asked them to focus on certain spots. Will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Gift Punpun
reviews.text: I often come here for massage services. Every time I come, I'm impressed. The staff here are all lovely. The massage skills are excellent. After the massage, they serve mango sticky rice with hot tea. I recommend Heavenly Relax and Full Spirit package 💆🏼‍♀️

reviews.name: Shermaine Quek
reviews.text: Been to let’s relax spa in their different outlets and they are always consistently good! The pressure points and strength hits different. :) booked a wrong timing and the staff were accommodating to book me on another timing for the next day. I will always recommend them

reviews.name: emily d'silva
reviews.text: Tranquil and relaxing experience. The massage is tailored accordingly; uou can choose which parts to focus on and the strength of the massage. Added on is your choice of massage oil. Starting of with a nice hot herbal drink and ending with mango sticky rice treat! 🤗 It was a lovely experience!

reviews.name: Marian Rachelle Taruc
reviews.text: Soo good gentle yet purposeful touches, must is the warm oil massage with siamese blend oil 🫶 scent is sooo relaxing and addicting after massage is tea and mango sticky rice 😍 highly recommended service and ambience! Must try when you are in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Luk L
reviews.text: Picking this location for a testing massage. The pricing has always been standardized for the franchise, and the quality was usually fine. However, this 1 hr massage I had was very disappointing.  The massage felt like I got someone randomly pinching my body for an hour instead of locating my sore points or my knot to work on them.

reviews.name: Gerard Tate
reviews.text: Always an amazing experience from start to finish! The room is spotless, calming, and welcoming. The massage never disappoints—truly one of the best every time. And the perfect touch at the end? Delicious mango sticky rice and tea. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Alejandra Romo
reviews.text:
Great massage and attention to detail.
Also reasonable prize for the 90 min massage.

reviews.name: Mimi Milan
reviews.text: I came in today for a massage and body scrub, and I was so impressed! The staff here took such good care of me – everyone was kind and attentive. The atmosphere is clean and very relaxing, and the treatment room was beautifully peaceful. I’ll definitely be coming back again. Oh, and they served mango sticky rice afterwards – my favorite! What a sweet touch!

reviews.name: Rajan
reviews.text: Second time visiting this specific location and had an amazing massage again. Love the ambience and feel a sense of calm as soon as you walk in. The mango and sticky rice at the end is always a treat too!

reviews.name: Ka Ping Man
reviews.text:
I visited C Care on sukhumvit 26 with a friend for a massage after dinner and selected a relaxing oil body massage for 60mins.  This was a very good experience and we both enjoyed the massage.  I had a good sleep too!
The spa is very well organised, clean, bright and comfortable.
It has single rooms and couple rooms too.
I would recommend coming and it's very reasonable in price.

✅Actually worked on/through and helped alleviate said problem areas (I walked in with super tight hips and soreness in upper back - left feeling limber and fresh!)

10/10 recommend and will be back again!!

✅ Understood your problem areas

✅ Applied the perfect pressure

We’re so happy you left feeling limber, fresh, and relaxed! 💆‍♀️🌿

reviews.name: Floris Werk
reviews.text:
I had a very uncomfortable experience here. During what was supposed to be a normal 60-minute Thai massage, I had to say no twice when the masseuse tried to turn it into an intimate massage and touched my private parts.

The rest of the massage itself was actually very good, but this completely ruined the experience. Please respect your customers’ boundaries and don’t put others in this situation, it isn’t right.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We take this feedback extremely seriously and apologize for this experience. This behavior is strictly against our policies and we are investigating immediately.

The rest of the massage was good, but your safety is our priority. We are committed to a professional environment for all.

Thank you for your honesty; we will take the necessary actions to ensure this never happens again.

reviews.name: Kat Ang
reviews.text:
I came at midnight and they close at 2am. I chose the relaxing oil massage for 90mins, but probably cos it's too close to end of their shift, the therapist seemed already clocked out. There were more than 5 moments of OWWWW cos the kneads and presses were painful. It's not the pressure, it's the control of her hands that was making it very uncomfortable. 90mins was just a 60min massage done super duper slowly to a point of it being ticklish to extend it to 90mins.

The aircon was blowing directly at me as well. The therapist threw the packaging of the hairnet and disposable underwear just on the floor. I was made to wear the hairnet which she yanked off my head when it was time to give me a head massage. It got caught in my earrings and she just continued yanking. Not the best and most recommendable experience.

Note that they don't take card payment as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: A relaxing 90-minute massage should leave you feeling lighter—not counting the minutes or worrying about discomfort. We're genuinely sorry that your visit was not the relaxing experience you came looking for. Your comments about the massage technique, air conditioning, cleanliness, and the way the hairnet and earrings were handled have been noted carefully. We appreciate you taking the time to explain everything in detail, as it gives us a clear opportunity to do better.

reviews.name: Yoon Jeong Shin
reviews.text: I had a massage from Sky and she was very friendly and nice the whole time. Regarding the price, it was worth to try and the massage itself was very good. (Had a full Thai body massage)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the feedback! We’re glad Sky provided such friendly service and that you enjoyed the Thai massage. See you again!"

reviews.name: be Strong
reviews.text: I had an amazing foot massage here – the ambience was so soothing and relaxing. The therapist did a wonderful job, applying the right pressure and focusing perfectly on the pressure points. It was a truly refreshing and rejuvenating 60-minute session. I would definitely recommend everyone to visit this place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Refreshed, rejuvenated, and relaxed—that’s the spa triple combo! 😄✨ Thanks a lot for your glowing words and recommendation. We’ll keep the ambience calm and the pressure perfect for your next visit. 💆‍♂️🌸

reviews.name: Jack chen
reviews.text: At first I just wanna do foot massage for an hour. But the masseur was really good and she did massaged on those points. After that foot massage, I asked for Thai massage + relaxing oil massage for another hour. She was really experienced and skilled in massaging. Her name is NUT! Very skillful, friendly and humorous. Thank you NUT!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted that you enjoyed both the foot and Thai + oil massage with Nut. She truly takes pride in her skill and service. We look forward to welcoming you again soon. 🙏

reviews.name: drag n coco
reviews.text: The young lady is extremely gentle and professional. The environment is brand new and there are no additional charges. English communication is possible. Highly recommended! Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It’s wonderful to hear you felt comfortable and well-taken care of. We love that our English-speaking staff and fresh environment hit the mark for you! 🧘‍♂️🧼

reviews.name: Sirinyata Boondech
reviews.text: I really like to get a massage at your shop. And the service there is very good. The atmosphere is very good. The staff is very friendly. Everyone is cute. The massage is very relaxing and comfortable. I love it very much.♥️♥️♥️🤟🏻🤟🏻🤟🏻😍😍😍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow! Thank you so much for your sweet words ❤️🤟🏻 We’re thrilled that you love our massage, our staff, and the atmosphere. Your happiness makes our day, and we can’t wait to see you again soon!
Khob khun ka/krub 🙏

reviews.name: Salman Ansari
reviews.text: Excellent massage at CCare. Got a foot and neck massage. Staff is professional. The rooms and massage seats are clean. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Excellent review, thank you so much! 😊 Glad you enjoyed the foot and neck massage and found our staff professional and everything clean! Highly appreciate the recommendation! 🙌✨

reviews.name: Laura Vrg
reviews.text:
I paid 350 baht for a one-hour foot massage was a complete waste of money.
The woman kept making unpleasant facial expressions, which I found very unprofessional considering she works in customer service. It was obvious that she didn’t like her job, and because of that I felt uncomfortable throughout the entire session. I couldn’t wait for the hour to be over.
She wasn’t even really massaging my feet. She just kept stroking them in the same repetitive motion while using her other hand to scroll on her phone. At one point it bothered me so much that I told her to massage my feet properly. I was already thinking about getting up and leaving after the first 20 minutes.
It was the worst massage experience I’ve ever had. I went there to relax, but instead I got  stress for my money.
Despite all of this, she stood by the door expecting a tip and made another unhappy face when I didn’t give her one. What was she thinking? Do your job properly, treat your customers with respect, and maybe then you’ll deserve a tip. And don’t spend the massage using your phone ,I didn’t pay for that!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re sorry to hear about your experience and understand how disappointing it must have felt when you came in expecting a relaxing foot massage. Your feedback about the service and professionalism has been taken seriously, and we will discuss this with our team. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention and hope we have the opportunity to provide you with a better experience in the future.

reviews.name: Chinjutatip Thipbunmak
reviews.text: "I had a wonderful time at C CARE MASSAGE .The ambiance was tranquil and relaxing, with soft music and a lovely scent. The staff were very professional and friendly. I highly recommend their aroma therapy massage – it was top-notch! Will definitely come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Soft music, lovely scents, and a top-notch aroma therapy massage — sounds like a perfect day! 😄🌿
Thanks for your amazing review, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another relaxing session!

reviews.name: Deni
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing place! Very big, clean and the staff is so lovely! I had a wonderful massage of top notch quality and I can’t wait to be back! You can also choose your own cookies 😁
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so happy you had a wonderful experience at our spa! Thank you for the sweet words about our clean facilities and lovely team. We always aim for top notch quality, and we are glad you enjoyed personalizing your treat with our cookies! ☕️✨ Looking forward to your next visit!

reviews.name: Wannipa Termtes
reviews.text: Just had the most amazing foot massage! The ambience was so calming, and the therapist really knew what they were doing – perfect pressure on all the right points. Felt completely refreshed after the 60-minute session. Totally recommend this place to anyone looking to relax!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We sincerely appreciate your thoughtful feedback. It is a pleasure to know that the ambience, therapist’s skill, and overall experience met your expectations. Thank you for your kind recommendation. 🙏

reviews.name: Simrata Dhillon
reviews.text:
Patty and Daony at C Care were absolutely amazing! We had one Thai body massage and one Thai oil massage, and both were honestly some of the best massages we’ve ever had. They were so skilled, attentive, and really made us feel completely relaxed from start to finish.

We left feeling so light, refreshed, and genuinely taken care of. On top of that, they were incredibly kind and thoughtful — even treating us to ice cream and a gift afterwards, which was such a lovely touch.

If you’re looking for the best massage experience, you have to come here. Couldn’t recommend it more!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re absolutely thrilled to read this! 😊✨ Patty and Daony will be so happy to know they made your experience so special. From the massages to the little treats at the end, it sounds like a perfect visit. Can’t wait to see you again! Khob khun ka 🙏

reviews.name: Erika Occena
reviews.text: Perfect way to end a full day of touring. All the staff were very friendly and accommodating. They were all professional. The massage was so gooood!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: After a day exploring the city’s heartbeat, you found your calm in our little oasis 🌸. We’re so happy our team could wrap up your day with warmth, care, and the massage you deserved. Thank you for sharing your lovely energy — see you again for more peaceful moments. Khob khun krub 🙏

reviews.name: The Twinsbb
reviews.text: The massage was incredibly relaxing and professional, helping me release all the tension. The spa itself is clean, calm, and beautifully designed, making it easy to unwind. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made me feel comfortable from start to finish.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed a relaxing and professional massage and found our spa clean, calm, and welcoming. Your kind words about our staff are greatly appreciated, and we look forward to your next visit.

reviews.name: UN x FRIENDS
reviews.text: It was my first time visiting this place and I was really impressed. The atmosphere is great, the staff are lovely, and the massage was so relaxing. They even offer some snacks! 🥰 I’ll definitely be coming back again.

reviews.name: Donnie Goh
reviews.text:
Not my first visit to Lets Relax spa for sure but my first to Phayathai branch! Upon landing , i took the airport rail to this branch and this was the best decision ever!

Managed to book through pelago and was assigned Anong as my masseur. She is professional and all my pain points were addressed well!

Highly recommend this branch and Anong!

Thank you 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.text:
We came here twice as it was close to our hotel. The first time I got a back massage and it was probably the worst 30 minute massage I've ever had. It was only 30 minutes but it felt like an eternity. There was so much pushing with the elbows. I felt like I was going to bruise the next day.

Then I decided to give it another chance and go for a foot massage. The foot massage is definitely better than the back massage. The only problem was that they lady kind of burned my belly with the hot pack she placed on me. Price is okay but a little bit much for the quality received

reviews.name: KICHI KO (こ)
reviews.text: Highly recommend Pitipa! His technique was excellent, and he was very professional and attentive throughout the entire session. He worked with great care, never rushed, and didn’t waste any time. I left feeling completely relaxed. Thank you for such a wonderful massage!

reviews.name: Liz Fernandez
reviews.text: It was a really great experience! I took the 3 hour heavenly massage that went for like over 3.5 hours. They served you tea and mango sticky rice after. The service is amazing and it exceeded my expectation. I would love to keep coming back

reviews.name: Ivy Eyu
reviews.text: Enjoyed a Thai Aroma Oil Massage at Let’s Relax, conveniently located near Phay Thai BTS. Professional service, serene vibes, and friendly staff made the experience so relaxing. Loved the cozy couple room with shower facilities, and the surprise treat of Thai mango sticky rice dessert after the massage was great! Highly recommended! #BangkokSpa #ThaiMassage #AromaMassage #RelaxAndUnwind #SpaTime #WellnessJourney

reviews.name: Nanako Aida
reviews.text:
I went here to get oil massage (60mins) and I regret not trying this earlier😭 It was life changing!!
My shoulder pain is gone after the massage!!!
You can choose the smell of the oil and places where you want it to be focused/ avoid!
Also how strong the massage you want and choose whether to shower before the massage!
After the massage, I got mango sticky rice and tea and it was VERY GOOD!!
I definitely recommend this to everyone!!

reviews.name: Denise Ang
reviews.text:
My bf and I went here on our last day in Thailand. It was definitely a great decision to have a massage here because we had a really great experience. We availed the Dream Package for 950Baht. It comes with a 45 min. foot massage, 15 min. hand massage and a 30 min. back and shoulder massage. The location is very accessible and close to the train station. We didn't book ahead and only walked in. Went on a Tuesday late afternoon around 530PM and they had a slot for us at 6PM and we didn't mind waiting. They offered refreshments and a cold towel prior the treatment. We were allowed to conveniently pay using our credit card. When it was finally our turn, they cleansed our foot first then we headed on to the upper floor where all the comfy chairs are situated. The massage was extremly relaxing and calming. All my stresses have gone away. I almost fell asleep during the massage because of how good they were. The therapist took time to really massage my feet and I wasn't feeling that it's being rushed. The pressure was spot on, it wasn't too light or hard. The chair was really comfy so it was I felt very comfortable laying down.
After the hand and foot massage, we were asked to go to a diff type of chair for the shoulder massage. I am astounded by how everything was well thought of, even the type of chair. I almost drooled because of how relaxed I was. The soreness of my feet from all the walking and shopping went away. Post massage, you get a mango sticky rice with a hot cup of tea. Just the perfect way to end the treatment. The staff are courteous and friendly. I highly reco this spa, I will definitely go back here again when I go back to Bangkok. You really get what you pay for and it's all worth it.

reviews.name: Tiktiktok G.
reviews.text:
Great Thai massage place, you have to make an appointment at least one day before you go. Very nice service and awesome environment. We tried 4 hands Thai massage which was very nice. Remember to prepare tips for the ladies/men.
They’ll provide you the mango sticky rice and tea after you finished the massage. Highly recommend this place, super clean and amazing.

reviews.name: James Moore
reviews.text: I enjoyed the Spa Experience (210 minutes). Very good value and the therapist was fantastic. I used Let’s Relax at multiple locations across Bangkok and Chiang Mai and they were all very good and very professional.

reviews.name: Mameeyoww
reviews.text:
Had the most amazing time in Let's Relax Phaya Thai. They offer affordable but still absolutely fantastic massage services. They offer shower areas and warmed beds too. All facilities were very clean. I could converse well with the therapists for any changes. I went back for a 2nd time to the exact same branch and was not disappointed.

The only drawback was the noise of the weekend traffic of honking cars but that is something outside of their control given their location and proximity.

reviews.name: Genesis Macale
reviews.text:
Best massage I've availed yet in my life - no kidding. Mr. Nattawut was very professional and excellent in what he does and I really enjoyed the Thai massage. And they don't even ask customers to write a review about them at all.

There is also complimentary mango sticky rice and hot tea at the end of your massage.

Will definitely recommend this spa to friends.

reviews.name: Gough Samake
reviews.text: Just had a Thai massage today. Professionally set up, all the reception staffs are super helpful and welcoming.  Catering for all kinds of customers as I am diabetic. The masseur was very kind, Gentle, and skilled. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Sina
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Let’s Relax Phayathai. The massages were absolutely excellent, very professional, relaxing, and great value for the price. You really get high-quality treatment without spending too much.

One of the highlights was the mango sticky rice served after the treatment. It was delicious and the perfect way to end such a relaxing session.

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great massage experience in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Bec Collins
reviews.text: If you have time before your plane, make sure you go here and have their feet massage at a minimum. The most mesmerising experience. The staff were so kind and professional. I couldn’t resist their package of hands and body massage. The facilities were elite and the services were outstanding. 30secs straight from airline train station. So convenient. Even to get out of airport and go if you have a lay over. So easy to get to and back to airport via the train.

reviews.name: Hedges Leo
reviews.text:
Price wise not the most affordable but the service level is through the roof. From making the booking to the reception to massage and send off 5 star service. Great relaxing environment even though the shop was located next to a busy street, but had excellent sound proofing.

Opted for aromatherapy oil massage with my wife. We get to choose the essential oil of our choice. Once the staff stored our footware, we were given hotel style bedroom slippers and were escorted up to the room. Room had an ensuite bathroom. Super clean aesthetics.

Massage was awesome. As I'm a regular runner, my calfs are tight and the masseuse made all the tightness disappear. Super please with her technique.

The cheery on top was being served dessert of mango sticky rice and hot tea before we left the shop. They really made you feel like royalty there at let's relax. Will definitely return to one of their many outlets throughout Thailand. 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

reviews.name: Asher ts
reviews.text:
The staff and therapists provide great service. The location is very convenient right by the BTS.

One problem is that if you get a room facing the street, it is noisy. You’ll hear the train and traffic, which can ruin the relaxed mood.

reviews.name: Canada Cat Wong
reviews.text:
The massage is fine , but not I expected . A Thai massage is a symphony of well orchestrated movements: bending, stretching, pulling and relaxing muscles. It's even scored like a symphony: it has a gentle build up, it reaches a crescendo and it resolves. You feel like you have a new body when your done.  But I can’t feel like that here . I took the 2 hours Thai massage twice . One is female and the other one is female therapist.
The place is nice and clean .
The only surprise is the mango sticky rice , after the massage they will give to you for free . But I love so much I paid extra 50 Thai for one more .

reviews.text: A terrible experience. My feet were still cold after 90 minutes of massage. I asked the masseur for medium pressure beforehand, but they used incredibly strong pressure, almost injure my foot. after I told them it hurt, she kept touching my foot for 90 minutes. This is my first ever terrible review.

reviews.name: Harvey Tan
reviews.text:
Tip-top service ! Quiet and clean with affordable pricing.
We opt for classic Thai massage was only THB 1,100 for 120 minutes.  Worth every penny !
Their complimentary mango sticky rice is good too!

reviews.name: Karawin Pruk
reviews.text: Conveniently located near BTS and Airport Rail Link, Let’s Relax Spa Phayathai offers a serene atmosphere, professional therapists, and a wide range of treatments—from Thai massage to aromatherapy. Excellent service, relaxing ambiance, and great value for money. Highly recommended for a quality spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.text:
Had the greatest experience at this spa.. I didn’t even book, I was looking y an app thy was near my hotel, was greeted with the most friendly faces, and they were so accommodating for me.. that they would compare prices of what they had to what was on the app.

Such a professional environment one of the best spa I’ve been too, and I’ve been to few. If you’re ever in Patong, and need to relaxed  “The Cozy Spa” is the place to be!! Won’t ever be disappointed!

reviews.name: Sean McEvoy
reviews.text:
We went for a couples massage using a promotion (white booklet) for a mixed sense massage, using a combination of traditional Thai massage and oil massage. I thought it would be good to get a mix of both worlds and I’m thrilled I did! We went for 60 minutes and it honestly flew by, the masseuse adjusting pressure seamlessly and finding all my muscle knots and painful areas. Besides the repair, it was also peaceful, the massage beds were immaculately laundered, tranquil music played in the background and I felt myself almost drifting to sleep several times

There are a lot of massage places locally, but I would thoroughly recommend visiting here, as the price is great and the service is top notch on every front. Has genuinely earmarked this hotel for our next return trip

P.s. cold tea before massage, hot tea after, both delicious and well received!

reviews.name: Click Trend
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at this spa. From the moment I arrived, everything felt calm, professional, and welcoming. I chose a body scrub and massage, and it turned out to be one of the most relaxing treatments I’ve ever had.

A special thank you to Maya – she did an incredible job. Her technique was perfect, and she paid great attention to every detail. I came in with back and leg pain, and by the end of the session, I felt completely relieved and refreshed. It’s rare to find someone so skilled and dedicated.

I left feeling lighter, relaxed, and genuinely happy. I highly recommend this place, and especially Maya, to anyone looking for a high-quality, healing, and deeply relaxing experience. I will definitely come back!

reviews.name: la Da
reviews.text:
I was debating where to get a massage on the last day of our trip, and in the end, we decided to have it at the place where we were staying. It was more expensive than other places, so I was a bit hesitant at first. But after the massage, all those thoughts completely disappeared. It was absolutely amazing.

It was clean, the facilities were excellent, and the staff were incredibly friendly. It was the best massage I had in Thailand. Everyone, finish your trip here—you won’t regret it!

reviews.text: The staff are amazing and it helps us relax. The massage are great thank you guys

reviews.name: gita s
reviews.text:
I had the most relaxing time at the spa in R Mar Resort. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel completely at ease with their warm hospitality and calming atmosphere.

The massage was absolutely amazing — just the right amount of pressure, and they really knew how to melt away all the tension. The essential oils they used smelled divine, and the soothing background music made the whole experience feel like a dream. 💆‍♀️💖

reviews.name: Israel Archilla
reviews.text: Amazing experience from start to finish. The staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel completely relaxed. The massage was exactly what I needed—perfect pressure and very calming. I left feeling refreshed and stress-free. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: 3975 เมธาพร นิ่มอนงค์
reviews.text: The massage was excellent and very relaxing. The service was great from everyone. The Thai dessert and tea were also good taste

reviews.name: Suyash Harlalka
reviews.text:
I recently visited Nua Thai Massage in Phuket and chose their 90-minute Thai herbal massage, and honestly it was fantastic from start to finish.
From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt peaceful and relaxing, blending modern comfort with traditional Thai hospitality that immediately put us at ease. The booking and check-in process was smooth, and the staff were warm and welcoming throughout.

The massage began with a personalized selection of oils, such a lovely touch. We were guided in choosing an aroma that suited our mood, which set the tone for the entire session. The quality of the oils and herbal blends was exceptional; you could tell they weren’t generic or overly perfumed, but rather thoughtfully curated to enhance relaxation and soothe the senses.
The therapists were incredibly skilled and attentive. Their technique combined traditional Thai massage principles, incorporating stretches, pressure point work, and gentle compressions with soothing herbal heat where appropriate. The warmth and herbal essence helped ease muscle tension, boost circulation, and melt away stress in a way that felt deeply therapeutic yet totally relaxing.
Overall, this 90-minute Thai herbal massage was one of the best spa experiences of our Phuket trip, a perfect balance of deep relaxation and genuine therapeutic benefit. I’d highly recommend booking in advance, as this place gets busy due to its excellent reputation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a thoughtful note. We’ll be happy to welcome you back whenever you return 🧡

reviews.name: Danicksha Ford
reviews.text: Out of this world experience. You come to Thailand for the food and culture, come here for the massage.  What a way to bring in my birthday.  Rejuvenated and refreshed. Thank you guys for the queen treatment.

reviews.name: Warren Ong
reviews.text: Nua Thai Massage in Phuket delivers a truly skillful and rejuvenating massage experience in one of the island’s more upmarket areas. The therapists are highly trained, attentive, and know exactly how to melt away every knot and ache – I walked out feeling light, relaxed, and refreshed! The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall warmth of the visit. The ambiance is lovely and relaxing, though for the premium price tag, I felt it was just missing that final touch of perfection. Still, an excellent spot to indulge yourself and recharge while in beautiful Phuket!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you 🙏
We work every day to improve our service. We hope that next time, you will give us 5 stars 😊

reviews.name: Downtoearth
reviews.text:
I traveled 40 minutes to visit this spa, expecting a quality experience. Unfortunately, the massage did not meet my expectations, as the therapist’s pressure was too light. Overall, the spa did not stand out compared to other standard massage salons, and I felt the pricing was relatively high for the level of service provided.

Additionally, they did not offer disposable underwear for men and instead provided small-sized women’s underwear, which was uncomfortable. Based on my experience, I would recommend considering other options.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We’re genuinely sorry that your visit did not fully meet your expectations. Comfort and personalized care are very important to us, and we regret that we did not align perfectly with your preferences on this occasion.

We always aim to adjust each treatment to the guest’s desired pressure, and we appreciate feedback that helps us refine the experience further. Regarding the disposable underwear, we currently provide unisex sizes up to XXL; however, we understand that comfort can vary, and we will be expanding the size range to ensure a better fit for all guests.

We truly value your visit and your perspective. Should you choose to return in the future, we would be happy to take extra care in tailoring everything precisely to your preference 🙏🏻

title: Sumalee Thai Boxing Gym
ownerDescription:
Sumalee Boxing Gym offers Muay Thai and Yoga Training in Phuket with excellent standards of service, accommodation, facilities and food.

We offer a traditional Muay Thai training program and a mixed, varied style Yoga program. Both are specifically tailored to cater towards all levels of experience and abilities.

Our facilities, such as swimming pool and chillout zone, make Sumalee the perfect place to unwind and relax whilst at the same time challenging yourself to the limits.

All training is accompanied by our range of nutritious and delicious food options at our on site restaurant, The Nutrition Station. With menus designed by our in house sports nutritionist you can be sure that you're fueling and recovering effectively from training

reviews.name: Maya
reviews.text:
I stayed at this Muay Thai camp for one week, and honestly, it was one of the best experiences of my life.

In just seven days I learned more than I ever expected: real technique, real discipline, and real confidence. I had my first sparrings ever (two of them!), and it felt both scary and empowering at the same time.

The program is very intensive and incredibly well-structured. You train a lot, but it never feels chaotic everything has purpose. The trainers are absolutely amazing: professional, attentive, and with a great sense of humor. Training with them is not only effective, it’s genuinely fun.

What makes this place truly special is the community. Because everyone knows each other, you instantly feel included. For solo travelers, this camp is just perfect you’re never alone, but you always have your space.

The facilities are excellent for the price: delicious food on site, cozy lounges to rest and connect with people, daily cleaning, laundry service, and even bike rental right at the camp.

The management is very caring and thoughtful , you really feel supported here, not just as a client, but as a person.

This camp gave me strength, confidence, and a deep love for Muay Thai.
I’m 100% coming back. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Maya!

reviews.name: Wayne McNicol
reviews.text: Weather you are looking for a greatly run peaceful resort or the best and most authentic Muay Thai training available, I’d highly recommend this place. When I first started training here with coach luay and doing a weeks stay and train package I went from completely new to Muay Thai and boxing and after 2 weeks training here I am leaving a confident fighter. All coaches are as experienced as it gets and all the training here is as good as it gets. Every athlete no matter the level will be looked after here and I don’t have one bad word to say about this gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Wayne!

reviews.name: Ian Orekondy
reviews.text: Such a great experience. As a first time Muay Thai trainee, Sumalee was perfect. Staying on-site was peaceful and quiet and made training so easy.  The whole staff is welcoming and available and great at their roles. The food was actually FANTASTIC. Both on-site as well as around the corner at Krua Praya.  Definitely recommend for anyone looking for focused attention from amazing trainers (Khru), and a friendly supportive community.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Ian!

reviewContext.Rooms: Simple and clean is all you need.
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Krua Praya restaurant - Michelin recognized. Bang Tao beach is 25 minutes away. And Sumalee organizes trips to Bangla Boxing Stadium.
reviewContext.Walkability: I was able to walk to do a last minute load of laundry (on-site laundry requires 24 hours).  The walk to the laundromat nearby was quite fun and the woman running the machines was so kind and helpful and even folded very thing perfectly. Surprisingly quick and easy. I went to Bang Tao beach (20 minute grab ride) while the laundry was drying.
reviewContext.Food & drinks: Amazing all around. The smoothies are delicious here. The power bowls are better than anything I’ve found in America. Highly recommend, but order food ahead of time.

reviews.name: I am
reviews.text:
Great Krus, Great Place

Great workers, Krus are all very friendly and helpful. The rooms are cleaned daily and my girlfriend had a great experiance as well. I would recommend this gym for anyone wanting to learn muay thai, it's great for beginners snd those who know what they're doing alike.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks!

reviews.name: Sidd Chhabra
reviews.text:
I spent a month at Sumalee this year and had a great experience. I stayed in a double room with a bronze package.
As someone new to Mauy Thai I couldn’t have asked for a better place to learn. Classes were the ideal size (20ish) to get the perfect mix of 1 on 1 attention while still having a selection of sparring partners at various experience levels. Private training sessions were monumentally helpful in perfecting technique.
Outside of training, the camp grounds are clean and peaceful. The best part of the whole experience is meeting all the like minded people who value mental and physical wellness.
The only drawbacks at Sumalee is that the location isn’t great if you’re looking to explore around the island/visit the beach daily, and there isn’t a great selection of equipment for weight training.
I recommend Sumalee to everyone and I can’t wait to visit Sumalee again in the future!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Sidd!

reviews.name: Eaden Daansen
reviews.text: I had a really great time at the gym! The coaches are highly motivated, pay close attention to proper technique, and take the time to support beginners as well. The training sessions are intense but a lot of fun and push you to your limits every time. The atmosphere is respectful and feels like a family – you immediately feel welcome. I’ll definitely be coming back! 🥊💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Eaden!

reviews.name: Kody Kai
reviews.text: I’ve never trained Muay Thai before Sumalee & I’m glad I went here! Immediately from the start, all the trainers were extremely friendly and helpful in teaching me the basics. Emphasizing learning proper technique and form, over brute strength. Classes usually are no more than 15-20 people, making the training session very intimate. I got one on one time every session I was there. By the end of the two weeks, they also had me starting to spar which was what I was looking for. Overall great way to learn the basics, get a good workout, & or refine the skills you already have if you’re an intermediate or advanced fighter. They also have accommodation, ice baths, massage, yoga, and health food available. I will definitely be coming back next time I’m in Phuket! Bonus points for a gym cat.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Kody!

reviews.name: Minou Maydell
reviews.text: Beginner-friendly gym with very welcoming and supportive trainers. Training is intense but always fun. Great recovery options like yoga, ice baths, and massages. The rooms are nice, and the pool is perfect to relax in between sessions. One week in and I’m really enjoying my stay!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Minou!

reviews.name: Eric Shim
reviews.text:
Man where do I start? Sumalee provided the best environment to sharpen my Muay Thai technique, eat great food, and meet even better people!

Sam, Sun, Clinton and their whole team are unreal: down to earth, kind, and organized.

Accommodation: super comfortable beds that were very welcome after a long day of training. Rooms are clean, but i highly recommend bringing your own mosquito spray from home, as the ones sold in local pharmacies don’t always work, and the outdoors are always teeming with them.

Training: All the trainers or Krus are so good, they meet you at your level and help you improve.

Food: The chef was solo when i visited, but still held down the fort really well. Make sure to scan the QR code on the tables when you first arrive, the pre-order your lunch and dinner when you get your first breakfast for the day, it helps prevent food waste :)

I recommend the pad thai, chicken shawarma, and açaí bowl (breakfast), but honestly everything is quite good!

There’s one morning session an (intense) yoga class, and one afternoon training. Privates can be scheduled between morning and afternoon training.

As someone relatively new to Muay Thai, I found 2 sessions a day (or 1 private, 1 training, or 1 yoga), were a good balance for me that challenged me but didn’t burn out either!

Can’t recommend this gym enough!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the great review, Eric! Hope to see you again some day

reviews.name: Vitiksha Misra
reviews.text: Amazing place! Fun trainers and such great group and 1-1 sessions. Ice baths and massages on site. With a beautiful pool and nice rooms. Definitely coming back again! The trainers encourage you to go beyond your limits and are very fun and kind.

reviews.name: EJB
reviews.text: Wonderful private training sessions with Khun Rune for two people. Clean gym and gear. Tremendously knowledgeable and friendly staff, who deal well with kids and all ages. Very easy to book your sessions via khun Sun.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks!

reviews.name: Miranda Ma
reviews.text:
First of all, I would like to let you know the pad holding course is not only for coaches but for everyone who wants to know more about muaythai. I join this course because in the gym where I am trained back in Hong Kong the students need to hold pad for each others and I would like to advance my pad holding skills.

Thanks to Kru Sam who sets me a professional standard in pad holding, and does not bother to correct every of my postures! He corrects me immediately if anything goes wrong. The 6 days learning is well-planned, build up bit by bit daily - ABCDE, as Kru Sam describes in his simple by effective English. At the end of the course I feel very confident to hold pad for my fellows back home. I have developed a even stronger sense of distance, that is extremely crucial in sparring too. Also super thanks for clinging with me everyday in regular PT class.

Thanks to the manager, the kitchen staffs who make my smoothie every morning, the house keeping ladies and all fellow students who train with me. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Miranda!

reviews.name: M V
reviews.text:
I stayed at Sumalee for two weeks and had a really great experience. As a beginner in Muay Thai, I truly appreciated the supportive and welcoming community. The trainers are attentive and adjust to your skill level, while still encouraging you to push your limits and improve each day.

I also loved having access to yoga classes, healthy food options, ice baths, and massage services - it really supports recovery and overall well-being. For anyone new to Muay Thai, I think this is an excellent camp to start your journey.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you!

reviews.name: Abigail Daly
reviews.text:
I had an amazing week at Sumalee Boxing Gym. The Muay Thai training is challenging in the best way—they push you just enough to make real progress without feeling overwhelmed. I learned a lot in a short time and felt myself improving every day.
The staff are super friendly and always happy to help, which creates a really welcoming vibe. The food is really good, it’s healthy and balanced with a varied menu of both Thai and western food.

Rooms are cleaned daily, with fresh towels and water bottles provided. The pool and sunbeds are perfect for relaxing between sessions, and the yoga classes and massages were a great way to recover and reset.

I’m leaving feeling stronger, more disciplined, and already planning to come back—next time for longer!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Abigail!

reviews.name: Ayame van Beusekom
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful week at Sumalee staying at the camp, training and enjoying everything they have to offer.

Everything at the camp is well organised from the accomodation, to training, booking PT’s, food, laundry etc. everything you need is on site, making it stress free so you can focus on training.

I particularly enjoyed doing one on one sessions with head coach Keng, as he specifically worked on areas I wanted to improve on, and has an abundance of knowledge and techniques.

The food at the nutrition station had an awesome variety of nutritious and delicious meals which helped us fuel and recover from all the training. Was stoked that there was so many different ingredients and local fruits/ veges used.

The staff and coaches are all super friendly and there is overall friendly and energetic vibe amongst everyone at the gym.

Thank you Sumalee coaches, staff and Sam for a fantastic week!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Ayame

reviews.name: Ruben
reviews.text:
It was my first time doing muay thai, the trainers are super nice (and funny) thay train you super well, have a good eye for your needs and level of experience, and its all wrapped up in a playfull trainingsession. The avaiable 1 on 1 sessions really help to elevate your technique, and all the trainers are very experienced. The camp itself is really nice aswell. There's plenty of ways to recover and relaxe and some great food aswell!
Highly recommend coming here if you want to up you muay thai game or just experience it for the first time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks, Ruben!

reviews.name: happywaller
reviews.text: This is single handedly the best Muay Thai experience I've had in Thailand. I've been here multiple times, to many gyms, in many parts of Thailand. Not only is Sumalee warm, welcoming and friendly, the trainers are all different and experts in their own styles. They are fun, friendly, and never leave you to figure things out on your own (as I've seen in other gyms). Sam and Sun is also very helpful and there if you need anything. The facilities are top notch - swimming pool, good rooms, great food, and yoga as well. Most importantly, it seems to be a hub for open minded travellers who are here to improve and enjoy their time. No egos. Just good vibes, the love of Muay Thai and travel. This place is also perfect for beginners, but is also good for experienced students. I will 100% be back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Cheers, Joe!

reviews.name: Rico Siaron
reviews.text:
Hi, I hope you and the owner will take this matter seriously. If you need to contact me, I’m currently in Chiang Mai. This is not my first time visiting your massage shop. I was here about 4–5 months ago for a 90-minute session to treat my office syndrome. The therapist I had at that time was excellent and really relieved the pain I was experiencing. Last week (mid-November), I returned for the same treatment and clearly mentioned it to the staff. However, I was assigned a different therapist. The pressure she used was generally okay actually a bit soft, but I felt that she was pressing on the wrong spots on my back. At one point, it became difficult for me to breathe. To be fair, she did ask me if the pressure was okay or if I was hurt, and I said it was fine because the pressure itself wasn’t the issue. She focused heavily on my back and shoulders, and also massaged toward my head and arm using her elbows and other techniques. My concern now is that my right upper back has been hurting ever since. I can barely lift my right arm, and pushing it backward is very painful. This has been very disappointing. Please, if possible, ensure that all therapists receive proper and thorough training before being assigned to clients.

Thank you so much for today. I truly appreciate your response. I'll definitely go back for the next two massages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
🙏🏻❤️We were truly sorry to learn that your recent massage experience with us did not meet your expectations or was not entirely satisfactory. Please accept our deepest apologies for any disappointment, discomfort, or frustration this may have caused you.
Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we regret that we fell short of delivering the high standard of service we aim for. We take your feedback seriously and are using it to review and improve our services immediately.
We understand that an apology alone cannot rectify the experience, but we sincerely hope you will give us another opportunity to show you the quality of service we are known for.
Should you choose to visit us again, we promise to ensure your next experience is exceptional and tailored precisely to your preferences. We would be honored to have the chance to make things right.
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

reviews.name: Harry Earle
reviews.text:
My partner and I decided to splash out on treatments at the same time. I asked if they could focus on specific areas such as my lower legs, my shoulders, my forearms and my left hand which was really painful, gesturing clearly to show them.

My partners treatments were good. My massage was good in parts but of the areas I mentioned, the masseur only focused on my legs, and kept pressing my knees painfully into the hard massage table (I have had a lot of massages before and never experienced this so I don't know what was wrong here.) By the end of the massage my neck was aching from the face pillow being quite high. I was a bit confused at times why it didn't seem like my focus areas were being attended. After we had left my partner mentioned that his masseur focused on his left hand quite a bit, and we realised that somehow he had been given the massage meant for me. I am really frustrated about that as I was not expecting to leave so dissatisfied after a 2 hour massage.

title: Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa
subTitle: อันดามัน คาเนเซีย รีสอร์ท แอนด์ สปา
description: Refined property with polished rooms, suites & villas, plus a 3-tiered pool, a restaurant & a spa.
ownerDescription: Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa is located at Kata Beach, Phuket, Thailand. This is the wellness hotel which recommend to everyone who like to stay in quiet area surrounded with mountain and few minutes walk to the beach.
address: 212 Kok Tanod Rd., Kata Beach, T.Karon, A.Muang, Phuket 83100, Thailand
street: 212 Kok Tanod Rd., Kata Beach, T.Karon
plusCode: R872+48 Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand
hotelDescription:
This polished resort overlooking the Andaman Sea is a 6-minute walk from Kata Beach and 10 km from the Wat Chalong Buddhist temple.
 Offering balconies, the refined rooms feature satellite TV, minibars, and tea and coffeemakers; some have sea views. Villas and suites add living rooms, whirlpool tubs, outdoor sunken hot tubs, and/or private gardens.
 A free beach shuttle is available. There's a laid-back restaurant with a terrace; breakfast is offered for a fee. Other amenities include a coffee shop, and a 3-tiered outdoor pool with a poolside bar, plus a hot tub and a spa. There's also a gym and a reading room, as well as gardens with cabanas.

reviews.name: S S
reviews.text:
I have a mixed review.
Location was great however be warned the hotel is located on a very steep hill.  The hotel provides a bus shuttle service every hour which we only found out on day 2. They are very close to kata beach and shops.

Staff, although very friendly the communication is shockingly poor.  One staff member says one thing, the other says something different.   It seems the hotel are more concerned with people taking stuff and wrecking their rooms than actually providing people with a great service.  They just nod and smile to everything.

Also you need 3,000 Thai money for deposit.  We were never informed about this prior to arrival but they use this money for any marks in the room.  However it is OK for the hotel to provide dirty linen on the beds with pen marks? Clearly they are trying to blame the new guests for the damage so they can earn extra money.

Lack of communication regarding what they offer I.e. we had an excursion at 7am and was never informed about the pre order of breakfast box.

If they communicated, be honest, let people know the rulings etc, the stay would of been OK.

Beautiful setting, pool is luxurious and nice and quiet.  Stunning hotel.

Verdict I would say 6.5/10 for a 4*.

reviewContext.Rooms: Ok but dirty linen and don't take anything from the room.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Our stay at this hotel was amazing! The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive — they truly go above and beyond. Even when we had to check out early, they prepared a breakfast box for us to take on the road. Such thoughtful service! Everything was perfectly taken care of, down to the smallest detail. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: JK
reviews.text:
Update: staff were quick to resolve the issue below, even had a nice chat with Manager Micky who was very kind to present a fruit platter. Fingers crossed no more hiccups until checkout. Will update review at the end of the stay.
Original review:Welcomed by dead lizard in the room. Rudely shut down when asked for more water because it’s a hot day. Front desk staff rudely said “didn’t you get two bottles? That is all you get! Anymore go and buy yourself!” Even water , a simple necessity is being rationed by this expensive hotel. But they advertise in the room, ‘Please enjoy continuous access to fresh water (see picture)
Simply blown away but I strongly believe this isn't Thai service. Hope hotel fixes this issue fast

reviews.name: Prayash Poudel
reviews.text:
I’ve traveled to many places, but my experience at Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa was honestly quite unusual.
The staff were polite and attentive, but at times it felt a bit forced, as if they were trying too hard rather than being naturally welcoming. There were moments when I felt slightly different from other guests, almost like I didn’t quite belong. It’s hard to explain, but there was a subtle feeling of being left out, which made the stay a bit uncomfortable.
That said, the location of the resort is excellent. The view of Kata Beach from the property is absolutely breathtaking. From the outside, the resort looks beautiful and well maintained, and the overall setting is impressive.
However, the room itself was disappointing. The interior felt quite empty, with very minimal amenities. For a couple, I was surprised to be given a double bed instead of something more suitable. I had made my booking a month in advance, so I expected better room preparation and overall comfort, but unfortunately, I wasn’t satisfied with the room provided.
The breakfast was good, and the property facilities along with the location are definitely the strongest aspects of this resort. Overall, while the views and location are amazing, the room experience and overall comfort did not fully meet my expectations.

reviewContext.Rooms: Still not sure who gives a double bed for a couple?

reviews.name: peter c
reviews.text: I stayed here last July with my partner. We had a lovely 2 weeks in the sun, all the staff were welcoming, polite and friendly. The different pools were lovely to swim in and the food was very tasty in the restaurant and room service. The shuttle to Kata beach is very helpful as the hill is quite steep.

reviews.name: vaida mockuviene
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa Phuket. The hotel is beautiful, peaceful, and perfect for a relaxing holiday. Every staff member was friendly, professional, and always ready to help.
A very special thank you to Manager Micky, who made our stay even more memorable. She was incredibly kind, welcoming, and always smiling. No matter what we needed, she was always there to help and made us feel truly valued as guests.
The food was delicious and always fresh, the rooms were cleaned every day to a very high standard, and the shuttle bus service to the beach was very convenient and appreciated.
Everything about our stay was excellent, and we would definitely love to come back again in the future. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: J Ch
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful room, and a nice, relaxed, chilled vibe. Staff were always so nice and friendly – Micky is hands down the loveliest person we've met even after a good year in Thailand. Definitely will come back for a visit!!

Highly recommend to anyone wanting a nice place to stay and relax. Close enough to walk down to Kata, but equally just as easy to get a Grab anywhere.

reviews.name: Marcus RM
reviews.text:
Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa was truly a perfect stay.

The resort is beautifully located on a hillside overlooking Kata Beach, and the elevated position gives you breathtaking panoramic views of the bay. We had the most incredible sea view from our room — honestly one of the best views I’ve ever had from a hotel. Waking up to that turquoise water and enjoying sunsets from our balcony was absolutely unforgettable.

The room was spacious, clean, and very comfortable. The décor felt elegant with subtle Thai touches, and the large balcony made the most of the spectacular surroundings. Everything was well maintained, and housekeeping kept the room spotless throughout our stay.

The pool area is beautifully designed with lush greenery and multiple levels, creating a calm and almost tropical sanctuary feel. I loved spending time there during the day, relaxing and enjoying the view over the ocean.

Breakfast had a good variety of options and was a great way to start the day before heading down to explore. One of the big advantages of staying here is the proximity to Kata Beach’s restaurants, cafés, shopping, and nightlife.

We didn’t use the hotel’s shuttle service. Instead, we used the hotel’s own walking path down to town. It only took about 5 minutes to walk down. And from there, it’s only about 2 minutes before you’re standing on the beach. Kata Beach is absolutely amazing — wide, clean, turquoise water, and a fantastic atmosphere. It’s honestly such a great beach and one of the highlights of staying in this area.

The service was very good. From the moment we arrived, the staff were welcoming, attentive, and professional. Check-in was smooth, and throughout our stay we felt well looked after — whether at breakfast, by the pool, or whenever we had a question. The hospitality added a personal touch that made the whole experience feel even more special.

Overall, Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa was perfect — stunning sea views, comfortable rooms, a beautiful pool area, excellent service, and easy access to everything Kata has to offer. I would absolutely stay there again and highly recommend it to anyone wanting both scenery and atmosphere in Phuket.

reviews.name: イワナ
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing stay! The hotel exceeded all expectations – stunning sea views, beautiful rooms, and a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

Everything was spotless, well-maintained, and very comfortable. The garden and terrace are gorgeous, perfect for unwinding.

Breakfast was very good, with plenty of options to choose from. Every couple of evenings, the hotel organizes live music with a small band, creating a lovely atmosphere. They also offer an all-you-can-eat dinner option at a very reasonable price, with good and enjoyable food.

The staff is exceptional – kind, professional, and always attentive. A special thank you to the manager, Miky, who truly made our stay perfect with her warmth and dedication.

Highly recommended – a place I would happily return to!

reviews.name: isaac 033
reviews.text: We were treated very poorly at this hotel. When I asked the receptionist for a pair of scissors to cut a dress for my partner, she refused, claiming it was too dangerous. As for the food, the two room service meals I ordered were terrible. There were also some potato chips in the room that I ate, only to discover they were expired; I suffered from a stomach ache for two days, yet they still charged me for them. Finally, we left behind a luxury belt worth €300; they claimed there was nothing in the room, even though we knew it was there. This hotel is terrible—I do not recommend it at all.

reviews.name: Rares Mulea
reviews.text: We had a excellent time here. Everything was amazing. The room was more than we needed, the staff is very friendly. Beautiful pool are, with a jacuzzi, sunbeds and a terrace with a view to the ocean ( Kata beach). I really recommend this place!

reviews.name: Beth Benn
reviews.text:
Such a beautiful hotel. The rooms were brilliant and huge! We had a ground floor room with a patio with access straight to the Jacuzzi and pool which was a lovely surprise. The staff are very friendly and always willing to help (except for the end of the stay which I will get too), and very happy always saying hello! The location is lovely and the views from the stairs at the back of the hotel are beautiful of kata beach. The roof is also an amazing place to watch the sunset. Tui however claims it to be on a hill but it’s basically a mountain no seriously, it is a pure workout going up it, so if you can’t do very steep roads at like a 35% incline then I would use the shuttle all the time or get bolts or taxis instead, we did a mix of the 2, but it’s a killer trust me haha.

Overall a lovely place to stay, very relaxed, calm and beautiful, also very authentically Thai with some modernisation but it’s honestly stunning. The food was hit and miss to be honest but not too bad.

At the end of our stay when we checked out and got our deposit they tried to say we had drunk 2 bottles of water from the minibar, we didn’t. We didn’t drink or take anything in the fridge or room that was chargeable as they made that clear at check in, we always went to 7-eleven or the mini mart to get our drinks unless we brought them through room service or at the bar. It was an unpleasant experience to end our trip after 2 weeks, we even showed pictures that they were still there before they touched or cleaned the room, and at 6am in the morning when you are trying to leave for the airport, it was very annoying. Ultimately we paid the 90 baht because we didnt want to miss our transfer to the airport and couldn’t stand there arguing about it but we made it clear it was disappointing and not a good end to our stay. We spent a lot of money on their services and food which is why we used some of our deposit to pay for the things we had billed to our room. We still came away with just over 1000 baht from the 3000 you must pay on check in, it was just that we knew we hadn’t touched any of it and just seemed calculated and orchestrated in my opinion.

reviews.name: Nadine Dib
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel with our family and booked a total of three rooms.

The service was extremely disappointing. Prior to arrival, we confirmed our booking, including the provision of one extra bed. This was approved both over the phone and in writing via Booking.com, with confirmation that the quoted price was the total amount. However, upon arrival, the room was not set up as agreed, and we were informed of an additional charge, despite prior confirmation that no further costs would apply.

Cleanliness was also a major issue. The rooms were not properly cleaned, with dirty sheets being placed back on the beds. Our rooms were consistently cleaned last, which resulted in us frequently being left without essential items such as toilet paper, towels, and clean bedding.

In addition, housekeeping routinely attended our rooms around 5:00 pm, which is an inconvenient time when guests are preparing to go out for dinner. On multiple occasions, cleaners entered the room after knocking, even when we asked them to wait briefly so we could dress appropriately. This was uncomfortable and unacceptable.

Overall, this stay fell well below acceptable hospitality standards, and we would not recommend this hotel to others

reviews.name: Gülfem Dikici
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, our experience at this hotel was very disappointing. The room is extremely old, poorly maintained, and has serious hygiene issues.

The bed sheets and pillowcases were stained and yellowed. Instead of a single fitted sheet, two separate stained sheets were joined together on the bed, and even the mattress protector underneath was visibly out of place. There were also pen marks on the pillowcases, which clearly shows a lack of proper cleaning standards.

There were no towels in the room upon arrival; they were only provided after we requested them. However, there is no place in the bathroom to hang towels at all. Additionally, there is no proper shower threshold, so water flows directly from the bathroom into the room after showering. The hair dryer is practically useless — it turns on, but has almost no drying power.

The slippers provided in the room were unwrapped, clearly used, and worn out, with loose straps. When we asked for new slippers, we were told there were none available. This is unacceptable from a hygiene perspective.

The furniture is very old and worn, the wardrobe interiors are poorly maintained, and there are visible cracks and paint defects on the walls. The room layout is also extremely impractical.

Overall, the room looks exactly like what you see in the photos — old, neglected, and poorly maintained. I would definitely not recommend this hotel to anyone who expects basic cleanliness, comfort, and hygiene. It is absolutely not worth the price.

reviews.name: Connor Archer
reviews.text:

House keeping were slow ans had to ask a few times to get things sorted, new towels, split bed etc. But more a note rather than a complaint, soon fot sorted.

reviews.name: Karderia
reviews.text: I had a great time staying at this hotel. The staff was incredibly accommodating and kind. My room was upgraded, which I was very grateful for. The check-in process was swift. The accommodation was clean, roomy, and had a great partial view of the ocean. I received a very wonderful birthday greeting on my bed. They also surprised me with a lovely fruit platter on my birthday for breakfast. I had a wonderful visit.

reviews.name: Ar.Krutika Gharat
reviews.text: The resort overall was good and well maintained. The topography and layout inside the resort are very nice and give it a pleasant, peaceful vibe. However, the room did not have a window, which was a drawback. The location is not very happening and not within walking distance of shops or other places, so commuting is required. That said, the view from the resort deck was great and very relaxing. The food was good, and there was one Indian staff member at the reception available 24/7, which was helpful. Overall, a decent stay with a few limitations.

reviews.name: Mark Pitts
reviews.text:
We have enjoyed going to this Sense location in the past, but I had to give it 3 stars for their inconsistencies in terms of trained staff.
Lately it seems that it is not a dependable spa that we can go to any longer for a good massage experience. There are several staff members who obviously are untrained or inexperienced (or both), or worse, they just seem not to care about making your experience a happy and relaxing one that is worthy of their higher fees.
We most likely will not be returning to this spa again, and I won’t recommend it to others.

reviews.text: The massage is rejuvenating and relaxing. Delicious tea and snacks before and after the massage. It is a great way to spend our last hours in Chiang Mai! 🥰
