reviews.text: 100% recomendable. I took the herbal + oil massage package 120min for 38eur (1400bt) price is obviously higher than in most of Chiang Mai places but the reason is clear...it is SUPER hygenic. Massage was absolutely great. They offer welcome and goodbye drink and staff is super nice.

reviews.name: miriam ben
reviews.text:
Beyond massage! We chose a 4-hour route that included a scrub, a Thai yoga massage, a deep tissue massage and a Thai herbal ball. The women are professional and the experience was amazing and powerful. A lovely and cozy place, the best masag we've experienced so far in Thailand
(and this is our third one just for this
😊 week) worth a visit

reviews.name: Natthaphon Sueb-Am
reviews.text: Great experience at Sense Garden Massage & Spa in Chiang Mai, Thailand! It's wonderful. The place cozy and warm, and that you received the best quality of service.

reviews.name: Jas
reviews.text:
An absolute waste of money to do oil massage here. They literally only rub the oil on you….. the “massage” is so light you can barely feel anything. That’s 700baht for someone to just apply oil on me. My friend who took the “hot oil” massage (800baht) had the exact same experience and the best part? The oil is not even warm. There’s also no shower offered for us to rinse, unlike other massage places we have been to.

Another friend did not enjoy her head, back and shoulder either. She felt sore after. She did the same service with 3 other massage places in Chiangmai and this was the worst for her too.

All there is to this massage place is the aesthetically-pleasing interior.

If you would like to visit, you can try other services if you are up for it.

reviews.name: Paulina Barron Escalante
reviews.text: Incredible spa, the most amazing staff with the best quality and options for massages. We did a full 2.5 hours with deep tissue and Thai ball massage and it was great! The foot scrub was great as well! Facilities are luxurious. Lavender tea is great.

reviews.name: Hui Ying Chin
reviews.text:
Highly recommended. Very experienced and skillful practitioners. Get the package, the Thai yoga, herbal ball and oil massage a divine treat for 2.5 hours. I wish I can go back every week. They serve tea and snacks for free as well. Such a gem in the old city. The facilities is so calming and beautiful.

Came back today for another 2 hour session in paradise. They are super professional and the vibe is so relaxing. The snacks and tea are super delicious. There's toilet and free luggage storage if you need it. Really wish I'm here to come every week. Definitely get their packages or at least 2 hours. You'll never regret it!!!

reviews.name: Andy Lo
reviews.text:
My Wife and I found this place to be at the TOP of the best massages we’ve ever had. And we go frequently all of Asia.

The experience was purposeful and every detail was considered. We opted for the deep tissue massage. And the masseurs were very skilled to the point they know where We needed additional attention.

reviews.name: Anant Sukha
reviews.text: This was an amazing experience, one I have never had before. The place was calm with a great modern  interior. The traditional Thai massage was increadable, great focus areas and lovely stretchs,  not forgetting parts I never tought they were tight getting some care. I would recommend coming here, I would easy come again. Thank you so much Na and everyone at Sense Massage&Spa (Arak)

reviews.name: Chia Hui
reviews.text: Hands down the best massage we had in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai. Their deep tissue massage hits all the right spots in relieving knots and tensions. Feels so much better after each session. It is also priced quite affordably. We came here twice throughout our stay and will come back again if we visit in the future.

reviews.name: Nico
reviews.text: Sense Massage and Spa is a clean and fresh looking establishment. Everything looks spick and span with modern aesthetics. There's decent lighting and good air conditioning all around. Unlike many massage places, it's not cramped and there's a sense of space. Starts off with a good foot bathe and scrub , and a cold tea drink. The masseur who attended to me did a pretty good job, not the best I've had, but sufficient in strength and technique. They would've gotten 5 stars if not for the policy of removing shoes outside - where there are no seats to do so. Customers end up sitting on steps and putting their bare feet on the side walk. Totally out of character from the rest of the operation.

reviews.name: Umut Deniz
reviews.text: Worse than average massage with higher price compared to the similar scale places. Had much better massages in thailand with some reasonable prices.. not only me but my friend had the same comment…

Clean and cozy massage place with professional
masseuses. I like the ambiance. Makes me feel relaxed. I love that they give welcome drink and post-massage tea.

My wife and I opted for the 60 minutr oil massage followed by a 60 minute foot treatment. It was only 1200 bht for the package but 900 bht per person with the discount. My dogs were barking and back was in aching by this point in our trip. Walking out I felt like a new man!

reviews.name: Sébastien Roy
reviews.text:
I just visited Kiyora Spa Chiang Mai and had my very first facial ever - the Bio-Essential Normal Skin Facial. I regularly get full-body Swedish massages in Canada from licensed therapists every week and a half to two weeks, so I’m used to a certain professional standard. This was not only my first facial ever, but also my first massage experience in Thailand.
And I was genuinely impressed.

From the moment we arrived, everything felt elevated. The decor is calm, beautiful, and thoughtfully designed - a noticeable step above many typical spa settings. The environment is peaceful, smells amazing, and everything is extremely clean. The staff welcomed us warmly, and when we mentioned we had just come off a train and hadn’t had time to shower, they immediately offered us one, which was incredibly accommodating. We were also served tea and crackers to start - a very thoughtful touch.

The facial itself was exceptional. I honestly did not think my skin could feel this good afterward. The attention to detail and level of care were on par with, and honestly comparable to, the licensed therapists I see back home in Canada. I had my treatment with therapist Jamie, who did an absolutely amazing job - professional, gentle, and clearly very skilled.

At the end, they even give you a small gift to keep and serve mango with sticky rice along with tea, which was a lovely way to finish the experience.
This was my first spa experience in Thailand and my first facial ever, and it set the bar very high. Highly, highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Sébastien, for your detailed and heartfelt review! We’re truly honored that your very first facial and your first massage experience in Thailand took place at Kiyora Spa and that it met the high standards you’re used to in Canada. It’s wonderful to know you found our decor calm and elegant, the environment peaceful and beautifully scented, and our staff warm and highly accommodating. We’re especially glad we could help you freshen up after your journey with a shower and a welcome of tea and crackers.

We pride ourselves on training our therapists in both technical skill and attentive, personalized care, and we’re so pleased that Jamie’s Bio‑Essential Normal Skin Facial left your skin feeling as wonderful as you described. The small gift and the mango sticky rice with tea are our little way of sending you off with a smile.

We warmly invite you to return to Kiyora Spa whenever you revisit Chiang Mai for another refined and relaxing spa experience. We’d be delighted to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Joseph Diaries
reviews.text: As a chain of Massage Spa in Thailand. Experiences totally varies; my friends actually had nice experience and quite relaxing, but not totally. They say they wanted to sleep, but they just can’t relax that much, they had the aromatic oil massage and got a Mango Sticky rice afterwards. I like the welcome drink, but should have been provided much earlier to make you totally set your mind to relaxing. It was my first time getting a massage, but it felt too painful. I thought it was normal, but my friends didn’t experience the same. Too much elbow on my back. Also, we didn’t get a mango sticky rice, we got only a pack of coconut crackers 🤣. I know our massage wasn’t as expected as the others, but the price is only 300baht different. I wouldn’t say it is bad, but I wouldn’t also say it is the good.

reviews.name: Helen Do
reviews.text:
I went there four times: once for a facial and three times for a foot massage.

First of all, it’s a clean space, which I believe they work hard to maintain, especially considering that the surrounding streets are full of huge rats. Because of that, I would recommend taking a taxi there in the evenings.

When you arrive at the salon, they offerу you tea and give you a tablet where you mark the areas that should be avoided (in red) and the areas you want massaged. You can also choose the pressure level. Unfortunately, that is where the usefulness of the tablet ends. The massage therapists do not seem to look at it at all and simply follow their usual routine. They do not even care if you clearly mark certain areas as “avoid.” The therapist will still go over those red zones with a stick, pressing harder and harder until tears come to your eyes.

When I asked for the tablet in complete shock and pointed at the red zones, the therapist simply said “Sorry, sorry” and continued. That was my last massage there. I never came back after that.

The second massage was actually good. That therapist understood that lymphatic drainage massage should generally move upward rather than rubbing evenly up and down. That was the best session out of the three.

During the first massage, however, the therapist kept pressing only downward the entire time. My poor lymphatic system had no chance to drain upward. It felt awful.

I also went there for a facial, and that experience was wonderful. I would definitely recommend the facial treatments.

The reception staff also have a rather strange approach to booking clients. The first time I called to book a massage, they told me there were no available appointments that day. The second time, they said the next available slot was in four hours. However, in both cases I was able to book an appointment online for just one hour later — and even with a discount. Honestly, I do not understand why they work in such a careless, “couldn’t be bothered” way.
The funniest part was that they actually tried to hand me the tablet so I could leave a review right there in the salon. I told them that was probably not a risk worth taking, because the review would not be very flattering. But after thinking about it, I decided to write it here instead.

reviews.text:
I had a massage here today after finding the place on Google Maps. At the entrance I specifically told the receptionist that I wanted their best therapist and that I would leave a Google review. She assured me they had a very good therapist, so I agreed. They took a 350 baht advance payment and brought me upstairs.

The massage setup was uncomfortable. The massage table was completely flat and did not have a face hole, which made lying face down quite uncomfortable for the neck.

There was also no relaxing background music at all, which is very unusual for a massage place and made it harder to relax.
During the session, the therapist was chewing gum and continuously talking in Thai with another therapist nearby. It was distracting and unprofessional. I get massages regularly and I have rarely felt this bored and uncomfortable during a session.

More importantly, the therapist repeatedly tried to apply pressure directly on the spine. I had to warn her several times to stop. Direct spinal pressure can be risky and should be avoided.

Overall, this was not a good experience and I would not recommend this massage shop.

The visit felt quite disorganized from the start. We walked in from the street and were signed up for a foot massage immediately, but the staff didn’t seem very welcoming or attentive, and the atmosphere felt chaotic rather than relaxing. Noone washed our feet.

At one point, two massage therapists were called in from outside. They appeared to come directly from the street and were not dressed in proper uniforms, which felt unprofessional. That said, the massage itself was actually very good and skillfully done. The therapists did a great job. She was very kind.

Unfortunately, the ambience made it hard to fully relax. The environment didn’t feel calm or well managed, which affected the overall experience.

There are plenty of nearby places that offer better organization and a more relaxing atmosphere at the same price, so I would recommend considering those instead.

She disappeared, and no one returned or provided any explanation.
The situation became even worse because of the receptionist. Instead of apologizing, the receptionist said, “Shut up.” That response alone speaks volumes about their standards of customer service. She is rude and not fit to deal with customers.

title: Top Thai Massage @Sukhumvit 49
ownerDescription:
Top Thai Massage @ Sukhumvit 49 is the perfect destination for the best massage experience in Bangkok. reviews.name: Vanessa Gracia
reviews.text:
5 years living in BKK, and this place is now officially my favorite place for thai massage. I had thai massage with tiger balm, much needed for my sore muscles. Therapist was polite and the massage technique was on point, pressure was perfect without me even giving instructions.

The place itself looks aesthetic, clean and clearly well maintained.

reviews.name: Rebecca Thomas
reviews.text: Had a 30 minute food massage for a very reasonable price. The service is very good with welcome drink on arrival and tea offered once your massage is completed. The facilities are very clean and a relaxing atmosphere. Khun Pui was very skilled and used the appropriate pressure throughout. I would recommend and return.

reviews.name: Jeanette Jane
reviews.text: Not the best, and not the worst massage for me, although my husband specifically asked for light pressure before the massage began and was left with hand/ nail marks on his back. He also told them it was too rough for him during the massage.

reviews.name: Antonia Peters
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Wonderful Experience at Top Thai!

I messaged Top Thai via WhatsApp to ask about their prices, and within minutes they replied with a full list of services, prices, and even some special offers. Super efficient and friendly!

I booked a 90-minute foot scrub and foot massage for 8pm. When I arrived, the lovely woman at reception greeted me warmly, took my payment, and showed me to my seat. The ambience was beautiful — not like your usual Thai massage place. The seating was very comfortable, and they even provided a soft, fluffy blanket to make you feel extra relaxed.

There was a couple chatting nearby, and the staff kindly asked them to keep their voices down — something I really appreciated since I came to unwind and switch off.

The massage itself was second to none. Even though it was a foot massage, the therapist worked all the way up to my thighs, which was a nice touch, and finished with a relaxing neck massage. Afterwards, I was guided to another seat and offered a cup of tea. Sitting there, sipping my tea while watching the rain, was the perfect way to end the session.

I would totally recommend Top Thai to anyone looking for a relaxing and professional massage experience. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Food & Travel lover
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Found this place by chance while walking near our accommodation. They have a happy hour from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. The place is clean and well-organized. My therapist was very professional and did an amazing job — my wife was also very happy with her massage. They offered tea and water after the session, and all the staff were friendly. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great Thai massage!

reviews.name: Zaiisha
reviews.text:
I recently had the chance to visit this massage center, conveniently located just opposite Samitivej Hospital. The location itself is a big plus—if you have some free time while waiting at the hospital, this is a perfect escape to relax and unwind.

From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with a soothing atmosphere. The interiors are clean, calm, and tastefully decorated, creating a peaceful ambiance that immediately puts you at ease. The staff welcomed me with a refreshing drink, which added a thoughtful touch to the overall experience.

The center spans three spacious floors, all well-maintained, including the washrooms, which were surprisingly spotless—a small detail, but one that matters. The massage itself was very good; the therapist was professional, attentive, and skilled in technique. Every motion felt purposeful, easing both physical tension and mental fatigue.

After the massage, I was offered a warm cup of tea, which felt like a gentle ending to a calming journey. I would confidently give the ambiance a 5 out of 5. This place is a hidden gem for anyone looking for a quick getaway in the middle of a busy day, especially if you’re near Samitivej Hospital. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: My husband and I just left this place and I’m still floating  The service is outstanding from the second you walk in: super friendly, warm smiles, and genuinely kind staff that make you feel instantly relaxed and welcome.I went for a foot massage + back massage combo and… wow. The foot massage was honestly the best I’ve ever had in my life. Perfect pressure, amazing technique, no discomfort at all—just pure bliss. The back massage was just as fantastic; it melted all the tension away and left me feeling light, loose, and completely renewed.I can’t say for sure if it’s “the absolute best in the world” (everyone has their own favorites), but what I can tell you is that the whole experience was fantastic from start to finish. reviews.text: Super good massage place next to my home! The staff are very friendly and professional. I highly recommend the foot massage — it’s amazing. I’ve been there many times and always leave relaxed.

reviews.name: kyoko G
reviews.text:
Amazing place and massages ! Went 3 days in a row. The cleanest, newest place I have seen in bkk.
My mother and I visited the place several times within our short stay because it was really great. I brought her there as I used to visit the older sister outlet but this one was closer to our hotel. Honestly so glad we came here, the cleanliness and the luxuriousness is unbelievable for the price ! Recommend you visit when in bkk ( loved all the massages but favourite was Thai).

reviews.name: Amber Duns
reviews.text:
Not a great experience for me even though I had high hopes because of the great reviews and the fairly high price for Thai standards.
Salon looks very clean and neat.

I chose 30 mins neck and shoulder massage (350 baht). I was seated in the open area where all foot massages are given, on the foot massage chair with clothing on.

Massage felt very rushed and movements didn’t feel very consistent. First half of the massage was 40% headscratches, but also quite rushed.
Nothing to cover your face/eyes and lighting in the room was very harsh and bright.
Second half of the massage I had to sit on the foot bench. This was nice, she was really working on my knots and I enjoyed this part of the massage.

Overall not very relaxing and not the experience I’ve had with massages in Thailand. I would not return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback and we’re truly sorry your visit didn’t meet expectations. We appreciate your kind note that the salon is clean and neat.
We take your comments seriously—especially about the massage feeling rushed/inconsistent, the bright lighting, and the lack of face/eye cover, as well as the seating setup in the open foot-massage area. This is not the relaxing experience we aim to provide.
We will review this with our team and improve the consistency of technique and the comfort of the environment. If you’re willing, please contact us directly with the date/time of your visit so we can follow up properly and see how we can make this right for you.
Thank you again for helping us improve.

reviews.name: Ian Whitney
reviews.text: Had the loveliest of massages at the spa. I had the aromatherapy with warm oil for 90 minutes and my wife had the same with a body scrub. The massage itself was fantastic. You can have it at any intensity you like. I chose medium. As a man who has had similar Thai style and oil fusion massages in London, I found it to be the right level of deep tissue and tension relieving. If you are someone who doesn't want to feel firm to strong tension and then release, then you should opt for the lighter intensity. Regardless the masseuse will increase or decrease the pressure to your liking so feel free to speak up. Understand there is an element of Thai style to the aromatherapy and oil message so there will be stretching towards the end although it is not the focal point of the massage. The facilities are very clean. The staff are incredibly professional. They start with a foot wash so check that box is definitely checked. They will alter the room temperature to your liking. You do not feel rushed in any way. No one is yelling. It is a calm serene environment and well decorative. Very warm and relaxing. It is well worth the price. I've read the reviews of many other spas in town so spent over an hour doing my research (I like a good massage and I'm picky about where I spend my money). This was a great experience and I would definitely recommend this place and come back. The price is more expensive than others, but here, you definitely get what you pay for.

I opted for the Aromatherapy Massage; it was gently as requested, but she massaged all of the spots, even some I never knew I needed! She braided my hair and tied it back when she sat me up to rub my back in a seated position, and she combed my hair. Wow. It was finished with a cup of warm tea and sesame rice biscuits with cashews and honey. From
Start to finish this was a top notch experience and if you’re at The Chiang Mai Old Town as a guest for 2+ nights a 2-hour session is complimentary and it’s hard to believe it is. A MUST visit if you’re from the States and want a truly memorable, relaxing experience. And I highly recommend the hotel; the hospitality is top notch, the rooms are beautiful and spacious, the food here is excellent, the staff is so helpful and always smiling. Cannot say enough amazing things!!!

reviews.name: Annie Li
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the service at the Chiang Mai Pavilion branch. I paid 2,300 THB for a Hot Stone SPA, but the experience was a nightmare.
The massage technique was unprofessional—after I asked for more pressure, the therapist began using their elbows to poke my bones harshly, which was very painful. Furthermore, the stones were far too hot on two separate occasions, causing me to shout in pain due to the lack of temperature control.
When I complained, the staff’s attitude was dismissive. They told me "there's nothing they can do" and the manager only offered a ridiculous 5% discount (around 115 THB) as compensation. This is unacceptable for a reputable brand like Let's Relax. Save your money and go elsewhere where they actually care about customer safety and professional service.

The ambiance was serene, and the staff were incredibly attentive. The massage therapist worked out all the knots, leaving me feeling rejuvenated.

Highly recommend for a tranquil retreat in the heart of Chiang Mai. Love the surprise mini treat of the mango sticky rice that taste so good!

reviews.name: Lucia LI
reviews.text:
I visited Heavenly Spa Old Town today with my mom, sister, and 9-year-old son. The environment and rooms are nicely set up, and my sister enjoyed her Thai massage while my son liked his foot massage.

However, my mom and I booked the herbal massage (750 baht/60 min) and were placed in the same room. Unfortunately, the two masseuses talked loudly and laughed in Thai throughout the entire session—we couldn't relax or rest at all. When my mom turned off the AC because she was cold, the masseuse said she was hot and turned it right back on. The AC was so strong that even I felt cold.

At the end, as we were trying to rest for a few minutes, one masseuse suddenly spoke to us very loudly and rudely in Chinese saying "change your clothes!"—no courtesy or patience.

I spoke to the manager on-site about all of this. She apologized but took no real action. No offer to adjust the bill, no acknowledgment beyond a quick sorry.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback with us. We sincerely apologize that your experience with your mother did not meet the standard of comfort and relaxation we aim to provide at Heavenly Spa.

We are glad to hear that your sister and son enjoyed their massages and that you liked the environment and rooms. However, we are truly sorry that the herbal massage for you and your mother was disrupted by loud talking and laughing, as this should never have happened during a relaxing treatment.

We also apologize for the discomfort caused by the air conditioning and, especially, for the way our staff spoke to you when asking you to change clothes. We understand that the tone and manner of communication made you feel uncomfortable, and we take this matter seriously.

Although our manager apologized to you at the time, we understand from your feedback that this did not feel sufficient, and we are sorry that we did not handle your concerns better on the spot. We will be reviewing this incident with our team, including our standards for quiet treatment rooms, communication with guests, and attentiveness to individual comfort.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention. Your feedback is important to us and will help us improve our service. We sincerely hope that we may have the opportunity to provide you and your family with a much better experience in the future.

reviews.name: Rohit Dhawan
reviews.text:
I will compare this to the one I visited in Pattaya( Grand honey massage 3). I went there on 8th March 2026. It was around 2 PM. The owner of this massage centre as per staff is a Korean and they provide Chinese massage ( although on website they mentioned japanese style massage). I am not very particular about what kind of Nuru massage I get as long as it is Nuru massage. Although the girl that I hired did not wear chinese clothes at all, so I don’t know why they called it Chinese massage. Anyways when you enter, they don’t show you ladies face to face. You have to select them from the photos. Now I understand photos can be highly edited and hence not right source of information to select a perfect lady. I selected the one whose age was 26. She was 36-24-36 size. All this information was mentioned on the photo itself. As per the staff she is one who is teacher of all masseuse in this massage centre and she will be a good masseuse. And she looked beautiful too in her photos. So I selected her. Then I waited outside for smoking when I saw a girl in hoodie entered inside the building. I went inside the building too and found out she was going to be my masseuse. I went with her inside the room. The room was shady compared to one in Pattaya. In grand honey massage 3, room actually looks like a hotel room. While in this building ( and I selected vip one), the room was very shady ( like a proper red light area). I asked girl her age because she nowhere looked like 26. She tells me she is 29( I was like of-course you would say it’s 29 because 29 makes other feel like you are still in your 20s while still making sure that you do not look too much older for your marketed age)

The girl was a very good masseuse I have to say. The massage was much better than the one I received in Pattaya. I understand now why she is teacher of all masseuse. But she had wrinkles on her face. I only had one shot with her( I bought 2 shots though) because I didn’t found her beautiful enough to have sex.

When I raised this issue of age ( “26 on photos” vs “29 as per masseuse” vs “35 age as per her looks”) with the staff after the service. They told me you could have raised the concern to us and we would have changed the woman. But they should have told me that there was such policy while showing me photos. You can’t expect the customer to take the risk of no service being provided with no refund. I trusted them that they are telling a good amount of truth based on photos.

If any massage centre asks you to choose ladies based on photos, run away. They are probably scammers
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello, first of all, thank you for your valuable and honest review.
We are not a business that provides Chinese-style massage, and we have never described our service that way. It seems there may have been a misunderstanding or incorrect information conveyed.
The tablet PC selection system is a method we use to improve the quality of our service. Our top priority is customer satisfaction.
Regarding the room environment, since we are an erotic massage establishment, the lighting is intentionally kept dim and atmospheric, similar to other businesses in the same industry, rather than bright lighting.
You mentioned that you were satisfied with the service, but also stated that you paid the price twice but only received the value of one payment. This part is difficult for us to understand. You also mentioned that you were not satisfied with the appearance, but if you had informed our staff immediately before starting the service, we would have gladly changed the staff member until you found someone you liked.
We never force customers or behave rudely. All of our staff always try to maintain a friendly attitude and provide the best possible service.
If you visit again in the future, we will do our best to provide an even better experience. Please feel free to let us know your preferred style next time.
We hope to welcome you again with a smile.
Thank you.

reviews.name: Daniel_D
reviews.text:
Good service from the front desk, mid massage. Overpriced.

Came here the night before to book a massage and an onsen package. They told me to confirm the booking via Instagram. Due to some scheduling conflicts I wasn’t able to go to the onsen session but made it in time for the massage.

Thankfully the front desk lady was very understanding and she quoted me a new price for a 90 minute massage. It was my first massage in Bangkok so I didn’t know what to expect, but she charged THB 1,500 for a traditional dry Thai Massage, which I later learned is about double the price of neighboring massage shops.

Facilities are quite standard for a mid-high end Southeast Asian massage spot— foot bath, complimentary refreshments, tea.

However, the massage itself was below standard. The pressure from the masseuse was inconsistent and she was quite rough with my joints when doing manual stretching. The AC was also set too cold in the room, and she didn’t speak English so it was difficult to communicate to her to turn it down. The massage was not relaxing. For the price they charged at THB 1,500, I could have gotten an oil or aromatherapy massage for 2 hours at a shop closer to my hotel.

Went at 11am and the shop was entirely empty.

Overall:
- Good customer service. Kind, polite, understanding and flexible staff.
- Clean facilities.
- Disappointing massage, wouldn’t try again.
- Price is on the high side.

I didn’t come for the onsen, which other reviewers have said is good, but considering the prices it might be better to just go elsewhere. If they run a discount I’d be willing to give it a shot though.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us. 

We truly appreciate both your positive comments about our front desk team and your honest concerns.

We’re glad to hear that our staff provided kind and understanding service, especially with your scheduling situation. However, we sincerely apologize that the massage experience did not meet your expectations.

Regarding the pricing, we aim to reflect our service quality, environment, and overall experience, but we understand that value perception can vary, especially for first-time visitors to Bangkok. Your feedback helps us reassess this.

We are especially concerned to hear about the inconsistent pressure, discomfort during stretching, and room temperature. This is not the standard we strive for. 

We will address this with our team to ensure better communication, technique, and guest comfort moving forward.
Your comments are very valuable to us, and we will use them to improve. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much better and more relaxing experience.

reviews.name: BKK snap & bite
reviews.text:
An Elevated Massage Experience in the Heart of Bangkok

Today, I had the opportunity to enjoy a massage on the 30th floor of a centrally located venue in Bangkok—and it was nothing short of exceptional.

From the moment I arrived, the reception team stood out with their warm, welcoming demeanor. Their level of attentiveness and hospitality surpassed that of any other branch I’ve visited, creating an immediate sense of comfort and care.

The massage itself was equally impressive. The therapist demonstrated remarkable skill, applying precise pressure and intuitively targeting the right spots delivering a deeply satisfying and effective treatment.

Overall, this was a truly memorable experience. From service to technique, every detail was thoughtfully executed, leaving a lasting impression of quality and professionalism

reviews.name: Kannika Rangsang
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my visit to this branch. The environment was quiet and calming, perfect for switching off after a long day. The service was smooth from start to finish, and the staff made me feel well taken care of my treatment was both relaxing and effective, especially for relieving muscle tension. I’d say it’s a reliable place for a good spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Maelys
reviews.text:
I recently had the chance to visit this place, and it turned out to be one of the most satisfying spa experiences I’ve had in Bangkok.

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere immediately felt calm and welcoming. The space is beautifully designed, clean, elegant, and softly lit, with a subtle aroma that helps you unwind almost instantly. Despite being located in a busy part of the city, it feels very private and peaceful inside.

The staff were professional and attentive without being overbearing. Check-in was smooth, and they took the time to explain the treatments clearly and make sure I was comfortable. Small touches like the herbal drink before the session and the cool towel really added to the overall experience.

I went for a Thai massage, and the therapist was excellent skilled, intuitive, and able to adjust the pressure perfectly based on what I needed. It felt both relaxing and therapeutic, especially for relieving tension after a long day. You can tell they are well trained and experienced.

The treatment rooms were spotless and well maintained, with comfortable beds and just the right ambiance to help you fully relax. I also appreciated how quiet everything was, no loud noises or disruptions, which made it easy to disconnect and recharge.

After the session, they served tea and mango sticky rice, which was a nice way to ease back into reality. It didn’t feel rushed at all, and I liked that I could take a few extra minutes to sit and relax before leaving.

Overall, I’d highly recommend this branch of Let’s Relax Spa if you’re looking for a high quality massage experience in Bangkok. It strikes a great balance between professionalism, comfort, and value for money. I’ll definitely be coming back again.

reviews.name: Natali
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with this salon. I visited twice in April for a one-hour oil massage and did not enjoy it at all. The room was too cold (around 23°C), which made the whole experience uncomfortable. The actual massage lasts about 50 minutes, and the remaining time is spent wiping off the oil with towels that quickly become cold, making you feel even colder.
Also, it is very unpleasant that immediately after the massage they bring a tablet and ask you to leave a review. At that moment you just want to relax and enjoy the after-feeling. If you want reviews, it would be more appropriate to ask during tea time, not right after the session.
Overall, the atmosphere is not welcoming, and the therapists seem unfriendly. I will not return and do not recommend this place.

Halfway through the session, she seemed too lazy to move my feet and just tapped them instead of lifting them slightly. Her elbows were on the chair the whole 60 mins and overall it was a very sloppy job. (Second red flag)

When my sister closed her eyes to rest, her masseuse stopped massaging and appeared to rest instead. In my case, the pressure was extremely light throughout and there was no attempt to adjust or check. (Third red flag)

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional and did not match expectations.

reviews.name: Tawan Wongkatay
reviews.text:
My massage experience at Let’s Relax Spa Grande Centre Point Ploenchit is the most impressive. I had a massage last year. I used to think that massages everywhere are the same. But since I came here, it's like I found a new place to relax my body after a hard day's work.

When I came here, everyone treated me like a princess. Starting from the moment I entered, the receptionist invited me to sit down first. After that, we talked about the packages, which she recommended very well. If I wanted to relax, I should choose an aroma oil massage. The therapist changed my shoes and washed my feet without feeling embarrassed.
And willing to hold my feet. During the massage, it was very comfortable beyond words. I recovered from the fatigue that had accumulated for a long time. If we talk about the atmosphere here, it is the most perfect with 30th floor. It smells good, clean, quiet, comfortable. I like this place very much and hope to come back here again. I definitely recommend this place.

reviews.name: Nijaya I
reviews.text:
Cool, cozy, private spa on 30th floor of grand center point, pluenchit. Nice underground parking.

Clean, roomy and well designed interior with details of seating , foot washing area, private foot massage zone. Clean restroom

Nice well come cold drink and good bye warm tea with special thai snacks.

reviews.name: Kristine Edemska
reviews.text:
Let’s Relax Spa was the highlight of our first day in Bangkok! From the moment we arrived to the Grande Centre Point hotel, the spa service was exceptional, with every detail carefully thought out. The facilities were immaculate and beautifully polished, creating a serene and relaxing environment.

The treatment itself was incredible, and the thoughtful post-treatment touch made it even more memorable. We were served a soothing cup of local relaxation tea alongside a delicious mango sticky rice dessert—a perfect end to a perfect experience.

Highly recommend this spa for anyone looking for top-tier relaxation in central Bangkok!

reviews.name: eric h
reviews.text: Best massage spa i have been in my life. Fantastic price, service and massage on the top floor (31?) in a five star hotel. Started with hot tea and towel, getting feet washed and clothes changed, followed by a relaxing massage and finished with delicious mango glutinous rice. I won't miss it when i come to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Dan Nordby
reviews.text:
Easily the best massage I have ever had. My massage therapist was called “Thanyakarn” and she was extremely skilled, accommodating, and deceptively strong. I’m an ex professional rugby player, so my body is full of injuries. Rather than taking the easy way out and skipping over my injured areas (my lower back for example), Thanyakarn altered her pressure and movements so that I was still able to experience the relief that massage provides without causing me any pain whatsoever. And the best part was that she was actually happy to accommodate, giving me the space to talk openly about my injuries without feeling like I was a burden.
Also, I often find it difficult to find massage therapists who are strong enough to provide the firmness that my body requires. I was blown away at her grip and strength. Not to mention, she kept the same amount of pressure for a full 2 hours and 15 minutes. I’m genuinely impressed!
Highly recommend for athletes and people who need firm/very firm massages (though I’m sure she is great doing medium & light pressure too). Will definitely come back. Even if I’m not staying at this hotel, I’ll come just to come here and just to see her.
Reception was also extremely pleasant. 5 star experience from start to finish. Provided delicious cold tea (drank most of it before taking picture) & a cold aromatic hand towel when I came in and hot herbal tea & a tasty snack when I finished. 10/10 recommend!

I had the facial and the hot herbal compress massage today, and it was one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had.

I’ve been dealing with really tight shoulders and back muscles, and the hot herbal compress helped release the tension almost immediately. It was incredibly relaxing, and I felt so much lighter afterward.

The facial was equally impressive. The results were instant—I could actually see a more defined jawline right after the treatment, and my skin looked brighter, firmer, and more refreshed.

I highly recommend both treatments if you’re looking to relieve muscle tension and give your skin an immediate glow.

Thank you Orn❤️

This treatment is more of a deep tissue massage and stress relief of the facial muscles, instead of a standard facial skincare treatment. I have accumulated a lot of tension in my forehead and jaws over the years due to work stress, and Orn’s massage has really helped me relieve the tensions and it felt absolutely amazing. She applied a wholistic approach to entire face, neck, head areas. Following the session, I can see, and more importantly, feel the immediate results on my face. Orn is very kind and very experienced in this space.

Again, I would HIGHLY recommend anyone who experiences tension on their face or is interested in this type of treatment to give this a try!

The space is intimate and refined, far from the typical mass-market massage studios. It’s run by a wonderful lady whose professionalism, warmth and attention to detail make the experience feel truly personal. I will certainly return. Easily one of the best massages I’ve had in Thailand!

Orn specialises in face massage, and she’s amazing. She releases all the tension not only from the face but also from the neck and the upper chest area. I left feeling completely renewed and balanced. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jules Richards
reviews.text: Orn is a highly qualified and experienced massage practitioner who gave me an incredible neck, shoulder and head massage as part of her deep face massage experience. Her communication through FB was prompt and helpful, enabling me to book ahead, and her treatment unlocked the jamming I had causing headaches. I would highly recommend her deep face massage with the puffiness and lymph that she shifts from your face. I am going to try some of her techniques now I am home! Thank you so much Orn for your skill, generosity and a beautiful experience. You will absolutely get what you pay for at Healing Hands. Amazing!

reviews.name: Angelika
reviews.text:
This is not one of those typical walk-in massage places you find on every main street. It’s a small, cozy salon run by a lovely lady who truly cares about her clients. From the very beginning, you can feel it’s not a mass-service business – everything is done with attention, warmth, and real skill.

The massage itself was excellent. I could literally feel the muscle tension melting away. It wasn’t just random pressure, but a thoughtful and professional treatment. Before starting, the therapist asked if it was my first Thai massage – such a nice and caring touch. After the session, we had a short, friendly chat, which made the whole experience even more personal.

The place is not located on a main street, but it’s absolutely worth the short walk. I’ll definitely be going back and already recommend it to my friends. So far, it’s the best massage I’ve had in Thailand. Also, an important plus – the lady speaks very good English, so communication is easy and comfortable.

title: Le Karn Spa & Beauty
ownerDescription:
Last arrivals accepted until 22:00

Welcome to Le Karn Spa, a premium massage and beauty sanctuary in Bophut, Koh Samui. Designed with elegance and attention to every detail, our space offers a refined and deeply relaxing atmosphere dedicated to your well-being.

We offer a full range of professional treatments including massage, facials, manicure, pedicure, hair spa and waxing, all performed in private rooms for comfort, discretion and total relaxation.

We use premium brands such as Clarins, Gelish, Footlogix... selected for their quality and performance, ensuring visible results and a high standard of care.

Located in the heart of Bophut, we welcome both tourists and residents seeking a peaceful and high-quality spa experience. 🙏😊
address: 17/9, Bo Put, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
plusCode: H26C+GR Koh Samui, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: Ekaterina Vasileva
reviews.text:
Everything is the best! There is a lot of attention to details, tea and hot/cold towels before and after massage, everybody is so nice! The massage is perfect too!
Definitely must visit place

The prices is 100% affordable for such quality
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Everything is the best? Wooo… we’ll happily take that 😄✨

We’re so glad you noticed all those little details : the tea, the hot/cold towels, the treats, the design… for us, a great spa experience is about all five senses, not just the massage itself.

From what you see, smell, taste, hear, and of course feel during the treatment. We want every moment to feel special.

And thank you for mentioning our pricing too. We always try to offer high-quality treatments while keeping them accessible.

Hope to see you again soon at Le Karn Spa 🙏  It just makes sense ...😊

reviews.name: Ed Lee
reviews.text:
The place feels calm, clean and comfortable, and reception was efficient and we were served drinks immediately while deciding on the treatment.
Nook and Rat attended to us and they were always checking with us if we were comfortable with the strength. I enjoyed the oil massage with hot compress. It was a relaxing moment and i would love to go for anither round soon! Credit card payment additional 5% charge, do note.

Update: i came for my 2nd round 2 days later and went for an aromatherapy oil massage. My masseur was fabulous and the stretch and kneading was great..after the massage we were served hot tea and some biscuit snacks. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for such a detailed review 😊

We’re very happy you enjoyed the calm atmosphere, the welcome at reception, and especially the care from Nook and Rat. Checking the pressure throughout the massage is something we consider essential, because a good treatment should always be adapted to the person, not just follow a routine.

The oil massage with hot compress is a lovely combination for releasing tension and completely switching off, so it’s great to know you enjoyed it.

We hope your “another round” happens very soon at Le Karn 🙏😊

reviews.name: Vivienn Fekete
reviews.text:
I had a 90-minute head spa with facial treatment and overall it was a lovely experience. I had to wait 30 minutes before my appointment, but they kindly offered a free foot massage, which turned out to be one of the best I’ve had on the island!

The head spa itself was wonderful, with shampooing, masks, treatments, and steam using different techniques. The facial was also very relaxing, and my skin felt incredibly smooth afterwards.

The only downside was that the last 30 minutes were spent blow-drying and styling my hair. I have naturally curly, frizzy hair, and unfortunately the stylist didn’t ask how I wanted it finished. I arrived with my natural curls, but after a long blow-dry with a small brush, my curls were gone and my hair became quite frizzy.

It felt disappointing that one-third of the head spa time was dedicated to styling that I hadn’t requested. I would have preferred to spend more time on the spa treatment itself. My suggestion would be to ask clients beforehand whether they would like their hair styled, especially those with curly hair.

Overall, a relaxing experience with great service, but this small change would make it even better.

reviews.name: Chris Ginefra
reviews.text: Just enjoyed a great couples oil massage. Very impressed with the quality and service for the price point. Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed your couple’s oil massage 😊

At Le Karn, we aim to offer more than just a treatment — with private rooms, personalized attention, and a calm atmosphere designed for deep relaxation.

We also truly appreciate your note about the value. It means a lot to us that you feel the experience reflects a fair and thoughtful price for the level of care and service provided.

Our vision is to create a complete journey that engages all five senses, making each visit truly special.

We look forward to welcoming you again soon at Le Karn ! — it just makes sense...

reviews.text:
An absolutely wonderful spa experience from start to finish! The facility is spotlessly clean, and the calming décor instantly puts you at ease the moment you walk in. The staff are professional, friendly, and communicate excellently in English ;)

The massage was top-notch skilled, professional, and exactly what I needed. We booked the private room for two, which was beautifully maintained, comfortable, and very relaxing. Perfect for a couples' treat!

What really stood out was the complimentary drinks and snacks upon departure a thoughtful and well-presented touch that left us feeling truly pampered.

Highly recommend this gem to anyone looking for a quality spa experience. Will definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this amazing and detailed review 😊✨

At Le Karn Spa, we truly believe a spa experience should awaken all five senses : the calming decor you see, the relaxing music you hear, the scents in the air, the tea and treats you taste, and of course the feeling of a great massage and attentive care.

So it makes us genuinely happy when guests notice all those little details, because that is exactly the experience we try to create every day.

We’re also very glad you enjoyed the private couple room and the professionalism of our team 😊

Thank you again for your recommendation, and we’ll be very happy to welcome you both back again soon at Le Karn ! 😊  It Just Makes Sense...

reviews.name: Rosa Rios
reviews.text:
Wow, I felt so relaxed the moment I sat down, greeted with a Butterfly Pea tea, cooling towel, and confirming my choice of services. So inviting and warm personalities from everyone!

I ended up getting a deep tissue massage and herbal compress. The knowledge and technique my therapist had was absolutely amazing. She hit all the right spots giving great relief! I have a laborious job and of course had pains from traveling so the muscle and joint relief was GLORIOUS. The deep pressure was perfect for my liking but I know it could be too much for others, so definitely be aware of your preferences. The therapist kept checking in, so I am sure she could've easily held back if she needed to.

The herbal compress was a great addition for just everyday stress. Being on vacation the herbal smell, warm feeling, and relaxing pressure definitely allowed me to relax, forget any worries, destress, and rebalance my senses and nervous system.

And the hospitality did not end there, upon exiting I was greeted with a nice warm towel, ginger tea, and thai taro pudding ☺️. All my senses were satisfied throughout my experience and thank you Le Karn Spa & Beauty for such great care and attention!! 🥰🫰🏽💆🏽‍♀️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such an incredible review 😊

Reading your words honestly gave us goosebumps. You described our vision better than we ever could ourselves.

From the Butterfly Pea tea and the calming atmosphere, to the herbal aromas, the therapist's technique, the warm towels, the ginger tea and the homemade taro dessert... our dream has always been to create an experience that awakens all five senses, not "just" a massage.

We often say that a treatment should be something you see, hear, smell, feel and even taste. The fact that you noticed every one of those details tells us we achieved exactly what we set out to create.

Thank you as well for mentioning your therapist's technique. Deep tissue massage is a real skill, and our team trains continuously to deliver effective treatments while adapting the pressure to every guest.

Reviews like yours remind us why all the hard work is worth it. We feel incredibly lucky to welcome guests like you.

Enjoy the rest of your holiday, and whenever you return to Koh Samui, we'll be delighted to welcome you back at Le Karn 🙏😊

reviews.name: Alexandra Becková
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about this salon because some services were excellent, while others were disappointing.

First, the pedicure was outstanding. The technician was very thorough, took great care of my skin and cuticles, and applied the gel polish beautifully. It has been almost two weeks since my pedicure and it still looks great.

The salon itself is beautiful, clean, and very professional. The hospitality is exceptional – guests are offered drinks and small snacks before and after the treatment. The overall atmosphere feels comparable to a high-quality European salon.

My husband also had a Thai massage and was very satisfied. According to him, it was above average compared to many other Thai massages he has experienced.

Unfortunately, my manicure was a major disappointment.

My cuticles were not properly treated, and the manicure already looked grown out on the same day because the product was applied too far from the cuticle area. The nail shapes and lengths were inconsistent, and even after I asked for corrections, the final result was still uneven.

The biggest issue was the nail preparation. I only had gel polish previously, but the technician treated my nails as if they had hard gel and over-filed them significantly. During the procedure I repeatedly indicated that it was painful, but the filing continued. My natural nails are now extremely thin, sensitive, and feel almost like paper. Even simple daily activities are uncomfortable.

The gel polish application itself was also below expectations. The product is uneven in several places, with visible bumps and thickness inconsistencies. Some edges were not properly finished, and the polish was applied untidily around the sides of the nails. Overall, the manicure does not look like a freshly completed professional service.

It is a shame because the salon, pedicure, hospitality, and massage were all excellent. However, due to the poor manicure quality and the damage caused to my natural nails, I cannot recommend the manicure service and would not choose it again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
**Response:**

Thank you for taking the time to write such a detailed and honest review.

First of all, we are truly happy that you and your husband enjoyed the atmosphere, hospitality, pedicure and massage experience at Le Karn Spa 😊

However, regarding your manicure, we completely agree with you: the result shown in the photos is absolutely not acceptable and does not reflect our standards at all.

As soon as we saw your message and the pictures, we contacted you immediately because we genuinely wanted to correct the situation. We first offered to redo the manicure properly, but you preferred not to have it redone. We then proposed a refund, but instead, you kindly chose to enjoy another treatment with us the following day, which we were happy to offer.

We also want to be transparent: the technician involved had unfortunately been having attitude and professionalism issues with the team for some time already. However, this was the first time she had ever neglected the quality of her work to this extent, which is why the situation shocked us as well.

She was suspended the same day and officially dismissed the following day.

This situation is deeply regrettable because quality, hygiene and attention to detail are extremely important to us. We continue training and monitoring our team closely precisely to avoid experiences like this.

We are sincerely sorry again for the manicure experience, but we are also grateful that you still appreciated the rest of your time with us and recognized the efforts of the rest of the team 🙏

We truly wish you all the best, and thank you again for your honesty and understanding.
