แนะนำอีกร้ายค่ะ ❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
This hair salon is warm and cozy with a friendly atmosphere.
The staff are lovely and attentive throughout the process.
The location is easy to find; you can drop off your child at school and get a haircut while you wait.
Highly recommend! ❤️❤️

reviewContext.Services: Hairstyling, Hair coloring, Service not listed

reviews.name: Surapa Chongsirikul
reviews.text: ร้านสะอาด บรรยากาศสบาย พนักงานน่ารักค่ะ มารับบริการแล้วสบายใจ ทำผมตรงปก ไล่เลเยอร์สวยๆค่ะ ทำสีสวย ค่าาา แนะนำค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The salon is clean, the atmosphere is comfortable, and the staff are lovely. I felt very relaxed after receiving service. My hair was styled exactly as pictured, with beautiful layering. The hair coloring is also gorgeous. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ophelia Holmes
reviews.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ ตัดออกมาตรงเรฟเลย ราคาเหมาะสม คุ้มค่ามาก แนะนำร้านนี้เลยค่ะ 😻
reviews.textTranslated: I'm very impressed! The haircut came out exactly like the reference picture. The price was reasonable and it was great value for money. I highly recommend this shop! 😻

reviews.name: Pannarucha Pansumrit
reviews.text: ประทับใจกับช่างมืออาชีพมากค่ะ ออกแบบทรงผมให้เหมาะกับใบหน้า เปลี่ยนลุคแบบผมดูหนาขึ้นเลยค่ะ 🥰🥰
reviews.textTranslated: I was very impressed with the professional stylist. They designed a hairstyle that suits my face and completely changed my look, making my hair look thicker! 🥰🥰

reviews.name: jollypink
reviews.text: ทางร้านบริการดีมากกก สระผมฟินสุด ทรงผมตรงเรฟมากเลิ้ปสุดๆ จะมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The service at this salon was amazing! The hair wash was incredibly relaxing, and the straight hairstyle they gave me was exactly what I wanted – I absolutely loved it! I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: p p
reviews.text: มาตัดผม ร้านสบายมากค่ะ ตัดสวยมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: I came to get a haircut. This salon is very comfortable and they do a great job cutting hair.

reviews.name: Montra Kaewkochum
reviews.text: มาตัดผมที่ร้านเป็นครั้งที่สองแล้วค่าาา ช่างตัดสวย อยากได้แบบไหนแจ้งได้หมดเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This is my second time getting my hair cut at this salon! The stylist does a great job; you can tell them exactly what style you want.

reviews.name: อะ นัย
reviews.text: ตัดสระดีม้ากก ตรงตามใจพี่ช่างน่ารักมากๆค่าาซ้ำแน่นอน♥️😻
reviews.textTranslated: The haircut was amazing! Exactly what I wanted, and the stylist was so lovely! I'll definitely be back! ♥️😻

reviews.name: Danaya Tunsomboon
reviews.text: ทรงผมถูกใจมากกกกก พี่ช่างคุยให้คำแนะนำดี พนักงานน่ารัก ดูแลดีค่ะ แนะนำให้จองมาก่อนนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated: I absolutely love my hairstyle! The stylist was great and gave excellent advice. The staff were lovely and attentive. I recommend making an appointment in advance.

reviews.name: ธนภร รัตนวงค์กต
reviews.text: ช่างมือเบามากๆเลยค่ะ  บริการแนะนำดีมาก  สีผมและทรงผมได้ตรง ref ราคาดีมาก ไม่แพงเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The stylist had a very gentle touch. The service and advice were excellent. The hair color and style matched the reference image perfectly. The price was very good, not expensive at all.

reviews.name: Paptawan Chaisuwan
reviews.text: บริการดี ตัดตรงเรฟที่สุด แนะนำดีมากๆ ประทับใจมากๆเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent service, haircut exactly as per reference, great advice, very impressed!

reviews.name: จิราพร จันทร์เพ็ง
reviews.text: มันเริสมากทุกคนนนนน ช่างหนึ่งรู้ใจลูกค้ามาก เรื่องทรงผม ออกแบบทรงผมให้เข้ากับลูกค้าคือดีมากก แนะนำเลยคะ เลิฟๆคะ
reviews.textTranslated: It was amazing, everyone! The stylist, Nueng, understands her customers so well. She designs hairstyles that suit each client perfectly. Highly recommend! Love it!

reviews.name: Natnicha Khamsa-ard
reviews.text: ทางร้านบริการดีมาก หลังตัดเสร็จพี่ช่างให้คำแนะนำในการเซ็ตผมดีมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The service at the salon was excellent. After the haircut, the stylist gave great advice on how to style my hair.

reviews.name: Pinto Channel
reviews.text: ร้านตัดผมที่service mind อย่างแจ่ม ขอทรงไหนได้ดีกว่าที่ขอ จากคำแนะนำที่สะสมผ่านประสบการณ์ของช่าง ร้านสะอาด กลิ่นสดชื่น เย็นสบาย 😊
reviews.textTranslated: This barbershop has amazing service mind. They deliver even better-than-requested hairstyles based on the stylists' experienced advice. The shop is clean, smells fresh, and feels cool and comfortable. 😊

reviews.name: Kimon Kimjae
reviews.text: บริการดีมากๆค่า สระผม นวดศีรษะ คอให้ สบายมากๆ ตัดผมได้ตรง Ref สวยมากค่าาา
reviews.textTranslated: The service was excellent! They washed my hair, gave me a head and neck massage, it was so relaxing. The haircut was perfectly straight, just like the reference picture, and it looked beautiful!

reviews.name: Supissara Phromphakdee
reviews.text: ตรงเวลา เราจองในเพจเฟซบุ๊ก พนักงานพูดเพราะบริการดี  สระผมสะอาดเกาสะใจมาก ตัดผมตรงตามเรฟที่ยื่นให้ ประทับใจไว้ไปใช้บริการอีกค่ะ👏👏
reviews.textTranslated: Punctual, we booked through their Facebook page. The staff were polite and provided excellent service. The hair wash was very thorough and satisfying. The haircut was exactly as shown in the reference picture. Very impressed and will definitely use their services again.👏👏

reviews.name: Karan Kamolrak
reviews.text:
ตัดผมมาหลายร้าน สุดท้ายจบที่ SENE 😭✂️
เป็นร้านที่เข้าใจคำว่า “ตัดให้เข้ากับคน” จริงๆ
ช่างดูรูปหน้า ดูสไตล์ แล้วออกแบบทรงให้เลย ไม่ใช่ตัดตามเรฟแบบทื่อๆ

คือหลังตัดเสร็จหน้าดูเล็กลง ดูสะอาด ดูแพงขึ้นแบบงงมาก 555
เซ็ตผมง่ายขึ้นอีกต่างหาก ตื่นมาก็ยังทรงดี 🫶

ร้านก็โคตรคลีน ฟีลเกาหลีมาก แสงดีทุกมุม
บริการดีตั้งแต่เดินเข้า ยันเดินออก
รายละเอียดทุกอย่างคือเนี๊ยบมาก สมกับเป็นร้านที่คนรีวิวเยอะจริงๆ

บอกตรงๆ ว่ารอบนี้คือ “หล่อขึ้นแบบเห็นได้ชัด”
ใครกำลังหาร้านประจำ แนะนำให้ลองสักครั้ง แล้วจะเข้าใจว่าทำไมคนติดร้านนี้เยอะ 🤍
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been to many salons, but finally ended up at SENE 😭✂️
This salon truly understands the meaning of "cutting hair to suit the person."
The stylist looks at your face shape and style, then designs a hairstyle accordingly, not just cutting from a reference picture in a bland way.

After the cut, my face looks smaller, cleaner, and more sophisticated—I was so surprised! 555
My hair is also easier to style. It still looks good even when I wake up 🫶

The salon is super clean, very Korean-style, with great lighting everywhere.
The service was excellent from the moment I walked in until I left.
Every detail is meticulously done, befitting a salon with so many positive reviews.

Honestly, this time I "look noticeably more handsome."
If you're looking for a regular hair salon, I recommend trying it once. You'll understand why so many people love this place 🤍

reviews.name: กัญญารัตน์ เวชการ
reviews.text:
บริการดีมาก สระผมฟินสุด งานละเอียด
ร้านกลิ่นหอม พี่ๆพนักงานบริการดี
ช่างตัดผมออกมาตรงเรฟฟ
🍳 ราคาดี ตรงข้ามตลาดเลย
reviews.textTranslated:
Excellent service. The hair wash was amazing, very detailed work.
The salon smells great and the staff are very friendly.
The haircut matched the reference picture perfectly.
🍳 Good prices, right across from the market.

title: T.B.M.I. (Thai Blind Massage Institute )
subTitle: T.B.M.I.
address: 89, 413 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WV29+FJ Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: JARVIS Kj
reviews.text: May I ask the owner something? Is this massage shop not accepting Thai customers? Every time I call and a woman answers, she always says it is full when I speak Thai. But when a man answers, there is available time to book. I have been to your shop 3-4 times before, and I noticed most customers were foreigners and they gave big tips. Is the reason Thai customers cannot book because they don’t tip much? When I first came, I saw this and the next time I also gave a tip to the therapist (about 40–60 THB). But now I cannot book at all. Honestly, this makes me feel very disappointed.

reviews.name: Seoyeon Ryu
reviews.text:
It was my first time to experience massage by blind people. Interesting.. although my masseuse was normal and doesn't have fascinating technique.
The location is a bit different from what Google map says but quite near by it. You can park your car at right in front of the shop. The shop is quite authentic style. Not so fancy & super clean. But it's worth to try. You will be welcomed by friendly local people and pet rooster 😅 and also few cats.. if you have phobia for birds or allergic for cat fur, this shop is not good option.

reviews.name: Lorenzo Siwadol Sias
reviews.text:
Thai massage is one of the main things you should try while visiting Thailand ans this place is perfect. Many years have passed, but this place and its workers have never changed. They are professional, available and gentle. For a modest amount of money you will get an unforgettable and regenerative massage. As you can see in the picture, there are different options to choose from, and you can also ask for something else at the reception.
Also, at the end of it, if you want, you will be asked for a free coffee/tea.
I absolutely suggest you give this place a try.

reviews.name: Marco Thomas Ranaldi
reviews.text:
Thai place is a scam, only 1 of 5 therapist in the room was blind, my therapist was able to see with no issues, and from they way the other therapists were moving things around and walk you could tell they were able to see perfectly. The massage is cheap but with not a good technique behind it.

I had plenty of thai massages and nobody ever asked me to turn and move that many times, breaking the relaxing atmosphere (she asked me to move from the lay on my stomach to a side, then other side for massaging part of my body that she could have reached perfectly and efficiently from the previous position). Also when she asked me if medium or strong, I've asked strong and she started complaining of why I prefer strong (firstly do not ask if you are unhappy to do it, secondly you should keep silence while in the room with other clients too.

They do not provide any massage clothes, they have curtains but they don't use it, so you may end up pretty much close to a person wearing only underwear, just next to you.

The location is not accurate, the place is deferred of 50/80metres on the same side of the street.

Even if prices are so competitive, I would not return in this place.

reviews.name: JudgeJudy
reviews.text: If you’d like to support a blind Thai, walk into the TBMI and hand 200 baht to the first person you suspect to be so. Then leave. Consistency is but one of the issue’s at TBMI. This massage was up there with the most technically flawed and unintuitive I’ve had. It was made worse by the distraction of four telephone calls received by another client in the massage room during the hour I was there. Sadly, this situation is not unusual at TBMI, it has become the norm. There are better massage options nearby. The trick is to find a compatible masseur and stick with them. And tip well.

reviews.name: Oliver Lee
reviews.text: Best massage ever, great value for money. I look forward to a Thai massage from here every time i come to Pattaya.

reviews.name: Андрей Железкин
reviews.text: I have been here many times. Today I ordered a Thai massage for an hour. The young administrator first put me on a decent couch, but immediately after me an English-speaking guy came and this administrator for some reason switched our places and put me on a mattress on the floor. The only decent explanation I have: a female massage therapist did the massage on the couch, and a man did it for me on the mattress. Of course, my mood was immediately dampened, for such an organization 3 stars. But the master 28 did a very high-quality and skillful massage and of course he gets 5 stars! In general, the massage therapists here are masters, the main thing is to say in advance what you want to get. Only my personal opinion!

reviews.name: Ron T
reviews.text: Fantastic massage given by visually impaired male and female massagers. Great value, 200 baht for one hour full body massage. Clean environment.  Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: jekk pak
reviews.text: Very good massages available here. Cool atmosphere. It's clean. You may want to book in advance sometimes. Masseurs talk to each other sometime while they work on you, it's funny. Terrace with tea and coffee afterwards, and the house rooster wandering around.

reviews.name: Tamiko Watanabe
reviews.text:
I had 60minutes Thai massage. The lady masseuse looked she was not blind.
My husband had blind massage.
We extended 30 minutes because they were good.

Price is cheaper compared to other places around Pattaya.

reviews.name: Danny Boccagno
reviews.text: Great experience, and the best massages I ever had,especially the Thai massage.

reviews.name: Yuri Smirnov
reviews.text: Very well trained masseurs. The Thai massage was very good, but really painful.  Foot massage is different from other places, very nice and relaxing. The oil massage is very good too. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: S K
reviews.text: Very good! Most painful 2 hours of my life but worth every bit. They feel every muscle and know where and what. Recommend learning the word for pain so u can say when it's too much. No pain no gain. If u want more make sure to ask for someone with extra strong hands! Feel great guaranteed!

reviews.name: Tr.65
reviews.text:
The first time I was here, a young man really did his job well. Excellent!

Second time, an old masseur only touched my skin without doing massage! After I complained, they changed another old masseur, bad skill. I was really uncomfortable.

reviews.name: Ria Scholz
reviews.text:
The massage was good but I didn't like the setting too much. They put up to 5 people in the same room with no curtains and therefore no privacy. It's a bit unusual and I thought it's funny to see how other tourists are getting massaged haha
But if you don't mind that, the massage is probably worth it. I felt really great afterwards. My blood circulation was evidently improved !

reviews.name: Stephen Westlake
reviews.text:
Excellent massage if you want real authentic thai massage. My masseur was very polite and made some conversation with me before starting. He was very strong and really put just the right amount of pressure. It wasn’t too hard but didn’t feel like a rub down.

Would highly recommend for anyone looking for a good authentic massage.

reviews.name: Patricia Nordmann
reviews.text: I love the massage here, I have been coming here for years and have never been disappointed. It is not like an ordinary massage institute. You will be given clothes to wear (if desired) and will be massaged alongside others. The Thai massage is a traditional massage, please check first if you like that kind of massage. It is very much about pressing and stretching the body.

reviews.name: Vlad
reviews.text: Four of us went for a massage today. It was amazing. We'd been to different places before, but this massage was deep and professional. We'll only go here from now on. Thank you.

reviews.name: Maurice Nagington
reviews.text:
Excellent massage, I had a two hour oil massage. The therapist (San?) worked very methodically but also in a way that responded to my body slowly worked deeper to relieve tensions. Excellent technique, one of the best massages I've had in Thailand (and I've had a lot). Very reasonable price too.

*Update*
Because my massage was so good, I took my Dad the next day. He is elderly and needs a hip replacement. They have him a food and leg massage which he absolutely loved, he said he had less pain and slept so well he went back again for an hour long Thai massage. He said it really relaxed him and reduced his pain even more, it also really improved his mobility. The staff were also so kind and attentive. I would really recommend, even if you have disabilities, they will help you.

reviews.name: Jacob LED
reviews.text: I had two different massage specialist both of them were really experienced and I felt very good the next day. a little annoying can be that they are talking while doing the massage but not necessarily very much disturbing. It is a very traditional place, so don’t expect western type of hygiene. But somebody can still say that it’s a clean place. People we are in Thailand this is almost a third world country, don’t expect things what you experienced in central Europe. Plus this kind of massage will never get somewhere there.

title: Fasai Massage
address: 245 577 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
plusCode: PG98+76 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Denisse Pangan
reviews.text: Don’t let the simple setup fool you—this place offers an amazing massage experience! I had a one-hour foot massage for just 300 baht, and it was worth every penny. Not only did the therapist expertly work on my feet and legs, but she also included a soothing neck and back massage, which was a delightful surprise. Despite its location by the street, the ambiance remained calm and relaxing, with only a faint hint of outside noise.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏 see you again next time

reviews.name: Aizat Nordin
reviews.text: Very good massage to end the day. Price is reasonable. Would come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks 🙏🏻 so much

reviews.name: Rūta Serapinė
reviews.text: Very good price for a massage, only 300bht for leg massage, included shoulders and neck too. If you don't mind a bit noise from outside, massage is for an incredible prices and very good.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Nabil Muzafar Shah
reviews.text: Fantastic massage!! Oil couples massage was incredible very relaxing with the right amount of pressure. Recommended 👍

reviews.name: Nanor Tashjian
reviews.text: Out of this world. This place is amazing to say the least! If you can tolerate the good kind of pain and need a break from the madness in Bangkok, this is the place. Just 300 baht for an hour of incredible Thai massage. Recommend 10000%. Thank you Nani!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏 see you again

reviews.name: Kate Targato
reviews.text: We found this place on our first trip to Bangkok and have returned again. It is a very clean massage studio. Masseurs Ladies are very good at what they do. We had very firm mattresses so were coming daily with sore backs. We had the oil and the thai massage that was helping in no time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Anna-Lena Witt
reviews.text: We have been here three days in a row. It was amazing. Especially the back, neck and shoulder treatment was relaxing as we haven't experienced jet. Been in Thailand for 3 Weeks and did have many massages on our journey, but the lady's from Fasai we recommend most! Thank you so much. Was a pleasure :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much 🙏 Fasai massage 😊 ยินดีไห้บริการ และหวังว่าจะได้รับไช้ท่านอีกในโอกาสต่อๆไป 🙏

reviews.name: Trisha
reviews.text: Awesome massage, we just walked in around 8pm and they took two of us straight away. Recommend the Thai massage for 300 baht as a beginner friendly option. Felt really relaxed. Don't be discouraged by the basic layout of the place - it's worth a visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Tracy Ho Wai Wong
reviews.text:
Very Nice massage. Masseur kept massaging with no chit chat. Reasonable price.
However Google location is wrong. It should be along the way of motorway.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks 🙏

reviews.name: Mari Ono
reviews.text: I had a great massage - perfect after walking around the city in the heat. Thank you!

reviews.name: Passion Lin
reviews.text:
I just finished Muay Thai training, I did foot massage here to relief my legs. It’s very comfortable, I almost fell asleep. It’s not only foot massage, but also a little head and back massage.

There is only one thing that can be improved. Soak foot into water before massage. That would be wonderful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณคะ ยินดีต้อนรับและไห้บริการคะ🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: chye
reviews.text:
01 Jan 2023: Excellent massage service, the masseuse was able to relieve the tight muscle knots and relax the body. Adequate strength and pressure was used accordingly to ensure maximum effect. Will come back for repeat visit.

Do make reservation in advance as it is mostly full.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much  😊 Happy new year 🎉

reviews.name: David Furlonger
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing massage.
I've had hundreds and this is definitely up there as one of the best. Great pressure and clear knowledge of the body and muscular structure. I feel like new
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Michael Hunt
reviews.text: Literally the best massage I’ve ever had! And I’ve been coming to Thailand for 20 years. This place is the bomb! I come here every time I come to Bangkok. They’ve got so many glowing reviews for a reason!! You will not regret coming here, I guarantee it! The people here are all very skilled, you will leave floating on a cloud! Highly highly recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏 see you again next time 😊

reviews.name: GUYONNET Emilie
reviews.text: Super nice ladies, very very good massages for such a reasonable price. Even though the setting is not amazing compared to spa places, it’s clean, confortable, not too noisy and for the price - super worth it! Going 2 times a week.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Matt G
reviews.text: Got a 2 hour Thai massage. The facilities are a bit cramped and dated but that can be overlooked. The message was decent but the masseuse was absolutely brutal. If you are into a very firm massage then this is your place. I also am not a fan of the stepping on your back method and that part lasted a good 15 minutes. By the end of the massage in felt that the masseuse was as much wanting to get it over with as I was.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏

reviews.name: Omri Rose
reviews.text: After having many massages in Thailand, this is simply the best.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much

reviews.name: Caren Diane Daquis
reviews.text: Sounds exaggerated but the best massage i had in my life 🤣 life changing. Always comparing this to any massage that I get around the world
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much

reviews.name: Unusual Emma
reviews.text: Superb massage place, slightly off the beaten track but very popular, so often full if you just walk in. Worth waiting for, though (or they take bookings, I think). Unlike many massage places in Thailand, here you get more than a rote massage. The ladies here will find your knots and sore spots and work on them very effectively. Great service, lovely people, and one of the best massages I had in Thailand. Can't ask for more! ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏 see you again

reviews.name: Aaron Sawyer
reviews.text:
If you are always demanding "more pressure" from your western masseuse, I couldn't recommend Thai massage enough and this place delivers the best I've ever had.
The massage therapists are friendly, polite, professional, and considerate of old injuries or past surgeries. A Thai massage from here stretches your muscles and massages while they are stretched for maximum relief. Outstanding experience. 5 stars. 🤩
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏 see you again

title: Chai Massage 2
ownerDescription:
Massage Shops in Nimmanhaemin, Chiang Mai: Chaimassage1 and Chaimassage2

If you are looking for massage shops that offer affordable prices, cleanliness, and a standard of massage in the Nimmanhaemin area of Chiang Mai, I would recommend Chaimassage1 and Chaimassage2. These two well-known establishments have gained popularity among customers for over 10 years. They are located in the vibrant Nimmanhaemin area, which is the hub of shopping and relaxation in Chiang Mai. With just a short walk, you can easily access the Starbucks and McDonald's nearby, as well as the Anantara Hotel.

Chaimassage1 and Chaimassage2 have a reputable name in the massage industry in Chiang Mai. They provide high-quality services and excellent customer care. Both sh

reviews.name: Lee Ringo
reviews.text: I like massage very much. So when I was in Chiang Mai, I tried the Chai Massage 2 a week ago. I walked in and met the receptionist - Kitty (the right hand side lady). As I am a picky guy and I asked Kitty how was the skills of their masseurs, she recommended May (the left hand side in red pant) to me and it was so surprised that she said "if you tried the massage for 10 minutes and you confirmed it was not okay. I could refund the money to you." In view of this, I tried May to have Package 1 (1 hour Foot Massage + 1 hour Thai Massage - 700 bahts). The bedding spaces there were comfortable and quiet. The music was so relax and made you sleep easily. During the course of massage, I felt good and May was skillful to touch all the points of my body.  On the other day, I tried to do massage by another male masseur, but his skill was not good enough. If you are there and u want a good massage. Why not try May !

reviews.name: Chia Jeslyn
reviews.text: Last day in Chiang Mai and wanted to get a foot massage before heading to airport. We came across this massage place, look decent and walked in. There are 2 branches, the other one just about 100-200m away. Overall the massage is good, strong enough and after massage drink and snack was good. The prices here are pretty much same around the area. Notice that the difference between a foot massage of price 300 baht and 350 baht is the initial feet washing. The chair that for foot massage also make a lot of different, those adjustable one is better.

reviews.name: Martin Leimbach
reviews.text:
After two wonderful massages at Chai Massage 2, I'd like to leave a review.

Both times, I received a warm welcome in the entrance area and was seen immediately. The massage rooms are well-air-conditioned and feature pleasant background music.

I personally found the massages—both two-hour packages for feet, back, neck, and aromatherapy—to be very pleasant and invigorating. My feet felt noticeably smoother, my back loosened, and I felt generally more relaxed and at ease. The massages were neither too firm nor too gentle. My respect goes to the masseuses for lasting two hours.

The delicious ginger tea afterward perfectly complemented the entire pampering experience.

I would gladly return for a third visit and can wholeheartedly recommend this studio.

reviews.name: Brenda X
reviews.text:
We had such a lovely experience at Chai Massage in Chiang Mai. From the moment we walked in, everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which immediately made us feel at ease.

The foot massage was honestly perfect. Not too soft, not too hard, just exactly right. What impressed us most was how the therapist could feel where the problem areas were without us saying anything, and really worked on those spots in such a skilled way.

The whole place has a really warm and relaxing atmosphere, beautifully decorated and calm. And after the massage we got tea with some cookies and a refreshing mini towel, which was such a nice extra touch.

We left feeling completely relaxed and taken care of. Definitely a place we would come back to and highly recommend to anyone visiting Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Sheng Yang
reviews.text: Nice place if you prefer a traditional massage. I actually wanted a deep tissue massage for my legs as I went a long distance cycling that day, they suggested Thai massage for me, but it was also nice, relaxed and it’s a new experience for me as a tourist. Also I think it is more traditional than those well decorated spas, both the atmosphere and the skills of therapists.

reviews.name: Nostradamus Crypto
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this massage place in Chiang Mai. The staff were very friendly and professional (Cherry is really goo), and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing. The massage was excellent and helped me feel refreshed. I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

reviews.name: Marcus Chee
reviews.text: Came back for my second visit today as it eased my right shoulder pain after the 1st visit. The massage pressure was applied uniform across my back and shoulder, I believed loosen all my strained muscles due to prolonged desk works and weekend golfs. My wife who is reluctant to go massage tried out the foot massage and enjoyed it very much that we went back for 2nd visit. Bought their rice cakes and ginger tea.

reviews.name: Cheng Guo
reviews.text: My husband and I tried foot massages in three different shops in Chiang Mai and this was the best value for money. An hour foot massage for 350 BHT and the quality was surprisingly good! In the other two places (Makka and women’s prison) they used sticks to apply pressure to our foot and toes but here the therapists just used their hands which felt more natural and comfortable to us. The front desk lady also showed a lot of care about whether we could get a taxi after and while we were waiting along the street she came out a couple of times to check on us and offered to help. All in all this is not the type of luxurious experience you would have at a resort but definitely worth the time and money.

reviews.name: Francois Boudrias
reviews.text:
I had a male therapist (I don't have his name unfortunately) and it was the best massage I've ever had. I took the thai traditionnal massage.

All pressure points were just perfect, and the place was very neat. Felt mid to higher end - yet the price point is still very reasonnable.

It was my first thai massage ever so I was a little bit worried that I wouldn't like it. Yet, after no more than 5 minutes, I was convinced that I was having a life-changing experience.

Thank you!!

reviews.name: Ahmed Zayer
reviews.text: One of the best clean massage spots in Chiang Mai… it will be my only massage place whenever I’ll be here.. the staff are so professional & the receptionist is so welcoming.. must visit place 👌🏻

reviews.name: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.text:
I am a 'two massage a week' person. I have my favourites and sometimes I try a new massage parlour for a change.

A month ago I decided to try the very popular 'Chai Massage 2' on Loi Kroh, which is between the Hard Rock Cafe and the Iron Bridge.

Many people rave about this place, so we must have had an off-night. We booked in advance and they weren't ready for us at the appointed time. They obviously bring in masseuses from outside when busy and perhaps we just had bad ones, but that wasn't all that was wrong.

The curtains were left open (very revealing) throughout the Thai massage, and I was surprised that no relaxing music was played at all - a prerequisite I would say for a good massage. To make matters worse, we had to endure a man nearby talking to his girlfriend very loudly on his phone, for about 10 minutes, until we told him to be quiet. The staff made no effort to stop his talking!

The Thai massage pretty much followed a set routine that we were familiar with, but there were two major incidents. At one stage the masseuse was kneeling hard on my arm, not uncommon during a massage - except that she seemed unaware that my arm was not on the small mat underneath, but on the hard wooden floor - and this was VERY painful! I had to stop her of course, and move to a better position myself.

Towards the end of the massage she had her full weight upon me and suddenly pushed my two arms outwards. This produced a sharp pain in my rib cage area, and I can honestly say that that pain took three weeks to fully subside.

I don't know what she did, but this sort of massaging is totally unacceptable, and I would never return there; pretty though it is on the outside.

reviews.name: Miguel Guardian
reviews.text: Stumbled into this massage place while exploring a side street just off the night market. The place was cozy and the staff were friendly and communicated the options well in English. I got a 1-hour aromatherapy (oil) massage and it was great. The masseuse was responsive when I asked her to go softer or harder throughout the massage.

reviews.name: Anny
reviews.text:
1 The lady do massage well.
2 they offer ginger tea and rice crackers after the massage.
3The room smells nice, it’s quiet and comfortable with soft instrument music

reviews.name: arroma1990
reviews.text: Very good experience. The massage was strong and with lots of techniques that Iv never experienced before. The receptionist and the masseuse are super nice and friendly. The prices are quite affordable (900 Bhat for 2 hours). The place is peaceful and beautifully decorated.

reviews.name: Leanne
reviews.text:
The place is clean and has a nice atmosphere and staff are so lovely. I wouldn’t rec  the hot oil massage -

The oil was not even lukewarm and the massage was really really painful - and I am no stranger to a strong massage but this was definitely too much for me. I left disappointed and in pain. I’ve had so many better massages in Thailand /chiang mai and sadly for me this was the worst massage I’ve had in years! Perhaps the traditional Thai massage is okay here but don’t waste money on the hot oil

reviews.name: 宗哥
reviews.text:
The interior design of the shop is quite nice, and the prices are reasonable.
However, the male therapist’s technique was poor. Massage should not rely on brute force; it requires proper skill and an understanding of pressure points.
Unfortunately, my back was strained during the session, and I am currently unable to lift my arm. I hope it recovers by tomorrow.
In addition, the shop did not adequately protect customer privacy. Although curtains were installed, they were not closed, which made me feel uncomfortable and unsure of the reason.

reviews.name: Kwan Hui Su
reviews.text: Thought about giving myself a treat to a better massage and there are two in this part of the town. The reason I chose this is they have a better deal, if you take both Thai massage and foot massage. Relaxing interior, beautiful decor! The masseur was good and also very friendly. I felt so refreshed after the massage. After the massage session, they also served warm Thai tea and some dessert made from soy which is delicious!

reviews.name: Anna Pekoz
reviews.text: Amazing place!! Had a lovely massage there today. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: G Lem
reviews.text: this place is slightly higher tier than those 200baht parlours. Facilities are much cleaner here. Packages are a good value. They also wash and use a scrub on your feet before they begin, rather than just a hot towel. This place gets booked quickly though so book a day in advance. Evening walk~in will be full. 13 Special Thai is what I had, balm is like a muscle relaxant.

reviews.name: Tam Tam
reviews.text: We had shoulder, legs & foot massage for 1 hour and it was so good. They have amazing technique and the atmosphere and host are so nice here. The people are kind and I feel so light everywhere now!

title: CORAN Boutique Spa

Same-day visits are welcome: our website shows today's open time slots in real time, and any remaining slot can be booked online instantly with immediate confirmation. Support in English, Japanese, Chinese, Thai and Korean. Open daily 10:00–21:00.

reviews.name: Lola Saidkhodjaeva
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived at CORAN boutique spa ( Night Hotel ) - Asok the experience was flawless.The ambience of the lounge was calm and elegant, making it easy to unwind, and the massage was expertly performed, leaving me feeling completely relaxed. My massage therapist, Jaa, was amazing. She was professional and really skilled. She applied the right amount of pressure and was really attentive to my needs. I also enjoyed a gentle facial treatment that complemented the overall sense of relaxation. I did 4 hours Cure of Ayurveda v4 one day and because the service was so good, I came back the next for different 4 hours package deal. The spa had promotions for spa packages. By far, it is the best spa service for the price offered and I have been to many in Bangkok so I have something to compare to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Lola, for sharing this wonderful review. We’re so glad you enjoyed the calm, elegant lounge atmosphere, Jaa’s attentive massage with the right pressure, and the gentle facial treatment, and it truly means a lot that you returned the next day after your Ayurveda package. We’re grateful you found our promotions and pricing to be such great value compared with other spas in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Rachel Lincoln
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience, I had the 3 hour long Herbal Body & Organic Facial Package. So relaxing I even fell asleep during the last part of the session. Lovely staff and great hospitality. Definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for visiting us. what a joy to hear that the 3-hour Herbal Body & Organic Facial Package left you so deeply relaxed that you drifted off — that's truly the sign of a treatment doing its work. We're glad our team made you feel genuinely welcomed throughout. Your recommendation means a great deal to us, and we look forward to having you back at CORAN for another restorative session whenever you're ready.

reviews.name: Angus Ip
reviews.text:
First time to try the Ayurveda massage, this is marvellous joy and super relaxing. Masseur was professional and provide a shower room to clean up after the massage.
Fabulous and highly recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Angus! I’m so glad your first Ayurveda massage with us was such a relaxing experience and that you felt well taken care of by our therapist. We’re happy the shower room was convenient for you afterward, and we really appreciate the recommendation.

reviews.name: Dima Istambouli
reviews.text:
It has been 2 days since I am in Bangkok. One of the main things I wanted to do is to enjoy a good massage. I tried to search for a massage place near me. The amount of massage places they have is unbelievable. While walking on the street I came across Coran. I went to level 3 to check out the place and I fell in love. The service and the information that Nam, the spa manager, shared were straight to the point. She advised about the package we should book based on the outcome we wanted. They have so many packages to choose from. After you choose the right service for you, Name present you with the different types of oil to choose from.
Ning was assigned to take care of me. We went into a super clean room, with soft music, dim light and lovely interior. Ning spent 2 hours working on every single muscles in my body. She really helped me relax and breath again. The time has passed so quickly.
After I have finished, I was offered a special tea with some dried fruits.
I loved the experience, the customer service and the value for money was amazing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Dima! I'm delighted to hear that Nam was able to guide you so well with selecting the perfect package and oils for your needs. It's fantastic that Ning helped you relax and enjoy your time here, and we're thrilled that you appreciated the tea and dried fruits after your treatment. We hope to see you again soon for another rejuvenating experience!

reviews.name: Angela Cheung
reviews.text:
I love Indian Head Massage & Shirodhara so much. Every time I go to Thailand, I would try to find a spa to have this treatment, together with other services.
I didn’t realise this was my second time I visited Coran and it was very great and luxurious experience. I felt so relaxed and comfortable. The massage therapist was wonderful with her gentle techniques and softness.
Also, the room environment was relaxing and comfortable. However, the shower room/ toilet is required to be refurbished and renovated, turned to be a more refined bathroom.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Angela, thank you for coming back and for sharing how much you enjoyed the Indian Head Massage and Shirodhara—I'm so glad you had such a relaxing, luxurious experience and felt comfortable with your therapist’s gentle techniques. We also really appreciate your note about the shower/toilet area, and it’s feedback we’re taking seriously as we work on improving and refining that space.

reviews.name: Hoa Gin
reviews.text: I visited CORAN Boutique Spa and was extremely impressed. The massage was deeply relaxing and the therapist was professional and attentive. The calming atmosphere helped me unwind completely. I also tried a facial treatment and found it very soothing. Highly recommend this spa for anyone seeking a peaceful day of relaxation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hoa, thank you so much for the wonderful review. I’m thrilled to hear you found the massage deeply relaxing, appreciated the therapist’s professionalism, and enjoyed the calming atmosphere and soothing facial. We really appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back soon.

reviews.name: Baldish Toor
reviews.text: I loved the serene atmosphere at CORAN boutique spa Night Hotel Asok. The quiet ambience and gentle lighting created pure relaxation. The staff were attentive and my first Thai massage treatment left me feeling relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommend for anyone looking for peace and tranquility in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Baldish, for the wonderful review. We’re so glad you enjoyed the serene atmosphere, gentle lighting, and our attentive team, and that your first Thai massage left you feeling relaxed and refreshed. We really appreciate the recommendation and hope to welcome you back for another peaceful visit in Bangkok.

reviews.name: mm yd
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience at CORAN Boutique Spa. The massage was incredibly soothing, the ambiance felt like a peaceful oasis, and the cleanliness was immaculate. I left feeling completely relaxed and tranquil – if happiness had a location on Google Maps, it would be here. Highly recommend trying their facial treatment too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the lovely review! We’re so happy you enjoyed the soothing massage, our peaceful ambiance, and the cleanliness, and that you left feeling truly relaxed. We really appreciate the recommendation, and we’d love to welcome you back for a facial treatment next time.

reviews.name: Luisa Kirchmayr
reviews.text: CORAN Boutique Spa is a wonderful oasis of calm. I loved the peaceful atmosphere, the soft music and gentle lighting that made me feel completely relaxed. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the facial treatment was soothing and left my skin glowing. I left feeling refreshed and ready to face the day. Highly recommend for anyone looking for peace and tranquility.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Luisa, thank you so much for the kind words. We’re really happy you enjoyed the calm atmosphere with the soft music and gentle lighting, and that our team helped you feel relaxed during your facial. It means a lot to hear you left refreshed and glowing—thank you for the recommendation.

reviews.name: Anthony Taylor
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at CORAN Boutique Spa. I had the 90min aromatherapy treatment. The environment was incredibly relaxing, peaceful and immaculately clean, which made me feel calm and fully rejuvenated. The staff were friendly and attentive, creating a serene atmosphere that let me unwind completely. I appreciated the deep tissue massage and thoroughness of the experience. I’m excited to return here again for my next visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Anthony, thank you so much for your kind words—I'm really glad you enjoyed the 90-minute aromatherapy treatment and found the spa relaxing, peaceful, and spotless. It means a lot to hear that our team helped you fully unwind and that you appreciated the deep tissue work and overall thoroughness. We can’t wait to welcome you back on your next visit.

reviews.name: eleonor henderson
reviews.text: Nam and Phot were so professional and kind! Phot work was heaven to my tense body. The onsen was warm and soothing, the sauna helped me unwind, and the massage was exactly what I needed to release tension. The whole environment was calm and tranquil, perfect for relaxing after a busy day in Asok. I also enjoyed a gentle facial treatment that left my skin feeling refreshed. I will definitely return for another peaceful experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Eleonor, thank you so much for visiting CORAN boutique spa at Night Hotel Asok and for sharing your experience. We’re so glad Nam and Phot made you feel well cared for, and that the onsen, sauna, massage, and facial helped you fully unwind and feel refreshed. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back for another peaceful reset.

reviews.name: francesca sanchez rodriguez
reviews.text: I had a wonderful visit to CORAN Boutique Spa. The massages were unbelievably relaxing, the ambiance was soothing, and everything was spotlessly clean. I especially enjoyed the facial treatment that left my skin feeling refreshed. The staff created a calm atmosphere that made me forget the outside world.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Francesca! I’m so glad you enjoyed the relaxing massages, our soothing ambiance, and the cleanliness of the spa, and it means a lot to hear the facial left your skin feeling refreshed. We’re happy our team could create a calm space where you could truly unwind.

reviews.name: Matthew Rivera
reviews.text: I had a wonderful massage at Coran boutique spa ( Night Hotel ) - Asok. The therapist was skilled and the environment was calm and soothing, making it easy to unwind. This was my first Thai massage and frankly i didn’t know what to expect but i enjoyed every minute. Thank you to the wonderful people!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Matthew! I'm delighted to hear that you enjoyed your first Thai massage at our spa and appreciated our skilled therapist and calming environment. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing experience!

reviews.name: J a (Ja)
reviews.text:
Excellent experience! Booked an oil massage + Indian oil head massage, therapist Salee is very professional with gentle and skilful hands, good attention to small details too.

The place is clean, comfortable and relaxing, with spacious room. If u need to wash your face don’t forget to bring your own face moisturiser.

I will definitely return in my next visit to Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Ja! I'm glad to hear you enjoyed your oil massage and Indian oil head massage with Salee. It's great to know you found our spa clean, comfortable, and relaxing. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Bangkok!

reviews.name: may Take
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Coran boutique spa Night Hotel Asok. The atmosphere was incredibly relaxing, calm and serene, and the amenities made me feel completely at peace. I especially enjoyed the facial treatment and left feeling refreshed and tranquil. Excited to return here again for my next visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, May! We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and amenities at Coran boutique spa, and that the facial treatment left you feeling refreshed and tranquil. We look forward to welcoming you back for another peaceful visit soon!

reviews.name: Pat O
reviews.text:
I have visited Bangkok twice and both times I got the 4 hour aromatherapy package basically as soon as I landed.

Honestly, this treatment is so good that it prevents any jet lag and sets me up for the whole trip. It's magic and I'll be doing it again next month.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The whole team at CORAN is so pleased to hear this! Landing in Bangkok and heading straight for a four-hour aromatherapy session sounds like the perfect way to begin a trip — and knowing it's become your personal jet lag remedy genuinely warms our hearts. We'll be ready to welcome you back next month, refreshed oils and all.

reviews.name: Jean-François Dupont
reviews.text:
From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the exceptional level of professionalism demonstrated by the entire team. Any initial hesitation quickly disappeared thanks to their warm welcome, confidence, and genuine attention to detail.

The spa environment is beautifully designed—calm, refined, and impeccably maintained—creating a serene setting that immediately encourages relaxation. What truly sets this place apart, however, is the outstanding quality of the treatments. Every step of the facial was performed with precision and expertise, combining gentleness with remarkable effectiveness.

The massage was profoundly soothing and expertly delivered, reflecting a high standard of skill and care. The team’s professionalism, technical mastery, and commitment to excellence made the entire experience feel truly premium. I left feeling completely relaxed and confident that I was in the hands of highly trained specialists. I will absolutely return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Jean-François, thank you so much for your kind words and for noticing our team’s professionalism and attention to detail from the moment you arrived. We’re really happy you enjoyed the calm, refined atmosphere, and that both the facial and massage felt gentle, effective, and truly soothing. We’ll be honored to welcome you back to CORAN boutique spa (Night Hotel) - Asok a スパ.

reviews.name: Anne Castillo
reviews.text: I had a genuinely delightful massage experience at CORAN boutique spa (Night Hotel) with the Deep Tissue Massage with Hot Oil. surrounded by calm and serene ambiance, it was the perfect way to unwind. The skilled therapist effectively worked out all kinks, leaving me feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. Also helped with my back ache.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Anne! I'm glad to hear that you enjoyed your Deep Tissue Massage with Hot Oil at our spa. It's wonderful to know that our skilled therapist was able to help with your back ache and make you feel relaxed and rejuvenated in our serene setting.

reviews.name: Takamitsu Matsuo
reviews.text: The massage was deeply relaxing. I also enjoyed Shirodhara treatment. Overall a wonderful experience for anyone looking for relaxation and a soothing day spa visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Takamitsu—I'm so glad you found the massage deeply relaxing and enjoyed the Shirodhara treatment as well. We really appreciate your kind words, and we’re happy CORAN Boutique Spa could be a soothing, restful day spa escape for you.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text: Great services and they are very thorough with their treatment. Shower with relevant amenities are available for cleaning up after the oil treatment. Will return for their treatment next time.

reviews.name: R J
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved training here! Went 3 days in a row as I couldn't get enough. Great trainers and amazing atmosphere. The team are super friendly, fun and welcoming, and they make you feel comfortable no matter your level. In the short time I was here, the trainers picked up in several errors I'm my technique which honestly made a HUGE difference. Im so happy!

I could tell the trainers were keeping a close eye on me to see how much I could handle, which also gave me a lot of confidence.

The pad work was awesome, they held the pads really well so I could flow with my kicks and punches, and it felt both fun and effective. Really enjoyed sweating it out in the heat. Prices are very fair too. I did classes on the first 2 days and a private class on the 3rd. Wish I'd started earlier during my trip.

I’ll definitely be coming back next time in Thailand, highly recommend this place if you want a great Muay Thai experience!

Actually sad I'm going back home tomorrow! Though training here has given me back my mojo for training back at home.

reviews.name: Miodrag Popovic
reviews.text:
Hands down the best Muay Thai gym I’ve trained at in Thailand.

I’ve trained in Koh Samui and Chiang Mai, both traditional and modern gyms, and this place stands out immediately.

The environment is professional, focused, and welcoming. The staff are knowledgeable, warm, and genuinely care about their students.

Every session is well structured with a coach-led warm-up, rounds on the bag and mitts, conditioning, and a proper cool-down. Additionally, they have sparing classes available. You get the chance to put your practice in play!

The attention to detail says a lot. Gloves are replaced every six months, which speaks to their standards and hygiene.

After my first session, I bought a one-month package even though I’m only here for two weeks. If you’re in Bangkok and want serious training, a strong team, and a top-level facility, this is the place.

reviews.name: Sachin T
reviews.text:
An unforgettable Muay Thai experience!

Singha Archa is hands down one of the best Muay Thai training centers in Bangkok. The place is incredibly clean and well-maintained, with top-class trainers who truly know how to guide you—whether you're a beginner or an experienced fighter. The atmosphere is energetic and fun, filled with passionate people from all over the world.

The facilities are world-class, and it’s located right in the heart of Thonglor, which makes it super convenient. There’s even ample parking space, which is rare in central Bangkok.

What really stood out were some of the fighters here—watching them train felt like witnessing a real Muay Thai fight! It was intense and inspiring. I had an amazing time and learned so much.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience authentic Muay Thai in a professional yet welcoming environment.

reviews.name: Joel Nash
reviews.text:
The only Muay Thai gym I visited in Thailand in which I had a bad experience. The warm up consisted of some drills I had not done at other gyms and when I asked how to do them, the owner and some trainers were laughing and the owner asked ‘is this your first day ever training Muay Thai?’ In between rounds of hitting pads my trainer kept poking my stomach and laughing as if to call me fat. Maybe he thought it was funny but as I didn’t laugh or smile once, I thought he would realise I didn’t like it but he kept doing it. For sparring at the end, they stressed to me that it was light sparring. I was sparring at about 10-20% power and when my partner punched me so hard that I wobbled and was almost knocked down, I said to the trainers ‘you said it’s supposed to be light’ The trainers didn’t do anything and some were laughing.

If you are a beginner I don’t believe you should be mocked for not understanding drills. You shouldn’t be teased for being fat and you should be protected from sparring with people trying to knock you out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Joel,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re genuinely sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

I would like to clarify one point. As the owner of the gym, I do not recall ever having the conversation you described, so there may have been a misunderstanding or perhaps someone else was mistaken for me.

If any laughter or joking made you feel uncomfortable or disrespected, I sincerely apologize. That is never the experience we want our students to have. Our gym is very beginner-friendly, and we are committed to creating a welcoming and supportive environment for everyone, regardless of their experience level.

Regarding the sparring, safety is one of our highest priorities. We have seven trainers supervising our classes, and all sparring sessions are expected to be controlled and appropriate to each student’s level. If someone sparred too aggressively, we would certainly want to investigate the situation.

Could you please let us know the date and time you attended, as well as the name of the trainer you worked with, if you remember? We’d like to look into this thoroughly and understand exactly what happened.

Thank you again for your feedback. We take all comments seriously and appreciate the opportunity to investigate and improve.

reviews.name: lechi p
reviews.text:
I recently visited a head spa in Koh Samui and honestly, it was a very disappointing experience.

First, when I made the booking, they asked for a deposit. That was fine, no issue but it’s not something I usually see in Samui.

Second, when I arrived at my appointment time, I was about to sit down on the sofa when the lady on the counter called me over and told me to go to her counter and pay first. I don’t understand why the service was handled this way. If you already have the QR code ready on your phone, why not approach the customer properly instead of calling them over?

Third  and most importantly,  the service itself was very poor. The staff asked about pressure level, but the massage was extremely weak, like they didn’t want to put in any effort. On top of that, they kept pulling my hair painfully, and water even went into my ears.

It feels like there is no clear focus on what they are doing BEST. The massage was not relaxing, and even the hair wash was not done properly. I said no facial massage, but they applied oily product on my face anyway and just left it there, leaving my face and arms greasy.

When it came to blow-drying, it was also painful, with  pulling. The products used made my hair feel dry, stiff, and damaged afterward, I understand the therapist didn’t mean to pull my hair, but the products made my hair dry, rough, and tangled, which caused the pulling.

Overall, I did not feel relaxed at all, and my hair condition actually got worse. For 1,199 THB, this is extremely overpriced for the level of service provided.

For this price level, with such poor massage and lack of experience, the products used should be far better. I came in to relax a headache, but left feeling worse than before.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

We are truly sorry that your visit did not meet your expectations. This type of feedback is very rare for us, and we take it very seriously.

Regarding the deposit and payment upon arrival, we understand that it may seem unusual. However, in Koh Samui, many clients do not show up for their appointments. This is why we require a deposit at the time of booking and payment upon arrival, in order to ensure proper organization for every guest.

Concerning the products used, we would like to clarify that we work with a well-known local brand, Secret of Samui, recognized for its high-quality, 100% natural products. This is actually the first time we have received a complaint about our products, which is quite surprising to us.

As for the treatment itself, your feedback is important, and we regret that the pressure or certain techniques were not adapted to your preferences. Our team is always trained to adjust the pressure and ensure the client’s comfort throughout the entire experience.

Finally, we do find the 1-star rating quite severe considering our daily commitment and the many positive reviews we receive. We sincerely wish you had contacted us directly or spoken to us on-site, as we would have gladly taken action to improve your experience or find a suitable solution.

We remain at your disposal if you would like to discuss this further.

Best regards,
Juna Care & Head Spa Team

reviews.text:
I came to Let’s Relax Spa earlier in the day for a back massage and was genuinely impressed by the attention to detail. The masseuse was excellent at finding my knots and really working through them properly, not just going through the motions.

I really liked that they use an iPad to communicate pressure levels and specific areas to focus on — such a simple but effective touch that makes the whole experience feel more personalised and professional.

Price-wise, I’d say it’s mid-range, but absolutely worth every penny. It was noticeably better than some of the cheaper alternatives we tried the day before.

I was so impressed that I brought my family and friends back that same evening. All seven of us had an hour-long foot massage, and the verdict was unanimous — everyone agreed the standard was very high.

I had a male masseuse for my foot massage and he was excellent — strong, precise, and incredibly thorough (and somehow had unbelievably smooth skin too!).

Highly recommend if you’re looking for quality, consistency, hygiene and a proper massage experience rather than a quick budget option. We’ll definitely be back.

I had an incredible time at this spa. The service was truly outstanding—staff were warm, professional, and made me feel completely at ease from the moment I walked in. The environment is serene, clean, and perfectly designed for relaxation.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for more than just a typical massage—this is a truly unique and thoughtful experience.

reviews.text: I am a regular here with probably 20+ visits over last 3 years. P'Oh (hope the spelling is correct) continues to provide the best oil massage possible in Bangkok. Also, if you need a more technical massage, or have some pain or discomfort - definitely get a massage from the owner of the shop - she is incredibly skilled and trains all the masseuse in her shop herself. i gave you a decent review and you are defending and making excuses. I am now making it  1 star.  If your staff is tired do not put them on work.The only reason i didnt notify the owner was because i felt bad for her! And no there was no hand wash between touching my feet and face!!!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I opened this business before the COVID-19 pandemic, and it is still standing today because of our loyal regular customers.
They chose to support us because they want this shop to continue, which shows that our service has been good enough for them to return consistently for more than six years.
Our regular customers have never asked for discounts, and they continue to support us with trust and respect.
This is very different from someone who visits only once and then claims that our service or our business is not good.
I respect all opinions, but I do not give importance to unfair reviews.
I prefer to spend my valuable time taking care of customers who truly appreciate our service.
ขอชี้แจงตามข้อเท็จจริงนะคะ
ทางร้านมีขั้นตอนความสะอาดชัดเจน หมอนวดจะ ล้างมือทุกครั้ง เมื่อมีการใช้น้ำมัน เช่น เท้า / คอ / บ่าไหล่ / ศีรษะ เพื่อไม่ให้คราบน้ำมันสัมผัสส่วนอื่นของลูกค้า
ดังนั้นสิ่งที่คุณกล่าวหาไม่ตรงกับวิธีการทำงานจริงค่ะ

ส่วนการนวดไทยที่ ไม่มีน้ำมัน เราล้างเท้าลูกค้าก่อนทุกครั้ง และตามมาตรฐานไม่จำเป็นต้องล้างมือซ้ำ เพราะเท้าของลูกค้าเพิ่งผ่านการล้างมาแล้ว หากลูกค้าต้องการความสะอาดเพิ่มแจ้งได้ทันที พนักงานพร้อมทำให้ค่ะ

เรื่อง “พนักงานหลับ” นั้น
ขอเรียนว่าหากพนักงานหลับจริง ๆ ก็ไม่มีทาง “นวดต่อเนื่อง” ให้คุณได้ครบเวลาอย่างแน่นอน เพราะการนวดต้องใช้แรง ใช้เทคนิค และต้องมีสมาธิ
อีกทั้งหากลูกค้าเห็นว่าพนักงานหลับจริง ๆ ก็สามารถบอกหยุดหรือแจ้งเจ้าของร้านได้ทันที ไม่ใช่นั่งให้บริการจนครบ แล้วค่อยมาตั้งใจเขียนรีวิวทีหลัง

สิ่งที่คุณรีวิวจึงมีความย้อนแย้งอยู่มาก ทำให้มองได้ว่าต้องการสร้างภาพว่าตัวเองอดทน ทั้งที่จริงแล้วคุณก็รับบริการจนจบโดยไม่มีการร้องเรียนตอนนั้นเลยค่ะ

ร้านเรายึดมาตรฐานและความซื่อสัตย์ในการทำงาน
ยินดีรับฟังทุกคำติ แต่ขอเป็นข้อเท็จจริงค่ะ ไม่ใช่การแต่งเรื่องให้ดูดีฝ่ายเดียว

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly value all comments, as customer satisfaction is our highest priority.

We would like to clarify that whenever there is a concern or suggestion regarding our service, we take it seriously and address it immediately. If a therapist is corrected or reminded, it is not a sign of internal conflict, but rather our commitment to maintaining high service standards and ensuring the best possible experience for our clients.

All of our therapists have been working with us for many years and are well trained in our professional standards. Continuous feedback and improvement are a normal part of our operation and are always carried out with the customer’s satisfaction in mind.

Regarding massage pressure, Marada Massage & Therapy is well known for therapeutic and firm massage techniques, which are preferred by most of our regular clients. However, clients are always welcome to request lighter or stronger pressure at any time during the session. If no specific preference is communicated, the massage will be performed according to our usual professional standard.

As for the ambiance, our shop is designed to be calm and relaxing, which may feel darker to some guests. Please note that every room has adjustable lighting, and our staff is always happy to increase the brightness upon request.

We are sorry that your experience did not fully meet your expectations and appreciate your comment regarding the friendliness of our staff. Lastly, we thank you for your feedback and sincerely hope you will find a place that suits your preferences in the future.

**We would also like to kindly note that we value transparent and genuine reviews. Open identification helps ensure clarity that feedback comes from actual customers who have received services at our shop, and not from unrelated parties or competitors. It also allows us to verify the visit details, including which therapist provided the service on that day, so that we can properly review and address the feedback.

Our group of seven arrived around 8:40 PM, and despite the late hour, the owner graciously called in reinforcements so everyone could enjoy the massage of their choice. The entire team was incredibly patient, welcoming, and accommodating, making sure they felt comfortable throughout the experience.

The staff does speak English, but it was a nice touch that my mom was able to communicate in Thai to be more specific about her preferences. My masseuse, Nisa,  was a graduate of a professional massage academy with three years of experience, and it certainly showed in the quality of the treatment.

Every member of our group left feeling refreshed, pampered, and completely at ease. I would happily recommend this spa to anyone looking for an authentic Thai massage experience.

reviews.text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at this Thai massage salon. The atmosphere is incredibly cozy and relaxing, and all the staff are very kind, welcoming, and always smiling. 😍

Before the session, they gave me a fresh outfit to change into, and it smelled absolutely amazing. Such a small detail, but it made me feel really comfortable and spoiled from the very beginning.

The therapist who took care of me was gentle in her movements but strong and precise with the pressure, which made the massage both soothing and highly effective. I didn’t feel any language barrier at all. She understood everything I said, and even communicated with me about how exactly she should massage certain areas. When I mentioned discomfort in my stomach area, she immediately adjusted her technique and was very gentle there. She was also calm and polite every time she asked me to change positions, which made me feel really comfortable and cared for.

The whole session was deeply calming, yet full of therapeutic benefits. My lower back pain and neck tension have completely disappeared, and the amazing head massage at the end was the cherry on top. I left feeling refreshed and truly relaxed. To complete the perfect experience, I was served delicious tea and cookies after the massage.

I also want to give a big compliment to the lovely guy at the reception, who is from Denmark. He fits the atmosphere of the place so well with his calmness, care, and friendliness. His excellent English makes a huge difference for tourists like me. It’s wonderful to have someone to talk to before or after the session, making the entire visit feel even more welcoming. It’s also nice to see European staff working in such an amazing place, adding even more to its charm!

I highly recommend this salon to anyone searching for a relaxing and professional Thai massage experience. I will definitely return! 💚
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Wow—thank you. We don't often receive a review that captures the heart of what we do so beautifully, and we are truly touched by your words. Reading about your experience, from the fresh massage clothes to the therapeutic care and thoughtful conversation, means more to us than we can say. We are so proud of our team, and we’ll be sure to share your kind words with your therapist and our wonderful Danish receptionist. It makes us happy to know you felt so understood and cared for at every step.

With heartfelt thanks,
The Lian Linn Massage Team 🌿

reviews.text:
My original stay was to take place in Bangkok. But I wanted to try this massage parlor. And to do this, I boarded a flight to Chiang Mai. I was pleasantly surprised by the cleanliness and brightness of the place. The staff at reception are very helpful. The technician I chose is Mr James. I was surprised that the session began with a foot washing. This operation was carried out with so much care that at one point I wondered if he had not made a mistake in the "menu" ordered. Then he directed me to the room while helping me carry my travel bag. He knows how to give a firm and supple massage. It exerts pressure on different parts of the body to make the accumulated pain and fatigue disappear. He is always attentive and knows how to hold a conversation in English. Which can be appreciable. Finally, there was no cheating on the time. deadlines were met...Prices are reasonable. The tip too. In the end, I was escorted back and held to wait for my taxi to arrive. it was my first time. And certainly not the last.

￼

reviews.name: Tim G
reviews.text:
The massage therapist here had great technique - not too hard and not too soft (usually anyway).

They were also very friendly, and the waiting area was comfortable.

The aroma in the waiting area as well as the massage area was also quite pleasant, even though we didn't pay for aromatherapy.

It may seem like a small thing, but we also appreciated the fact that the disposable underwear was soft and stretchy, unlike several other places we've been to.

Cons:
1) non-private room.
Another couple came in on the other side of a divider, which was very distracting, and ruined the whole quiet, relaxing vibe.

2) talking and laughing masseuses.
I'm laying there practically naked on the table, so it seems unprofessional for them to be talking in Thai and laughing. And again, this takes away from the vibe.

3) the padding on the table isn't soft, so when you put your face in the hole, it's hard and uncomfortable. There is a ring-pillow, but then that lifts your head up/back, not to mention it moving around on you.

In the end, we would go back again, but we will continue our search for the perfect massage.

---
Update:
We went here again, and my bf got a great massage, but I didn't. I'd rate it 6 out of 10. They were all very nice and polite. It's just that the technique of my particular masseuse wasn't that great. So i guess it's just luck of the draw, unless you happen to know a specific masseuse by name that you like.

reviews.text: I can confirm the praises aired here. I use massage services regularly and also have frequented many physiotherapists. I think the quality guarantee in this place is really the owner. The masseuse assigned to me did not disappoint. The touch was firm yet not too hard, and the massage was thorough and professional. The owner checked in during the session to see how everything was going and gave instructions. I immediately booked a follow-on session. reviews.name: Nan Yi Cheah
reviews.text:
The owner was really lovely, warm, and welcoming — such a kind person! My friend’s therapist was also super skillful and gave one of the best massages she’s ever had, so I can still honestly recommend this place overall.

Unfortunately, my own experience wasn’t great. The therapist I got (a rather slim lady) didn’t seem to have much technique. She kept pressing directly on my bones instead of the muscles, and my lower back actually felt worse after the session. It also felt like she never really hit the right points — even though I mentioned a few times that I wanted it harder, the “harder” pressure always landed on the wrong spots. The areas that actually needed strength still felt like gentle stroking, while the parts that didn’t need it were pressed way too hard.

It was honestly a very painful 1.5 hours, and I ended up asking to stop early. To be fair, the owner was very apologetic and even gave me a small gift afterward, which I really appreciated. But of course, nobody comes to a massage place for gifts — we just want a good massage.

Still, apart from this one therapist, everything else was great: lovely atmosphere, clean space, fair prices, and amazing service from the owner. I’d definitely recommend it — just maybe avoid that particular therapist.

reviews.name: Sunita
reviews.text:
We were hotel guests and wanted to treat ourselves to a professional massage. I chose the 60-minute back and shoulder massage and was quite disappointed. For almost the entire 55 minutes, the same technique was used, in the same rhythm. The massager pressed on different parts of my body with the palm of the hand, elbow, presumably knee, etc., holding briefly, then releasing, then pausing again. Then, a few centimeters further along, they pressed again, held briefly, released, paused, and repeated the process… I know this as one of several techniques, but almost the entire massage consisted of the same sequence, which is completely unfamiliar… no balm or oil (which was used occasionally in other shoulder/back massages in Bangkok, Krabi, etc., even if it wasn't an oil massage), no fingers, no circular movements, and not enough depth to penetrate the muscles.

About half the time, pressure was applied to my lower body, which I didn't understand at all considering the massage I had chosen. My shoulders were only treated for the last five minutes (while the timer was already beeping), and even then, only the neck muscles were worked on, not the sides of my neck or anything like that. I was really disappointed, and the worst part is that the rooms are equipped with a pillow, and you can only rest your head sideways on it! This means that while they're working on your back and neck, your spine is crooked, which unfortunately led to more tension than relaxation. Even for a hotel spa in this higher price range, I'm disappointed and wouldn't go again.
But the spa was clean and there was something sweet afterwards; my mother was very satisfied with the foot massage.

reviews.name: Danielle Richards
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Relaxing, Convenient & Worth Every Baht

This spa was exactly what I needed and more. The opening hours are incredibly convenient (around 11 a.m. to 7 a.m.), which makes it perfect for late-night relaxation — especially if you’re on a busy schedule or even heading straight to the airport like I was.

The location is great and easy to get to, and the facility itself is clean, well-maintained, and has a really calming atmosphere from the moment you walk in. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable straight away.

I had a full body scrub and massage, and both were absolutely excellent. The treatment was thorough, relaxing, and left me feeling completely refreshed. I even brought my own face mask, which they kindly applied for me during the treatment — such a thoughtful touch. At the end of my massage, I also had a neck and shoulder cream, which they applied for me as part of the experience. Truly above and beyond service.

What made this visit even more special was how accommodating they were. I called ahead to check if I could come with my suitcase, and they happily said yes. I arrived with my luggage, had my full treatment, then got dressed there in my airport outfit and left directly for the airport. I walked out feeling like a completely new woman — relaxed, refreshed, and ready for my journey.

The pricing is also very reasonable for the quality you receive, which makes it even better value.

Overall, a fantastic experience from start to finish. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing spa experience in Bangkok — especially late at night.

reviews.name: Billal Sahlaoui
reviews.text:
Run. Just run. Go anywhere else!!!

I wanted to relax. I left feeling worse than when I arrived.

The massage was aggressive from the start. Not “firm pressure” aggressive… borderline violent. I asked them to go lighter. They went harder. I asked again. Same thing. At one point they worked on my neck in a way that genuinely scared me… the kind of movement that makes you think “this could seriously hurt someone.”

The place itself doesn’t help. Dark, cramped, not a relaxing atmosphere. Zero effort to create any kind of ambiance.

The therapists looked like they had somewhere better to be. No warmth, no attention, no care in their movements. Just going through the motions…roughly.

Oh, and the elevator. I’m not exaggerating when I say I wasn’t sure I’d make it out of that thing alive. It’s essentially a freight lift that hasn’t been maintained since the building was built. A genuine safety concern.

Save your money. Save your back. Save your neck.

Do not go here.

reviews.name: One Step at a Time
reviews.text:
After weeks of shoulder and back pain, I finally decided to get a Thai oil massage with aromatherapy on Saturday morning. The place was very calm, clean, and serene—truly relaxing and peaceful. The therapists were kind, polite, and attentive, and they speak English well. I simply asked them not to touch my ankle due to a fracture, and they fully respected that without any issue.
The massage itself, including foot and head massage, was a moment of deep relaxation and well-being that I have rarely experienced, even compared to many massages across Asia. I highly recommend this massage salon for its professionalism, the tranquil and tropical yet quiet atmosphere, and the genuine kindness and skill of the therapists.

reviews.name: L C
reviews.text:
I always try to start reviews with something positive, but unfortunately, there was nothing positive about my experience here.

The entire visit was disappointing from start to finish. It began with the masseuse appearing so exhausted just from walking up the stairs that I was genuinely concerned she might pass out. That alone didn’t inspire much confidence.

I booked a 90-minute scrub and massage, but the session lasted only about 65 minutes. The treatment itself felt rushed and careless, with no attention to comfort or technique. It honestly felt like she was hurrying to finish, as if another customer was waiting—but when I went downstairs, there was no one there.

On top of that, the hygiene was very concerning. The mats, sheets, and towels did not smell fresh or clean, which made the experience even more uncomfortable.

This ended up being the worst massage experience I’ve ever had.

Before leaving, I spoke to the receptionist (who may have been the owner) and pointed out that I entered at 10:30 and was finished by 11:35. I also made it clear that the massage was very poor.

Hopefully, other customers won’t have to go through the same experience.
