reviews.name: Boeing driver
reviews.text:
I’ve visited a few branches of this spa now, and it’s consistently good across the board.

Everything is well organised with a uniform, professional setup, and the standard of service never really drops. The massages are always excellent.

I went for a 45-minute foot massage this time and asked for firm pressure, which was delivered perfectly. My feet felt noticeably lighter afterwards.

The place is also very clean, which adds to the overall experience.

I’ve never been disappointed and would happily return again.

reviews.name: Nutharin Phusitphoykai
reviews.text:
This is a simple, stylish, and conveniently located spa in the heart of downtown Bangkok. We decided to enjoy a relaxing foot massage here while waiting for our next appointment, and it turned out to be an excellent choice.

Fortunately, we were able to make a reservation by phone. The spa is located on the sixth floor of Terminal 21 Asok, making it easily accessible by both the BTS Skytrain and the MRT.

The décor is modern, clean, and minimalist, creating a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. The facilities are well maintained, and restrooms are conveniently available inside the spa.

Upon arrival, we checked in at the reception, selected our treatment, and completed the payment. The staff warmly welcomed us with a refreshing cold towel and a sweet cold drink. We were then given a mini iPad to personalize our massage experience by indicating which areas we would like the therapist to focus on or avoid—a thoughtful touch that we really appreciated.

Next, we changed into comfortable slippers before being escorted to a private area where our feet were gently washed.

Afterward, we were taken to a spacious treatment room with large, comfortable reclining chairs.

The foot massage itself was excellent. The therapists were skilled and professional, and the treatment left us feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

After completing our foot massage, they gave us a plate of mango sticky rice with a warm drink. This is nice.

It was a peaceful and enjoyable experience from beginning to end.

We think this place is a pleasant spa for anyone looking for a quality massage in a convenient downtown location. With its attentive service, comfortable facilities, and relaxing atmosphere, it is a place we would happily return to.

reviews.text: I loved the massage and the vibe here. The employees are very kind, the location is well cured with soft lights and music. Also the scents are pleasant. I asked for an harder massage and they offered to change my masseuse with a stronger one. The massage was amazing, found it professional and very relaxing. They offered us mango sticky rice at the end. I recommend it!!

The staff at the reception had very limited experience and were speaking to each other in Thai while assisting customers, which did not feel very professional. The massage itself was also not as good as what I have experienced at other branches.

Overall, I would recommend Let’s Relax Spa, but I would not recommend this particular branch.

reviews.name: Connush B
reviews.text: I like this massage chain business.  All the branches are very similar, clean and comfortable.  This one is at the 6th floor next to the Cinema/gym at the Terminal Asok mall.  The staff is very attentive, helpful and polite.  My favorite is the dream package 90 minutes massage which includes foot, hand and back.  It is recommended to book in advance. They often offer good promotions. Also the tea and mango stickyrice at the end is a nice detail.  We can recommend this place.

reviews.name: P Lim
reviews.text:
I’ve had spa services at this branch three times over the past couple of years, and I think it’s fair to say that while the treatments are alright, there’s definitely room for improvement. I’ve experienced much better hospitality at other branches like the one at CentralWorld.

To be sure I wasn’t imagining things, I actually repeated the same treatments on two separate days. Haha.

Back & Shoulder Massage – The same techniques and short sequences were repeated over and over on the same areas for the entire 60 minutes. Even as the recipient, I found it monotonous and uninspired.

Foot Massage – There was little variation in technique. Much like the above, the same routine was repeated for the full 45 minutes, which felt repetitive and lacked engagement.

Facial Soothing Massage – I felt that more pressure could have been applied to specific areas, especially since it’s supposed to be a massage. Otherwise, it felt more like a series of facial cleansing steps. Personally, I felt like my face was just being cleansed repeatedly with different creams or gels. There was about a 10-minute mask treatment, but it didn’t seem to have any noticeable effects - no tightening or refreshing sensation. I found myself getting impatient as the session went on.

Customer Service – We had made and paid for back-to-back bookings: a Facial Massage followed by a Foot/Back/Shoulder Massage. This was acknowledged and confirmed at check-in. However, after the facial session, we were unexpectedly given the change of footwear and served fruits and tea -essentially, the usual sign-off at the end of a visit. We were puzzled and explained that we had another session. Instead of checking the record, they returned with the treatment menu and asked us what we would like to book. What? I had to head back to the counter to explain again that we had already paid for the next session. It took them a while to sort it out, and by the time they did, precious time had been lost. We were frustrated, and there was no apology for the confusion. I really wish the team had better internal coordination and ensured that booking details were properly relayed among the staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Let's Relax Spa, Sawasdee Ka.

We sincerely regret that your recent visit was impacted by a lack of attentiveness from our receptionist. Exceptional service is expected at every Let’s Relax Spa branch, and we have shared your feedback with the branch manager and relevant department to support further staff development in service mindset and customer care. Thank you for expressing your concerns. Your feedback is being taken seriously and will be used to help us raise our standards and ensure a truly relaxing experience for every customer.

reviews.name: Abdulrahman
reviews.text:
Had a very relaxing experience at Let’s Relax Terminal 21 Asoke.
I tried the Body & Soul (120 mins) treatment and really enjoyed the atmosphere, cleanliness, and professionalism of the staff. The massage was comfortable and helped me feel refreshed and relaxed. A great place to unwind after a busy day in Bangkok.

I have tried several other places afterward, including some that were more expensive, but this one still remains my favorite.

reviews.name: Rowena Mangabang
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience. We had the aromatherapy oil massage for an hour. We booked a room for a couple and it was heavenly.  Definitely worth coming back.  The reception, staff and therapist are nice and very welcoming. A must try if you are in Terminal 21, Asok. Location is good. Inside the mall and accessible at BTS and MRT.

reviews.name: Anna Guskova
reviews.text: I am very stressed because of this company and their service. I couldn't expect it at all. I booked the massage through their website and the money was deducted from my bank card, but when I came to them (Let's Relax at Terminal 21)they told me that the money didn't go through. There was no return to my bank card. I contacted my bank and they confirmed that the transaction went through successfully and is being processed by an international payment system. I didn't know it would take so much time for the transaction to be processed, it never happened before. I've been in their brunch for one hour already trying to resolve this issue with them, I presented all the evidence to them from my bank, but they didn't do anything to resolve this issue. I lost my money, my time and they gave me so much stress instead of relaxation. And I feel helpless to do anything about it.

reviews.name: Jsen Goh
reviews.text: The staff is very friendly and welcoming at the reception.The therapist is very professional wand makes my whole body relax.I will highly recommend this place and will definitely visit again when I’m in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Steven-MUC
reviews.text: A somewhat upscale massage parlor in a very pleasant setting with very friendly staff. The massage is excellent, and they offer drinks and cookies before and after. The prices are slightly above average, but here in Thailand we're talking about maybe two or three dollars more. So it's really manageable. All in all, a highly recommended establishment.

reviews.name: D Law
reviews.text:
Incredible foot massage. Fell in and out of sleep. Variation in massage techniques. Steady pressure throughout. The heating pad under the shoulders was a very well appreciated cherry on top.

Would definitely come back.

reviews.name: R D
reviews.text:
I had the Aroma Oil Massage at Let’s Relax Terminal 21 Asoke and it was amazing. The therapist was good and gentle, and the pressure was just right — exactly what I needed to unwind.

The whole experience was peaceful and relaxing. After the session, they served warm tea and mango sticky rice — the perfect end to a perfect treatment. 💆🏻‍♀️☁️💕💕

reviews.name: The Travel Monkey
reviews.text:
I wanted to book a massage at Let's Relax Spa in Terminal 21 Asok. At the reception I politely mentioned that there are two spots on my body that should not be massaged.
Right away this became a big issue. The receptionist reacted very complicated and repeatedly said that this would not be possible. It turned into quite a scene, even though I was only asking to simply avoid two spots.
I have been in Thailand since January and have had more than 40 massages in different places. Everywhere else it was absolutely no problem to say which areas should not be massaged. Only here they made a big drama out of it.
For that reason I unfortunately cannot recommend this place. During a massage you should feel comfortable, and simple requests from customers should be respected.

reviews.name: Nam waan
reviews.text: The service was excellent, the massage was very relaxing, and the shop was clean and well maintained. The mango sticky rice was absolutely delicious. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.name: Farhan Chowdhury
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Let’s Relax Terminal 21.

There was zero flexibility with their packages no option for a standard 60-minute Thai massage. Instead, they tried to push a 4-hands massage just to fit the duration, which felt forced and unnecessary.

We clearly told them we had a flight to catch and needed exactly 60 minutes, and that we were happy to leave if they couldn’t start immediately. Despite that, they took full payment upfront without properly confirming timing, and did so with a pretty smug attitude.

Then we were made to wait 15 minutes before the massage even started. Because of this delay, I had to leave halfway through (after 30 minutes) despite paying full price.

To top it off, the service itself didn’t justify the premium price at all. Easily one of the most underwhelming massages compared to other places nearby that charge much less.

The manager was also unhelpful and showed no interest in resolving the situation.

Would not recommend.

reviews.name: Richard Fanell
reviews.text: I had a 30 min. shoulder and back massage by Saifon Phimthong. She was amazing and seemed to have a sixth sense in finding all my problem points. I was floating after I left.I wished I had requested the 60 min. massage I highly recomend Saifon and the friendly staff at Lets Relax at Asok Terminal 21.

reviews.name: Anna marie Julian
reviews.text:
Kudos to our therapists,  Kruewan and Ronghida! You guys were amazing! The dry Thai massage turned out to be the best and exactly what we needed after days of walking and hustling around BKK. It was fun and relaxing to be with you, plus of course the friendly and acommodating Spa Manager- Ms Jill. 👏
Khob khun kha! See you again next time! 🥳🫶🏻🫰🤗

reviews.name: Daphne Yeo
reviews.text:
New at Terminal 21, the facilities are very new and clean. We walked in on a Sat afternoon and lucky that they still have 2 slots left for us. Did a 2 hr Scrub and Aroma Oil massage for THB2500 nett. Was served a cold towel and chilled pandan drink at the start, the cold towel was excellent given the hot weather, so was the drink, though I found it a little sweet. The treatment was excellent, my masseuse was skillful and I like how my chosen scrubs and oils came in a sealed individual pack, giving me the hygiene assurance.

I was also served a small portion of mango sticky rice after the session.

reviews.text: This place was a hidden jem I am so glad I found. Initially the stairwell was a little scary but the upstairs area where the massage beds are is clean, comfortable and spacious. The masseuses are all so kind, gentle, thorough and give you the best massage of your life! Only 300 bht for 1 whole hour with hot cloths and tea at the end.

had the best experience by professional massage ladies! she gave me the best neck and legs like i never had before. Feel so much lighter after massage.

reviews.name: Joee Wong
reviews.text: Renovated on 1st floor. Entire massage is so on point. Only body massage, option 1 hour or 2 hour. Suggest to take 2 hours. Kudos to the therapist they’re so experienced!

reviews.name: Justin Tan
reviews.text:
December 2025: I am a Level 8 contributor (> 450 reviews) on Google and regularly review eateries and experiences both in Asia and Melbourne.  I found this massage studio by accident and decided to check it out.  The studio is 60 m from Sam Yot MRT station. Take exit 2, turn right as you step out of the station, walk to the intersection, turn left and you will notice the sign Thanom Chai area. Turn left again into the alley.

The Thai massage is authentic.  I was led by the therapist upstairs to a row of "private" cubicles, separated by curtains. You can definitely hear customers in adjacent cubicles moaning in pain. One local Thai customer was groaning so loudly that I eventually giggled. It's not exactly a "zen-like" atmosphere but the massage is PAINFULLY good as the therapist stepped onto the underside of my thighs and my butt, curling her soles for a firm grip, and walked up and down the area. It was incredible.  I did take a sideway glance and saw that she was supporting her body weight by holding onto a strap.

I wouldn't recommend this to those who are looking for a relaxing massage.  However,  after the session,  I felt so good because the tightness on my body was soothed. Definitely check this place out if you are game for an authentic experience. I paid 450 Baht for 90 minutes.

reviews.name: Elli Ma
reviews.text:
This place is heaven.
The masseuses were indeed professionals who knew where to massage without asking.
Came out of the 2 hour massage not knowing what to do with our new limbs
600 baht for 2 hours so worth it.
The facilities are very clean, beds as pictured. And bathroom was also clean so that's always a plus.
And the staff were so friendly!

reviews.name: MM F
reviews.text: It used to be good, but not anymore. I've been a regular here since 2023. But recently the masseuse seems to be undedicated. The pressure points were inconsistent, and barely made any difference to my muscle aches. To top it off, the therapist complained that I gave her 50 baht as a tip, asking for 100 more. I was shook and now I'm not planning to visit anymore. Sorry.

reviews.name: Daniel Yap
reviews.text:
This place is for people who like Thai massage. If this is your first time, read the other reviews and prepare accordingly!

The location is conveniently located near MRT Sam Yot. We came after walking Wat Sathat. There are some roads to cross, but I felt it was alright. Walking in, you will see a big green sign, push the retro door to go inside.

My wife and I went for 1 and 1/2 hours, 450B each, total 900B. The massage lady brought us to the second floor. We used the toilet before our massage. The toilet was clean and well maintained, with working hose bidet, like most places in Bangkok. 👍🏽

The massage was damn good. From what I read, the ladies are experienced pros, so they know where to press, which are your problem areas. They will press hard, so if you have low pain tolerance, ask for gentle, softer. I walked a lot the previous day carrying a heavy bag, and the lady knew to press my calves and shoulders. I just had to lie there and endure for my own good! They did check periodically if I was ok, if it was too painful, but I was ok with it. The lady also stepped on me to press out my knots, but my wife did not get the stepping.

Aircon is good, bed and facilities are clean.

I would highly recommend you go if you love traditional Thai massage. If you have tried Thai massage, and are looking for something more authentic, I would recommend this place as well. 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽

Will definitely return one day 💛⭐️

reviews.name: Naiara Vieira
reviews.text: Have been there today with my husband and we both loved the massage. Very professionally done, with knowledge and care. It is traditional Thai massage, so yes it is strong and it hurts, the relaxed and released feeling come after. So again, it is no zen massage, it is therapeutic massage. Totally worth it, we will come back for sure!

reviews.name: ST T.
reviews.text:
I can say this place has the authentic Thai massage by experienced masseuses. They are well trained and some can spot the aching problem just by massging. Good for curing long time aches.
No fancy decoration. The place is like to be freezed in time back 20 years ago. Still, it is clean, tidy and well air conditoned. There are 5 or more beds in a rooms with cloth curtain partitioning for some privacy. Enjoy Thai slow folk musics while having massage is a great combination.
The charge is less than USD1 per hour. Minimum service is 2 hours. Tip is not compulsory but giving some will be very appropriate.
The staffs are professional and friendly. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Trevor Owens
reviews.text: Great 1 hour Thai massage for 300 baht. We both loved it. They give you a change of clothes. The ladies are a little snarky. FYI, it's not a Swedish Massage. It's a little more aggressive.

reviews.name: Nijaya I
reviews.text:
Interesting massage place
Next to MRT Somyot station
Clean , professional massage lady
Old style massage.

reviews.name: Cholnapa Anukul
reviews.text:
One of the oldest Thai massage house in Bangkok located nearby Samyod MRT station and the Old Siam shopping mall.

All of masseuses have more than 10 years professional experiences with traditional Thai massage.

The front image of massage shop reminds me of the 60s period. The facility is quite old but very clean and quiet. The air conditioning is in best quality. The background music is “Soontraporn” music, Thai oldies with smooth and sound theme, which is rare among Thai massage services.

The majority of customers are thai elderly people who keeps loyalty to this massage house for decades.

My friend recommended this massage house a long time ago. Since then I am aware that their masseuses have higher skills than other new emerging massage shop in Bangkok tourist traps in Patpong, Sukumvit, Pratunam, etc.

I have visited this massage house almost monthly and never upset with their massage skills, which relief stress and heal muscle issues.

reviews.name: Pricha Petlueng
reviews.text: Come here for good tradition Thai massage. They have been operating for almost 50 years. There is a lady wing if you come by individual or group of ladies and don't want to mix with others. It is a bargain, 400 baht for 2 hours.

reviews.name: Shoggy The Foodie
reviews.text:
I used to be a Thai masseur, so I know when someone’s just going through the motions. This place is NOT that.

Right at the start, they asked me to choose my pressure level. Mild, medium, or strong. That’s massage 101 and so many places just skip this step. Instantly knew I was in good hands.

Then they just went to WORK. Head to toe, every single muscle getting the attention it deserves.

the team here are legends. Super friendly but also dead serious about getting those knots out. You can feel the difference when someone actually cares about what they’re doing.

300 baht for an hour. I tipped them 100 baht because honestly, these masseurs work hard and don’t get paid enough. If you can, please tip them.

Oh and they finished me off with a Thai tea that hit different after all that. Perfect way to cap it off.

If you’ve been sleeping on getting a proper Thai massage, or you’ve had dodgy ones before, go here. They’ll sort you out properly.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🏻💖

reviews.name: Seetheworld
reviews.text:
I was offered the promo 2 hour body scrub and Thai oil massage. Only did about 20 minutes of scrub then a massage. Scrub was mediocre at best! Massage was really good I have to say. Was in and out in only 90 minutes! But when I mentioned to the owner she didn’t care she just wanted her money!

There’s too many other place with better prices and service!

Sad because the two massage ladies were kind and they did do a good massage but hour scrub is not 20 minutes!

There was no misunderstanding!!! I asked for a one hour body scrub and one hour oil massage, I get one every week for half the price. The staff knew my request and TOLD ME IT WAS ONE HOUR SCRUB, ONE HOUR MASSAGE!
It’s typical do what you want regardless of the customers request!

AS I SAID THERE A MANY OPTIONS. ALL THE SPAS around THERE WERE OFFERING TWO HOUR SCRUB AND MASSAGE! Same price. Try them!!!

It’s a shame! Oh well! Good luck 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I believe there may have been a misunderstanding regarding our promotion.

Our Promotion No. 1 includes a 30-minute body scrub, a 1-hour oil massage, and a 30-minute facial treatment, making a total treatment time of 2 hours.

It seems there may have been a misunderstanding that the body scrub itself lasted for 1 hour and did not include the body massage and facial treatment. However, that is not the case. In fact, it is not recommended to perform a salt cream body scrub for a full hour, as it may cause skin irritation or discomfort.

Also, the owner was not at the shop yesterday.

Lastly, thank you very much for your kind compliments about the therapist who provided your massage. We truly appreciate your feedback.

Thank you.

Thank you for updating your review. I noticed that your explanation is different from what was written in your original review.

I would also like to clarify a few points based on our records. You mentioned that you visit our shop every week, but neither our staff nor our appointment records indicate that you are a regular customer. In fact, according to our booking records, no customer has booked this promotion during the past three weeks.

You also mentioned that our staff recommended this promotion to you. This would normally apply to a first-time customer, which makes your statement about visiting us every week difficult for us to reconcile with our records.

If you believe there has been any misunderstanding, I would sincerely like to invite you to visit the shop while I am here. We can review your visit together, including which therapist treated you, and discuss any concerns in person.

I would also like to clarify that our policy is always to provide the treatment our customers request whenever possible. From the beginning of your visit, the main issue appeared to be the room arrangement for you and your husband, rather than the massage itself. Additionally, your husband was the one who received the body scrub treatment, while you received the full 90-minute massage as booked.

We always welcome honest feedback because it helps us improve. However, we also believe it is important that reviews accurately reflect the service that was provided.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your message.

The shop does not have a foot-washing basin, but we do provide a herbal towel to clean your feet.

We clearly informed you of our closing time when you arrived for your massage.

I checked the CCTV footage, and it shows that you left our shop at 12:09 AM. This indicates that our therapist provided you with the full duration of the massage service.


For private rooms, all items are changed for every customer. This is especially important for oil massage rooms, where linens cannot be shared. We replace everything each time. We believe you may have noticed that the linens were completely clean and not stained with oil, as they were freshly prepared. If they had been used or oily, you likely would not have accepted the service from the beginning.

Regarding the pillows, the first one you used is a face cradle pillow designed with a breathing hole for when you lie face down. When you turned over, you were provided with a second pillow, for which we change the pillowcase after every use.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

reviews.name: Andy T.
reviews.text: My friend and I found this massage place by accident as other places were fully booked. We were not disappointed at all. All the ladies were so friendly and attentive. I had a Toc San, a special kind of Thai massage, which is only available at a few massage places. I highly recommend it as it is slightly different from the usual Thai massage. We definitely recommend this place and will come back next time we are in Chang Mai

reviews.name: The Universe and Me
reviews.text: This place was amazing. I’ve been struggling to find a place that is intentional with their massages, so I was ecstatic when I found a place that actually used the right pressure (I like strong pressure) and was intentional with their work. I only did a 30 minute foot massage, but I will definitely be back to try a full body massage before I leave. It doesn’t look too fancy on the outside but it beats any one of those others that are on the main streets and charge way too much.

reviews.name: Peter
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful Thai massage here with Kieng. The massage was the perfect mix of strong and relaxing. It was so good I ended up getting a second massage right afterwards.

The hospitality is also very nice, and the owners are very friendly. I ended up hanging out for a couple hours chatting with everyone. Definitely give this place your business!

reviews.name: John Son
reviews.text: I've had ongoing back tightness for months and was hoping to find some relief on my Thailand trip. I tried several massage shops in Bangkok and now in Chiang Mai but none of the massages were strong enough to release the tension in my back. Finally I got a "sports massage" here and my back feels great. The best massage I've had in Thailand.

reviews.name: Ye Lin Aung
reviews.text: Great Thai massage. Staff are friendly and proficient

reviews.name: D Transilvano
reviews.text: A true gem hidden at the back of the alley!! The massage ladies are professional, extremely attentive and very skilled.  My wife and I went back to this place multiple times and every single time we were well attended. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Lisa Wauters
reviews.text: Excellent traditional Thai massage. Peaceful and calm setting. Very friendly owner and staff.

reviews.name: Shiyu W
reviews.text:
I had a lot of long term foot and leg muscle pain, so I ordered 1 hour foot massage from this place. When I walked out my foot pain was almost gone and I was walking on air.

I had an expensive "famous" massage in Chiang Mai and then this massage spot the next day. I would say this spot is a much more on point massage than the other "famous" one.

The male massager is very skilled and talented, I can feel that he is working on my muscle pain point every second. He is very intuitive with muscle communication. I have had many massages in my life, this one is mind blowing.

The massage room is almost empty so I had an extremely tranquil experience. If you want a local Thai feeling massage from a very talented massager this is your place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Tinabanana J
reviews.text:
I had THE BEST Thai massage ever here. Jom, the masseuse, has GOD’S HANDS🙏🏻.
I came in with a frozen shoulder that no one no other massage or even physical therapy could fix. But somehow, in just one session, he made all my pain go away. He knew exactly where it hurt the most and worked his MAGIC. It was incredible!

I was so amazed that I went back on my last day for an oil massage, and it was just as AMAZING. Super relaxing and satisfying.I wish I had booked a session with him EVERY SINGLE DAY!

My mom also had a massage from Whan, and she said it was the best massage she’s ever had. Whan really took good care of her and made sure she felt completely cared for.

One of the things I miss most about Chiang Mai is Jom, Whan, and Netnimid Massage honestly. “Khop Khun Kaaaa everyone”

Also, a special thank-you to Anne, who owns the place. She’s such a warm and happy person and gave me such welcoming spirits of Chiang Mai. Talking to her made my trip even more memorable.

If you’re ever in Chiang Mai, you HAVE TO GO to Netnimid Massage. You’ll THANK YOURSELF for it!🌺

reviews.name: Jai Ananda
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Orientala Spa. I chose the Thai oil massage, and it was one of the most invigorating and rejuvenating treatments I’ve ever had. From the moment the session started, the masseuse demonstrated exceptional skill, precision, and experience. She knew exactly where the tension points were and applied the perfect pressure throughout the massage.
By the end of the session, my body felt completely refreshed, lighter, and energized — almost like having a new young body again. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more relaxing and therapeutic.

What truly stood out was the professionalism and technique of the therapist. It was not just a massage, but a complete wellness experience that relieved stress and revived both body and mind.

I highly recommend Orientala Spa to both locals and visitors looking for a high-quality and worthwhile spa experience. It is definitely a place worth visiting if you want genuine relaxation, rejuvenation, and excellent service. 🙏

reviews.name: Hader Ali
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience! I had a 2.5hr Thai massage and it was honestly the best massage I’ve ever had. The whole place was incredibly professional, clean, relaxing, and welcoming from start to finish.

A huge shoutout to Ploy, who was my masseuse — she did a brilliant job! Her technique was outstanding, the pressure was perfect, and she made me feel completely relaxed and refreshed. You can tell she’s very experienced and genuinely cares about giving the best service possible.

If you’re in Patong and looking for a proper Thai massage, I highly recommend this place, especially Ploy. I’ll definitely be coming back next time I’m in Thailand!

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this massage in Phuket! The staff were incredibly friendly, professional, and made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. I highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Phuket. I’ll definitely be coming back. Thank you for the excellent service!

reviews.name: Christine NG
reviews.text:
We visited Orientala Spa based on our hotel’s recommendation, and as guests of Four Points Phuket, we received a discount. The spa is clean, comfortable, and very well run. The therapists were truly skilled—especially Ms. Sudjai, who was so good that we went back for a second session with her!We also want to mention Ms. Wanna, who was excellent as well. Both therapists provided a full two-hour treatment without any breaks, showing great professionalism and care.Highly recommended! Prices are very reasonable for the quality of service you receive.
P.s. the Money Exchange next door offer quite a good competitive rates.

reviews.name: Alexandr Komarov
reviews.text:
Went to Orientala Spa Phuket almost every day — and honestly, it became part of my routine.

The staff are very friendly, polite and make you feel comfortable from the first minute. The massage itself is just amazing — exactly what you need after a long day.

The place is clean, calm and well organized, you can really relax there. Also, if you come regularly, they offer discounts, which is a nice bonus.

If I’m back in Phuket, I will definitely go there again — more than once.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: Walk in for a 60min foot massage as it was raining. Get to choose if i want it to be gentle, medium or hard. The masseuse provides the right amount of strength i requested. Even gave me an umbrella as it was raining. 👍

reviews.name: Ria Atomita
reviews.text: I had the aroma oil & foot massages for a reasonable price. It was worth every penny. The therapist was professional and asked if I was okay with the pressure a few times. Very polite staff at the front desk. The room was clean and tidy. Highly recommend 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Jodie Puah
reviews.text:
We enjoyed the treatment at the spa so much that we visited the spa 2 times in our 4 day trip. The masseuses at our second session were particularly attentive and did really a really good job.
My masseuse Ploypailyn was attentive enough to notice that I had a stiff shoulder and was not able to comfortably put my arm in a particular position. She adjust it without asking. She was also very detailed with the scrubbing.
My friend masseuse Nattaya also used enough pressure when massaging her and my friend claim it was one the best massage that she ever had.

reviews.name: ASHWIN SONALE
reviews.text: Best and legit massage spa, they are professional and worth of money. I came here 4 days back to back. Techniques are solid. Worth to go.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are grateful for your 5-star review. Thank you for choosing our spa.

reviews.name: Jess Ko
reviews.text:
DO NOT COME HERE! This place is a scam.

We came because we saw decent reviews on here and Klook and if you book with them it is the same price as you find on Klook so we thought we were helping them out by booking directly..

We ordered the Sweet Lovers massage and added on a 30 min facial massage - NOTE: they no longer have any of the gold products so this is essentially a regular scrub, oil massage and bath. We still agreed since I really wanted to have a milk bath and this was only offered in this set.

They have another location in the back inside the Ramada hotel. This place was NOT as clean as the main reception area at all. There were blood droplets under my massage bed as if the person before had a nose bleed and they forgot to clean it up?

The total amount of time for the set and facial was 180 minutes. The masseuse wasted so much time setting up between transitions, it was just strange.. We both asked for strong pressure massages and I had to continually remind them during. Each time I asked, the ladies would start talking amongst themselves, making it a very uncomfortable situation as well.

The facial massage was a JOKE as well. There was no massaging and they basically just wiped our faces for 15 mins with cotton pads… they wasted 15 mins gathering materials outside the room. I asked for them to focus on my face bc that’s what I was interested in and that’s when they said the facial massage time ended already and they were providing a free head and shoulder finisher… I peeked at the clock a few times during the face massage because I already felt shorted on the previous scrub and body massage.

My husband and I have been to a weeks worth of massages and spas at this point, these women did not seem to know what they were doing. It was so chaotic and unorganized. I even had to stop her to put towels under my ankles bc she was basically sitting on my legs at one point, digging my knees into the bed. It was so painful.

We never like to talk badly about any establishment but the receptionist was dismissive when we told her about our horrible, waste of money and time experience.

I wish I listened to the review prior to this one with the 1 star, stating a similar experience. I instead wanted to give them a shot due to Klook and the older reviews. DO NOT MAKE THE SAME MISTAKE AS WE DID 🙅🏻‍♀️🙅🏻‍♀️

ownerDescription:
Bliss Massage ให้บริการนวดผ่อนคลายโดยหมอนวดมืออาชีพ ในบรรยากาศที่สะอาด เงียบสงบ และเป็นกันเอง เรามีบริการนวดไทย นวดน้ำมัน และนวดฝ่าเท้า เพื่อช่วยคลายความเมื่อยล้า ฟื้นฟูร่างกาย และมอบประสบการณ์การผ่อนคลายอย่างแท้จริง ยินดีต้อนรับทั้งลูกค้าคนไทยและนักท่องเที่ยว

Bliss Massage offers professional Thai massage and relaxing treatments in a clean, calm, and comfortable atmosphere. Our skilled therapists provide Thai massage, oil massage, and foot massage to help relieve tension, reduce stress, and restore your body and mind. Conveniently located and welcoming both locals and travelers looking for a relaxing massage experience.

Bliss Massage 提供专业的泰式按摩和放松护理，在干净、安静、舒适的环境中为您带来真正的放松体验。我们的专业按摩师提供泰式按摩、精油按摩和足部按摩，帮助缓解疲劳、减轻压力，让身心恢复活力。欢迎本地顾客和游客前来体验。
address: 183 6 Changklan Rd, Chang Khlan Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXJX+6W Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
☔️ RAINY DAY AT BLISS
A little rain, a little relaxation.
Let the rain fall, and let your body unwind. 🤎

✨ Welcome to Bliss Massage ✨

A warm Thai welcome, friendly smiles, and a little time to relax. 🇹🇭🤍

Thank you for choosing Bliss Massage during your time in Chiang Mai. Whether you need to relax, refresh, or simply take a break from exploring the city — we’re here to take care of you. 💆‍♀️🌿

📍 Open daily | 09:03 AM – 11:00 PM
Come in, relax, and enjoy a little moment of bliss. ✨

We look forward to welcoming you! 🙏🏻

ผ่อนคลายความเหนื่อยล้า ให้ร่างกายได้พักผ่อนอย่างเต็มที่ที่ Bliss Massage สัมผัสประสบการณ์นวดเท้าสุดฟินบนเก้าอี้นุ่มสบาย พร้อมการบริการที่แสนอบอุ่นจากทีมงานมืออาชีพของเรา แวะมาเติมพลังและให้รางวัลตัวเองได้แล้ววันนี้

Escape the hustle and bustle and step into a world of pure relaxation at Bliss Massage. Sink into our cozy recliners and let our professional team melt your stress away with a soothing foot massage. Whether you're a traveler or a local, we're here to help you recharge with a warm smile.

在 Bliss Massage 开启您的放松时刻。告别一天的疲惫，躺在我们舒适的按摩椅上，享受专业的足部按摩。无论是旅行中的小憩还是日常的放松，我们温暖贴心的服务都能让您重焕活力。快来和我们一起享受惬意的时光吧！

Bliss Massageで、日常の疲れを忘れて最高のリラックスタイムを過ごしませんか？心地よいリクライニングチェアに身をまかせ、プロによる丁寧なフットマッサージで心も体もリフレッシュ。温かいおもてなしで、皆様のご来店を心よりお待ちしております。

ขอบคุณลูกค้าที่น่ารักทุกคนนะคะที่แวะมาพักผ่อนและให้ความไว้วางใจ Bliss Massage ดูแลในวันนี้ รอยยิ้มของทุกคนคือกำลังใจที่ดีที่สุดของเราเลยค่ะ แล้วพบกันใหม่นะคะ (ทางร้านขออนุญาตลงรูปภาพจากลูกค้าเรียบร้อยแล้วค่ะ)

A big thank you to our lovely guests for choosing Bliss Massage! It was a pleasure having you all today. Your smiles truly make our day. We look forward to welcoming you back soon! (Photo shared with guest permission)
เหนื่อยไหมกับการเดินเที่ยวมาทั้งวัน? มาผ่อนคลายความเมื่อยล้าด้วยบริการนวดเท้าและคอบ่าไหล่ที่ Bliss Massage ให้คุณรู้สึกเบาสบายและสดชื่น พร้อมออกเดินทางต่อได้ทันที จองคิวล่วงหน้าได้เลยวันนี้!

Exhausted from walking? 🚶‍♂️✨ Treat yourself to a relaxing foot or neck and shoulder massage at Bliss Massage, located right near Chiang Mai Night Bazaar. Your body will thank you! Book your session now! 💆‍♀️🙌

ช่วงนี้อากาศเปลี่ยนจากร้อนเป็นฝน หากกำลังรอฝนหยุด แวะมาผ่อนคลายกับเราได้ค่ะ เราขอแนะนำ **Hot Oil Massage** เพื่อช่วยสร้างความอบอุ่นให้ร่างกาย คลายความเมื่อยล้า และให้คุณรู้สึกสบายมากขึ้นในวันที่ฝนตก


The weather is changing from hot to rainy. If you’re waiting for the rain to pass, stop by and relax with us. We recommend our **Hot Oil Massage** to warm your body, relieve tension, and help you feel comfortable and relaxed on a rainy day.


最近天气从炎热转为多雨。如果您在等雨停，不妨进来放松一下。我们推荐 **热油按摩（Hot Oil Massage）**，帮助温暖身体、缓解疲劳，让您在雨天也能感到舒适放松。

reviews.text: I’ve been here for a 1-hr foot massage, 1-hr oil and 1.5 hr oil massage. Each time was excellent. All of the staff are kind and welcoming; I’ve had a great experience each time and I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Dana Robinson
reviews.text: This place rocks!! My wife and I stopped by here on a whim. We passed by a few times on our walks to and from the market and the ladies outside would always smile and say hello. Bliss Massage Team 🌸

title: Core Combat Chiang Mai

Voted best Martial Arts School in Northern Thailand, and fully licensed by the Thai Ministry of Education, Core Combat Chiang Mai offers training in Muay Thai, Western Boxing, MMA, Filipino Martial Arts, Emergency Self-Defense, Junior Kickboxing and Private Training.

Contact us TODAY for more information!

plusCode: QXCX+XH Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Nasser Al-Naama
reviews.text:
Core Muay Thai was one of those rare finds where you can immediately feel the difference before even stepping into a session. I came across it online and reached out, and what stood out straight away was Jamie, the co-founder. Despite what is clearly a very full schedule, he took the time to respond thoughtfully, thoroughly, and with real clarity. Not generic replies, but considered, precise answers that showed both depth of knowledge and genuine care.

I stopped by in person to get a sense of the space, and it confirmed everything. The gym is more intimate, focused, and intentional. It doesn’t feel like a high-volume operation; it feels like a place where people are actually seen. There’s a level of attention and presence that’s hard to come by, and it’s very clear this is something he’s built with purpose.

Jamie himself carries a quiet authority. You can tell he’s spent years immersed in Thailand and in the discipline, and he speaks from experience, not theory. There’s a sharpness to him, but also a generosity with his time and energy that doesn’t feel transactional. He’s deeply involved in the local community as well, which says a lot about the kind of person he is beyond just running a gym.

What stayed with me most is that this place feels like an extension of him. Not just a business, but something personal, something he stands behind fully. That kind of ownership shows in every detail.

If I were staying longer in Chiang Mai, this is exactly where I would have trained. Places like this are rare, and people like Jamie even more so.

reviews.name: Andrew Romine
reviews.text:
I fully recommend this gym. The staff is very attentive to questions with Ed Visa or DTV which they offer. If any issues arrise with immigration they are very attentive and responsive and will assist you the whole way.

Self defense under Ed Visa or Muay Thai DTV

The self defense class integrates different forms of martial arts. All the coaches have their unique backgrounds

Chinese Kung Fu
Philippine Martial Arts
Muay Thai
Western Boxing

Just to name a few

They take their knowledge and experiance into the gym and teach you real world applications with their techniques.

Equally benificial for someone who has a background in martial arts or someone who doesnt.

If you are looking to learn something new or wanting to train to compete, Core Combat can do both as they have students who do come here to train and fight in chiang mai competitons - western boxing or muay thai

I highly recommend this gym for training and or just to learn something new. You will not be disappointed.

From the front office staff with visa requirements and extensions to the coaches in training, You are in good hands with this gym

reviews.name: April Stephanie Tupas
reviews.text: I wanted to try Muay Thai while we’re staying in Chiang Mai for a vacation and very fortunate enough to have a friend living there who gave the opportunity for the experience to happen in Core Combat. The gym has an impressive facility and friendly staff! I’m also happy that their coaches are very approachable and knowlegeable. Coach Tong was really good in explaining and demonstrating the moves of the martial art while Coach Mob gladly assisted me with the proper stance of Muay Thai. I also enjoyed a sparring session with Coach Earl who really made it challenging but very fun! Core Combat does not only provide physical benefits but also instill valuable life skills to their clients❤️ All in all, I recommend Core Combat for people who want to try and learn martial arts. Great community! Fun experience! Hope to be back soon❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi April Stephanie Tupas,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're absolutely delighted you had such a positive Muay Thai experience at Core Combat. Hearing that you enjoyed the facility, the friendly staff, and the coaching from Tong, Mob, and Earl truly makes our day. We strive to provide not just a workout, but a valuable learning experience. We hope you'll visit us again in Chiang Mai! :D

reviews.name: Kaan Secilgin
reviews.text:
I have done my 1-year Education Visa at Core Combat.
All the coaches and staff are so knowledgeable, helpful and friendly.
Definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to learn martial arts in a serious but very approachable environment.
I am hoping to be back there one day.
Thank you Core Combat and its beautiful people.

reviews.name: Twan Dullens
reviews.text:
I trained for one month at Core Combat Chiang Mai and had an amazing experience. I followed the Western Boxing classes, and despite already having some experience, I learned more in this single month than I did in the four years before.

The level of expertise of the coaches is extremely high, and what impressed me most is how well they are able to transfer their knowledge. They really take the time to help you improve, paying attention to details and making sure you understand what you’re doing and why.

The atmosphere at the gym is also fantastic. There is a lot of mutual respect between members, regardless of skill level. Everyone supports each other, and you immediately feel welcome. Most importantly, you feel safe and valued from day one.

I would highly recommend Core Combat Chiang Mai to anyone who wants to seriously improve their boxing skills while training in a respectful and supportive environment
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Twan, thank you for such an incredible review! Hearing that you progressed more in one month with us than in four years of prior training is the ultimate compliment to our coaching team.

We truly believe that understanding the 'why' behind every movement is what creates a great boxer, so we’re thrilled you appreciated that technical focus. It was a pleasure having your energy in the gym—thank you for contributing to the culture of mutual respect we strive for. You're welcome back on the mats anytime. Safe travels!

reviews.name: Ghislain Derouasie
reviews.text:
I had a great Muay Thai class here yesterday. The session was fun, very informative, and suitable for all levels. The coaches were excellent—friendly, professional, and always willing to help improve technique.

I learned a lot during the class and really enjoyed the atmosphere. I will definitely come back when I return to Chiang Mai. Highly recommended for anyone looking to train in a welcoming and motivating environment!

reviews.name: Chili Ta Thuy
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this gym enough! It is always super clean, tidy and coaches are amazing - very patient and professional. The atmosphere is always friendly and motivating and you can tell the staff is like a little family. It was my first experience with muay thai and fell in love with it thanks to the coach Earl. I also recommend group lessons, very good if you want intense conditioning.

reviews.name: Adriana

A month spend in Chiang Mai, spend well at Core daily.

Webster Boxing:

Safe travels on your next adventure, and we can't wait to have you back on the mats when you return to Thailand. Ous!!

reviews.name: Carl Hewlett
reviews.text:
Great school to learn from a variety of different martial arts from, Muy Thai, Boxing, MMA, Kali (Filipino Martial Art) & Self Defense.

The school caters to all levels and the atmosphere is extremely welcoming to new students that may feel overwhelmed especially if you are new to the martial arts scene.

Every student is required to respect each others level whilst making the most of improving your own level/performance. The majority of classes are for adults however they have junior kickboxing classes catered specifically for kids & juniors.

The facility has a Muy Thai/boxing ring, MMA padded ground, several bags and a mini gym/weight area. Its fully indoor and well ventilated during burning season!

The school also offers a 1 year educational visa (self defense program) for those looking to learn whilst staying in Thailand.

Highly recommended school with upmost respect for each other. If you are looking to join for a single session, one week, one month or a year, they have something for everyone ✌️🇹🇭
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the wonderful review Carl, our staff always enjoys reading reviews such as the one you left us! It lets us know we are making customers happy and doing something right! We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Rosita Yuli
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Core Combat for almost a year (ESD and Muay Thai), and I couldn’t be happier with my experience, really one of the best decision i’ve ever made. The coaches (Jamie, Sakan, Earl, Tong, Mob, and Kru Do) are super friendly, patient, and really know how to be the best coaches, they explain you everything and always push you to improve in the best way, also can’t forget to mention they are super fun and make you really comfortable with no matter your level are.
The admin staff (Tik and Khem) is also amazing and very helpful with anything you need. It’s such a welcoming and supportive environment (sad I have to leave 🥲), and of course I’ve learned so much since I started, if there’s no Core Combat I will never thinking to learn Muay Thai and now I will continue to learn it because I love it haha
Highly recommend Core Combat to anyone looking to train and grow in a great community.
Once I comeback to Chiang Mai I will definitely training there again.
Big thank you to all the coaches and staff you guys are the best ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Rosita, 

Thank you so much for your kind words! It means the world to us to hear that you've had such a positive experience training with us at Core Combat. We're so happy to have been a part of your journey in ESD and Muay Thai, and we're thrilled to know you've enjoyed the supportive community and the dedication of our coaches and staff. We'll definitely look forward to welcoming you back to the gym when you return to Chiang Mai! Safe travels until then! ❤️

reviews.name: Angelique Sideño
reviews.text:
I was initially hesitant to join a combat sports gym as a woman, expecting it to be male-dominated. However, Core Combat Chiang Mai completely shattered that expectation! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and supported. The advanced students are incredibly helpful, which made learning so much easier.

A huge highlight for me is Coach Jamie's Western boxing classes. He covers everything from beginner basics to advanced drills, and his coaching is excellent. I really appreciate the recent addition of Saturday classes, which makes it much more convenient to fit training into my schedule.

The facilities are clean and well-maintained, and the front desk staff are always friendly and helpful. The overall vibe at Core Combat is like a supportive family, all working together to reach our goals. Whether you're interested in competing, learning self-defense, or just getting in shape, this gym caters to everyone.

I highly recommend Core Combat Chiang Mai to anyone living in or visiting Chiang Mai. It's truly a fantastic place to train!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your review Angel! 

We're particularly thrilled to hear that Core Combat broke down any preconceived notions you had about combat sports gyms. Creating a welcoming and supportive environment for women in Muay Thai and all disciplines is incredibly important to us. We're delighted you're enjoying Coach Jamie's boxing classes and feeling empowered by the supportive atmosphere. We're proud to have you as a strong woman in our Core Combat family! ☺

reviews.name: Joe Chan
reviews.text:
Review for Core Combat Chiang Mai

Core Combat Chiang Mai is an exceptional training facility that offers a welcoming yet challenging environment for martial artists of all levels. From the moment you step into the gym, the energy is positive, and the dedication of the coaches is evident. The team here not only focuses on building physical skills but also cultivates mental discipline, resilience, and confidence.

The self-defense and mixed martial arts training sessions are well-structured, blending technical mastery with practical application. Whether you're a beginner or aiming to compete, the coaches tailor their guidance to suit your personal goals. The attention to detail in technique and form is outstanding, making each session a learning experience.

The community at Core Combat is another highlight. The camaraderie among trainees creates a supportive atmosphere, fostering mutual growth and encouragement. Training here feels like being part of a family where everyone pushes each other to be their best.

Core Combat Chiang Mai is more than a gym—it’s a place where you can grow both physically and mentally while connecting with a fantastic group of like-minded individuals. Highly recommended for anyone looking to explore martial arts, improve their self-defense skills, or take their training to the next level.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We look forward to continuing to support your martial arts journey and helping you achieve your goals.
Thank you again for being a valued member of our Core Combat family.

reviews.name: Roberto Cappi
reviews.text: I was wondering about taking an MMA class since 3 years already. Life brought me here in Chiang Mai, in this gym, and I could not be more satisfied. Perfect mindset, great teamwork, love the coaches and the strong integrity they have. If you want to learn fighting and especially having fun, this is the place to be!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Robby, Thanks a ton for the awesome review! So glad you enjoyed our classes :)

reviews.name: DV Royo
reviews.text: I did a drop-in session with a friend. It was fantastic! First, the facilities were clean and well-kept. They have A/C. Second, we were accommodated, welcomed, and attended to by the people at the front desk. They were all smiles and made us feel welcomed. Third (and most important), Core Combat has well trained and knowledgeable coaches. They gave special attention to us as we were beginners and our forms needed checking. They made you feel that you are part of their community even though we were just having 1 session with them. It was a very good experience for 2 friends who wanted to try muay thai in Thailand. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Our coaches are trained to provide attentive guidance to beginners, and we're so glad you felt well cared for. We hope you enjoyed your Muay Thai experience in Thailand :)

reviews.name: Stephanie Wagner
reviews.text:
My partner and I looked high & low for a reputable place to get our education visa AND actually learn something! Core Combat exceeded our expectations in every way. The class times are solid, the office staff are amazing in getting your visa paperwork handled and everyone speaks perfect English (very helpful for us who haven’t mastered the language yet 😆)
We couldn’t recommend this place enough!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Stephanie, we really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a 5-star review. It means a lot to us.

reviews.name: S G
reviews.text:
I have been to many gyms in Chiang Mai. Apparently, it is my favourite among all. You should come here for detailed skills.
The gym is very clean. Aircons are always on. The coaches are the best. I took MMA sessions and the lessons curriculum was wonderful. It's not a circuit training style like some other gyms, but a well-organised lesson that actually helps your striking and grappling skills. Also, I felt the coaches English skills are close to native speakers and they know how to fit sparring intensity for each student's level.
As the coaches are nice, the gym people are also warm-hearted and gentle. I will visit again soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. It’s heartwarming to receive such positive feedback. We’re committed to maintaining the high standards you’ve experienced and hope to continue exceeding your expectations.

reviews.name: Ghoul 920
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a place to challenge yourself, learn practical self-defense, and immerse yourself in the world of mixed martial arts (MMA), Core Combat is the perfect gym. This place doesn’t just offer a workout; it offers a community and a complete martial arts journey.

The coaches at Core Combat are top-notch, bringing extensive experience and a supportive approach to teaching. They take the time to work with each student, whether you're a beginner learning the basics of striking and grappling or an advanced student looking to hone your techniques. The classes are well-structured, combining striking, grappling, wrestling, and conditioning, all tailored to build your skills progressively. Coach Earl made me a proper a fighters that competed and finish the fight camp and all the intensive training.

Core Combat also emphasizes technique over brute force, making it ideal for people of all fitness levels. The facility itself is clean, well-equipped, and provides a welcoming environment.Also the cleanest gym in Chiangmai.

Overall, Core Combat offers a blend of rigorous training and supportive mentorship. If you're committed to self-improvement and want to test your limits, Core Combat is the place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We're thrilled to hear that you had such a positive experience at Core Combat! It's fantastic to know that you've not only learned valuable skills but also found a supportive community.

Our team of coaches is dedicated to helping students of all levels reach their full potential. We believe that a well-rounded martial arts education should include a blend of technical skill, physical fitness, and mental toughness. It's great to hear that Coach Earl played a significant role in your journey.

We're also happy to know that you appreciate our clean and welcoming facility. We strive to create a positive and motivating training environment for all our members.

Thank you for choosing Core Combat and for taking the time to share your experience. We look forward to continuing to help you achieve your goals!

reviews.name: Schirin
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic private class with Coach Earl, who was very encouraging and knowledgeable. Because I liked this class so much, I even joined one of their MMA group classes the same day. Training atmosphere was great and even though I was the only woman, I always felt safe in sparring.
I especially liked the „reflection round“ after the group class, in which everybody was invited to reflect on their learnings but also on any mistakes made during sparring. Overall, I would recommend it to everyone and would gladly join again if I‘m ever in town again✨🥊

reviews.text:
My favorite part has to be the private room (as most headspa in Thailand tend to have open area). As a hijabi, this meant a lot to me. The room is spacious, with a massage table, an attached bathroom to get ready comfortably, and even a hair drying area inside. They also provide locker and a hanging rack, which made everything feel very convenient and well-organized.

The spa is newly opened, and you can really feel it— everything is fresh, clean, and beautifully designed with a calming, nature-inspired vibe. Even the foot washing area is thoughtfully done and looks super comfortable, which already sets a relaxing tone from the start.

I went for the 19-step head massage spa using L’Oréal treatment, and it also included a facial massage with Clarins products. The whole session was incredibly relaxing, especially the focus on the head—it honestly melted all my stress away. The staff were amazing—very polite, always smiling, the massage pressure were nice and firm and they kept checking in to make sure I was comfortable throughout.

The location wise is also great, right in front of malls and a night market. It’s not exactly walkable from the city center but very easy to reach by Grab and easy to spot from the road.

Overall, I had a really great time and would highly recommed to everyone else!

A nice little bonus: I got to choose a free hairbrush after writing a Google review, which was such a cute touch! The session ended with a warm cup of tea that was super comforting and good.

title: Bangkok Sports Massage - Thonglor
ownerDescription: Thailand's premiere sports massage services located on the popular Thonglor road and only 250 metres from Thonglor BTS sky train station. Open since 2015 and having served over 13,000 customers as of June 2026, BSM provides relaxation for all, not only athletes. Sports massage works exclusively with all 3 layers of your muscles to help you relax, recover, and perform better. Our certified therapists and sports scientists are here to help.
address: 2nd Floor, Fifty Fifth Plaza, 90 Thonglor Sukhumvit 55 Road, Soi 2, Klongton Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 2nd Floor, Fifty Fifth Plaza, 90 Thonglor Sukhumvit 55 Road, Soi 2

💪 Ready to challenge yourself in a whole new way?
Push past your limits, test your grit, and sign up for the Spartan race that calls your name 🔥

So race hard… we’ll help you recover smarter 😉

reviews.name: D OC
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Bangkok Sports Massage and would highly recommend it.

My therapist, Wanwipa, was excellent. She was highly skilled, professional, and quickly identified the areas that needed attention. The massage was both therapeutic and effective, helping to relieve muscle tension and improve mobility. She applied the right amount of pressure and clearly understood how to work on sports-related aches and tightness.

The clinic was clean, welcoming, and very professional, with a relaxing atmosphere from start to finish. If you’re looking for a high-quality sports massage in Bangkok, this is definitely a place worth visiting.

Thank you, Wanwipa, and the team at Bangkok Sports Massage for such a great experience. I’ll definitely be returning.

reviews.name: Garlam Won
reviews.text:
One of the best sports massages I’ve had in Bangkok. I’ve tried a lot of massage places here, and there’s a huge difference between a normal massage and someone who actually understands how to work on tight muscles.

I booked with Mr. Game and he was excellent. He quickly figured out where I was holding the most tension and really focused on those areas instead of just following the same routine for everyone. The pressure was strong but controlled, and the stretching and deep tissue work made a noticeable difference by the time I walked out.

The place itself is clean, professional, and conveniently located in Thonglor. If you work out regularly, sit at a desk all day, travel a lot, or just want proper sports massage rather than a relaxing oil massage, I’d definitely recommend this place and Mr. Game.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We appreciate it and are motivated to keep providing great service to all customers.

reviews.name: Николай Кушниров
reviews.text:
This is an excellent place if you’re looking for a high-quality sports massage or therapeutic treatment. If you want more than just a relaxing massage with gentle strokes—something that truly helps your body recover and improves your overall well-being—this is the place to visit.

I had a great experience and will definitely come back. Next time I’d like to try a full course of treatments and experience the different techniques the therapists offer.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional, effective massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We appreciate it and are motivated to keep providing great service to all customers.

reviews.text: I’ve been coming to BSM for a few months now for services ranging from remedial massage to sports and office syndrome massage. All are great in their own way, and the therapists are consistently professional, knowledgeable and welcoming. If you live in Bangkok, I highly recommend it here for all of your recovery needs. You’re in good hands. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for placing your trust in us. We aim to look after every customer the best we can, and should there be any issues we would sincerely accept any feedback.

reviews.name: JTamim
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Mr. Yok. He is highly professional, knowledgeable, and truly skilled at what he does. I had been struggling with tennis elbow for quite some time, and his unique treatment technique made a significant difference. He took the time to understand my condition and provided exceptional care throughout the process. It was a pleasure working with him, and I highly recommend his services to anyone looking for an experienced and dedicated professional.

reviews.name: Sarah Meugens
reviews.text: This is exactly what I needed. I swim and rock climb regularly and have developed a tight rhomboid with a severe knot under my scapula and a tense lower back. Ms. Koi was amazing at identifying all the locations that needed attention. With the remedial sports massage she was able to focus on my problem areas for the entire session. Although necessarily painful at times I left feeling relief in my back that I haven’t felt in years. After leaving this review I’ll be going online to book my next session. 10/10 service. Professional, polite, clean, comfortable, and no wasting time- perfect experience.

reviews.name: Jimmy S. Lee
reviews.text: For my first time. It’s been a great remedy to my post marathon run. Ms. Por had treated my muscle soreness with great expertise. I’ll be coming back more often.

reviews.name: Thomas CAZENAVE-VERGEZ
reviews.text: Khun KoiLek has been absolutely unbelievable. I've been looking for a great sports massage place around the Tonglen area for a while. I tried many, many places and never had such an experience. The key differentiator is her knowledge. She's a master at work. I provided a clear explanation of my previous issue, accidents, and surgery experiences and she did absolutely amazing! Perfect analysis, sharp massage, exactly what I needed. Oh my God! I feel so good after it! Very highly recommended but please don't use her too much! Ha ha! Leave me some time with her 😂
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the glowing review.  We will certainly pass on your praises to her as words of encouragement. 🤗

reviews.name: Cale Gibson
reviews.text: Bangkok Sports Massage - Thonglor was an excellent experience from start to finish. The staff were professional, knowledgeable, and clearly understood recovery and muscle work very well. The treatment was thorough, effective, and tailored in a way that felt both relaxing and genuinely beneficial. The space was clean, comfortable, and well run, and the whole experience felt polished and professional. A great place in Bangkok for proper sports massage and recovery. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Tyga Hero
reviews.text:
If a 3rd party Sports Therapy ranking system existed and placed Khun KoiLek #1 in Bangkok, I would not be shocked. Having been a professional athlete, I can assure you she's that good.

I've undergone her deep tissue sports, pre-event, post-event, and remedial therapy massages. All have a different structure, by design.

What separates KoiLek is her holistic approach. A large majority of non-acute sports injuries develop because of balance issues or the strong side compensating for the weak. Khun KoiLek understands and her routine will address this. For example, with her remedial therapy, you can explain an injury and she'll work around it while focusing just as much on the opposite side.

I work in Phuket and our sports therapy services are progressing nicely. Still, I have booked with Bangkok Sports Massage Thonglor on multiple occasions. It's a testament to the consistent quality they have provided.

Overall the massage feels good, and if you can tolerate some uncomfortable moments, your body will thank you.

reviews.text:
Went to this place years ago and truly dissatisfied with the massage. I took a sports massage with Ms.Por and there are some things I would like to note:
- The sports massage is wrongly advertised, this happened to be just a regular oil massage you can get at any massage place.
- After booking the massage I received a message where i would like the massage to be focused at. I noted that I would like to have it focussed on my shoulders, back and chest. Ms.Por during the massage gave very little attention to the points that I mentioned and showed that needed attention. She just simply ignored it and said yes later but the later never came.

Honestly, if you're on the fence of taking the sports massage then I would not bother and just go to any regular massage place as there is no difference.

reviews.text: Today was my first time getting a massage here, and I was very impressed. The therapist was incredibly professional, knowing exactly what I wanted and giving it her all. reviews.text: Visited a few times over our week stay. Not a cheap spa but an elegant one! Its a very relaxing vibe from the minute you walk in. Staff are beautiful and kind and thr treatments were top notch. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Fiona Qian
reviews.text:
I’ve been to Let’s Relax Spa a couple of times before and both visits were excellent. However, this time I had a disappointing experience. I booked a body scrub session in person and was given a handwritten confirmation slip. When I arrived for my appointment, I was told that my reservation could not be found.

It was quite frustrating to make the trip only to discover the booking hadn’t been recorded. I would recommend double-checking with the receptionist when booking, as you may otherwise arrive to find there is no reservation.

reviews.name: Table Notes
reviews.text:
Tucked within the calm surroundings of Boat Lagoon, this spa offers a quiet pause away from the busier parts of Phuket.

Inside, the atmosphere is soothing and carefully designed, with soft lighting, gentle music and the subtle scent of essential oils drifting through the rooms. The treatments focus on traditional Thai massage techniques alongside oil massages and spa therapies that aim to ease tired muscles after long days of travel.

The therapists work with steady, practiced movements, and the experience feels professionally run from start to finish. That said, as part of a larger spa chain, the experience can feel a little structured compared to smaller independent spas where the atmosphere sometimes feels more personal.

Still, it remains a comfortable and reliable place to unwind. A quiet hour of calm before stepping back into the rhythm of the island.

reviews.text:
Worst massage ever  !

I went for 2hr 45 mins package.
They ask me what my problem areas were . But didn’t bother about them at all . Therapist Did her own thing.
After 2hr 45 mins , I needed a real massage ! On the next day my whole body was in pain rather than relaxed !

The ambience is good , counter staff is nice, but the therapist I got was not able to massage with proper technique!

Even though the pressure was good, the massage was not at all relaxing. It was actually More painful  because she was randomly pressing points.

So it depends on the therapist who you get and their skills.

Very expensive and very bad massage!
I would not recommend it !

reviews.name: Natpapat Likhit
reviews.text:
I visited this spa today and booked a 2-hour session: 1 hour of Thai massage followed by 1 hour of oil massage. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing.

The Thai massage was acceptable, but during the oil massage, the therapist mostly just applied oil and lightly rubbed my body without any proper technique. There was no pressure point work and no muscle relaxation at all. I eventually had to ask her to increase the pressure. However, after that, it felt like she was simply pressing down heavily without intention or technique. The pressure was extremely hard and painful, making the experience uncomfortable rather than relaxing.

Throughout the session, it felt rushed, as if the therapist was trying to finish as quickly as possible. This experience felt unfair not only to me as a customer, but also to the business owner, as having such unprofessional service reflects poorly on the spa.

I hope this feedback will be taken seriously and used to improve staff training and service quality in the future.

reviews.name: Devon Patterson
reviews.text:
A bit pricier than most, but worth it for the full spa setup - nice facilities, proper privacy, and not just a quick in-and-out local spot.

Orapin, my therapist, was the standout! She actually listened to what I needed and focused there instead of running through a generic routine. Pressure was spot on, and she checked in just enough without interrupting the flow.

Will definitely go back and book with her again.

reviews.text: Very good experience~ high value massage with excellent service and clean environment~ very recommend, will visit again for sure.

reviews.name: Ciro Pizzi
reviews.text: 50 % of our reasons to come to Chiang Mai is this massage place. The staff is amazing, the place is clean and the price is fare for the quality offered. A must try for all travelers.

reviews.name: May Lim
reviews.text: Had a great experience! The massage was really good and right on point. The therapist knew exactly where to focus

reviews.name: Donna Wing
reviews.text: From the moment we walked in we treated awesomely. Greg got a foot massage that he says was out of this world. Myself I got a mani pedi. My girl was absolutely efficient. Thank you both for a great experience.Donna Wing. Ontario Canada

reviews.name: Janel Christensen
reviews.text: Great service! I got the deep tissue massage and it was wonderful.

reviews.name: dilnazar dolkun

I love this massage. boss has been working in 4 season's hotel before and very experienced. enviroment is warm and the staff are very kind and helpful.
very skillful and reduce my pain and tiredness. the quality of massage oil is tip top condition. feel relaxed and not too oily. I must visit again while go Chiang mai. strongly recommend
