reviews.name: Alex Turpin
reviews.text: We absolutely loved this place. I got the best Thai massage I've ever had from Pom. Thank you so much! We were actually hoping to go back again today, but just noticed that they are unfortunately closed on Saturdays. All the staff are very friendly and they make sure that you have a wonderful experience. If you're in the area, you have to give this place a go. I hope to be back one day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for enjoying our service and having a wonderful experience. We’re delighted that you will be returning to our shop again.Our shop now open every day. Thank you very much 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.name: Rashmi Virmani
reviews.text: I got an aroma massage done from Varich. It was just a walk in from my side. The experience turned out be awesome, relaxing and completely rejuvenating. I had shared my concerns and stiffness areas. They suggested relevant massage. The therapist who did my massage was mature and had thorough knowledge of technique. II thank Varich team for taking good care of me. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.name: Miss J Ball
reviews.text: One of the best and most comfortable massages I’ve ever had. It starts with a welcoming cup of tea and a short form where you can note which areas need attention, any health concerns or recent surgeries, and your preferred pressure level. Then comes a lovely foot wash with warm, fragrant water,pure bliss after a long walk around Chiang Mai 🥹😆. I was lucky to get a wonderful masseuse; it was so relaxing I nearly fell asleep. The spa is right in front of Sanae Hotel, which is also a great place to stay in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆที่แบ่งปันประสบการณ์ที่ยอดเยี่ยม ขอบคุณมากที่ชอบการบริการของเรา ♥️🙏♥️🙏♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.name: Luigi Lim
reviews.text: It was one of the memorable massage I ever had , I was the last customer walked in at 10pm and wanted a foot neck head shoulder massage which was 90 mins and they close at 11pm . I was not rejected and warmly welcomed instantly with a smile. I was asked with the paper list if I liked to have medium or strong massage to be highlighted to the massuer, was surprised that I never had such attentive service at many massage parlors I went before . The lady boss at the reception attended to me washing my feet with scrubbing salt where it was not commonly used elsewhere as the masseur was still with another client session . The masseur proceeded with my session after finished the previous , she exerted with precise strength never dimmishing and soothed my aching muscles after a Chiangrai day trip . It was genuinely a satisfied  massage I had and I highly recommend this place amongst the rest at same stretch of the street .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: เราดีใจและมีความสุขเป็นอย่างมากที่ได้รับรู้ว่าคุณลูกค้าชื่นชอบและพึงพอใจการบริการของเรา ขอขอบคุณมากๆที่แบ่งปันประสบการณ์ที่ยอดเยี่ยมเป็นรีวิวที่สวยงาม เราหวังว่าจะมีโอกาสได้ให้บริการคุณลูกค้าอีกครั้งในโอกาสต่อไปค่ะ ขอบคุณมากค่ะ♥️🙏♥️🙏♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.name: Xianhui Yang
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. This was the first place where they actually had a chart where they marked which areas you choose to massage, you can specify how long for each part and preferred strength. The massuese constantly asked if the strength was ok. It felt super good when my shoulders and back had the knots pressed out. Would definitely xome back here again.

reviews.name: Heidi Ng
reviews.text:
Very nice place for massage
Not the most fancy & pretty place, but the therapist skill are very good.
Environment is 7/10
Skill is 10/10!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆที่ชอบเทคนิคการนวดของหมอและรีวิวที่ยอดเยี่ยมของคุณทำให้เรามีความสุขมากๆหวังว่าจะได้ให้บริการคุณอีกในโอกาสต่อไปค่ะขอบคุณมากค่ะ♥️🙏♥️🙏♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.name: Patsy Wong
reviews.text:
We are a group of 5 at ages 60+ to 80+.  We stayed in Nimman Mai Design Hotel Chiang Mai for 4 nights. It is only 1 minute walk from our hotel. After having tried the first time, we went every evening.
Staff are all polite with cheerful smiles. Even walk-in, it takes at most 10-15 minutes for the massager to serve you. Massagers' service is above average. Price is reasonable. I have recommended it to my friends.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆที่ชอบการบริการของเราและขอบคุณมากๆอีกครั้งที่แนะนำเพือนๆของคุณให้มาใช้บริการของเรา หวังว่าจะได้ให้บริการคุณและครอบครัวในโอกาสต่อไปค่ะ🙏♥️🙏♥️🙏♥️

reviews.name: Sting Kimetkis
reviews.text: I saw reviews and tought is gonna be really nice but lady was very old and pretty tired, breathing heavy and loud and feel asleep during massage. I felt sorry for her but you just could say that staff is tired and or not available I didnt have to go through this 60 min emabrasment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Our shop has always prioritized and implemented measures to ensure the happiness, safety, and maximum benefit of our customers. If your experience was untrue, you could have terminated the massage, informed us, or chosen many other constructive ways to protect your rights and benefits. Instead, you chose to damage our shop's reputation. We are truly saddened by this incident, even though we don't yet know whether what we've heard is true or false!!!

reviews.name: Pete Lai
reviews.text:
Had an enjoyable experience here,
There's no extra charge for a couple's privateroom.

The masseuse was great at spotting a sore spot to target for stress relief.
Highly recommended.

Enjoyed ourselves
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏 so much.

reviews.name: Karen Chu
reviews.text: Read the reviews and decided to come as it was very near to where I was staying. Left totally impressed by the ambience and service! The place was very clean and they play very soft gentle music at the background, minimal disturbance unlike some spas which would have people constantly chatting. My therapist was very attentive and gentle! 300 baht for 60mins foot massage with that kind of standard I would say is very reasonable. Oh, and the ginger tea at the end is SO good, especially on such a rainy evening. Thank you for a subtle but much appreciated session. 😊🙏🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much and happy to meet you again in the future “Kob kun Ka 🙏🏻🙏🏻”

reviews.name: ESTHER X
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience! The three of us visited for two consecutive days, and every staff here was nice and friendly. The massage place is pretty clean as well. I strongly recommend a young, slender female therapist with long hair and another female therapist with short hair and glasses. Their techniques were excellent, and they focused perfectly on the areas we requested. A special thanks to my therapist, your smile and profession truly made my day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: เราดีใจมากๆที่ได้มีโอกาสต้อนรับคุณลูกค้าและมีความสุขเมื่อรู้ว่าคุณได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ยอดเยี่ยมจากการบริการของคุณหมอที่เราคัดสรรให้ รีวิวที่วิเศษของคุณทำให้เราซาบซึ้งและมีกำลังใจอย่างหาที่สุดมิได้ ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ🙏♥️🙏

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊 🙏

reviews.name: Alex Chung
reviews.text: The massage was absolutely exceptional! The therapist's technique was perfect, with just the right pressure to relieve tension and promote relaxation. I felt completely rejuvenated and stress-free afterward. The ambiance was calming, and the attention to detail made the experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a truly professional and relaxing massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: เราดีใจและมีความสุขที่ได้รับรู้ว่าคุณได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ยอดเยี่ยมผ่อนคลาย,มีความสุขและประทับใจกับการบริการของเรา ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ 🙏♥️🙏♥️

reviews.name: Molly Seifert
reviews.text: We stayed right across the street during our time in Chiang Mai and we came to Varich Massages almost every day because every massage was better than the last! We enjoyed multiple different kinds of massage and felt great and relaxed after each one. My husband loved the bell fruit tea they served us so much that we made sure to buy some at a market before we left. If you’re in the area do not skip Varich massage! They may be off the main road but walk up the street and enjoy some relaxation!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for choosing Varich massage and your nice reviews,we’re so glad to be a small part of your special moment during your visit to Chiang Mai and enjoying our service. We hope to welcome you again in the future.🙏♥️🙏♥️

title: Khaosok Yoga เขาสกโยคะ
ownerDescription:
Yoga meditation sound healing in the jungle rainforests. Jungle Yoga retreats
Peaceful and harmonic yoga sala in the hill with a stunning view.
address: 329 Moo 6 Khaosok Khlong Sok, Phanom District, Surat Thani 84250, Thailand
plusCode: WG8V+X6 Khlong Sok, Phanom District, Surat Thani, Thailand

reviews.name: Emily Balentine
reviews.text: My partner and I had a fantastic experience here doing the evening Vinyasa class! In addition to the location being very peaceful with the best view of the sunset, Rossi made our yoga class super relaxing and serene. Her meditation practices brought us to the present and are something we will take with us on the rest of our journey. The singing bowls were very calming alongside the sounds of the jungle coming alive at night. We were so comfortable in her class- the mats, blankets, face towel, and water were perfect. Rossi even took some photos of us while in class with the stunning sunset view! Easy 10/10 experience. The location is a bit far from town, so be sure to leave early if you want to enjoy the walk to her studio :) Thank you, Rossi!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for sharing, see you next time . Love Rossi

reviews.name: Amy Charlotte Sturgeon
reviews.text: Idyllic location hidden up in the jungle. Excellent host who told us lots about the teachings of yoga and Buddhist philosophy. Booked the night before super simple, had the whole class to ourselves. We did morning yoga and meditation. Very peaceful and felt great afterwards. Didn’t get to try sunset yoga or singing bowl but can imagine they would be fantastic too. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Khao sok if they have the chance :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thansk you for sharing and looking forward to see you next time

reviews.name: Ellie Kinney
reviews.text: I had such a wonderful experience here! I had been wanting to find a yoga spot like this since being in Thailand and this exceeded my expectations. Beautiful views, lovely space to practice, and the instructor Rosie was amazing. She helped give physical corrections, but more importantly gave us a better understanding of Buddhist teaching and how it is incorporated into yoga practice. The sound bath was next level, she even places the the bowls on your chest to feel the vibrations. The walk there is beautiful and she will drive you back to your accommodation for a small price! Can’t recommend enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for your reviws

reviews.name: Karolina
reviews.text:
Best sunset yoga! Definitely add this place to your itinerary🫶🏼 one of the best classes I did on my trip with the breathtaking view
The studio is located a bit outside of the center of town, the walk there is beautiful and takes around 30-40min. The class is a wonderful vinyasa with hands on adjustments and flow for everyone no matter the level! After that the teacher does a sound healing which was one of the most relaxing things I have ever done! She uses bowls and makes sounds with them and at the end puts it on your chest. The feeling of vibration is magical!
For the small price she provided a lift to the center where it’s close to restaurant to get dinner or a snack after:)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for sharing, see you next time . Love Rossi

reviews.name: Molly Young
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at an authentic and intimate yoga class in Khao Sok! Highly recommend walking the 40 minute scenic route from the village to the beautiful studio located in the middle of the jungle. We chose the 6pm Vinyasa Flow class with a 30 minute sound healing afterward, which was amazing to experience the sunset while practicing surrounded by nature. Our teacher Rossi spoke very good English and explained the class so well, she also took us back to Khao Sok village for 50 baht each.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for sharing your review, peace and love Rossi

reviews.name: Margot Guétat
reviews.text:
I did the 3-day retreat. It was incredible! A very good experience as a beginner to yoga and meditation. Rossi is kind, she takes the time to show us the different poses and correct us. During the classes, she explains the philosophy of Buddhism and its connection to yoga, which is very interesting. I highly recommend the experience, whether for a retreat or just a yoga class. Thank you, Rossi! 🫶
And what's more, the setting is beautiful !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Such lovely to having you here for 3 days retreats. I love your energy and willingness to learn ancient wisdom to bring your better life. Keep pratice yoga meditation. I would love to hear from you one day you come back, said you have been in 10 days slient meditation . Peace and Love Rossi

reviews.name: Kristina Heyen
reviews.text: This was such a beautiful experience! I did the sunset yoga with singing bowl meditation class, and it was wonderful. Rossi is so kind and has the most beautiful location for a yoga class. She placed the singing bowls right on our chests during part of the meditation and it was so relaxing. I highly recommend this class to yogis of all skill sets.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thansk you for sharing you experience. will wait to see you next time. Love Rossi

reviews.name: Sahar Armandi
reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful experiences in this outside yoga studio, surrounded by beautiful nature. Rossi is a kind and warm soul that led us through excellent yoga and calming meditation.

I took the evening yoga class with singingbowls and the morning mist yoga with meditation.

I also had a private singing bowl session. Rossi poured all her beautiful energy, love and kindness into this session. I felt so taken cared of and cared for. Rossi really works with her whole body, mind and soul.
I met many kind souls in Thailand, but I will keep a special place for Rossi in my heart.
I would recommend booking in advance, especially the private sessions since it's limited and fills up.

Truly greatful for the experienced I had in Khaosok Yoga. My trip to Khaosok would have been incomplete without this.

Forever thankful,
Sahar
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much from my heart for your beautiful words. Reading your review truly touched me deeply, and I’m incredibly grateful that you chose to share your experience.

It was such a joy to practice with you in both the evening and morning classes, and to share the private singing bowl session together. Knowing that you felt cared for, supported, and connected means everything to me. I always offer my sessions with my whole heart, body, and soul, and I’m so thankful that this came through for you.

Khao Sok has a very special energy, and I’m grateful we were able to share those peaceful moments surrounded by nature. Meeting kind souls like you is one of the greatest gifts of this work, and I will also keep you in a special place in my heart.

Thank you for your recommendation and for your trust. I’m so happy that Khaosok Yoga was part of your journey here, and I truly hope our paths cross again one day.

With deep gratitude and love 🙏
Rossi

reviews.name: David Hubert
reviews.text:
The 3-day yoga retreat with Rossi was truly a great experience and a pleasure. I'm not sure that other yoga experiences will quite compare to practicing yoga, meditation, and learning about Buddhism in this jungle paradise. The view, the sounds, and the atmosphere created by Rossi make this a very special experience.

Rossi practices Buddhism and uses Yoga as a tool for relaxing the body and the mind for meditation. I love that approach! The sessions are with those attending the retreat, as well as those attending single classes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for reviews , will wait for see you next time. Love Rossi

reviews.name: Sophia Grant
reviews.text: What a peaceful lovely experience in the jungle! I did the 8.30am yoga and meditation class and came away with a much deeper appreciation for Thai Buddhist meditation, and the basic key elements of sitting in meditation. I’ll be taking that learning home with me! And the walk to and from the yoga shall is just beautiful. Thank you for the experience, highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for reviews , will wait for see you next time. Love Rossi

reviews.name: Natasha Black
reviews.text: An amazing yoga class and unique sound bowl experience. Rossi is very talented at sharing her gift, is welcoming, and the studio is amazing. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏 for sharing

reviews.name: Laetitia Nossek
reviews.text:
What a magical experience!!! Rossi is the best with the nicest energy. I did the 3 day retreat - yoga meditation and singing bowls. I feel healed :). It is high season so it can be busy some times..

Thank you so much for these few days filled with jungle air, good stretches and a new core memory!! Highlight of my trip.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Such lovely to having you here for 3 days retreats. I love your energy and willingness to learn ancient wisdom to bring your better life. Keep pratice yoga meditation. I would love to hear from you one day you come back, said you have been in 10 days slient meditation . Peace and Love Rossi

reviews.name: Sidonie Satchell
reviews.text: What an amazing class! We did the 1h30 evening yoga class with singing bowls which had the most beautiful view and the instructor was great! Definitely a challenging class but still accessible for beginners! We walked from our hostel and the walk was easy in the daylight and ok at night but bring a torch!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for your kindness reviews

reviews.name: Rozálie Elmanová
reviews.text: If you’re heading to a sunset yoga class, skip the taxi and walk. Such a beautiful walk from town at sunset. The class was combined with sound healing in a stunning setting. It was really special — thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thansk you for your reviews. Love Rossi

reviews.name: busara hall
reviews.text: The Sunset Yoga and Singing bowls are a must do if you come to Khao Sok. It’s a challenging but accessible flow, breathe-taking view, and the special singing bowls technique was phenomenal. I felt like I was floating above my body and releasing so much built up tension and stress. Will be back for the retreat!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Such lovely to have you here for 2 sunset yoga, looking forward to see you in retreats next time you come back to Thailand. Love Rossi

reviews.name: Carolina Buxo
reviews.text:
Rossi is an amazing teacher and person, being around her is already a blessing.
We did the 5 days yoga retreat, which was really intense with yoga+meditation every morning and afternoon and 4 sound healing sessions.
I felt my energy moving in my body and mind with the sound of the bowls and Rossi’s special techniques, understood my body blockages with yoga and relaxed to meditate. Also learned a lot about Thai culture and the history of Yoga and meditation.
Thank you Rossi so much for sharing all your knowledge with us, I will never forget my house of Khaosok🩵
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It so pleasure to having both of you here on 5 days retreats. Love your guys energy and being present in the classes, Hope to seeing you next time when you come back to Thailand .Love Rossi

reviews.name: Christina Graf
reviews.text:
I have to admit that I never really thought much of yoga or meditation. I had tried it several times back home, but it never really convinced me — until I booked this class.

The yoga teacher is truly amazing! Everything feels very authentic, which is probably why I felt so comfortable.

I especially appreciate the breathing techniques and beginner meditation exercises, as I like to use them on overwhelming travel days.

The way to the yoga class was quite a trek, but the breathtaking view definitely made it worthwhile.

Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Christina, Thanks you for feed back, If you forget how to do breathing techniques text me I can help you to remind pratices agian. with Love Rossi

reviews.name: Ana Serrenho
reviews.text:
Going to khaosokyoga was one of my best experiences in Thailand!
Rosie is such a gentle, authentic and warm-hearted person. She is welcoming you in her house which is in the middle of the jungle. Her sunset yoga combined with singing bowls was just magical surrounded by the sounds of the wildlife.
I also went for a 1:1 session where she teached me about buddism and her way of living combined with a guided meditation. She teachs in an authentic way which makes it easy to understand.
I would recommand this place to everyone!
Thank you Rosie for your teaching!✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I love your curiosity to take note writing down and learn about thai Buddhism, you on the way to find your own answer of the life. Thanks you for attended 2 best classes to learn and gain hour self more wisdom of life... Love Rossi

reviews.name: Simon Jacobs
reviews.text:
Rossi gave me the most wonderful experience over a 3 day retreat of yoga, meditation and singing bowl healing.

Her location is stunning. It really is Jungle yoga and provides a tranquil and beautiful setting. She’s a great yoga teacher, pushes you if want to be challenged (which I did), patient if you’re a beginner. The way she ties in the meditation with the yoga and a simple understanding of Buddhism as a background is excellent and forms an approach to a healthy life you can take with you for incorporating into the everyday.

Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It not only you learn from me, I learn and seeing my self in you such a great opportunity for me to having you  in my retreats. Yes healer need healing. Thanks you to choose jungle yoga to healing you. Keep meditation we see again, Love Rossi

reviews.name: KristyLouise InTheBreeze
reviews.text: I booked a 3 day yoga retreat as a solo female traveler from the US. I was delightfully surprised at my experience. I stayed across the road and the accommodation was awesome. The host was super helpful as well in my future trip planning. My yoga experience was AWESOME! The meditation, sound healing, yoga… it was all thoughtfully planned and Rossi was very well educated in her practice! I could not recommend this experience more!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you 🙏 for your kindness review. It blessing to have you here

title: CC's Hideaway
description: Modern hotel offering stylish rooms, free breakfast, an outdoor pool & rooftop dining.
address: 84 Patak Rd, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R8H3+XV Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand
hotelDescription:
Nestled in the hills overlooking the Andaman Sea, this funky, modern hotel is 1.8 km from the beach and 9 km from the Wat Chalong temple.
 Featuring custom furniture, hand-made linens, and period and modern art, the upscale rooms are decorated in traditional Thai styles, and come with free Wi-Fi, air-conditioning, minifridges and flat-screen TVs with satellite channels. Some upgraded rooms have direct pool access.
 Free amenities include a shuttle to nearby beaches, plus a breakfast buffet in a chic rooftop restaurant offering Thai and Western food. There's also an outdoor pool, a bar and a business center. Massages are offered.

reviews.name: 703mikaelaz
reviews.text: CC’s Hideaway was everything and more!! I solo travelled to Phuket and left with some wonderful friends from around the world. I participated in the holiday retreat package where I took yoga 1-2 times a day (depending on how I was feeling). The view from the rooftop is beautiful. The aerial yoga is a must try!! Breakfast was fresh daily and I would join others on the retreat at that time before getting ready for whatever activity I had planned to participate in (you have a consultation to discuss what you would like to do each day - great for the organized!). I loved the viewpoints day, James Bond Island day, temple tours, and Thai cuisine day (major shout out to Kong, our engaging and intelligent tour guide who tolerated me for 4 outings and Chef Por for a fun cooking class). The massages were also amazing and relaxing. I loved the aromatherapy consult! While the menu through the hotel could feel limited, the items were fresh and the juices/smoothies were a great option to cool down by the pool. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful and truly made for the best experience possible. As a yogi and solo traveller, this was an unforgettable experience and CC’s played a major role in that!! I hope to visit again soon!!!

reviews.name: Princess Flower Louise (Sydney0011)
reviews.text:
CCS hideaway is an awesome little gem 💎 hidden in the hills of Kata beach!! 🏝️It really is a must do if you’re looking for a mixture of yoga and adventure solo or with a companion.💃🏻

The provide regular Shuttles return to kata beach and 8 different stops filled with markets, places to eat, massage venues and everything you can possibly need!

The staff are fantastic - they get to know you by name and room number which creates a really nice personalised experience! ⚜️ the food is 5 star 🌟 every time, the teachers are super experienced and kind, I did the yoga retreat and loved doing a couple of days on Thai herbal remedies and soap and essence making. The tours are a localised experience you just can’t get anywhere else, the tour guides are super fun and care about you so much they make the days exciting, informative and super fun!! 🤩 everything is run so perfectly with everything considered to make your day perfect every time!! loved every one of them!

The cooking class and farm experience is also an awesome experience spending most of the day with a couple of the chefs from the retreat and they teach you everything you need to know about Thai cooking starting with a taste test of all the local fruits at the market ending with learning to cook 4 dishes for yourself you enjoy for lunch.

I did a mixture of wellness and adventure and it really was once in a life time experiences! The week was filled with events, too many to list them all but the were all fantastic, all run smoothly with so much care! You finish the days with a community all staying at the hotel Together which is nice.

I was so comfortable in my room it was great! Had everything I needed, was super comfortable, smart TV, well laid out and sized with creature comforts everywhere! The drop off nightly of sleep tea was a super cute touch!

This retreat deserves a 10 star really!! If you want a super personalised experience, with caring and fun staff, a mixture of adventure, relaxation, Thai experience this place is a must!!!

I already can’t wait to come back!! 🤩🧘🏻‍♀️🌸

reviews.name: Radhika Lamba
reviews.text:
Wow — is all I can say. I had the most amazing time at CCS Hideaway. I came as a solo traveller and arrived at the beginning of May (slightly off-season), so the hotel was quieter, but the staff were still so accommodating and welcoming.

I did the yoga retreat holiday, which I highly recommend because it was such an incredible experience. My package included all meals, yoga classes, and the option to choose between activity days or meditation/wellness days — they really tailor the experience to you.

For example, one day I did the island trip, which was amazing, and the next day I joined the yoga philosophy day. They have such a great range of teachers and yoga styles including Hatha, Ashtanga, Aerial Yoga and Vinyasa — it’s the perfect way to try different styles and explore what suits you. I’m already a keen yogi, so it was really nice to experience some slower styles like Hatha and learn from different teachers.

They also have multiple spaces to practice in, including a beautiful rooftop and a downstairs studio, which I loved. I joined some sound healing sessions in the evenings too, which were such beautiful experiences. I really tried to make the most of all the activities available.

Even if you don’t book one of the retreat packages, you can still pay to join individual workshops and classes, which I’d definitely recommend because everything they offer is so special.

From the moment you book, the staff are so attentive. You receive WhatsApp messages and daily updates about your itinerary for the next day, which makes everything feel easy and organised.

The staff truly make the experience. Everyone was so friendly that you leave feeling like part of a family.

Special shoutouts to:

Nim — she has so much energy and runs the tours amazingly.
Cristina — I did her Reiki healing and chakra workshop and her knowledge was incredible.
Bam — the beach yoga sessions were beautiful.
Dev — the yoga philosophy day was so informative.
Stefanie — her yoga classes were challenging in the best way.
Sarah —runs the teacher training programs her class was great.
And so many more people who genuinely go above and beyond.

I honestly can’t thank everyone enough for the experience.

The food was also so delicious — healthy, fresh, and nourishing. You can really tell they care about looking after you.

My only feedback would be that if you book one of the retreat packages, take your time understanding all the options available. It took me a day or so to fully understand how everything worked. You usually choose between two different day styles, but you can also add extra activities if you want to. For example, I chose an active day and then added an evening meditation session, which was great. You can also choose beauty/spa-style days too.

If you’re staying at the hotel, they also run a beach shuttle, which I used on my last day — super easy and convenient. You can also do the Big Buddha hike directly from the hotel, which is another great option if you want to explore independently.

Overall, such a beautiful experience and I’d absolutely recommend CCS Hideaway to anyone looking for a wellness retreat, yoga holiday, or even just somewhere relaxing and supportive to stay.

reviews.name: Q3185RUbrianw
reviews.text: Wonderful team—warm, friendly and supportive. Great hilltop location with easy access to town. I joined the detox program and, though I was worried about the diet since I love meat and avoid greens, the meals were delicious, filling and surprisingly enjoyable.

reviews.name: Becca Melnick
reviews.text:
Cc’s is an absolute gem. As others have said, I was a bit concerned when I pulled up but I was blown away by my stay here. The rooms were lovely - comfortable and modern with smart tvs. The staff were fantastic - warm, welcoming and helpful. And the pool was perfect.

What really makes CCs shine are the activities they offer and the food. Every meal I ate at the restaurant was better than the last. It was healthy and extremely tasty. And the comprehensive yoga and wellness program was a true treat. You can either book a room inclusive of  the wellness program, or pay per class. They offer yoga, Pilates, meditation and outings each day.

The other fantastic element of CCs is the community. It was the perfect combination of friendly but not a raging party. The environment fosters social connection without it feeling like a 20-something’s hostel. As a solo traveler looking for a more laid back vibe, it was the perfect environment.

I wholeheartedly recommend CC’s and I hope my travels bring me back some day.

reviews.name: Jolene Ruth Tan
reviews.text:
CC Hideaway is hands down one of the best value wellness stays I’ve ever experienced!

What I loved most is how fuss-free everything is. All 3 meals are included, there’s morning and evening yoga daily, and a structured schedule where you simply choose what you feel like doing that day.

The activities are genuinely thoughtful. It’s rare to find something that’s affordable, calming, well-organised, and truly worth it, but CC Hideaway absolutely nails it. They’ve set the bar very high, I’m already planning to come back next year just to experience the other half of the weekly activities!

Highly recommend if you want a wellness stay where everything is taken care of and you can just be.

Thank you CC! I’ve had a wonderful stay.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jolene,

Thank you so much for your kind review. We’re truly happy to hear that we met your expectations, and we look forward to welcoming you again next year.

Warm regards,
CC's Hideaway team

reviews.name: Craig Warren
reviews.text: The hotel is excellent, as are the staff. Breakfast was also a welcome change, with lots of fresh, health food. If you don't choose to pay for the breakfast, it has 330b per person per day. The hotel is out of the way, which makes it quiet. They have a very easy shuttle service, which makes transport to the local towns very easy. Otherwise we used the Grab app. Their mattresses and bedding are also top notch. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for choosing to stay with us. It was truly a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back again for another wonderful experience.

reviews.name: 556malb
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at CC’s. Great vibes and energy at CC’s. Perfect place to recharge and reset. There are plenty of activities you can undertake or take it easy with yoga and massage. Recommend the reiki and “office syndrome” massage.

reviews.name: Domj Bro
reviews.text:
We had a bit of a mixed stay at CCs. It's more like a nicer hostel, which wasn't really what we were after but would be perfect if that's what you're looking for.

Cons: they play music with bass all day and the rooms surround the pool and reception area, so you can hear it everywhere you go. We wanted to sit quietly by the pool and read but didn't because of the music. It's pretty cruisy music, so it might not bother you but it bothered us. They also had a Christmas Eve event while we were there which was fun, but if you were tired or sick that evening then there's no way you could've rested or slept during the event due to the amount of noise.

Pros: the food was great and well priced, and they had activities all day. We joined in on the yoga and we both enjoyed it. If you are a solo or social traveller looking to meet people then I would probably recommend CCs. The first room we were in was directly behind the bar so we asked for a different room and they moved us, which we really appreciated. The rooms were clean and had everything we needed.

reviews.name: Anna
reviews.text:
From start to finish CCs was excellent.  The communication before hand was great and continued to be for the whole stay.
The activities were great and well organised as was the more wellness days. The food was brilliant, tasty, nutritious and fresh. The room was great, spacious and clean. I'd return 100%. I did the yoga retreat.

reviews.name: KC
reviews.text:
From the outside front view, I honestly thought I had made a mistake—it didn’t look very appealing at first. But once I went upstairs, I was so glad I was wrong. The experience inside is completely different from the first impression.
The room quality really impressed me. The bed was thick, super comfortable, and perfect for a good night’s sleep. I also loved the details inside the room, especially the paintings by local Thai artists—it added such a nice, authentic touch.
The property also has a restaurant with many vegan options. It is a bit on the expensive side, but the quality of the food is excellent and worth it.
The staff were professional, friendly, and spoke good English, which made everything easy and pleasant. The only downside is that the walls are a bit thin, so don’t expect complete soundproofing.
Overall, definitely worth the money, and I’d happily recommend this place.

reviews.name: Khym Kim
reviews.text:
Fun place to get away from everything. Took the yoga retreat package. Its a little pricey but I really liked how the package included transfer, activities and meals and it offered that yoga retreat option without having to preplan in advance. Just drop in and join. They have a versatile schedule that will really keep you occupied if you wish.

The hotel is wonderfully decorated and really lives up to its name as a hideaway. I really didn't leave or feel the need to unless I had joined a tour. The pool area was very next to relax at. Yoga areas on the rooftop gave such a great environment to refocus myself.

Room was comfortable for me. However my room was by the lobby and I could hear the lobby all the time. Its not unbearable though. Earplugs recommended if you are sensitive.

Food was quite nice. A lot of options which was so hard for me to choose from. I felt I was well fed. The fresh fruits in the morning breakfast were my favourite. I also really enjoyed the seabass. The package I took allows for a smoothie a day and they were all really fresh and delicious. Additional items and alcoholic drinks can be purchased on site.

Had a couple massages in the spa as well. The Thai herbal compress massage was actually one of the best I ever had. Masseuse had great pressure and knew where to target. Definitely worth the cost for me.

Overall, I had a great time despite coming alone. Even made some new friends. This short getaway was what I needed. Really could do whatever I wanted and just hideaway.

reviewContext.Walkability: Its up a hill. They provide a free shuttle around the area if you do not want to walk.
reviewContext.Food & drinks: In house restaurant and bar available. Quite a decent offering with very fresh ingridients.

title: Thai Oasis Spa School
ownerDescription: The “Thai Oasis Spa School” was founded in 2009 on the premise that education is fundamental to maintaining the unique qualities of Oasis Spa. Our school offers instruction in ancient and traditional massages and spa therapies. We teach numerous traditional Thai massage techniques using acupressure points as well as western massage techniques. Our purpose is to help students understand and practice how to deliver a personal and unforgettable Thai Lanna spa experience. Massage training is based on the Thai Lanna wisdom found in Thailand’s traditional medicine. This instruction was developed and implemented over the 14 years at Oasis Spa.
address: 131 44 Moo 1, Tambon Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: RXF5+JR Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: KAORI
reviews.text:
I took a 1-day head massage course here before and had a great experience, so this time I took the 2-day foot massage course.
Just like last time, Teacher Anda was my instructor. She speaks fluent English and taught me patiently at my own pace, which helped me really get the hang of foot massage. It was a fun and fulfilling two days of lessons.
The school is very clean, well-equipped, and comfortable.
Also, the cafe attached to the school is so stylish and delicious that I ate lunch there both days.
Learning massage during a trip to Chiang Mai is a wonderful experience that I highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Kaori,

What an incredible pleasure to welcome you back, and thank you for sharing such a vibrant and enthusiastic review with us! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that your 2-day Foot Massage course at Thai Oasis Spa School was just as rewarding and enjoyable as your previous Head Massage training.

We will happily share your wonderful compliments with Teacher Anda. She will be delighted to know that her patient guidance and English instruction helped make your learning experience so fulfilling. It also brings us great joy to know that you appreciated our facilities and enjoyed dining at our cafe during both days of your course.

Thank you for choosing to continue expanding your skills with us during your time in Chiang Mai. We truly appreciate your kind recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another exciting and enjoyable course in the future! 

Warm regards,
Thai Oasis Spa School

reviews.name: Viola Braswell
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely incredible experience at the Thai Oasis Spa School completing the 30-hour Aromatherapy Oil Massage course. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is beautifully calm and deeply relaxing.
The instructors are truly world-class. Andaman was fantastic, teaching us the rich history and practical applications of oil massage, as well as the science behind aromatherapy. We even got to blend our own custom oils and take two bottles home! Ning was phenomenal, her dedication to ensuring we mastered every single technique was inspiring. She seamlessly integrated insights from Thai and Swedish modalities, and her wealth of knowledge made it clear we were learning from a true master. Her warmth and friendliness made the environment so welcoming.
A standout feature of the course is the hands-on approach: students practice on one another. Learning by both giving and receiving the massages was invaluable for understanding the techniques. I cannot recommend this school highly enough. Thank you to the wonderful teachers and the entire Thai Oasis Spa team for a truly unforgettable experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was a pleasure to read your wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear that you found the atmosphere at our school calm and welcoming, and that our instructors provided such a meaningful learning experience. It’s especially rewarding to know that you enjoyed exploring the art of aromatherapy and creating your own oil blends. Your kind recommendation means a great deal to us and encourages us to continue providing inspiring and high-quality education. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Thai Oasis Spa School in the future.

reviews.name: Tamar Auerbach
reviews.text:
I took the combined Aromatic Massage, Foot Massage, and Thai Massage course, and I really enjoyed the experience!

The school is excellent — new, clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. The showers and bathrooms are really nice. There’s even a great café on the school grounds with delicious food, and students get a discount voucher for the café.

As for the professional side, Pii Andaman was amazing.
She is very professional, kind, patient, and explains everything clearly. She made us feel comfortable throughout the course and taught us everything carefully and thoroughly.

I highly recommend this course! The experience was great, the teaching was excellent, and the price is also very reasonable. Definitely worth it!

Thai Oasis Spa School Team

Everything came together perfectly — my experience was simply fantastic.

My teacher was absolutely wonderful. She helped me work through my self-doubt, encouraged me when I felt unsure, and genuinely sparked my confidence and motivation. She structured the time so well — there was always enough space to really absorb and practice each technique. You can tell she puts her heart into preparing each class. Learning never felt dull, and both theory and practice were explained in such a clear, approachable way.

I was also incredibly lucky to have an amazing course partner — that connection made the whole experience so much richer and warmer.

If you're looking for more than just technical training, if you appreciate beauty and aesthetics in everything — this is your place. There's this rare balance here: a beautiful sense of ease and relaxation, combined with precise, professional standards. It's that blend that makes it special.

This has honestly been the best investment in my family's well-being ❤

reviews.name: Pam Vamplew
reviews.text:
I don't like leaving negative reviews.  I feel like this place has great potential, but is lacking in professionalism.
The massage itself was only adequate, non symmetrical with the masseuse forgetting what she had done.  This, I believe, was mainly due to the fact that she kept talking to the other masseuses through the curtain and all laughing.  This happened almost throughout the whole 90 minute massage.  Although I cannot say what they were laughing at, it made me very uncomfortable and difficult to relax.
The masseuse also used a technique that I have never encountered before, where she walked up and down my spine with her knees and full body weight.  I am an average sized 50 year old woman, and along with being very uncomfortable and again non symmetric, I can't imagine that she can feel adequately enough with her knee caps to tell how the muscles beneath are responding.
The establishment itself was very clean and inviting, but the staff are lacking in tact and respect.
If the staff are able to create an environment suitable for massage and proper relaxation, I believe that they would secure a better and dedicated clientele.
Note:  I am a trained relaxation spa director in North America.

reviews.name: Ell Ell
reviews.text:
My partner and I joined an ice bath and breathwork session with the beautiful Sandra while we were on Koh Lanta for just four days, and honestly, it was one of the highlights of our entire stay. If only we’d found it on our first day - it’s something we would have done every single morning. 🌅

Sandra is wholesome, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. The session went far beyond what we were expecting. We learned so much about the importance of breathwork, the role of spirituality, and how powerful it is when breathwork is combined with an ice bath. I’ve done ice baths before, but never alongside guided breathwork like this; the difference was profound.

The facilities are very well maintained and beautifully set up. The ice baths themselves were the nicest we’ve experienced, overlooking the ocean with a stunning view that made the whole experience even more special.

At just 500 Thai baht per person, it’s incredibly reasonable given the length and quality of the session, amazing value for what you receive.

We left feeling completely refreshed, renewed, and genuinely educated on the subject of breathwork. Sandra also offers a multitude of different classes, all of which we would have loved to try if we’d had more time on the island.

This place is a real gem. If you want to leave feeling grounded, energised, and inspired, this experience is an absolute must. An incredible offering on Koh Lanta — highly, highly recommend. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
