reviews.text: The best thing about this massage shop is that it is fully open. There is no stale air from the air conditioning, which is a great advantage! The therapists are experienced, mostly over 40. I had a three-hour massage for 750. There seems to be a small increase in the prices with 2025.

reviews.name: Doug Maner
reviews.text:
The best Thai massage we've experienced in Chiang Mai.
They charge only 180 bhat for an hour, which is at least one third less than other places that aren't even close to being as good as this is.
Even when it's hot, they manage to keep in cool inside, which is due to its wide open doors are many fans.
This is definitely worth your time and money.

reviews.name: C T
reviews.text: Very good experience, the workers are friendly although they cant speak english, but very experienced and kind! Professional.

reviews.name: VC
reviews.text:
Take my review with a pinch of salt as it was my first time for a full body Thai massage but... Wow, I just loved this place and how it made me feel.

The place is partitioned in two areas: left hand side for the mattresses and full body massages and right hand side for foot massages and also the place where you pay after the massage ends.

180 baht for an hour massage that made me feel so relaxed I fell asleep several times during it.

I'd fully recommend and I look forward to my next experience there already.

P.S. You can tell your masseuse about about pre-existing pains or sensitive areas and they will respect that although only basic English is spoken.

reviews.name: Christina
reviews.text:
Good foot massage at no frills place in Old City near Tha Phae Gate. It is located within a small 1-storey strip mall complex - it has some eateries, juice shop, nail salon, clothing & bag shop.

Place gets busy. Suggest to come early / making a reservation. When I arrived around 4:30pm, had to wait for abt 45 minutes for earliest available slot.

The owner/receptionist spoke English but my masseuse (Rose) spoke very little English. Regardless, she was lovely. Pressure was alright, could be harder but overall it was a nice massage to relieve soreness from back to back walking. Great value for money.

60 min foot massage was 200 THB. Given the price, suggest that you tip your masseuse generously (at least 20%) if you’re happy with their service.

reviews.name: Dian
reviews.text: After getting massages almost every day in SE Asia, I’ve concluded that this place is the best!  It’s a no frills place filled with experienced masseuses. Of course, there are many of them so YMMV.

reviews.name: A N Harris
reviews.text: Food massage with Khun Mali (Jasmin) was amazing. The way she gives massage is slow but strong, very nurturing and healing. 🙏🏽🧡

reviews.name: Sze Chern Paul Ting
reviews.text:
chance upon this place and went in for a try. 200baht for 60mins massage, massue Jasmin did a terrific job!

the price is a steal so please do tip your massue a good one for their hardwork!

the place has limited seats so wait is a norm, while waiting, try the food stalls nearby. Blue Beef noodles is just round the corner.

reviews.name: Atusa Amani
reviews.text:
This is the only place I am going to now in Chiang Mai. I’ve been here several times and all the massages were good. I finally found my girl Jasmine here who is the best!!! Her pressure, her touch and her sweet energy is exactly what I was looking for. I’m so grateful to have found this place and for 200baht an hour, you cannot find a better place. Highly recommend if you are in Chiang Mai.
Thank you Jasmine!!! 🙏

reviews.name: Anastasiia
reviews.text: Hi. This is a good place for a massage. We came here after a long trip and were very satisfied. The staff are very kind. They provide clothes to change into, give a full-body massage covering everything from head to toe, and offer drinks afterward. A great experience — careful and high-quality. I definitely recommend visiting them.

reviews.name: TJ Jones
reviews.text: got my first real thai massage here and it was kind of life changing. highly recommend, very skilled people here

reviews.name: U E
reviews.text: Went there at the end of the day for a foot massage. I told the lady that my legs were hurting a lot from walking all day and to do a proper massage for the pain. Instead she did it very softly and I didn't feel any relief so I was very disappointed with the massage. Maybe she was tired, I don't know, bad luck for me I guess with the lady I got. Going to go somewhere else next time.

reviews.name: Alexandra P
reviews.text: the place has good service and price. 180 baht per 1 hour of foot or thai massage. It'd better if you come in the morning, close to opening hour (10 am), the place is quiet with few customers.

reviews.name: Eoin O' Doherty
reviews.text: Absolutely one of the best massages I've had in Thailand feel 15 years  younger🤸‍♀️🤸‍♀️🏋‍♀️....

reviews.name: Kanishka Aggarwal
reviews.text: Best massage in terms of skill and value for money. And in the middle of a great space to check out local brands selling quirky artsy stuff. Loved the vibe around as well.

reviews.name: Emily C
reviews.text: One of the best massages in Chiang Mai. Affordable and the lady that was working on me found my knots and worked them as hard as possible. If I had more days with her, I'm pretty sure my knots would be more relieved. If you don't mind your neighbor can accidentally flop over and touch your hand, this is a quick massage that's good and cheap!

reviews.name: tansy knight
reviews.text:
10/10 recommend- the price is such good value as well- This place his a hidden gem✨ The staff were so friendly, professional and really knew what they were doing. I had foot reflexology/massage and it was better than any of the massages I’d had in Bangkok🤭
Will be going back again tonight for full Thai massage 💆‍♀️🥰

reviews.name: Ma Lydia
reviews.text: Doing massage by Uber.  Uber is the name of the gentleman.  He is the best.  Very professional.  I am leaving tomorrow and hopefully will come back again for more services.  Thanks for a reasonable price and wonderful service.  Thanks Uber.  You are great!

title: Sabai Thai Massage Tha Phae สบาย ไทยมาสสาจ ประตูท่าแพ
address: 20/3 MoonMuang Rd Lane 2 Old City Phra Sing, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXMR+MR Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Adventures of Kulderzipken
reviews.text: I can only say good things, the price was very good, the massage was very relaxing and so is the location. A small street with no traffic, calm music and a very experienced masseuse. Definitely recommended!

reviews.name: charinarpa sriwong
reviews.text:
Fantastic massage place and lovely staff. Honestly, this place is the best massage I've ever been in Chiang Mai.
The oil massage felt like a deep tissue session, working out all the knots.
Thai mass and foot massage  I left feeling relaxed and renewed.

Highly recommend! 💆
Sometimes might be fully booked. Better calling ahead for a reservation. Well worth it!

reviews.name: Donna Cashore
reviews.text: Very nice, very clean place. My companion's 1hr body massage was nice and relaxing -- done by a competent masseuse with skill. My foot massage was wonderful. She had excellent technique. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: George B
reviews.text:
Fantastic massage place. A small place with four massage tables. This allows the owner to carefully select who works there. I must honestly say, this was the best massage I've gotten in Chiang Mai (yes I've tried all the over hyped places like the blind massage, the prisoner massage, etc - those places don't even come close). The oil massage was similar to a deep tissue massage and all the knots were patiently worked out. After, i felt like new.

I would recommend calling for a reservation ahead of time. Well worth it. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Sol Nawaz
reviews.text: Excellent massage here, I had an oil massage for 90 minutes, the staff are all uniformed, polite and professional. The massage was excellent and not rushed, it was so good I went back for another massage.  Definitely the best massage in this area.

reviews.name: Isabella Von Andechs
reviews.text: I had a wonderful massage here today!  I’ve been twice and both times were amazing. I’m absolutely thrilled and will definitely come back. Totally satisfied and highly recommend!

reviews.name: Emily Gentry
reviews.text: I had a great experience here, would definitely recommend! Really friendly staff, clean facilities, and great massage! The massage left my friend and I both feeling so relaxed and renewed, one hour oil was perfect. Will be returning!

reviews.name: A.
reviews.text:
Karina Thai Massage was a fantastic find, and the ratings don’t lie. They offer authentic Thai massages with customizable strength preferences. The environment is old-school, featuring beds and fans instead of air conditioning, which enhances the breathing experience during the massage for maximum relaxation.

Pin and Dada were fantastic masseuses, delivering a thorough and professional massage. After the session, tea and snacks were served, adding a nice touch to the experience. The price point is very affordable for a 2-hour massage, making it great value for money.

Easily reachable via Grab or by foot if you’re staying near the Tha Phae Gate area. Highly recommended for a true Thai massage experience!

reviews.name: Lyubov Smith
reviews.text:
The best massage I've ever had. I picked deep tissue massage as needed work on my painful knotted muscles. The young lady called Lat was just amazing. Very strong, but very attentive same time.
I thoroughly enjoyed my experience and highly recommend this place if you want a good quality massage.

reviews.name: choco low
reviews.text:
So lucky to find this place on our first day in Chiang Mai!
We tried the foot massage with scrub and really loved their technique — so relaxing and professional. We immediately booked again for the next day!

On Day 2, we did a body scrub and hot oil compress massage — absolutely amazing. The massage was so good that we both had a deep sleep right after getting back 💤

The interior might not be super fancy, but the massage quality makes up for it. Definitely worth the price. Highly recommended if you’re looking for real skill over aesthetic decor 🙌

reviews.name: justforsharing s
reviews.text:
The lady boss (petite lady) was very dedicated in her job. She is not big in size but she is still quite strong with her hands. I can feel that she is putting in genuine effort to do her job 👍🏽 There is also welcome drink and tea after massage 🙏🏽

Feedback for improvement: I hope they can improve on the part where guests have to face down while laying on the bed. The bed does not have a round cut-out, so guests have to put their faces down on a donut cushion thing. It was quite uncomfortable and breathing was quite difficult after a while. Also will be good if mosquitoes are controlled better. It's not that the shop is full of mosquitoes, but I got bitten by one 😅

reviews.name: Anna
reviews.text:
First time doing a massage here in Thailand 🇹🇭 and I wasn’t disappointed 🤩 Karina Thai Massage had the sweetest ladies that massaged our back, neck, shoulders, and head. Very skilled with cracking our backs and a nice oil to make the massaging go very smoothly 🫶🏼

We dropped in without an appointment and they were happy to receive us at 8PM!

The ladies chatted a little amongst themselves and also with us. It sounded like they had lots of fun doing their job ♡💕

The prices are also very good! For one hour, this specific massage was 350 baht. The towels and massage bench are very clean, and you get a refreshing water to drink at the end.

Thank you so much for having us Karina Thai massage, we wish we stayed longer in Chiang Mai to visit you more often! Until next time ♡

reviews.name: Ambre Chevrolet
reviews.text: Was perfect ! Pin did such a good massage and I feel much better after her massage. All the team was really kind. 300 THB for 1h of a Thai massage was more than worth it!! Don’t hesitate!! Plus they offer you a tea with biscuit at the end🤩

reviews.name: Laure Waleffe
reviews.text:
Nai was in charge this morning and I had a great aroma massage. She was very attentive to my health issues and gave me the best massage so far. I already booked the next one with her in a few days 😊
I totally recommend the place, everyone is professional (I had previously a massage with Lucksamee, she's very good too) and  so nice, and Karina is great. Definitely worth a visit if you're in town

reviews.name: toni
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience! The massage was absolutely wonderful and left me feeling completely relaxed. The staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming, which made the whole atmosphere even more enjoyable. Everything was clean, professional, and done with such care. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Thailand!

reviews.name: François QUATREHOMME
reviews.text:
We tried Thai massage, oil and foot massage with family and everything was perfect. The masseuse were very kind and skillful!
I highly recommend 👌

reviews.name: Oggy Vott
reviews.text: Had oil massage for 350 b with Nuch, it was my favourite. She is devoteful, caring for comfort  and present during the session. I can recommend it if want to relax . It's a tender oil massage with elements of Thai massage and acupressure and some stretches for neck. In addition Hot towel on back after back massage was  very good. 🙌

reviews.name: Stefan De rooij
reviews.text: It was amazing, thank you so much. Feel way better now

reviews.name: Eric Pelot
reviews.text:
I visited here 3 days in a row - Thai massage, foot & leg massage, and sports massage.

All were amazing!  If you get the sports massage be prepared for some intense pressure, which I loved... But, many may consider it too strong.

The lady that seemed to be in charge spoke great English and was able to pass along my requests to the massage therapist.

I will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Rico Thongsab
reviews.text: I can't recommend this place highly enough. Lovely, cosy place with very professional attentive staff. Whilst having a full body massage, my masseur (Amy) picked out certain muscle issues I had without me saying anything beforehand. This points out how good they really are and I even went back again. Very reasonably priced too. Highly recommended.

title: Quan Massage
address: 51 Yaowarad Rd, Tambon Talat Nuea, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand
plusCode: V9MP+RX Phuket, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Pragya Ghosh
reviews.text:
This was my very first foot massage experience, and I’m so glad I stumbled upon this place while walking around Old Town in Phuket. Beam took excellent care of me and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire session. The experience was incredibly relaxing, and everyone here was so warm and sweet.

Even though I had only booked a foot massage, they kindly included a short shoulder massage as well, which was such a lovely touch. I felt so relaxed afterwards that I immediately decided we would definitely come back again for another massage before leaving. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a calm and welcoming place to unwind!

reviews.name: Manan Goyal
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience at Quan Massage Centre! I was lucky to have Tang as my therapist, and she was absolutely amazing. She was professional, attentive, and made sure the pressure was just right throughout the session. Her technique was excellent, and I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

The centre was clean, welcoming, and had a very calming atmosphere. If you’re looking for a high-quality massage in Phuket, I highly recommend Quan Massage Centre. Thank you, Tang, for such a fantastic experience—I will definitely be back!

reviews.name: subhasri acharya
reviews.text: Ja and Nan were super authentic therapist. We had one hour traditional Thai massage with herbal balm. It was very ralaxing hour and we loved it. Will surely visit here again.

reviews.name: Sandeep Acharya
reviews.text: Best possible Authentic Thai Massage in Phuket Old town . Ja & Nan were awesome therapist. Very clean and nice ambience.

reviews.name: Julianne Jirousek
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic massage and service from Beam, who took great care of me. The entire place is so well run and gorgeous. The only reason I’ve taken it down from 5 stars is that the upstairs massage area can get a bit noisy when other patrons are coming in during your massage. The massage rooms are only separated by curtains, so no sound insulation from people talking. BUT that being said, I would absolutely recommend this spa for a fabulous massage!

reviews.name: Elliott Nicholls
reviews.text: I don’t normally leave reviews but this definitely deserves one! This was the best massage I’ve had in a while. Very kind and welcoming. Lovely room, quiet and private. Definitely recommend coming here!! 5*

reviews.name: R R
reviews.text: Probably my favourite massage parlour in the whole of Thailand. It is not flashy and overdone like some other places, they focus on the service and quality. Best massage I had in Thailand. The massage area we were in was not very large and a curtain was separating us in between each room, keep in mind. Prices were also very reasonable.

reviews.name: Sabi Sanghera
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a couples massage and Ya ya was absolutely brilliant the massage was just out of the world. I had the foot, neck, back and shoulders.

My husband had the same  with Ning who  was excellent.
We will be coming back for a massage for sure.

Thank you

reviews.name: ETANA
reviews.text: Poorest massage I’ve ever done. Random staff just keep opening the curtains while I’m fully naked inside, to chat with the staff massaging for me turning on the light which is shining to my eye directly. The outside of the shop looks fine but the inside is totally crap. The bedsheets and the towels stinks. I did the body scrub and facial. Id say that the body scrub is fine but the facial part is a total disaster. The staff use sponges to scrub my face, by the time I could stop her my face is already burning. Worst experience ever.

reviews.name: Frederic Belhassen
reviews.text:
Really excellent place for massage
Ming and the other stuff made me feel like new
Super recommended

reviews.name: Vrushali Deshmukh
reviews.text: I really liked this place! Because of how well they accommodated me. I had done a long temple climb so my muscles were very sore. My initial masseuse I felt didn’t use enough pressure and after I spoke to the reception they gave me additional 10 mins with another masseuse who was so so good. Overall I loved how warm, professional and well spoken every one was! Highly recommend the place!

reviews.name: spenz Spicy
reviews.text: Amazing massage , I had 1.5 hours Thai massage with YAYA . She was very very good . A professional!!!  Everything was amazing about the massage it felt amazing the best I’ve had in Thailand !

reviews.name: Peau James Sommer
reviews.text: We enjoyed our foot massage here. The place was new and clean as well as having a very relaxing atmosphere. It’s located near the Sunday night market.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Peau James Sommer,
Thank you for your heartening review. We're thrilled you enjoyed the foot massage and found our spa clean and relaxing. Your feedback regarding our location near the Sunday night market is appreciated. Our commitment to providing an exceptional experience is unwavering, so we're glad to have met your expectations. Look forward to welcoming you again soon.

Best Regards,
Quan Massage Team

reviews.name: Kanishth Karthik
reviews.text: Had a foot, head, back, and shoulder massage with Ja and it was excellent. The pressure was just right, my back joints cracked perfectly, and I felt deeply relaxed afterward. Left feeling completely de-stressed. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Georgia Colson
reviews.text: Really nice massage, great price, and I had a lovely masseuse named Bing who was amazing!

reviews.name: Sanjay Lama
reviews.text: My wife and I got here after a tiring day and opted for their foot massage. The place is very quaint and Ms. Jan was lovely. Thank you!!

reviews.name: Amos Aow
reviews.text: My brother and I did a massage Ms.Yu and Ice - they were so strong and good. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: james shea
reviews.text: Stopped by for random foot massage and was blown away. Yu provided the best foot massage I’ve ever had in Thailand. The shop is clean, comfortable and peaceful. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Ezgi
reviews.text: We tried traditional Thai massages. But I had better experiences in my home country.

reviews.name: Mandakini Devasher
reviews.text: We had a wonderful foot massages at Quan Massage. Highly recommend  Ice mint Ning kan!

title: Mesa massage-เมษา​ นวดและกดจุด
subTitle: Mesa Thaimassage-เมษา นวดไทย
ownerDescription: We are a small massage shop. Sometimes we just relax. We have a special program that is a Sytometic massage this program you can inform a therapist they will focus on your problem point to make you get well.
address: 72/2 Ratchamanka Rd Old City Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXPQ+76 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Mikko Rafanan
reviews.text: Amazing foot massage! I’m visiting Thailand and this was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had. Great pressure, very relaxing, and the staff was friendly and professional. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Thailand!

reviews.name: Monika Nikolaeva
reviews.text:
Fantastic massage, came two nights in a row, once for a thai massage and once for full body oil massage. Enjoyed it very much, they also give everyone after the massage some tasty cookies, tea and water which is a nice detail.
The lady managing the place is a very nice person.
I recommend 100%

reviews.name: ignacio calderon
reviews.text: Very nice expedience. We were looking for a place to get a Thai massage and found this spot walking from our hostel. The owner was such a sweetheart and gave us tea and some kind of dessert after the massage. Would definitely recommend

reviews.name: Kristian Browning
reviews.text:
A friend loved this place during her last visit, so she brought our group of four here—and it did not disappoint!

Between us, we tried foot reflexology, Thai oil massage, deep tissue, and neck, shoulders, and back massages. Every treatment was excellent, and we all left feeling relaxed. The staff are kind and attentive, and the atmosphere is welcoming. I enjoyed it so much that I came back for another massage on my own. I absolutely love Mesa Massage and highly recommend it!

reviews.name: so you
reviews.text:
Mesa Massage is just a 30-second walk from Asaya House, right at the entrance of the alley. This was my second visit. The staff are friendly and the massage is excellent. Prices are exactly as listed on the menu. Highly recommended for solo travelers and couples.
See you again😆

reviews.name: Dean Riggott
reviews.text: I've had hundreds of massages in my life of 58 years, but the best were at Mesa Thai Massage in Chiang Mai. Absolutely fantastic if you like deep tissue massages!

reviews.name: Tamika Gambrell
reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about this place. The massages are AMAZING! We went twice in the last two days.  The staff is so sweet and kind.  When I come back to Chiang Mai, I will see them again.

reviews.name: Kairo Trek
reviews.text:
Best Foot Massage of My Life!

On my second day in Chiang Mai, I was looking for a high-quality massage and stumbled across this gem. I am so glad I did!

The woman who provided my back, neck, and shoulder massage was incredible - she really knew how to address muscle tension and I felt great immediately afterward.

However, the real highlight came a day later when I returned and had the pleasure of meeting a beautiful woman named Tik. She gave me what was, honestly, the best foot massage I’ve ever had in my life.

I am in Krabi now and I miss the service at Mesa already! Thank you for everything; your team is amazing and the hospitality is second to none. Thank you Tik. Keep Smiling!

- Kairo Trek

reviews.name: Agos-Tina Coniglio
reviews.text: Piu was excellent!!! 😀😀😀 I Did two Hours massage with her, one hour reflexology and one oil massage and it was the best massage I had in years!!! Im so happy, the place is clean and relax, music is optime, temperature is great and confort excellent. Everything smell Good and its clean. Congrats for such a wonderful people!!!

reviews.name: Gustav Wagener
reviews.text:
Brilliant and authentic massage. It was very nice, and so cheap, they even gave tea, small cakes and water afterwards.
Can only recommend!

reviews.name: Ameerah Nakaguchi
reviews.text: Love the massage. the staff are so attentive to my body needs. definitely will come back here. love the complimentary cookies and nuts too

reviews.name: Dorel Shimoni
reviews.text:
This place is a gem, one of the best massages I’ve got in Thailand, was really deep, inexpensive and professional.
Came for 1 hour, extended to 1 hour and half.
They know exactly what they are doing.
Will come back again tomorrow for o another session.
Plus they spoil you in the end with free cookies and amazing tea!

reviews.name: 염결혜지
reviews.text:
My daughter and I got the massage today and we both were very enjoyed! The massage was wonderful.
Clean and all staff was friendly 😊

reviews.name: Andrew Sanford
reviews.text:
Best massage place I've been to in Chiang Mai Old Town!! Perfect balance of hard pressure. I don't think my spine has been this thoroughly popped before and I feel great! If you have been disappointed by other places for not being firm enough, come here.

Super nice staff. I only had 770 baht and they were nice to get me the 800 baht package for my wife and I.

reviews.name: Cam Caine
reviews.text:
I have been back here every other day I am in Chiang Mai.

The place is good value for money and the massages are excellent. I have had several different masusses and all have been good.

There is a space in the back for couples massages which is clean and quiet.

The owner May is really sweet and can not do enough for you.

I especially recommend the 90 minute foot massage.

reviews.name: nkhs nikki
reviews.text:
Very friendly staff and good massage.
Went there with 3 of my boys and we had a really good time.
They really took their time and listened to what I needed

reviews.name: Julie Holst
reviews.text: I’ve come 2 times during my visit to Chiang Mai, and it’s for sure the best fullbody oil massage that I have ever had. They are a bit though, but it’s all worth it. I’m coming back again before I leave.

reviews.name: Rosie Norton
reviews.text: These masseurs do not mess around, we had the head, neck and back massage and although it concentrated on those areas there was a little bit of full body too. Be prepared for very firm pressure (read a little painful) but absolute relaxation by the end. The head massage was all round loveliness. They looked after us really well, finishing with complimentary tea, water and mini biscuits. Would highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jas Seira
reviews.text:
Great and relaxing experience! Felt very at easy and very relaxed throughout.

Complimentary water, tea and biscuits too which was amazing!

reviews.name: Simba The King
reviews.text: well, this massage place was next door to my hotel, didn’t have to walk too far to be relaxed and minute back to hotel to rest thereafter. prices and services were superb, we event became friends since i visit many nights, and sometimes even just to sat with them and chitchat, very friendly people 🥰

title: MSENSE SPA & Massage
ownerDescription: "MSENSE Club - "Beyond priority, you're my one and only" Explore a true sense of relaxation, crafted specially for a man like you. we appreciated and we have to say we are all gender friendly, LGBTQ+, gay massage, men massage, men spa, and also women spa as well. เปิดประสบการณ์ ที่สุดแห่งการบำบัดความเหนื่อยล้าสู่ความสมดุลแห่งสุขภาพดี โดยนักบำบัด สุภาพบุรษมืออาชีพ ที่เข้าใจสุภาพบุรษดีที่สุด [Roya pampering aromatic massage package 150 นาที] ท่านจะลุ่มหลง และผ่อนคลายระดับลึกด้วยลวดลาย การนวด สปา บำบัดแบบที่ไม่เคยได้จากแห่งไหนมาก่อนด้วยบริการที่นำคุณดำดิ่งสู่สุทรียภาพแห่งการบำบัดและ สุดยอดการปรนนิบัติที่ละเมียดลไมและอ่อนโยน"
address: Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Khwaeng Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
plusCode: PG7H+7R Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: 羅Kenyon
reviews.text: Had a wonderful SPA experience today! The place is incredibly quiet and beautifully decorated. The staff are super professional and welcoming—plus, he speaks Mandarin 👍 The room itself is spacious and gorgeous, making it so easy to unwind and relax. The service here is unmatched, and the little snacks they serve afterward are a lovely touch(My fav is pineapple cake 😍) I also love that the owner makes their own massage oils. "Sunrising" is definitely my absolute favorite✨

reviews.name: Darren Saw
reviews.text:
I had a really wonderful massage with Pup. His massage technique is very good, and the pressure was strong enough for me — exactly what I like. I chose the “Flying to the Moon” package, and he really did make me feel like I was flying to the moon! 😆

The whole experience was very relaxing, warm, and comforting. Pup is also very cute, friendly, and super handsome, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I felt very comfortable throughout the session and left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

They serve good desserts and tea as well.

Definitely a five-star experience. I would happily come back again!

reviews.name: Faden Smith
reviews.text: This is my third session with Pup, and I highly recommend him. He is professional, respectful, and speaks English very well. He makes me feel comfortable, and I have been sleeping much better since starting therapy. The place is clean, private, and respects clients' privacy. Thank you for your excellent care!

reviews.name: 王剑雄
reviews.text: First time come to this massage center. It's really good massage place with very nice environment and good massage skill. I book Mr Korn he is very handsome and polite Also very good massage skill make me have a nice sleep and very relax after the massage. Recommend you could try this shop and try Korn's massage.

reviews.name: Anupong Nuanchan
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly Recommended!
This is hands down the best relaxation massage for men. What sets this place apart right from the start is their consulting process—they actually let you customize and DIY your session to match exactly what you need.

The ambiance is spot on: the room was spotlessly clean, smelled incredible, and had the most relaxing background music playing.
I actually found out about this place through their massage vlog, and getting to meet the real person behind it was awesome. A huge thanks to Mosswell, the session left me feeling completely energetic and fully recharged.

I will definitely be back. Love this place and highly recommend it to everyone!

reviews.name: Dan M
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Msense Massage. The massage itself was incredibly relaxing and exactly what I needed. The space is inviting, very clean, and has a warm, welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease.
The service was excellent from start to finish professional, attentive, and thoughtful. I also really appreciated that the spa is LGBT friendly, which made the whole experience feel even more comfortable and inclusive.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a relaxing, welcoming place to unwind. I’ll definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: "Thank you so much for your kind review! We’re thrilled you enjoyed your time at msense. Can’t wait to welcome you back soon!"

reviews.name: Alex S
reviews.text:
Discovered this Spa recently and decided to give it a try!
The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming! The ambience was very good as well! Massage rooms were spacious and comfortable conveniently with very clean and large well equipped bathroom attached.
I was assigned Nobi my masseur.
He was very professional and very friendly!
His finger skills were excellent in the entire massage and it was really relaxing. He managed to relax every tensed spots in my back all conducted very professionally.
Really enjoyed my two hour massage very much worth the price!
Fully recommend the visit here and experience Nobi’s skill and the establishment’s hospitality!

reviews.name: Arthurology MTCU
reviews.text: Super nice ambience, music, location. You will feel private from entering to leaving. The massage was superb with hands of Paul. He knew the posture very well. Definitely come next time.

reviews.name: Nakin Rachakrom
reviews.text:
I recently visited MSENSE SPA & Massage and had a wonderful experience. I booked a 90-minute aroma oil massage with Therapist Yang, and it was exactly what I needed.

The therapist was very professional and attentive, making me feel completely relaxed throughout the session. The pressure was just right, and I could really feel the tension in my body melt away. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and welcoming, which made the overall experience even better.

I left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Linh Nguyen
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience here today. The spa is pristine, peaceful, and located in a beautifully quiet neighborhood. My therapist, Paul, provided exceptional service from the moment I arrived. I chose the "Fly Me to the Moon" package, and Paul’s warm, kind, and professional demeanor instantly put me at ease. The room’s ambiance and temperature were dialed in perfectly for relaxation. Paul is a gifted therapist who balances a gentle touch with the strength needed to work out deep tension. Having tried a few different spas during my travels, I can confidently say Paul's massage was the absolute highlight. He expertly stretched out my tight muscles and relieved all my knots and aches. I highly recommend M'Sense Spa in Bangkok and definitely recommend Paul for the best massage.

update:

Last night was the best sleep I had in a long time. Thank you, Paul

reviews.name: Jay
reviews.text: It was my first time experiencing Thai Massage and it was beyond my expectation. Very relaxing, refreshing and dreamy. I had Tiger as my Therapist and he was very professional and sweet. I would visit here again.

reviews.name: Edwin Zhuang
reviews.text: Had a 90 min Royal Pampering Aromatic massage with Tent. His service from start to finish was impeccable. Warm, friendly and massage techniques are on point. He remembered that I requested to spend more time on the shoulders and he did just that. Tea and Panna cotta, which is not too sweet, at the end was a pleasant surprise. All in all, I left the place as a satisfied customer.

reviews.name: Hongyuan Li
reviews.text: Charnon is my masseur today, of good shape, good service attitude, good nature to press his energy into my body. He is attentive and checks my response for each new part of the progress. After the massage my tight lower back and shoulder are so relaxed. I thanks him for the two hour hard work! Also I got a first-time discount, for this nice facility.

reviews.name: Josh Mara
reviews.text: Had a massage with Boy. He is okay. I don’t like when he cheats the time. I paid for 90 minutes but only got around 60 minutes of real massage. The rest is me taking showers for 5 minutes and then waiting on them to come inside the room.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations. We take your comments seriously and will review this matter with our team to improve our service standards.

If possible, please contact us through our LINE Official Account so we can learn more about your experience and assist you directly.

Thank you for helping us improve.

reviews.name: Iye Ashan
reviews.text:
I booked my massage in advance, and I’m glad I did. From the moment I arrived, everything felt calm, polished, and well organized. My therapist, Chanon, was ready immediately, and the experience felt smooth and unhurried from start to finish.

I chose the 120-minute Royal Pampering treatment, and it was absolutely worth it. This is a truly premium spa. This is a high level, high class, and exceptionally clean location. It felt noticeably more refined than many other places I’ve visited. I was welcomed with tea, the room was immaculate, and the bed and linens were spotless. The space felt private, quiet, and thoughtfully designed.

The massage itself was excellent. The pressure was perfect throughout, and the entire experience felt professional, personalized, and well executed. Chanon was clearly very experienced and attentive, and I felt completely comfortable the entire time. There was never any sense of rushing or pressure. The whole experience was just a calm, confident, high-quality service.

I left feeling genuinely better and deeply relaxed. This was one of the most professional massages I’ve ever had, and it’s a place I would happily return to. I truly look forward to coming back the next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Kevin Wen
reviews.text: Very cozy and clean place. And KC was quite gentle

reviews.name: Arvind Luximan
reviews.text: A truly premium spa for gentlemen. One feels highly cared for right from the moment they step in and up until the moment they leave. My therapists today were Tent and Paul, both extremely professional and highly energetic. I feel much relief in the areas where I would tend to feel pain after workouts. They are also very attentive to our specific needs, and delivered a great service throughout! Special kudos for the mango sticky rice + strawberry panacota served after the session with the tea!

reviews.name: Paul Hutton
reviews.text: Great experience at MSense. My masseuse was Pup. The massage was relaxing and professional, and the whole experience was exceptional. Clean, premium facilities, friendly staff, and a visit I won’t forget.

reviews.name: xiaobao song
reviews.text: Therapist Nobi is very a white guy，so cute，massage technic is excellent. The environment is clean ，quite and the massage oil smell is good！

reviews.name: jeremy zheng
reviews.text: "I highly recommend Tor! He is an incredibly polite and professional therapist who made me feel comfortable throughout the entire session. His massage technique is exceptional, and he knew exactly how to work out all the tension in my muscles. I left feeling completely refreshed and will definitely be booking with him again!

title: Daravalee Massage
ownerDescription:
The best value massage & spa in Nimman, Chaingmai.
Thai traditional and foot massage for $300 baht/hour
Aroma oil massage for $450baht/hour.
We also have other packages for what best for you, please feel free to visit or contact us.
address: 2/1-2/2 Nimmana Haeminda Rd Lane 3 Nimmanhaemin Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXX8+JX Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Yunhee Kim
reviews.text:
The facilities at this massage shop may look a little old, but they are well maintained and there were no issues at all.

The owner couple is incredibly kind and welcoming. 👍🏽👍🏽

I received massages here more than 10 times during my stay, and every session was excellent. After my first visit here, I was so satisfied that I kept coming back.

They also have a very cute “sales representative” dog who adds to the charm of the place.

Highly recommended!! 😊

reviews.name: Colton Collins
reviews.text: Daravalee Massage is my go-to place every time I visit Chiang Mai. The shop is clean, calm, and very professional. The staff speak great English, making it easy to communicate your preferences. Every session leaves me completely relaxed, truly the best massage in Chiang Mai! Good price too! I come back here every year, and the quality is always consistent. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.text:
Middles of the road massage and spa parlour. Jaded and needs redecoration.

Special 2 for 1 price offers.

Massage OK but no better than average.

reviews.name: Sean Andersen
reviews.text: Great massages that are super chill and relaxing. Great intro into Thai massages.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review.

reviews.name: Shaw-Jiun Wang
reviews.text: Best massage in Chiang Mai. Authentic Thai massage!

reviews.name: M Dean
reviews.text:
I have had several massages in Chiang Mia before trying Daravalee massages I am so glad i did, this by far is probably the best massage I have had in a very very long time, pressure was prefect the massage was fantastic.

Also very reasonable priced, I will definitely be going back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, hope will see you soon🙏

reviews.name: Tom Garachon
reviews.text: First time for me, I tried Aroma massage 1hour, excellent 👌🏻

reviews.name: A Haeg
reviews.text: I went for a 90 minute Thai massage and it was the best massage I have had in my six months here in Chiang Mai. It came highly recommended by a long time expat and this massage spa did not disappoint. What I did not like was that people could use their cell phones in there. People talking on the phone and getting noisy message alerts does not help me relax. All in all a good experience though especially at the low price of 450 thb. Makes it easy to tip generously

reviews.name: Carlo Alaimo
reviews.text:
Exceptional Thai massage experience at an affordable rate. I've visited multiple times for a two-hour Thai massage, and my wife enjoyed a foot massage. Ask for Duan; she is highly professional, fluent in English, and made my last session incredibly enjoyable with a humorous conversation. Highly recommended!
Tips are well deserved.

reviews.name: Kate P
reviews.text: I’ve visited a lot massage places with different ratings, but this one - is the definitely the best. I mean best massage technique with the reference to the current state of muscles and body overall. I’ve been to foot massage here more than 20 times, tried Thai massage and oil. Very well trained masseuses. Caring and positive. Always taking me late even if closing soon. Brought all my friends here — same opinion. Love ❤️ and will continue coming!

reviews.name: Eda Man
reviews.text: Had a two hour full body Thai oil massage. The lady masseuse was very good, she really stretched out my muscles and I really enjoyed the beginning. The oils used weren’t great, I’d say it was a bit misleading, I was expecting some deeply scented calming oils. Nevertheless the skill of the masseuse was impressive and so was her strength. Would probably have gone for the standard one hour Thai massage as opposed to the oil one in hindsight.

reviews.name: Megrain Yang
reviews.text: Very good massage, we really enjoyed it

reviews.name: Dave Ngai
reviews.text: nice place, good massage skills👍🏾

reviews.name: Jolien van H
reviews.text: Had an half hour foot massage that consisted of... Three movements. Seriously, for half an hour the lady with short hair only did three things consistently while my neighbour got a real nice foot massage with variation. I was very dissapointed.

reviews.name: SONNY V
reviews.text:
I went there because have good reviews but I had foot massage and that was worse.
My massager either don’t know how to do foot massage or very tired. Again I asked her bit strong pressure but it only last 5 minutes and back to worse.

reviews.name: Michelle Kaczor
reviews.text: I just had a wonderful 1 hr Thai full body massage here. Price and massage was great, the place was clean and they give you clean pajamas to wear and a locker with key to keep your stuff safe.

reviews.name: Jesper Madsen
reviews.text: Just had a 90 minutes leg massage with my spouse. The guy had absolutely no idea what he wa doing. Even after telling him 3 times that he needs to press harder, he didn't care and was just rubbing my legs. My spouse suggested that his guy was alright and we could exchange the therapist. It was just 20 minutes past. But they refused to swap each other. We had to cancel the massage after about 45 minutes. I just couldn't take it anymore as it wasn't enjoyable. But apparently we still had to pay for 90 minutes. It's alright, but I was quite disappointed. Paid the therapist 100 bht tip anyway. Wish him all the best in life but I will never go there again.

reviews.name: Ji hoon Her
reviews.text: 여기서 절대 받지 마세요. 맛사지 안배운 사람이 종아리만 계속 문지르다가 결국 살갗 벗겨졌습니다. You should not get massage here. I got foot massage here, But the staff hasn’t get trained about Thai maasage at all. She just repeated rub my left reg again and again. And finally my skin got off. I had to stop getting massage. I still felt burn and pain in my lef leg. If getting foot massage from someone who never trained is dangerous. I warn you “don’t get massage here”

reviews.name: Wayne Cheah
reviews.text: Pretty legit massage experience. Responsive on google messages too

reviews.name: Phil Sumner
reviews.text: Actually a really excellent 1 hour foot and Thai massage. Don’t be fooled by the look of the unit, great value for money and one of the best foot massages i’ve had in Thailand!

title: Dasy Massage & Spa One Nimman
ownerDescription: Dasy Massage & Spa – One Nimman offers premium massage in Chiang Mai's Nimman area, inside One Nimman. Services include traditional Thai massage, aroma oil massage, foot massage, deep tissue massage, herbal balm massage and hot stone treatments delivered by skilled therapists in a calm, refined setting. Open daily from 11:00 to 01:00 for locals and travellers looking for a professional massage near Nimman.
address: 6, 19 Nimman Road Nimmanhaemin Suthep, Meaung, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXX8+WV Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Ammar
reviews.text:
If you have sore feet or body pain from walking all day, this massage shop is the perfect place to relax and recover. The massage was excellent and helped relieve the pain completely.

The place is clean, well-organized, and has a comfortable atmosphere. The staff are friendly and professional, making the whole experience very enjoyable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality massage after a long day of exploring. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Joanna Wang
reviews.text: Excellent service and great value for money! The shop is very clean, cozy, and has a soothing vibe. The massage was perfect—just the right amount of pressure. The staff were all friendly and professional. I will definitely be coming back again🔥❤️

reviews.name: Lena Lim
reviews.text: Amazing massage! Perfect spot to relax after walking around Nimman Road all day. Skilled therapists, great pressure, clean and calm space. Highly recommend stopping by here to recharge — will definitely come back next time!

reviews.name: suzy su
reviews.text: The massage was very relaxing, and the therapist was friendly and professional. She also checked in during the session to make sure the pressure was comfortable. I’d recommend making a reservation in advance, as you may have to wait for an available slot if you just walk in.

reviews.name: chisato matsuyama
reviews.text: It was wonderful. Everyone was very satisfied. I'm especially grateful to the person who assisted me. I would like to use your services again when I visit Chiang Mai. Thank you very much! 😊

reviews.name: 아름다운계절
reviews.text:
I had a foot massage here on the last day of my trip, and it was such a wonderful way to end my stay. The massage was incredibly gentle, soothing, and deeply relaxing. I honestly felt as if I had been to heaven!

Thank you so much for taking such great care of me and for giving me such a thoughtful and relaxing massage. I truly appreciate your kindness and dedication. I will definitely make a reservation here again when I return early next year. Thank you for making my last day so special!

reviews.name: Hsin-Hui Chen
reviews.text: Very nice experience! I rarely tried foot massage, but it is very therapeutic and professional. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Irvine Kinneas the Third
reviews.text:
The place was very clean and the ambience was relaxing!
The staff was very professional and explained the services offered very well.
The massage itself was very relaxing. Highly recommended! Will come back again!

reviews.name: Thalassa Wren Benzon
reviews.text: Had a very good experience! Both massage and service are impressive. Highly recommend. Has english speaking staff~ with free tea and cookie at the end. ^_^

reviews.name: Tunyaporn Wongratanamajcha
reviews.text: Highly recommend this massage shop! The therapist was professional and very friendly, the room was clean and well-maintained, and the overall experience was excellent. I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews.name: Jianyang Hu
reviews.text: This is absolutely the best Thai massage shop on Nimmanhaemin Road! The space is spotless and cozy, filled with a lovely scent of herbal essential oils. The therapist carefully talked through my stress and tense areas, and my body felt fully relaxed afterwards. Highly recommed！

reviews.name: Siao Chun Woei
reviews.text: Receptionist speak good English and friendly staff, highly recommended for visitor if you don’t like too hard massage.

reviews.name: Pei Jia Chong
reviews.text: Did the foot, head and shoulder massage, 1.5h Very relaxing 👍🏻 just the a/c not as cold.

reviews.name: gabriele paskeviciute
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere and great massage staff very friendly and polite 😁 definitely recommend

reviews.name: Anita
reviews.text: This was one of the best massages I've ever had. The place is so clean and relaxing. I had a most wonderful lady, Tuck  (Tàk), who got rid of knots in my shoulder. Be sure to ask for her!! And a kind gesture would be great!!

reviews.name: Nino Bailen
reviews.text: Great massage place in Nimman area. Extremely polite and very professional. Price is very reasonable and the place is spotless and clean. They put you in a room with curtains for privacy. Would visit again next time I am in Chiang Mai

reviews.name: Vincent Lyu
reviews.text:
Very nice and clean place to get an authentic Thai massage 💪💪💪 they are very careful and sweet, really made my day!

Tips: don’t come on a rainy night, would be fully booked.

reviews.name: Clover Leaf
reviews.text: Very clean environment. Relaxing foot massage done by a skillful masseuse. Definitely worth a try when you come to Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Sherlyn David
reviews.text: Love the how clean and new this place is, the staff are very friendly and welcoming. Their service is excellent. My therapist was good and I definitely had a great massage on my last day in Chiang Mai 😀

reviews.name: Lay Hoon
reviews.text:
Nice massage. I had the warm aroma oil and it's so comfortable.
Very nice and relaxing environment.
Staffs are polite and helpful.

title: Tree D Yoga Aonang
address: 539, Aonang Third Place Hometel - Standard King Room, 539 Soi Aonang 2/1, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000, Thailand
street: 539, Aonang Third Place Hometel - Standard King Room, 539 Soi Aonang 2/1
plusCode: 3R4P+6X Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi, Thailand

reviews.name: Li Lian Ong
reviews.text:
I had the privilege of engaging Teacher Oily and her team to conduct yoga and sound healing classes for our retreat group the past few days. From the time I started communicating with Teacher Oily during the planning stage, she was always kind and responsive in very good English. She took the effort to understand the theme of my retreat and the group profile, suggested the style of yoga classes that would benefit my group.

True enough, the actual experience was perfect for my retreat participants. Teacher Oily brought the necessary equipment to our hotel and conducted the classes professionally, also very friendly and generous in sharing her knowledge to help us understand how the practices benefit our body and mind. Her classes made my retreat programme complete, as I share mindfulness and other wellbeing strategies from a western psychology angle and she shared from the yoga and sound healing angle. Our whole group loved the way she and her team conducted the classes.

I will definitely engage her again when I do my programme in Krabi, or go to her studio if I'm travelling to Krabi for my own holiday!

reviews.name: Mystica Conceicao
reviews.text: Oily is an excellent sound therapist. She was able to hold space for me and I felt an immediate trusting connection. Her space is situated among trees, lending to a very spiritual experience

reviews.name: Susan Young
reviews.text: Khun Oily and her Yoga team organised a "special" yoga class with sound healing bath to celebrate International Yoga Day.  This is my second visit to Tree D Yoga.  The atmosphere is always very inviting, calm and peaceful.  There is an instant "good feeling" the moment you arrive.  All the yoga instructors are lovely and explain everything in English.  The sound healing bath is very relaxing and leaves you feeling relaxed, but energised.  Highly recommend Tree D yoga.

reviews.name: dorin lazimi
reviews.text: I attended the Wednesday morning yoga class, “Energetic Morning Flow,” and really enjoyed it. The class was relaxing, and full of positive energy such a wonderful way to start the day. Thank you so much for a lovely experience! 🙏😊🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Samien Houben
reviews.text:
I was immediately sold after the first class I did at Tree D Yoga Aonang. I tried different classes from the  challenging energizing flow to the more relaxing sunset yoga. All classes are so good and you can choose the one that fits your needs the most. I was doing Muay Thai so the combination with easy stretching and hata sunset where perfect!
The classes are creative and compelling. The teachers are really professional and pleasant! They guide you so smoothly trough every movement, giving the right alignments cues and know perfectly where to push to help you get deeper in to the poses. Besides that, very likable and caring people. The energy of this place is just lovely. Big thanks to Oily, Ae and the whole team 😊

reviews.name: Virginie TURCI
reviews.text: I took the 6-class course and it was truly fantastic. The teachers are incredibly attentive and professional, guiding us step by step through the practice; it was a truly wonderful experience. I will definitely come back on my next trip to Krabi. Thank you all.

reviews.name: Tea Mikkonen
reviews.text: One of the best yogastudios in Ao nang! Beautiful shala with a good variety of classes. Participated in two flow classes and one stretching & soundbowl session and they were all amazing! Everyone was so welcoming and kind. Will definitely visit again if I ever come back to Ao nang.

reviews.name: Vendy Law
reviews.text:
Such a beautiful and deeply relaxing experience. 🌿✨

Oily is such a gentle and calming healer. From the beginning, I felt very safe and comfortable with her — there’s something about her energy that makes it easy to trust her and completely relax.

The whole session was peaceful, grounding and healing. I could really allow myself to slow down, let go and just be present.

Highly recommend Oily and Tree D Yoga if you’re looking for a safe, gentle and relaxing healing experience in Ao Nang. 🤍

reviews.name: kelly tooze
reviews.text:
I joined for two classes at Tree D Yoga. One Prana flow & one energizing flow, both of which I loved but the energizing flow was my favourite with lots of joy breathing and some challenging postures. I love that the classes are all 1hr 30 minutes long which leaves time for play - and I now feel comfortable in my tripod headstand thanks to these two classes!

CC was a beautiful, calming & supportive teacher. And Oily was super communicative & even helped arranging for a ring I left at the studio to be delivered to Phuket once I’d left Krabi, and I couldn’t have been more grateful.

Thank you both ✨

reviews.name: Kamolporn Khunthongjan
reviews.text:
🌧️🤍

A beautiful teacher.
A beautiful place.
A beautiful vibe.
A beautiful energy.
Beautiful people.
A beautiful journey back to myself.

This was more than a yoga class or a sound bath session.

It was a space where the noise slowly faded, the weight on my shoulders softened, and my mind finally found room to breathe.

No matter how heavy you feel when you walk in, you’ll leave feeling so much lighter that you can barely remember the burden you carried through the door.

Today, I walked away feeling grounded, restored, and completely full of gratitude.

A true piece of mind, a peaceful heart, and a soul gently healed. 🤍

reviews.name: Saphora Dabo
reviews.text: Attended a couple sound healing session with Oily. The experience was amazing! Would highly recommend, Oily is super friendly, calm & a true expert at what she does.

reviews.name: YPS
reviews.text: First time trying a sound bath and it was such a unique experience. The session was thoughtfully adjusted to suit my pregnancy, which I really appreciated. I felt an instant connection with Oily. She’s warm, friendly and made me feel completely at ease. The space itself is calm and soothing, perfect for relaxing and unwinding. Would definitely recommend this to anyone!

reviews.name: Fatima Ahmed
reviews.text: Went with my friend for sound and stretch session, the ambiance is like you're at one with nature. It was raining when we went so it just added to the experience. Oily is amazing, post stretching we had sound session which was Soo sooo peaceful, I want to go back just for that ! Wish I had discovered it earlier in my trip

reviews.name: Fitore Haa
reviews.text:
visited Tree D Yoga for a private 7 Chakras Balancing session. Oily took a lot of time and care to explain everything to me and guided the entire session wonderfully.

Immediately afterward, I already felt lighter and freer. Before the session, I used to overthink almost everything, but since then it has become noticeably better. I feel calmer, more peaceful and more connected to myself.

Thank you so much for this beautiful experience. I wish you all the best and can truly recommend this session to others. 🤍🙏

reviews.name: Angela Sang Toomast
reviews.text: I'm very happy that I joined Tree D Yoga Aonang classes while my stay in Aonang. I had a very satisfying and healing experience from whole week's classes. I tried 6 of the several courses and my body and mind got a new breathing. All yoga teachers are very deficated and they care a lot about their students, it doesn't matter if you are the beginner or professional. 🙏

reviews.name: Brigitta Daroczi
reviews.text:
I had a great experience today at Tree D Yoga Center. The Hatha Flow class felt amazing, especially after a week of relaxation. The teacher was wonderful throughout the entire class—she was kind, supportive, and even took extra time to help me afterward.

Thank you so much for such a great experience. I hope to visit again soon!

reviews.name: Philip S
reviews.text: Happy to practice Yoga at Tree D Aonang. There is a wide variety of Yoga classes with different great teachers. Quality yoga mats and props are available and the place is in a nice peaceful environment. The yoga centre is managed by Khun Oily and she is a yoga teacher at the same time. It really feels that the place is run by passion and heart. Thank you very much for the great time

reviews.name: Sunny Cowsill
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Tree D Yoga. I booked a chakra balancing session because I had been feeling a little lost and disconnected in my journey, and it ended up being exactly what I needed.

From the moment I walked in, the space felt calm, welcoming, and grounding. The session itself was thoughtful, intentional, and deeply restorative. I left feeling centered, balanced, and much more aligned, like I had reconnected with myself in a really meaningful way.

If you’re feeling overwhelmed, stuck, or just in need of a reset, I highly recommend giving Tree D Yoga a try. It was a truly healing experience, and I’m so grateful I went.

Thank you so much ✨

reviews.name: Elena R
reviews.text: The peaceful, beautiful studio and the calming yoga classes are a great combination if you’re looking for a grounding and meditative experience.

reviews.name: Leethyng Ong
reviews.text: The teacher was very patient and took the time to make sure we as beginners, could follow each pose comfortably. She is also very soft-spoken, which made the session feel calm and relaxing. The environment was peaceful also.

title: Eaze massage,beauty and spa
ownerDescription:

Therapists are certified by the Ministry of Public Health. Open daily 10:00–22:00. Book online for 10% off.

reviews.name: Nejoua Ouchene
reviews.text: An exceptional Face Yoga massage experience! The place was spotless, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. The therapist was highly professional and knew exactly what she was doing. I could immediately feel a lifting and tightening effect on my face after the treatment. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and glowing. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional facial massage experience.” ✨💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review. ✨

Eaze Spa is truly happy you enjoyed your experience with us. We hope to welcome and pamper you again soon.

reviews.name: Pitchaporn Kosago
reviews.text:
Best spa in Phuket! 🌸
I went to Eaze Spa two days in a row because it was that good.

Day 1: Indian head massage + aromatherapy — I loved everything about it.
Day 2: Aromatherapy massage again, and you can choose your oil. I picked Sakura, and I’ve never seen any other spa offer this scent. It really makes this place special.

All the staff were incredibly kind and professional. You can clearly tell them what you like or don’t like, and how much pressure you want. There’s also parking available right in front of the spa, which is very convenient.

I’ll definitely go back again! 💆‍♀️✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review. ✨

Eaze Spa is truly happy you enjoyed your experience with us. We hope to welcome and pamper you again soon.

reviews.name: Apiradee R.
reviews.text: Highly recommended if you’re looking for a massage place in Phuket Town, especially near Central Phuket. I chose a body scrub and aromatherapy massage for 2hrs., and they even had a "May" summer promotion! It was so comfortable and incredibly relaxing, definitely worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review. ✨

Eaze Spa is truly happy you enjoyed your experience with us. We hope to welcome and pamper you again soon.

reviews.name: Kate Bass
reviews.text:
I recently visited a brand-new spa that opened in November last year, and I was truly impressed. The design is absolutely beautiful, with a modern, stylish, and clean atmosphere that makes you feel instantly relaxed. They offer a wide range of services, and I had the pleasure of trying the candle massage for the first time. The sensation was fascinating—afterward, my skin felt incredibly smooth, as if it had been tightened and nourished. Even after taking a shower, I could still feel a pleasant glide on my skin.

They also offer an Indian scalp and hair spa, which is a fantastic experience. Additionally, they provide all kinds of traditional massages, and with three floors full of rooms, each is equipped with state-of-the-art amenities. I highly recommend visiting if you’re in the area. The two lovely owners are incredibly friendly and attentive to all your needs, and they also serve delicious tea.

#Phuket #Spa #PhuketSpa #CandleMassage #IndianSpa #TraditionalMassage #LuxurySpa #Wellness #Relaxation #ModernDesign #MassageExperience
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much. We appreciate your support. 🙏☺️

reviews.name: china china
reviews.text:
Bad Experience at EAZE Massage (March 6)

I visited EAZE today and got a 690 baht Thai massage. The massage therapist was an elderly woman with a very rude attitude – she looked at me like I was her enemy.

The massage was bad. I asked her several times to press harder, but she seemed annoyed and impatient. She only slightly improved when I said I wanted to change masseurs.

The receptionist was nice and the place looks good, but the masseuse's attitude and skill were terrible. Very disappointing experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello, and thank you for telling us about your visit. We're very sorry that your massage did not meet your expectations — especially that your requests for firmer pressure were not met with the care and patience you deserve. This is not the standard we want for our guests. We would be glad to make it right: please message us on LINE @eaze or call +66 65 383 9787. — EAZE Spa team

reviews.name: Irina Bashmakova
reviews.text:
I am very satisfied 💖
Everything - from the greeting to the very end was perfect!
I chose baby yoga face massage. First of all I was greeted with refreshing drink and wet towel. Then I had my legs washed and proceed to the nice place with relaxing music. Massage bed was perfect - with a pillow for my back and soft blanket. Nuk was nice and smiley lady, with warm and  soft hands ❤️ the massage itself was great. I loved cold compress and mask following warm massage oil.
While I had mask on, Nuk massaged my arms. At the end, she put lip balm for me and did a great sculp massage.
At the end I had hot tea and cookies. 😋
Kob kapun ka and see you next time ka💖

reviews.name: Faiza Khan
reviews.text: My mum and I came here twice during our trip to Phuket because we loved it so much! Such a great experience both times.  The staff were lovely and did an amazing job. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Laura Ronderos
reviews.text: I had an Indian head massage here and it was beyond amazing. From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding—they welcomed us with cold drinks and a refreshing towel, which instantly set the tone. The massage itself exceeded all my expectations, so relaxing and thorough, and I felt completely pampered from start to finish. It’s 100% worth it, and I can’t recommend this place enough if you’re looking for exceptional service and a truly rejuvenating experience.

reviews.text:

Start from the reception the lady is very nice and friendly. Explaining about the massage I’ll do today and there’s a paper for you to tick if you want the massage to be light/normal/hard.

The environment are so soothing, clean and smell nice.

The therapist really gave me a good 90 mins on this head massage/ shampoo and blow dry.

I’ll recommend friends and family to come here and also will plan to come back here as well!

reviews.name: Kat Pinthira

The atmosphere was relaxing, the staffs were incredibly attentive, and the treatments were top-notch.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a peaceful spa day. I’ll definitely be coming back to try out other programs!

reviews.name: Kira B
reviews.text: This is my favorite Guasha facial massage since being in Thailand. Although bangkok has a lot of spas, Waze in Phuket is now my favorite. My face looks so lifted after the treatment and no only did I get a guasha massage, my head was also massaged as well as a back massage at the end. It was so relaxing and the place is new and so clean. The bedding, sheets, robes, and blankets did not have any stains. I've noticed that some places have stains on their sheets even if clean but Eaze Spa did not have ANY STAINS! EVERYTHING WAS CLEAN! THE SHEETS WERE IMMACULATE.  THE SPA WAS IMMACULATE. EVERYONE WAS SOOOOOOOO KIND AND KNOWLEDGEABLE! I felt welcomed at all times. I did not want to leave and felt so sad when I had to say bye. Also they wash your feet when you first arrive and put on slippers on your feet so that you can walk to your treatment room for your spa session. I had a 90 minute quadha massage and I'm already trying to plan another trip to Phuket to get another one in the future. I WISH THEY HAD THIS SPA IN BANGKOK. I feel so relaxed. I loved how sweet all of the employees were. I also came late and they were still kind to me. I even got a gift when leaving of a spa elephant Keychain. They get a 10 out of q0 stars. I will be recommending this spa to everyone. You also get a welcome drink and tea when leaving and cookies

Very clean, bright, and spacious massage place with great service and skilled therapists.

I had a foot massage here and really liked the result. I’ve been to many massage salons, so I’m quite picky and I know what good quality is. This place is located right in the center, opposite ICONSIAM, in a very touristy area, but still offers excellent quality for a very fair price compared to other salons nearby.

Highly recommended. Definitely 5 stars from me. Also, it’s very convenient that they accept Apple Pay.

reviews.text: Great reviews don’t lie! Fantastic massage, affordable prices, and super nice masseuses. My only complaint isn’t about the parlor, but the other patrons: please try to be more civilized—keep your voices down and use earphones instead of phone speakers to watch shows. It’s disrespectful to other guests and to the staff who are doing their best to provide a relaxing experience.

Nothing about it was relaxing or to enjoy. They left the curtain open between me and my gf and kept talking and laughing with each other. The whole massage also seans freestyled.

Normally I would say: you get what you pay for.

But it was highly unenjoyable.

reviews.text: The front-of-house team was very helpful and friendly. Loved exploring all the different scents, and the tea was so tasty — such a nice touch to a relaxing visit.

reviews.text:
I always have a great experience at this massage spa. The place is clean, well-organized, and very comfortable. Making an appointment is easy, and the front desk staff are always kind and helpful, especially Nok and Lin.

Today’s massage with Aomjai and Tien was excellent. They were polite, friendly, and very professional. I felt relaxed and comfortable throughout the session, and my body felt light and refreshed afterward. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.text: First time visiting this massage place, and it felt amazing! The therapist was excellent and hit all the right spots. The scented fabrics and tea made the experience super relaxing — definitely coming back!

reviews.text: Nice quiet place to enjoy a quiet massage break. No reservation required. Simply pumping in. Therapist AOR can communicate with Mandarine and is well-trained.

reviews.name: JCC

reviews.name: Ng Hui Yin
reviews.text: I booked a 90-minute Pure Oil Massage but unfortunately had a bad experience. The masseuse’s technique was not synchronized, the massage felt different on each side of my body. I requested a stronger pressure, but she did not increase the strength and continued with light, superficial strokes that felt more like just applying oil than an actual massage. Overall, it was disappointing and I would not recommend this service.

title: Aroma Health Massage by Zen Sense
