reviews.name: Britz Man
reviews.text: I would say this massage place is great for mental stress relief. It’s got a relaxing ambience with peaceful sounds d effects and healing towels. The message was thorough and very rejuvenating. As a big guy, I think a stronger massage would get those deep knots so I think I’d get the deep tissue massage if I went back. Very friendly service and clean building. They finished with a lovely jasmine tea and rice cracker at the end. Recommend!

reviews.name: vivi ‘ana
reviews.text: Beautiful space for the price. Nid is so sweet, friendly and treated my body with care, grace and respect — which I really appreciated. Had a 1.5 hour aroma oil massage, though I wish they patted down some of the oil before putting on my clothes. Couldn’t wait to shower afterwards cause I felt drenched in oil.

reviews.name: Emily Marshall
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this place, don’t be fooled by the pretty water feature out the front. I was placed at the very top of the 3 sets of stairs, and half way through the massage other people came and disturbed the peace talking and playing stuff on their phones. It took 10min for the therapist to say something to them, I tried to tell them to shush also. The top they put you in had buttons down the back which get in the way when you are getting a massage they keep adjusting, the curtains make an annoying noise when they are knocked.
The massage its self was ok he had a good technique but it wasn’t great.

Nice downstairs area, yum after massage tea.

reviews.name: Janice Ng
reviews.text: I love the massage here. Great music with the right volume. It’s probably one of the best aromatherapy massage I’ve ever had in years. Roy is great. Great massage

reviews.name: David Duffy
reviews.text:
Unfortunately had one of the worst massage experiences of my life. Came in at 22.15, so I take some responsibility, it is already too late for a massage realistically.

The owner seems to need to force someone to get ready to give a massage. A young boy comes out, he seemed exhausted and I should have stopped the massage right then, but out of some strange idea of not wanting to offend anyone let it continue. Hoping it would be ok

The massage was a combination of painful and then nothing but weak oil rubbing. Zero pleasure, technique or therapy. I would be angry at the masseuse but to be fair to him, he is probably overworked, and the owner shouldn’t have made him do another massage if he was too tired

This leaves me with weird guilt in Thailand, as I never want to make other people feel bad. So as a result of the owners desicion, I felt awful. The boy surely did, and now this review will possibly make her feel bad. Just no good came of it, except 400 baht in her pocket I guess

Another man came in after me and the owner called in an external masseuse. She looked great, and had lots of energy, I just wished she had done the same for me

In the end, I got a small refund, as I stopped the massage after 45 minutes.

I don’t want the masseuse to get in trouble as he may just be overworked. Although either way he did feel unskilled. And equally I don’t want to not leave a review as I would like the owner to learn from this, and hopefully not have other people experience it

Someone else left a similar review so I am not the first person. Long story, don’t come here late at night. Probably don’t get any
Massage late at night realistically. That’s on me. Lesson learned

reviews.name: And now you know
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a first class massage then this is the place to go. A big thank you to Tang for the best message I have ever had.
I can't wait to see you again

reviews.name: Yanat Chalala Lala
reviews.text:
This was my first visit. The therapist was experienced and followed a standard routine. When I requested to focus on my shoulders and scapula, the therapist simply mentioned that the session is typically divided into one hour for the back and one hour for the front anyway, implying those areas would be covered as part of the normal flow. However, there was no consultation form or inquiry about my preferred pressure before starting.

Privacy and noise were the main issues for me:

Curtain Partitions: The treatment areas, including the main entrance to the massage room, are only separated by curtains. This made it impossible to fully relax as I could clearly hear staff talking about their schedules and other guests walking up the stairs.

Lack of Privacy: During my oil massage, the therapist left the curtain halfway open after returning from washing her hands. This felt very exposed and unprofessional.

Accessibility & Value:
There is no parking, so it’s best to arrive via Grab or walking. The pricing is slightly lower than average for this area. If you’re okay with a basic setup and standard routines, this place is fine for the price. But for those seeking a truly private and peaceful atmosphere, it might not be the best choice.

reviews.name: Robert Sanchez
reviews.text: The best massage in this part of Chiang Mai. The place is very clean with a relaxing environment. My massage therapist named Benz was truly amazing and very experienced. I will definitely come here again when I return to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: amandajallen
reviews.text: Wonderful! Amazing oil massage. Peaceful environment that starts with a glass of water and a foot bath. Then up to a quiet space with a face cradle for starting out facing downward. They have A/C which is a plus. Ended with a tea and little sweet cake. I would definitely go again!

reviews.name: W L
reviews.text:
was quite disappointed with my experience. I had just finished dinner and specifically wanted a chair massage, so we chose the foot and shoulder option to avoid lying down. However, the therapist took me upstairs to a room with massage beds. I tried to explain that we preferred a chair massage, and then therapist said something which i didnt understand and we were kept upstairs anyway. I thought this was their thing, but then i later noticed 90 mins foot+neck and shoulders are actually really on chair.

the massage itself was not comfortable and the so called foot+shoulder and neck actually only included like 5% on shoulder and neck, one of the worst massage experiences I’ve had.

reviews.name: Naho Maho
reviews.text: I had an incredible 60-minute hot oil massage. I chose the jasmine rice oil, and it was a fantastic choice. The experience left me feeling completely relaxed and revitalized. The facility was impeccably clean, and the staff were exceptionally attentive. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking a truly great time and a wonderful massage.

reviews.name: Anu Singe
reviews.text: Amazing staff and service! My massage was one of the best I had and they worked around my shoulder injury as requested! Highly recommend and the teas at the end to top up the experience! 😊

reviews.name: Mavel Robayo
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Aroma Health Massage by Zen Sense in Chiang Mai! The location is very convenient and easy to find. The prices are also really reasonable, especially considering the quality of the service and you can pay with card.
They were open until midnight, which was perfect for me. I went for a 90-minute massage, and the lady who took care of me had excellent technique. I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

reviews.name: Mathieu Tan
reviews.text: Overall good experience and careful massage! Reasonable pricing too

reviews.name: BJ
reviews.text: I have my best massage experience in town! The shop is cozy and clean, the young man therapist (whose name is Ten) is skilled, and constantly checked in to make sure I was comfortable and that the pressure was okay. I really appreciated the attention to detail and the care I received. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Catherine Suter
reviews.text:
Very good experience, 90minute aroma oil massage, this is designed to soothe and relax with medium pressure which is what i wanted and what I got. This was really well done
Lovely staff, Thank you

reviews.name: Therese Dao
reviews.text: I came here since it was close to my hotel, and I had an excellent experience. I did the 90 minute foot, head, neck, shoulder massage. My masseuse took great care of me, and all of the staff were very kind and spoke great English! I would definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Cherie Nguyen
reviews.text: Visited Aroma for the first time based on the reviews & how nice the space looked. Unfortunately we did not have a good experience. Our massage was very mediocre and our masseuse put little to no effort. It was just continuous motion (like kneading dough lol), no pressure, and very rushed. At some point, I was over my massage and wanted to get up. I hope this review helps anyone visiting and for the spa to improve on their service. The space is nice and clean, just wish they provided better service :(

reviews.name: Paul Duffy
reviews.text: Good massage. Reasonably priced and high quality. Clean and relaxing space. High end, comfortable chairs for foot massage and soft blankets to stave off the air conditioner chill. There are a lot of staff so suitable for groups. Includes welcome drink and exit drink and snack. Will definitely go back. Thanks

reviews.name: Tyler Jorden
reviews.text:
The atmosphere is comfortable and modern—hands down my top 1 of the entire 10-day trip.
It was the only place where I truly relaxed enough to fall asleep, yet every pressure point was spot on.
Very fair pricing, incredibly comfortable and relaxing.
Number one, no doubt. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text: We went in without a reservation and the staff were able to give us an appointment slot later that day. The staff are welcoming. The massage bed was warm throughout the massage. The massage it self was brilliant and after our massage, we were given mango sticky rice and tea.

reviews.name: Ab
reviews.text: Brilliant experience, went for the 2 hour Thai massage with hot compress and left feeling invigorated! The massue was professional and experienced and coupled with the environment really left an overall nice experience. Would definitely recommend making a reservation beforehand to secure your slot.

reviews.name: Aneta
reviews.text: This place is absolutely wonderful! The atmosphere is so relaxing and beautifully designed. The foot massage was the best I have ever had in my life – incredibly professional, soothing, and perfectly tailored to my needs. The staff were kind, attentive, and made me feel truly cared for from start to finish.

reviews.name: Isheoma Yahaya-Joe
reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience at Let’s Relax. The receptionist was professional and guided me in selecting a package that suited my needs. The masseuse was excellent, from serving warm drinks to performing body scrubbing and massage. Everything was a perfect 10 out of 10. I definitely recommend them, and the location was clean and serene - I didn’t notice any dirt on site. As a clean freak myself, this place was heaven for me. Plus the sticky mango rice was very yum.

reviews.name: Cedric William Cheam
reviews.text:
You get what you pay for. What you pay for is quality. Let's Relax Spa definitely delivers a premium experience.
This Surawong branch is clean, tranquil, and much more peaceful than the busier mall locations. The therapists are highly professional, the environment is pristine, and the complimentary mango sticky rice at the end is the perfect finish. It is the best spot in the area for a high-quality massage without the 5-star hotel price tag!

reviews.name: Angel Tsim
reviews.text: Today I came to Lex’s Relax Surawong for a two‑hour Thai massage. I have always looked forward to your brand because the quality has been consistently reliable. However, today I encountered a therapist who kept falling asleep and worked very slowly. As a result, I stopped before completing the two hours because I did not want to continue feeling uncomfortable. Massage should be an enjoyable and relaxing experience, but this time it was quite the opposite and it affected me as a customer. My intention in sharing this feedback is for you to make improvements, as your brand has always been very good.

reviews.name: Brad Overturf
reviews.text: Enjoyed an excellent shoulder & neck massage at the Grand Centre Point Let's Relax. The atmosphere is indeed relaxing, the service was excellent and the therapist was professional and highly skilled. I recommend this Spa.

reviews.name: 2 Pathfinders
reviews.text:
Headline: An Oasis of Calm on Bustling Surawong Road

Rating: ★★★★★

I had a truly wonderful experience at the Surawong branch of Let's Relax Spa. From the moment I stepped in from the busy street, the atmosphere was immediately calming. The reception area is clean, modern, and smells divine with a subtle lemongrass aroma.
I was greeted with a cool towel and a welcome drink while I selected my treatment. The booking process was smooth, and the staff were professional and spoke excellent English.
I opted for the 2-hour Thai Massage with Hot Herbal Compress. The massage itself was both relaxing and invigorating, expertly stretching out all the tension in my shoulders and back. The highlight was the hot herbal compress, which felt absolutely heavenly and smelled amazing.
The treatment room was private, clean, and dimly lit, with soothing music playing in the background. Afterwards, I was led to a relaxation area and served their signature mango sticky rice with a cup of warm tea. It's the perfect way to finish the experience and a lovely touch that sets Let's Relax apart.
Overall, this was a fantastic spa experience. It's a bit pricier than smaller local shops, but you are paying for the quality, professionalism, and pristine facilities. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable and high-quality massage in the Silom/Surawong area.

reviews.name: Lynette Elleanora
reviews.text:
One of The best spa in Bangkok, in my opinion! I really love massages, so I went almost every day. I stayed in Bangkok for 5 days and went to the spa 4 times, haha. I was staying at a hotel right next to this spa (Grande Centre Hotel ⭐️ very nice hotel to stay too!), and so far, this is the best spa in Bangkok I’ve tried 💆‍♀️

The service, room cleanliness, and especially their sanitized slippers, totally different from other spas, even though the prices are similar. They also give you a welcome drink and a drink after the session, which made me super happy! The spa session was actually on time, unlike other spas that say it’s 60 minutes but when I counted, I only got 35 minutes :( Here, they have a timer and they show it to you, so it’s really honest!

reviews.name: Chatchaya Chatratanarak
reviews.text: A fantastic experience at Let's Relax Surawong. The facility is immaculately clean and the staff are very professional. My 2-hour Thai massage was one of the best I've had – the therapist was incredibly skilled. The famous mango sticky rice they serve afterwards is a wonderful bonus! It's a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of Bangkok. Well worth the price for the quality you receive. I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: natalie chew
reviews.text: 10/10 massage experience!! highly highly recommend this place. the masseuse was very experienced and the whole experience was wonderful. super clean and relaxing and they even served mango sticky rice after!!

reviews.name: amanda
reviews.text: The whole experience was beyond my imagination!! From the entrance your greeted with warm smiles and a welcome drink with a refreshing towel. After the massage you get hot green tea with mango sticky rice. I had a two hour Thai massage with SEXTAN - the best masseuse I’ve ever had, he’s very strong yet attentive and an expert in this field. I highly recommend this place anthem  if you’d like a strong massage !!

reviews.name: Pat Mack
reviews.text:
Absolute fantastic service. My masseuse Supannipha   started off light, after telling her to go harder she hit all the spots I needed. She was professional and seems to know what she’s doing. I had foot, leg back neck and shoulder massage. My husband had Thai, he said his lady gave him a very good massage too. We both had two hours.
We’ve had many Thai massages and sometimes come away disappointed, but note here. The only feedback is around the tablet asking which area you want focus, avoid etc, not sure you this but I’m guessing Its good for those who cannot converse in Thai and a way of communicating with your Masseuse. The Spa itself is clean and has very good facilities. Yes you pay more compare to places that are scattered around Thailand. But I guarantee you will not get the same level of service you receive here. Hot towels, foot wash with warm water, recliners, and massage chair. The price is worth every penny. Will have to come back before leaving for a Thai massage.

reviews.name: Victor Eziyi
reviews.text: The staff were extremely respectful. I had great value for my time. The massage was so relaxing and I would love to do a feet massage next. The serenity and ambience was top notch. They even gave me tea and a complimentary gift after the session. Loved it loved it loved it

reviews.name: Sampson Lo
reviews.text: My therapist - Prim was highly skilled and intuitive, applying the perfect balance of pressure to release deep-seated tension. The assisted stretching was transformative, leaving me feeling both profoundly relaxed and incredibly energized. The atmosphere was serene and authentic, which truly enhanced the healing process. It was more than just a massage; it was a rejuvenation of both body and mind. I cannot recommend this experience highly enough and will definitely be returning. Thank you for such amazing service

reviews.name: Anaïs Novak
reviews.text: A gentle and relaxing experience. I loved the way we were received by the therapists. I recommend the back and shoulder massage and foot massage!

reviews.name: Black Bird
reviews.text: Very very cold, guys! 🥶 Why do you switch on air conditioner  this way?) it was like in the fridge. ❄️ Back and shoulders massage was so so, coz I couldn’t relax sitting on the massage chairs: my face was squished, absolutely not comfortable… pretty design and pleasant atmosphere, but my massages and cold temperature didn’t let me enjoy as well

reviews.name: Vovka Slovesnyy
reviews.text:
It was the last day of my trip, and I booked the 210-minute package.
It was perfect! The location is brand new, everything is crystal clean.
I can compare it with other premium spas in Thailand, and can give it 10 out if 10.
One thing I would add is a short health and allergy survey form for customers.
For example, I have a specific area in the back, which has to be treated carefully. In all other spas, I had to fill out a short survey about my health.

reviews.name: יוליה מחלין
reviews.text: Very very good treatment and massage they are really professional and kind! I did twice and tommorow i am coming again for the long treatment!!! Exelante!!

They have cold plunge for the ones who don’t like icy water and a hot bath or steam bath for the ones who don’t like sauna. This is paradise for fast recovery… the staff are the most lowly crew I’ve been served by, 5 out of 5 stars 🌟 THE FOOD! reviews.name: Zak Dada
reviews.text:
Regen is a beautiful spa with amazing, new facilities. It has a swimming pool, cold plunge, hot tub, sauna, steam room, and showers.

I’d highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.name: Yasmine Tran
reviews.text: Amazing place! Cold plunge, pool, sauna, steam room, cafe, massage everything you need for a great recovery session

reviews.name: michelle wong
reviews.text: I came with my son because he wanted ice bath   , it’s a small place then other fancy spa and most are athletes so  I wasn’t expected too much . But surprisingly the massage room is  very clean and the lady did even better job then the lady at other supper expensive spa. It also have a small but nice clean open kitchen to cook very healthy food upon your order. I  am sure my son will keep on coming . Great place for people who train on the street , definitely recommend 😻

reviews.name: Emily Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: Amazing recovery and cafe. Such a nice chill vibe. A must do if you’re coming to fitness street. Great weekly/ monthly prices

reviews.name: Rebecca Keogh
reviews.text:
Cool new spa!
Gave out towels and a drink and shoes for my visit.
Hairdryers available.
As they are new, I just got to try out the sauna (Finnish style!), cold plunge and normal pool (slightly heated) - all gorgeous.
Definitely somewhere you could spend a few hours just relaxing and reading by the pool too in the open air.
Also random extras like space you could sit with a laptop or charge your phone which is really handy.
Also they have massage options available, although I didn’t have time to try.
Was 450 baht entry, but as they are new and not all facilities are open yet (steam room was about to open on December 30th), so I paid 25% less.
Overall really enjoyed :) only minus point was because I can’t judge the facilities that aren’t open yet (steam room and I think they are opening another hot room)

reviews.name: Dom B

reviews.name: D A
reviews.text:
Disclosure: we have experienced quite a list of hotels and could really get particular so I'll try to just cover actual facts and details.  We stayed in a 2-Bedroom unit 1bath but really no shared living room and very little shared space a long narrow thin between the two rooms.  Comments on the rooms and space.  The bay window seatings are nice. The miniscule side tables are not. The lowered bed is still comfortable but the thin table was not.  Does not have any place to hang anything in the room even  the small closet is outside the room. The whole hotel unit seem to have something against hanging hooks.

The washroom is located nicely in between the two rooms. BUT we discovered that the washrooms are literally paper thin.  Not so much concern because of sound but more of light. Meaning, if you leave the light on in the washroom, both bedroom walls will be completely lighted up.
So if you are light sensitive when sleeping and somebody needs to use the washroom in the middle of the night, be warned your room will glow up every single time. Somebody goes to the washroom.
Each room have a 40inch Samsung TV

There 2 robes and a safe as well as 2 pair of slippers note we booked the 2-Bedroom for four occupants.

The washroom is well appointed and nicely layed out. Two separate sinks, separate toilet 🚽 and separate shower🚿 but still in one room no separation partitions that will allow two people to use the washroom with privacy.

It is not the most comfortable stay for four days but manageable.

The hotel property in itself is beautiful and functional. The morning 🌄 breakfast is okay and the attendants are great. Hours between 6:30-10am

The on-site spa seems pricy but nice to be available. The restaurant and bar space is a great plus. Good space to chill outside your rooms
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear D A,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share such a detailed and well-considered review of your stay with us. We truly appreciate feedback from experienced travelers, as it helps us better understand how our design and facilities are perceived in real use.

We are pleased to hear that you found the hotel property beautiful and functional, enjoyed the bay window seating, appreciated the breakfast service and our attentive team, and found value in the restaurant, bar, and outdoor spaces. We are also glad that the room amenities, such as the televisions, robes, and overall bathroom layout, met your expectations in certain aspects.

At the same time, we sincerely thank you for your candid and detailed comments regarding the two-bedroom unit layout. Your feedback concerning shared space limitations, furniture proportions, storage and hanging options, bathroom privacy, and light transmission is very valuable. We understand how these elements can affect comfort, especially during a longer stay with multiple occupants. Your observations have been shared with our management and design teams for careful review and consideration in future improvements.

We also appreciate your comments regarding the spa services and breakfast hours, and we are pleased to know that our breakfast attendants made a positive impression during your stay.

Thank you again for your honest and constructive feedback. While we regret that the stay was not entirely comfortable, we truly value your insights and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa in the future under circumstances that better suit your needs.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager
De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

reviews.name: Yogita Popat
reviews.text:
Stayed at De Chai Colonial last week, great location and convenient. Breakfast limited but decent enough. Staff very friendly. Pool was small and average but you don’t go to Chiang Mai to stay by the pool. Bedrooms were big but basic. Our room overlooked someone’s backyard/house so we had to keep our blinds closed the whole time.
I’d definitely recommend this hotel purely for its location to everything

reviews.name: Ron Scozzafava
reviews.text:
Our room at the De Chai The Colonial Hotel & Spa  had a modern, simple design, with a somewhat limited (partially obscured) view. That said, it did not detract from the overall comfort. The space was well maintained, nicely laid out, and clean. The bed was comfortable, and housekeeping kept everything in good order throughout our stay.

The location is a major advantage. It is an easy walk to the Old City, multiple restaurants, temples, and numerous massage spots. The night markets are about a 10–20 minute walk away, close enough to be convenient but far enough to avoid the noise and crowds late at night.

Service was excellent. The staff were genuinely caring and attentive, and interactions felt warm rather than transactional. Breakfast was good with solid variety, though the coffee was on the weaker side.

Overall, a well-located hotel in Chiang Mai offering clean, comfortable rooms and consistently strong service.

reviews.name: RareBit
reviews.text:
We were quite disappointed with our stay. The room appeared poorly maintained or badly renovated from the start. The paintwork looked uneven and unfinished, and overall the room felt worn.

Several physical issues stood out: the corner of the bed frame was chipped, the floor had visible stains, and the decorative drape over the bed had noticeable marks. In the bathroom, there were cobwebs, broken tiles, and the shower head was old with visible buildup. The shower also leaked water out into the toilet area, and dirt was still trapped around the drainage, suggesting housekeeping had not thoroughly cleaned the shower space.

Another unusual detail was that the toiletries were placed outside near the TV area rather than in the bathroom, and that area was dusty. It made us question what type of room we had been assigned, as it felt very different from what other reviews described.

We booked the room at approximately $80 per night and could not help but wonder whether we were given a lower-quality room because of the discounted rate.

The location is also not particularly convenient or outstanding compared to other options in the area.

That said, the staff were friendly and polite throughout our stay, which we appreciated.

Overall, while the service was pleasant, the condition and cleanliness of the room did not meet expectations.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Just it,
Thank you again for sharing your detailed feedback. We sincerely regret the concerns you experienced and take your comments very seriously.

In order for us to properly investigate the matters you described and take the necessary corrective actions, we would greatly appreciate it if you could kindly provide your period of stay and room number. This information will allow our housekeeping and engineering teams to conduct a thorough review and ensure improvements are made accordingly.

Please rest assured that your feedback is important to us, as it helps us maintain and enhance the standards we strive to deliver to every guest.

We look forward to your reply and hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in us.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: catherinek941
reviews.text: The hotel was in an excellent location and the hotel itself is good. But it’s the little things that I struggled with. Lots of staff either sitting around one particular member of staff smirked a few times and was really unhelpful when trying to ask if they could provide some gluten free options for my daughter as she’s celiac for breakfast, after this he was always quite cold with me. ||. I’m unsure if they were short staffed for breakfast but like a few people have mentioned. I would skip breakfast. Trying to get a cuppa with breakfast was tricky and I had to ask lots to get one||I think we may of been a little unlucky when we arrived as we had flown over 5000 miles and were desperate to sleep, there was work next to our joining room and lots of banging. When I queried this, I was advised that there was information in the Lift to explain this. ||After complaining they were very good and stopped the work. ||We were in the family room and between the bathroom and the main room they had shutters to open. I think to watch the tv in the bedroom from the bath. In all honesty it was not a nice feature. ||The hotel is so close to being really nice, but I found it was the little things like lack on soap in the main toilets, next to pool, lack of towels next to pool. Lack of seats in|Bedroom, toilet roll running out In bathroom next to pool and not being replaced. It could do with someone staying there to try out the layout.||The main rooms felt stuffy , the air in was quite smelly at times.  ||The hotel has the potential to be amazing and in all honesty I felt disappointed - my experience of Thailand with hotels has always been super friendly but this was not my experience this time.

reviews.name: I6312NEbethk
reviews.text: I enjoyed our stay. The hotel was beautiful. It was clean, comfortable, and the room was spacious. The staff were friendly and helpful. I travelled in a group of 14 family members, in 5 separate rooms, and everyone had a great experience!

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Lovely old charm hotel with friendly and attentive staff. Great location to explore Chiang Mai. Lovely relaxing coy carp pond on the foyer. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Leon Gaschka (Leon)
reviews.text:
when we arrived, they worked on the hotel and there was a construction going on so it was loud sometimes because of that and the AC is very very loud. moreover the AC broke down 2 times and it flood our floor and some of our clothes. for that we didn’t receive any kind of compensation. also at breakfast I didn’t receive my ordered food :(

I cannot recommend you this hotel for that price. the location is fine but it’s not a nice hotel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Leon Gaschka (Leon),

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are sorry to learn that your stay did not meet your expectations and sincerely apologize for the inconveniences you experienced.

Regarding the work taking place during your stay, we would like to clarify that it was minor maintenance work being carried out to keep the hotel in good condition and ensure a comfortable environment for all guests. We apologize if this caused any disturbance during your visit.

We are also sorry to hear about the air conditioning issues you encountered. Unfortunately, there was an unexpected issue with the unit during your stay. In order to minimize the inconvenience and allow our engineering team to perform a thorough inspection and repair, we offered to move you to another room. However, you preferred to remain in the same room. While we fully respected your decision, this unfortunately limited our ability to carry out more extensive maintenance immediately. Nevertheless, we understand the frustration this situation caused and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Regarding breakfast, we apologize if there was a misunderstanding or delay with your order. This is certainly not the level of service we strive to provide, and we will review this matter with our team to prevent similar situations in the future.

We appreciate your feedback, as it helps us identify areas where we can improve. Thank you for staying with us, and we wish you all the best in your future travels.

Kind regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: Sowmya Vasanthakumar
reviews.text: Cant fault this hotel! Great breakfast, such friendly staff and great location. Its also VERY clean abd well kept. They were so lovely to our 18m old son too, and helped us with booking private driver, excursions, taxis and provide amazing laundry service - thank you so much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sowmya Vasanthakumar,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review. We are truly delighted to hear that you had such a fantastic stay with us.

It means a lot to know that you enjoyed our breakfast, cleanliness, and convenient location. Your kind words about our team are especially appreciated — we are so happy to hear that they made you and your family, especially your son, feel welcome and well taken care of.

We are also glad that we could assist with your travel arrangements and laundry service to make your stay more comfortable and convenient.

It was a pleasure having you and your family with us, and we sincerely look forward to welcoming you back again in the future.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: 72VaughanS
reviews.text: Top boutique hotel tucked away in the heart of Chiang Mai. 5 minute walk to old Town and the wall with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby.|Staff were friendly and helpfull and the rooms were spacious and well appointed.|We were in a family suite with shared bathroom but it was fine and suited our needs.|Good little bar and pool downstairs and the best club sandwich I have ever had.

reviews.name: Vic Flockton
reviews.text:
No durian allowed? What the hell am I meant to eat then?

Pool was REALLY cold and they ran out of towels

View was great
Pigeon nesting right outside the window
Lizard caught in bathroom
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Vic Flockton,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

We would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced during your stay. Regarding the durian policy, this is a common practice in many hotels in Thailand due to its very strong odor, which can linger in rooms and affect other guests. However, we understand your frustration and appreciate your feedback.

We are also sorry to hear that the swimming pool temperature was not comfortable. Whiles we respect your review, we would like to clarify that pool towels are provided in the pool restroom area and are normally replenished regularly by our housekeeping team. We apologize if they were not available at the moment you needed them or if the location was not clearly noticed during your visit.

Regarding the pigeon nesting near the window and the lizard found in the bathroom, as Chiang Mai is a tropical area, occasional encounters with small wildlife can happen. That said, we do take pest control seriously and will continue to improve our prevention measures.

Thank you again for your feedback. It helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again for a better experience.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: Fab C
reviews.text: A really great hotel. The rooms look exactly as in the photos on line, and are big with quiet air conditioning. PLEASE BUY NEW NOT LUMPY SOFT PILLOWS for the bedrooms. The breakfast is excellent with a fresh egg station, and all the staff are professional and friendly. Totally satisfied.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Fab C,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review and for choosing to stay with us.

We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your spacious room, the quiet air conditioning, and that the hotel matched your expectations from the online photos. It is also fantastic to know that our breakfast selection and the service from our professional and friendly team contributed to a totally satisfying stay — your kind words truly mean a lot to us.

We also sincerely appreciate your comment regarding the pillows. Guest comfort is extremely important, and your feedback has been shared with our management and housekeeping teams as we continuously review and upgrade our room amenities to improve sleep quality for our guests.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again soon for another great stay.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager

reviews.name: Lindsay King
reviews.text: We arrived at this hotel, fresh (or maybe ripe) from a 2 day hike in rural Chiang mai. The front desk was so helpful in tending to our immediate needs which were laundry and spa service. The room was beautiful and so was the view, being on the 5th floor. Location is fantastic. Easy walk to multiple restaurants and massage spots. About 10 minute walk to the night market.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lindsay King,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review. We’re delighted to hear that our team was able to assist you promptly after your hike and make your arrival comfortable with laundry and spa services.

It’s great to know that you enjoyed your room, the view from the 5th floor, and our convenient location near restaurants, massage spots, and the night market. Your kind words about our staff mean a lot to us.

We would be thrilled to welcome you back to De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa on your next visit to the city.

Warm regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager
De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

reviews.name: Dqn Myer
reviews.text: Tucked away on a quiet street. Great food and a kind, helpful staff. Rooms are well supplied and super clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dqn Myer,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our quiet location, the food, and the helpful service provided by our staff.

It is also great to know that you found the rooms well equipped and super clean during your stay.

Your kind words truly mean a lot to our team, and we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again on your next visit to Chiang Mai.

Hotel Manager

reviews.name: foofoo laundry
reviews.text:
Thank you, De Chai customer, for choosing Foo Foo Laundry to pick up and clean your laundry and shoes.

You can also leave your laundry, bags, or payment at the reception — no worries, we’ll take care of everything for you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Hotel Manager

reviews.name: sirlim101
reviews.text: The place was great value to stay with.  It was a 5-10-minute walk to most of the old city.  It even featured a tourist office 30 seconds away so you aren't really far from anything.||We stayed at their two-bedroom hotel room.  The beddings were clean and comfortable.  The room had everything that we needed.  I appreciate the high tech items in the room such as the Smart TV where we could play YouTube and other apps, as well as the alarm and bluetooth speakers.  ||Breakfast had a wide choice for us, both Western and Thai options.  I enjoyed the chicken dishes they served every day of our stay.||But the staff was the best part.  They provided us with useful advice and arranged a breakfast box for us on the last day when we had to leave for the airport before the breakfast hall opened.  They were also helpful in helping us book a taxi.||I would certainly consider staying here again in the future.

reviews.name: Destanee Burrus
reviews.text: My friend and I are staying here for three nights. Upon arrival, we were greeted with a kind gentleman who took our luggage inside for us and helped get us checked in. We were also greeted with passionfruit juice (probably the best juice I have get tried). Hotel was very clean, in a good location, and had very nice staff. I would definitely recommend this place! Plus, they have a spa- who doesn’t like those?!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted that you and your friend enjoyed your stay with us. It’s great to hear that our team made a positive first impression—from the warm welcome and luggage assistance to the refreshing passionfruit juice.

We’re glad you found our hotel clean, well-located, and appreciated the friendly staff. And yes, our spa is definitely a favorite among guests!

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you both back on your next visit to Chiang Mai.

Best regards,
Wallop M.
Hotel Manager
De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

reviews.name: Vivan
reviews.text:
Our stay here was nice, there were very spacious and comfortable rooms. Only one person could use the toilet at once, there were no doors in the toilet or shower.

There weren't many staff at reception during peak check out hours, so it was quite a wait. The breakfast had limited variety, especially for vegetarians.

The hotel was in a pretty sketchy alleyway, which got scary at night.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your feedback with us, following your recent visit to De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa. We are absolutely delighted to hear that your stay was nice overall. However, please accept our sincerest apologies for any inconvenience occurred in customer service counter. Your comment will be taken onboard for the future improvement.
Kind Regards,
Wallop M.
De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

reviews.name: Dawg
reviews.text:
My room didn't have hot water, but they did try to fix it and I didn't care enough to change rooms.

Otherwise, it was a perfect stay. Staff are so lovely and the location is great. I have some amazing memories there after spending 5 nights there.

We would be thrilled to welcome you back to De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa and provide an even better experience next time.

Wallop M.
Hotel Manager
De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

reviews.name: ilan voloch
reviews.text:
We just arrived today ,the service is excellent, everything u ask is being done immediately (suitcases arrived in 1 minute, additional blankets 1 minute).
The room are big, and very good quality (beds, all the equipment, bathroom etc).
They also have free chocolates for the kids, and everything u need.
The location is good, but if it was next to Chabad's house, it might be better for us.

De Chai Colonial Hotel & Spa

title: Zen Sense Health Massage @ZenSquare
address: 130/1 Ratchapakhinai Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXPR+56 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Alanah Reid
reviews.text: I had the best massage at Zen Sense! I was a bit nervous as I’ve only ever had one massage before this, but I felt completely at ease. I got the hour long Aroma Oil Massage Therapy for 550 baht and you can choose which aroma you’d like. The masseuse made sure I was OK during the massage and I left feeling soooo relaxed. The tea and snack afterwards was very welcomed. I highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back again.

reviews.name: marco thurau
reviews.text:
A tale of two very different experiences.

We visited this place twice for a massage, and unfortunately, the experiences couldn't have been more different.
​The First Visit (5/5 stars): Our first experience was incredible—honestly one of the best massages we’ve had in Chiang Mai. Before starting, we were asked to fill out a form regarding our problem areas and preferred pressure. We were treated to a relaxing foot bath, and the massage itself was professional, relaxing, and exactly the strength we requested.
​The Second Visit (1/5 stars): We returned today expecting the same high standard, but it was the complete opposite. There was no intake form and no foot bath. Although we booked a full-body massage, it didn't feel like a massage at all. The therapist mostly just spread Thai balm over my skin without any real technique or pressure.
​It is very disappointing to see such a lack of consistency. We went from having a top-tier experience to a very poor one in just a few days. We hope the management looks into this, as we really enjoyed our first visit.

reviews.name: Lillian L.
reviews.text: Pricing is unbeatable. Clean establishment. No wait time. I got the thai office massage and my shoulders were so relaxed!

reviews.name: J N
reviews.text: Walked past this place a few times during previous days so decided to give it a try. Very big and clean.. paid 650 for a one hour hot oil massage, was very good overall. The masseuse is very experienced. Started off by getting your feet washed in a sink outside in the yard, then you go inside a large area where the massage beds are, there are curtains between them. When I was there tonight there was nobody there, very quiet , very relaxing. She massaged arms, hands, legs, feet, back, neck, front of chest and stomach. After finishing they give you a treat with tea. Will definitely come back before leaving Chiang Mai. 10 out of 10, one of the best legit massage places I've been to in Thailand.

reviews.name: 胡静怡（RSer）
reviews.text: Thai massage is very relaxing, and the massage technique is very comfortable. I will come again next time.

reviews.name: CREATE YOURPEACE
reviews.text: Such a great experience. Had the best aroma massage I've had in Chiang Mai here so I came back to show my friend and she also really enjoyed her massage. They are talented and kind with a welcome environment and beautiful grounds. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Jill Jackson
reviews.text: I had the most fantastic massage today! I had a problem with my knee, which o did not inform them of, however the masseuse must have known as she worked on the muscle and it feels brilliant! I am coming back tomorrow for the reflexology!

reviews.name: TzP
reviews.text:
I came here for a foot massage. On the menu it was listed only as a 90-minute treatment, so I asked the receptionist if it was possible to do just one hour. She said yes, but another staff member (who seemed to be the supervisor) later said it was not possible and that only the 90-minute option was available.

Because of that, I chose a different treatment- a combined foot, back and shoulder massage, which was more expensive than the regular foot massage. I also asked if the massage could be done on the chair instead of the bed, and they agreed.

About 10 minutes into the massage there was a power outage that lasted for the rest of the session. The therapist herself was good, attentive and professional.

However, toward the end I realized I had basically received only a foot massage, with about 5 minutes of shoulders and neck at the end,  which is something that is anyway included even in regular foot massages in Thailand and is considered standard.

When I spoke with the supervisor afterward, she explained that because I chose the chair, the time distribution between feet and back/shoulders is different. This was never explained beforehand. Although she apologized and admitted there had been a mistake and misinformation, no partial refund or compensation was offered- even though the treatment was more expensive than a normal foot massage and there had also been a power outage during most of the session.

Because of this, I left disappointed with the way the situation was handled.

reviews.name: Agatha P
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic experience! 650 baht for the foot/head/shoulders/neck massage for 1.5 hours. Great price for the quality of massage and care I received! Clean facilities

You can choose the pressure and the balm they use is very menthol forward so great for sore muscles. The front desk staff speak fluent English and are very helpful.

Finished off treatment with tea and a snack!

If I had more time in Chiang Mai, I’d be back every night!

reviews.name: John
reviews.text: My partner and I both had awesome experiences here. So good we went back a second time. for me the first time a traditional Thai massage to get my body into shape, then a relaxing massage with oils the second time. for my partner who suffers from sore neck and back, she had the "office neck and shoulders" Thai massage.... this is fully recommended. the masseuse was very professional and a real expert with lots of skill . she pinpointed all her tension and kept working on it until it went. full 5* recommendation.

reviews.name: Valerie Wagner
reviews.text: Everyone was incredibly sweet and caring here. It was an elevated massage experience filled with special details and lots of love. Tik was concerned and kind. She also has strong hands with gentle healing touch.

reviews.name: Raquel Conde
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this place! So relaxing. My friend and me had a couples massage, they gave us a feet scrub to start. Then we had an oil full massage of 1 hour. They were so profesional, got super relaxed. They apply the right amount of pressure and even got a final full body stretch at the end.
The tea and snack at the end was the cherry on top.
100% recommended

reviews.name: puresukhayoga
reviews.text: Lovely space , friendly staff and great traditional Thai massage . Great price for the length of the different massages and quality of service. Love the tea and snack at the end. Have visited numerous times already.

reviews.name: sulin lau
reviews.text:
Very simple but completely clean and professional -
addition to usual Thai and aromatherapy, they also offer a few specialised options including Swedish, lymphatic drainage etc. comfortable, firm and wide massage bed with attached shower/toilet in same room

What I liked best. During the check in process, we’re asked to mark the parts of the body to concentrate on/ that we’re sensitive/ to avoid during massage.

I took 90mins aroma deep tissue for 800B.

reviews.name: Virginia Fuente
reviews.text:
I had an aromatic whole body massage for 60’ (you can choose from three different scents of oil).
I was with my friend in the same room, with two women masseuse.
First, they washed our feet, and then they took us to the area where the massage began. My masseuse was very considerate and asked me several times if I was comfortable. She didn't apply too much pressure (I was worried about this, as I suffer from back pain), but it was actually perfect.

At the end, they give you courtesy tea and biscuit.

The place is very clean, I really recommended.

reviews.name: Dimitra Sampani
reviews.text: One of the best massages I’ve ever had. So relaxing, perfectly done, and I left feeling incredible! The place was very clean and the staff professional, welcoming and friendly

reviews.name: Zvonko B.
reviews.text:
BEST massage in my whole life.

Will never forget this.

I had a 60 minute foot massage and then right after that a 90 minutes Thai massage of the whole body.

Ask for NUT to be your therapist - She is absolutely wonderful.

Thank you for the experience.

reviews.name: Dee D
reviews.text: I have regular massages and went here knowing exactly what works and doesn’t work for me. I booked a deep tissue (oil massage) and it was a perfect experience. Not the cheapest place but the quality is good, which I think is more important!

reviews.name: erica kung
reviews.text:
Summary: not recommended.

I purchased the hot oil massage and the whole body scrub. “Hot” oil was not hot, it was at room temperature. Whole body scrub was okay, point to know is that normal body scrub does not include body massage so thats why i added 300 baht for extra massage service

Environment:
- overall cleanliness is similar to that of a three-star hotel - fair. There were a few flying insects in the room.  The washroom in our massage room has no hot water so we had to walk to another massage room naked (wrapped in a towel)
- Overall massage: i was attended by a random masseur named “FL-C” who obviously was amateur and does not have professional massage skills. there was no skills and strength in her massage and i dont feel relaxed after the whole service at all. Worst message i had in thailand
- Comfort: maybe because we were having the body scrub, the room seemed particularly cold. After the oil massage and body scrub, the masseur will use a wet towel to help wipe away the oil/ scrub, which was also cold

reviews.name: Jony Elyovich
reviews.text:
I had the best massage of my life here. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, clean, and welcoming. The therapist was incredibly skilled and attentive, quickly understanding exactly where I held tension and working with the perfect pressure throughout. Every movement felt intentional, professional, and deeply relaxing, and I left feeling both lighter and more energized than I have in years.

This was not just a massage, but a truly healing experience. The combination of technique, care, and atmosphere made it unforgettable. I cannot recommend this place enough and will definitely return whenever I have the chance.

title: Aromee massage
subTitle: อโรมี มาซซาส ร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
ownerDescription:
Welcome to Aromee Massage, a relaxing massage shop in the Khao San and Rambuttri area of Bangkok.

Take a break from walking and sightseeing and enjoy a comfortable massage with our friendly and experienced therapists.

We offer Thai Massage, Foot Massage and Oil Massage at clear and reasonable prices.

Whether you need to relax after a long flight, soothe tired feet after exploring Bangkok, or simply enjoy a peaceful moment, we are happy to welcome you.

Clean • Comfortable • Friendly Service • Fair Prices

Visit Aromee Massage and enjoy a relaxing break in the heart of Bangkok.
address: 57 Ram Buttri Aly, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
plusCode: QF6W+M9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Kinow
reviews.text: We just went there with my partner. He had a Traditionnal Thai Massage (1h) and I had a Head, Neck, Shoulder, Back (30min) & Foot massage (30min) and we absolutely loved it! I had lower back pain, I told them I wanted a massage about that and I feel like I was really listened ! My therapist was absolutely wonderfull, Katya/Katae (I think, sorry if I misspell 🙏), she put the good amount of pressure at the good places and really listen to my body! My partner also had an excellent massage, we both feel way better! The place is clean and everyone is really kind, explaining the differents massages they offer. Also the prices are really fair. We would definitely come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your detailed and wonderful review! 
We’re very happy to hear that both you and your partner enjoyed your massages.

It means a lot to us that our therapist listened carefully to your needs and paid special attention to your lower back.
We’ll be sure to share your kind words with our team. 

Thank you also for mentioning our cleanliness, friendly staff, and reasonable prices.
We look forward to welcoming you both back to Aromee Massage on your next visit to Bangkok!

reviews.name: SH
reviews.text: I visited here twice during my trip to Bangkok because it was so amazing! The therapists are highly skilled and very attentive. I especially loved that the facility is very clean and offers private rooms, which made the experience so comfortable and private. On top of that, the prices are very affordable, offering the best value for money. The traditional Thai massage really helped me get rid of all my travel fatigue. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Bangkok. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Niklas
reviews.text: I had a 60-minute Thai massage here with a male therapist, and it was honestly one of the best Thai massages I’ve ever had. The massage had strong pressure and firm techniques, exactly how a proper Thai massage should be. Very professional, and he really knew how to work on tension and sore muscles. I left feeling completely relaxed and refreshed. Highly recommended if you’re looking for an authentic and high-quality massage experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your amazing 5-star review!  We’re delighted to hear that your 60-minute Thai massage was one of the best you’ve ever experienced. Your kind words about our therapist’s professional technique and strong pressure mean a lot to our team. We hope to welcome you back to Aromee Massage again on your next visit to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Shannon Martin
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere. They keep it quiet with a relaxing background sound. The masseuse were really friendly.
We had a good laugh hearing the customer next to me snoring so loud. He was just so at peace.

The foot massage got me goosebumps and fixed my legs after so much walking from the past weeks. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Anna Llauradó López
reviews.text:
We had a oil massage. We payed 360 bath for 1h. Overall, it was a decent experience—relaxing, but nothing special. The place was clean and comfortable.

Just a heads up: double-check your change when paying, as we were almost given 100 baht less “by mistake.” Good for a standard massage.

reviews.name: Will Langston
reviews.text: Fantastic massage spot. Great deal! 300 baht for Thai massage. Clean.

reviews.name: Pia L.
reviews.text: I went in Bangkok for my first Thai massage and it was an amazing experience. I really enjoyed the time, the massage was just relaxing and relieving. I would definitely recommend coming here.😃 thanks again

reviews.name: l b
reviews.text: Of all the massage places I visited in Bangkok, this was by far the best experience I ever had. The spa was clean and well-maintained. The service is impeccable. I got a 90 minute thai and foot massage to cap off my trip and it was the best and most relaxing massage I ever had. My masseuse, Eid, was good, had good pressure and was attentive. I highly recommend this place. Their massage therapists indeed have years of experience and it shows in the quality of the massages they give.

reviews.name: AddictPanda
reviews.text: Best massage i’ve been to in this neighbourhood! Both times were great, i will defend return
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!  We’re very happy to hear that you had a great experience with both of our therapists. It means a lot to us that you consider Aromee Massage one of the best in the area. We look forward to welcoming you back again!

reviews.name: Mel Jones
reviews.text: I had the best foot massage with shoulder, neck and head massage from Chai. I thought I’d won the foot massage lottery with him. He really seemed to know what he was doing, and it’s hard to find that in Thailand. I went back three times.

reviews.name: Sophie Lejeune
reviews.text: Perfect place for a massage, I went there 3 times during my stay in Bangkok and would definitely go again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! 😊 We’re especially happy to hear that you visited us three times during your stay in Bangkok. Your continued support means so much to our team. We look forward to welcoming you back to Aromee Massage on your next trip to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Teodora Andrişan
reviews.text:
I visited this massage parlour on my last day in Thailand, hoping to release some physical and emotional tension, but sadly, it turned into a deeply upsetting experience.

While the welcome was warm and friendly, the massage itself was the opposite. The therapist, a middle-aged woman with shorter hair and a fuller build, started very deep and fast without easing into it, which is not safe or professional. When I asked her to go lighter, she laughed, making me feel dismissed and unheard.

As a massage therapist myself, I understand the balance between deep pressure and relaxation, but this lacked flow, care, and respect for my needs. She also kept the AC blowing cold air directly on me, despite me asking multiple times to adjust it. Though she gave me blankets, it didn’t solve the discomfort, and her response felt dismissive again.

To make matters worse, she chatted with the other therapist during my session, which felt unprofessional and disrupted the atmosphere. By the end, my calves hurt as if they’d been beaten, and I left feeling anxious, upset, and deeply triggered.

While the salon itself seemed clean and other therapists might be better, this was the worst massage experience I’ve ever had. I felt no compassion or care, and it ruined my last evening in Thailand. Please avoid this place or at least the therapist I described.

reviews.name: Mr Jon
reviews.text:
I never leave 1‑star reviews — but this place isn’t even worth 1 star. I booked a 4‑hand massage expecting a relaxing experience. Instead, I got the “public spectacle” package. No private room, no curtain — just me, shirtless, in full view of about ten people casually getting their foot massages and probably wondering why I was on display. The massage area was so tiny that when they stretched my leg, it smacked straight into the wall. Not even a wipe‑down with a hot towel at the end.

And the cherry on top? When I walked out, no one even asked how my massage was — which says a lot about the level of care here. Then I noticed they have a sign offering 10% off if you leave them a 5‑star review. That says it all. For the price, I expected peace, privacy, and at least a hint of hospitality. Instead, I got a cramped fishbowl experience, a silent goodbye, and a push for fake glowing reviews. Never again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Your review shows the disrespectful nature of those who make fake reviews. The 10% discount is available for customers who ask for it, but we have conditions for giving it if they are truly satisfied with the service. There is no asking or coercion, and most of the customers at the store are good. If you don't like this place, I apologize. You should go to the place you like. Thank you.
I am confident that I conduct my business with sincerity and seriousness in my work.I apologize if you received unsatisfactory service. I will take this issue to improve and fix it immediately.

ownerUpdates.text:
A Different Way to Experience Bangkok. Chidlom is known for luxury shopping destinations such as Central Embassy, Central Chidlom, and Gaysorn Village. Others visit the area for business meetings, five-star hotels, or cultural landmarks such as the Erawan Shrine. 

A full day often means hours spent on your feet. Visitors walk between shopping centres, navigate the city's bustling streets, and spend long periods standing, sightseeing, or travelling between destinations. By evening, tired legs, sore shoulders, and general fatigue are common companions.

For some, a traditional Thai massage provides the perfect way to relieve muscle tension after a day of walking. Others prefer an aromatherapy massage, where calming essential oils and gentle techniques create a deeply relaxing experience. Business travellers often seek treatments that focus on the neck, shoulders, and lower back, while shoppers frequently appreciate a restorative foot massage that helps soothe tired feet. 

The best spas create a space where recovery feels effortless. Private treatment rooms, experienced therapists, premium massage oils, and thoughtful hospitality all contribute to an experience that lingers long after the treatment has ended.

Located just moments from Chidlom BTS, Vanarin Spa offers a tranquil retreat in the heart of Bangkok. Book a treatment with us with a few simple steps, just LINE us at @vanarinspa or call us +66 9 8 415 4545.

Thai Massage in a Premium Spa in Bangkok
If you opt for a Thai massage at Vanarin spa, know that Thai massage is one of Thailand’s most well-known wellness traditions, valued for its ability to restore balance, improve flexibility, and release deep tension.

But when combined with the comfort and refinement of a modern luxury premium spa, the experience becomes something more, an experience that is elevated, personalised, and deeply restorative. 

Originating in Thailand, the art of traditional Thai massage is a unique practice that blends acupressure, assisted stretching, and rhythmic movement.

Unlike oil-based treatments, it is performed without oils and works along the body’s energy lines to release blockages and improve circulation.

The result is a treatment that feels both energising and grounding, leaving the body lighter, more flexible, and rebalanced. 

While the technique remains rooted in tradition, the environment in which it is delivered plays an equally important role.

At Vanarin Spa in the Chidlom area, Thai massage is experienced within a calm, private, and thoughtfully designed space, allowing you to fully relax throughout your treatment.

Private rooms, clean modern interiors, and en-suite facilities ensure that your experience is not only effective, but comfortable from beginning to end.

Choosing the right treatment can transform your entire spa experience. Two of the most popular options, Thai massage and aromatherapy massage, offer very different benefits, each suited to different needs and preferences.

Understanding the difference can help you choose the treatment that your body truly needs.

Traditional Thai Massage: Deep, Restorative, Energising -- Rooted in centuries-old healing practices, traditional Thai massage focuses on stretching, pressure, and movement. Unlike oil-based treatments, it is performed fully clothed and works along the body’s energy lines.

Aromatherapy Massage: Calm, Soothing, Therapeutic -- Aromatherapy massage uses warm oils blended with essential extracts to calm the mind and relax the body. The movements are slower and more fluid, allowing tension to gently melt away.

We believe that a truly exceptional spa and massage experience in Bangkok comes from a combination of experience, training, and genuine care—brought together in every session. 

Experienced and Highly Trained - Our therapists are professionally trained in a range of wellness and massage techniques, including Thai massage, deep tissue, and aromatherapy. With a deep understanding of the body, they are able to work with precision, whether applying targeted pressure to release tension or using gentle, flowing movements to encourage relaxation. 

Personalised to You - Before each session, take the time to let our therapists understand your needs, whether you are experiencing tightness in specific areas, prefer a certain pressure, or simply wish to unwind. From there, every movement is adapted to suit you, creating a treatment that feels intuitive and completely personal.

Attentive and Reassuring - Beyond technique, it is the level of care that defines the experience. Our therapists are attentive without being intrusive, ensuring your comfort at every stage. Feel assured that you are in capable and caring hands.

A Commitment to Excellence - Consistency is at the heart of what we do. Every therapist at Vanarin Spa is committed to delivering the same high standard of service, so that each visit meets the expectations of a premium spa and massage in Bangkok, Thailand.

Thank you very much for your recent visit to endota spa and for your feedback. We are so delighted you had a great relaxing time at the spa, with just the right pressure from our therapist, and also enjoyed our facilities afterwards. We do look forward to welcoming you back again. 

Kind regards,
endota team

reviews.name: Tommy Saggus
reviews.text: I have been living in Thailand for almost 10 years, and this was by far my best massage/spa experience. I have never felt so relaxed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback. We’re truly honoured to hear that your visit with us was the best spa experience you’ve had in Thailand. It’s our pleasure to know you felt so deeply relaxed and cared for. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another experience.

Kind regards,
endota team

reviews.name: Gillian
reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly staff, well trained therapists, good English, very relaxing and my skin feels revitalised. Advanced renewal treatment.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Gillian,

Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our service and had a relaxing experience. Your kind words about our friendly team, skilled therapists, and treatments mean a great deal to us. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

Vanarin Spa Team

reviews.name: Place To stay
reviews.text:
What I like :
- cleanest and modern design
- good quality products
- polite and very attentive service
- sabai comfortable room and massage bed
What I DONT LIKE and make me never back :
- therapist skills. I want relax and soft pressure , but she doesn’t knows the right points… I know that you need follow the rules of Endota , but i tried thousands massages and i can see that your therapist doesn’t know muscles map, points for relax , she doesn’t feel right speed of movement for relaxation treatment . Therapist also put too much oil on me . I didn’t speak to your therapist at all, because she doesn’t speak English, but i can feel that problem is not about language..
- In the end of treatment you should give feedback form or at least listen your clients . Because only honest review can upgrade your business if owner will listen and take action.
I like the shop but the most important point is the therapist in your business..
thank you for welcoming receptionist and good tea🍵
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

We appreciate your valuable review and welcome all feedback as this helps us to improve overall customer experience. We are very sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction with the treatment. We do ensure that our therapists, all with over 10 years of experience in the industry, are well qualified and certified in both spa and massage aspects as well as the endota protocol, before servicing our customers. As the Organic Relax treatment offers light to medium pressure, it can be that it may not be the most suitable for customers who take part in frequent and advanced massages. But we hope that we will have the opportunity to welcome you with our customised massage which would offer you a more targeted and suited experience. Thank you again for your feedback to help us in improving our services. 

Kind regards,
endota team

title: My Day Thai Massage

My Day Thai Massage provides professional Thai massage and wellness services in a clean, calm, and welcoming environment. Conveniently located near Ramada Plaza Bangkok Menam Riverside, our shop is ideal for hotel guests, travelers, and local customers seeking relaxation and rejuvenation.

Our experienced therapists offer a variety of treatments designed to relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and promote overall well-being after travel or long working hours. We emphasize quality service, proper techniques, and customer comfort to ensure a consistently relaxing experience for every guest.

Open daily. Advance booking is recommended, especially during evenings and weekends.

reviews.name: Hazel

reviews.name: Paul Murphy Quiambao

reviews.name: Laura Lazarenko
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed my experience at My Day massage salon
The atmosphere was cozy and relaxing, the staff were friendly, and the massage was amazing. The prices are also very good for the quality you get😊

reviews.name: Celia V

reviews.name: Evan Stegmuller
