title: Phuketian Cooking Class by About BE
ownerDescription:
Learn to cook Thai food like a local, so you can impress friends and family back home. A real hands on experience...you will be amazed what you can cook!!!
There is no better way to earn Thai cooking once you are in Thailand and taking a Thai Cooking Class.
The cooking class at Phuketian Thai Cooking has a cozy and friendly style environment.
You are not only watching, but participating in the cooking of traditional Thai dishes. Also as a part of our cooking, we visit the local market to learn about local exotic fruits and vegetables. There is always an abundance of new things to see and taste.
address: 33, 2/1 Yaowarad Rd, Tambon Ratsada, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand
plusCode: W94G+J7 Ratsada, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Johanne Reyntjes
reviews.text:
This has been my favorite thing to do in Thailand. This cooking school was very clean and professional. The teacher had excellent English speaking skills and a very thorough knowledge of Thai cuisine. She is passionate about her culture and sharing it with others.
I especially enjoyed the tour of the local market, would never have seen this without the cooking class. I recommend doing this earlier in your stay as it increases your confidence and awareness of foods to try.
Definitely recommend this for anyone with an interest in cooking and Thai food, the hints along the way were priceless!

reviews.name: Drew Reynolds
reviews.text:
This was such a fun experience. Be and her staff were absolutely focused on making sure everyone in the class was having a good time and sharing in there love of Thai cooking.
Starting with a trip to an open air market, we were able to sample and learn about the ingredients we would be working with that day. After returning to the kitchen, we created some incredible, complex Thai dishes. The instruction was easy for any cooking skill level. And the food was phenomenal, I could not believe the quality of the dishes we were able to create.
Thank you, Be, for giving us such an unforgettable memory to take home.

reviews.name: Di Toms
reviews.text: Highly recommend anyone doing these cooking lessons with Be, she’s absolutely amazing & very professional.  With Be we went to the market to learn about local produce.  I’ve had the best Tom Yum Soup ever… and Be taught me how to prepare and make it.  I went on a Thursday & so made Tom Yum Soup, Phuket Noodles, Chicken with Holy Basil & Coconut pudding.  I give Be a 10 star rating.  If you want to impress friends & family with Thai cooking, I definitely suggest you do a Thai cooking lesson with Be.

reviews.name: Audrey
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I LOVED it. It was the highlight of our trip so far. Only wish we had done it sooner because B gives you some other travel tips and you learn so much about the culture. They picked us up and we started at the morning market for about an hour, then went to the cooking school for the rest of class. B is an amazing instructor and makes you feel like family! We made 4 dishes that all came out delicious. She also showed us how to fold lotus flower and put it in my hair. (Bonus: The cooking class has very nice A/C.)

reviews.name: Anya Sobina
reviews.text: Cooking class at About Be was a wonderful experience. I got lucky and it was just two of us. I really appreciated the market tour and Be explaining Thai ingredients with such passion! Cooking itself was awesome. This was a highlight of my 12 day Thai trip. It is not commercialised but rather intimate and special experience. Different days have different menus, so plenty of options. I loved egg stir fry and a snapper soup we made because the flavour was unique and complex. Pad Thai was also delicious . Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Antonette Etele
reviews.text:
We were collected on time from our hotel as arranged. When we arrived Bee was there to meet us. She took us to the local market and gave us information on the produce being sold there. The market tour was for about 30-45 minutes then went back to the cooking school.
Bee took us through the menu step by step and supported us through the whole process. All the time giving tips and advice. At the end we sat down to an extremely hearty delicious meal.
My partner and I loved the whole class and Bee made it extremely memorable, fun and interesting.
I would 1000% recommend this cooking class🤩🤩🤩

reviews.name: Vanessa Brow
reviews.text:
A wonderful experience from start to finish! The driver was waiting for us when we arrived at the meeting point & Mr S was pleasant & friendly with a well air-conditioned mini van. We picked up our host Be outside the cooking school and carried straight on to the market. Be gave us a tour of the market, stopping to point out different stalls & the different fresh produce. All the stall holders know Be and were really friendly. Be was more than happy to answer any questions we had and took time to explain the different  food on sale and encouraged us to sample a variety of pastes and sweet foods. Next we went to the cookery school which was a lovely, clean & cool building (toilets are immaculate!! Always a good sign!!). We cooked 4 dishes in total. Please inform Be in advance of any dietary requirements...I don't eat fish but on booking didn't have an opportunity to add a note but Be encouraged me to cook using the fish, fish sauce and shrimp paste & to be honest I couldn't taste any fish (although I didn't eat the sea bass in the soup!l) we ate 3 dishes that we cooked then while the dessert was cooking Be gave us some pineapple and told us to eat without salt first, then try after dipping is salt...something we wouldn't think of doing. Then we tried sticky rice cooked in bamboo while Be explained how it was  made and why...we tried it with and without pandan paste, again something we wouldn't have thought about doing.
Be is passionate about what she does, encourages you to try new things and genuinely wants you to get the most of the time with her. I cannot recommend this experience enough, a genuine kind heart with a passion she wants to share. Her team are great & they all work together well helping make the class seamless.

Thank you Be & your team, I hope your business continues to flourish as your dedication and passion deserve it!!

reviews.name: Karen Sponner
reviews.text:
It was a fantastic experience
We created traditional Thai food with our teacher Be , she was very patient and proud of of her heritage
We made chicken pad Thai, as we personally asked for and Be was happy to change . marinade grilled chicken, papaya salad, coconut pudding we were not rushed at all . I will take these amazing recipes back to Australia .. thankyou Be from kaz xxx
Maybe BE stands for brilliant experience 😆

reviews.name: Munisha Savania
reviews.text: I had such a brilliant experience at this Thai cooking class! Be the host was absolutely fantastic, so friendly, knowledgeable and made the whole day fun and relaxed. I’m a strict vegetarian and everything was thoughtfully catered for without any issue. The kitchen was spotless and all the ingredients were fresh and well prepared. The market tour was a real highlight,  it was so interesting learning about Thai culture and local foods. After cooking, we all sat down to eat together which made it even more special. I made some lovely new friends and had such an informative, fun day. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ben Clatworthy
reviews.text: My Viator operator let me down on a cookery course last minute so we booked with Be through our hotel rep. This must have been a good Omen as we had an absolutely fantastic experience with Be from start to finish. We spent some time in the old market tasting some of the local produce whilst Be shared her knowledge. We then experienced a very intimate cookery lesson, where Be was patient, kind and extremely passionate. The food we cooked was so tasty and all the recipes are shared afterwards. This was a gift for my Mum whilst on holiday and Be made the whole experience and unforgettable one. I would highly recommend this experience 6/5 stars!!

reviews.name: Kelly Marsland
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking class! Highly recommend. The food was amazing, Be is so fun, knowledgeable and kind. The market tour was brilliant too. Great activity to do in Phuket. I have done others in bali that had way too many people but this one is a small group. The best Thai food too. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.name: Paul White
reviews.text: Had the best experience with Be and her team. A market tour, cooking class, lots to learn. And the best part was eating the amazing food we cooked. Be was very informative and such a lovely person. Highly recommended. Thanks Be.

reviews.name: Aurélie Rosat
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time with BE. She first showed us the market (which is only open in the morning) and explained to us the different typical ingredients and spices that they use in the Thai cuisine. She was very enthusiastic in sharing her knowledge and the Thai cuisine with us. The cooking part was well prepared and we tasted the different steps of our recipe, which helped us understand what part every ingredient plays. The food was really good and the team reel organised. There was a lot, we were happy that we haven’t had breakfast!
I definitely recommend :)

reviews.name: Lorraine Pearce
reviews.text:
We did a cooking class with a gorgeous lady called Bee.
It was really well done. We made 3 courses and Bee’s instructions were so thorough and clear.
I definitely recommend this cooking class.

Our class started at the market which was so amazing

reviews.name: Clayton Zwanenburg
reviews.text: A delightful experience from start to finish! From the informative and engaging trip around the local market, through the total hands on, guided cooking lessons, to the joyous farewell, spending the day with Be (and her wonderful staff) is an absolute treat. Was so impressed with the delicious dishes we made and the comfortable, relaxed atmosphere created by About Be.  (and totally adaptable - Be personalized the experience where necessary with professionalism and care!) TOTALLY recommend this cooking class, worth every cent paid!

reviews.name: stephanie gellberg
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience this has been! Great visit to the market with taste testing and smelling. Be is great att explaining everything and answering questions!
Back at the cooking station we hade so much fun!! Everything was easy to follow and do delicious 🤤 Highly recommend this experience!!

reviews.name: Tsholofelo Seitlhamo
reviews.text: About Be is all about aunthetic Thai food. Touring the market in the morning was breathtaking. I loved the interior as well the individual cooking stations. The sauces are labeled and they also explained the utensils used.  I was confused on the process of making the dessert but got the hang off it. I'm glad I chose About BE cooking class. It was truly a treary moment seeing the food that I had prepared. Keep up the great, authentic work. Be blessed!

reviews.name: Amy Davis
reviews.text: My partner and I booked this cooking class the day before without knowing too much about what the class entailed. We were picked up promptly by our driver from our hotel then met with Be, the chef who took us to the local market. She sourced some fruit and local dish for us to try then we went to the beautiful cooking studio space. It was super clean, organised and efficient. We made 4 delicious Thai dishes and dessert. It all tasted amazing. Be is super kind and caring and speaks great English. They were very thoughtful and made up our leftover for us to take. We had the most lovely morning on this cooking class and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to others!! Thank you to Be, our driver and the other staff helping us! We are so grateful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much. I'm glad you enjoyed and learned from our cooking class. I look forward to welcoming you all again.

reviews.name: Agnieszka Stephenson
reviews.text: Thank you so much for a great experience with many helpful suggestions the market tour was unexpected where we tried the genuine pastes. The day will be remembered long after the price is forgotten B was very knowledgeable and passed on many tips.

reviews.name: Agnes van der Laan
reviews.text: Amazing lady (Be) who loves sharing her passion for Thai cuisine after showing you the fresh markets . It’s a must do experience for anyone . Thank you Be for teaching me ♥️

title: Supattra Blind Massage
ownerDescription: Supattra Blind Massage, a Traditional Massage by Blind massage therapists. Which has been established since 1997.
address: Sri Poom Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Amphoe Mueang Chiang Mai, Chang Wat Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXVR+MW Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Melati
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at Supattra Blind Massage in Chiang Mai. The staff was incredibly kind, professional, and welcoming from the moment I walked in. You can really feel the care and skill they put into their work. My massage was relaxing, therapeutic, and exactly what I needed.

I also love supporting a business that creates meaningful opportunities for the visually impaired community. If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a genuine, high quality massage experience, I highly recommend this place. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Asha Setzekorn
reviews.text:
Had a massage today at Supatra Nlind Massage in Chiang Mai and it was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had in many, many years in Thailand — definitely in my top three. The pressure was absolutely perfect, the salon was very clean, and my massage therapist was wonderful and very skilled.

I’ve heard they’ve been struggling a bit with the lower number of tourists lately, so they really deserve some support. Highly recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a genuinely excellent massage experience.

reviews.name: Alexandria Smither
reviews.text: Was one of the best experiences my husband and I had in Chiang Mai! Our therapists both had knowledge / strength they knew exactly which points of our bodies needed to be worked on and we feel brand new. We cannot wait to return!

reviews.name: Ron Scozzafava
reviews.text:
Supattra Blind Massage offers a genuinely good acupressure experience. The therapists — who are blind — have an impressive sense of touch and apply just the right pressure on key points. You can feel the tension release gradually, and by the end the muscles are relaxed without feeling beaten up.

Beyond the massage itself, it also feels meaningful to support a place that provides skilled employment and dignity through real craftsmanship. A good cause paired with a very effective treatment — and one I’d happily return to.

reviews.name: Wanderlust Tv
reviews.text: Excellent technique Thai massage from Master Nut. Prices so cheap so I give more. 2 hour massage only 360 baht. Many other students have special skills. Can be painful but relieving

reviews.name: JP P.
reviews.text: For 180 bhat, it was more than worth it ! Definitively the cheapest price in CM i’ve seen. Unfortunately the famous M. Nat wasn’t there (only work on evenings) but my assigned massage therapist was very good ! I recommend.

reviews.name: Anjula Weeranayake
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at SUPATTRA Blind Massage. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm, professional, and genuinely welcoming.
What makes this place truly special is that all the therapists are visually impaired. And honestly, their skill level is beyond impressive. Their sense of touch, precision, and technique felt even more refined than many regular massage places I have visited before. You can clearly tell they are highly trained, experienced, and deeply focused on their craft.
The pressure was perfectly balanced, every movement felt intentional, and the entire session left me feeling relaxed, refreshed, and mentally lighter. It was not just a massage, it was a meaningful experience.
More people should support places like this instead of spending money at random commercial massage parlors. Here, you are not only receiving professional service, you are also supporting talented individuals who truly deserve recognition and appreciation.
Highly recommended. Definitely worth every penny and an experience I would gladly repeat. 🌿

reviews.name: ASTER
reviews.text: The service is a bit cheaper than any other massage you can find in chiangmai. The people are so nice. The acupressure is strong which is my favorite.

reviews.name: Travelling Darryl
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Mr. Nat as a therapist and as a teacher.

I had 2 massages with him, as well I did a 20 hour class to learn his 2.5 hour massage sequence.

All done over a 2-3 hour period per day so the knowledge can settle in my mind and massage fingers.

Mr. Nat is a lovely, kind and patient teacher, who will look after your massage or teaching needs.

reviews.name: J. H
reviews.text:
Wonderful and skilful massage. I already went twice and each time is was with precision and the right amount of pressure.

Please please give more than the usual price as it deserves the regular price rage.

I highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Gary khoo
reviews.text: Absolutely hidden gem in Chiangmai. The staff that works here has vision issue, but due to this they were able to feels every tension/soreness that I had and they are extremely skillful. Mr. Nut was one of the best in there, although it was painful, (bearable pain) I felt relief and my back pain was fixed. While I was visiting Chiangmai, I would come here on daily basis because how comfortable and affordable it is. Especially how costly it would be oversea to see physical therapy. But please  make sure you tips well because they are hardworking people even with disability. I highly recommend this place to anyone who's has muscle/sore on their body. They can fixes you in few sessions. 10 STARS !!

reviews.name: Ellie Freeman
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! My masseuse was an older lady who found all my muscle knots. I used Google translate audio to ask if she could concentrate on my lower back and she did a great job. I actually enjoyed the masseuses talking to each other, it sounds like they are great friends. At the end, the boss came over and cracked my back and neck, which was fantastic! I’m so glad I stumbled across this place.

reviews.name: Zoe Arias-Walker
reviews.text: I went here 4 x while I was in Chiang Mai and had an incredible experience with Po and Nat. For 180 baht these are some of the best massages in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Ria
reviews.text: One of the best massages I had in my life! Definitely high on the pain scale and exactly what I needed. Different method than most massage places, it's not a spa it doesn't have music or closed rooms and there is talking but I don't mind at all!! The people were so kind and so skilled, I loved it I feel so relaxed now it really got deep into the tissue.

reviews.name: C V N
reviews.text:
The place is definitely worth a visit. We were recommended this place from a local tour vendor when we asked for suggestions for an experienced massage parlour (there's just so many parlors to pick from). All the masseuse are blind and they understand minimum English so make your presence known when you step in.
We picked an hour thai massage and it was a good massage. If you want a strong pressure massage, pick the man, the women we had massaged with her elbow (which was ok) while the man was really good. The place was very professional and clean, would come back tonight for another massage.

reviews.name: Flo S
reviews.text:
Want to have a really enjoyable massage? Go there. It was my second experience in thai massage and the best I've ever done. Focused on legs yes, all body is done. Just plan nothing after. Just relax even the next day.
It hurts because it's a thai massage, but made by blind people, you'll know that perception and feeling of blocked points will be cured at a high level.
It's a calm and relax place with kind people. Respect them as they respect you. No expectation, go there and turn a blind eye on this massage.
Thanks Na for this incredible massage.
Will be back

reviews.name: Tereza Faltysová
reviews.text: This was absolutely an amazing massage! I went 3x and would love to go again if I could. It is no fancy beauty saloon but a professional massage studio. The massage is painful but so beneficial. I had three different therapists and all of them vere amazing. They always find the right pressure points and after I felt like melting. Yes, sometimes they talk to one another but I definitely don't find it wrong. The place looks simple but clean. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Natalie Kruse
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here! Unsure how to spell his name, but Ton/Thon/Thun/Tun was so intuitive and gentle, and made my body feel brand new! I have hyper mobile joints so I was nervous about Thai massage, but I felt very comfortable and wish I could go back. Highly recommend :)

reviews.name: ThorKS
reviews.text:
Superb massage, which is very fairly priced to boot! I had the 1 hour Thai massage, and the masseur seemed to feel where tension had built up and applied extra pressure as needed - consequently, I felt very relaxed and eased of tensions afterwards!

Highly recommendable!

reviews.name: D
reviews.text: Amazingly accurate and strong therapeutic massage, feeling very relaxed and less tense. Highly recommend it

A great Thai cooking class should start before you ever reach the stove.

At Phuket Thai Cooking Academy, your experience begins at a local fresh market, where you’ll learn about the herbs, vegetables, curry ingredients, sauces, and spices that make Thai food unique.

Then it’s back to the kitchen to prepare authentic Thai dishes yourself, step by step, with guidance from our instructors.

Whether you are visiting Phuket for a few days or looking for a hands-on Thai cultural experience, our Phuket cooking classes are designed to be practical, relaxed, and most importantly—delicious.

Classes available Monday–Saturday.

Come hungry. You’ll be cooking plenty.

Book your Thai cooking class in Phuket directly with us.

Staying in Patong and looking for an authentic Thai cooking class nearby?

Phuket Thai Cooking Academy is located in Kathu, just a short drive from Patong, making it easy to add a hands-on Thai cooking experience to your Phuket holiday.

Our Thai cooking classes combine practical cooking, traditional Thai flavors, and local ingredients in a relaxed, friendly setting. Depending on your class, you can learn popular Thai dishes such as Pad Thai, Tom Yum Goong, Green Curry, Massaman Curry, Som Tam, Mango Sticky Rice, and more.

For many guests staying in Patong, we also provide convenient transportation, so getting to your cooking class is simple.

Whether you're a complete beginner or already love cooking, you'll leave with new skills, Thai recipes, and a better understanding of the flavors that make Thai cuisine so special.

What Can Families Do in Phuket?

If you're looking for family activities in Phuket or wondering about the best things to do with kids in Phuket, consider trying something everyone can enjoy together.

A Thai cooking class is more than just preparing a meal. It's a fun, hands-on experience where parents and children work side by side, learn about Thai culture, and create memories that last long after the holiday ends.

At Phuket Thai Cooking Academy, families visit a local market, discover fresh Thai ingredients, and then cook authentic Thai dishes together with guidance from our friendly chefs. Our classes are beginner-friendly, and children love getting involved in the cooking process.

We're proud to have been featured by Phuket101 as one of the Best Things to Do with Kids in Phuket, recognizing our cooking classes as a great family-friendly activity on the island.

Whether you're travelling with young children, teenagers, or grandparents, our cooking classes are designed to be fun, interactive, and suitable for all ages. Instead of another day at the beach, enjoy an experience you'll take home with you through new recipes, new skills, and unforgettable family memories.

Looking for one of the best family activities in Phuket? We'd love to welcome your family to our kitchen.

Looking for a unique and hands-on experience in Phuket?

Our Thai Cooking Workshops at Phuket Thai Cooking Academy are designed for travelers and food lovers who want to learn real Thai cooking techniques — not just follow recipes.

Each 3-hour workshop focuses on one important skill such as tofu making, Thai desserts, wok cooking, curry preparation, and ingredient pairing. You will cook, plate, and enjoy 3 different dishes while learning directly from experienced Thai chefs in a small-group setting.

This is a fun and educational experience where you will learn:
• how Thai flavors are balanced
• practical cooking techniques you can actually use at home
• timing, heat control, and authentic ingredient preparation

Perfect for couples, friends, solo travelers, and anyone looking for one of the best cooking workshops in Phuket.

reviews.name: Marion Beer
reviews.text: EXCELLENT!!! Pick up from hotel was on time, market trip was great! Local market  was very clean and all food was so fresh, (only a short comfortable private bus ride from our Patong hotel). Our friendly expert chef guided us through the market & explained everything very well. The market trip was just enough time (about 15 mins) & then another very short bus trip to the cooking academy. The facilities were excellent, clean & air-conditioned. We were given welcome drinks and then we started cooking our personally chosen 4 dishes. Myself, my husband & teenager daughter all chose different dishes to cook. The steps were well explained & our 2 chefs guided us all through the cooking process, all of which were very straightforward (even for the most beginner cook).Hygiene standards were excellent, with clean cooking utensils/fry pans etc used for each dish & frequent hand washing performed. When we finished cooking our dishes we were sat in a dinning area together as a family & enjoyed our food (12 different dishes between the 3 of us!). The food was amazing! We were then transferred back to our hotel when we were ready. We all thoroughly enjoyed our afternoon! Highly recommend! ❤️ 😊

I’ll be sure to share your feedback with our chefs. They’ll appreciate your kind words and knowing you enjoyed the experience.
You are always welcome back anytime. We would love to see you again.

reviews.name: Lauren Clowes
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at this cooking class! The experience began with a visit to a local market, where our instructor explained the origins of the ingredients and their importance in Thai cooking. After the market tour, we headed to the studio, where the class continued in a fun and welcoming atmosphere.

Our instructor was fantastic! Patient, knowledgeable, and great at explaining each step of the cooking process. One of the highlights was learning how to make fresh curry paste from scratch, with a full demonstration for the entire class.

What really makes this class stand out is the flexibility to choose your own dishes. Unlike many other classes in the area that have a fixed menu, we were each able to select four dishes we wanted to make. My husband and I chose completely different dishes, which made it even more fun because we got to sample a variety of everything at the end.

As a bonus, we were sent all of the recipes afterward so we can recreate the dishes at home. I highly recommend this class to anyone looking for a fun, interactive, and memorable activity while visiting Phuket!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Lauren, for taking the time to leave such a wonderful review.
It was a pleasure having you and your husband join us. The team really enjoyed you both. I'm really happy to hear that you enjoyed the market tour and the cooking class. Understanding the ingredients and where they come from is an important part of learning Thai cooking, so it's great to hear that stood out to you.
I'm glad you enjoyed the flexibility of choosing your own dishes. We know everyone has different tastes, and being able to create a personalized menu rather than a fixed menu is something that makes the experience more enjoyable. We feel each guests should have the chance to try a wide variety of Thai food and choose what they want to eat.
Thank you again for joining us and for recommending Phuket Thai Cooking Academy to future visitors. We hope you'll have fun recreating the recipes at home, and if you find yourselves back in Phuket, we'd love to welcome you back anytime.

She took the time to explain all the ingredients commonly used in Thai cuisine, and we learnt how to prepare authentic dishes that tasted even better than many restaurants we’ve tried. Her instructions were clear and easy to follow, and the food portions were extremely generous.

The location was very easy to find, only around 15 minutes from our hotel with a smooth, safe drive through a lovely neighbourhood. The class was well organised, and everyone had their own cooking station, which meant we could adjust spice levels and cater to allergies. The kitchen was air-conditioned, very clean, and Chef Joyce even provided gloves and bottled water.

It was an unforgettable experience — not only delicious but also educational. I walked away with priceless knowledge, and the recipes were surprisingly easy to recreate, so I can’t wait to make them at home.

A must-do experience if you love Thai food or want to learn to cook it properly. Thank you, Chef Joyce, for such a memorable day!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Your feedback means a lot to our team, and we’re so happy that you found the recipes easy to recreate and the experience both educational and memorable.

Thank you again for recommending our authentic Thai cooking class. We hope to welcome you back the next time you visit Bangkok for another wonderful culinary experience!

Warm regards,
Mahanakorn Thai Cooking Class team,
Authentic | Hands-on | Unforgettable Thai Cooking Experience in Bangkok

reviews.name: Suchada Napathorn
reviews.text: We enjoyed cooking class so much. Khun Joyc is very kind, friendly, and professional. All 4 dishes are delicious.

I would highly recommend this activity, and please come hungry—you will cook and eat a lot!

reviews.text: Do you a favor, join the class of Joyce because she is the best teacher in town. The place is so authentic and you will eat literally like in a restaurant. And the best is that you made that delicious dishes! You will have also a lot of pictures and gifts after your experience. The atmosphere is so familiar and warm. Joyce and her husband are doing a great job, they put attention in every detail. All clean and perfect. You will feel cuddled and… full! ❤️

reviews.name: Tilly Daley
reviews.text: The most amazing cooking class! Definitely need to add this to your to do list when you visit Bangkok. The food and service was exceptional. 100% recommend! So fun and the can’t wait to try this recipes at home!!

title: Plu Massage (พลู นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ)
address: Suan Phlu 1 Alley, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand
plusCode: PGCQ+52 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Ike
reviews.text:
Don't let the location or the entrance fool you! This place is tucked away off the main street, and while the wooden stairs leading up to the second floor are quite narrow and a bit creaky, the experience inside is world-class.
I had a 2-hour Thai massage with Lim, and it was hands down the best massage of my entire trip. Lim is incredibly skilled—I was so relaxed that I actually fell asleep halfway through. If you are looking for an authentic, high-quality massage rather than a fancy storefront, this is the place. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Laverne Kosasih
reviews.text:
foot massage was great at an affordable price, friendly owner, will definitely be back :)

jaemaigaiga chicken rice shop is right next to this massage place, solid food to checkout as well!

reviews.name: Belle
reviews.text:
One of the best massages I had in Thailand were here at Plu Massage. I went twice and would have come back every night we were in Thailand if there wasnt a long waitlist almost every night. I advise you to call beforehand and secure a reservation.

The place is small and the rooms are narrow but they have amazing masseuses. I had different masseuse and both knew what they were doing. They would spend a little extra time massaging tender muscles and would come back later to check on the area. There's stretching involved and I usually get uncomfortable so I ask to skip it but I gave it a go here and it was life changing. I felt lighter after my first massage and I made sure to book my next one before I fly out of BKK.

The nice lady receptionist gave me an elephant plush keychain as a gift. Highly recommended hole-in-the-wall spot but totally worth it.

reviews.name: T J
reviews.text: Paid for 90 min Thai massage. She finished 10+ mins early and spent the last 30 mins just playing around with my hair / face - probably the most disappointing massage I had in Thailand. Go elsewhere.

reviews.name: Tim Cooper
reviews.text: The massage itself was average, but the masseuse seemed more focused on asking personal questions rather than concentrating on the treatment, which made it uncomfortable. Not really a relaxing experience. Also, the stairs going upstairs are quite steep and feel a bit dangerous to climb. Overall not recommended.

reviews.name: Cathrine Hansen
reviews.text: One of the best massages ever! My boyfriend’s shoulder issues basically got cured with a 30 minutes shoulder massage. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Dave
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to Thailand nearly 20 years, I like it when you receive proper service, and P bor certainly lived up to that. I only had time for a 1 hour Thai massage, but that was enough, she really worked through the entire body, and I walked out feeling sore but new.

As others have mentioned don’t let the shop put you off, I always look for the shops off the main road as I usually find them better and cheaper, tucked around a corner this shop is not one to miss.

reviews.name: Aleesha Chib
reviews.text:
Perfect amount of pressure and good techniques used. I loved my 90 minute foot massage session. Staff are very honest, I left a tip on the chair under the pillow, and she thought it was mistake and tried to return the money to me. Nice to see staff with morals, I told her it’s a tip for you 😌
On side note we had to ask for towel to be laid on chair since leather was worn it was irritating our legs, but they were more than happy to accommodate this request.
Be cautioned they use a large amount of tiger balm at the beginning of the massage so don’t be alarmed when you feel the tingling heat sensation. Thanks for great massage I’m sure we will return now we know where to find you down the alley.

reviews.name: Roos Helmink
reviews.text: Great Thai massage! The staff really knew what they were doing, and knew where to find the stiff spots immediately to relieve them.

reviews.name: Vanessa Botes
reviews.text: Just the right pressure! Really good massage didn’t want it to end.

reviews.name: Leo LSF
reviews.text: OMG, best massage hands down. I have had shoulder pain for a while. The lady there was able to pin point my pain point right away, and after a few hard press, she opened up my muscle strings, and started untangling the twisted strings from my shoulder all the way down to my fingers, it was magic. I feel much better after the 1-hour shoulder massage, and she identified all the strings that are causing my shoulder pain.  The lady is a true pro.

reviews.name: Fiona
reviews.text: A really lovely massage and experience that I would highly reccomend.  I got the 1 hr oil massage and was very happy with it. They have created a lovely atmosphere in the shop, withsoothing music and running water sounds. You have a private room for your massage and the masseuse' are very professional. I think strength or a massage is subjective but it was perfect for me and she checked in with me early on in the massage to make sure I was happy with it. I would definitely recommend Plu massage and will visit again myself

reviews.name: Nadine Wood
reviews.text: As a couple we had the Leg and foot massage, after a day of travel this was the best thing we could have done! The massage technique is firm and releases all tension in the legs and feet. They even reset you shoulders and back at the end. The staff are friendly and accommodating, the set up is very clean. The price at 300 Bhat for 1 hours is very, very good! We would highly recommend.

reviews.name: chinh nguyen
reviews.text: Excellent massage. I went twice and each time I have different lady but both are very good. First they give you a loose top and a loose long short to change. This is much better than being naked with only underwear and they throw a towel on you like other massage places. Both ladies give very strong massage as I like it. They use their thumbs, their palms, their elbows and knees. They work on every part of your body. Money well spent for one hour. Strongly recommend and make a reservation since this place is busy.

reviews.name: Adam Fox
reviews.text: Wow, glad I read the reviews while looking for a massage place near my apartment. So many in Bangkok it’s hard to distinguish, but that massage was fantastic. I feel great, will definitely go back. Lots of TLC :)

reviews.name: Hazem Essam
reviews.text: The massage was very good. I asked for 1 hour and they did 2 hours, maybe because they don’t speak English. But it was too stressful as I had a plane to catch and missed an hour of my planning!

reviews.name: Calvin Bui
reviews.text: Plu Massage (พลู นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ) in Bangkok offers an exceptional wellness experience that combines traditional Thai massage techniques with a serene and welcoming atmosphere. The skilled therapists are attentive to individual needs, ensuring each session is both relaxing and therapeutic. The facility is impeccably clean and thoughtfully designed, providing a tranquil environment that enhances the overall experience. Whether you’re seeking relief from muscle tension or simply a moment of relaxation, Plu Massage delivers outstanding service that leaves you feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

reviews.name: A Wee
reviews.text:
It's kinda hard to rate because styles of massage are subjective at best.  But to put it into perspective, I enjoy the tuina, acupressure type of massage over the spa type of rub-over massage. Which is what I would describe massage here to be,  at least based on the masseuse I had.  What's nice was the slightly hot oil used for massage which I love.  But I had enough of the rub over massage after 5 min.  What I needed was a firm acupressure point massage to soothe my hard knots away.  Sadly it didn't happen.

What was a little disturbing was that the masseuse had a cold n at some points coughed or wiped herself and continued massaging , without a mask.  I think it shd be mandatory to wear a mask if you are going to be talking to your client and coughing or sneezing, especially in an enclosed space for 90 min!

That said, she had a truly pleasant demeanor, which I give her extra star for. Thought hard about whether to post this but just be aware that expectations could be different even when you read reviews.

reviews.name: Julie K.
reviews.text: The Spa is very cosy with good service attitude from the reception. My massage therapist was very good with her massage technique. she has amazing skill strength and is apt at applying the right pressure to suit my needs. Whether is it after a tiring day in the office or coming from the gym, she always manage to ease all the tensions from my back and shoulders. Very friendly and a pleasure to chat with too. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Miriam 1234
reviews.text: Thank you so much Nus, for that amazing 2 hour thai massage, it was the best i've ever had! It was with good pressure and alot of attention.  Nus found really all weak spots in the muscles and took good care to get rid of them ;). I can highly recommend it!

title: Let's Relax Spa - Mahanakhon CUBE
address: 4th Floor, Mahanakhon Cube, 96 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
street: 4th Floor, Mahanakhon Cube, 96 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd
plusCode: PGFH+HF Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Kurenai
reviews.text:
Exceptional professionalism and genuinely friendly staff! Even though I didn't get a massage today, the staff showed amazing hospitality from start to finish.

Reservation management is top-notch, and the entire team speaks fluent English, so there was no language barrier at all. For a full-body massage, Let's Relax Spa offers far better quality, control, and technique than small neighborhood parlors. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Giang Tran
reviews.text:
This place was such a wonderful find! We were looking for a spa experience nearby, and it ended up exceeding all expectations.

The service here is excellent and foreigner-friendly. Everyone on the team is soft-spoken, polite, and attentive from start to finish. Most importantly, the therapists have fantastic technique—they knew exactly how to target and release all the deep muscle tension and pain points.

Left feeling completely refreshed and relaxed. Highly recommend if you're in the area and need a quality massage!

reviews.name: Victoria Kuprina
reviews.text:
I am a regular customer of Let’s Relax and I go for a massage every week, so I know the service standards of this brand well and can compare different branches.

Another important point: at this branch, I was not given the tablet/form to select the massage areas, pressure level, and personal preferences before the treatment, even though this is normally done in other Let’s Relax branches. This is a basic part of the service

Unfortunately, the branch opposite Mahanakhon consistently leaves the worst impression. Perhaps because of its tourist location, this branch relies on a flow of one-time customers who visit once and never come back. But for a regular customer, it looks like a complete lack of quality control, service standards, and proper attitude toward guests.

My last visit was especially unpleasant. The therapist, Phanni Rueangsak, was rough, abrupt, and completely inattentive. All her movements felt like she simply wanted to finish as quickly as possible. Her attitude felt tense and irritated, as if the whole process annoyed her. There was no sense of care, calmness, or hospitality — only rough movements and the feeling that she wanted to finish as quickly as possible.

I left the salon in tears, did not even stay for the tea, with my mood completely ruined and with the feeling that I was not treated as a guest, but simply “processed” as another customer.

I also want to emphasize that this does not feel like a one-time mistake by one therapist. This particular branch has repeatedly given me the impression that Let’s Relax standards are not being controlled here. I have had much more professional and pleasant experiences in other branches, so the problem is clearly with this location.

I strongly do not recommend booking with this therapist, Phanni Rueangsak. And I also do not recommend this particular Let’s Relax branch.

reviews.name: Aiswarya Babu
reviews.text: The Body & Soul session at Let’s Relax aligned my body with my soul-deeply calming and grounding.   I really appreciate the care and technique by Preya( Masseuse- correct me the name if heard wrong) definitely come back for this!

reviews.name: Connie
reviews.text: Been to this same branch 4-5 times over past two years , always good standard and value for money. Polite staff even during peak periods, they are also patient in understanding my requests. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: NNchan
reviews.text: A spa with excellent service and multiple branches across Bangkok. Having visited several locations, I particularly love the atmosphere of this branch. The location in Mahanakhon Cube offers a scenic view of the Mahanakhon Building. The space is spacious, with a well-separated lobby and a snack room for relaxation after the massage. The massage quality is up to standard. However, one downside is that when the staff cleaned my feet, the water was too hot. Other branches usually use warm water, but this branch poured hot water directly, which was uncomfortable. Aside from that, it’s a great spa experience.

reviews.name: Tan.W
reviews.text:
We decided to try their Dream Package after always experiencing their aroma oil therapy. This package includes a 45-minute Foot Massage, a 15-minute Hand Massage, and a 30-minute Back & Shoulder Massage. While you can opt for these treatments separately, the Dream Package at ฿950 per person is ฿125 cheaper than getting the 3 treatments a la carte.

This was our first visit to their Mahanakhon Square outlet. The view from where we had our therapy was nice, although the air conditioning seemed weak or malfunctioning. I felt quite warm during the session, but the masseur brought in an air cooler to help.

Their service is truly top-notch. Even during the foot washing before the treatment, they were gentle and slipped the slippers back onto your feet. I appreciate this attention to detail compared to other massage chains that just shuffle your feet aside after drying them.

During my foot massage, the masseur noticed some thick skin on my toe and kindly filed it away for me. This added value was a pleasant surprise.

For the Back and Shoulder Massage, we switched to the monkey chair instead of staying in the same chair. It was a good change, especially with the therapy ending with warm wipes and a peppermint spray.

Similar to the Aroma Oil massage, you also receive their signature jasmine tea and mango sticky rice after the treatment.

reviews.name: Ratchana Numnaphol
reviews.text: I booked dream package from Klook but can't use right away by the same day. Once I called the shop to make a reservation there was a staff booking by phone for me. The massure staffs were great and profession. Lastly, there were complimentary mango and sticky rice serving as well. I will definitely book this package again with Let's relax!

reviews.name: Philip Chen
reviews.text: Went for 90min Thai massage + herbal priced 1200B. Brilliant masseur, nice facilities and services. They put the aroma spray on our palms as a mint refresher, which was a cherry on the cake. Bought a couple of the spray as well, with a discount applied to them. Loved the signature mango sticky rice as a happy ending😆

reviews.name: Mei L.
reviews.text: Been here 3 times now, as the spa is wonderful. Clean, perfect massages and the mango sticky rice afterwards is a plus. Make sure to book in advance.

reviews.name: Charlotte Fong
reviews.text:
Located in the Cube mall - take the lift/escalators. Quiet place with SUPER clean toilets.
Comfortable experience.
90min traditional Thai massage for 1000THB.
The staff take you to an area to wash your feet before showing you to your private room to change into Thai pyjamas for the massage. Complimentary mango stick rice pudding after.

reviews.name: Mikee Novio
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible massage!. One of the best massages I’ve ever had — 10/10, highly recommend!💗🫶🏼

reviews.name: DC
reviews.text: Excellent massage as usual.  Has been using let’s relex massage for quite some time now and they always delivered.  The therapists are pleasant and  professional.  Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Kochin Fan
reviews.text:
Got the 4 hands massage, it was sooo good!! Everything is perfect
If you are staying at the standard you could show them your room key and get 10% off :)

reviews.name: Kristal Chow
reviews.text: I've been here many times, and each experience has been consistently wonderful. The service is exceptional, and the massages are nothing short of amazing!

reviews.name: Nuch Suppanuch
reviews.text: New store located in the center of Sathorn CBD. Reception and view are great. Not so many people around. The massagers could have done better. We love their mango sticky rice desserts after the massage.

reviews.name: Kung Food
reviews.text:
Great massages!!
Please be noted that LTES RELAX won’t do any refund for person being late, even we don’t receive the prior notice by phones from receptionists.

reviews.name: Ming Eats
reviews.text: Had one and half hour excellent foot massage in such a cosy and quiet place.  Looks like this is a much more upscale branch than those in the tourist area.

reviews.name: Seraphina Yan
reviews.text: Came twice for aroma oil massage 90 minutes and both times were amazing. I felt completely relaxed after that. They also give you mango sticky rice after. :)

reviews.name: Yensama Yen
reviews.text:
EDIT: I revisited a few months later. And this time it was better. I made sure to not get that guy and things were already much better. The front lady was different too, nicer. I have changed the stars. I will revisit again to see if things change.

I saw such high review so I came to try, it was not good. I was in pain that I needed another massage.
And the guy's service mind was horrible. It's like he had a bad day and just dump it on me

title: LeSpa by Stay
ownerDescription:
A tranquil sanctuary in the heart of Rawai, Phuket, offering guests an elegant environment and luxurious organic treatments. This tranquil sanctuary inspires relaxation, offers respite and creates unforgettable experiences.
The 900-square meters of LeSpa by Stay offers its suite of distinctive treatments in 17 treatment rooms, tastefully adorned in subtle sophistication. Guests will reawaken their senses with the gentle touch and exceptional attention provided by highly trained therapists, along with the use of PAÑPURI and PHYTOMER skincare products and treatments.
address: 56/80, Soi Suksan 2, Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83130, Thailand
plusCode: R86J+43 Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Astrid Demeulenaere
reviews.text: What a wonderful place to get a massage! I booked a hot stone massage and a coconut hair mask. Before the session starts, you fill out a form to specify which areas need extra attention or should be avoided completely. My masseuse (Pony) was incredibly friendly and kind. She checked in at just the right moments to make sure everything was perfect, without ruining the relaxing atmosphere. It was the perfect escape to unwind and recharge!

reviews.name: SLam
reviews.text:
I went twice in 4 days after fishing and Muay Thai, can’t describe the relief that the complimentary onsen and the massages gave me!! I love the place, it is a bit tucked away, but so serene, clean and the most comfortable massage beds I’ve ever had. First day was 60m Asian blend massage and 60m purifying facial with therapist Yaya and second time 60m aroma massage with Nus. My eyes kept for joy when Yaya applied the cold eye cream and I walked out radiant even with being slightly sunburnt.
I think the price is reasonable for what you get - disclaimer, I’ve not tried anywhere else in the area, but why would I go anywhere else if they remain consistently good. Hope they will not disappoint in my next visit 🙏🏽

reviews.name: Carissa Davis
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I honestly can’t recommend Vivian highly enough! This was hands down one of the best spa experiences I’ve ever had. Her massage was pure magic—I walked in carrying so much tension and stress, and walked out feeling lighter, calmer, and better than I have in a very long time. She has an incredible gift for knowing exactly what your body needs.

The facial was equally outstanding. My skin is absolutely glowing! It feels hydrated, smooth, firm, and so refreshed. I genuinely couldn’t stop looking at my skin afterwards.

What makes Vivian truly exceptional is the level of care and attention she gives. She’s warm, professional, incredibly skilled, and made me feel completely relaxed from the moment I arrived.

If you’re thinking about booking with Vivian, do it. You won’t regret it. She is absolutely amazing, and I’ll be recommending her to everyone I know. I can’t wait for my next visit!

reviews.name: BLS
reviews.text: Luxurious spa experience. We visited here for a birthday celebration. We booked two 90 minute Thai massages with access to the spa. I recommend asking for Ming or Vivian. They are expertly trained in Thai massage paired with an unexplainable intuition to find the muscles that need the most attention. The extended spa included the steam room, sauna, ice room, cold plunge, onsen, jet plunge and showers. We spent time here and left walking on clouds. We also enjoyed fresh coconuts at the pool restaurant while waiting for our ride. Overall a nice experience.

reviews.name: Nesrin Erdem
reviews.text: Had the best thai massage ever with Aoy. Almost fell asleep and woke up super fresh and well rested. The tea after the massage made everything perfect. I had a small pain in my left finger when i cam there but after the massage it was gone 🤍✨ i will come again!

reviews.name: Erin MacDonald
reviews.text: The spa was wonderful and had a very relaxing atmosphere. The Onsen area was quiet and peaceful. The salt float pod was clean. The massage treatment room was well appointed and calming. I highly recommend booking a day of self-care here.

reviews.name: Anna Fongaro
reviews.text: The spa is nice, with indoor pools, steam room and sauna. The atmosphere is pleasant, but in my opinion the price is quite high for what you get. A big downside: there were a lot of mosquitoes inside and I got bitten almost everywhere, which really affected the overall experience

reviews.name: Okan Acan
reviews.text: Used their recovery room and massage. Recovery room included sauna, steam room, ice wall, cold plunge, hydration pool and hot pool. Used all facilities had great experience. Equally massage was very good, therapist was expert and helped recovery of my sport injury

reviews.name: Mark Phillips
reviews.text:
We have been here several times as this is our favorite place for massages. It is probably the best Thai massage we have ever experienced. They also do so many different types of massages and therapies. Even if you don’t stay at Stay Wellness Resort, you can use the spa. We have done this on several occasions. I couldn’t really take any photos since it is a spa. But I did add a few of the room in which they serve you tea and refreshments afterwards.

Vivian did an excellent job today and she was very kind, professional and friendly. She made sure I was comfortable and was very helpful. Thank you Vivian.

Orn did an excellent Thai massage and we were very impressed by her abilities. She was very professional and also made sure we were comfortable. Thank you Orn.

On our second day here, we went back for another massage. Chell and Miw did a perfect amount of pressure and work the areas perfectly. This was probably my favorite massage so far. Thank you Chell and Miw.

Our third day we tried different massages with Miw and Beer. It was very nice and professional. We really appreciate Miw and Beer as they were very nice.

Our fourth day was the best one of all week. This time Nus and Ae were our therapists. They did the best job of all week and we were extremely impressed by their skill level and abilities. Excellent.

reviews.name: Margareet Sciascia
reviews.text:
My favourite Spa in Phuket.

Nee and Mook at LeSpa are exceptional therapists. Their massages are truly rejuvenating - they have a way of melting away stress and leaving you feeling refreshed and cared for.

Both have remarkably skilled hands and a deep understanding of their craft, which shows in every session. Mook brings a calming presence, while Nee's approach is nurturing and supportive. Their attention to detail and intuitive touch make each experience special.

If you're looking for a high-quality massage that'll leave you feeling revitalised, I highly recommend Nee and Mook. They're a great asset to LeSpa.

Make sure to start or finish your therapy with an AMAZING onsen they have.. pure bliss!

Reception staff are always so beautiful, warm and welcoming and give a professional service.

The whole atmosphere is clean, ambient, calm and so healing.

Thank you!
Looking forward to return again 😊🙏

reviews.name: Yuwarin Treenara
reviews.text: I had a wonderful spa experience. The greeting was warm, and the ambiance was calm, clean, and relaxing. I had a 60-minute aroma massage, and the therapist “Beer” did an excellent job. The pressure was just right, and she really knew how to target the right points. I felt completely relaxed afterward. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality spa experience.

reviews.name: Dave Cheok
reviews.text: Came for an onsen experience and was  impressed. The facility offers 7 different zones, including a sauna, steam room, ice room, jacuzzi, two different type of hot pools, and a cold plunge. Shower amenities were excellent. Arrived tired and sore post-workout, left feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated.

reviews.name: Ayeshia’s Little Finds
reviews.text: One of the best spa place in Phuket! They offer a wide ranges of rooms to go from ice room, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, milk bath, cold plunge. All the amenities are clean and amazing. Loving the vibe here and would definitely come back anytime soon!

reviews.name: Skrr Skrr
reviews.text:

My fiancé and I had such a rejuvenating massage today at LeSpa. The whole experience was so lovely and relaxing!

Our therapists Orn and Miw were both amazing!

reviews.name: nika1odeon
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere and scenery 🤍
They have hot mineral pools, a cold pool, and a normal water pool with a jacuzzi. They have a dry sauna and steam sauna. Basically, everything you need for relaxation 😌

But I also want to pay attention to the details, the interior design is great. They have good changing rooms with lockets and toiletries, including a hairdryer. All the shampoos, hair conditioners and shower gels are very good quality, don't need to bring your own.
They provide you with a nice tray that includes a robe, towel, and even a small plastic bag (which you can use to store your wet swimwear after)

reviews.name: Daniel Bent (DB)
reviews.text: Yaya is an exceptional massage therapist who clearly has a deep understanding of the body and its pressure points. She intuitively knows exactly where to focus, applying the perfect level of pressure to release tension and work through stubborn knots. What really sets her apart is the care and attention she puts into the session—she doesn’t rush and makes sure every tight area is properly treated. I left feeling noticeably more relaxed, refreshed, and physically restored. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a genuinely skilled and attentive therapist.

reviews.name: Elise
reviews.text: I had an absolutely fantastic experience at LeSpa by Stay! Over the course of my stay, I indulged in multiple treatments, including nearly all the massage options and a body scrub—and every single one was outstanding. Each session left me feeling completely relaxed, with all my aches and tension melting away. I also love the thoughtful touch of finishing every treatment with a soothing green tea and a little treat. The attention to detail and level of care here are truly exceptional. I can’t wait to return for another rejuvenating experience!

reviews.text:
Highly recommended in all aspects, high quality of ingredients, price, service.  We came here 3 days in a row in January.
I and my husband from Europe ate here first meal near our accommodation. Feel very lucky to choose here because Tom Yam Koong is the best, tasty as authentic Thai food as I am Thai, they are big prawn not small ones. Fried squid is quite good surprisingly as they are crispy without too much flour. The price here is much more reasonable than most places nearby especially ones on main street.  First meal with 5 dishes and 2 smoothies costed 18 Euro for 2 persons.
Tom Yam Koong is a bigger pot while my photo is sharing portion.

reviews.text: We are here twice during our stay in Thailand. The food was good. Emilie enjoyed the Khao Soi which she could order with less spice. I enjoyed everything else.

reviews.text:

Not on photos but ordered calamari and chicken wings the best!

reviews.name: noel medina
reviews.text:
The Chef by Chef Tai in Chiang Mai is a convenient spot for flavorful Thai dishes with a modern twist. I had the seafood fried rice — perfectly balanced and packed with fresh flavors.

Located near several temples, it’s an easy and satisfying stop for a quick meal before a temple run. Worth it for the quality and taste.

reviewContext.Seating type: Indoor dining area, Outdoor patio / terrace

reviews.name: Devin Grayman
reviews.text: We had a wonderful lunch at The Chef, where the food, service, and ambiance exceeded our expectations. We ordered Thai tea, butterfly pea lemonade, fried noodles with seafood and broccoli, and fried noodles with pork and broccoli. The flavors were vibrant, with the noodles perfectly cooked and the seafood fresh. The staff was friendly and efficient, ensuring we didn't have to wait long for our meal. The restaurant was clean and had a welcoming atmosphere, making it an enjoyable place to dine. Best of all, the entire lunch for two came to only $10—a great value for the quality and experience.

reviews.name: Kimberly Quesenberry
reviews.text: Had a delightful experience here for dinner. We were seated right away with the option of inside or outside. The air conditioner felt so nice we decided to sit inside. Service was prompt, communication was easy and food was simply delicious. The plants around the entry are so well cared for (you can tell) and the lighting would make for a great experience outdoors as well. We found the prices very affordable and I put a picture of the menu below. I can recommend chicken pad Thai, mixed salad with a yummy sesame/peanut dressing and I had an iced cocoa to drink. I ate every bite cause it was so dang good. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this stop for your next meal out.

reviews.name: YJ H
reviews.text:
Not to be confused with the lower rated "Chef Tao’s Thai Cuisine" despite proximity.

The Chief is a busy restaurant with good food. I highly recommend the crab curry (there is a version which they debone for you), and the fry rice was the best I've had in Chiang Mai so far. Their fry chicken is also quite juicy and crisp. Would return. There is also a temple close by for a cool afternoon walk nearby.

reviews.name: Freya Sinclair
reviews.text: The waiter was top tier, so kind. The atmosphere is so chill, clean and lovely. I ordered the Padang and it definitely wasn’t a favorite of mine. The cheaper street places do better Padang but this place is definitely perfect for a chill out and maybe a coffee.

deliciously delicious and again delicious.
perfectly balanced, a good balance in preparation, professionally competent. No ingredients stand out. The dishes are pretty and presented on beautiful plates.
There is a chef at the stove here.

100 points and a well-deserved 5 stars.

reviews.text: Food was delicious. Ask for Tom yum without cream or coconut milk. Oh boy! It was off the charts. Crab fresh rice is tasty and lots of crab meat. Mango with sticky rice is excellent. reviews.name: Gatsby大作手
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely terrible experience at this place. Just arriving here was awful due to the abysmal service from both the cashier and the order taker.

I arrived at 5:30 PM and there were plenty of empty tables. There was a four-person table outside that wasn’t even reserved, but they told me to sit inside. Then they had the nerve to ask if I would move to a small side table later if a group of four showed up.

With this kind of pathetic service and attitude, there is no way they are ever going to fill those seats. Honestly, I hope this garbage restaurant goes out of business soon. 😡

It was very clear that there is serious racial discrimination here — they treat everyone except Thai customers differently.

reviews.name: Kai Sweet
reviews.text:
An absolute hidden gem and one of the most relaxing experiences I’ve had in a long time!

The Setup: Found this spot via Google Maps while staying at the Chillax Resort—it’s practically right outside the front. Came here last night for a 30-min foot massage treat (180 Baht each) and had to come back today for the full 2-hour Thai massage (600 Baht). Total spent was around 780 Baht (~£17) total.

What stood out:

✅ The Service: All of the staff are so attentive and nice, offering a truly hospitable and authentic service. They are incredibly skilled and really want you to enjoy and experience their talent.

🔥 The Experience: An unbelievable find. It was a proper, in-depth professional massage that wasn't rushed at all—you truly get the full 2 hours. It's so unassuming and authentic, literally feeling like you're walking straight into their front room where it is warm, inviting, and safe.

🙌 The Value: 10/10 - The value here is absolutely ridiculous! Getting that level of top-tier professional care and a dedicated 2-hour service for 600 Baht is completely unmatched.

The Verdict: Highly recommend to anyone who is looking for a genuinely authentic, top-tier massage experience in the area!

I had an hour long oil massage and it was very relaxing. The lovely lady that massaged me made me feel relaxed and I was offered cold water.

But please to all my fellow tourists: Show some common courtesy for the work these ladies do! Be quiet, respectful and don’t be obnoxiously loud or rude.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊😊

reviews.name: Julia Maas
reviews.text: Don’t go there for your nails!! I went there today but really regret it. They told me to do gel, but I got shellac. The girl was very nice and took her time. Bur when she was ready, I already saw some cracks. And even the same day some nails damaged.. really not happy with it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry, we're ready to fix it if you return.

reviews.name: Bronnie K
reviews.text: Simply lovely staff, wonderful massages (I had four in total over 4 days! Greedy!). I highly recommend. Thank you for making my stay in Bangkok very special.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊😊😊

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.text: Trust the reviews it was incredible!:) I had a 1 hour head shoulder & back massage (which felt like 2 hours!). Fantastic technique & lovely staff. I paid 350 baht & would do again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊😊

reviews.name: Gaz Jones
reviews.text: These amazing ladies cured my 15 year back  pain.  I couldn't tie my own shoes put socks on or do the simplest of day to day things by myself.  I honestly can't thank you enough 🙏. But I know we're to come next time I need fixing..   thank you once again. ..!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks 🙏

title: Nimman House massage
subTitle: Nimman House Thai Massage
ownerDescription: Thai massage
address: 59, 10 Nimmanahaeminda Road, Suthep, เมือง Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXW8+2C Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Chris M
reviews.text:
Out of the 12 massages I had in my trip to Thailand, this was the best by far.

Great service, there is care taken as you arrive and throughout the massage. You feel you are getting a luxury, authentic experience, and the massage I got from May was incredible. She checked to see if the pressure was right at a couple of points in the massage, and did real work on my muscles, being comprehensive, responding to my body, and finding the points that needed release. She is incredibly skilled. I felt lucky to get this massage for a very reasonable price.

Thank you Nimman House and thank you May!

reviews.name: thmsbrnt123
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I walked in without a reservation and were lucky enough to get a 2 hr massage including a foot massage. It was clean, quiet and comfortable and the massage was very thorough, therapeutic and truly amazing. Our massage therapists were both great and they were extremely attentive and good at their jobs. We had a wonderful experience and it was half the price of some other places we've visited. Would highly recommend. We'll be going back.

reviews.name: Clare Lyons
reviews.text:
High quality massage :)
I've lived in Thailand for almost 20 years and these guys are the best I've ever come across. The masseurs are very skilled. They understand anatomy and are genuinely interested in what they're doing and how you respond.
The set-up is simple, the atmosphere usually calm and quiet.  Rates are very reasonable, starting from 350 baht an hour.
I have been to much swankier massage establishments in Chiang Mai in the past, but the quality of the massage is very hit-and-miss. Many masseurs try the job as a way of making money but don't always take it seriously or last very long.
You have to book in advance but they are usually very responsive.
If you want a top-quality massage, I HIGHLY recommend them!

reviews.name: SauLin See
reviews.text: This was my second time visiting Nimman House Thai Massage, and it was just as wonderful as the first. I booked a Thai relaxing massage and was paired with May. As many other reviewers have noted, she truly knows her stuff! She found all my tension and left me feeling completely refreshed. Chiang Mai is already such a lovely, highly livable city, but having a top-tier spot like Nimman House here makes it even better. Highly recommend​!

reviews.name: Jimmy Cheung
reviews.text:
Oil massage was great, with gentle hands and dedicated skills
Dim lighting gives a calm and relaxing vibe.

Affordable price and really up to value
Boutique massage house, with garden style

reviews.name: Desreal Shorts
reviews.text: So for Christmas I was gifted a spa package. I did the body scrub, followed by a oil massage and then a facial. OMG I FEEL SOOOO GOOD! And my skin looks AMAZING!!! And thr best part, it was soooo affordable, like ima come back next week again for the same package affordable amd maybe try out something new while im at it!

reviews.name: Jane
reviews.text: Perfect little place in the middle of busy Nimman. Has plenty of parking space, either motorbike or car. Fair price for a private room massage, most places only do curtains, so this place feels more private. Very good masseuses, some speak a little bit of English. Not talkative which I prefer when you are trying to get away from your noisy life. Had a relaxing time every time I go there.

reviews.name: Michael
reviews.text: Great massage. No fancy stuff, just solid technique that really works. I walked out feeling reborn. The staff were nice, kind, and cheerful, and the place was clean and relaxing. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: simonhz
reviews.text: Great massage. My body was aching after intense Muay Thai training. I had a two hour Thai massage with oil. After that I was ready again to train again. The rooms are High standard and the staff is kind and professional. The prices are hugger than average but when so going here is highly recommendable. I will definitely go again when I return to Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Guillaume Robier
reviews.text:
🌿✨ Nimman House – A hidden oasis in Chiang Mai where relaxation meets perfection. From the moment you step in, with a charming little fountain at the entrance, you feel like you've entered the jungle. The space is incredibly clean, the staff is beyond friendly, and the massages are divine. My therapist knew exactly where my pain points were without me saying a word, and even anticipated my preferences – like not touching my head – without needing to ask. Incredible attention to detail, top-notch service, and a soothing cup of tea to end the experience. Truly, one of the best value-for-money massage spots in the city.
‘Where relaxation finds you before you even ask.’ 🍃

reviews.name: Siobhan Moore
reviews.text: we scheduled for a morning massage just the evening before and they were able to accommodate us. Relaxing atmosphere and incredible massages. Would recommend to anyone looking to relax or needing an activity for a dreary day in rainy season

reviews.name: Diane McFaul
reviews.text: My favorite massage by far. I had the Thai body with nerve touch. I have had many deep tissue massages, but this was the best. The masseuse was amazing and the price was very reasonable. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dee Jas
reviews.text: I went here 3 times. The place is lovely, not like a  generic high end spa but the right level of comfort compared to street massages. I enjoyed every treatment I had - and May is brilliant. She targeted some tight muscles in my shoulder and I felt refreshed. Definitely recommend! Simple, affordable and good quality treatments.

reviews.name: Andrii Turanov
reviews.text:
Nice place for a massage.
The only issue for me was the fact that they don't wash your feet.
They just wipe them with a tissue.
But overall the location is nice, place is clean itself.
But most importantly the masseuse was just great at what she does.
Maybe I got lucky, but the experience was great.
She even cracked my neck properly.
Definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Victoria Cook
reviews.text:
We went for a couples massage, the staff were very friendly and we even had a laugh during the session.
The quality of the massage was brilliant, the  staff were very well trained.

reviews.name: Kyaw Shinn Thant
reviews.text: The therapists are super skillful. The rooms are clean and pleasant. I really like foot massage.

reviews.name: EY
reviews.text: Massage review. This was one of the best massages, if not the best one so far, in the city of Chiang Mai. The owner is very kind and made great recommendations: 1.5 hours of thai massage with nerve pressure, which is pretty much a thai style of a deep tissue massage, and half an hour of herbal compress. Overall, this was a great experience! Highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Cheryl Yap
reviews.text: I really cannot understand the good reviews this place receives. I booked a 2hour massage here for my mom and I at the recommendation of our Airbnb host. My mom asked for a relaxing massage and I asked for an intense Thai massage which I had to pay additional for. Neither of us got what we wanted and both agreed it was the worst massage we have ever received in Thailand. I love massages and usually find 2hours not enough but I literally could not stop staring at the clock hoping for this session to end. Not sure why I had to pay something close to 40% more for an “intense” Thai massage when the masseuse was literally just stroking my body. Utter waste of my time.

reviews.name: Marley
reviews.text: Highly recommend Nimman House! It’s secluded so make sure you follow google maps. It’s clean and the staff is friendly. Doi does an excellent job. I visited her twice and she was gentle but also worked out my knots and stretched me out real good. I recommend the Thai Massage 2 for a more health focused and muscle massage. Rooms are very private and each have their own door. You get a little tea and cookie at the end too! 10/10 - I miss it!

reviews.name: Hanna Jonsson
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience. Very affordable for the package treatments. My massage was gentle and very relaxing, I got the food massage and back+shoulder+head combination (it was about 50/50 focus on the calves and feet, really great after being swollen during my flight). I wanted to add another hour of Thai herbal massage which was no problem. In total I paid 950 baht for this three hour session

You could sometimes hear other people since the treatments are in a big room with dividers between. It did not bother me at all. I was there in a Monday afternoon and the atmosphere was very calm and peaceful.

title: 清迈厨房
ownerDescription:
ChiangMai Chufang 清邁廚房中文班
首先由我們的司機到酒店接大家一起前往清邁廚房,開始好吃又好玩的烹飪之旅,抵達後先挑選自己想要學做的四道菜,加上必做的芒果糯米飯和泰式冰奶茶兩種餐點,共六道菜式,然後由我們的中文烹飪老師帶領著大家,前往泰國傳統市場,簡單的介紹各種食材,之後返回學校在老師細心的專業指導下,開始學著用新鮮的材料,巧手烹煮成一道道美味的泰國料理,做好並享用自己做的餐點,吃飽喝足後由司機送大家返回酒店。
address: 366 Thanon Charoenrajd, Tambon Wat Ket, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: R234+C8 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Gary Wu
reviews.text: A fantastic place to learn Thai cuisine! The teachers are kind, patient, and ensure learners can confidently prepare a full set of delicious dishes.

reviews.name: Luca Yang
reviews.text: My instructor is super nice the food is also very good and I learn how to cook and it was very fun.👍👍👍👍👍👍😆😆😆😆😁😁😁😁

reviews.name: Chi Ting, Joan CHEUNG
reviews.text:
The teacher is patient and professional
So much fun to enjoy a morning here
It is so yummy！
