reviews.text: hi，how can i contact you？i cannot call
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi, may I have your phone number please. Do you have WhatsApp?

reviews.name: Ryan Huang
reviews.text: Very good experience

reviews.name: 莊瑞美
reviews.text: 全程中文老師講解，仔細並具有耐心，傳統在地巿場認識食材，順利完成二個人共8菜一甜點一飲料
reviews.textTranslated: The entire session was conducted in Chinese by a dedicated and patient teacher. We learned about ingredients at a traditional local market, and successfully prepared eight dishes, one dessert, and one drink for two people.

reviews.name: Elvelyn Jiang
reviews.text: 阿文老師中文說的很好，有問題都會親切答覆，而且料理過程會指導，知道很多泰國料理的知識，很值得來體驗看看！
reviews.textTranslated: Chef Awen speaks excellent Chinese and is always ready to answer any questions. He also provides guidance during the cooking process and knows a great deal about Thai cuisine. It's definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: 張美鳳Amy
reviews.text:
第一次來清邁，感謝朋友推薦這個行程，總共做了四菜兩甜品，超道地的料理，都是我在台灣愛吃的泰式名菜，老師講中文從早上先帶我們去傳統市場認識料理食材後開始耐心指導我們做菜。
做完菜很有成就感，重點是菜非常好吃很道地。大力推薦來清邁一定要體驗這個行程很划算很值得。
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time in Chiang Mai, and I'm so grateful to my friend for recommending this tour. We cooked four main dishes and two desserts – all incredibly authentic Thai cuisine, many of my favorite Thai dishes from Taiwan. The instructor, who speaks Mandarin, started by taking us to the traditional market in the morning to learn about the ingredients, and then patiently guided us through the cooking process.

I felt a great sense of accomplishment after finishing the dishes, and most importantly, they were absolutely delicious and authentic. I highly recommend experiencing this tour when you visit Chiang Mai; it's a great value and well worth it.

reviews.name: TZU JIE Lin
reviews.text: 二刷清迈廚房，真的每次必排半天來體驗，老師會從傳統的市場開始帶我們認識菜跟香料，再來備料著手自己做，而且非常有耐性，中文講的超級好～非常建議來清迈真的要來試試傳統道地的料理，還能有食譜帶回去唷～～大推大推👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviews.textTranslated: Second time visiting Chiang Mai Kitchen! I always make sure to queue for half a day to experience it. The instructor starts by showing us the traditional market, introducing us to the vegetables and spices, then we prepare the ingredients and start cooking ourselves. He's incredibly patient and speaks excellent Mandarin! I highly recommend trying this authentic traditional cuisine when you're in Chiang Mai; you even get a recipe to take home! Highly recommended! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.name: 陳小飛
reviews.text:
老師非常用心，到市場介紹香料很仔細
整個上課過程非常舒服，煮完每道菜老師還會幫大家試味道，很推薦來清邁上廚藝課👍🏼
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher was very dedicated, explaining the spices in detail at the market. The whole class was very comfortable; after cooking each dish, the teacher would even help everyone taste it. I highly recommend taking a cooking class in Chiang Mai! 👍🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 謝謝您，我希望再次造訪我們的廚房。

reviews.name: 楊牛牛
reviews.text: 來清邁一定要來廚藝學校上課，把吃過的菜都學過一輪，老師很有耐心的教導，煮出來的菜都超好吃，上課環境也很不錯，煮好的菜吃不完都可以打包帶走 ，一切都很棒
reviews.textTranslated: If you come to Chiang Mai, you absolutely must take a culinary class. You can learn to cook all the dishes you've tried. The teachers are very patient, and the dishes they cook are all incredibly delicious. The class environment is also great, and you can even take away any leftovers. Everything is fantastic!

reviews.name: yin chung chen
reviews.text: 泰菜半日學習，老師講解簡單明瞭，價格合理，不同語言分開學習，含接送想學泰菜可來試看看
reviews.textTranslated: Half-day Thai cooking course. The instructor explains concepts clearly and simply. Reasonable price. Separate classes for different languages. Transportation included. Anyone interested in learning Thai cooking is welcome to try it out.

reviews.name: Vic Maddux
reviews.text:
很棒的體驗，教學過程還會跟你說泰國本地調味跟符合自己口味調味的比例，請教小文老師課程以外的食物，他也樂意解答喔
雙條車接送也是很特別的體驗
reviews.textTranslated: It was a fantastic experience! The teaching process included explaining local Thai seasonings and the proportions to suit your own taste. Teacher Xiaowen was also happy to answer any questions I had about foods outside the course. The songthaew (shared taxi) transportation was also a unique experience.

reviews.name: 謝坤安
reviews.text: 這堂課超棒，從菜市場認原料到手把手做出五道菜。超好玩。學到好多。阿文老師超棒。從原理開始教。很清楚。
reviews.textTranslated: This class was amazing! From identifying ingredients at the market to cooking five dishes step-by-step, it was so much fun. I learned so much. Teacher Awen is fantastic. He taught from the basic principles, making it very clear.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 謝謝您，我希望再次造訪我們的廚房。

reviews.name: Roderick
reviews.text: 很棒的體驗，老師會說中文溝通教學沒有問題，而且還會帶我們去市場介紹特殊菜，煮料理可以挑選喜歡的餐點，老師很生動活潑且非常有耐性，煮出來的東西特別美味～非常推薦大家來唷！
reviews.textTranslated: It was a great experience! The teacher spoke Chinese and there were no problems communicating and teaching. She even took us to the market to introduce us to special dishes. We could choose our favorite dishes when she cooked. The teacher was very lively, patient, and the food she cooked was especially delicious. I highly recommend everyone to come!

reviews.name: David Jim
reviews.text: 很好玩，中文教學，會去市場認識一些香料與青菜，重點是成品菜色很好吃，完全符合口味
reviews.textTranslated: It was a lot of fun! The lessons were taught in Chinese, and we went to the market to learn about spices and vegetables. Most importantly, the finished dishes were delicious and perfectly suited our tastes.

reviews.name: Wan Ting Chang
reviews.text: 今天下雨天，剛好排了清邁廚房的泰式料理煮飯體驗，老師先帶我們去傳統市場買菜，整個過程耐心教學，中文流利很親切，讓我一秒變主廚！大推！
reviews.textTranslated: It was raining today, but I happened to have a Thai cooking experience at Chiang Mai Kitchen. The instructor first took us to a traditional market to buy groceries. He patiently taught us throughout the process, spoke fluent Chinese and was very friendly. It made me feel like a chef in a second! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: 傑米
reviews.text: 老師非常耐心與細心的去教導我們，料理蠻道地的，希望下次來能夠學習更多不一樣的菜品
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher was very patient and meticulous in instructing us, and the cooking was quite authentic. I hope to learn more different dishes next time I come.

reviews.name: mimi nian
reviews.text: 超級好玩！每個人可以從四個類別中各選一道，加上芒果糯米飯、泰奶總共六道，阿雯老師用中文教學非常清楚，會先到市場介紹食材，再到廚房學做菜，時間大約4個小時，好吃又好玩～
reviews.textTranslated: Super fun! Everyone can choose one dish from each of the four categories, plus mango sticky rice and Thai milk tea for a total of six dishes. Teacher Awen teaches very clearly in Chinese. She first introduces the ingredients at the market, then teaches you how to cook in the kitchen. The session lasts about 4 hours. It's delicious and fun!

reviews.name: Pink Panther
reviews.text: 今天一個人來上課，小文老師中文說的很好，有耐心又親切，服務很好，有想來上中文烹飪課的朋友我會推薦來這裡。
reviews.textTranslated: I came to class alone today. Teacher Xiaowen speaks excellent Chinese, is patient and kind, and provides great service. I would recommend this place to any friends who want to take a Chinese cooking class.

reviews.name: Renna
reviews.text: The woman at this massage place helped us when our motorbike broke down. And the massage was also very comfortable—we had a relaxing and pleasant time! Thank you so much 😊

reviews.name: Vasudeva Rao Kondeti
reviews.text: We visited this place for a foot massage and they absolutely stood up to their reputation. Their massage was so good that me and my wife slept like babies. The ladies here were really kind and accommodative as well to our cranky toddler. They took great care of him and can’t thank them enough for their patience and love. Our visit was absolute fun and we would visit again. Till then sawadee krab!

reviews.name: shahnuma khatoon
reviews.text:
An Amazing Foot Massage Experience in Phuket!

I had an absolutely wonderful foot massage during my trip to Phuket! After a long day of exploring and walking along the beach, this was exactly what I needed. The staff were so welcoming and professional from the moment I walked in. The place was clean, calm, and had such a relaxing vibe — the perfect spot to unwind.

The therapist was incredibly skilled and attentive, making sure the pressure was just right throughout. She focused on every sore spot and by the end, my feet felt so light and rejuvenated. I also appreciated the little details — the soothing music, cool towel, and refreshing tea at the end made the experience even better.

If you’re in Phuket and looking for a truly relaxing and refreshing foot massage, I’d highly recommend this place. It’s one of those simple pleasures that makes your holiday even more memorable! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Jeff Liow
reviews.text: I did neck back and shoulder massage and my wife chose Thai massage. Both ladies were very professional and friendly. It was a very relaxing hour.

reviews.name: Alexa S
reviews.text:
I really recommend this place. I came here based on all reviews, and I must say I was a bit lost finding the place. Once I founded I trusted the reviews.
I got Minni and I must say that she was wonderful. I did a foot massage and back and shoulder massage.
She was very attentive and listened where I got injured in my foot. During the massage she was extremely gentle with my foot and careful not to touch the injured part (lisfranc ligament during padel). The back massage was also one of the best I ever had.
I left this placed super relaxed. Thank you minni 🙂

reviews.name: AP Lim
reviews.text: I guess i was unlucky. I saw rating 4.8 and thought it should be all right. It's so bad. It felt to me the masseuse is just spreading oil on me despite me asking her to do it harder and stronger repeatedly 5 or 6 times.

Totally recommended

reviews.name: Kajol Thakkar
reviews.text: Goya and Yaya are the best massage staff at this place! If you come to Patong, don’t miss this place. It is sooooo good and relaxing. The best place.

reviews.name: Linda Hartman
reviews.text: We have had an hour foot massage, and an hour oil massage here, same girls each time. Both massages were heavenly! Beautiful and relaxing in a  great clean environment. The girls were both great massagers and lovely to speak with. Thoroughly recommend!

reviews.name: Meena Patil
reviews.text:
Very good service. Minni was super good for head massage.
Thank you for such a wonderful service

reviews.name: Anshuman Sarda

Great place, Minnie did a wonderful job!
Right next to Holiday Inn Patong.

reviews.name: Kis Nar
reviews.text:
Good massage do for 2 hours
Good stuff clean I will come back again

reviews.name: James Kwr
reviews.text: I had an incredible massage experience! The therapist was professional and attentive, focusing on all my problem areas. The ambiance was peaceful, the  smelled amazing with essential oils, and the background music helped me truly relax. I walked out feeling lighter and pain-free. Highly recommend for anyone needing stress relief!

reviews.name: Yankee Alpha
reviews.text:
I've been a loyal client of this spa for over 7 years now, and I can confidently say it continues to exceed my expectations every time. The place is always spotless – incredibly clean and hygienic – which is something I truly value, especially in a wellness environment.

The staff are consistently professional, warm, and welcoming. From the moment you walk in, you're treated with genuine care and attention. Whether it’s a massage, facial, or any other treatment, the service is always top-notch and delivered with great skill.

What keeps me coming back year after year is the consistency – they never compromise on quality. It’s clear that the team takes pride in what they do, and that makes all the difference. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a relaxing, reliable, and high-standard spa experience!

reviews.name: C R
reviews.text:
I don’t think they have training here as a masseuse, no pressure, when I asked for more pressure, she started making disappointed sounds the whole massage like she is doing me a favor.

I don’t think this place does legit massages, more of a funny business type of massage place.

reviews.name: Joffrey Longomo
reviews.text:
The massage is very good. The masseuse knew how to recognize where I was in pain and she is very attentive on sensitive points.
I really felt my body in great shape.

reviews.name: Traveling Hoppy
reviews.text:
I’m a struggling single mom who unfortunately has to leave Thailand due to financial circumstances. I had paid for classes here and asked if there was any possibility of receiving a refund for the classes I can no longer attend, while forfeiting the ฿6,000 visa processing fee to account for the administrative work already done.

Unfortunately, I was told that the amount paid for the classes was non-refundable.

I pointed out that nowhere in the paperwork I signed before making the payment did it state that the class fees were non-refundable. I was then shown a receipt, issued after payment, where the non-refundable policy was stated.

Obviously, I wish I had known this before paying.

I understand that businesses need cancellation policies, but I believe customers should be made clearly aware of those policies before they commit a significant amount of money.

If you are considering signing up, I strongly recommend making absolutely sure that your plans are 100% set in stone before paying. If your circumstances change afterward, you should be prepared to potentially lose the entire amount you paid.

I’m sharing this simply so others can make an informed decision before committing their money.

Had a good time at Let’s Relax spa! From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by their attention to detail. They have a proper shoe storage system that keeps your footwear safe and organized - such a thoughtful touch that many spas overlook.

The spa treatment itself was nice. Every aspect was nicely executed, and the hot towel head massage at the end of the Thai massage was the perfect finishing touch that left me feeling rejuvenated. The therapists are clearly skilled professionals who know how to create a restorative experience.

reviews.text:
A very disappointing experience.  For more than twice the rate of other massage businesses I was expecting a professional and personalized service.  Instead after requesting a deep massage I received medium pressure throughout. A few minutes in I asked for more pressure. She obliged but very briefly then returned to a lighter touch.

Also prior to the massage we were asked to identify areas where we wanted more time spent. Among other areas I selected my upper and lower back. Unfortunately this area got about half the time that was spent on my legs. I would have preferred the reverse.

Lastly at the beginning of the massage I pointed out a part of my body that was tight and asked that some extra attention be spent on it. She agreed but then spent a maximum of three minutes focused on that area.

Overall, it felt like a very average massage in a very nice setting. People were pleasant and the service very good.  Just not the massage I hoped for.

reviews.text:
2 stars for customers services or treatment
I had a body scrub and Thai massage here, and the treatment itself was wonderful. My therapist was kind, gentle, and polite — she made me feel relaxed throughout. One of the receptionists was also warm and accommodating when I arrived.

However, I couldn’t help but notice some inconsistencies in how they treat their guests. When I checked in, I was informed that their dessert was already limited and that they could only offer me tea and snacks — which I completely understood. But after my session, I saw other guests, particularly foreign (white) customers, being served dessert. It left me feeling that service might be a bit selective, which was disappointing.

I also asked the new receptionist if they had a business card for their Bangkok branch, because im planning to have another visit in their bkk branch in my next month visit and she said none, and instead of assisting or checking, add extra miles of helping she simply told me to look it up online. For a spa that promotes a premium experience, that response felt dismissive and lacking in customer care.

The massage itself was relaxing, but I hope the management pays closer attention to ensuring all guests — regardless of background — are treated with the same level of hospitality and respect. Consistency and genuine care make a huge difference in customer experience.

After researching several places, we were incredibly fortunate to have discovered Sunisa Facial Spa. From the moment we stepped in, we were met with the warmest, biggest smiles and immediately prepped for our Indian Head Massage. Worst spa experience of my life.

I was really looking forward to visiting this spa, but unfortunately it turned out to be the worst wellness treatment experience I have ever had. I went there today with my mother to do the Indian Head Massage (20 steps).

Sadly, the young woman who treated me had very fast, rushed, and extremely rough movements. I asked her several times, using Google Translate, to slow down and apply less pressure, but she did not change her approach at all. It was extremely unpleasant. She was hurting me so much that at one point I almost got up and left. It was horrible.

I had previously read a review from another woman describing the exact same experience, and I honestly thought she might be exaggerating. I now believe we were treated by the same person. If you end up with this woman, be aware that the experience will be terrible and absolutely not relaxing. More than six hours after the treatment, my scalp still hurts because of how aggressively it was done.

That said, my mother’s treatment went well, and the person who took care of her was apparently gentle, which makes the situation even more frustrating.

This review is not questioning the politeness or friendliness of the staff member, who was courteous. However, I do not understand why she ignored my request three times via Google Translate to be gentler and slower. Honestly, this will probably remain the worst memory of my vacation.

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Tisha, and I must say, it was an absolute gem! If you're looking for an affordable and rejuvenating experience, this is the place to go.

From the moment I stepped inside, they showed warm and inviting. The Korean guy greeted me with genuine smiles and made me feel instantly welcome. The entire place was clean, well-maintained, a simple setting but perfect for relaxation.

The massage therapists were highly skilled and attentive to my needs. You can see that they are all certified therapists from the certificate hanged on wall. The therapist applied just the right amount of pressure, relieving my muscle tension and promoting deep relaxation. I left feeling utterly refreshed and rejuvenated.

The prices were incredibly reasonable, especially considering the exceptional experience I had. It was a fantastic value for money.

I must also mention the friendly staff. They were knowledgeable, courteous, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout my visit. We left late with heavy rains on the last night in Chiang Mai. The owner of Tisha drove us back to hotel. I love Chiang Mai and part of the reason is because of these blissful and special memories.

I can't wait to return to Tisha for my next retreat. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Sreerag Nampoothiri K
reviews.text:
My partner and I visited Makkha Health & Spa (Phuket) and had a 60-minute Aromatic Massage, and it was genuinely the best massage I have ever had.

From the moment we walked in, the place felt calm, clean, modern, and beautifully designed. The reception staff were warm and professional, and the whole experience felt very well-organised.

The massage itself was excellent — strong, skilled, and deeply relaxing. The therapists were clearly experienced and the quality was on another level compared to most places.

The facilities are also amazing: spotless treatment rooms, great ambience, and a very premium feel throughout. As a really thoughtful touch, they even served us sticky mango rice and tea at the end, which was such a lovely surprise.

Highly recommend this spa if you want a proper, high-quality massage in Phuket. A perfect way to say goodbye to Thailand. Kapunka!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your beautiful and detailed review. We’re truly honored to hear that your Aromatic Massage was the best you’ve ever had. It brings us great joy to know that you appreciated the ambiance, professionalism of our team, and the thoughtful touches throughout your visit.

Your kind words mean so much to us, and we’re delighted to have been part of your farewell moments in Thailand. We hope to welcome you both again on your next journey. Kapunka! 🌿💛

reviews.text: This is by far the best place I’ve received a massage in all of Phuket. I’ve also gotten massages in Krabi and it still stands as the best. They are gentle if you want them to be, they apply pressure if necessary. They seem to be very knowledgeable about where your body is and what it needs. Everytime I’ve gone, I’ve left more relaxed, my legs and body are relieved of pain. I highly recommend you come to Aum’s. I wish I came straight here when I landed instead of giving other places a shot! Haha. I can only imagine what it would have been like to have had them for a few weeks consistently. reviews.name: Sean Lammerts
reviews.text: I received two massages from Simmi, and both were excellent. The facilities themselves were peaceful and tranquil, creating a calming atmosphere from the moment I arrived. Soft lighting, soothing music, and a serene environment made it easy to unwind before and after each session. Simmi was friendly, professional, and clearly very skilled. Her technique was strong and therapeutic, with just the right amount of pressure, and she paid close attention to areas that needed extra work. Each session left me feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and noticeably better. I would highly recommend Simmi to anyone looking for a high-quality massage experience in a truly serene setting.

reviews.text:
This is by far the worst massage/spa experience I have had in my entire life. I have opted for the Full Spirit 165 minutes and let me say - the only time I felt relaxed was during the wrap after the body scrub when I was left alone.

1st Treatment: Foot Massage
- Not only the masseur was yawning multiple times, there was clearly no strength and she missed all the pressure points. I did requested for the pressure to be stronger but from there on, it was purely strength!

2nd Treatment: Scrub
- She was thorough

3rd Treatment: Oil Massage
- My request before the treatment was to focus on my back, lower back, calves. Instead, Ive gotten at least 5 head massages which gave me a headache by the end of the treatment. I appreciate the use of various techniques but all she used was her forearms (again using pure strength) on my calves, back, neck, BONES & some intensive squeezing on my Trapezius Muscles which caused intense redness rather than helping me release tension or relax.

I am not asking for any compensation but Let’s Relax, please ensure that your therapist are all well trained, follows the requests of the customers & really have the passion to heal fatigue.

I probably wouldn't come back for a second time because the prices are quite high compared to other places in the area, and the massage skills should be much better. They should hire more skilled masseurs. The overall atmosphere of the shop is okay, but the issue is solely the masseur's skill. For those who just want a relaxing massage without too much focus, it might be alright. However, for me, I expected a much more relaxing massage.

reviews.name: Follow Fauzia
reviews.text:
🦶✨ Foot Massage Adventure on SuraWong Road! ✨🦶

So Andy and I were strolling along SuraWong Road, on the hunt for a good foot massage for two 👣👣. We kept asking around but either the places were full or they insisted we commit to at least 60 minutes (we were like… okay lahhh! 😅). Finally, we stumbled upon this spot — and LUCKILY they had two seats side-by-side! 🎉 Perfect for chatting while getting pampered. 💬💆‍♀️💆‍♂️

We sat down, got comfy… and then BAM 💡💡💡 — the lights above us were so bright it felt like we were about to be interrogated 😂. We kindly asked them to dim the lights and they did so immediately, with Thai-style politeness and a smile 🙏🏼 — thank you very much kaaaa! 💛

Now, let’s talk massage. My masseuse was super sweet but just didn’t have the pressure I needed for a full leg and foot massage for the whole hour 😅. No biggie — I still relaxed. But Andy? He totally lucked out! 🍀 His masseuse was this petite, strong, and super cute powerhouse 💪🏼 who went above and beyond — did some unexpected magic foot tricks 🪄 that made his feet feel brand new! I kept hearing “Oh wow!” from his chair 😂

The shop smelled amazing — lovely aroma in the air 🌿 — and they had several therapists working hard to soothe the feet of fellow weary travelers. It’s clean, friendly, and has a peaceful vibe (especially once the lights dimmed 😂).

✅ Price? So reasonable for a full hour of foot bliss.
✅ Service? Sweet and sincere.
✅ Vibe? Relaxed and aromatic.
✅ Recommendation? YES, especially if you’re in the area and your feet are screaming for help!

🌀 Bonus: I’ve recently become addicted to foot massages (no shame!), so expect more reviews coming your way soon! 🫶

📲 Don’t forget to Follow Fauzia for more fun, honest reviews from Bangkok and beyond —
on YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram! 🎥📸🧖‍♀️

#FootMassageAddict #FollowFauzia #MassageChronicles

I had such an amazing experience at Rawai Thai Cooking Class! From the moment we arrived, Juncinta and her team made us feel completely welcome. The kitchen is spotless and well-organised  with plenty of space for everyone to cook comfortably.

The staff were warm, funny, and incredibly knowledgeable. They explained each ingredient, shared local tips, and guided us step-by-step without ever rushing. I loved how hands-on the class was—every dish we cooked tasted restaurant-quality, and we got to enjoy everything afterwards in a lovely, relaxed setting.

If you’re staying in Phuket and want to learn authentic Thai cooking while having a genuinely fun time, this class is a must-do. I’d happily go back again! 🌶️🥥🍜
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing review! 
We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed your time with me and our team. It’s wonderful that you appreciated the warm atmosphere, the hands-on experience, and of course, the delicious Thai dishes!

We’d be delighted to welcome you back anytime for another fun and flavorful cooking adventure in Rawai!

reviews.name: Anna Jasiak
reviews.text: We found this cooking class in our neighborhood. We went as a family.  From start to finish , we learned and participated in every part of the class! The venue was clean, tranquil and well organized. Our family of three were joined by two others from Germany. The two groups were able to choose two different menus to prepare! Everything was delicious. I can’t wait to try the Thai dishes at home!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you Anna for your kind review! 😊 It’s great to hear that you and your family had a fantastic time cooking with us. Sharing Thai cuisine in a warm and friendly atmosphere is what we love to do. We’re glad you enjoyed the experience and the delicious dishes you made. Have fun cooking them at home, and we hope to see you again soon! 🌿👨‍🍳✨

reviews.name: Blake Plimpton
reviews.text: This cooking class was so fun and easy to follow! Great instructions and a very clean space— we made papaya salad, green curry, pad see ew, and mango sticky rice, all of which were delicious. And they sell a lot of their own seasoning and tools which made great souvenirs and gifts.

reviews.name: Jasmine Dela Cruz
reviews.text: I had so much fun on this cooking class. Our chef Julnika and her assistants are wonderful and very warm welcoming! It is such a beautiful experience in Rawai. One of my highlights of this trip. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Jasmine for your lovely message! We're thrilled to hear you had such a great time with Chef Julnika and our team. It was a real pleasure to welcome you, and we're so happy that our class became one of the highlights of your trip to Rawai. Thank you for recommending us, we hope to see you again on your next visit!

reviews.name: Maciek Lyko
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience at Thai Cooking Class in Rawai! From start to finish, it was a fun, hands-on, and educational journey into the art of Thai cuisine.

The class was well-organized, and the instructor was both knowledgeable and approachable, making it easy to follow along.

The highlight for me was making my own Pad Thai and Green Curry—absolutely delicious! The instructor shared so many useful tips and tricks that I can’t wait to try at home.

The setting was beautiful, clean, and welcoming, which added to the overall experience. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced cook, this class is perfect for anyone looking to immerse themselves in Thai culture and cuisine.

Highly recommend this cooking class if you’re in Rawai! It’s not just a class, but an experience you’ll treasure. I left with a full stomach, new skills, and some amazing recipes to take home.

We will be back
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌟 We're thrilled to hear you had such an incredible experience at our Thai Cooking Class in Rawai. It’s amazing that you enjoyed making your own Pad Thai and Green Curry, two true classics! 🍜💚

We’re glad the tips and tricks shared in class were helpful, and we can’t wait to hear how they turn out at home. Your kind words about our setting and organization mean the world to us, and we’re so happy we could share the joy of Thai cuisine and culture with you.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another fun and flavorful adventure in the kitchen! 🥘✨

reviews.name: Екатерина Кисса
reviews.text: It was very tasty and interesting. I can recommend this master class. The chef is very friendly and pleasant. We liked everything.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your kind review! 😊

We’re really happy to hear that you enjoyed the cooking class and found it both interesting and delicious. It means a lot to us that you appreciated the experience and the friendly atmosphere.

Thank you as well for recommending the class. It was a pleasure having you with us, and we hope to welcome you again for another cooking experience!

title: Thanarika Relaxing Massage
ownerDescription:
Relaxing Massage
Massage in chiang mai

reviews.name: 玄虎SS
reviews.text: The massage was amazing! The therapist’s technique was really good. I felt so relaxed and my whole body felt great afterwards. The place was clean and had a nice atmosphere too.

reviews.name: Shi Yiing Tan
reviews.text: Really nice, chill place. The staff were friendly and made me feel comfortable right away. Massage was great and helped me relax a lot. Clean space and walk-in was smooth too.

reviews.name: L Y
reviews.text: Clean, quiet and reasonable price. Pin point accuracy on de-locking your muscle strains. Very professional therapists 😄

reviews.name: Allard de Muinck Keizer
reviews.text: This shop is recently modernized, and this is very well done. You receive cold water before treatment, hot tea after. They have professional masseuses and really nice treatment rooms including your own toilet and shower. They take you through a whole treatment experience but it is still very affordable. I paid 500 bath for an aroma oil massage for 1 hour. Would definitely recommend this massage parlor to everyone.

reviews.name: Jennifer Nguyen
reviews.text: The best massage in Chiang Mai. Ask for Kratea! She has good technique, firm but smooth. I felt relaxed after my session.

reviews.name: Jonathan Wald
reviews.text: Amazing massage . We did Thai massage it was exceptional.  The people are very nice at the reception and the Masseuses were professional.

reviews.name: Marilyn Das
reviews.text: Relaxing scrub and oil massage. Peaceful environment, respectful employees and great service. Loved the fact that I could choose the type of scrub and oil that I wanted to use. They have a good selection. They also provide you with tea and mini cookies after the massage.

reviews.name: Poser
reviews.text:
I had a 1.5 hour Thai massage and it was spot on! They give you a form to fill out if any particular areas to focus on & pressure preference etc
The massage is done in a private room which I personally prefer as I don’t like being disturbed by unnecessary noises.
This is my second visit

reviews.name: Leesa Matwick
reviews.text: My husband and I each enjoyed a wonderful, 90 minute foot massage. Nok was my massage therapist and managed to work out all the knots in my feet. The spa is elegant, chairs are very comfortable, and the tea and treats at the end, a lovely finishing touch. Great value and service by all at Thanarika! Thank you Nok! 🥰🙏

reviews.name: Priscylla Cheung
reviews.text:
I recently visited Thanarika in Chiang Mai, and it was an incredible experience! The atmosphere was calming and inviting, which instantly put me at ease. The staff were professional and attentive, ensuring that I received the best treatment tailored to my needs.

The therapist had great technique and really worked out all my tension.❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I’m really happy that you like it.Thank you very much🤎

reviews.name: Abby Anderson
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Thailand! The aromatherapy oil massage is so relaxing and I loved getting to choose my scent. The room was quiet and air conditioned to the perfect temperature. So happy I found this place
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a million kha🥰🤎

reviews.name: Havneet Dhami
reviews.text: This was our favourite massage parlour during our trip to south east Asia in March. This review is long overdue but we still think about the amazing foot massages we received here. The parlour is small, quiet, easily accessible, and have great masseuses. We can't wait to visit Chiang Mai again and return to Thanarika!

reviews.name: MO VIRJI
reviews.text: Very respectful 2 sisters running this fabulous establishment. Priya & Rekha. Massages are great and so are the prices. I highly recommended this place to all visitors to Chiang Mai. Any establishment that can accommodate 8 adults at the same time with great service is definitely a place to visit.

reviews.name: Miriam Newman-Paul
reviews.text:
Just got a massage here and have to say, I’m so happy and relieved I chose a good place to get a massage. My masseuse was knowledgeable, skilled, and thorough; she gave a full Thai massage and paid extra attention to my problem areas. I came in with a chronic low back pain flare up and left pain free :)

Chiang Mai is packed with Thai massage options so it’s important to choose wisely.

I’m a massage therapist so my standards are high. I’m telling you, for the same price as anywhere else, you are getting QUALITY here.

reviews.name: Asha S
reviews.text: Great experience - received the Thai herbal balm massage for 60 min. I feel super relaxed and it was great serve. Thank you!

reviews.name: lizzy cue
reviews.text: service is good, and the place is really relaxing, they gave me free tea and drink. And also the price is the same with other shop but they have better service. It is really good experience for me

reviews.name: Ernesto Alvarez
reviews.text: Great massage by P'Jaja P'Kookkai, get the acrobatic Thai balm with Kookai it will really stretch your muscles and leave a fresh burning feeling with the balm.

reviews.name: Fbfbfbgbf Dnfbfbf
reviews.text:
Very good and professional massage
I suggest this beautiful place
Very nice atmosphere and good vibes
I’ll come back again and again☺️🩷

reviews.name: Sam Chewanun
reviews.text:
I had a massage at Thanarika Relaxing Massage in Chiang Mai and was really impressed. The place is calm and relaxing, the staff are polite and friendly, and the massage was very professional. The price is also very fair for the quality.
While I was there, I saw a situation where a man asked for a refund after his session. I actually heard the woman with him say earlier that the massage was good, but after he finished, he still went to the counter asking for his money back. I was having tea after my massage and saw the whole thing. What impressed me most was how calmly and professionally the staff handled it.
They explained that since the massage had already gone on for over an hour, a refund wasn’t possible — just like finishing a meal and then saying it wasn’t tasty. That honestly made me smile 😂 because it’s true. They also said if a customer isn’t happy, they can let the staff know during the massage, and the shop will gladly change the therapist. I think that’s very fair.
As a foreign customer, I can honestly say this place offers excellent service and real professionalism. I highly recommend Thanarika Relaxing Massage to anyone looking for a quality massage in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: By Cat
reviews.text: Thanarika Relaxing Massage is amazing! 😍 The staff are super welcoming and the therapist is very experienced. After the massage, I felt completely relaxed, just like the name says. 🤩 They even serve soft, Herbal tea 🍵. This is my 3rd visit, and I love it every time!

title: Khroua Baan Thai
subTitle: ครัวบ้านไทย
ownerDescription: Cours de cuisine & Restaurant
address: 37 7 Soi Sreesud, Tambon Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: RX37+PW Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Pierre Palladin
reviews.text: Great experience with Pooh, Yves and their son and staff ! Very friendly and professionnal,  we felt at home. The recipes are easy to understand and the results are delicious !

reviews.name: Ahmed Al-Saeed
reviews.text:
Thank you for the wonderful hospitality, this was an enlightened experience not only I have learned so much about the Thai cooking but also so much more into their culture and their lifestyle.
Thank you khroua baan Thai I had the honour to join your Thai cooking class.

reviews.name: Schane Iseni
reviews.text: Nous avons réservé un cours en famille et je crois que c’est un de nos plus beau moment sur Chiang. École tenu par une famille qui parle parfaitement le français. Ce n’est pas qu’un simple cours de cuisine c’est une invitation dans la culture culinaire Thaïlandaise. Humour bienveillance et bonne humeur! Vous ne pouvez pas passer par chiang Mai sans passer chez Pook et Folk. Encore merci pour ces bons moments
reviews.textTranslated: We booked a family cooking class and I think it was one of our best moments in Chiang Mai. The school is run by a family who speak perfect French. It's not just a simple cooking class; it's an invitation into Thai culinary culture. Humor, kindness, and good cheer! You can't go to Chiang Mai without stopping by Pook and Folk. Thanks again for these wonderful moments.

reviews.name: David
reviews.text:
Super moment passé 👍
Tout le staff était aux petits soins, très bonne ambiance avec les blagues de Folk (le fils) tout au long du cours, cours en petits groupes (6 pers) donc au top.
Les plats sont excellents et très copieux.
Vraiment je recommande, service de transport assuré depuis le logement.
Merci beaucoup
reviews.textTranslated:
We had a fantastic time! 👍 The entire staff was incredibly attentive, and the atmosphere was great, especially with Folk (the son) cracking jokes throughout the class. The small group size (6 people) was perfect.

The food was excellent and very generous.

I highly recommend it; they even provide transportation from your accommodation.

Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Jeremy Gms
reviews.text:
Cours de cuisine exceptionnel en français ! Les personnes qui nous ont expliqué les recettes ont vraiment pris le temps de nous apprendre, de nous faire découvrir les différents produits, légumes et ingrédients locaux.
Je recommande vivement ce cours de cuisine : c’était délicieux, ludique et vraiment génial comme activité.
Nous sommes repartis avec un petit livre de recettes en français, comprenant toutes les recettes que nous avons préparées. Une superbe expérience !
reviews.textTranslated:
An exceptional cooking class in French! The instructors really took the time to teach us and introduce us to the different local products, vegetables, and ingredients.

I highly recommend this cooking class: it was delicious, fun, and a truly fantastic activity.
We left with a small recipe book in French, containing all the recipes we prepared. A superb experience!

reviews.name: Marie Potillion
reviews.text:
Une véritable bulle de bonheur et de gourmandise ! Ce cours de cuisine restera l’un de nos plus beaux souvenirs de notre voyage en Thaïlande.

Nous avons eu la chance d’avoir un cours privé, rien que pour notre famille. Pook et Yves nous ont accueillis avec une incroyable gentillesse, comme si nous faisions partie de leur famille. Leur passion, leur simplicité et leur bienveillance rendent cette expérience unique.

Ce que nous avons particulièrement aimé, c’est que chacun avait son propre menu et préparait ses propres plats. Même notre fils de 9 ans a eu ses recettes adaptées et a cuisiné de A à Z. Nous avons ensuite pris un immense plaisir à goûter les plats de chacun dans une ambiance conviviale et pleine de rires.

Les explications sont claires, les produits sont d’une grande fraîcheur et les recettes sont absolument délicieuses. On apprend énormément tout en passant un moment chaleureux et authentique.

Bien plus qu’un cours de cuisine, c’est une véritable rencontre humaine. On repart avec de nouvelles recettes, de merveilleux souvenirs et le cœur rempli de gratitude.

Merci infiniment Pook et Yves pour votre accueil si chaleureux. Si vous cherchez une expérience authentique à Chiang Mai, n’hésitez pas une seconde : vous vivrez un moment inoubliable.
reviews.textTranslated:
A true haven of happiness and deliciousness! This cooking class will remain one of our most cherished memories of our trip to Thailand.

We were lucky enough to have a private class, just for our family. Pook and Yves welcomed us with incredible kindness, as if we were part of their family. Their passion, their down-to-earth nature, and their genuine warmth made this experience truly unique.

What we particularly loved was that everyone had their own menu and prepared their own dishes. Even our 9-year-old son had his own adapted recipes and cooked from start to finish. We then had the immense pleasure of tasting everyone's creations in a friendly and laughter-filled atmosphere.

The explanations were clear, the ingredients were incredibly fresh, and the recipes were absolutely delicious. We learned so much while enjoying a warm and authentic experience.

Much more than a cooking class, it was a truly enriching human connection. We left with new recipes, wonderful memories, and hearts full of gratitude.

Thank you so much Pook and Yves for your incredibly warm welcome. If you're looking for an authentic experience in Chiang Mai, don't hesitate for a second: you'll have an unforgettable time.

reviews.name: Léna ANDRE
reviews.text:
Nous avons suivi un cours lors de notre séjour à Chiang Mai. Je suis une vraie passionnée de cuisine et prend toujours un temps fou à choisir LE cours que je vais prendre lorsque je voyage à l’étranger. Et là… je pense que ce n’était pas possible d’avoir mieux. C’était PARFAIT 🥰
Tout d’abord, le fait que le cours soit dispensé en Français est un véritable atout (notamment pour toutes les questions que nous souhaitons poser 😛).
Il n’y a pas de visite de jardin ou de marché, mais cela permet de passer beaucoup plus de temps sur les gestes et techniques aindi qu’un apprentissage plus approfondi des ingrédients utilisés dans la cuisine thaï.
Mais ce que j’ai aimé par dessus tout c’est l’incroyable bienveillance, générosité et humour de Pook et Folk qui sont tous deux formidables et passionnés. Ce cours a été un vrai moment de bonheur durant notre séjour en Thaïlande. Ils n’hésitent pas à partager tout leur savoir faire, prennent le temps d’expliquer et de passer du temps avec chacun d’entre nous. Le cours se fait en petit comité (et c’est beaucoup plus sympa que d’autres cours ou c’est un peu l’usine).
Enfin, la cuisine était variée et véritablement délicieuse. Nous nous sommes régalés du début à la fin, bien plus que dans pas mal de restaurants.

Encore une fois, merci pour tout ❤️ je garde un souvenir génial de cette journée !
reviews.textTranslated:
We took a cooking class during our stay in Chiang Mai. I'm a real food enthusiast and always spend ages choosing THE cooking class when I travel abroad. And this one… I think it couldn't have been better. It was PERFECT 🥰
First of all, the fact that the class was taught in French was a real plus (especially for all the questions we wanted to ask 😛).
There were no visits to gardens or markets, but this allowed us to spend much more time on the techniques and skills, as well as a more in-depth learning about the ingredients used in Thai cuisine.

But what I loved most of all was the incredible kindness, generosity, and humor of Pook and Folk, who are both wonderful and passionate. This class was a truly wonderful moment during our stay in Thailand. They readily share their expertise, taking the time to explain and spend time with each of us. The class is small (which is much nicer than other classes that feel a bit like a factory).

Finally, the food was varied and truly delicious. We enjoyed it from beginning to end, much more so than in many restaurants.

Once again, thank you for everything ❤️ I have wonderful memories of this day!

reviews.name: Jérémy Le Guénic
reviews.text:
Une superbe expérience lors ce cours de cuisine Thaï ! Avant notre venue à Chiang Mai, capitale de la gastronomie thaïlandaise, nous avions cette envie de participer à un cours de cuisine et grâce au Guide du Routard nous sommes tombés sur cette école ! Nous avons passé un super moment en compagnie de Pook, Yves (son mari) et toute l’équipe ! Le cours se passe en petit comité ce qui est mieux pour apprendre les différentes techniques et poser les questions que l’on voulait ! Le cours se fait en français ce qui est vraiment un gros point positif ! Nous cuisinons les recettes que nous avons sélectionné en amont lors de la réservation ! L’établissement est très propre ! Avec ma copine nous avons vraiment aimé ce cours où nous avons beaucoup appris sur les différentes techniques, sur les différentes herbes aromatiques, … ! Ambiance conviviale et nous avons bien rigolé ! À la fin nous avons même le droit à un livre de cuisine avec notre diplôme !
Prix très correct qui comprend aussi l’aller et le retour entre l’école de cuisine et l’hôtel !
Merci encore :))) et vous pouvez réserver sans aucune hésitation !
reviews.textTranslated:
A fantastic experience at this Thai cooking class! Before our trip to Chiang Mai, the culinary capital of Thailand, we had been wanting to take a cooking class, and thanks to the Lonely Planet guide, we stumbled upon this school! We had a wonderful time with Pook, Yves (her husband), and the whole team! The class is small, which is perfect for learning the different techniques and asking all the questions you want! The class is taught in French, which is a huge plus! We cooked the recipes we had selected beforehand when we booked! The establishment is very clean! My girlfriend and I really enjoyed this class, where we learned so much about different techniques, various aromatic herbs, and more! The atmosphere was friendly, and we had a lot of laughs! At the end, we even received a cookbook along with our certificate! The price was very reasonable and included round-trip transportation between the cooking school and the hotel!
Thanks again :))) and you can book without hesitation!

reviews.name: Mustafa Yilmaz
reviews.text:
Superbe expérience à faire absolument lors de votre séjour !
Un de nos meilleurs souvenirs de vacances.
L’équipe vous accueille dans une ambiance familiale.
Folk est EXCELLENT nous le remercions pour son sourire, sa gentillesse, son humour, il parle très bien le français.

L’expérience ne s’arrête pas au cours de cuisine, nous avons également profité de la présence d’une artiste qui nous a présenté des danses traditionnelles et de la musique.

Et la surprise, ne s’arrête pas là, car vous partirez avec votre livre de recettes et votre diplôme !

Je ne partage pas certains avis négatifs sur Yves que j’ai trouvé accueillant et singulier.
Il avait des anecdotes à nous raconter, il a pris le moment d’échanger avec nous sur son expérience en Thaïlande.
Il peut paraître brut mais je l’ai trouvé attachant.
reviews.textTranslated:
A superb experience, an absolute must during your stay!

One of our best vacation memories.
The team welcomes you in a friendly, family atmosphere.

Folk is EXCELLENT; we thank him for his smile, his kindness, his humor, and his excellent French.

The experience doesn't end with the cooking class; we also enjoyed the presence of an artist who presented traditional dances and music.

And the surprise doesn't end there, because you'll leave with your own recipe book and certificate!

I don't share some of the negative reviews about Yves, whom I found welcoming and unique.
He had anecdotes to share and took the time to talk with us about his experience in Thailand.
He might seem a bit gruff, but I found him endearing.

reviews.name: Chapel Xavier
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une excellente matinée avec Folk et sa famille! Tout était vraiment bien pensé et fait dans la bonne humeur et avec beaucoup d’empathie. Tout le monde était très chaleureux et très attentionné, ils s’adaptent à tous les âges et à tous les goûts: nous étions avec nos 2 enfants de 12 et 14 ans qui ont adoré et nous avons une personne végétarienne dans l’équipe.
Ne passez pas à côté de ce moment unique à partager avec une équipe formidable!!
Merci Folk pour ta gentillesse et ta bonne humeur, merci aussi à ta maman et à toute l’équipe!!
reviews.textTranslated:
We had a wonderful morning with Folk and his family! Everything was so well thought out and done with such good humor and empathy. Everyone was so warm and attentive, and they cater to all ages and tastes: we were there with our two children, ages 12 and 14, who loved it, and we even had a vegetarian member of the team.
Don't miss out on this unique experience with such a fantastic team!
Thank you, Folk, for your kindness and good humor, and thank you to your mother and the whole team!

reviews.name: Maëlle Sampson (Malou)
reviews.text:
Le cours de cuisine était formidable, nous avons autant appris sur la culture que sur la nourriture ! Pook et Folk, avec beaucoup d’humour et de bienveillance nous ont accompagné dans ce moment d’apprentissage tout comme le reste du personnel.

Les plats étaient excellents et nous sommes même repartis avec les recettes que nous avions réalisé.

C’était un véritable échange culturel. N’hésitez pas à y aller, vous ne serez pas déçus et repartirez avec bien plus que des recettes !
reviews.textTranslated:
The cooking class was fantastic; we learned as much about the culture as we did about the food! Pook and Folk, with their great humor and kindness, guided us through this learning experience, as did the rest of the staff.

The dishes were excellent, and we even left with the recipes we had made.

It was a true cultural exchange. Don't hesitate to go; you won't be disappointed, and you'll leave with much more than just recipes!

reviews.name: Marie Pelcé
reviews.text:
Super expérience je ne peux que recommander ! Nous étions avec Folk qui est thai mais qui parle très bien français et qui nous a dispensé le cours
Il prend le temps, est patient et a beaucoup d’humour, le cours est passé super vite !
Il était accompagné de sa mère et d’une équipe également adorable
On repart d’ailleurs avec son livre de recette mais également son petit diplôme
À faire absolument !
reviews.textTranslated:
Fantastic experience, I highly recommend it! We were with Folk, who is Thai but speaks excellent French and taught us the class.
He takes his time, is patient, and has a great sense of humor; the class flew by!
He was accompanied by his mother and a lovely team. We even left with his recipe book and a little certificate. A must-do!

reviews.name: Isa
reviews.text:
Je ne peux que recommander le cours de Pook et Folk. Une organisation millimétré, où la journée passe incroyablement vite ! On y apprend quelques subtilités de la cuisine thaïlandaise et on repart avec son livret de recettes, un vrai plus pour pouvoir prolonger la magie en France. Le fait d’avoir le cours en français est un vrai plus quand on est pas parfaitement bilingue ! Et Folk maitrise très bien le français et l’humour. Nous avons appris, cuisiné et dégusté dans une ambiance chaleureuse et bienveillante. Nous étions un groupe de 8, 4 adultes et 4 enfants et tout le monde était ravi sans exception !!
Merci a cette jolie famille !!
reviews.textTranslated: I highly recommend Pook and Folk's cooking class. It's meticulously organized, and the day flies by! You learn some of the finer points of Thai cuisine and leave with a recipe booklet, a real bonus for extending the magic back home. Having the class in French is a real plus, especially if you're not perfectly bilingual! And Folk speaks excellent French and has a great sense of humor. We learned, cooked, and tasted in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. We were a group of eight—four adults and four children—and everyone was thrilled! Thank you to this lovely family!

reviews.name: MARINE SANQUER
reviews.text:
Magnifique expérience.
Ce cours restera un des beaux moments marquants de notre voyage.
Énormément d’humour et de complicité !
J’espère pouvoir refaire les recettes à Paris.
En tout cas mon diplôme sera affich sur le frigo de la cuisine et impressionnera mes invités 😆!
Merci pour tout et à toute l’équipe. 🙏
reviews.textTranslated:
A wonderful experience.

This class will remain one of the highlights of our trip.
So much humor and camaraderie!

I hope to be able to recreate these recipes in Paris.
In any case, my certificate will be proudly displayed on the kitchen fridge and will impress my guests! 😆
Thank you so much to the whole team. 🙏

reviews.name: Dubois Marie lou
reviews.text:
Ne réfléchissez plus réservez !

C’est une super expérience à faire ! Tout le monde y est super adorable, drôles et souriants !

La nourriture qu’on y prépare est super et on apprend de nombreuses choses.
Tout au long du cours on cuisine, on rit, on apprend, et on goûte mais on ne voit pas le temps passer !

Nous y avons en plus rencontré des français sympathiques.

Nous l’avons conseillé à tous les français qu’on a croisé ensuite alors vraiment pas de doute allez y !

Une super expérience !
reviews.textTranslated:
Don't hesitate, book now!

It's a fantastic experience! Everyone there is so lovely, funny, and always smiling!

The food they prepare is amazing, and you learn so much!

Throughout the class, you cook, laugh, learn, and taste, but the time just flies by!

We also met some really nice French people there.

We recommended it to every French person we met afterward, so honestly, go for it!

A fantastic experience!

reviews.name: Mylène
reviews.text: Une super expérience ! Cours de journée en petit groupe, beaucoup de gentillesse, d'humour et de pédagogie. Tout est extrêmement bien organisé,  depuis le transfert depuis notre hôtel, l'accueil, les cours ... à la fin nous déjeunons avec les plats préparés.  Pook et Folk ont été d'excellents profs car c'était délicieux. Un grand merci à vous tous ! Nous recommandons vivement.
reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic experience! A daytime course in a small group, full of kindness, humor, and excellent teaching skills. Everything was extremely well organized, from the transfer from our hotel and the welcome to the classes themselves... right up until lunch, where we enjoyed the prepared dishes. Pook and Folk were excellent instructors because the food was delicious. A huge thank you to you all! We highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Florian Descottes
reviews.text:
Première fois que je participais à un cours de cuisine, et sûrement pas la dernière au vu de cette première expérience ! La barre a été mise bien haute !
À notre arrivée, Yves, français d'origine et amoureux de la Thaïlande, nous a partagé les us et coutumes de ce fabuleux pays afin d'éviter de se comporter comme de "simples" touristes pour la suite de notre voyage. Enfin, le plus inoubliable de cette expérience se trouve dans l'accompagnement et les conseils de sa famille, Pook et Folk notamment, qui ont été adorables. Tout cela dans une ambiance intimiste et familiale.
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time taking a cooking class, and certainly not my last, judging by this first experience! The bar was set very high!
Upon our arrival, Yves, originally from France and a lover of Thailand, shared the customs and traditions of this fabulous country with us so we wouldn't behave like "just" tourists for the rest of our trip. Finally, the most unforgettable part of this experience was the support and advice of his family, especially Pook and Folk, who were absolutely lovely. All of this took place in a warm and intimate atmosphere.

reviews.name: Stéphanie Testini
reviews.text: J’ai adoré le cours de cuisine donné par Pook et sa famille. Le cours est donné en français, dans la joie, bonne humeur, pédagogie et authenticité! C’est un de mes plus beaux souvenirs de mon voyage en Thaïlande ! Simplement merci 🫶!
reviews.textTranslated: I loved the cooking class given by Pook and his family. The class was taught in French, with joy, good humor, excellent teaching skills, and authenticity! It's one of my best memories of my trip to Thailand! Simply thank you! 🫶

reviews.name: VERYPATRIP
reviews.text:
Nous avions participé à un cours de cuisine en 2015 dans cette « école » et nous avions tellement aimé l'ambiance que nous y sommes revenus avec notre fille
C'est encore mieux qu'avant !! Le cours est donné par Folk le fils de la maison et il a un humour qui bien animé notre cours de cuisine Nous avons bien appris à reconnaître et utiliser toutes les épices et aromates locaux, et nous avons préparé le menu que nous avons ensuite dégusté devant un petit spectacle de danse
Thaï
Les points fort de ce cours sont :
- La langue Francophone
- Le petit groupe de personnes qui rend le cours très interactif
- l'ambiance familiale
- ils viennent vous chercher à votre hôtel
Remise d'un livre de cuisine avec vos recettes à la fin👍🏼

💡 Retrouvez d’autres idées d’évasions et de découvertes sur mon compte de partage de loisirs et de voyages sur Instagram :
@very_pat_trip 🧳🌍
reviews.textTranslated:
We took a cooking class at this "school" in 2015 and loved the atmosphere so much that we came back with our daughter.
It's even better than before!! The class is taught by Folk, the owner's son, and his humor really livened things up. We learned to recognize and use all the local spices and herbs, and we prepared a menu that we then enjoyed while watching a short Thai dance performance.

The highlights of this class are:

- The French language is spoken
- The small group size makes the class very interactive
- The friendly, family atmosphere
- They pick you up from your hotel
You receive a cookbook with your recipes at the end 👍🏼

💡 Find more ideas for getaways and discoveries on my Instagram account for sharing leisure and travel experiences:
@very_pat_trip 🧳🌍

reviews.name: Manon Sepret

Expérience à ne pas manquer avec Yves, POOK, FOLK et toute leur équipe.
Nous avons passé un très agréable moment au sein de cette joyeuse et adorable famille.
Tout est fait pour que nous passions un moment riche en savoirs, sans perdre de temps. Et c’est une sacrée réussite! Qui plus est pour nos papilles. Repas de roi, bien l’un de nos meilleurs jusque là!
Il est aussi très agréable de repartir avec les recettes réalisées en français.
Merci pour votre gentillesse, bienveillance et tout ce travail.
Romain et Manon
reviews.textTranslated:
An experience not to be missed with Yves, POOK, FOLK, and their entire team.

We had a wonderful time with this joyful and lovely family.
Everything is done to ensure we have a truly enriching experience without wasting any time. And it was a resounding success! What's more, it was a feast fit for a king, easily one of our best meals so far!

It was also a real treat to leave with the recipes written in French.

Thank you for your kindness, thoughtfulness, and all your hard work.
Romain and Manon

reviews.name: Jialong Liu
reviews.text:
This massage place is probably the one that  I won't imagine walking past by chance. It's deep down an alley (not that dark as some mentioned) with a bar and a few eateries, before making a left turn to see it.
Not the most convenient, but definitely one of the better ones!

The environment was alot nicer and has a touch of Thai, unlike the more modern looking or the totally "rustic" ones at patong. The lack of cars and people around the area does help as well.

Price wise, not the cheapest, neither the most expensive (see price list in my pic).

I did a Head, Shoulder and back massage for the first night and it was good. The technique the masseur used was Abit different from most other Thai. I felt so much better at the end of the massage. Only thing that bothered me was the position of my head... Alike most other Thai massage places, they do not have a "hole" for us to put our heads in when lying down. But no big issue for me.

Next day, I did I foot massage at only 250baht (most ard the area are 300, and some are 200bahts) and I realised I really love this environment.
Massage was good as well, although slightly softer which I could have easily informed her. But it was so comfortable and I appreciate when they allocate Abt 15min on my hands and back! So it's not entirely on foot but no complaints!
My best massage place among my 4 massages during this trip!

Will be back here everytime I come back to Phuket!

reviews.name: Minh Vo
reviews.text:
It was my first time learning how to make pastries and choosing Chef Lucas studio has been my right choice so far.
The class was less than 8 people and we were supported nicely throughout the course.
I have learned a lot from this with many useful tips and I decided to registered for the croissant class 😍
After the course, I could bring my cakes home and my friends totally loved it.
10/10 for my experience here

reviews.name: Nawarat Undech
reviews.text:
I’ve taken three baking classes with Chef Lucas, and every class has been a fantastic experience! The atmosphere is fun, welcoming, and very hands-on—you get to do every step yourself, so you really learn the techniques instead of just watching.

The recipes are delicious, and Chef Lucas explains everything clearly while sharing lots of practical tips that are useful whether you’re a home baker or a professional looking to improve your skills.

If you’re Thai, don’t worry about the language. The Thai team does an excellent job translating and is incredibly supportive throughout the class. They’re patient, friendly, and always happy to help. What I appreciate most is that they continue to answer questions even after the class, which shows how much they care about their students.

I’ve learned so much from these classes and always leave feeling inspired to bake more at home. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to improve their baking skills in a fun and supportive environment!

reviews.name: Phantira Chetbundit
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Chef Lucas Baking Studio! Last Saturday, I joined the one-day croissant class, and it was fantastic. Even though making croissants was a bit challenging for me, the chef (can speak  French and English) and teaching assistant (can speak Thai and English) were so helpful and guided me through every step. The studio is well-organized, and the teaching style is clear and engaging. I had so much fun learning and practicing all day. Highly recommend this studio to anyone interested in baking!

reviews.name: Puja Koirala
reviews.text:
"Chef, your kitchen is my happy place, and I'm so grateful to have shared it with you 😊. Thanks for believing in me and pushing me to be my best self."
"I'm still pinching myself – I got to learn from the best! 🙏 Thanks for sharing your expertise and passion with me, Chef."
"Your kitchen is where magic happens, and I'm honored to have been a part of it 🍰. Thanks for making me feel like family, Chef."
Thanks for teaching me so much and making it look effortless 😄."
"Chef, you're the reason I love baking – you made it an art form in my eyes. Thanks for inspiring me! Thanks again chef Lucas ❤️‍🔥
From puja koirala's

reviews.name: Valerika Darasteanu
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Chef Lucas professional Pastry & Bakery diploma highly enough.
Chef Lucas is a very knowledgeable Pastry chef, and he is always ready to answer all questions and clarify any doubts. He demonstrates all recipes' steps and techniques first, and then all students can proceed to replicate the dessert at their own stations. Chef Lucas and his assistant are always monitoring the students, and assistance is given when needed.
I am a professional chef and I found the course perfect to learn new skills and brush old ones up; I certainly got inspired to try more Pastry and Bread making as soon as I will resume working and feel more confident in offering my future guests new desserts.
I very much enjoyed the international classes. Lucas and his assistant speak fluent English Thai and French, so nobody missed a single step of all explanations.
Thank you again for the wonderful time!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We are glad you enjoyed the course and wish you the best for your career!

reviews.name: Yangdon 75
reviews.text: I had the most wonderful experience at the studio. It was truly the best decision of my trip. Chef Lucas explained everything with great patience and attention to detail. The staff were incredibly helpful, and the studio maintained excellent hygiene and was fully equipped. I’m truly grateful for such an amazing class.

reviews.name: Calyn B
reviews.text: Time well-spent with Chef Lucas' team. The 5-hr class was just enough to upgrade one's baking skill. I took the choux and eclair class, there were 8 of us. All the materials including the recipes are provided.We even got to take home everything that we made and share with friends and family! Chef Lucas was able to make the baking steps easy to digest so you can really remake everything on your own. I couldn't believe I was able to make these beautiful and yummy pastries on my own (attached some photos).  He and his assistant were also very attentive and very open to questions and provides tips to help us learn better. 10/10 recommend. Will definitely try to attend his other classes when I get back to Thailand

reviews.name: Kavin Phuntarakit
reviews.text:
I took Sourdough & Pizza class and I had an amazing experience at Chef Lucas Baking Studio!!

I haven’t thought of taking any baking class until I found this studio. It is my first time in baking and Chef Lucus did the best in teaching.

Clear explanations during the class so I haven’t to worry if I should do something wrong.

Systematic syllabus and managed class that Chef Lucas and staffs are able to control sequences and time, while the students can enjoy baking seamlessly.

The class also offers translation in Thai. She did her very best and is always helpful. No worries for those Thai who might not good in English.

Professional staff who always busy keeping equipment clean and ready, also the overall cleanliness of the studio.

All equipment and ingredients are well-prepared.

However, though there is no parking available at the studio but the location is superb! It is easy access to the studio with walkable distance from BTS Phra Khanong

I would recommend this studio (also already recommended to my friends since I finished the class). I will also definitely be back in class again for another amazing baking class.

reviews.name: Norine O.
reviews.text: Thank you Chef and the team for the wonderful experience! We had such a great time joining the one-week Chocolate Making Class. The class was small and intimate, which made the experience even more enjoyable. We learned so much and enjoyed every moment. We’ll definitely be back for more classes in the future!✨

reviews.name: Hnin Yoo_Yar
reviews.text:
If you’re in Bangkok and looking to improve your baking skills, I highly recommend Chef Lucas Baking Studio! Thanks to my sister’s recommendation, I had such a great experience here. It’s an international baking class taught in English by a French chef, making it perfect for both locals and expats. The prices are reasonable, and you even get a certificate after completing the course—what more could you ask for? 😍*

*I took two classes: the Pastry Classics (Tiramisu, Brownie, Blueberry Cheesecake) and the Croissant Class (Original, Almond, Chocolate, Timber Ring). Everything was hands-on, and the chef’s step-by-step guidance made it so easy to follow, even for beginners. The best part? You get to eat what you bake! And trust me, everyone who tried my creations said they were absolutely delicious. 😬*

*The location is super convenient—just a short walk from Phra Khanong BTS. If you’re into baking or just want a fun, rewarding activity in Bangkok, don’t miss this place! 🤩

reviews.name: Christele Fock
reviews.text:
I went to Chef Lucas 1-day baking class for croissants, and it was totally worth it. 🥰
I’ll advise to bring your phone/camera so you can take videos and picture during the workshop so you can record and more easily remember some of the explained techniques later on.

Everything is provided on-site, so you don’t have to bring anything apart from your learning mind, be ready to use your hands, and bring lots of delicious pastries afterwards. 🤤

The workshop is taught in English, with a Thai translator person on-site too.
The number of people in the class is kept small, so it feels like having a private class. Chef Lucas and his staff were super helpful, and patiently answered all questions, plus took the time to check that we didn’t have any issues during each part of the process.

We also received lots of useful tips about how to choose our ingredients or tune the process to our timeline.

At the end of the workshop, not only I brought back what I shaped and baked on spot, but I also could bring back home an extra laminated dough that I did use later at home.

My friends were super happy to enjoy fresh pastries in the next days 🙌
I’ll certainly keep an eye in the next baking workshop opportunities 🥰

Thanks again!!!

reviews.name: NEXT VEST LTD (NEXT VEST LTD)
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Chef Lucy’s Baking Studio. The location is very convenient and easy to access, which makes attending sessions hassle-free. The staff are extremely friendly, supportive, and well-organised throughout the class.

Chef Lucas stands out with his detailed explanations and teaching style. He patiently listens to all your questions and makes sure everyone understands each step clearly, which is very helpful, especially for beginners.

The recipe book provided is clean, simple, and very easy to follow, making it perfect for practicing at home.

Overall, I truly loved the session and would highly recommend it to anyone interested in baking!

reviews.name: Shachar Bar David
reviews.text: I completed the Grand baking course and the experience was great. Chef Lucas is extremely helpful and friendly and provides descriptive answers to many baking questions. The course includes a variety of different pastries and baked goods and helps teach the essential skills needed. The processes and recipes are broken down to each step which are simple and straightforward to follow. The class size is also small so Chef Lucas is able to provide extra assistance if necessary. Overall the course was exceptional and very informative.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the review, and we wish you the best for your professional projects!

reviews.name: Yamone Oo
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with this baking course! I learned the techniques, foundations and some very good recipes. Most of all I really enjoyed the classes. Lastly, I'm thankful for the Chef's helpfulness and patience towards us. All the best to Chef Lucas and his team!!!

The classes are well organized, enjoyable, and very informative, and the recipes provided are excellent. I shared the pastries I made with my neighbors, and they absolutely loved them.
I look forward to attending another class with Chef Lucas in the future.

reviews.name: Wila Nakara

I returned home with a tonne of goodies🥯🥖🍩🍞🥖🍩🥯🥖 and I will surely return to learn baking in other classes🥳

reviews.name: Ko Zwe Naing Aung
reviews.text:
Hello! 👋  This is Zwe.

One of a student attended from Chef Lucas Baking Studio. As a student, I am really proud of learning basic bakery and pastry courses from Chef. Everyone smile at me and warmly welcomed. Honestly, I personally found this bakery school the most effective for me. Because we have learnt not only in paper but also in practical.
During operations, we would be offered the same equality equipments per person. That means there will be no panics or no disasters or no rush fighting for an equipment between students.
Students also help to each others if they see the others are struggling. We could bring any items that we made at school to our homes. I shared with my family, my friends and my relatives all together to get as much as honest reviews. They would not believe if I could not show my certificate because it was too delicious and tasted very authentic. However, I would never stop learning or I would be coming back to Chef and try another courses.👨‍🍳

🙏🏻I feel very special and welcomed learning at this bakery school. Chef is the most patient and the most inspiring.

With regards,
Zwe

reviews.name: Ehhser Wah
reviews.text: As a complete beginner, attending bakery classes at Chef Lucas Baking Studio was an incredible learning experience! The classes were well-structured, hands-on, and easy to follow. The instructor was patient and supportive, making baking feel approachable and fun. I gained essential skills, from handling dough to decorating, and now feel confident trying recipes on my own. Highly recommend for anyone starting their baking journey!

reviews.name: Thant Zin
reviews.text: Very nice baking studio , especially the one-day class. Suitable for all ages and no experience needed for that class. Now I can make the many delicious croissants because of the Chef Lucas.

reviews.name: Christian Breitkreutz
reviews.text:

reviews.text:
Came here multiple times during our time in Karon. The staff here are very professional and lovely, they were very kind to our 2 year old son when we brought him along with us to rest and relax. Highly recommend coming here to support this little massage place! 😊
Not a very clear photo but just to show how happy and delightful the staff are here!
Side note, the space is very clean and calming!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Omg !! Thank you ❤️🤗

reviews.name: Paul Compton
reviews.text:
I'm not one for a massage, however this was very nice. The place was very clean and very professional. Had a coconut milk massage which was pleasant enough. My partner had a aloe Vera one (good for burns), and yeh it was alright. I would say it was a soft massage but ok for my first time. I'll definitely be going back for maybe a bit more vigorous especially on my back and shoulders but very nice.

So update to this review, went back for another go. Guys if you're reading I recommend the "Thai oil massage" much deeper and a bit more going on than the coconut one. I've been pulled and pushed into positions I've never been in, however I feel fantastic afterwards! I read some poor reviews on massage places and this one is top class! You won't be disappointed!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ❤️❤️thank you for kindness review 🙏🏻❤️❤️

reviews.name: Kristina Mlynarczyk
reviews.text:
Thai massage by Natty is something everyone should try. If you’re in Phuket, you have to come here - it was the best Thai massage I’ve ever had. I’ve never had my trigger points worked on so deeply and precisely before.

Make sure to show this photo, and they’ll book you specifically with Natty. It truly makes a difference from the very first minute.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kindness review ❤️🙏🏻

reviews.name: Helen Mallon
reviews.text: What a fabulous experience!  We went this morning for a one hour foot massage and loved it so much we came back this afternoon for a couples Thai massage with oil for 90 minutes.   Amazing!!!!  The staff are friendly and it started pouring down as we were about to leave so they gifted us raincoats - 5 stars and definitely coming back again - thank you ladies, Helen and Tony from NZ
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much ❤️you’re so kind 🙏🏻😍

reviews.name: Haesal
reviews.text:
We made a reservation in advance, but when we arrived, the staff told us there were no available seats.
They apologized briefly and said they had accepted other Russian customers instead.

There was no proper explanation or attempt to resolve the situation.
We came as scheduled based on our reservation, but were simply turned away.

Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this place if you expect reservations to be respected.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I have to ask the customer because when the customer came to book, the customer was in a hurry and rushed to the hotel, so we did not ask Thai what the customer would massage. The shop therefore understood that the customer would massage the body and locked the three-bed room, which is a private room for the customer. When the customer arrived, the customer came to inform that he would massage the feet, but we had already received the customer and the same booking customer and the customer booked as well, but he stated that he would massage the feet, so there was no foot massage for the customer. I have to apologize for not being clear what to book.🙏🏻so sorry 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Rini Smith
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional ladies . The relaxing atmosphere and treatments are top notch. The tea and fruit after the treatments are a nice touch . Value for money . Should I ever return to Phuket , this will be again on my list of must do's.

I had aroma massage (90 min) for three days there, basically everyday I was in Karon and I was sad to leave Karon just for this massage shop. Highly recommended.

title: Kin Kub Chef
