reviews.name: Kasem Aofficial
reviews.text:
The food here is absolutely delicious. Every dish was beautifully prepared and presented, with well balanced flavors and a great variety of options to choose from. Overall, I was very impressed with the quality of the food.
The main area I think could be improved is the service. I would recommend providing a little more training for the staff, especially when it comes to presenting the dishes and explaining what each dish is when it is served. It would also be better to clear the plates properly before serving dessert. With some improvements in these small details, the overall dining experience could be even better.

reviews.name: J Ta
reviews.text: This is one of my go-to spots! The dishes are crafted by a hotel-level chef, with quality that far exceeds the price. Whether it’s bold, flavorful Thai single dishes or pasta and steak, everything is top-notch. The prices? Super reasonable! You might have to wait 30-60 minutes depending on the time, but trust me, it’s worth every second. Highly recommended! หรอยยคับ ต้องไป

reviews.name: Shwe Yamin
reviews.text:
Went there with some friends, the atmosphere was nice though there were some groups who’d be talking loudly. They have seats and tables for both indoors and outdoors. The food menu was on a digital menu that you have to scan the QR and order by yourselves. The tuna salad I ordered was pretty delicious but you cannot opt out the add ons. The drinks menu is with a booklet and they have a quite strange one named “Coffee Beer”. I hope anyone who tries that one would let me know how it tastes. ✌️
The lasagna with the spinach is also a good one too.

reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Phuket Old Town. We come here all the time and the staff and chefs are super friendly. The food is very tasty and they have a great variety of western and Thai dishes. Prices are very reasonable as well. I come here with my daughter all the time.

reviews.text: Great value for high quality food with Thai and European/Italian + fusion dishes on the menu. Pizza and pasta too! Has outdoor and indoor aircon seating. Reservations can be made in advance for indoor seating. Cooked to order with fresh ingredients. We come here often!

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Spinach Lasagna, Tempura Shrimp, Crab Omelet, Scallop, Salad And

reviews.name: PK PO
reviews.text: Every time I go here, it's delicious. Every time, the taste is delicious. The quantity is a great. There are many menus to choose from. Every menu is delicious. All the staff are lovely and friendly . And this is another restaurant that I recommend. all the foods taste and quantity, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.name: Jonathan Cottrell
reviews.text: This spot is outstanding. The menu has a little bit of everything to offer varied tastes and diets, including my gluten free, picky, and vegetarian eaters—difficult to feed all of in one place in Thailand. Everyone enjoyed their meals, but the standout items were surely the tropical crème brûlée and delicious Italian sodas. This place is so inviting on a cool evening in Thailand, complete with sparkly light exteriors that draw you in. It’s well worth the visit.

reviewContext.Vegetarian options: Lots of vegetarian options, from pasta to gyoza to salads to pizza…and more.
reviewContext.Dietary restrictions: Each of my gluten free and vegetarian children both loved this place and the menu options provided. It satisfied us all.
reviewContext.Kid-friendliness: There are more options beyond Thai fare for westerners looking for something different. It met my three children’s desires each uniquely. Highly recommended for western families.

reviews.text: Chef was very kind to us, we ordered pumkin soup and also wanted to try mushroom soup. They served us on free of charge as we ordered many food. And the food were great with good price i must say. Ribeye was a little tents for me but other than that everything were great. Service,environment,pricing.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Spinach Lasagna, Avocado Almond Milk Smoothie

reviews.name: Julie Okros
reviews.text: We stay in Phuket town for 3 months over the winter and frequent this restaurant several times a week. Their food, service and atmosphere never fails to amaze us. We never leave this place disappointed.

reviews.name: Hotel White Mansion Phnom Penh

reviews.name: Amanda

reviews.name: Chang Thai Motorbike rental
reviews.text: If you're looking for delicious food in Phuket town, Kin Kub Chef is a great option. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including steak, spaghetti, Thai food, desserts, and coffee. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff is attentive and friendly. The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous, making it an excellent value for money.

reviews.name: Britt Beyond Borders (travel designer)
reviews.text:
This is one of the most affordable “western food” you’ll find in old town. Very good price and portion ratio.
They do have a small menu of thai food.
Wi-Fi is fast. Atmosphere is nice and calm. I’ve only visited for lunch. They have wine and beer and almond milk. Coffee is ok.

Order a mixed smoothie: passion fruit and avocado almond milk and thank me later! It’s creamy, not too sweet and a lovely punch of flavor. The Chicken karage, mixed salad, and wraps are also recommended.

There’s one waitress that does AMAZING in the lunch rush. Come before 12 to get a seat inside the air conditioned dining room. There is outdoor seating but no one is brave enough to sit there.

reviews.name: Isabelle in Phuket
reviews.text:
Kin Kub Chef

Cute place to enjoy with friends.

Dinner for 2:
🥟Gyoza Japanese (79 THB) - crispy and delicious. Comes with sauce on the side.

🍗Chicken Karaage (89 THB) - crispy from outside, tender from the inside. Slightly feel the ginger, overall great taste.

🍔Wagyu beef burger (159 THB) - big disappointment.
Seems like everyone using the word ‘Wagyu’ to sell. This is defiantly doesn’t taste like it. Taste very industrial.
I asked MR as I like bloody meat, but since it’s not a real meat (more like processed meat, there was no blood - which is a bad sign for meat).
The meat was COLD, the cheese on top didn’t even melt.
The ban was hot and crispy, perfectly cooked. I will NOT RECOMMEND this dish at all.

🍝Spinach Lasagna (129 THB) - delicious. Cooked perfectly, generous with the cheese. Good size of portion.

🍧Matcha creme brûlée (89 THB) - Served inside open coconut, with coconut ice cream on the side. Presentation is amazing (very insta friendly), taste is superb.

🍹Passion fruit soda - Too much sugar. Served in plastic cup - which is very disappointing.

Value for price - most dishes are fairly priced.

Service - friendly service, waiters speaks well English.

Atmosphere - there isn’t a special vibe or atmosphere. Fluorescent light a bit too strong, soft lightening would give the place a better charm.

Parking - there is some parking spots in front, but nothing organize.

Before trying the food we were already interested to come back and try some stakes, but after the experience with the burger I suspect the meat is about the same quality - which means low, almost industrial. So very likely won’t come back to try those.
First dishes & dessert are great tho!

Nice place to share a meal with friends or family.

reviews.name: Louis
reviews.text:
Nice restaurant although the western style foods were not great.
Thai food was really good. Salmon spicy salad was good with a lot of salmon. Salmon steak and rice also really good.
T-bone steak not so good. For Thai food it was a bit expensive but the place looks good so I guess it was worth it.

reviews.name: Thitayakorn Thirati
reviews.text: A small restaurant with a basic menu that comes with such a great taste! Our pasta and ribs were delicious. Not touristy and not many options for local specialty food but this is a good place for everyday meal.  Three dishes, one rice, one water, and one iced tea for around 500 baht. You can park on the street.

reviews.text: I had such a great time learning how to bake here. The instructor is very professional and thorough, she made sure I follow through. The academy is well maintain with up-to-date equipment. There is a cute restaurant/cafe that is also own by the academy downstair.

Highly, highly recommended!

I’m so glad I found Sweet Cottage Academy.

reviews.text: First of all,the instructors there were all nice.They taught me the details & very patient & friendly as well.They can teach well in English.The classrooms were very spacious & clean.Very satisfied with the classes there.Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Today, I learned to make a crepe cake with three sauces with "Chef Pla" She is very nice and she explained every step in detail, providing techniques and tips for the recipe. reviews.text: The teachers are really helpful, friendly and well prepared with the ingredients and tools needed, and the classrooms were clean. They even gave us a dessert to try during our lesson and we could also bring anything we made in class home. Not only that, they gave each of us a copy of the recipe and even a list of where to the the tools and ingredients, too. Overall, me and my friend had a really great experience and fun time during all of our lessons.

The Classroom was clean and all ingredients very professionally laid out. Both the instructors were really good and answered all my queries patiently.

reviews.name: Yashwant Raj Paul
reviews.text: We took a couple of courses with Sweets Cottage Academy, i.e. Basic Bread-making course & Pizza course.  Chef Foam, Chef Baifern and Ms. Pretty (our translator) were the absolute best guides and mentors - their professional approach and meticulous planning made the entire process simple, quick and easy to learn.  They patiently cleared all doubts that we had.  The course booking process was handled by Ms. Nan who was extremely polite and courteous in helping us figure out which courses to take.  All in all, a highly recommendable institute.  I look forward to visiting again.  With love from India.

reviews.name: Mark Findlay
reviews.text: Superb location.  The Sea Time Cafe & pool.look out onto Chalong Bay. The resort is several hundred meters back from the main road so it is peaceful. The resort is in a tropical setting with two decent sized & well maintained pools. The staff are excellent & friendly. The happy hour at the  Sea Time Cafe from  4 pm to 7 pm make it great value (2 for the price of one). My only criticism is the bathroom needs a bit of maintenance needs a new shower head holder, the towel rail is not secured properly & the shower water does not drain properly (insufficient gradient) Other rooms may not suffer these problems.  Overall very happy.

reviews.text: We stayed for 10 nights. We only used the hotel to sleep. The staff were lovely could not fault them at all. Breakfast was included but it was not worth getting up for. The choices were not enough. The bread was hard. Croissants were hard. Our room was ok but not much space at all. Wardrobe door was broken We had to leave everything in the suitcase. The shower definitely needs a new on as the one we had was old and just hanging on. The beach was not a beach. The pools look like they needed a good clean it was not worth staying at all. We never used the pool facilities. Food and drink last order was 9.30pm which is too early as everything closes at 10pm. The hotel was far from everything we took a uber daily and went out daily. It cost us money on this but it was better being at the beach and days out than staying in the hotel. I dont usually like to give a bad review but this hotel needs some work on.

reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed staying at this hotel. Away from the craziness, really calm and peaceful. The hotel feels like a family run hotel, with care. Time stands still here, allowing you to unwind and relax. The view from the delicious breakfast is dreamlike. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Steven Tran
reviews.text: Location is off the normal path, making driving pretty difficult if you do not memorize your street.  Cozy and relaxing atmosphere.  If you do not need any service it is an awesome place to stay.  If you do need service than make sure to ask or pay in advance because the price is like the stock market. Always fluctuating.  Coffee in your room is free but if you go to the restaurant…it is 100 baht for a coffee, 150 baht for the whole breakfast but if you have another person it is 500 baht.  I need to go back to math class.

reviews.name: John Hawkwind

reviews.name: Craig Boorman
reviews.text: A lovely, smaller hotel with a really nice, authentic vibe. Staff are wonderful and very attentive. Rooms could do with a better clean though as mould in the grout in shower area was quite excessive and floors always seemed to be dirty in the room. It has a very small beach it shares with a local neighbourhood behind but this does virtually disappear at high tide. Overall very fairly priced and a nice place to stay would come again

reviews.name: Kieran Jones
reviews.text: It's a nice enough hotel, not a great spot if you don't have a bike or car to get around. Rooms was decent enough and the pools are really nice.

reviews.name: babsicles62
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel for 3 weeks it was very peaceful and quiet there’s a bus that will take you to the beach 3X a week one way you have to get a taxi back. The food in the hotel couldn’t be faulted we had a standard room that was exactly that 5 hangers no storage for clothes and a nice big cockroach in the bathroom bedding was not changed daily only bed kind of made cleanliness of the room was not great be careful not to leave the door open as flies and mosquitoes get in and bite ,but the staff were all very friendly and the grounds and pool were being constantly swept, if you get there early when you first arrive you can’t have a breakfast and won’t be able to get in the room till 2:00pm. There is a lovely view from the pool onto the beach but it’s not somewhere you would lay on the sand and go in the sea it’s more for boats and fishing the nearest beach is poo island kata beach about 15 minutes on the shuttle bus. There’s shops restaurants and bars of all kinds at the beach and also a night market and loads of food and drink stalls where you can go with a buzzy atmosphere back at the hotel there’s not a lot to do just a chill out place . Overall a nice relaxing time but would definitely not go for a standard room. This place is quite remote if you just want pool and sunbed it’s perfect

reviews.name: Menno Kremers
reviews.text: It’s like all the other reviews describe. We gaan an amazing time cooking with Opal. She and her husband are such great people, we had so much laughs with them. She picked us up at our hotel and took us to a local market. She described all the ingredients we bought for the cooking class. Then we left to the cooking location, an idyllic little place in the country side. We had a great time cooking and eating 5 different dishes.

reviews.name: Alexia R
reviews.text:
I’m so happy I chose Sukjai Cooking School for my cooking experience! From the moment I booked to the final drop-off, I could really feel how much Opal loves sharing her passion for food and hospitality. Communication was super clear and easy from the start.

I’d read about other schools having big classes, old tools, and feeling rushed — but this was the total opposite. The class size was just right, and Aim made it so much fun — “Chin up, chest up, and grind!” 😊 She made sure everyone felt comfortable and included. The ingredients were fresh, and everything was well-organized. Like others have mentioned, we stopped at a local market, and I learned so much about the local vegetables that are staples of Thai cuisine.

The location of the school is perfect — less than 30 minutes from the busy Old Town. It’s beautiful and peaceful, surrounded by a pond with ducks and fresh air all around. Such a relaxing and happy place to spend the day! We cooked (and ate!) so much amazing food that I had to skip dinner afterward.

It was truly one of the highlights of my trip — warm, welcoming, and full of good vibes. I’d 100% recommend Sukjai Cooking School to anyone looking for a genuine and memorable Thai cooking experience.

reviews.name: Maya Kretchmer
reviews.text:
Amazing cooking class!
We were a small group of 5 and the experience felt very intimate.
Opal is so sweet and funny, she and her husband are very nice and welcoming.
The visit to the local market was fun and we got to learn about all the ingredients we cooked with.
Everything that we cooked was exceptional and place itself is also nice, the view to the rice fields is lovely.
I would recommend this for the experience and for the chance to meet and support such a sweet family.
סדנה מעולה עם מדריכה מקסימה! הכל היה ממש טעים ובאווירה טובה. מומלץ בחום

reviews.name: Viktoria Krzyszczyk
reviews.text:
We loved this cooking class! Opal led the entire class with so much passion and humor and explained every step clearly and with genuine enthusiasm. We especially loved the visit to the local market, where she showed us the key ingredients. Everything in the kitchen was perfectly organized and Opal supported us at every step, always with a smile and helpful tips. The dishes we prepared under her guidance were simply delicious.

We had an amazing time and felt truly well taken care of throughout the entire experience. We can highly recommend Sukjai Home Cooking School to anyone who wants to experience authentic Thai cooking in a friendly and inspiring atmosphere.

reviews.name: Sam
reviews.text:
The BEST evening at Sukjal cooking school!

Opal picked us up and took us to a local market where she explained different local ingredients and picked out the fresh vegetables we would be cooking with. She drove us to the cooking school set in the countryside, it was beautiful and the facilities were very nice. Everything was well thought out, there was insect spray, a cold water filter and the cooking area was very clean.

Opal was super knowledgeable, funny and helpful with cooking. We had 5 courses (though as we were so full she packaged up the leftovers for us) and made us butterfly pea flower tea.

We enjoyed the cooking and learning about all the different meals and dishes. It was just me and my partner at the class so we had great conversations with Opal and she answered all our questions. The food was also so yummy! Opal and her family were so welcoming and hospitable.

There seems to be lots of very popular cooking schools in Chiang Mai due to TikTok but Sukjal home cooking school is only small groups and I hope that people sign up for her cooking class.

One of our favourite experiences whilst travelling and will hold these memories forever!

reviews.name: Olivia Mulford
reviews.text: Chef Opal is amazing!!!! We took her cooking class in addition to a bike tour with Co van Kessel and had such an amazing time. The location and facility is sooo beautiful and Opal and her husband were so attentive and kind. Opal is hilarious and the food we prepared was absolutely delicious. You can tell she really loves what she does and wants to share her passion with others. Would absolutely recommend to others in Chiang Mai!!!!!

reviews.name: Franziska Scheuring
reviews.text:
I joined a cooking class with Opal and it was absolutely amazing! From the very first moment, we felt completely comfortable. Opal is incredibly lovely, fun, and passionate about Thai cuisine.🫶🏽

We also visited a local market where she showed us all the fresh ingredients, making the experience even more authentic. During the class we cooked so many delicious dishes, laughed a lot, and created wonderful memories together.

It was soooo great, honestly one of the highlights of my trip. This is definitely a must-do in Chiang Mai — I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a genuine, warm, and super fun cooking experience!☺️

reviews.name: Matyas Kahle
reviews.text:
I just wanted to share a really great experience I had in Chiang Mai — maybe it’ll be useful for someone.

I joined a Thai cooking class run by a local Thai woman who left a big cooking school and opened her own small place in a beautiful location next to rice fields. It’s not one of those mass-tourism cooking factories, the whole experience felt very personal and relaxed.

The group was small (max 6 people), so she had time for everyone. Free pickup from Chiang Mai, then we went to a local market where she explained everything in detail — what ingredients are used for, how they work in Thai cooking, and what can be substituted. After that, everyone chooses what they want to cook, no fixed menu.

She was also very considerate about allergies and dietary restrictions, nothing felt like a problem. You can really tell she cares about what she’s doing and enjoys sharing it.

If you’re looking for a more authentic experience away from the crowds and want to support a small local business, I can definitely recommend it.

reviews.name: Josipa Markanovic
reviews.text:
This was without a doubt the most unforgettable experience I had in Chiang Mai.

If you are looking for something truly authentic, not staged or touristy but real, this is it. The setting alone is breathtaking. You are surrounded by lush rice fields just outside the city, with mountains in the distance and nature all around you. It feels peaceful, pure and deeply Thai.

Opal, the chef and host, is an absolute gem. She is bubbly, warm and genuinely kind. Her energy is contagious and you cannot help but smile around her. She creates such a relaxed and joyful atmosphere that you immediately feel at home. If you are traveling with children, you could not ask for better. She is incredible with kids, patient, playful and engaging, making it just as magical for them as it is for adults.

What makes this experience so special is the passion. You truly feel that Opal loves what she does. She does not just teach recipes, she shares stories, culture and heart. The guidance is clear, hands on and supportive, so whether you are a beginner or someone who loves cooking, you feel confident and involved every step of the way.

And the food… wow. Fresh, vibrant and full of flavor, and even more satisfying because you made it yourself. Sitting down to enjoy your meal overlooking the rice fields is a moment you will not forget.

If you are in Chiang Mai and want an experience that combines nature, culture, connection and incredible food, this is the one. I would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.name: Michael McGuinness
reviews.text: Our group was so happy with our decision to come to Sukjai. Opal was the definition of enthusiastic and kind, she is also very funny. The venue is about as authentic as you can imagine, cooking right next to a rice paddy. Clean up service was taken care of by her husband, felt like we were part of a family by the end!

reviews.name: Rypley Sauve
reviews.text: I didn’t know what to expect with a cooking class, I had never done one before and was a little nervous do to it. Sukjai Home Cooking School is by far one of the best activities you can do when in Chiang Mai. Opal (the teacher) was absolutely amazing! She was so funny, so kind, so good at explaining all the different steps and was always there if I was confused about anything. The property where the cooking class took place is a whole other conversation. IT WAS BEAUTIFUL!! I absolutely recommend, it got me out of my comfort zone and I’m so glad I did it! If you’re looking to support some locals this is definitely the place to do it:)

reviews.name: Eva Goodman
reviews.text: When the reviews say this is a must do, and an unforgettable experience with the best Thai food you’ll eat… they are not kidding. Opal was the loveliest and funniest teacher, she made everything from the moment we were picked up to the moment we were dropped off memorable and fun. The food you will create is amazing, and will be easy enough to re create at home. You make 5 courses so go with an empty stomach and expect to be in a food coma when you leave. Such a reasonable price with the market tour included! Loved every second!! Highly recommend and if you don’t have time to do it, make time to do it!!

reviews.name: Pia Bergstein
reviews.text:
Definitely the highlight of my Thailand trip! Opal was the sweetest soul, we had so much fun and laughed a lot together and she explained a lot about the local food and culture.

We got picked up, went to a local market together to shop all of the ingredients which was super authentic and afterwards drove to the cooking school.

It’s located outside of the city in the nature with an idyllic backyard which was so relaxing and the location is beautiful. Everyone was able to choose from 3-5 different options for the 5-course menu.
We had so much fun preparing and cooking the dishes and learned a lot!
On top of that the food tasted delicious :))

I can only highly recommend it to everyone who want to have an insight into the Thai culture and cuisine:)

It was truly such a blast!

reviews.name: Clare Chao
reviews.text: Cannot recommend this experience enough if you're coming to Chiang Mai. Opal and her husband are incredibly warm, good-humoured people who made every moment of the class fun, informative and relaxing regardless of confidence in the kitchen. A well curated menu of options to cook with well-known favourites like pad thai and tom yum goong as well as northern Thai specialties like Khao soi. The pace of the class was perfect and had lots of breathing room to rest and digest between cooking and eating, enjoying the farm land views and open spaces around the school. Incredibly affordable and enriching, super full after cooking and eating 5 dishes and super convenient with pick up + drop off anywhere in the old town area. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience Opal!

reviews.name: Heather Callison
reviews.text: Had THE BEST experience with Opal at Sukjai cooking school. She was the funnest teacher, with an enjoyable learning environment. The experience was overall educational, culturally immersive, and so fun! The food was delicious & shopping at the market was great! Would highly recommend for anyone to take this class!!

reviews.name: Aabir Laqrafi
reviews.text:
It was the highlight of our trip to chiang mai
OPAL is the nicest + the funniest & we cooked very tasty dishes and she gave us all the recipes
The cooking school felt more like a home very peaceful place surrounded by nature
It was more than just a cooking class

reviews.name: Robi Sorber
reviews.text: The best cooking school in Thailand! 🤩Yesterday, my girlfriend and I had a cooking class given by Opal with the help of her husband, Ten. We firstly went to a market to get all the vegetables we needed and then we drove off to the place with all the beautiful kitchens. Opal is a very friendly, energetic person and speaks English very well! During the class, she explains everything is a structured manner and gives fun facts about the vegetables we used. Compared to other cooking schools, at Sukjai you really get to take your time and Opal is very patient with everyone. From beginner to experienced cooks, this cooking class is very fun and informative. A real must do if you are staying in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Irene Lai
reviews.text:
Yesterday I took a cooking class with my nephew, and we had an absolute blast! The school is super cute, with ducks and chickens roaming around, making it a chill place to hang out.

Opal was awesome. She picked us up from our hotel in the morning and took us to a local market to show us the ingredients. Everything was well prepared, and we cooked five delicious dishes. Her husband also helped prepared different things. A lovely couple! I can tell how much hearts they’ve put into this cooking school.

It was a fantastic day! Definitely highly recommended to everyone!

reviews.name: Christopher Keightley
reviews.text: This was the highlight of mine and my partners holiday to Chiang Mai! Oppo and Ten are wonderful hosts, incredibly friendly and make you feel welcome from the second they pick you up. The cooking school is a 20 minute drive from central Chiang Mai in the countryside. Before we started cooking Oppo let us feed her ducks and geese which were great fun (they’ll nibble from the palm of your hands!). The cooking class was really fun throughout, well organised and Oppo adds humour and energy throughout it all. Every dish we cooked was absolutely delicious and we will definitely be taking our learnings back home to cook some Thai food at home. Cannot recommend this more to anyone looking to learn Thai food and have fun whilst doing it!

reviews.name: Josh D
reviews.text: This is a must do when in Chiang Mai! Opal is a treasure, her energy and enthusiasm are infectious. This is not simply a cooking class, it's a cultural experience and a view into the lives of Opal and her husband Ten. They were so welcoming and hospitable. Opal's ability to share her passion for cooking was amazing. We got to attend a local market to retrieve all fresh ingredients and learn about foods we had not seen before. The cooking class itself was fun, interactive and educational. Do yourself a favour and visit Opal! Lasting memories guaranteed.

title: White House Thai Massage

reviews.text: Had an excellent experience at White House Thai Massage in Rawai, Phuket. The rooms are spotless and well-kept, and the staff are very professional and welcoming. Special thanks to Joy and Ly for their wonderful service and attention to detail — highly recommended!

reviews.name: Julia Vovk
reviews.text:
I came here once after reading so many good reviews about the professional massages at this salon. Unfortunately, my experience was completely different.

The massage therapist was very unfriendly. From her facial expression and overall attitude, I felt like she wasn’t happy to have me as a client at all.

The massage itself was extremely unprofessional. She clearly doesn’t know how to properly feel and work with the body, and she was pressing her elbows directly onto the bones to the point of pain. This has nothing to do with a professional massage — it felt amateurish and careless.
At the same time price here is quite higher than in other salons. After this experience, I have absolutely no desire to come back.

reviews.name: janina
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this Thai massage. The staff was very professional and made me feel comfortable from the beginning. The massage itself was both relaxing and effective, with just the right amount of pressure to release tension without being too intense. The atmosphere was calm and clean, which added to the overall experience. I left feeling refreshed and much more relaxed. I would definitely recommend it and come back again.

We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

reviews.name: Muhannad AlMahoozi
reviews.text:
I am at a loss for words...
Simply life changing.
The best massage I have ever received, hands down, as I am now forever changed.
Kind owners, friendly and kind staff. I came in not knowing what to expect, and left having gotten more than I could have ever asked for.
A million thank yous, and may you all only thrive!

reviews.name: Nadine P.
reviews.text: A truly transformative experience! We came in after a long journey with tired muscles and a stiff neck — and left feeling like a brand new person. The therapist was an absolute expert, combining traditional Thai stretching techniques with targeted pressure work that released tension I didn’t even know I was carrying. The studio itself is calm, clean and beautifully decorated, creating an atmosphere of pure relaxation from the very first step inside. The staff were warm, professional and genuinely attentive to my needs. If you’re in Phuket and looking for an authentic Thai massage experience, look no further. This is the real deal — and worth every single Baht!”
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.text: I did two different massages at this place and was disappointed with both. The first was advertised as a special (higher priced) 2-hour sports massage, but it felt like a standard relaxation massage—the therapist didn't apply the deep tissue pressure or targeted techniques I expected for sports/deep therapy work. The second was booked as a foot massage, but it focused almost entirely on the legs with very little attention to the feet themselves, and the pressure was too light and mechanical throughout. After two lackluster experiences, I won't be returning and wouldn't recommend this place to others.

reviews.name: Phanuwat Srisawang

reviews.name: Eva Lau
reviews.text:
In Bangkok for a business trip and found this amazing spa while wandering around the Silom Edge Mall. I did the Thai Massage and after the session was served delicious tea and mango sticky rice. The massage therapist, Pannee was amazing, ended up coming back twice for more massages.

All the professional staff are super nice, attentive, and friendly. The location is clean and conveniently located near Silom Station and Sala Daeng BTS. The prices are clearly listed, so no hard sale. Would definitely come back again, thank you🙂

reviews.name: Nicole Heenan
reviews.text:
I don’t usually get massages, so this was actually my very first experience. I decided to try the 2-hour Thai massage, and I was truly impressed.

The therapist was very skilled and knew exactly how to target the areas that needed attention. Beyond the excellent massage, the service was exceptional from start to finish. I was welcomed with a refreshing pandan drink, and the experience ended perfectly with delicious mango sticky rice.

The receptionist was also very friendly, professional, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Felix Ser
reviews.text:
Was treated to a very very good Thai massage for 2 hours. The strength was firm with strength as requested which relieved my back a lot. Staff at reception and the massage was friendly and professional and helpful

But the 3rd hour of 1 hour scrub seemed to be in a rush. It felt as though it was by a different person but I am unsure.

- About 5 minutes in I realised I was given a coffee scrub when I requested an orange scrub. Lady explained she was given scrub by the front reception which I accepted and didnt mind and responded that therapist can continue.

- As she was rushed, the container she was using accidentally spilled, with warm oil all over my knee. It wasn't hot so I didnt mind so told her to continue.

- I had a healing scratch on my right leg which I requested therapist to be careful but she forgot. Which again I didnt mind and asked her to proceed

- Halfway she explained that she felt warm and asked if im ok with the temperature. I said Im ok. After another while, she apologized and said she felt warm n went out to ask for help and returned with a colleague who helped with controls. I was ok but now the temperature is a little cold. It didnt help that the scrub had turned lukewarm n colder. She helped cover me in the sheets to let the scrub work on the body for 15min n the temperature was then acceptable.

- By the end of the scrub, when showering, it was very oily and despite using 2 rounds of soaping and washing it was still quite oily. The temperature of the water fluctuated and it didnt help that it was starting to flood. I turned off the water to wait but it was not going down. So I turned the water back on to wash a 3rd round still oily but better but by then I had to step out before it overflows rush out to use the toilet.

When finally out, we were treated to a very nice mango sticky rice dessert. Overall, the massage was great, the staff was helpful, but all the small little things just added up and it became not as great an experience I was hoping for. My companion had a great experience though.

reviews.name: Jas19 in Bangkok
reviews.text:
I had an excellent back and shoulders massage at Let’s Relax Spa, Silom Edge branch. The therapist was highly skilled and applied just the right amount of pressure to relieve the tension in my neck, shoulders, and upper back. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and relaxing from the moment I arrived.

The staff were friendly and professional, making the entire experience comfortable and enjoyable. After the treatment, I felt refreshed, lighter, and much less stressed. If you’re looking for a quality massage in Bangkok, I highly recommend this branch. I will definitely be coming back again.

reviews.name: Almu L
reviews.text: Superb Best masage in Bangkok. Second time we go for for massage and full body masaage. All ladies are so nice and kind.Massages were so relaxing, my foot really painful after all day walking around and also my back . After massage you feel like floating in a cloud. Aldo a jazmín tea and cole tower before massage and hot tea and dessert after.  Hightly recommended. 100% TOP!!

reviews.name: Ryan Tsai
reviews.text:
Came with my gf to get 2hr full body thai massage for the first time. Ive been to a couple different stores of Let’s relax branches before and had great massages. However, this branch is totally different.

We received the massage in the same room, and the two masseuses were chatting and laughing half the time, which affected the strength. Pressure was uneven and the places were random. One masseuse even left to get bathroom break, and didn’t make up for the lost time afterwards. We were their last customers of the day and probably want to just get it over with. They did a terrible job

Also, compared to the other branches, the interior decor is definitely not as nice, which is ok. What i think that matters more is that a lot of the street noise could be heard inside.

I still like Let’s Relax, but I’m never coming back here again. To end this review on the good note, their mango sticky rice is just as good.

reviews.name: Ana García
reviews.text:
Amazing massage excellent service, me and my husband came here together and when we left our bodies felt reborn.

reviews.name: suviyada sukpattaratham

The session focused on massaging the neck, shoulders, and feet — perfect for releasing tension and relaxing after a long day. The therapists were professional and attentive, making sure the pressure was just right throughout. The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very inviting.

What made the experience extra special was the sweet treat at the end — a serving of mango with sticky rice. It was the perfect way to finish the session, leaving both my body and taste buds happy.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a well-rounded and relaxing massage experience!

title: Nantika 2 Physical Thai Massage (南迪卡泰式按摩店）

reviews.name: Rushali Riah
reviews.text:
I tried my first Thai Massage here just before the Walking Street, and it was a good budget-friendly experience. The price for a Thai Massage is 400 Baht for 60 minutes, which is very reasonable compared to the premium spas around. They start by washing your feet at the entrance, which is a nice starting touch.

The setup is split between downstairs (rows of massage chairs for foot/back massages) and upstairs (rooms for Thai and oil massage). Upstairs feels a little basic—four beds in one room separated by curtains, dim lights, no music, but clean overall. I went with my partner, so the shared setup was fine, but solo travelers might find premium spas more private. Washrooms were clean, and they offered complimentary water after the session.

As for the massage itself, it was genuinely relaxing and done well. Not the luxurious atmosphere of big spa chains, but at this price point, you can’t really complain. This place also has a few more outlets even before the entrance of Walking Street, so it’s fairly well known.

If you’re on a budget and want to try an authentic Thai Massage in Pattaya, this is definitely worth it. For a more premium and private vibe, you’d have to spend extra elsewhere.

Happy Exploring!

reviews.name: Aleksandra Czerwiakowska
reviews.text:
I’m sad to say that my second visit at this massage parlor did not go as expected :(
After the first massage, that was wonderful, that I got at the newest place owned by the same owner (chill chill 3), I decided to go a second time on the next day. Chill chill 3 was cool, clean and peaceful and the massage was perfect, the masseuse very focused and professional. When I came in today, the masseuse from yesterday recognized me and told me the massage would be performed in chill chill 1 although I asked to do it at chill chill 3. I accepted after explicitly asking if I would have some privacy as the place is rather small. In the end another person came to perform the massage. When I first lied down, I had to ask for a change of face towel as the one on the table was already used and smelly. In the first 15-20 minutes of the massage, the masseuse interrupted the massage several times and took the liberty to speak loudly with other members of the staff, who were passing by. They used the bathroom just next to the bed I was lying on, constantly spoke among themselves loudly and even opened some cupboards next to “my” bed, barely half a meter away from my head. After asking them to stop three times, I started getting up, the lady who was massaging me finally stopped talking to others, but I could tell from the quality of the massage that she was really not happy with my request. This experience left a really bad taste in my mouth, as I have not been treated like a valued customer. I have been asked to pay the full price despite this situation and did so in order to not make a scene as there were other customers, but I don’t think this level of customer service is ok especially given the outstanding reviews and words of appreciation from clients. It’s sad as I’ve met the owner and she really seems to care, but her employees might not share her commitment. I’ve really felt bad since leaving this place earlier this afternoon, as I feel like the peace and relaxation I decided to treat myself with was thrown to the garbage.

First of all I have to say really sorry that you have a bad experience from my shop. And thank you so much that you say to me and I promise I have to talk with my team and not be heppen again with other clients.

reviews.text:
A Clean and Affordable Massage Experience

I visited this massage place that left me in a pleasant state. The first thing that caught my attention was how clean and well-maintained the establishment was. The ambience was soothing, creating a relaxing atmosphere right from the moment I stepped inside.

What impressed me the most was the quality of the massages offered. It was clear that the therapists were skilled and experienced. I opted for the Head, Shoulders, Back, and Foot package, which proved to be a good choice. The massage techniques used were effective in relieving tension and promoting relaxation. I left feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

One of the highlights of this place is its affordability. The package I chose was only 350 baht, which is an excellent value for the quality of service provided. It's not easy to find a massage place that offers such a comprehensive package at such a reasonable price.

Overall, I recommend this place for anyone seeking a proper massage experience. The cleanliness, skilled therapists, and affordable pricing make it a fantastic option. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or treat yourself, you won't be disappointed with the Head, Shoulders, Back, and Foot package.

title: POM GYM BJJ & Muay Thai
ownerDescription: มวยไทย ฟิตเนส จูจีซี BJJ Muay Thai MMA
address: Thailand Onnut Soi 17/1 921/2 Sukhumvit 77 Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand
plusCode: PJ66+MV Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: May Wasa
reviews.text: Great gym! Super nice vibes! Usually come here for open mat on Saturday and people here are super friendly and really helpful. Location is not hard to find and easy to get to! Love it here!!

reviews.name: Max Foo
reviews.text: Came for a drop in class. Gym community was welcoming and friendly. People here were great to roll with and there was a strong emphasis on techniques and control. Coach Yong was very caring and knowledgeable, taught really well. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Qinjia Sun
reviews.text: Such an amazing practice today the coach was so awesome she teaches us the most suitable action for actual combat! I love that! I kindly recommend everyone to join!

reviews.name: Tom Bolam
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience training at this gym in Bangkok. I wouldnt train anywhere else in Bangkok The atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, and everyone—from beginners to advanced students—makes you feel comfortable right away.

The coach Yong is outstanding: very knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping each student improve. They break down techniques clearly and take the time to give individual feedback, which really helps you progress.

If you’re looking for a friendly environment with high-quality coaching, I highly recommend this place!

reviews.name: Adel M
reviews.text:
I did one month in this club.

I took both courses, which were Muay Thai and JJB. Coach Baki and coach Junyong were very patient with me and took the time to explain the technique despite my amateur level. I also really liked the mentality of all the club members without exception, a lot of respect and kindness between the fighters.

Special mention to Kang who taught me a lot during training !

I will certainly come back with a little more experience to measure my progress 💪

reviews.name: Baes Zadran
reviews.text: Great gym! Went a few times they have good lessons and nice times to go training so you can fit it in your schedule. Good coaches too they watch the sparring carefully so nothing crazy happens. Definitely recommend if your in bangkok!

reviews.name: Dan Mesh
reviews.text:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect training experience!**

Visited POM Gym with my team (BJJX) for their Saturday open mat and had an absolute blast. The team was incredibly welcoming, and the sparring partners were both technical and tough. The real "pressure master class" came from the coach himself, who rolled with everyone and effortlessly demonstrated his incredible skills and control. An amazing, high-level gym with a great community vibe which you might feel from the video. Can't wait to train here again

reviews.name: Brian
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this gym! Jiu Jitsu classes are very good and the coach really ensures you’re doing the techniques correctly.

Very safe environment for sparring as well. Muay Thai is great too!

reviews.name: Menelik
reviews.text: Been training combat sports for some time and living in thailand 3yrs now as an expat & can honestly say this gym is one of if not the best in BK when it comes to grappling. Saturday morning classes are extremely high level and fun! Coach Yong is super gracious and knowledgeable. Truly a great gym.

reviews.name: Henry
reviews.text:
I’ve visited here 3x based off of a recommendation and I’m glad I listened! Coach Yong was very welcoming and cultivated a very chill vibe in the gym (I later learned that POM stood for Peace of Mind lol). Everyone I met had great attitudes and solid jiu jitsu, a testament to the teaching.

Yong he is an incredible instructor. He is patient, observant and very detailed. In my opinion, he has the best class format for learning and internalizing moves.

Thank you Yong for the rolls and the great learning experience. I will definitely be visiting again next time I’m in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Hally Kam
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Pom Gym! The BJJ classes have such a warm, family-like vibe—everyone is super friendly and welcoming. Coach Yong is extremely safety-conscious and gives detailed, personal attention to each student, always watching closely for any risky movements. I also loved the Muay Thai classes—great energy, lots of fun, and a really supportive atmosphere. I chose Pom Gym because I can train both BJJ and Muay Thai in one place, and with three class slots a day, it fits perfectly with my flexible schedule. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Samantha de la Costa
reviews.text: Gym is very spacious and very clean! Professors and coaches are so nice and so good! They’ve got good merch too! Highly recommend them for jiujitsu practitioners.

reviews.name: Shahabas Shakeer
reviews.text: Great gym with awesome trainers. Kru Baki is an excellent Muay Thai instructor. I was able to learn muay thai and lose weight at the same time.

reviews.name: Alex T375
reviews.text:
Pom gym is a great place for those who want to learn BJJ from a high level black belt coach in Kim Jun Yong and improve their ability in a safe and clean environment.

Jun Yong has a nuanced knowledge of BJJ and a wealth of experience in high level competition, which he applies to coach day 1 beginners and high level competitors alike.

There is an emphasis on safety on the mats here, which is extremely important as potential for injury is already elevated due to the nature of the activity. This is something which is unfortunately overlooked and sadly undervalued in many other gyms.

The environment on the mats is clean and the gym has plenty of natural light flooding in, the student base is friendly and welcoming.

reviews.name: Sophie Thomson-Webb
reviews.text:
I dropped in to this gym when visiting Bangkok due to the recommendation of a trusted friend, and I would go ahead and recommend the place to absolutely anyone interested in training!
It’s an unassuming gym but very clean and welcoming, and Coach Yong is wonderful - highly technical and clearly committed to his students.
I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Spenser N
reviews.text: Incredible gym with high level coaching and great training partners. Super welcoming to visitors! Highly recommend training here. Thanks again for having me!

reviews.name: jason siroen
reviews.text: In Bangkok for a few weeks and training here almost every day. The gi and nogi classes are great, coach Yong is amazing! Great pressure style and has attention for every individual student. The gym also has a very friendly and welcoming atmosphere, I felt at home from day 1. Recommend training here a lot and I’ll come back every time I am in Bangkok to train here for sure!

reviews.name: 최일용 (Choi Jitsu)
reviews.text:
Best gym in Bangkok.
Friendly atmosphere, great team and - most importantly - fantastic coach with invaluable knowledge.
Crucial details to fundamentals and really rare emphasis on pressure game.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to train jui-jitsu in bangkok; from beginner level to more experience practitioners.

title: โซลฟิต พิลาทิส ราชพฤกษ์ (Soulfit Pilates Ratchaphruek)
ownerDescription:
Soulfit Pilates ราชพฤกษ์ – พิลาทิสตัวต่อตัว มาตรฐานระดับสากล

Soulfit Pilates สาขาราชพฤกษ์ ตั้งอยู่ที่ HomePro ราชพฤกษ์ ตึก VILLA MARKET (MK) ชั้น 2 เป็นสตูดิโอพิลาทิสที่ให้บริการ พิลาทิสตัวต่อตัว (1-on-1) โดยครูผู้เชี่ยวชาญ ดูแลอย่างใกล้ชิด พร้อมอุปกรณ์มาตรฐานระดับโลก

บริการของเรา:
✅ พิลาทิสตัวต่อตัว (Personalized Pilates) – ออกแบบโปรแกรมเฉพาะบุคคล เพื่อฟื้นฟูร่างกาย ปรับบุคลิกภาพ และเสริมสร้างความแข็งแรง
✅ แก้ออฟฟิศซินโดรม – ลดอาการปวดคอ บ่า ไหล่ หลัง จากการนั่งทำงานนาน ๆ
✅ เสริมสร้างความยืดหยุ่นและการทรงตัว – เหมาะสำหรับทุกช่วงวัย ไม่ว่าจะเป็นผู้เริ่มต้น นักกีฬา หรือผู้ที่ต้องการฟื้นฟูร่างกาย

🕘 เปิดบริการทุกวัน: 07:00 - 21:00

reviews.name: JaAey Sarinthip
reviews.text:
ลบความเชื่อเดิม ๆ ออกไป ร่างกายเราทำอะไรได้มากกว่าที่คิดเยอะ! 🤍✨
​ไม่เคยคิดว่าจะพาพุง 70+ มาอยู่บน cadillac ได้ ตัวไม่ปลิว..แต่ใจพริ้วมากนะพูดเลย! 🧘‍♀️😂

ถามว่าได้อะไร..เล่นพิลาทีส ??
✅️ สมาธิ ไม่ว่าในหัวเราจะคิดอะไรอยู่ ในขณะที่เล่นเราจะมีสมาธิมาก โฟกัสที่ร่างกาย การเคลื่อนไหว ลมหายใจเข้า - ออก
✅️ กล้ามเนื้อ วันไหนที่มาเล่นพิลาทีส แล้วกลับไปรู้สึกปวดร้าวตัว ถือว่า แฮปปี้มาก เพราะเท่ากับว่า เล่นถูกจุด แบบว่า เล่นแล้ว..มันโดน 😂 รู้สึกว่าร่างกายกำลังสร้างกล้ามเนื้อเพิ่มขึ้น (คิดเองนะ) ทำให้การเผาผลาญดีขึ้นจริง
✅️ บุคลิกภาพ จากนั่งตัวงอ เดินพุงยื่น ก้นแอ่น พอได้สติก็ปรับท่าให้ดีขึ้น
✅️ อาการปวดเมื่อย ออฟฟิสซินโดรม แทบจะไม่ค่อยเป็นแล้ว เพราะกล้ามเนื้อได้ยืด ไม่เกร็ง

บอกเลย ไปต่อแน่นอน 😁 ฉันจะเป็น 🐷 ที่แข็งแรง

และขอบคุณ Pilates Instructor น้องโอปอคนสวย น้องน่ารักมากให้กำลังใจและคอยดูแล support ตลอดเลย 😍

#รักตัวเองไม่เจ็บเลยซักวัน ไม่เจ็บแต่ร้าวตัวมาก🤣 #ภูมิใจในตัวเองที่สุด
reviews.textTranslated:
Forget the old beliefs! Our bodies are capable of more than we think! 🤍✨
I never thought I could get my 70+ kg belly on a Cadillac! My body isn't floating...but my spirits are, I swear! 🧘‍♀️😂

What do I gain from Pilates?
✅️ Concentration: No matter what's going on in my head, I'm very focused while exercising. I focus on my body, movement, and breathing.
✅️ Muscles: On days I come to Pilates and feel sore all over, I'm so happy because it means I've worked on the right areas. It really works! 😂 I feel like my body is building more muscle (my own opinion), which actually improves my metabolism.
✅️ Posture: From slouching, walking with a protruding belly and arched butt, I adjust my posture to be better once I'm mindful.
✅️ Aches and pains: I hardly get office syndrome anymore because my muscles are stretched and not tense.

I'm definitely going to continue! 😁 I'll be a strong 🐷!

And thank you to my beautiful Pilates Instructor, Opor! My younger sibling is so sweet, always encouraging and supportive 😍

#LoveYourselfAndYouWontGetHurtEvenForADay (Not hurting, but my body aches a lot 🤣) #SoProudOfMyself

reviews.name: Paul Smith
reviews.text: What a great gym ! First time visitor to Bangkok and I found out about Unreal Gym from it's great reviews on Google. I wasn't disappointed.  First day I hit upper body and then the next day legs. Leg day is never fun but the range of equipment,  new and old school,  made it fun to push hard. This will be my go-to Gym when I visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: Erika Lippert
reviews.text: Yaaaay absolutely love this gym! Super happy I came across it. I’m just passing through BKK on my way back home to Chiang Mai and Unreal is a quick 10-15 min walk from where I’m staying. It’s a greeeeat bodybuilding gym, clean, modern, and they even have some high quality old school lifting equipment that has been really well maintained! 🤩 I also LOVE how adamant they are about re-racking weights. 👏 My kinda place!

reviews.name: Peter Let
reviews.text:
The equipment here is good and well maintained, but the price is extremely high for what the gym actually offers.

The facility itself is not very large and the number of machines is relatively limited, so the overall value doesn’t really justify the membership cost.

It seems that part of the reason the price can stay this high is because there are very few comparable bodybuilding gyms in central Bangkok. With limited competition, pricing naturally stays elevated.

From a pure training value perspective, the price simply doesn’t match what you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi there Peter, 

First thank you for taking your time to write us a review that is honest. We are extremely happy that you notice our emphasis on quality and how we maintain our equipment. We truly appreciate this.

UnReal Gym was never designed to compete on size or volume. We deliberately cap membership, prioritise spacing between machines, and curate specific equipment pieces rather than maximize floor density. Our pricing reflects specialisation, limited capacity, and a focused training environment; not the square footage.

Comparisons to Bali, this we find it interesting as we know Bali extremely well and the operating costs, real estate pricing in central Bangkok, and business models differ significantly. We don’t position ourselves as the cheapest or the largest but we position ourselves as a performance-focused facility built intentionally for serious training. We find this to be unfair to us but to customers, we agree that comparisons are based on their point of view and budget allowance.

As for Instagram exposure, many of our members train here as their primary gym because the environment aligns with how they want to train. Not every person with a camera is an influencer. And we do have a policy that customers mobility and movement within the gym is priority to placements of cameras.

We fully understand that different athletes prioritise different factors whether it is size, amenities, community vibe, or price. We respect that and encourage everyone to choose what fits their goals best. 

Once again, thank you for visiting us. We hope that you will find a right gym suitable to your budget allowance.

reviews.name: Алеся Кальная
reviews.text: Great gym! 💪 Modern equipment, everything is in perfect condition. The staff is super friendly and always ready to help. It’s always clean, and the atmosphere is amazing — makes every workout enjoyable! 🔥

reviews.name: Ryan Howells
reviews.text: Always my go to gym when in Bangkok. Make the trip especially to come here no matter what part of BKK I'm staying.  Great leg room and elite equipment for any muscle group no matter what youre training! Only 500 baht for a day pass too!

reviews.name: Le Voyageur Exigeant
reviews.text:
Unreal Gym is an excellent gym, especially for bodybuilders and anyone serious about strength training. The equipment selection is impressive, with a wide variety of high-quality machines and everything you need for an effective workout. The atmosphere is motivating, and it’s clear that this gym is designed with lifters in mind.

My only criticism is the cardio area. There are only two treadmills, and unfortunately they don’t perform well enough for proper running. For anyone training for endurance events or simply wanting to include quality cardio in their routine, this is a noticeable drawback. Replacing or upgrading the treadmills would significantly improve the overall experience.

Overall, this is one of the best gyms for bodybuilding in Bangkok. If the treadmills were upgraded, I would definitely train here again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Helllo there!

Thank you for your review, and yes we do agree with you. With our gym, cardio has always been somewhat a trade-off when we chose which equipment to put inside the gym. We have chosen to focus on bodybuilding and powerlifting thus with limited spaces that we have, ended up with limited cardio options. 

We assume that most condominiums and hotels where our customers would reside in should already have outstanding cardio facilities especially if they're located within 500m around our gym. Therefore we made the choice of complimenting our gym spaces with limited amount yet high variety of cardio options from Skiierg to rowing machines to stairmasters. 

But we do agree with you here, and we cannot wait to show what we have in plan for UnReal 2 project in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Alexandre “Lexa10” Brismontier
reviews.text:
Probably the best gym in Bangkok wether you’re a bodybuilder , powerlifter ,a fitness enjoyer or even a Muay Thai fighter you’ll find everything you want.
Full of brand new equipments a lot of gymleco pieces and machines to target every muscles. Bonus points for the posing room and the really good air conditioning 👌👍

reviews.name: krista korenika
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing gym!

This gym truly stands out from the rest. The selection of equipment is incredibly wide. They have machines you won’t find in most other gyms including several hip thrust machines and many different glute-focused machines 🤩
Everything is thoughtfully designed, both for the comfort of members and the overall look of the space. You can really feel that every detail is made with care.

Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves working out and enjoys a gym that has everything you need! 💪🏼

reviews.name: P
reviews.text:
This is a proper body building gym. It strikes a balance of convenience and serious lifting with dedicated lower and upper body floors housing  machines that you won’t find at your average fitness club. The muay thai gym on the last floor is the cherry on top. Solid offerings in their store and vending machines too.

Cons:

1) They don’t offer free water. You have to buy their shaker bottle if you want them to refill your water. I’m surprised more people don’t mention this. It would be very easy to install a water station with paper cups on each floor. This is not a budget gym so I think it is long overdue.

2) It suffers from a bad odor that i presume is caused by plumbing or garbage disposal issues in the building.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi there P.  Your feedback is valuable for us. Yes, we have been recently suffering from drainage issue which came with an extremely unpleasant odour that can only be traced the pipes. We have identified the odour to have traveled through our stairwell and we are now working with the building to solve this issue.

As far as drinking water is concerned, yes previously did not provide free drinking water. For most boutique gyms, it is quite uncommon to provide free drinking water. We had run a small sample poll around late 2024 on this issue and most customers prefer to buy bottled water but a big bottle (1.5 L) one or bring their own. Hence, we chose to stock 3 different variant of drinking water : small bottled watar, small mineral water, and big bottled water as a result of listening to our customers.

Free drinking water, we do provide if you use our gym’s own cup which is now given to you free for long term customers.

reviews.name: Charly Pn
reviews.text: Unreal Gym is amazing! It offers a stunning view, multiple floors with all the equipment you could need, and everything is always well-maintained the staff is super friendly, the coaches are always smiling, and the posing room is a great touch for bodybuilders. Highly recommended if you're in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Rich Youth
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Unreal Gym Bangkok — Truly Unreal!

If you’re looking for a gym that goes above and beyond, Unreal Gym in Bangkok is exactly that — unreal in the best possible way! From the moment you walk in, you can feel the positive energy.

The facilities are spotless and modern, with top-notch equipment for every kind of training.

reviews.name: ryan howells
reviews.text: Back at the best gym in Bangkok especially for leg day. Have trained in over 60+ countries and have never seen some of these machines not only for hamstrings/glutes but also old school leg curl and leg extension in a position that really emphasizes the stretch. Even tricep machines I've never seen before. Considering the size its amazing how they've got so much top level equipment here.

reviews.name: Osadaj
reviews.text: I’ve found it!! Gym that have a lot of machines and have a posing room first in Thailand

reviews.name: hu rungrawan
reviews.text: This gym is amazing — the equipment is top-notch, and they’ve recently updated the layout, which makes training even more enjoyable. It’s never too crowded, so you can really focus and have a great workout.

reviews.name: Christoph Lex
reviews.text: Best gym in BKK for people who are serious about fitness and it’s not even close. Great, well-maintained equipment and they even got some really unique machines that are hard to find elsewhere. Top notch music (mostly upbeat electronic music, no trashy EDM), air purifiers in every room and just in general so much attention to detail. Even their merchandise is sick! If you are in town and looking for a proper gym with the right vibe and crowd, this is the place to go.

reviews.name: Daniel Berg
reviews.text: It’s a nice facility, but there is a an unwelcoming vibe. It’s the businesses prerogative to enforce their rules, but it feels as though they’re on a hair trigger. Spent more time worried I was doing something wrong than about my workout. If you are a bodybuilder that values a manicured gym environment, decent aesthetics for pictures/video, and good recovery facilities, this is a good gym if you can afford it. For everyone else, pass. If i was the target demographic, I’d give this place a 4/5. I think the staff should give day pass people a rundown of the rules before paying to avoid awkward situations
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Daniel,

Thank you for your review and first and foremost, we hear your comment and we will take this up to our management level as it is a valid point. 

But once again, our rules are very natural and we are 100% confident that after the first visit, you will understand that the rules are just typical gym etiquette that's universally accepted and expected. 

Our gym was founded on the basis that the city lacks a gym that truly enforces rules (especially putting the things you have used back to their home) and the spaces ended up being messy. Senior members who just begin their journey will end up unable to use the gym if no one puts plates back to the rack. It is in our DNA. 

But yes, unfortunately different customers may perceive our constant reminder to be somewhat prerogative. We were aware of this at the time of implementation of this, but we were often praised for this on the other hand. 

And noted : we will ensure that our staff give all day pass customers a run down of rules which should have already been the case and at the same time, to know the reason behind them.

Your review is extremely valuable to us and we think is going to be informative to other customers soon to visit our gym.

reviews.name: James Clarke
reviews.text: Unreal gym is definitely unreal. Superb equipment selection, some pieces that I’ve never even seen. But all equipment is well maintained and in excellent condition. Gym itself is also very clean with plates also put back where they’re suppose to be! Would definitely recommend to anyway passing through or on a holiday! Day pass was 450 baht which is decent for the amount of equipment you get.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear James. Thank you for your unreal review! We love it when our customers notice small details about our gym and highlight these. We started very simple: given we inherited the space from a previous operator: keep it clean, create the sense of community (and order) and people will already feel the difference because in this industry the bar is somewhat set quite low.

Thank you again for choosing us to be your gym of choice in Bangkok and we look forward to welcome you again in the future. Do spread the words about us, as we are relatively a new player in town and we are deciding if we shall grow or keep our operations boutique like this as a passion project.

reviews.name: Joe B
reviews.text:
Hands down the BEST Muay Thai training I have ever gotten. I left exhausted, grateful, and with more knowledge. There is no fluff here. You will be worked, hard. I’ve been doing Muay Thai for 9 months now back home so while not a true beginner, I still had a ton to work on.

This is not like any other gym. This is truly 1 on 1 sessions. There are no group trainings where it’s 1 coach to 8 students and you’re hitting a bag. This is truly catered for all levels, to help you with whatever your goal is.

Let’s talk trainers.. I’m sure you read the prior reviews for this gym and wondering what the catch it. There is none. My trainer Lay was absolutely amazing and left me feeling more confident leaving the ring. His attention to detail was much appreciated.

The session started with a warm up with jumping on a tire and jump rope followed by shadow boxing. Lay really helped with my technique as well as other nuggets I could add to my arsenal. We then entered the ring and did some pad work. I did the last session of the day so it was just me and him in the ring with a few folks watching on the outside. Felt like a real fight!

After pad work and more technique, we did some sparring which I enjoyed with Lay although I would say the judges would give it to him. Please note this was nothing crazy where one would get hurt. Lay truly catered to my level, gave me a couple light tags while I returned some as well.

Overall I would recommended this gym to anyone of any level. You will seriously leave with more confidence, more knowledge, and a good workout!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Joe
Your review helps others who aren't yet familiar with our gym better understand what we offer and how we offer it.
We're happy that you enjoyed your time with us and that you were able to improve your level.
Thank you for your review
Big Mama Ratana

reviews.name: Swee Chye Loh
reviews.text:
Old school Muay Thai gym that offers normal class and private lessons. For the normal class, don't expect a structured program like the rest of the gyms.

Even though the guideline state the program flow is warm up, five rounds of pad work (4 minutes per round), bag work and sparring/clinching, only the pad work is "guided". The rest are "own time, own target" which also means you need to know what you are doing. Nevertheless, the instructors there are patient and more than willing to teach you if you ask.

One normal class cost 500 bhat. The rest of the pricing can be found on the internet. Each day offer two sessions and you can be there for as long as you want (2 to 3 hours).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the detailed review! Really appreciate the honest insight about the training style and class structure

reviews.name: LZ
reviews.text:
I arrived at PK. Saenchai as a beginner with five months of experience. What makes this gym so special that it produces so many champions? After a month of training here, I’ve developed a few theories. It isn’t just the intensity; it’s a pervasive culture of excellence.

The Training & Technical Foundation
At an elite gym like this, you receive world-class instruction regardless of your level. I spent most of my month training with Kru Fang, and I cannot recommend him highly enough. He is a brilliant, kind, and patient specialist, particularly in the nuances of clinching.

Kru Fang stays 100% focused during sessions, listening to your specific goals and correcting your form through disciplined repetition until it sticks. For a beginner, his ability to balance high-level technicality with patience is a game-changer. If he is available (he is often busy cornering pros at Rajadamnern), book a few private sessions to build a top-tier foundation.

The Atmosphere
The afternoon sessions are a major highlight. Observing professional fighters hitting pads and sparring at a level you rarely see at "tourist" gyms is an education in itself. Seeing these athletes push themselves to the absolute brink every single day is infectious—it "gases you up" and provides a level of inspiration that carries over into your own professional life.

Community & Support

The Fighters: The community of foreign fighters is incredibly friendly. Many are long-term residents who offer invaluable tips and advice.

Management: If you have specific goals, reach out to the manager, Game. He is very welcoming and ensures the staff is aligned with what you want to achieve.

Logistics & Tips
The gym is in an authentic, local neighborhood. I highly recommend staying at GL Sport Club Serviced Residence; it’s a 2-minute walk away and feels more like a home than a rental.

Summary: This is a legendary environment for any martial artist or professional seeking growth. I met many students who keep returning to Bangkok just for this gym, and now I know why.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind words! We’re really glad you had a great experience and look forward to welcoming you back soon.

reviews.name: ABOT Manon
reviews.text:
What an incredible experience! I don’t think we’ve ever been taken care of so well during a training camp, and this is already our fourth year in Thailand.

We hadn’t even started training yet, and Game was already helping us find the perfect place to stay according to our preferences.

As for the training, all the coaches are amazing. Each of them has their own specialties, which really allows you to switch things up and keep the training varied!
A huge thank you to all the coaches who looked after us. You’re fantastic!!!!

You can even spar with great champions!!!
And the boxing drills with Master Pui are absolutely top-notch!

At the end of each camp, we always fight. Cause if we’re in Thailand, we want to live the full experience!!
I wish I could thank every single person a thousand times because we’ve truly never been cared for like this.

Game organized amazing fights for us in a great stadium in Pattaya.
Avatar and Tui were the ones who drove us to the Pattaya Stadium and brought us back home after the show. The whole time, they made sure everything was okay. Even with the language barrier, they still took the time to give us advice with the translator in the corner of the ring. And Game, who couldn’t be there in person, sent us encouraging messages before the fight and congratulations after.

They really made sure everything was perfect for this big event!

In short, it was incredible. We were just foreigners like the many others who come through this famous gym every day, but they took care of us as if we were family.

Thank you to everyone : Game, the coaches, the fighters, the ladies at the reception, and everyone we met. Thank you for everything!

I’m sure I forgot to mention plenty of positive things, but to sum it up: I wholeheartedly recommend PK Saenchai. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced, if you love Muay Thai, this is the place to be 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this amazing and detailed review. It truly means the world to our entire team. We’re incredibly happy to hear that your training camp felt special from start to finish, and we’re honored to have been part of your journey in Thailand for the fourth year.

We’re glad the training, the coaches, the fights, and the support outside the gym all contributed to a memorable experience. Everyone you mentioned — from the trainers to the reception team, to Avatar, Tui, and myself — is truly grateful for your kind words.

Thank you for trusting us, for your positive energy, and for letting us be part of your fights and your growth. You will always be part of the PK family, and we can’t wait to welcome you back again. 🙏❤️

reviews.text: One of the best Muay Thai Gym I went the last serval years in Bangkok. It is professional organized and also as foreign you will get the same training and support from the trainers. reviews.name: Miki Gomez
reviews.text:
I trained here once, the session was 45min. The training consisted of 4 rounds of pads and 4 rounds of very light sparring with the coach, and then it was finished. (the 4 rounds of sparring were not even 3min each, maybe 1min each...)

During the pads, it was very basic: mostly 1–2 and right kick combinations, everything done with the right side. There were no new techniques shown, no variations, and I wasn’t corrected on my technique at any point, which was a bit disappointing, especially for someone looking to improve.

On the positive side, the gym does provide water and a towel, and you can shower at the gym, which is convenient and appreciated.

Overall, it may be okay for a very light session, but if you’re looking for technical feedback, detailed instruction, or more variety in training, this might not be the best fit.

reviews.name: Richard Holding
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my time at Action Point! Such a uniquely tailored experience which gave me not just a fitness and nutrition focused component but one also equally focused on mental wellness. I came looking to reset and re-align, and found myself connecting with others there for a multitude of reasons. The staff were fantastic, super inclusive and accomodating and really worked to ensure an optimal experience. Gareth went above an beyond to create a fun time with 10/10 vibes. Sam’s wellness coaching and private sessions really brought some outside and professional perspective to enable sustained changes towards better mental wellness. Peanut, always making people feel good and ensuring everyone felt included. Lek and Gift and the rest of the kitchen crew always smiling and bring the good vibes (and delicious healthy tastes) and being super accomodating to the various personal food requests. Excellent trainers, Eric and Jani, making the effort not to just train you but to connect personally. I also never thought I’d get into Muay Thai, but Angelos made it so fun and never have I felt fitter in my life and hungering for more Muay Thai (while also leaving with sore abs from laughing so much)! if it’s not the Action Point crew, the micro community it fosters as people rotate in and out really you connect with others and make some more adventures. My room also felt like a 5-star hotel room, and more than comfortable for my time there, which definitely differentiated Action Point from some of the others in helping me choose. There is something for everyone at Action Point and I definitely left feeling a renewed sense of purpose and reconnecting with myself after some of the baggage life can load you up with at time to time. I cannot recommend this place highly enough. I went for 4 weeks and while that sounded like a lot initially, it wasn’t long enough because I didn’t want to leave. Whatever your reason (probably don’t even need a reason really), Action Point is a great time and you should definitely book yourself in!
