reviews.name: Brian Athaide
reviews.text: An amazing retreat, facility and staff.  You feel like part of the family at Action Point. The staff are very helpful, kind and fun. Facilities are great. Food is amazing with focus on high protein and fewer carbs but still incredible tasty. I learned a lot and plan to be a regular there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Brian,

Thank you so much for your kind words — we’re so glad you felt part of the AP family during your stay. It’s great to hear you enjoyed the facilities, food, and the team, and that you took so much away from the experience.

We can’t wait to have you back as a regular!

Love Team AP x

reviews.name: Dan Harrow
reviews.text:
I’ve been to Action Point three times and each time is better than the last thanks to the work they put into constant improvement and upgrades.
The energy of the place - the staff, the trainers and the guests - is super infectious and you can’t help but leave feeling lighter both physically and mentally.
I’d be hard pressed to choose a favourite part from the food, the room or the classes.
I lost 5 kilos and gained a lot of friends and memories, can’t wait until my next visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Dan,

Thank you so much for your continued support — three visits and counting means a lot to us! We’re so glad you’ve felt the improvements each time and that the energy, people, and overall experience keep bringing you back.

Congrats on the amazing results too — 5 kilos down and plenty of great memories made! We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon.

Love Team AP x

reviews.name: Lama Khalil
reviews.text:
Action Point is so much more than a fitness and wellbeing retreat. It’s a home filled with warmth, care, and genuinely beautiful people. I stayed there for two months, and from the moment I arrived, I felt seen, supported, and truly cared for.

Chris, the heart you’ve poured into AP is felt everywhere, and the incredible team you’ve built reflects that. Every staff member works so hard while making guests feel welcome, valued, and at home.

A huge thank you to the behind-the-scenes team: Fah, Mon, and Win, always smiling and cheering me on with encouragement; Nai with his contagious smile; and Jor, Nan, and Tat, who always took a moment to say hello. Those small gestures meant so much.

Peanut, Aom, Oily, and Jane, such beautiful souls. I often stopped by just to soak up some of their positive energy. Gorgeous Bibi, the sweetest, always encouraging, baking with love, and capturing special moments during classes with her beautiful smile.

The PT and Muay Thai coaches are amazing. I’ll happily admit my bias and say Eric is the best of the best 😁 Every PT session was tough yet fun and motivating.
Wan Chai made Muay Thai an absolute joy every time.

Beautiful Sam, thank you for your support, guidance, and genuine care. You are an incredible life coach and inspiration.

Gareth 🤗 pure energy and light. Every moment around you was full of joy, and I’ll really miss your energetic Zumba classes.

Gift, Lek, Sandra, and Ya, the most thoughtful kitchen team. Always smiling, working so hard, and going above and beyond with my special meals.

Craig, thank you for your eye-opening talks and guidance toward a healthier me.

Charlie, a true miracle worker.

Jenny, such a beautiful soul. Her light, joyful energy makes you believe you can do anything and actually enjoy it. Morning walks with Jenny and Pew Pew were my favorite.

A special mention to the massage ladies for their incredible work and for being such an important part of my wellbeing.

Every day at AP feels special. Thanks to everyone for making my time unforgettable. I miss it already and hope to see you all again soon ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Lama for such a detailed review of your stay with us. We will ensure all staff are aware of your kind words and praise. We look forward to seeing you again on your next visit to us - it’s always a pleasure having you here. Love Team AP x

reviews.name: Edward
reviews.text:
Just spent 3 very productive weeks here working on fitness, weightloss and mindset. Once I had found Action Point I felt I had found the right place and after arriving I was very quickly sure it was. Amazing staff and coaches throughout but the philosophy, vibe and friendliness really shone through.
The rooms are well appointed and comfortable, the restaurant serves very tasty food whilst being truly healthy and it has the most amazing view which helps you recover from the toughest of sessions.
I will definitely return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Edward for your wonderful review ! We are so happy you enjoyed your stay with us and we look forward to your next visit! Love from all at Team AP x

reviews.text:

Chris has  brought together the most wonderful team  that provided all the support, direction and motivation needed to reach your personal goals. From early communications with Peanut, arrival orientation (and more) with Gareth, all the trainers, coaches, nutrition team, chef… this is a special place! We will be back for longer next year!
Andrea and Paul

reviews.name: Mariia Ganzevich
reviews.text:
Did today  a 7-step facial massage (1.5 hours) and it was really good. Honestly, it’s not easy to find a quality face massage in Pattaya, so I was very happy to discover this place on Google Maps.
They give you a a skirt-top which you have to put on to cover your breast zone so they can massage it as well.

The massage was deep, relaxing and very professional — face, neck and shoulders, hands and da bit of feet massage, gua sha, mask and lifting techniques. Not rushed at all, full 1.5 hours.

My face felt lighter and more lifted after the session, skin looked fresh and hydrated.

Highly recommend  a masseurname is  Smile if you are looking for a real facial massage, not just a simple beauty treatment.

reviews.name: Christabel Real
reviews.text:
This was truly the best retreat of my life, and I am already planning my return.

The entire experience was incredibly life-changing. I especially enjoyed the stunning beachside views, the amazing meals provided throughout our stay, and the wonderfully crafted local tour. It’s also heartening to know that the studio supports baby elephants, which makes the experience even more meaningful.

Thank you for such a memorable and transformative stay, Chriselda 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Awwweee thank you so much for this super cute review 🥰 This was such a fun 7 day retreat! See ya when I’m home this summer maganda 🫶🏽🤍😘

reviews.name: Carla Castle
reviews.text:
Chriselda is such a wonderful and positive teacher! My friends and I attended her class while on vacation and it was a really stellar experience.

The class starts off on a positive note with writing our personal wishes, and an easy going warmup that is accessible for beginners.

Afterwards we go straight into the main salutations with fun, energic and positive guidance. The class is meant for beginners but Chriselda does a really great job at guiding beginners into more complex moves. (I managed to do my first headstand in years!)

Shes very gentle with physically guiding your body into the right position and activating our muscles. The class ends off with a really detailed soundbath, I felt absolutely relaxed at the end yet reinvigorated.

Overall, it was such a great experience! My friends and I were still raving about the class hours after.

P.s Chriselda has amazing recommendations in the area for tourists

Chriselda is an absolutely wonderful teacher — so supportive, attentive and inspiring. She helped with every pose, and suddenly things that felt impossible became possible.

While on holiday, I treated myself to a delicious candlelit moon flow.
What an amazing decision, I had so much fun and really just let go. I was blessed with a beautiful soul to guide me through my practice, and just felt completely comfortable immediately. I don't want to give any spoilers away, there are many sensory aspects included and the physical support given really opened up my practice and really enabled me to keep trying.

It was a true pleasure to spend my evening here and I cannot recommend enough.

Even got some pics and a tinelapse of the practice which was a beautiful touch.

Absolutely will be back next time I'm here, which hopefully isn't too long x

reviews.name: Mohammad Jamshir
reviews.text:
I had a very positive experience at Phuket All Yoga. The atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and very suitable for anyone looking to relax, stretch, and enjoy a good yoga session while in Phuket.

The instructor was friendly, professional, and explained the movements clearly, which made the class easy to follow even if you are not very advanced. I appreciated the peaceful environment and the way the session was structured, with a good balance between breathing, stretching, mobility, and relaxation.

The class felt comfortable and not intimidating, and the overall experience was very refreshing. It was a nice way to slow down, focus on the body, and take a break from the busy travel schedule.

Overall, a very enjoyable yoga experience in Phuket. I would definitely recommend Phuket All Yoga to anyone looking for a relaxed and well-guided session, whether you are a beginner or already practice yoga regularly.

I was fortunate enough to discover Phuket All Yoga on a recent visit.

I did the 9am Spiritual Warrior class with Criselda.  The studio is a fun adventure with an amazing view of the sea over the palm trees.

Criselda explained the Jivamukti philosophy and history as she began the class.   I felt welcomed and comfortable from the very first.

The practice itself is an Ashtanga based flow.   Since we were a small class Criselda workshopped some poses to help me achieve really get into the space.  Her hands on assist was supportive and timely. I loved the flows and the music.

Criselda's vibrant personality and high energy made the hour fly by.  I definitely recommend Phuket All Yoga to anyone who is looking for a fun, challenging yoga practice.

Benefits of Neck & Shoulder Massage

✅ Reduces Stress & Promotes Relaxation

✅ Improves Flexibility & Range of Motion

Possible Drawbacks

⚠️ Bruising or Tenderness
Deep pressure may cause bruising, especially for people with sensitive skin.

People with recent injuries, fractures, severe osteoporosis, infections, or acute inflammation should avoid massage unless approved by a healthcare professional.

Some people may feel lightheaded immediately after treatment. Drinking water and resting can help.

⚠️ Results May Be Temporary
If poor posture or repetitive strain continues, pain may return without lifestyle changes or exercise.

* People with neck and shoulder stiffness
* Computer users

* People experiencing stress or tension

reviews.name: Dan Pieloch
reviews.text:
I visited before noon on 4 July. When I walked past this place, two young ladies outside asked me if I wanted a massage. I asked one woman directly if she would be my masseuse, and she said yes, and she was attractive, so in we went.

They accept American Express here, which is rare. They handed me a treatment card, and I chose aromatherapy oil full body massage for 1.5 hrs for 850 Baht.

My masseuse Nut took great care of me. She is thick in a good way, with a pleasant demeanor and plenty of smiling. The massage started off real light, so I asked Google Translate got her to go stronger, and she laughed and said yes, and then she did.

The massage took place in a private room upstairs, although there was a gap between the top of the wall and the ceiling, which might be a safety thing but always looks odd to me. There was also a shower in the room which is a big convenience. The massage table had a face hole, and it worked just fine. The AC in my room was flipping freezing, and I didn't want to be selfish since she was working so hard, but I asked her to bump it up a few degrees, and she did. There was no aggressive upselling and I left there with no stress once the service was completed.

Once downstairs, Nut gave me a coupon for 10% off my next service. Overall I had a verify good experience, and I'd be happy to return.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Tony for leaving us a review. Such a nice explanation. See you again for sure. 🥰🙏

reviews.name: wai Loo
reviews.text: Sooooo excellent！！！I enjoyed it very much! I am very satisfied! The auntie's massage strength is sufficient and very accurate. She can accurately massage the sore muscles and it is very relaxing to massage the whole body.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Wai Loo! 💖 We’re so glad you enjoyed the massage and felt truly relaxed. Our therapist will be happy to hear your kind words. Hope to see you again soon! 🙏✨

reviews.name: Remy Bygodt
reviews.text: We had such a great massage and time. I recommand this place for every people who want to live a peaceful and beautiful experience. Furthermore, the owner is really kind and attentive 😍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely words, Remy 🌸 We’re delighted you enjoyed your experience and felt well cared for. It means a lot to us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon ✨

reviews.name: Sushmeetha Morugan
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the leg massage! It was incredibly relaxing and exactly what my tired legs needed. The pressure was perfect, and I could feel the tension melt away almost immediately. Walked out feeling lighter, refreshed, and so much more relaxed. Highly recommended! Thank you Madam Massage..
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this wonderful review, Sushmeetha! We’re thrilled to hear that you absolutely loved the leg massage and that the pressure was just right for you. Knowing you left feeling lighter, refreshed, and deeply relaxed truly makes our day. Thank you for the recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Madam Massage again soon 🤍

reviews.name: Sébastien Sinsou
reviews.text: Really nice massage — deep if you want it. Very skilled technique and perfectly adjusted to body size. We loved the Thai oil massage, which combines traditional Thai and oil massage, especially the back work. A great experience overall
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind words, Sébastien! 💛
We’re so glad you enjoyed the Thai oil massage and appreciated the technique. Our therapists always try to adjust the pressure and style to each guest’s comfort. We look forward to welcoming you back for another relaxing experience soon! 🙏✨

reviews.name: Carrie Grubb
reviews.text: I loved my massage and the care, the lovely building and the sweet girl that was my masseuse.  The price was fantastic, as well. We were so well taken care of. I'd go there often if I lived nearby. I got the Foot, back, shoulder and head massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words, Carrie! We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed the massage, the atmosphere of our place, and the care from our therapist. It means a lot to us. We’re glad you felt well taken care of, and we’d love to welcome you back anytime you’re in the area again!

reviews.name: Thomas Parsons
reviews.text: A charming and welcoming place.  I got a 1 hr Thai massage and a 30 minute foot and leg massage.  This was an excellent combination due to the profound knowledge and energy of the therapist.  I get a lot of massages in Asia, and Madam Massage is among the top.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Thomas! 💛 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Thai and foot massage combination and felt the care and expertise of our therapist. It means a lot that you consider Madam Massage among the top in Asia, we truly appreciate your kind words and hope to welcome you again soon! 🙏✨

i went here 3 months ago i really miss this place   guys much to try

reviews.text:

I started out hesitant if I would stay here to continue the membership or not, but within the first month I've had not a single doubt about it. The quality you get here for the price will leave you very happily satisfied.

reviews.name: Monica White
reviews.text:
We held a small cocktail event at the Great Room and it was very successful. The whole planning process went very smoothly. The team that help me was highly professional and very cooperative. They really went out of their way to ensure that all my requirements were met.

The ambiance on the evening was amazing. The view was fantastic and the set up with the beautiful decorations helped to create a very premium, cozy and intimate feel which was perfect! Guests really enjoyed the evening.

A special shout out to Khun Bo, Khun Bam and their team for their exemplary service.

I would highly recommend holding small private functions at the Great Room!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Monica, 
A huge thank you for your wonderful feedback on your recent event at the Great Room! Your review is truly appreciated. We look forward to hosting more fantastic events for you. Have a great week ahead!

reviews.name: Alban Jusufi
reviews.text:
I rented office space here and my experience during the stay was fine, but getting my security deposit back has been a different story. The return of my deposit was approved early on and confirmed in writing, including signed papers and email, with the agreed F&B charges to be deducted directly from it. Despite that, the money still hasn't arrived nearly two months after my contract ended.

Over that period I've been told repeatedly that it's "approved and being processed by finance," only for the next update to bring the same line again. When I followed up, I was even asked to make a separate payment and re-sign the refund form, despite the return already being approved. I've had to chase this multiple times and wait weeks between replies.

I'd advise anyone considering to reconsider wisely. Problems you might face will be answered by AI.

reviews.text:
One of the most spacious and cozy co-working spaces that I have visited. Unlike other co-working spaces that targeting expats or travelers, The Great Room will be great if you & your team are into professional and capacious location.

Thank you to P'Selin for having me the other day at The Great Room. I spent an afternoon here & what could I say, accommodating staffs, chilling and productive work dedication, and all other nice words I can share for this co-working space. Cant wait to be back very soon ;)

reviews.text:
I visited the facilities a couple of weeks ago and this is most impressive.
It is not just a working space for teams or companies to use, but really brings the sense of Hospitality into the workplace with the Great Room team.

Located on 2 entire floors within Gaysorn Towers, the living room allows for casual and fast meetings and there are plenty of other open spaces to have your brief phone calls.
Offices are of course well appointed and all you need to do is bring your office equipment to the beautiful and comfortable environment.
There are additional office facilities available.

What I found to be the most interesting is the variety of companies that were present at the time of visit. Ranging from high end That banks to restaurant booking companies.
The cherry on top of the cake was their initiative of Monday breakfast and other activities that are offered to all clients.
This brings people together and what other great way to get conversations flowing.

title: Pilates Atelier Phuket
ownerDescription:
Discover Your Strength and Balance at Pilates Atelier Phuket!*

Ready to transform your body and mind? Join us at Pilates Atelier Phuket, where we offer personalized and group Pilates sessions tailored to help you achieve your fitness goals.
Why Choose Pilates Atelier Phuket?*
- Expert Comprehensive Pilates Instructor with years of experience
- Personalized attention in private classes
- Energizing and engaging group sessions
- Modern and welcoming studio atmosphere

Transform your body, improve your posture, increase your flexibility, and boost your overall well-being. Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience the best of Pilates in Phuket.

Equipments: Reformer, cadillac, chair, barrel , mat. Balanced body, from USA
address: 9/56 Moo5 Wichit, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
plusCode: W929+5H Wichit, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Lins JF
reviews.text:
Pilates Atelier Phuket is one of those studios you immediately feel good walking into. The equipment is top tier, super well maintained Reformers, Towers, Cadillac, Wunda Chair and barrels.

Muge is amazing. Very professional but also warm, and she catches the tiniest details in your form. Her cues are clear and make instant sense, and the class is challenging without feeling punishing. You leave shaky in a good way and somehow taller.

The class flows beautifully through the repertoire, not rushed, not boring, just the right pace to understand what your body is doing.

And the view is a bonus 💯. Bright, calming, makes the whole session feel a bit like a reset instead of just a workout.

Highly recommend this studio if you’re looking for quality Pilates, great instruction, and a space that genuinely makes you want to come back.

reviews.name: Manthana Laupattarakasem
reviews.text:
Teacher Dream is an amazing Pilates instructor! 🤍 I had the chance to take Pilates with her in Phuket while I was pregnant, and I was genuinely impressed by how knowledgeable, professional, and attentive she was.

She guided me through the exercises carefully and made sure I felt comfortable and safe throughout the session. I also got to use all of the Pilates equipment, which made the class even more enjoyable and effective.

Teacher Dream explains everything so clearly, has great attention to detail, and really knows how to adapt the exercises to each person’s needs. I truly enjoyed every session and felt that I was in such good hands.

Highly recommend Teacher Dream to anyone looking for a skilled, caring, and professional Pilates instructor! ✨🤍

reviews.text:
I had a great Pilates experience here!

The instructors, Muge and Dream, are true professionals: very strong, attentive, and knowledgeable.

The atmosphere is pleasant and welcoming, and the studio has new, high-quality equipment.

Definitely highly recommended! 😜

• The Instructor (10/10): The instructor was exceptionally professional, attentive, and knowledgeable. They guided me through every movement with great patience and ensured my form was spot on.
If you are in Phuket and looking for a top-tier Pilates experience, this is the place to go. Highly recommended! I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.name: Nualpanod Khianpukdee
reviews.text:

The space is beautiful, spacious, luxurious, and top-tier equipment but it still feels very humble and comfortable.
The real stars are Muge and Dream. They are true masters with 10+ years of experience and a mindset that really pushes you to grow. I’ve discovered limits and potentials I didn't know I had thanks to their support. Plus, the energy from the other students and the hospitality here make every session a total joy.
Highly recommend for anyone from beginners to those looking for professional training!

reviews.text:

reviews.text:

So we paid for 1 hour massage and got only 30 minutes massage. Very disappointed. We won’t be returning back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback. We would like to clarify the fact regarding your visit. Foot soaking began at 14:40, and the massage service officially started at 14:45, which is the register start time in our system. Our 60 mins massage package is a combined service, which includes foot soaking and massage provided in accordance with with our standard procedure that are explained to customer prior to the service. The service was delivered in full and in compliance with these terms. Regarding massage pressure, our staff apply pressure based on the standard level of the selection package. Customer are always welcome  to request lighter or stronger pressure at any time during the session. However, no request to adjust the pressure was communicated to our staff during the service. For transparency, the service  timeline and procedures are documented through our internal system and CCTV records. Should you have any questions or wish to review the details, please feel free to contact us directly . Additionally during the massage session,  the customer fell asleep and remained asleep until the service officially started was complete. After the session ended, our staff gently woke the customer  and proceeded to serve complimentary tea as part of our standard post service hospitality. We apologize for any misunderstanding and appreciate your feedback. We strive to provide a comfortable and professional experience for all customers and appreciate the opportunity to clarify this matter. Thank you

Their manager, Khun Amy and her assistance, who welcomed us when we first arrived are also friendly and talkative. Overall, their staffs are polite and very sincere, including the person who washed our toes and others.

The product that they use has a very relaxing and extraordinary scent. In the middle of the treatment, they provided me with arms and hands massage. As a person who spent 40 hours per week on computer +10 more hours per day on the phone, my hands and my arms hurt a lot, so would say that their hand and arm massages were incredible and relieved so much tension on my muscles. This is the most impressive part of my visit here.

The location of the salon is located near a tourist spot, in spite of that, the price for their service is reasonable for me. Since they are located in a community, there are a lot of parking spaces.

I would like to recommend everyone who is looking to spend at least one hour to relax after a long work or a long trip (as they also have like a jet lag massage program)

Massage.
Second time couldn’t get through on the phone.
Third time got denied for a walk-in and told advance booking only.
Fourth time made advance booking for 90min Thai massage.

Not very consistent.

Although bright during the day, I preferred the nice Foot Massage chairs and their comfort over
the Thai Massage and open curtains setup upstairs which lacked airflow and aircon and Paid 690baht for 90mins.

I have tried many, many types of massage in BKK, ranging from high end (3000 baht/hour) to more reasonable prices. And so far, Mona is my absolute favourite. She doesn’t do random massaging. She feels points then dives in to loosen what she finds tight.
The supervisor, Nooki is also very pleasant and kind. I’m glad I found this massage place. It is very clean (which is so important).

If you need to sit down for a little bit, work on something in a relaxing environment for an hour or two, or just want to meet with someone over a coffee in a rather intimate setting - come here! Although I dont know how you can get in here without a Black Card.

The service here is really good, and the wait staff are trained specifically for customer service - to something close to the level of higher tier flight staff members. They are very courteous and the heads are usually on top of their game.

reviews.name: Zuzia Lesińska
reviews.text:
There was an issue with card payment at the beginning — the staff didn’t seem to know it was possible to pay by card. Eventually, I managed to pay through their website, but it took some time to sort out.

I can see that the girl tried her best, but unfortunately, this was probably the worst head spa experience I’ve ever had. It wasn’t relaxing at all — instead, it was painful and unpleasant.

The therapist didn’t speak English, which made communication nearly impossible. I couldn’t explain anything or ask for adjustments during the treatment. She applied a lot of oil on my face and massaged around the eyes very roughly, pulling and stretching the skin so much that the oil nearly got into my eyes. I had to ask for tissues to wipe it off.

Later on, she started massaging my legs, moving them so abruptly and forcefully that at one point, with water dripping nearby, it actually splashed into my eyes. It was very uncomfortable and far from a relaxing experience.

While my hair looked clean and nice afterwards, I left feeling tense and uncomfortable. I wouldn’t go back and definitely wouldn’t recommend this place — at least not with this therapist.

title: BaanThai Cookery School
subTitle: Baan Thai Cookery School
description: Laid-back school offering hands-on classes in traditional Thai cooking with local ingredients.
ownerDescription: Get ready for a mouthwatering journey at Baan Thai Cookery School, where we infuse the spirit of Thailand into the pure joy of cooking! Whether you're a culinary novice or a seasoned pro, you'll savor the art of Thai cuisine with our friendly instructors by your side. Turn up the heat, unleash your inner chef, and dive into a Thai flavor adventure that will leave you with unforgettable memories!
address: 9 Prapokklao Rd. Lane 9, Phra Sing, Mueng, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXPQ+WR Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Zoe Gage Self
reviews.text: Amazing cooking school experience. Boom took us to the local market to source all our ingredients, then welcomed back to her clean and luxurious kitchen facility where we cooked 6 courses! My husband and I were the only participants, so it really was like a private class. Great central location, great price, delicious food! Definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Atalanta Willoughby
reviews.text: Genuinely couldn’t recommend this experience more. We were picked up from our accommodation and taken first to the local market. The wonderful Boom walked us through all the staple ingredients in Thai dishes. She was so knowledgeable and we learnt so much. Then we were taken to the school and greeted with a drink and a snack before we began cooking. We were able to select which dishes we wanted to make. The chefs were all so friendly and made everything seem easy and achievable! It’s genuinely the first time I’ve really enjoyed cooking. I was particularly proud of myself for making spring rolls and curry paste from scratch! The Mango sticky rice was also a personal highlight for me. Everything was delicious. Crucially we were given a fantastic cook book at the end to take home all the knowledge and skills we picked up. This is an essential visit in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Valérie Gagnon
reviews.text: We just did the cooking class this morning and we are so happy to have chosen this place! We wanted a private and authentic experience and that's exactly what we had! The food was soooo delicious, we had to go walk after cause we ate so much! If you don't finish the food, they can put it in a box to bring home! Also, the little book at the end is just awesome!❤️

reviews.name: Teresa Koransky
reviews.text: This is such a great cooking class! My husband and I stumbled by this place while walking through Chiang Mai. The ratings were great and the people were friendly, so we signed up.  Tommy and Boom were absolutely fantastic!!! We had a small class, just one other couple. We started off at the market where Tommy described the spices and vegetables used in Thai cooking.  I didn't know there were so many kinds of ginger! We all made soups and sides and a main dish, along with classic pad thai and mango sticky rice with personalized instructions from either Tommy or Boom. And we could make everything as spicy or mild as we'd like.  We ate so much and still had our leftovers too take with us.  I recommend this school to anyone looking for a great cooking class.

reviews.name: Sujung P. (Sydney)
reviews.text: The whole experience was perfect — from picking up fresh ingredients at a local market, warming up with a welcome drink, and cooking a five-course authentic Thai meal, to learning about the culture and, of course, enjoying the dishes at the end. The teachers are considerate, patient, and speak English very well. At the conclusion of the session, you even receive a recipe book to take home. And did I mention that the facilities are spotless and beautifully maintained? Thank you, Boom and Tommy!

reviews.name: Heather McCracken
reviews.text:
Great experience from the market to the table!
Instructors are informative and friendly and really know how to use the right spices.
The food was delicious and the cookbook that is included is a bonus.
Anyone can walk out of this class and start cooking home made Thai food.
Come hungry because it’s a lot of food.

reviews.name: F M
reviews.text:
We went on a weekday in September so there were only a couple of us and got a lot of opportunity to ask questions! Class was 4-8 30 pm. Boom was amazing - she took us to the market to teach us about the ingredients and we made five dishes from scratch: pad Thai, one soup, one curry, an appetizer and mango sticky rice. There was just the right amount of supervision.  She helped us wash and portion the ingredients but we did all the cutting and cooking. For most dishes she would make one herself to show us the tricks. All the dishes were absolutely delicious and among the best food we ate in Thailand! I took notes during the class but you will get a physical book with their family recipes at the end to keep!
Make sure to bring cash to pay. No credit card

reviews.name: Angela Okune
reviews.text: Booked this easily via email with super speedy response back. We were a party of 5. Boom picked us up (and dropped us back off!) to our hotel which was a little outside old town. We loved every part of the experience. Didn’t feel overly touristy and that’s because Boom is down-to-earth, approachable and open to answering any questions. I know she gives these tours frequently but it didn’t feel coined or overly scripted at all. She gave us such in depth details about the unique ingredients during the market tour. Then she was great to instruct us on each dish. Both my 5 and 9 year old kids as well as my parents in their 70s enjoyed the experience. I appreciated how we made a dish, then ate it immediately while it was still hot. Make sure to come with an empty tummy! All in all, an incredible experience! Highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Siraj Gandhi
reviews.text: Baan Thai is awesome. The instructors were so kind and informative. You can tell they really love what they do. You start off in a local market briefly learning about local spices and herbs (with some time to buy your own to take home) before going to the cooking school to prepare dinner.  We made an appetizer, curry, noodle dish, and dessert. Each person gets to pick four dishes they want to make for themselves, and you can modify all to fit your dietary preferences/needs (vegan, vegetarian, allergies). They taught us about the specific flavors each ingredient adds to the dish and which parts of Thailand each dish originates from. Every part of the cooking process feels so authentic and culturally grounded. Everything is family friendly, great for young kids too, and one of the team members even takes high quality camera photos that you get emailed to you at the end of the night. Every dish we made came out so good; it was really hard to believe that we made it. Hands down best pad thai, pad see ew, mango sticky rice, and panang curry we have ever eaten, in the US and at local restaurants in Thailand.

reviews.name: park christine
reviews.text: I took this class twice while in Chiang Mai. It included pickup and drop-off, a market tour, detailed explanations of ingredients, and a special recipe book. You can choose the food you want and make it, and when you're full, you can take it home. This is a class I would really recommend.

reviews.name: Pantea Rahimian
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at this cooking school and highly recommended it. It was so fun to go to the market, learn about the original ingredients for some of our favorite dishes and meet a new friend Julio! We made papaya salad which is one of my favorites and various other dishes. Boom is a fantastic teacher and overall we had a wonderful time. If you are in Chiang Mai this is one activity that you must try with this cooking school.

reviews.name: Karen Lott
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed returning to this delightful cooking school after 20 years! The premises are new and pretty & scrupulously clean.  Tommy and Boom were really friendly & great teachers. We had a fabulous morning cooking 4 dishes of our own choices from a great selection .  Too much to eat it all but they also offered us to takeaway some. We learned a lot about Thai foods and cooking hints.  Also loved it was a maximum of 8 participants as other schools are way too big and impersonal. Faultless!

reviews.name: Lior Schnitzer
reviews.text: Took the evening course. Very knowledgeable instructors with a real passion for Thai food. Started with a trip to the market for a short lecture about the basic ingredients used in Thai cuisine, followed by cooking a Thai meal. The evening was so fun and informative, I will surely do it again if I’m ever in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: PJ Damen
reviews.text: Perfect! Went there with my wife and teens (12&13). Had a great experience. The course is a nice mixture of learning, eating and chatting. The pace is just perfect.

reviews.name: Oach Katzerl
reviews.text:
Amazing nice and clean place for cooking class. The teacher are absolutely nice. First went with us to the market and explained the ingredients and herbs.
The food was delicious. No need to go for lunch or dinner that day.
Just booked it by mail the same day for the evening.
I highly recommend it to everyone.
Next time I'm here, I'll cook with them again.

reviews.name: Noa
reviews.text: We took Boom’s cooking class and it was an amazing experience! All her team had such great energy, we did a lovely tour of the market and later we were welcomed with a cocktail to the cooking class. The class was super fun, we cooked delicious food in a great atmosphere, the dishes were bountiful, the team explained what ingredients can be replaced when cooking at home and we also got a detailed cookbook. It was one of the highlights of our trip, Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Charlotte Reeves
reviews.text: I'm leaving this review on behalf of my husband, who I booked the cooking class for while we were on holiday in Chiang Mai. He's definitely the cook in the family, which is why I sent him off to cookery school so he can come back and make me delicious Thai food at home! The booking process was super easy, I just emailed and got a response pretty much straight away. He had a BALL at the morning class, he is already a pretty good cook but learned so much more, especially how to make everything from scratch. I got to sample the spring rolls and mango sticky rice afterwards and they were amazing! A lovely touch was the gallery of photos that were sent through afterwards, they made me feel like I was right there and it all looked so clean and bright and professional. We will definitely recommend this experience to others who might be visiting Chiang Mai in the future!

reviews.name: Lea Vannier
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience taking a private Thai cooking class. The instructor was very kind, patient, and knowledgeable, and the whole session felt authentic and enjoyable. I learned a lot and had so much fun preparing (and tasting!) the dishes. Highly recommended for anyone looking to discover Thai cuisine in a hands-on way!

reviews.name: SAMANTHA MCCUBBIN
reviews.text:
We had the most amazing experience yesterday with Boom ! At Baan Thai cookery.

She was so friendly , patient and kind and taught us how to cook four authentic Thai dishes.   She took us to the market first to choose our fresh Ingredients and then we headed to the kitchen in town.

It was so much fun but also very educational and she made it so simple for us.  We can’t wait to bring our new Thai cooking skills to Scotland.

Thanks again Boom !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind words and for taking the time to leave us a wonderful review. We're so glad to hear that you enjoyed it.Your feedback means a lot. Looking forward to serving you again in the future 😊

reviews.name: Reut Lieber
reviews.text:
Amazing!!!
The best cooking class I have ever had!
Boom, the owner and the instructor, is so professional and welcoming. We used high quality ingredients only, everything was fresh and clean.
We made everything from scratch ourselves- even the curry paste!
The cooking class opened us a whole new world of thai cuisine, and we fell in love.
Please don’t miss the opportunity to come here and have the best time in thailand!

reviews.name: Thomas Franks
reviews.text:
Terrible massage! I booked the back, head and shoulder massage at Sirimas massage. Was taken upstairs into the stuffy massage room where all the noise of the main road makes it sound like you are being massaged on the street. No music or scents used to make the room feel anything a little more relaxing. Then asked to lay on my stomach for the massage - the bed had no hole you for head so you are forced to lay uncomfortably with either your head to the side or your face rammed into a pillow - why don’t you have proper massage beds?
Then the massage itself just consisted of the lady forcing her elbows into my spine for 30 mins. I spent the whole time wincing in pain and ask her to be more careful. She would find knots and then just rub them as hard as possible regardless how much pain I was in. It felt like she had no idea what she was doing and had no training into a relaxing massage.
After 30 mins having not massaged my shoulders or head, she moved to my legs - I explained that I have shin splints and it is painful to massage my legs - which she didn’t understand and carried on anyway.
I wanted to leave the massage after 10 minutes and truly wish I did. I am flying home today and have now have back pain (I am an 85 kg rugby player, so it’s not just me being soft) from this elbow beating.
My advice is to spend a little more money on a proper spa massage with relaxed environment and trained masseuse. Don’t do what I did and spend your last cash here hoping to be relaxed, you’ll be better off buying a cold Chang and people watching for an hour!

reviews.name: Mark Cossin
reviews.text:
I recently completed Remco's six-day Chi Nei Tsang (abdominal massage) certification course at Blue Garden Yoga Center in Chiang Mai, and I couldn't be happier with the experience.

The course consisted of approximately four hours of instruction each day, with plenty of hands-on practice. To earn my certification, I completed a full one-hour abdominal massage on a classmate, which was an excellent way to put everything I had learned into practice. (The full hour sequence took me more than an hour but I'll get better with practice.)

One of the biggest surprises for me was how much I learned about the anatomy of the abdomen and chest. Remco explained how working with specific abdominal zones can influence the flow of chi and correspond to different internal organs. It gave me a completely new appreciation for the connection between anatomy, energy, and therapeutic touch.

Remco is an outstanding instructor. His teaching style is engaging, approachable, and filled with humor, making everything easy to understand. He was generous with his knowledge, patient with questions, and genuinely invested in helping us succeed.

I would highly recommend this course to anyone interested in massage therapy, bodywork, or holistic health. Even if you never plan to work professionally and simply want to learn techniques to help your family, friends, or yourself, this course offers valuable knowledge and practical skills that you'll use for years to come.

reviews.name: Vivie Filippidi
reviews.text: I really enjoyed Remco’s abdominal massage training. I honestly expected something soft and light, but it turned out to be a deep and very interesting organ massage training. Remco is super knowledgeable, humble, and really pays attention to every student in the room. I loved how dedicated he was — constantly helping, correcting, and making sure everyone felt comfortable and confident. You can feel he takes his work seriously, while still bringing such a positive and vibrant energy. Highly recommend ✨Thank you Remco, I'm already practising what I learned in Crete x

reviews.text: Loved every second at Remco‘s school. I took the Chi Nei Tsang 1 course and feel so much more confident and secure with my knowledge and skills after only 6 days. Remco has the gift to not miss any details when it comes to adjusting and correcting your technique / touch. I‘m so happy to have met such an amazing teacher and would recommend anyone to take his courses. 🙏

5/5 and even more if i could !
I did chi nei tsang 1 and 2 and I am so grateful for the experience.
Remco is a great teacher : patient, humble, as well as very thorough and attentive, he will let you let you know how you can improve in a very kind way.

Book ahead in advance as he only teaches to small groups, (which is so nice)

He is fluent in English and learned from a very traditional thai lineage long ago.

Also, there’s an online content (videos of the course) + pdf book which is an awesome resource to keep track.

Bonus point : the blue garden is a beautiful place

I happily recommend this place to my friends & would come back ☀️

reviews.name: Lisa Smit
reviews.text:
I did the Chi Nei Tsang course with Remco this month. There are several places in Chiang Mai for this but Blue Garden is the most affordable one I saw. The fact that Remco has been practicing Chi Nei Tsang for 25 years now convinced me to give it a try. And I am so happy with my decision!

Remco is a great teacher. He communicates very clearly, enjoys what he does and is very precise in his teachings. He doesn't allow you to be sloppy, he pays attention to all the details and sees everything (even while lying down)! Also he is very humble. He never thinks a question is stupid and often laughs at himself. His prices are similar to those of massage schools run by thai people. He doesn't charge more because he's a westener (something you see a lot). I think that's really cool.

The fact that he also recorded this course so you can watch everything back later is amazing because during the course you can really be in the moment and not worry about filming or taking lots of notes.

This was my second time in CM doing massage courses and will be back again next year studying at blue garden for sure!! Now I know the quality of this school its a must go for me.

reviews.name: Max Gerard
reviews.text: Very beautiful experience with Remco. I studied Neuro thaï and dynamic thaï massage at Blue Garden. Very beautiful technique, sure… but I need to say the teaching goes beyond the techniques or maybe the techniques give a better perception of the teaching. I mean it goes together beautifully. Thank you for your teaching and sharings

reviews.name: MP
reviews.text:
I’m very grateful to have come across Remco’s place and teachings during my time in Chiang Mai.
I really recommend this course to anyone looking for an in-depth, sensitive, and yet very complete approach to Thai massage.
I had first planned to do all my training at one of the well-known Thai schools in Chiang Mai, but after two weeks I found myself looking for more depth and practice, more sensibility and a less mechanical approach.
Remco’s way of teaching was exactly what I was looking for. It’s truly a hands-on practice course, where you get to repeat and refine a lot. He gives great attention and care to each student, always coming around to correct our posture, giving tips on how to use our bodies better, to soften and relax more.
He also adapts to each person giving individual advice, as every body is different.
I really enjoyed the authenticity of the place, very good vibes !
I could only complete half of the full-month course as my time in Chiang Mai was running out, but I definitely got a lot out of it and I’ll surely come back for more training if life allows it !
Thank you, Remco!

reviews.name: Michaël Niel
reviews.text:
After studying in several Thai massage schools in Chiang Mai, Remco is so far the teacher that paid most attention to little details to help me improve. He tries to find solutions specific to each students so that they "get it": this is quite precious for a teacher, and not very common in Chiang Mai.

A specific shout out to his videos online:
The fact that he provides extremely detailed videos allows us to be fully present, and not like zombies filming and looking through the screens of phones as it tends to happen in other schools.
Having that tool really helps the learning experience!

The place itself is very relaxing, and what I would call "human sized". It's good if you like small groups, like me!
If you want to hang out with big groups of foreigners, there are bigger schools where you might get a little bit more of a "campus feeling"... Maybe with less time for individual feedback from the teacher, though.

Thanks!
Michaël, from France

reviews.name: Colleen Thornton
reviews.text: Remco & Bow run a magnificent yoga/detox/massage-training enterprise out of a charming little garden studio on a tiny soi across from Wat Pha Khao in old town Chiang Mai. Describing this gem of a place properly is almost impossible; it's something you have to see and experience for yourself. That I travel to Chiang Mai for a few months every year JUST for Remco's yoga classes is testament to how awesome his yoga is. He hosts a power vinyasa session in the mornings, and a delicious Hatha class in the evenings, weaving yoga fundamentals with flowy, feel-good, often playful movement that leaves you feeling like you've just had a massage. As humble as he may be, Remco's expertise in body work is extensive. Since taking his yoga and massage classes, I've gained so much more knowledge about how to "listen" to my body, respect its limits, build core strength, and alleviate a chronic issue. One of the highlights of Blue Garden, among many, is the tree in the center of the studio, surrounded by a beautiful wood-planked floor and gorgeous natural light streaming in through the surrounding garden and windows. The sound of their little waterfall is gorgeous and calming, and sometimes you're lucky enough to hear the monks chanting from the wat across the street. I highly recommend visiting Blue Garden, whether you simply want to take a yoga class while you're visiting Chiang Mai, experience an authentic Chi Nei Tsang massage, enhance your massage trainings, or do a 3-day detox with Bow. They also recently opened one of the city's few float tanks - an incredible experience. Thanks Remco & Bow–you're my favourite place in Chiang Mai!

Accompanied by his two cute dogs at his studio, I felt at home and learned a lot. I hope to go back in the years to come.

ownerDescription: With love and a Thai smile, we would like to invite those who are fascinated by traditional Thai food to join us in the friendly and fun atmosphere of the Galangal Cooking Studio of Chiang Mai. We have a lovely, spacious cooking studio on a big piece of land complete with an outside relaxing area and our own garden We offer an air-conditioned cooking environment and friendly service.

reviews.name: Mike Portch
reviews.text: My partner and I lived in Chiang Mai about 15 years ago and we returned with our two children in March 2026 for a holiday. We chose galangal cooking studio because of the menu and the ratings, and we most certainly weren’t disappointed. I would highly recommend this cooking class to anybody who would love a great day (or evening) and learn some authentic Thai dishes and have a few laughs. In particular, I really enjoyed learning to cook Khao Soi!! Was such a great day and value for money. Thank you!

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Galangal Cooking Studio in Chiang Mai. From start to finish everything was fantastic!
The market tour was incredibly interesting and gave us a great introduction to Thai ingredients and local food culture. Our instructor New was a wonderful host — friendly, patient, and extremely knowledgeable. She explained every step clearly and made the whole class fun and engaging.
The dishes we cooked turned out absolutely delicious, and I was honestly surprised by how good everything tasted. It felt very authentic and hands-on.
If you’re visiting Chiang Mai and want to learn how to cook real Thai food, I highly recommend this class. One of the best experiences of my trip!

reviews.name: Jack Armitage
reviews.text: I booked an evening cooking class, and got lucky as I was the only one who booked for that night so basically had a private class to myself! reviews.name: Marisa Mansueto
reviews.text: While in Chiang Mai, my husband and I booked a private class at Galangal Cooking Studio. Aoy picked us up from our hotel and we went to a local market to pick up all of the ingredients we needed and learned about what to use. From there we went to the studio, which is beautiful! Very clean and homey feeling. We made 5 meals from scratch each. My husband and I both chose different dishes so we had 10 different dishes to eat. We made everything with Aoy’s guidance and had such a fun day. The food was amazing. The best food we ate on our entire trip in Thailand. I would highly recommend a private class because it was very intimate. However I’m sure a public class is just as enjoyable. After our class Aoy sent us a digital cooking book with a bunch of recipes which I’m so excited to try some when we return home. We would visit again for sure the next time we are in Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you!

reviews.name: Sonal Sharma
reviews.text: This was our final activity in Thailand, and it certainly lived up to our expectations. Our instructor, New (yes, that’s her name—she jokes about it being "old" and not "new"). Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted and seated while waiting for the rest of the group. Once everyone had arrived, we took a brief trip to the local market to gain insight into where and how the ingredients are sourced. After that, we returned to the studio, donned our aprons, and began the step-by-step process of preparing four dishes of our choosing, which we selected through a link sent by New that morning. You can also purchase beers on-site at a reasonable price compared to other restaurants. It was a delightful experience mingling with people from all over the world, and no prior cooking experience is necessary to join the class. After cooking each dish, we sat down to enjoy it before moving on to the next one. Overall, it was a fun evening filled with great food and New's expert guidance—definitely an experience you won't want to miss!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi! Thank you for your lovely review, appriciate that!

reviews.name: Jo Full
reviews.text: In Chiang Mai?  Want to learn to cook Thai food?  Well, this is your place.   Aoy and her staff are awesome, the facility is spacious and stocked with everything you need.  Aoy is a very funny, very knowledgeable, and very professional.   Started off the day (it was my surprise birthday present) at the nicest large market I've seen in Chiang Mai.  She ran me through all the different ingredients, spices, meats, etc..., that were offered there ( and there were A LOT!!) then told me to wander around while she bought all the supplies for the class.   A quick ride from there to her studio and the class began.  Learned four dishes, to include my all time favorite Khao Soi, and went through all the various techniques and nuances of how to make a Thai kitchen.  Suffice to say, she and the class were awesome and I can only highly recommend this to anyone interested in learning how to make Thai cuisine.    Outstanding job Aoy and all your staff.  You made for a fantastic birthday!

reviews.name: Michelle H
reviews.text:
Attending a cooking class in Chiang Mai with Chef New was an outstanding experience. From the very beginning, it was clear that we were in for a treat. Chef New‘s English was excellent, making communication seamless and her instructions easy to follow. Her explanations were thorough and engaging, ensuring everyone understood each step of the process.

The class started with an informative visit to a local market, where we bought fresh ingredients for our dishes. This immersive experience allowed us to appreciate the importance of quality ingredients in Thai cuisine and gave us a glimpse into local culture.

We prepared a variety of dishes: Pad Thai, fried spring rolls, Khao Soi, and Tom Ka Gai soup. Each recipe was a delight to cook, and the results were delicious. Chef New‘s guidance made even complex techniques feel manageable, and her enthusiasm was contagious.

Overall, this cooking class was a highlight of our trip to Chiang Mai. Chef New‘s expertise and friendly demeanor made the experience both educational and enjoyable. I highly recommend this class to anyone interested in learning Thai cooking and experiencing the rich culinary heritage of Chiang Mai.

reviews.text:
My party and I called in a reservation a night before for 10 people. They confirmed it was alright and that they could do all of us at the same time, and gave us the price upfront.

The next day we come in right at our reserved time and they are severely understaffed. We mentioned that we called ahead of time and they just said yes and that they received our call. Although we mentioned 10 people would be receiving a 90-minute massage, there were not enough staff.

Our appointment was at 5pm and my cousin and I only got massages starting at 6:30pm for me, and 7:00pm for my cousin. A masseuse from one of our other friends had to come down to help us afterward because there weren’t enough staff. Same thing happened with lateness for 2 members of our party.

We did not receive any compensation nor discount because we had to pay upfront before the services. We only received a refund on just getting a 60-minute massage for the last two members because the rest of our party had been waiting too long and we had to leave so we didn’t have time to do the full 90-minutes.

As for the massages themselves, we could barely even enjoy them because we had just been waiting for so long and some didn’t even receive a good massage with the hot stone treatment.

I would not recommend with a large party, because even if you reserve ahead of time and confirm your booking, you will not receive your treatments on time.

reviews.text:
Clean, kind service, but mixed massage

Very clean space with AC and average prices for the area. The service was warm and professional, and the masseuse was extremely kind and considerate, she even asked for consent before touching my face, which I appreciated.

3 things affected the experience: the massage bed creaked very loudly with almost every movement, which disrupted relaxation, and the massage pressure was too light for my preference while massage technique was hit or miss dueing my treatment. While the masseuse checked in and did her best to go harder when I asked, her grip strength just wasn't very strong, which unfortunately lowered the quality of the massage for me (not her fault, just a personal preference).

On the positive side, the head massage part of the treatment was excellent, which says a lot especially coming from someone like me who usually doesn’t enjoy head massages.

reviews.name: Sigurd Von Balfoort
reviews.text:
Our visit to Chiang Mai Boxing Stadium was enjoyable and well organized. We chose the VIP option, which offered slightly better seating and a clear view of the ring, making it easy to follow the fights comfortably. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout the evening, which added to the overall experience.

The atmosphere in the stadium is lively and authentic, with a good mix of technique, intensity, and respect between the fighters. It’s a great way to experience Muay Thai in a setting that feels genuine and energetic.

Food and drinks were minimal and served about ten minutes before the fights began simple and straightforward, clearly not the main focus of the night. Still, everything ran smoothly, and the staff’s kindness made the service pleasant.

Overall, Chiang Mai Boxing Stadium offers a fun and engaging night out. The VIP option adds convenience without being over the top, and the combination of friendly staff, good seating, and real Muay Thai action makes it worth a visit.

reviews.name: Laurie Montes
reviews.text: I really enjoyed it and would have loved it even more if they had included the girl's fight as advertised. That was actually the main reason I bought the tickets. The atmosphere was fantastic, and everything was clean, well-organized, and fun.

reviews.name: Jenny
reviews.text: We came here mid week after purchasing tickets online. You can also purchase at the door so you don’t have to book in advance. We showed up around 8:45 and there were still good seats left. We watched 6 fights that were all really fun to watch. The bar was cheap with beer starting at 50 THB. I recommend this to anyone.

reviews.name: Deddy Paz
reviews.text:
This feels more like a tourist scam than a legitimate venue showcasing real fights.

The fighters are teenagers and complete amateurs. It is honestly ridiculous. The way the event is promoted makes it seem like you are going to see professional fights, but the reality is completely different.

It is simply a waste of time and money. Also, notice that many of the positive reviews boosting the Google rating appear to be from locals. In my opinion, this feels like a well-organized system designed to mislead tourists.

reviews.name: Tracey C
reviews.text:
A different and more "professional" vibe than the other stadiums in the city - feels like it could be in Bangkok or Phuket - fights are good quality and mostly feature reasonably experienced Thai fighters from the local region.

Traditional 5 round bouts with Wai Kru and dancing in the fifth round. There are some big money fights with one fight I saw earning a 50k bonus!

It's a family friendly atmosphere even if it starts a little late - and the ticket price is fair for the quality of the show (between 600 and 1200 baht).

It only lacks a little bit of the heart of some of the smaller local stadiums which is why it gets 4 stars.

reviews.name: Bawa Bawa Bawa
reviews.text: Ignore the negative reviews! As someone who isn't a combat sports fan, I found the whole experience incredible. Highly recommend if it's your first time watching Muay Thai

reviews.name: Cognizant Voyages
reviews.text:
This stadium feels more family-oriented and is probably a softer introduction to Muay Thai compared to the scale and intensity of places like Rajadamnern Stadium

We saw quite a few families there, including kids who looked to be between about 5 and 15 years old. That said, it’s worth noting that the fights start at 9:00 p.m.,so it is still a late evening for younger children.

The venue itself is comfortable and well run: air-conditioned, organized, and easy to grab a drink.

The fights we saw, however, were quite short. There were seven in total, and most ended in the first round, but maybe we caught it on an off night.

We did appreciate that the stadium is focused on developing local northern talent. Most matchups were Thai fighters in the same weight class, and there was only one bout where a foreigner appeared significantly heavier than his Thai opponent; something you sometimes see elsewhere.

From looking into the training room, we also noticed many fighters were using standard training wraps rather than fully taped hands used at higher-level professional events. It gave the evening more of a developmental, grassroots feel rather than a top-tier showcase.

Overall, it felt approachable and community-focused, but not the highest level of competition.

reviews.name: J F
reviews.text: Just ok experience,  if you are used to watching any action sports, this may bore you. I left halfway through. You will need alcohol to get through watching these fights. Set bar of expectations low. They are amateur fighters -  mostly, if not all, teenagers. Whole place smells strongly of moth balls. Was about half full on weeknight. I can see if you've never watched any fighting ever on TV then you may be entertained.

reviews.name: Jesse
reviews.text:
It was nice to experience national sport of Thailand in Chiang Mai. We booked tickets thru Booking.com and process was simple.
Stadium is in decent condition. Amount of fights varies, there was 6 fights this night. Only 1-2 of them was entertaining, but mostly level was training match-like.

I was suprised that there were NO local people on saturday evening (prime time) in audience. Maybe it’s too expensive or they know these fights are more for the tourists. Anyways If u wanna experience Thai boxing match in Chiang Mai, visit this place. Ringside seat cost 1 000 bahts, but next time I would rather just buy the normal 600 baht seat as you probably see better from there (the fighting might feel more intimite from ringside seat tho)

btw scooter park is 5 baht

reviews.name: TravelingObsidianFoodie
reviews.text: Event was good in the sense of experience and helping out locals but don't expect too much. Fighters were amateurs and still look like they're in training. Watching them fight was so boring. I was yawning the entire time. They started so late too. I didn't stay long after 4 short matches I went out and decided to just get a coffee instead.

reviews.name: TIMOTHY MICHAEL TALBOTT
reviews.text:
Omg this was the best part of my trip to Chiang Mai. Obviously there are more cultural things to do, but this was a great way to experience the nightlife.

Word of advice on seating. Three options.

1. Grandstand  seating (which is what I choose). Good but make sure you are at least  three levels up or the ropes can block your view. Make sure you are not at a corner angle. There are guys videoing the event in the corners of the ring and block the view.

2. Ring side seating. Plastic chairs around the ring. Looked fine, but I don’t think the view would be as good as the grandstand.

3. VIP which I think had the better view, but not for the price. 900bhat more then the grandstand. If you drink a lot it’s a better option, but beers are 100bhat. So unless you drink at least 9 beers or Alcohol drinks I wouldn’t.

I’m 48yo white guy from America and sat next to 5-6 (18-21 yo) Brit guys and had a blast. Everyone from the employees, the customers and even the unofficial guys taking bets are there to have a good time.

Make sure you pregame or get there early to get your beers. Before the fight it’s a madhouse trying to get a beer. After the fights starts no problem.

ownerDescription:
We are children of the North, the former kingdom of Lanna. We appreciate our arts and culture and love nature: our rice paddies and the mountains. We enjoy seeing people happy, their faces adorned with beautiful smiles. All this contributed to something that we built with love.
It is called Fah Lanna Spa.

reviews.name: Nicole Berkowitz
reviews.text: I had a 90-minute pregnancy massage and it was so disappointing. I had been so excited to try this place because most of the massage places in Thailand don’t offer any sort of prenatal option, and figured it must be good since it was much more expensive than any other place around. When I arrived for my appointment, they told me they only do soft pressure for pregnancy massages. I wish this had been posted somewhere in advance. Anyway, I proceeded with the massage thinking that would at least mean some pressure. I asked for more pressure multiple times, but it was still barely anything. Even the light pressure strokes were too short to actually accomplish anything and there was zero massage done on my feet. I’m very achy and sore from pregnancy and this did zero to improve that. Waste of my time and money. The spa itself seemed nice and less sketchy than the others around it, so maybe the experience of a regular massage would be better
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We'd like to take the opportunity to explain that our pregnancy massage is intentionally light and gentle by design, with the aim of promoting relaxation while prioritizing the wellbeing and safety of both mother and baby. This is clearly described in our spa menu and on our website: "Pregnancy massage is light and gentle massage".

We completely understand that pregnancy often comes with sore muscles, water retention, and aching feet, and that many expectant mothers would prefer a stronger massage. However, in accordance with the Thai Ministry of Public Health's guidelines, we do not perform stronger massage techniques or foot massage during pregnancy. Foot massage is avoided because pregnant women have a higher risk of blood clots, and massage could pose a risk if a clot is present. In addition, certain pressure points on the feet are traditionally believed to stimulate uterine contractions, which could potentially induce labour, and are therefore avoided as a precaution.

We also provide dedicated information about pregnancy massage and treatments you should avoid on our website at www.fahlanna.com/pregnancy-massage.

We truly appreciate your feedback and are pleased to hear you enjoyed the spa environment.

Warm regards from your Fah Lanna Spa Team. 🌿🙏

💆 Hidden gem massage spot

I almost walked right out as soon as I stepped in — the place didn’t look promising at all.
But I was desperate for a massage, had no energy to Google alternatives, and saw so many rave reviews… so I gave it a shot.

And wow — my doubts melted away the second the massage started.
I booked the 90-min Thai massage + 30-min foot massage combo (550 baht promo), and it was hands-down one of the best Thai massages I’ve had.

The foot massage was done while lying down
I tried to stay awake to remember how good it was… but halfway through, I was out like a light.

💡 Lesson learned: Massage skills do NOT always match the shop’s appearance or price.
I’ve had 300 baht massages way better than 1,000 baht ones — especially for Thai massage.
Sometimes, the simpler places surprise you the most.
But I personally don’t go for aroma massage at cheaper shops, since I’m picky about the oils 😅

If you care more about skill than setting, this place is absolutely worth a visit.

title: Krudam Muay Thai School
subTitle: Krudam Gym
address: 67 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PH9G+FG Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Honest Reviews Only
reviews.text:
I booked a private session through Facebook Messenger and found the gym to be quite responsive beforehand. I visited on a Thursday afternoon for a 90 min 1:1 session which cost THB 1499. The entire experience was excellent and my coach was very professional and patient. He took the time to focus on fixing my fundamentals and I honestly learned more in those 90 mins than I have during months of training back home.

The session was very well structured and included stretching, running, skipping, shadow Muay Thai, bag work, pad work, and some light sparring.

The gym itself is well maintained and has good ventilation. It is noticeably clean compared to many other Muay Thai gyms. They offer shower facilities and provide private session customers with the free use of a clean towel. You can also purchase bottled water at the office for THB 10 for a small bottle or THB 20 for a large one.

Overall it was a great experience and I look forward to going back for more training.

reviews.name: Eddie Narayan
reviews.text:
My two daughters trained here for a few days and we couldn't be happier with the experience. The facilities are outstanding—clean, modern, and very well maintained, with everything you need for quality Muay Thai training.

The coaches and staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and patient. From the moment we walked through the doors, they made us feel right at home. They took the time to encourage the kids, build their confidence, and create a fun, supportive environment while still delivering excellent training.

It's clear that everyone here is passionate about what they do, and the positive atmosphere makes this gym stand out. Whether you're a complete beginner or have experience, I highly recommend Krudam Muay Thai School. Thank you to the entire team for making our girls' experience so memorable—we'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: ManorNoam
reviews.text:
A deeply unprofessional and unsafe experience. One of the coach claimed that I had thrown an excessively hard punch during sparring at a partner who weighs roughly 90 kg (about the same as me). Instead of stopping the round and addressing the issue appropriately, he called me in to spar with him and began hitting me with excessive force. When I asked him to reduce the intensity, he angrily replied that he was simply doing to me what I had "done" to others.

A coach’s responsibility is to set boundaries and protect trainees, not use sparring as a form of physical punishment. I have trained in Muay Thai and MMA for four and a half years, including at gyms throughout Thailand and Vietnam, and I have never encountered behaviour like this. I will never return to a gym that operates this way.

Beyond this incident, there is very little meaningful technical instruction. I was there two times, and both sessions follow essentially the same repetitive format, with little progression and almost nothing new being taught. The people (trainees and some of the trainers) are generally friendly, but some of the coaching is simply unprofessional. I cannot recommend this gym.

reviews.text: This place is awesome.  The instructors are super knowledgeable,helpful and friendly.  On top of that , they made the experience so fun .   Don’t make no mistake, it’s not playing around , you will experience an intense session.  If I was living in Bangkok, I would definitely join this gym!

reviews.name: John Iskander
reviews.text:
Training at Krudam Muay Thai School was hands-down one of the most inspiring and energizing experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by walls filled with medals, certifications, and photos that speak volumes about the gym’s legacy and success in producing elite fighters.

The facilities are top-notch, spacious mats, a full ring setup, and a wide range of gear for all levels. Whether you’re a beginner or a pro, they’ve got you covered. The energy here is contagious. You can feel the discipline, passion, and respect for the art of Muay Thai everywhere.

Coach Dam Srichan and his team are incredibly knowledgeable, humble, and motivating. Their professionalism and focus on proper technique, conditioning, and mindset make every session feel purposeful. Plus, the sense of community among students and fighters is unmatched.

If you’re looking to train in authentic Muay Thai while being surrounded by champions and a world-class team, this is the place to be. I’d give it more than 5 stars if I could. Thank you Krudam Gym for such a memorable and empowering experience!

reviews.name: Niphylla
reviews.text:
My masseur fell asleep.

I had a great 2hr Thai massage session when I first patronised this place 2 days ago. Given the pleasant 5 stars experience by a lovely masseur, I booked another session right before I leave bkk, and the experience was the worst I’ve ever had in my whole life.

1. I told her verbally and made a cross with my hand to indicate where to avoid my foot as i had operation previously. She couldn’t understand and asked the receptionist to translate (i had no problem with the previous masseur despite being much older than her).

2. She fell asleep while massaging my leg, yes, you read it right. I was about to fall asleep and had heavy breathing, next moment I felt the pressure reduced to almost nonexistent. Her whole body was rocking back and forth and touching my leg. I quickly woke up and moved to show that “hey, im awake now”. Pressure was still light as she was still sleeping. The left leg was alright but she fell asleep when massaging my right leg. Totally unacceptable.

3. The app let us indicate the focus area and avoid area, yet she did not focus on the area I indicated: feet, shoulder and head. Most of the time was focused on back using her elbow which was not requested at all.

4. When told her it hurts when she used her elbow on my bum, she did not acknowledge and moved on to the next part. No eye contact, no apologies, no expression.

All in all, given the bad experience, I do not recommend to anyone.
