title: Tree 2 Massage
subTitle: Tree 2 Massage ทรี 2 นวดแผนไทย (@อ่อนนุช)
address: 79 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
plusCode: PJ42+R9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: A
reviews.text:
Horrible massage experience

I only came here because my partner had a great experience the day before with a different therapist. Unfortunately, that therapist wasn’t working today, and both of us ended up having a terrible experience. We left with sore muscles and painful joints rather than feeling relaxed.

From the beginning, the therapists were impatient when we tried to explain that we wanted certain areas of our bodies to be avoided. They also chatted with each other throughout most of the session, which felt unprofessional and made it difficult to relax.

The massage itself was extremely inconsistent. It started with almost no pressure at all—it felt more like someone lightly touching my skin than giving a massage. When I politely asked for a little more pressure on the muscles, the therapist immediately switched to using excessive force. It became painful, and even after I repeatedly told her that it was too painful and asked her to ease up, she simply smiled and carried on with the same amount of pressure as if my feedback didn’t matter.

Ironically, the only times the pressure became lighter were when she stopped moving completely and started chatting with her colleague. At that point, I had already given up expecting a proper massage and didn’t even mind that she wasn’t really working while talking.

Around 20% of the session consisted of her pressing hard on a single spot without any movement for nearly a minute at a time. There was no actual massage technique involved—just sustained pressure. I’ve had many massages before, and this did not feel like a professional technique.

Even worse, about half of the time the pressure was applied directly to my bones and joints instead of the muscle tissue. Rather than kneading or working the muscles, most of the session felt like forceful compression. It was uncomfortable and, at times, genuinely painful.

The worst part came during the stretching portion. The therapist used her knee directly against my spine—not the muscles beside it, but my actual spine. I immediately stopped her because I was concerned about being injured. Although I had paid for a 60-minute massage, the session effectively ended after about 50 minutes.

When I returned to my hotel, I discovered multiple bruises on my body, which only confirmed how excessive the pressure had been.

The environment was also disappointing. The room felt damp, and the massage beds were placed so close together that you could easily bump into the person next to you or be bumped by them during the treatment. It offered very little privacy or comfort.

This experience was not only disappointing but also left me with bruises and lingering pain. I cannot recommend this place, and I certainly won’t be returning.

reviews.name: Bryan Exel Sumugat
reviews.text:
Nap Lab Chula is a great spot for both relaxing and getting work done. The space is bright and well-designed, and the temperature is very comfortable, not too cold or too warm, which makes it easy to stay for long periods.

The area is clearly divided into a work zone and a nap zone. The nap area is especially nice for resting and recharging, and it feels calm and well-maintained. It’s a unique concept that’s executed really well.

One of the highlights is the range of amenities available for free. You can borrow pillows, monitors, stationery, and other essentials, which makes the experience very convenient. There are also different packages to choose from depending on your needs, and student discounts make it even more affordable.

Overall, it’s clean, quiet, and thoughtfully organized. A solid choice for students or anyone looking for a comfortable place to rest or be productive.

reviews.text:
One of the cleanest massage places I’ve ever been to. They use fresh pillows, blankets, and clothing, all sealed in individual bags. The fabrics smell clean and fresh, adding to the overall experience. The room has a comfortable temperature, soft background music, and dim lighting, perfect for relaxation.

The lady masseuse had strong palms and applied just the right amount of pressure. She wasn’t talkative, which I appreciated, but checked in occasionally to make sure the pressure wasn’t too much. It allowed me to fully relax.

The session started with a foot scrub and massage, and ended with a nice cup of hot tea.

There are plenty of massage chairs and beds available, but I still recommend calling ahead. There’s also limited parking right behind the building, so booking in advance is a good idea.

reviews.text: I have never had someone fall asleep on me while giving me a massage but here I am writing a review about it. This guy only massaged me with one arm for 80% of the massage and he used his elbow for it. At first I was like okay this guy is inexperienced but then for the second part of the massage he was rubbing my head and would just stop randomly. I thought he was maybe texting at first but then he would jolt and start massaging me again. I finally figured it out when he would start slightly snoring. Funny in the moment but horrible massage. They are not properly trained in Thai massages here do not go here. Also they are cash only.

reviews.name: Jeraldine Saulda
reviews.text:
Hutthaburi is my go-to massage place! I always come here because the service is consistently great. P’Oz is my most trusted and favorite masseur — he’s so good and truly professional. He really knows what your body needs and makes sure you leave feeling relaxed and recharged.
Prices are very reasonable, the staff are friendly and accommodating, and the whole place has a calm, comfortable vibe. It’s clean, cozy, and easy to feel at home here. The only small thing I’d love to see improved is for the tea they serve after the session to be hot — but that’s just me! 👌🏻

The therapist has no energy or effort at all. There was zero pressure throughout the 90-minute session.

She kept chatting with other therapists through the curtain the entire time, and even stopped massaging just to talk when someone walked by. The curtain was also partly open during the session, which felt uncomfortable.

Totally wasted my time and 525 THB here.

The machine actually removed a lot of blackheads from my pores, especially around my nose, which was very satisfying. The therapist also used Gua Sha and worked gently around my under eyes, which felt really nice.

I waited until the next day to write this review because I wanted to see how my skin would look, and it was glowing and felt really refreshed.

I also added the hammer massage and it worked really well. I work in an office all day so my shoulders are always tight, and this helped release a lot of that tension.

The floral tea they serve after the treatment is also really good. I liked it so much I went back for a second cup. The therapist was kind and skilled, and the whole place feels calm and very clean. I will definitely come back again ❤️ 🪷

reviews.name: Danielle Richards
reviews.text:
Absolutely AMAZING experience at Bloom Massage!

I had the Tok Sen Massage, and honestly… this is something everyone NEEDS to try at least once. It’s completely different from a normal massage — deep, rhythmic, and incredibly powerful. You can literally feel the vibration working deep into your muscles, right down to the bone.

At first, it’s intense — but in the best way possible. Every bit of tension, tightness, and stress just gets released. It feels like your whole body is being reset from the inside out.

Afterwards? I felt like a completely new person — lighter, looser, refreshed, and fully recharged.

If you’re in Bangkok, this is a MUST DO. Hands down one of the best and most unique treatments I’ve ever had. Highly recommend! 🌿✨

reviews.name: Brenda Tan
reviews.text:
I came here specially after seeing the multiple good reviews, so I feel very compelled to write this review so that people are aware.

I got a gua sha facial massage, which was 1800 baht for 45 minutes. This price is higher than some of the more luxurious spa buildings.  For that price, you are on a thin massage bed behind a curtain right by a busy corridor. It is noisy, the masseuse (bless her heart because she was otherwise so sweet) was not well trained - eg hand movements were messy and got hair all over my face, the pressure was inconsistent the entire time, and she spent at least 15 minutes removing very minimal makeup which meant the actual facial massage only lasted 15 minutes (if even that), before a sloppy massage on your limbs with a sheet mask slapped on top of your face.

I was stressed and so disappointed the entire time. I would not have been so upset if the price for this treatment wasn’t absolutely insane and unreasonable. When I came back out, the staff completed cleared out and there was no one at the front desk so I couldn’t even give feedback. I feel like that was purposeful, and it made me feel like I got scammed. From the bottom of my heart, would not recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Brenda, thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

We’re sorry to hear that your visit did not feel as relaxing as you had hoped. As our spa is located inside a shopping mall in the heart of Bangkok, our treatment areas are designed with curtains to provide privacy within that setting while still offering guests the convenience of an easily accessible location.

Regarding the treatment itself, our therapists are trained to work carefully around areas such as eyelash extensions to avoid disturbing them, which can sometimes slightly limit certain facial movements around the eye area. In addition, when guests are taking photos or videos during the session, therapists may pause or adjust their technique to avoid interfering, which can affect the natural flow of the treatment.

Regarding the front desk, our receptionist is normally present during operating hours and may have briefly stepped away at that moment. We apologize if this caused any inconvenience when your treatment finished.

We also appreciate your kind comment about our therapist being sweet. Your feedback is important to us and we will continue working with our team to improve the experience for all of our guests.

reviews.text: Clean and quiet environment for decent & proper massages. Alisa and Nong were very skilled in full body massage. Will come back again.

reviews.name: Tijan Samba
reviews.text: Amazing salon i have been dealing with a tensed back for weeks and now i left with a complete working fit body. The service was amazing verg clean and nice people. Even got in vited for tea!

reviews.name: Kims' Chronicles
reviews.text: Wow! After reading the reviews I was excited to visit this place. The place looks small and not very fancy....but don't be put off by that. The inside is nice and the women doing the massages were older and very experienced. It truly was my best massage in Thailand and I've had a lot. The lady went slow and really got all of the knots out. She also cracked some spots, and it felt great. They serve tea and small pastries after. I recommend others to visit and you won't be disappointed. The staff are kind and friendly. I will be going back for sure.

reviews.name: Double Duaty
reviews.text:
Namste and thashidelek my name is pasang  sherpa , I would like to share some of my experiences with you on this social network. A few weeks ago I went to Manju Tilla, Delhi, India to visit.Similarly, while staying there, we were missing Nepali food. While looking around for food, I came across a board that read Nirvana Thakaliki Kitchen. Me and some of my friends went there to eat. The ambiance and hospitality of that restaurant was excellent. All the staff working there were very helpful and cheerful. The food was amazing and delicious.

The ambiance was very beautiful, calm and clean.
I would like to thank you very much for opening such a good Nepali restaurant in a foreign land and serving the customers. I would like to thank the management team from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.name: Nico
reviews.text: "Massage Near Me" is a relatively new establishment and they are starting off on the right foot. Initially I got confused as I couldn't find the shop name in the vicinity. Just look for the sign that says "massage" in big letters. The interior is nice and clean, everything is new as it should be and there's a sense of space in this establishment because the chairs and beds are not tightly arranged. They start with a foot bath with salt scrub, a cool drink and end off with a hot drink. I had a good massage done by an experienced masseuse (Nutt) who knew instinctively where my trouble "areas" were and worked on them. She did more than expected and I was grateful for her added effort. They open till late and offer a range of services like hot oil, Thai standard, etc - check with the proprietor Ms Palm who speaks English confidently. Perhaps best to call in advance so that you don't have to wait.

reviews.name: Celina Bigos
reviews.text:
Very professional and experienced therapists with strong hands and excellent knowledge of the human body. My neck had always been stiff and hard like a rock, but the therapist was able to ease the pain significantly.

I highly recommend this place. I only wish I could have a massage like this in Poland!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you we hope to see you again soon

reviews.name: Janelle Ann
reviews.text: Overall good experience just that I dun enjoy being in the same big room with men having their massage beside me. There are curtains for privacy but it’s only half drawn.  Tea was served lukewarm.

reviews.name: BAO DONG
reviews.text: I highly recommend their massage services. My therapist's name is Rabbit. She is so professional, as soon as she touched my shoulder and neck, she asked if I had a migraine. I originally booked one and a half hours, but it was so relaxing that I added another 30 minutes. Within those two hours, my therapist completely relieved my migraine. I am so grateful.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you we hope to see you again soon

reviews.name: Gregg Schatz
reviews.text:
Our go to in Chang Mai, friendly talented staff, excellent prices. I love the standard Thai massage and the misses loves the hot oil.
Definitely 5 stars! Thank you for fixing me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Sharka “Sharka-Kama” Adrlova
reviews.text:
Best massages ever. Clean rooms with aircon and shower available after the oil massage.
I had the 3h long package (foot massage,  thai massage and oil massage) Every part was perfect and I have to recommend to everyone to take at least 2h! One hour is not enough. :) Very well priced and worth every penny.
You'll receive lovely Bael tea after session to relax before leaving.
Can't wait to come back next year

reviews.name: Jane
reviews.text: Very nice service and affordable price, they have 1 hr, 1.5hr, and 2 hr courses too! Starts at 250 baht per hr. The staff can recommend the best course for you, and the have promotions for services at 11:00-14:00.

reviews.name: Rowley Livock
